stem: What were people in parts of Scotland advised to do?

options.text: Watch the weather forecast.
Evacuate the area with the orange alert.
Avoid travel on Wednesday.
Prepare enough food and drink.

explanation:
【题目】What were people in parts of Scotland advised to do?
【翻译】苏格兰部分地区的人们被建议做什么?
A) 观看天气预报。
B) 撤离橙色警报区域。
C) 避免在周三出行。
D) 准备足够的食物和饮料。
【答案】C （细节题）Avoid travel on Wednesday.
【定位】The transport minister advised people in parts of Scotland covered by the orange alert to avoid travel on Wednesday.
交通大臣建议橙色预警覆盖区域内的苏格兰民众，周三不要出行。
【信号】建议动词 advised 直接领出动作。信号是建议动词本身——录音里 The transport minister advised people in parts of Scotland covered by the orange alert to avoid travel on Wednesday. 中 advised…to 后面跟的 avoid travel on Wednesday 就是被建议做的事，听到 advised 立刻锁定它后面的动词短语。
【替换】advised people in parts of Scotland covered by the orange alert to avoid travel on Wednesday ↔ Avoid travel on Wednesday.
几乎原句裁剪，去掉对象状语

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音开头说 heavy snow is forecast across the country，出现了 forecast 一词，A Watch the weather forecast. 就靠"看天气预报"这个原词诱你选；但录音从没建议民众去看预报，是答非所问。
借用原文：heavy snow is forecast across the country
B)
原词陷阱
录音多次出现 Orange warnings are in force for many areas 和 orange alert，B Evacuate the area with the orange alert. 借"橙色预警/区域"这些原词制造熟悉感；但录音只让"avoid travel"（别出行），从没说"evacuate"（撤离），动作被偷换了。
借用原文：Orange warnings are in force for many areas
D)
张冠李戴
录音后半对司机说 Drivers should make sure they're prepared for their journey with warm clothing, food and drink，出现了 food and drink，D Prepare enough food and drink. 就盗这组词；但这条是对"司机"说的、且本题问的是"民众"被建议做什么，对象和位置都错了。
借用原文：Drivers should make sure they're prepared for their journey with warm clothing, food and drink
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the head of road policing urge drivers to do?

options.text: Pay more attention to the roads.
Stay at a safer place.
Bring more mobile phones.
Take a train home.

explanation:
【题目】What did the head of road policing urge drivers to do?
【翻译】道路警务负责人敦促驾驶员做什么?
A) 更加注意路况。
B) 待在更安全的地方。
C) 携带更多手机。
D) 乘火车回家。
【答案】A （细节题）Pay more attention to the roads.
【定位】The head of road policing said, "I would urge drivers to take extra care on the roads for their journeys."
道路警务负责人说："我要敦促司机们在出行途中格外注意路况。"
【信号】催促动词 urge 紧领核心动作。信号是 I would urge drivers to take extra care on the roads 里的 urge——题干用的就是 urge，录音原话也用 urge，词后接的 take extra care on the roads 就是答案落点，听到 urge 立刻锁其后。
【替换】take extra care on the roads ↔Pay more attention to the roads.
同义替换：take care=pay attention

【排除】B)
过度推断
录音末句 consider if you really need to travel when conditions are this poor 让人联想"找更安全的地方"，B Stay at a safer place. 借这股"安全"语感诱选；但 urge 后真正的动作是"take care on the roads"（在路上当心），不是"待在更安全处"，是过度推断。
借用原文：consider if you really need to travel when conditions are this poor
C)
原词陷阱
录音对司机说 a charged mobile phone（带一部充好电的手机），C Bring more mobile phones. 盗 mobile phone 原词并把"一部充电的"偷改成"多带几部"；不仅数量错，这也不是 urge 那句的核心动作，是答非所问。
借用原文：a charged mobile phone
D)
原词陷阱
录音说 Trains, planes and ferries are also likely to be affected，出现了 trains，D Take a train home. 借"火车"原词诱选；但录音是讲"火车也会受影响"，根本没催司机坐火车回家，与 urge 那句无关。
借用原文：Trains, planes and ferries are also likely to be affected
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the news report mainly about?

options.text: There is only one ecosystem in Europe.
Romania's wetlands thrive again.
The wildlife in Romania isn't well protected.
There are 200 species of birds in Romania's wetlands.

explanation:
【题目】What is the news report mainly about?
【翻译】这则新闻报道主要讲的是什么?
A) 欧洲只有一个生态系统。
B) 罗马尼亚的湿地再次繁荣。
C) 罗马尼亚的野生动物没有得到很好的保护。
D) 罗马尼亚湿地有200种鸟类。
【答案】B （主旨题）Romania's wetlands thrive again.
【定位】Romania's wetlands are coming back to life thanks to help from local communities, the World Wildlife Fund, and funding from the European Union.
在当地社区、世界自然基金会以及欧盟资金的帮助下，罗马尼亚的湿地正在重新焕发生机。
【信号】开头点题句定主旨。新闻的主旨通常落在第一句导语。Romania's wetlands are coming back to life 开门见山点出整条消息的核心——罗马尼亚湿地正在复苏；后文的鸟类迁入、水道修复、禁渔提议都是围绕这一核心展开的细节。主旨题就锁这句开头的总述句。
【替换】coming back to life ↔thrive again
复苏 = 再度繁荣
Romania's wetlands ↔Romania's wetlands
主体同为罗马尼亚湿地
【排除】A)
未提及
录音从没说欧洲"只有一个生态系统"，There is only one ecosystem in Europe. 是凭空捏造，且 "only one" 这种绝对说法与新闻在讲某地恢复的事实毫不相干。
C)
与原文相反
录音盗用了 wildlife 这个词，The wildlife in Romania isn't well protected. 借它说"野生动物没被保护好"，但全篇是说湿地恢复、动物回归、政府还提出禁渔保护，方向恰恰相反，是把好消息说反了。
借用原文：filled with wildlife
D)
原词陷阱
There are 200 species of birds in Romania's wetlands. 盗用了录音的 "species of birds"制造熟悉感，但它只是篇中一个枝节数字，主旨题不能选细节项；何况录音明确说的是home to 300 species of birds——300 种，不是 200 种，数字也被改错了。
借用原文：home to 300 species of birds
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did government officials propose to do to protect the endangered fish?

options.text: Block the waterways.
Restore the fishing ban.
Use monitoring equipment.
Prohibit fishing in the next 10 years.

explanation:
【题目】What did government officials propose to do to protect the endangered fish?
【翻译】政府官员提议采取什么措施来保护濒危鱼类?
A) 封锁水道。
B) 恢复捕鱼禁令。
C) 使用监测设备。
D) 在未来10年禁止捕鱼。
【答案】D （细节题）Prohibit fishing in the next 10 years.
【定位】Government officials proposed to protect the area's endangered wild fish by issuing a fishing ban over the next decade.
政府官员提议，通过在未来十年颁布禁渔令来保护该地区濒危的野生鱼类。
【信号】提出做某事的动作句。题干问"官员提出做什么"，定位就盯表"提出"的动词。Government officials proposed to protect…by issuing a fishing ban over the next decade 里的"proposed…by issuing a fishing ban" 正是那个动作句，by 后面跟的"颁布禁渔令"就是具体做法，答案落在这里。
【替换】issuing a fishing ban ↔Prohibit fishing
禁渔令 = 禁止捕鱼
over the next decade ↔in the next 10 years
decade = 10 年
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
Block the waterways. 盗用了录音里的 "waterways"，但录音说的是用设备去 restore the waterways（修复水道），方向是修复、不是 block（阻断）；而且这是修复水道的动作，不是保护鱼的措施，把别处的动作安到本题上了。
借用原文：restore the waterways
B)
原词陷阱
Restore the fishing ban. 几乎照搬录音原词 fishing ban，极易"听到就选"；但录音是issuing a fishing ban（新颁布一项禁渔令），不是 restore（恢复一项原有的禁渔令）——动词 issue 被偷换成 restore，意思变了。
借用原文：issuing a fishing ban
C)
答非所问
Use monitoring equipment. 盗用了录音里的 "equipment"，但录音说的是 Groups used earth-moving equipment to restore the waterways——是各团体用"挖土设备"修水道，既不是 monitoring（监测）设备，也不是官员保护鱼提出的措施，与本题问的事对不上。
借用原文：used earth-moving equipment to restore the waterways
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What happened to Scott a month ago?

options.text: He had a car accident.
He attended his graduation ceremony.
He had a heart attack.
He gave a performance in the auditorium.

explanation:
【题目】What happened to Scott a month ago?
【翻译】一个月前Scott发生了什么事？
A) 他出了车祸。
B) 他参加了毕业典礼。
C) 他心脏病发作了。
D) 他在礼堂进行了表演。
【答案】A （细节题）He had a car accident.
【定位】Scott Dunn recently awoke from a medically-induced sleep he'd been in after a car accident.
斯科特·邓恩最近从一次医学诱导的昏睡中醒来,此前他因一场车祸而陷入昏睡。
【信号】开篇即点核心事件。新闻开篇第一句就交代主人公遭遇,awoke from a medically-induced sleep he'd been in after a car accident 直接点出 car accident 这一核心事件,新闻"开门见山报事件"的特点使首句成为答案句。
【替换】after a car accident ↔He had a car accident.
几乎原句对应

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
He attended his graduation ceremony. 盗用了反复出现的原词 graduation;但题问 a month ago 时他出了车祸、恰恰"错过"了原定典礼(he'd missed his high school graduation),并未在一月前参加典礼,属答非所问。
借用原文：he'd missed his high school graduation
C)
未提及
He had a heart attack. 与正确事件"车祸"同属突发坏事、听感都急促,极易混;但原文只字未提心脏病,他遭遇的是 a car accident,此项把事件换成了原文没说的另一种。
D)
原词陷阱
He gave a performance in the auditorium. 盗用了原文真出现的地点词 auditorium;但原文 auditorium 是同学们聚集补办典礼的礼堂,从无他"表演"一说,属借原词无中生有。
借用原文：met in the school's auditorium for graduation
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did Scott ask about when he regained consciousness?

options.text: What happened to him.
What date it was.
When the graduation ceremony was.
Where he was.

explanation:
【题目】What did Scott ask about when he regained consciousness?
【翻译】Scott恢复意识后问了什么？
A) 他发生了什么事。
B) 当时是几号。
C) 毕业典礼什么时候举行。
D) 他在哪里。
【答案】B （细节题）What date it was.
【定位】"I remember waking up in the hospital and asking mom what date it was. She told me it was the 28th," he said.
"我记得在医院醒来,问妈妈那天是几号。她告诉我是28号,"他说。
【信号】他亲口说出的问话。答案句是他本人的直接引语 asking mom what date it was,动词asking 后面紧跟的 what date it was 就是他问的内容,人物原话里"问了什么"即答案信号。
【替换】asking mom what date it was ↔What date it was.
问话内容原样对应

【排除】A)
答非所问
What happened to him. 像是承接"出了车祸"的合理联想,但题干问的是他苏醒后"问了什么",原文他问的是 what date it was,并没有问"自己发生了什么",此项答错了方向。
C)
原词陷阱
When the graduation ceremony was. 盗用了高频原词 graduation,又和正确项同样关乎"时间",极易混;但他问的是 date(几号),不是"典礼在何时",原文中典礼时间是后文交代、并非他苏醒时所问。
借用原文：met in the school's auditorium for graduation
D)
未提及
Where he was. 把疑问维度换成"地点";苏醒后问自己身处何地虽是常见桥段,但原文他问的是日期 what date it was,从未问 where,此项是原文没出现的内容。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why was Scott speechless at the graduation ceremony?

options.text: He was really touched by his classmates.
He didn't know what happened at all.
He couldn't remember what to say.
His parents wore caps and gowns.

explanation:
【题目】Why was Scott speechless at the graduation ceremony?
【翻译】为什么Scott在毕业典礼上说不出话来？
A) 他真的被同学们感动了。
B) 他完全不知道发生了什么。
C) 他记不起来该说什么。
D) 他的父母穿着学位袍和戴着学位帽。
【答案】A （细节题）He was really touched by his classmates.
【定位】"I'm speechless," Scott said. "I don't know how to even explain it. I'm speechless to know that so many people are behind me."
"我说不出话来,"斯科特说。"我都不知道该怎么形容。得知有这么多人支持我,我激动得说不出话。"
【信号】结尾本人道出缘由。答案句在新闻收尾处,他自己点明 I'm speechless to know that so many people are behind me,speechless 后面的 to know that… 正是"说不出话"的原因——这么多人支持他,本人解释句即答案信号。
【替换】so many people are behind me ↔He was really touched by his classmates.
概括:被众人支持=被同学感动

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】B)
与原文相反
He didn't know what happened at all. 借用了原文 I don't know how to even explain it里的 don't know 字样;但他说的是"不知如何形容(激动)",并非"完全不知道发生了什么",事实上他很清楚同学为他补办了典礼,此项把意思扭反了。
借用原文：I don't know how to even explain it
C)
偷换概念
He couldn't remember what to say. 与 speechless/"说不出话"听感极近,最具迷惑性;但speechless 在此是"激动得说不出话",原因是被支持感动,而非"想不起该说什么",二者并非一回事。
D)
原词陷阱
His parents wore caps and gowns. 盗用了原文确实念过的画面词 caps and gowns;但原文穿学位帽袍的是 Students(同学),不是他父母,且这画面与"他为何说不出话"无关,既张冠又答非所问。
借用原文：Students wore their caps and gowns and sat in the front of the auditorium
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say is the disadvantage of working from home?

options.text: Her children's disruption.
Quiet atmosphere.
A sense of isolation.
Longer working hours.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say is the disadvantage of working from home?
【翻译】女士说在家工作的缺点是什么?
A) 孩子们的干扰。
B) 安静的氛围。
C) 孤立感。
D) 更长的工作时间。
【答案】C （细节题）A sense of isolation.
【定位】I find isolation challenging at times. Apart from my mother, not too many people I know have time for phone chats during working hours.
我有时觉得孤立很难熬。除了我妈妈，我认识的人里没几个在工作时间有空跟我闲聊。
【信号】被问者直接应答。男士先抛出 Do you enjoy working from home?，女士在回答里直说 I find isolation challenging at times.，这句被问者的直接应答就是答案信号。
【替换】I find isolation challenging at times ↔A sense of isolation.
同根词换说法

【排除】A)
全文女士只提到 Apart from my mother，从未说孩子打扰，Her children's disruption. 是凭居家办公的常识脑补出来的，原文无据。
B)
原词陷阱
Quiet atmosphere. 盗用了原文 I find the library a bit too quiet. 里的 quiet，但那是男士评价图书馆，不是女士说的居家办公弊端，张冠李戴。
借用原文：I find the library a bit too quiet.
D)
Longer working hours. 也是居家办公常被吐槽的点，但女士全程没提工时长短，属凭印象添加的未提及项。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say is counterproductive to getting work done in the library?

options.text: It doesn't offer coffee.
It's too quiet.
It doesn't have free Wi-Fi.
It lacks the materials he needs.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say is counterproductive to getting work done in the library?
【翻译】男士说在图书馆完成工作时什么是适得其反的?
A) 它不提供咖啡。
B) 它太安静了。
C) 它没有免费Wi-Fi。
D) 它缺少他需要的资料。
【答案】B （细节题）It's too quiet.
【定位】I find the library a bit too quiet. I'd lack inspiration or stimulation, which would be counterproductive to getting a lot of work done.
我觉得图书馆有点太安静了。我会缺少灵感或刺激，这会对完成大量工作起反作用。
【信号】因果链指向起因。男士说太安静会导致 lack inspiration or stimulation, which would be counterproductive，counterproductive 的源头顺着 which 往前推就是 too quiet，因果链就是答案信号。
【替换】I find the library a bit too quiet ↔It's too quiet.
近乎原句压缩

【排除】A)
It doesn't offer coffee. 借了后文咖啡馆话题里的 coffee 来诱选，但男士说图书馆的问题是太安静，从没说图书馆不供咖啡，答非所问。
借用原文：Coffee shops seem to have effectively become office spaces
C)
It doesn't have free Wi-Fi. 原文从未提及 Wi-Fi，是利用办公缺网络这一常识硬造的未提及项。
D)
It lacks the materials he needs. 把男士说的缺 inspiration or stimulation 灵感刺激，偷换成缺实体资料，概念被换了。
借用原文：I'd lack inspiration or stimulation
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman like about doing one's work in a café?

options.text: The sense of being out in the world.
The coffee it provides.
The coffee table.
The comfortable working conditions.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman like about doing one's work in a café?
【翻译】女士喜欢在咖啡馆工作的什么方面?
A) 置身于外面世界的感觉。
B) 它提供的咖啡。
C) 咖啡桌。
D) 舒适的工作条件。
【答案】A （细节题）The sense of being out in the world.
【定位】I love the noise, the people, the busyness of the café, the sense of being out in the world.
我喜欢那种喧闹、人来人往、咖啡馆的忙碌，还有那种置身世界之中的感觉。
【信号】I love 喜爱信号。女士用 I love the noise, the people, the busyness 直接亮出喜爱信号，I love 后面一串并列就是她喜欢的点，是最明确的答案信号。
【替换】the sense of being out in the world ↔The sense of being out in the world.
原句直接命中
【排除】B)
The coffee it provides. 蹭的是咖啡馆 café 这个场景词，但女士 I love 的清单里是噪音、人群、忙碌，根本没提咖啡本身，答非所问。
借用原文：the busyness of the café
C)
The coffee table. 利用 coffee 一词的近形干扰，原文从未出现 coffee table，是凭咖啡馆联想硬造的未提及项。
D)
The comfortable working conditions. 把咖啡馆想象成舒适的办公环境，但女士喜欢的是热闹忙碌，原文未提舒适，属未提及。

stem: What is most annoying for café owners according to the woman?

options.text: People don't order anything.
People bring their laptops and paperwork.
People occupy valuable table space in quiet times.
People of two occupy a table for six.

explanation:
【题目】What is most annoying for café owners according to the woman?
【翻译】根据女士的说法,对咖啡馆老板来说最令人恼火的是什么?
A) 人们什么都不点。
B) 人们带着笔记本电脑和文件。
C) 人们在清闲时段占据宝贵的桌位空间。
D) 两个人占用一张六人桌。
【答案】D （细节题）People of two occupy a table for six.
【定位】The most annoying ones for café owners must surely be those usually only two of them who occupy a table for six with their laptops and paperwork.
对咖啡馆老板来说，最招人烦的肯定是那些通常只有两个人却占着一张六人桌、摆满笔记本电脑和文件的人。
【信号】the most 最高级。女士用 The most annoying ones for café owners must surely be 这个最高级加 surely 强调，直接把最招烦的圈定为后面那种人，最高级就是答案信号。
【替换】only two of them who occupy a table for six ↔People of two occupy a table for six.
原句改写为选项
【排除】A)
People don't order anything. 盗用了原文 not order much，但那只是女士先提的一般性烦恼，没被 the most 修饰，不点单不是最招烦的那条。
借用原文：spend a lot of time there and not order much
B)
People bring their laptops and paperwork. 直接搬了原文 with their laptops and paperwork，但带电脑文件只是六人桌那种人的修饰细节，本身不是被点名最招烦的行为，原词陷阱。
借用原文：occupy a table for six with their laptops and paperwork
C)
People occupy valuable table space in quiet times. 盗用了末段 take up the valuable table space，但原文说占用宝贵桌位是在 busy periods，并非 quiet times，时段被说反。
借用原文：they can take up the valuable table space in busy periods
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第14页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What makes the woman think about changing her job?

options.text: She is not satisfied with the salary.
She is not capable of the job.
She often works overtime.
She's received a job offer from another company.

explanation:
【题目】What makes the woman think about changing her job?

【翻译】是什么让这位女士考虑换工作?
A) 她对薪水不满意。
B) 她无法胜任这份工作。
C) 她经常加班。
D) 她收到了另一家公司的工作邀请。
【答案】A （细节题）She is not satisfied with the salary.
【定位】And I really think my skills and abilities deserve a higher salary.
而且我真心觉得，凭我的技能和能力，理应拿到更高的薪水。
【信号】I really think 主观加重语气标出真实理由。她在 I really think my skills and abilities deserve a higher salary 里用 I really think 加重语气，亮出最直接的换工作动因——觉得自己值更高的薪水，这种当事人强调式的自述句就是原因题的答案句。
【替换】my skills and abilities deserve a higher salary ↔not satisfied with the salary
"理应拿更高薪"="对现薪不满"的换说法
【排除】B)
与原文相反
原文里她说 my skills and abilities deserve a higher salary，是在标榜自己能力强、配更高薪，选项却说她 not capable of the job，把意思反了过来。
借用原文：my skills and abilities deserve a higher salary
C)
未提及
对话从头到尾在谈薪水、晋升、忠诚，从没提到她"常加班"，She often works overtime.是凭"职场"话题想当然补出来的，原文无据。
D)
与原文相反
她说的是 I'm going to start looking for another job——还没开始找，更没拿到 offer，选项 She's received a job offer from another company. 把"准备去找"夸成"已经拿到offer"，与原文不符。
借用原文：I'm going to start looking for another job
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about people who keep changing their jobs?

options.text: They may be considered as less loyal.
They won't get the promotion opportunities.
They should take more responsibility at work.
They will be given hiring priority.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about people who keep changing their jobs?
【翻译】这位男士如何评价那些不断换工作的人?
A) 他们可能会被认为忠诚度较低。
B) 他们不会获得晋升机会。
C) 他们应该在工作中承担更多责任。
D) 他们将获得招聘优先权。
【答案】A （细节题）They may be considered as less loyal.
【定位】If you do several jobs in a relatively short span of time, prospective employers might perceive that you lack loyalty.
如果你在相对短的时间里做了好几份工作，未来的雇主可能会觉得你缺乏忠诚度。

【信号】被问方男方的直接论断句。题目问"男方怎么说"，答案就落在男方那段 prospective employers might perceive that you lack loyalty——这是男方针对频繁换工作者下的直接判断，正是该题答案句。
【替换】might perceive that you lack loyalty ↔considered as less loyal
perceive…lack loyalty = considered as less loyal
【排除】B)
未提及
男方只说雇主会觉得你不忠诚、因而 reluctant to employ you，谈的是"难被录用"，并没说"得不到晋升机会"，They won't get the promotion opportunities. 在男方这段里无据。
C)
张冠李戴
They wanted you to take on more work and responsibility 里的 more responsibility确实被念到了，但那是男方在转述女方旧东家的做法，不是男方"对频繁换工作者"的说法，选项 They should take more responsibility at work. 盗了 responsibility 一词张冠李戴。
借用原文：They wanted you to take on more work and responsibility
D)
与原文相反
男方的判断是雇主会 wary and reluctant to employ you(迟疑、不愿录用)，方向是负面的；选项 They will be given hiring priority. 却说成"被优先录用"，把极性彻底反了。
借用原文：wary and reluctant to employ you
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say would happen even if she got promoted in her current company?

options.text: She might have to do extra work every day.
She might not get a pay rise.
She might not get enough vacation.
She might not gain more experience.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say would happen even if she got promoted in her current company?
【翻译】这位女士说即使她在目前公司获得晋升会发生什么?
A) 她可能每天都要做额外的工作。
B) 她可能得不到加薪。
C) 她可能得不到足够的假期。
D) 她可能无法获得更多经验。
【答案】B （细节题）She might not get a pay rise.
【定位】And even if I get a promotion, I'm not guaranteed to get a raise.
而且就算我升了职，也不一定能涨薪。
【信号】even if 让步句，转折后才是真意。她在 even if I get a promotion, I'm not guaranteed to get a raise 用 even if 设让步——"升职"是铺垫，让步后的"不一定涨薪"才是她要表达的代价，正是答案句。
【替换】not guaranteed to get a raise ↔might not get a pay rise
not guaranteed a raise = might not get a pay rise

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
take on more work and responsibility 里的 more work 确被念到，但那是男方追问女方"过去那家公司"的情形，不是"在现公司升职后"的后果；且选项 She might have to do extra work every day. 多出 every day，原文从未说"每天"，属夸大。
借用原文：They wanted you to take on more work and responsibility
C)
未提及
全程谈的是薪水、晋升、忠诚、经验，从没涉及 vacation，She might not get enough vacation. 在原文中毫无依据。
D)
与原文相反
经验在原文里是女方的正面收获 I've gathered a lot of experience，并非"升职后得不到"的坏处，选项 She might not gain more experience. 把它说成负面后果，方向相反。
借用原文：I've gathered a lot of experience in different jobs
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What benefit has the woman gained from changing her jobs frequently?

options.text: Experience.
Confidence.
Fortune.
Opportunity.

explanation:
【题目】What benefit has the woman gained from changing her jobs frequently?
【翻译】这位女士从频繁换工作中获得了什么好处?
A) 经验。
B) 信心。
C) 财富。
D) 机会。
【答案】A （细节题）Experience.
【定位】The way I see it, through having different jobs, I've gathered a lot of experience in different jobs and in different industries.
在我看来，通过做不同的工作，我在不同岗位、不同行业里积累了很多经验。
【信号】I've gathered + experience 的收获自述。她用 I've gathered a lot of experience 这一"动词 gather + 名词 experience"的搭配，亲口说出频繁换工作的收获，正是 benefit 题的答案句。
【替换】I've gathered a lot of experience ↔Experience.
gathered experience → Experience

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
I feel pretty confident that I can sell myself 里 confident 确被念到，但那是她描述自己的心态、回应别人对她经验不深的质疑，并不是"频繁换工作带来的好处"，选项Confidence. 盗了 confident 一词答非所问。
借用原文：I feel pretty confident that I can sell myself
C)
原词陷阱
录音结尾的谚语 Fortune favors the brave 里有 Fortune，但那只是她引用的一句鼓励自己的俗话，绝非"换工作得到的好处"，选项 Fortune. 正是预读预警过的"谚语原词"陷阱。
借用原文：Fortune favors the brave
D)
原词陷阱
an opportunity to progress 里 opportunity 出现过，但那是她抱怨现公司"看不到晋升机会"，是她缺的东西、不是换工作的收获，选项 Opportunity. 盗用该词反着用。
借用原文：getting an opportunity to progress

stem: What does the speaker say about being alone?

options.text: It's a horrible feeling.
It can be a blessing.
It's boring and dangerous.
It's the most comfortable state.

explanation:
【题目】What does the speaker say about being alone?
【翻译】说话者关于独处说了什么？
A) 这是一种可怕的感觉。
B) 这可能是一件好事。
C) 这既无聊又危险。
D) 这是最舒适的状态。
【答案】B （态度观点题）It can be a blessing.
【定位】In contrast, being alone can actually be a blessing, particularly when you've actively chosen it.
相比之下，独自一人其实可以是一件幸事，尤其是当你主动选择独处的时候。
【信号】转折 In contrast 后才是真意。前句 Loneliness is a horrible feeling. 讲的是『孤独』的坏，紧接着 In contrast, being alone can actually be a blessing 用 In contrast 转折，把话头转到『独自一人』并给出正面定性。转折信号之后那句才是对 being alone 的真正评价，正是答案句。
【替换】being alone can actually be a blessing ↔It can be a blessing.
近乎同句，只换主语措辞
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
It's a horrible feeling. 抄了录音 Loneliness is a horrible feeling. 的原词 horrible feeling，但那句形容的是 loneliness（孤独），不是题目问的 being alone（独自一人）。听到 horrible feeling 就勾，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：Loneliness is a horrible feeling.
C)
与原文相反
It's boring and dangerous. 借了录音 being bored and alone is dangerous 里的dangerous，但原文说的是『又无聊又独处才危险』，是有条件的；并非给 being alone 本身定性为危险。把条件去掉直接说独处『就是』无聊危险，与原意不符。
借用原文：being bored and alone is dangerous and can easily lead to the feeling of loneliness
D)
过度推断
It's the most comfortable state. 用了 the most comfortable 这种最高级，把独处吹成『最舒适的状态』。录音只说它可以是 a blessing，从未说它是『最舒适』，属于无中生有的拔高。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第20页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the speaker say helps reduce one's feeling of loneliness?

options.text: To be active.
To meet up with your friends.
To travel abroad.
To seek advice from others.

explanation:
【题目】What does the speaker say helps reduce one's feeling of loneliness?
【翻译】说话者说什么有助于减少孤独感？
A) 保持活跃。
B) 与朋友见面。
C) 出国旅行。
D) 向他人寻求建议。
【答案】A （细节题）To be active.
【定位】The trick is to be active.
诀窍就是让自己动起来、保持活跃。
【信号】建议句 The trick is to…。前一句说『又无聊又独处会导致孤独感』，紧接着用 The trick is to be active. 给出对策。The trick is to 是典型的建议/方法信号，其后的 be active 就是说话人开出的药方，是答案句。
【替换】The trick is to be active ↔To be active.
原句核心动作直接对应
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
To meet up with your friends. 抄了录音 meet up with your friends，但原文说的是『独处一阵后再去见朋友，你会更投入』，讲的是见朋友的好时机，不是用来减轻孤独感的办法。听到 meet up with friends 就勾，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：when it's time to be social and meet up with your friends, you will be fully there
C)
未提及
To travel abroad. 说出国旅行，录音只讲了 Get outside（出去走走）、do something cultural（做点文化活动），从未提到 travel abroad，属于无中生有。
D)
未提及
To seek advice from others. 说向别人求教，听起来合常识，但录音给的对策是 be active（自己动起来），全程没说要 seek advice from others，是凭常识硬填的干扰项。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is an advantage of spending one's time alone?

options.text: It provides a chance for people to think deeply.
It makes us treasure the time.
It enables one to identify true friends.
It helps us take care of problems more efficiently.

explanation:
【题目】What is an advantage of spending one's time alone?
【翻译】独处的好处是什么？
A) 它为人们提供了深入思考的机会。
B) 它使我们珍惜时间。
C) 它使人能够识别真正的朋友。
D) 它帮助我们更高效地处理问题。

【答案】D （细节题）It helps us take care of problems more efficiently.
【定位】Spending time alone also allows you to more efficiently take care of problems.
独处还能让你更高效地处理各种问题。
【信号】列举好处的 also allows you to…。录音用 Spending time alone also allows you to more efficiently take care of problems 直接陈述独处的一项好处，also 表明这是在罗列益处中的又一条，allows you to 引出具体好处，是答案句。
【替换】more efficiently take care of problems ↔It helps us take care of problems more efficiently.
几乎原词，仅调整语序
【排除】A)
未提及
It provides a chance for people to think deeply. 说独处给人深入思考的机会，听起来合理，但录音列举的好处是『高效处理问题、社交时更投入、更珍惜朋友』，从没提 think deeply，属于未提及。
B)
偷换概念
It makes us treasure the time. 蹭了录音结尾 your time spent together will be more worthwhile 里的 time，但原文说的是『和朋友共处的时间更值得』，不是『珍惜时间（treasure the time）』。借 time 一词偷换概念。
借用原文：your time spent together will be more worthwhile
C)
偷换概念
It enables one to identify true friends. 蹭了录音 appreciate your friends' company more 里的 friends，但原文说的是独处后『更珍惜朋友的陪伴』，不是『辨别出真朋友（identify true friends）』。借 friends 一词偷换概念。
借用原文：you will also appreciate your friends' company more
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the speaker's father?

options.text: He is a harsh person.
He is mean to others.
He is very demanding in his work.
He usually works very late.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the speaker's father?
【翻译】关于说话者的父亲我们了解到什么?
A) 他是一个严厉的人。
B) 他对别人刻薄。
C) 他在工作中要求很高。
D) 他通常工作到很晚。
【答案】C （细节题）He is very demanding in his work.
【定位】My father wasn't being mean. He demanded the same of himself.
我父亲并不是刻薄。他对自己也是同样的要求。
【信号】否定澄清句定调。My father wasn't being mean. 用 wasn't 主动否定'刻薄'这一负面解读，紧接着 He demanded the same of himself. 把父亲的真实形象定为'对工作和自己都要求高'——这种'先否定误解、再给真意'的句子就是答案信号。
【替换】anybody who worked for Thomas Kahoon had to meet his standards ↔ very demanding in his work
高标准=要求高

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
He is a harsh person. 的 harsh 在录音里确实出现过，但那是 the harsh acid smell of the cleaning solution 形容清洁剂刺鼻的气味，根本不是说父亲这个人苛刻——典型听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：the harsh acid smell of the cleaning solution
B)
与原文相反
He is mean to others. 的 mean 录音里出现在 My father wasn't being mean.——是被wasn't 否定掉的说法，选它等于把说话人否定的话当成了肯定的结论，方向正好相反。
借用原文：My father wasn't being mean.
D)
张冠李戴
He usually works very late. 里'待到很晚'对应 he made me stay late until I got it right，但那是父亲让'我'留下来重做，加班的是说话人自己，不是父亲；而且这是偶尔(做错时)而非 usually(通常)。
借用原文：he made me stay late until I got it right
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2020-07/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the speaker say about the housing project?

options.text: He moved out and divorced.
He was plagued by drugs and gang violence.
He lived there for 20 years.
His parents would move into his new house.

explanation:
【题目】What does the speaker say about the housing project?
【翻译】关于住房项目说话者说了什么?
A) 他搬出去并离婚了。
B) 他深受毒品和帮派暴力困扰。
C) 他在那里住了20年。
D) 他的父母会搬进他的新房子。
【答案】B （细节题）He was plagued by drugs and gang violence.
【定位】I moved out of my parents' modest place into a housing project. Drugs and gang violence were just beginning to plague the projects.
我搬出父母简朴的住处，住进了一个公共住宅区。毒品和帮派暴力当时正开始侵扰这些住宅区。
【信号】定位词后紧跟的描述句。录音一出现定位词 a housing project，下一句立刻 Drugs and gang violence were just beginning to plague the projects. 给出对这个地方的直接描述——题目问的对象一出现，紧跟其后的那句往往就是答案句。
【替换】Drugs and gang violence were just beginning to plague the projects ↔ He was plagued by drugs and gang violence
主语换了人但同义

【排除】A)
未提及
He moved out and divorced. 前半'搬走'对应 I got married and moved out，但录音说的是结婚后搬出，全篇只字未提 divorced(离婚)；这一半凭空捏造，整项就错。
借用原文：I got married and moved out
C)
原词陷阱
He lived there for 20 years. 的 20 在录音里确实念到，但 when I was 20 说的是他结婚那年20岁，是年龄不是在那住了20年——数字被挪去说时长，对象偷换了。
借用原文：when I was 20
D)
与原文相反
His parents would move into his new house. 说父母搬进他的新家，而录音是'我'从父母处搬出 moved out of my parents' modest place，方向正相反，且录音从没提父母搬来。

stem: What do we learn about the speaker as a stock clerk?

options.text: He was only responsible for unloading food.
He had to sign his name on every label.
It was a hard and tedious job.
He was required to work on Friday night.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the speaker as a stock clerk?
【翻译】关于说话者作为仓库管理员我们了解到什么?
A) 他只负责卸载食品。
B) 他必须在每个标签上签名。
C) 这是一份艰苦而乏味的工作。
D) 他被要求在周五晚上工作。
【答案】C （细节题）It was a hard and tedious job.
【定位】When we married, I worked as a stock clerk at Southwest Super Foods. It was hard, tedious work.
我们结婚时，我在西南超级食品店做理货员。那是又苦又枯燥的活儿。
【信号】直接的概括评价句。录音点出身份 I worked as a stock clerk 后，紧跟一句 It was hard, tedious work. 对这份工作做整体定性——这种对工作'是个什么活儿'的直接概括句，正是问'当理货员是什么情况'的答案句。
【替换】It was hard, tedious work ↔It was a hard and tedious job
work=job 近义替换

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
He was only responsible for unloading food. 的 unload 对应 cases of food that had to be unloaded, priced, and placed on shelves，但录音说货物要卸货、定价、上架三件事都做，选项用 only 只留卸货，把职责框窄了，与原文不符。
借用原文：cases of food that had to be unloaded, priced, and placed on shelves
B)
偷换概念
He had to sign his name on every label. 的 label 对应 the labels facing smartly out，但录音是说他把罐头标签朝外摆齐、这是他的'招牌(signature 比喻)'，并非真在每个标签上签名；把 That was my signature. 的比喻签名当成了字面签名。
借用原文：the labels facing smartly out
D)
与原文相反
He was required to work on Friday night. 的 Friday night 录音里念过，但原文是别人都想请假、I was always ready to work 是他主动乐意上夜班，不是 required(被要求)；把自愿说成被强制，性质反了。
借用原文：I was always ready to work

stem: By what means did scientists at University College London measure memory loss?

options.text: By recording the time people spend on TV.
By tracking people's living habits.
By using memory and fluency tests.
By scanning people's brains.

explanation:
【题目】By what means did scientists at University College London measure memory loss?
【翻译】伦敦大学学院的科学家们通过什么方式测量记忆力衰退?
A) 通过记录人们看电视的时间。
B) 通过追踪人们的生活习惯。
C) 通过使用记忆力和流畅性测试。
D) 通过扫描人们的大脑。
【答案】C （细节题）By using memory and fluency tests.
【定位】Scientists at University College London used memory and fluency tests on the same group of people six years apart.
伦敦大学学院的科学家们对同一组人，前后相隔六年，做了记忆力与流畅度测试。
【信号】动作动词 used 紧跟方法。答案句信号是表"使用某方法"的动作动词 used memory and fluency tests，问"用什么手段"的细节题，落点就在这个 used 后面带出的具体工具上。
【替换】used memory and fluency tests ↔By using memory and fluency tests.
原句动词转成 By doing 的近乎直译
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说 By recording the time people spend on TV.，借了录音反复出现的 television 话题词，但研究测量记忆用的是 memory and fluency tests，不是"记录看电视的时间"，这是听到 TV 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Watching more than three hours of television a day
B)
未提及
B 说 By tracking people's living habits."追踪生活习惯"，录音通篇只提到用 memory and fluency tests，从未说追踪生活习惯，属于编造出来的手段。
D)
未提及
D 说 By scanning people's brains.，"扫脑"听上去很像测记忆的高科技方法，但录音明确用的是 memory and fluency tests，从头到尾没有提到 scan 或 brain scanning。

stem: What contributed to memory decline in the participants?

options.text: Watching television for hours.
Playing video games.
Reading books and magazines.
Surfing the Internet.

explanation:
【题目】What contributed to memory decline in the participants?

【翻译】是什么导致了参与者的记忆力下降?
A) 连续数小时看电视。
B) 玩电子游戏。
C) 阅读书籍和杂志。
D) 上网浏览。
【答案】A （细节题）Watching television for hours.
【定位】Watching more than three hours of television a day doubles memory loss in older people, a new study of more than 3,000 adults suggests.
一项针对三千多名成年人的新研究表明，每天看电视超过三小时会使老年人的记忆力损失加倍。
【信号】因果动词 doubles 连起活动与后果。答案句的信号是 doubles memory loss 这个把"看电视"和"记忆损失"直接挂钩的因果动词，问"什么导致记忆衰退"，落点就在 doubles 前面的那个行为上。
【替换】Watching more than three hours of television a day ↔Watching television for hours.
具体时长概括为 for hours
【排除】B)
张冠李戴
B 说 Playing video games.，录音确实念了 playing video games，但那是作为"有助于保持脑力的活动"提的，方向是有益、不是导致衰退，听到原词就选会张冠李戴。
借用原文：interactive screen-based pursuits such as using the Internet or playing video games
C)
张冠李戴
C 说 Reading books and magazines.，录音里 reading 是与"保持脑功能"绑在一起的有益活动，不是导致记忆衰退的原因，借原词反向设套。
借用原文：activities known to preserve mental functioning such as reading
D)
张冠李戴
D 说 Surfing the Internet.，录音 using the Internet 同样是被列为"有益脑力"的活动，不是诱因，属典型的原词反用。
借用原文：interactive screen-based pursuits such as using the Internet

stem: What do the researchers say about their finding concerning the link between TV viewing and Alzheimer's disease?

options.text: Television viewing may be a potential factor for Alzheimer's disease.
Alzheimer's patients tend to watch television more than 3 hours a day.
Some research has confirmed the link between them.
Television watching is beneficial to Alzheimer's patients.

explanation:
【题目】What do the researchers say about their finding concerning the link between TV viewing and Alzheimer's disease?
【翻译】研究人员如何评价他们关于看电视与阿尔茨海默病之间联系的发现?
A) 看电视可能是阿尔茨海默病的一个潜在因素。
B) 阿尔茨海默病患者往往每天看电视超过3小时。
C) 一些研究已经证实了它们之间的联系。
D) 看电视对阿尔茨海默病患者有益。
【答案】A （细节题）Television viewing may be a potential factor for Alzheimer's disease.

【定位】The researchers say that television viewing may be a risk factor for Alzheimer's disease, but more research is needed to establish a link.
研究者表示，看电视可能是老年痴呆症的一个风险因素，但还需要更多研究来确立这种关联。
【信号】留余地词 may + 转折 but 限定结论。答案句信号是 may be a risk factor 的不确定词may，以及紧随的转折 but more research is needed，研究者用"可能、还需更多研究"把话说得留有余地，结论就落在这种谨慎表态上。
【替换】may be a risk factor for Alzheimer's disease ↔ Television viewing may be a potential factor for Alzheimer's disease.
risk factor 同义为 potential factor，may 原样保留
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 说 Alzheimer's patients tend to watch television more than 3 hours a day.，录音确有 more than three hours 这个数字，但那是讲"看电视时长与记忆损失"，从没说"老年痴呆患者每天看超三小时"，是借数字原词设的陷阱。
借用原文：those who tended to watch more than three hours a day
C)
与原文相反
C 说 Some research has confirmed the link between them.，但录音明说 more research is needed to establish a link——关联还没确立，C 用 confirmed 把"尚未证实"夸成"已证实"，程度严重越界。
借用原文：more research is needed to establish a link
D)
与原文相反
D 说 Television watching is beneficial to Alzheimer's patients.，录音里确有educational benefits and relaxation benefits，但那是泛指看电视的一般好处，绝没说"对老年痴呆患者有益"，整体基调是看电视有害，D 完全反向。
借用原文：watching television may have educational benefits and relaxation benefits

stem: What do the researchers suggest older people do?

options.text: Watch television no more than 3 hours each day.
Balance television viewing with other contrasting activities.
Watch some educational TV programs.
Take more physical exercise.

explanation:
【题目】What do the researchers suggest older people do?
【翻译】研究人员建议老年人做什么?
A) 每天看电视不超过3小时。
B) 在看电视与其他对比性活动之间保持平衡。
C) 观看一些教育类电视节目。
D) 进行更多体育锻炼。
【答案】B （细节题）Balance television viewing with other contrasting activities.

【定位】the researchers advise that adults over the age of 50 should try and ensure that television viewing is balanced with other contrasting activities.
研究者建议，五十岁以上的成年人应尽量确保看电视与其他相反类型的活动保持平衡。
【信号】建议信号词 advise + should。答案句信号是建议词 the researchers advise 加 should try and ensure，问"建议做什么"的题，落点就在 advise/should 后面带出的那个动作上。
【替换】television viewing is balanced with other contrasting activities ↔ Balance television viewing with other contrasting activities.
被动陈述转成主动祈使，措辞几乎照搬

A 说 Watch television no more than 3 hours each day.，录音里 more than three hours 确实念过，但那是描述研究发现的时长门槛，研究者给老年人的正式建议是"平衡活动"，并非"每天别超三小时"，借数字原词冒充建议。

C)
偷换概念

借用原文：watching television may have educational benefits

未提及

stem: " Those were the words uttered by pioneering British scientist Rosalind Franklin, who firmly believed that the pursuit of science should be __(26)__ to all.

options.text: accessible
accounted
adaptation
appropriately
considerable
effective
ladder
misread
nomination
overlooked
promoting
senior
submission
suggesting
thankfully

explanation:
26. the pursuit of science should be __(26)__ to all
【答案】A) accessible
形容词
【词性槽】be 动词 + 空 + to all，典型表语形容词位
【依据】be accessible to all = 「人人可参与」契合 Franklin 的科学观
前句引语 "Science and everyday life cannot and should not be separated." 强调科学不该脱离日常生活，自然推出科学的探索应「人人能够参与/接触」，accessible 与 to all构成固定搭配，意思精准。
【竞争词】E) considerable 义为「相当大的」，与 to all 不搭配，逻辑也不通
considerable 修饰程度/数量，不说 considerable to all；且「科学的追求对所有人是相当大的」根本不成句。
F) effective 义为「有效的」，不与 to all 形成自然搭配
effective 一般搭 for / against / in doing，说 the pursuit should be effective to all 既别扭也偏题——本句要谈的不是「有效」而是「向所有人开放」。
L) senior 义为「高级的」，与「人人」相反
senior to sb 虽能搭配，但意为「比某人级别高」，与「面向所有人」语义完全相反；且 senior留给 33 题的「senior levels」更贴。
【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 F) —— effective 词性合、感情色彩也对，最易误选。the pursuit of science should be __(26)__ to all 中，effective 是形容词、又显得「积极」；但effective 后不接 to all（应接 for / in doing），且与 Franklin 引言「科学与日常不可分」呼应的是「面向所有人」而非「有效」。防坑：be 形容词 + to all 框架下只挑能搭 to 的形容词，accessible 才对。

stem: As a woman working in the first half of the 20th century, Franklin's contributions to some of the greatest scientific discoveries of our time including the structure of DNA were sadly __(27)__ in her lifetime.

options.text: accessible
accounted
adaptation
appropriately
considerable
effective
ladder
misread
nomination
overlooked
promoting
senior
submission
suggesting
thankfully

explanation:
27. Franklin's contributions … were sadly __(27)__ in her lifetime
【答案】J) overlooked
动词
【词性槽】were 后缺表语，且 sadly 修饰，需要过去分词作被动
【依据】「贡献被忽视」与下一段「幸而我们今天活在不同世界」呼应
Franklin 是 DNA 结构发现的重要贡献者却长期未被承认；overlooked「被忽视」精准捕捉这一史实，且与下文 we are __(28)__ living in a different world 的转折逻辑「过去被忽视——如今境况变好」环环相扣。
【竞争词】H) misread 义为「误读、被错误理解」，偏离史实
misread 强调「读错、误解」，但 Franklin 的问题不是贡献被「误读」，而是根本没被承认/记得；与 sadly 的情绪虽都偏负面，但语义指向不同。
【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 H) —— misread 形态正确、色彩偏负，迷惑性极高。were sadly __(27)__ in her lifetime 中，misread 在形态（过去分词）和情绪（负面）上都过关；但回到「下一段是『幸而如今活在不同世界』」的转折，被翻转的应是「被忽视」而非「被误读」。防坑：被动+情绪转折结构里，要把上下段两端的语义都摆上桌再选。

stem: More than 60 years after Franklin's death, we are __(28)__ living in a different world, where women play an important part in every echelon(阶层) of our society—not least in science, innovation, higher education and research.

options.text: accessible

thankfully

explanation:
28. we are __(28)__ living in a different world
【答案】O) thankfully
副词
【词性槽】be 与现在分词之间，只能塞副词
【依据】评注性副词，与「不同于过去的世界」语义对接
本句对比的是 Franklin's contributions … were sadly __(27)__ in her lifetime 那种「可惜被忽视」的旧时代，到了今天「女性已能在各阶层发挥作用」。作者对这种转变持庆幸态度，thankfully「幸亏、值得庆幸地」正好对上这一情绪。
【竞争词】D) appropriately 意思是「恰当地」，与「活在不同世界」语义不搭
appropriately 修饰动作，强调「做得合适」；说 we are appropriately living in a different world（我们恰当地活在一个不同的世界）逻辑不通。它更适合修饰「报酬/做法」，留给35 题。

explanation:

explanation:
31. women __(31)__ for more than half of all Stem postgraduates
【答案】B) accounted
动词
【词性槽】主语 women 后缺谓语 + for 的搭配信号
【依据】account for 「占（比例）」与「过半」精准匹配

名词

stem: What is happening to the wallet?

options.text: It is disappearing.
It is being fattened.
It is becoming costly.
It is changing in style.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What is happening to the wallet 是开放式 what 问句，直接问钱包“正在发生什么”，不含 infer/suggest/imply，属于对原文事实的客观转述。
【拆句】Q46 主干 What is happening to the wallet，what 作主语，is happening 现在进行时，to the wallet 介宾短语作状语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】The wallet is heading for extinction. As a day-to-day essential, it will die off with the generation who read print newspapers.
钱包正走向消亡。作为日常必需品，它将随着读纸质报纸的那代人一起消失。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
heading for extinction ↔disappearing
预判的“正在消失”与 disappearing 在词义、时态上完全吻合，无须再权衡其他选项。
B)
偷换概念
being fattened 把 fatness 这处比喻钱包鼓胀的怀旧描写当成了事实陈述——原文是“过去周五发薪那种鼓胀的感觉令人愉悦”，并不是说钱包真的在变厚。
C)
无中生有
becoming costly 说“钱包变得昂贵”，全文从未讨论钱包本身的售价或制造成本，仅讨论它的“消亡”与“象征意义”。
D)
与原文相反
changing in style 暗示钱包还在、只是换了款式，与 heading for extinction 与 It may not be here much longer 表达的“将不复存在”相反。

stem: How are business transactions done in big modern stores?

options.text: Individually.
Electronically.
In the abstract.
Via cash register.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】How are business transactions done 用 how 直问交易在大店里怎么完成，要的是原文对做法的客观描述。
【拆句】Q47 主干 transactions are done，被动语态，how 问做法的方式，介词短语 in big modern stores 限定场景。
【定位】At the most cutting-edge retail stores—Victoria Beckham on Dover Street, for instance—you don't go and stand at any kind of cash register, when you decide to pay. The staff are equipped with iPads to take your payment while you relax on a sofa.
在最前沿的零售店里——比如多佛街上的维多利亚·贝克汉姆店——付款时你根本不用去站在任何收银台前。店员配备了 iPad，你舒服地坐在沙发上，他们就给你结账。
【选项】A)
过度推断
Individually 意为“一对一/单独地”，原文虽提到坐在沙发上接受服务的舒适感，但并未把这种服务方式称为 individually，也未与“群体性服务”对比。
B)
✓ 正确
The staff are equipped with iPads to take your payment ↔Electronically
预判“用电子设备付款”恰好被 Electronically 这一上位副词完整覆盖，定位与替换两端都通。
C)
答非所问
In the abstract 取自 the abstraction of the idea of cash，那是作者对现象的评价（金钱概念被抽象化），并非交易“如何完成”的具体做法。
D)
与原文相反
Via cash register 说“通过收银台”，但定位句明说 you don't go and stand at any kind of cash register——大店里恰恰不用收银台。

stem: What makes the author feel uncomfortable nowadays?

options.text: Saving money is becoming a thing of the past.
The pleasing Friday-night feeling is fading.
Earning money is getting more difficult.
Spending money is so fast and easy.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What makes the author feel uncomfortable 直问导致作者不适的事物，答案在原文中有对应陈述，不需推断。
【拆句】Q48 主干 What makes the author feel uncomfortable，使役结构 make sb do，what作主语问主语本身，nowadays 时间状语限定范围。
【定位】But across society, the abstraction of the idea of cash makes me uneasy. Maybe I'm just old-fashioned. But earning money isn't quick or easy for most of us. Isn't it a bit weird that spending it should happen in half a blink of an eye?
但放眼整个社会，金钱概念被抽象化这件事让我不安。也许我只是老派。但挣钱对大多数人来说既不快也不轻松。花钱却能在眨眼之间完成，这难道不有点怪吗？
【选项】A)
无中生有
Saving money is becoming a thing of the past 说“存钱在变成过去式”，原文从未讨论存钱（saving），只讨论花钱与挣钱。
B)
张冠李戴
The pleasing Friday-night feeling is fading 取自 that time-honoured Friday-night feeling of pleasing, promising fatness，但原文用这一感受作“钱包代表着重要的东西”的论据，不是作者声称的不安根源；他不安的是 spending it should happen in half a blink of an eye。
C)
偷换概念
Earning money is getting more difficult 把原文 earning money isn't quick or easy for most of us 的“挣钱本来就不快不易”误读成“挣钱正变得更难”——原文没有“更难（在变化中）”的意思，且作者不舒服的真正对象是花钱、不是挣钱。
D)
✓ 正确
spending it should happen in half a blink of an eye ↔Spending money is so fast and easy
预判“花钱太快太轻易”与 Spending money is so fast and easy 字面一一对应，不需要权衡其他选项。

stem: Why does the author choose to write about what's happening to the wallet?

options.text: It represents a change in the modern world.
It has something to do with everybody's life.
It marks the end of a time-honoured tradition.
It is the concern of contemporary economists.

explanation:
【答案】A （推断题）
【判型】Why does the author choose to write 问的是作者的写作动机，原文不会一字一句写“我写本文是因为…”，需要从作者明确表达“在意什么”的句子做一步延伸。
【拆句】Q49 主干 Why does the author choose to write about X，choose to + 不定式作宾语，about 引导写作话题，what's happening to the wallet 名词性从句作 about 的宾语。
【定位】But I'll leave the economics to the experts. What bothers me about the death of the wallet is the change it represents in our physical environment.
但我把经济这层留给专家。真正困扰我的，是钱包消亡所代表的、我们身处的物理环境的变化。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
the change it represents in our physical environment ↔ represents a change in the modern world
预判“钱包代表着当代世界的某种变化”与 It represents a change in the modern world完全对应。
B)
过度推断
has something to do with everybody's life 说钱包消失与“每个人的生活”都相关，原文虽然提到 across society，但作者强调的是“我真正在意的是它代表的变化”，并不是“它和每个人有关”。
C)
以偏概全
It marks the end of a time-honoured tradition 取自 that time-honoured Friday-night feeling，但 time-honoured 只是描述周五夜感受的形容词，全文并不是把钱包写作“一种古老传统的终结”，而是借它说环境变化。
D)
与原文相反
concern of contemporary economists 说钱包消失是当代经济学家关心的事，但作者在定位句开头就写明 I'll leave the economics to the experts，把经济视角主动让出去——这正是他写本文的动机所排除的对象。

stem: What can we infer from the passage about the author?

options.text: He is resistant to social changes.
He is against technological progress.

He feels insecure in the ever-changing modern world.

explanation:
【答案】C （推断题）
【判型】题干 What can we infer from the passage about the author 直接用 infer 提示推断题，要求基于全文判断作者形象。
【拆句】Q50 主干 What can we infer，情态动词 can 表能力可能，from the passage 与 about the author 是两个并列介宾短语分别交代依据与对象，结构平稳无陷阱。
【选项】A)
过度推断
resistant to social changes 说作者抗拒“社会变化”——但作者 Maybe I'm just old-fashioned 已自嘲只是老派，且 I'll leave the economics to the experts 表明他不打算就更大范围的社会议题表态。
B)
与原文相反
against technological progress 说作者反对科技进步，但作者明确称 Which is nothing more or less than excellent service——他承认电子化是优秀服务；他不满的是钱包消亡所代表的物理环境变化，而非科技本身。

✓ 正确
Everything about the look and feel of a wallet—the way the fastenings and materials wear and tear and loosen with age, the plastic and paper and gold and silver, and handwritten phone numbers and printed cinema tickets—is the very opposite of what our world is becoming ↔reluctant to part with the traditional wallet
Show your wallet, if you still have one. It may not be here much longer ↔ reluctant to part with the traditional wallet
三段表态聚合出“对传统钱包眷恋而不舍”，与 He feels reluctant to part with the traditional wallet 完全吻合。
D)
无中生有
feels insecure in the ever-changing modern world 说作者在“日新月异的现代世界感到不安全”，原文里作者表达的是不安（uneasy）与困扰（bothers me），均针对钱包消亡这一具体事，没有任何对“安全感缺失”的描述。

stem: What is scientists' finding about dreaming?

options.text: It involves disconnected weird images.
It resembles fragments of science fiction.
Dreaming about a learned task betters its performance.
Dreaming about things being learned disturbs one's sleep.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干What is scientists' finding about dreaming是“what is …finding”句式，问一个具体事实，不含 infer/imply 等推断信号，也不问 mainly about/title，属常规细节题。
【拆句】What is scientists' finding about dreaming? 主干是 What is scientists' finding，about dreaming 是介词短语作 finding 的后置定语，限定“关于做梦的发现”。句子结构简单，无陷阱。
【定位】Scientists have found that dreaming about a task we've learned is associated with improved performance in that activity
科学家发现，梦见我们学过的某项任务与该任务表现的提升相关联。
【选项】A)
答非所问
It involves disconnected weird images只是the fragmented, often bizarre imaginings they generate at night的转述，是“梦的现象”而非“科学家的发现”，与题干所问的 finding 不在同一语义层。
B)
偷换概念
It resembles fragments of science fiction借It might sound like science fiction这句比喻造干扰；原文只是说“听起来像科幻小说”，并不是科学家的发现内容。
C)
✓ 正确
dreaming about a task we've learned ↔Dreaming about a learned task
is associated with improved performance in that activity ↔betters its performance
预判要点“梦到所学任务→表现提升”，Dreaming about a learned task betters its performance恰好覆盖“梦到所学任务”和“表现提升”两个语义成分，与定位句完全对位。
D)
无中生有
原文只谈梦对学习的“正向作用”，从未提及Dreaming about things being learned disturbs one's sleep中所说的“扰乱睡眠”这一层；属凭空增加结论。

stem: What happens when one enters a dream state?

options.text: The body continues to act as if the sleeper were awake.
The neural activity of the brain will become intensified.
The brain behaves as if it were playing a virtual reality video game.
The brain once again experiences the learning activities of the day.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干What happens when one enters a dream state问“进入梦境时发生什么”，是对客观事实的提问，不含推断信号。
【拆句】What happens when one enters a dream state? 主句 What happens 是主语从句疑问形式，when 引导时间状语从句修饰 happens，one 是泛指代词。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】While we sleep, research indicates, the brain replays the patterns of activity it experienced during waking hours, allowing us to enter what one psychologist calls a neural(神经的) virtual reality.
研究表明，当我们睡觉时，大脑会重演它在清醒时所经历的活动模式，从而让我们进入某心理学家所称的“神经虚拟现实”。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
The body continues to act as if the sleeper were awake只描述了patients with conditions like sleepwalking, in which the sleeper engages in the kind of physical movement that does not normally occur during sleep这一梦游异常情况；原文明示这并非常态。
B)
无中生有
The neural activity of the brain will become intensified借neural(神经的) virtual reality中的 neural 一词造形似干扰；原文只说大脑重演活动，从未说神经活动“变得更强烈”。
C)
过度推断
The brain behaves as if it were playing a virtual reality video game把原文比喻what one psychologist calls a neural(神经的) virtual reality扩写为“在玩虚拟现实电子游戏”，添加了 game 这一无中生有的设定。
D)
✓ 正确
the brain replays ↔The brain once again experiences
the patterns of activity it experienced during waking hours ↔ the learning activities of the day
预判核心“大脑再次经历白天的活动”，The brain once again experiences the learning activities of the day在“再次”“经历”“白天活动”三处均精确等值。

stem: What does the brain do while we are sleeping?

options.text: It systematizes all the data collected during the day.
It substitutes old information with new data.
It processes and absorbs newly acquired data.
It classifies information and places it in different files.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干What does the brain do while we are sleeping是 what does X do 句式，问大脑在做什么这一客观行为。
【拆句】What does the brain do while we are sleeping? 主句 What does the brain do 是疑问句，while we are sleeping 是时间状语从句，sleeping 是现在分词。无陷阱。
【定位】This shows that while our bodies are at rest, our brains are drawing what's important from the information and events we've recently encountered, then integrating that data into the vast store of what we already know.
这表明，当我们的身体休息时，大脑在从最近接触到的信息和事件中提取重要内容，然后把这些数据整合进我们已有的庞大知识库中。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
It systematizes all the data collected during the day把原文what's important（重要的部分）擅自扩大为 all the data（全部数据），与原文“筛取重要”相矛盾。
B)
与原文相反
It substitutes old information with new data说“用新数据替代旧信息”，与定位句integrating that data into the vast store of what we already know恰好相反——原文是把新数据“整合进”已有知识，并非“替换掉”已有知识。
C)
✓ 正确
drawing what's important from the information and events we've recently encountered ↔ It processes and absorbs newly acquired data
the information and events we've recently encountered ↔newly acquired data
预判核心“提取+整合新信息”，It processes and absorbs newly acquired data两个谓语动词精确对应定位句的两个动名词，是最贴合的同义替换。
D)
无中生有
It classifies information and places it in different files中的 classifies（分类）+ places…in different files（放入不同文件）在原文中找不到对应；原文只说“提取重要+整合进已有知识库”，没有“分门别类放进不同档案”这一层动作。

stem: What does Robert Stickgold suggest about enhancing learning?

options.text: Having a little sleep after studying in the day.
Staying up late before going to bed.
Having a dream about anything.
Thinking about the odds of dreaming about the material.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干What does Robert Stickgold suggest about enhancing learning问某人具体建议什么，是事实型问题。
【拆句】What does Robert Stickgold suggest about enhancing learning? 主干 What does Robert Stickgold suggest，about enhancing learning 介词短语作 suggest 的状语，限定话题范围。enhancing 是动名词。无陷阱。
【定位】Robert Stickgold, one of the Harvard researchers, suggests that studying right before bedtime or taking a nap following a study session in the afternoon might increase the odds of dreaming about the material.
哈佛研究人员之一的 Robert Stickgold 建议：临睡前学习，或者在下午学习之后小睡一会儿，可能会增加梦到所学内容的几率。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
taking a nap following a study session in the afternoon ↔ Having a little sleep after studying in the day
Stickgold 的建议含两条，其中“下午学完后小睡”一条与Having a little sleep after studying in the day逐词对位；选项不必复述全部建议，只要属于建议之一即正确。
B)
偷换概念
Staying up late before going to bed（睡前熬夜）与原文studying right before bedtime（临睡前学习）方向完全不同——原文建议的是睡前“学习”，不是“熬夜”。
C)
以偏概全
Having a dream about anything说“做关于任何事的梦”，而原文dreaming about the material强调“梦到所学的材料”——选项把对象 the material 扩大成 anything，与原意不符。
D)
张冠李戴
Thinking about the odds of dreaming about the material借用原文最后一句Think about that as your head hits the pillow tonight并改造为“去想梦到材料的几率”，但原文这句是给读者的提醒，不是 Stickgold 的“增强学习”建议；同时把 odds 这一名词强行说成 Stickgold 建议的“做法”。

stem: What can be inferred about dreaming from the passage?

options.text: We may enhance our learning through dreaming.
Dreaming improves your language ability.
All sleepwalkers perform dance moves when they are sleeping.
Taking a nap after learning can help you find the way through the maze.

explanation:
【答案】A （推断题）
【判型】题干What can be inferred about dreaming from the passage中 inferred 显式宣告本题问“从全文可推出”，不是问字面陈述。
【拆句】What can be inferred about dreaming from the passage? 主干是 What can be inferred，be inferred 是被动语态（情态动词 can+be+过去分词），about dreaming 与from the passage 都是介词短语作状语，分别限定推断对象和推断依据来源。被动结构提示考生关注“可被推出来的内容”，而非原文字面说法。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
dreaming is an essential part of understanding, organizing and retaining what we learn ↔ We may enhance our learning through dreaming
college students who dreamed about a computer maze(迷宫) task they had learned showed a 10- fold improvement in their ability to find their way through the maze compared with participants who did not dream about the task ↔We may enhance our learning through dreaming
全文研究结论、机制、实验、建议四层证据全部指向“做梦有助于学习”，We may enhance our learning through dreaming恰好是这条主线的一步合理外推，且情态动词 may 留出合理余地，最稳。
B)
以偏概全
Dreaming improves your language ability只对应原文括号里举的语言例证we're "getting" a foreign language once we begin dreaming in it，不能覆盖迷宫实验、Stickgold 建议等其他区间；且原文用 popular notion（流行观念）描述此说法，并非作者断言。
C)
以偏概全
All sleepwalkers perform dance moves when they are sleeping把原文one female patient on the tape performs the dance moves she learned earlier中“某位女患者”扩大为“所有梦游者”，把单一例证拔到全称命题。
D)
强加因果
Taking a nap after learning can help you find the way through the maze强行把第四段哈佛迷宫实验与第五段 Stickgold 的小睡建议拼成因果关系——原文中两者只是分别论证“做梦助学”这一更大主线，并未明示“学完小睡就能走出迷宫”。

stem: What has caused the thick clouds in the photos taken by NASA satellite?

options.text: Ship traffic in the Atlantic.
Warm currents in the ocean.
Exhaust from cars in Europe.
Particles emitted by power plants.

explanation:
【题目】What has caused the thick clouds in the photos taken by NASA satellite?
【翻译】NASA卫星拍摄的照片中厚云层是什么原因造成的?
A) 大西洋的船舶交通。
B) 海洋中的暖流。
C) 欧洲汽车的尾气。
D) 发电厂排放的颗粒物。
【答案】A （细节题）Ship traffic in the Atlantic.
【定位】NASA officials explained those thicker clouds are signs of ship traffic below. When ships power their way through the ocean, they pump exhaust into the atmosphere, just as cars do. And those massive amounts of particles can cause clouds to form.
NASA 官员解释说，那些更厚的云是下方船只航行的标志。当船只破浪穿行于海洋时，它们会像汽车一样把尾气排入大气。而那大量的颗粒物能够促使云的形成。
【信号】因果词 cause 连起两端。答案信号是因果动词：those massive amounts of particles can cause clouds to form 里的 cause 直接把'船排出的颗粒物'与'云的形成'连起来，再往前those thicker clouds are signs of ship traffic below 点明云来自船，因果链清楚。
【替换】those thicker clouds are signs of ship traffic below ↔Ship traffic in the Atlantic.
原文 ship traffic 与选项同源
those massive amounts of particles can cause clouds to form ↔Ship traffic in the Atlantic.
颗粒来自船故归因于船
【排除】B)
未提及
Warm currents in the ocean. 听着像海洋话题，但录音通篇没说暖流造成云；只提到North Atlantic 这片海域，未提 warm currents，属凭海洋联想的无中生有。
C)
原词陷阱
Exhaust from cars in Europe. 偷了录音里的原词：录音确实说船排尾气 just as cars do，只是拿汽车作类比，真正造云的是船不是汽车；选项把类比对象 cars 当成了真凶，是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：they pump exhaust into the atmosphere, just as cars do
D)
原词陷阱
Particles emitted by power plants. 盗了录音原词 particles：录音的颗粒物是船排出的(ships…pump exhaust)，而非 power plants 电厂；录音从头到尾没出现 power plants，选项把颗粒物的来源偷换成了电厂。
借用原文：they pump exhaust into the atmosphere

stem: What do NASA officials think about the thick clouds?

options.text: They need to be taken seriously.
They have a huge effect on fishery.
They might be causing trouble to air flights.
They may be affecting the world's climate.

explanation:
【题目】What do NASA officials think about the thick clouds?
【翻译】NASA官员如何看待这些厚云层?
A) 需要认真对待它们。
B) 它们对渔业有巨大影响。
C) 它们可能给航班造成麻烦。
D) 它们可能正在影响世界气候。
【答案】D （态度观点题）They may be affecting the world's climate.
【定位】It's likely that these sorts of clouds are having some effect on the global climate, according to NASA officials. But scientists aren't yet sure what effect it has.
据 NASA 官员说，这类云很可能正对全球气候产生某种影响。但科学家尚不确定它具体有什么影响。
【信号】结尾结论句 + according to。答案信号是录音结尾的下结论措辞：It's likely that these sorts of clouds are having some effect on the global climate, according to NASA officials，It's likely 表推测性判断、according to NASA officials 点明这正是官员的看法，态度题答案常落在这种结尾结论句。
【替换】these sorts of clouds are having some effect on the global climate ↔ They may be affecting the world's climate.
having effect on=affecting 同义
It's likely that ↔They may be affecting the world's climate.
It's likely=may 同度推测
【排除】A)
未提及
They need to be taken seriously. 听起来像合理表态，但录音里官员只说'很可能影响气候'，从未说要'认真对待/重视'这些云，属于没有依据的拔高，原文未提。
B)
原词陷阱
They have a huge effect on fishery. 偷了录音里的原词：录音前面说云 These clouds can be huge，又说 having some effect on the global climate，选项拼凑 huge 和effect，却把对象换成了根本没提的 fishery 渔业，是原词陷阱叠加无中生有。
借用原文：These clouds can be huge
C)
偷换概念
They might be causing trouble to air flights. 借了录音'有某种影响'的意思，却把受影响对象换成 air flights 航班——录音只说影响 global climate，从未提航班，属于把影响对象偷换。
借用原文：having some effect on the global climate

Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.

stem: For what purpose did the staff at a supermarket in Melbourne sign a letter?

options.text: To appeal for higher wages.
To demand better health care.
To call for a permanent security guard.
To dismiss the bad-tempered supervisor.

explanation:
【题目】For what purpose did the staff at a supermarket in Melbourne sign a letter?
【翻译】墨尔本一家超市的员工签署联名信的目的是什么?
A) 呼吁提高工资。
B) 要求更好的医疗保健。
C) 呼吁配备常驻保安。
D) 解雇脾气暴躁的主管。
【答案】C （目的题）To call for a permanent security guard.
【定位】More than 50 workers at the store have signed a letter calling for a permanent security guard following a series of incidents, including a customer threatening to attack a supervisor with a knife.
店里 50 多名员工签署了一封信，在一连串事件（包括一名顾客威胁要持刀袭击一位主管）之后，呼吁配备一名长期保安。
【信号】动词 signed a letter 紧跟诉求 calling for。答案句的信号是"做该动作的动词 + 紧跟的诉求短语"：原文 have signed a letter calling for a permanent security guard 里，signed a letter 正是题干问的"签信"动作，其后 calling for（呼吁）后面的名词就是签信的目的所在，顺势锁定这句即可。

【替换】calling for a permanent security guard ↔To call for a permanent security guard.
现在分词转不定式，措辞几乎一致
【排除】A)
未提及
To appeal for higher wages. 说"为加薪"。录音通篇没提工资，只谈安全与保安——这是"员工签信常被想成为了待遇"的常识替代，属未提及。
B)
偷换概念
To demand better health care. 说"为更好的医疗"。录音从未提 health care，谈的全是人身安全（security / guard）。它把"安全"偷换成"医疗保健"，靠 care 一类词制造"好像听过"的熟悉感。
D)
原词陷阱
To dismiss the bad-tempered supervisor. 说"为开除坏脾气的主管"。supervisor 确实是录音原词，但原文是 a customer threatening to attack a supervisor with a knife——主管是"被顾客威胁"的受害者，不是员工要开除的对象。它盗用 supervisor 让你"听到就想选"，实则张冠李戴。
借用原文：a customer threatening to attack a supervisor with a knife

stem: What did the spokesman of the supermarket say regarding the employees' demand?

options.text: It had already taken strong action.
It would put customers' needs first.
It would take their appeal seriously.
It was seeking help from the police.

explanation:
【题目】What did the spokesman of the supermarket say regarding the employees' demand?
【翻译】该超市的发言人对员工的要求说了什么?
A) 它已经采取了强有力的行动。
B) 它会把顾客的需求放在首位。
C) 它会认真对待他们的呼吁。
D) 它正在向警方寻求帮助。
【答案】A （细节题）It had already taken strong action.
【定位】However, the spokesman of the supermarket said the store had taken strong action in response to incidents.
然而，超市的发言人说，门店已经针对这些事件采取了有力的应对行动。
【信号】转折 However + 引述 spokesman said。双重信号锁定这句：一是 However（然而）这个转折，前面讲的是员工的不满与诉求，however 之后才轮到题干问的"发言人"开口；二是引述词 the spokesman of the supermarket said，它后面紧跟的就是发言人原话。两信号叠加，答案句无疑。
【替换】had taken strong action in response to incidents ↔It had already taken strong action.
原话保留 + 加 already 点出已完成

【排除】B)
未提及
It would put customers' needs first. 说"会把顾客需求放首位"。发言人确实提到顾客，但从没说"以顾客为先"；这是借"超市当然重视顾客"的常识硬填，属未提及。
C)
偷换概念
It would take their appeal seriously. 说"会认真对待诉求"，是最像标准回应、最顺耳的一项。但发言人原话是 had taken strong action——讲的是"已经做了有力行动"，不是"将会认真对待"。它把"已做"偷换成"将认真对待"，且这话录音根本没说。
D)
未提及
It was seeking help from the police. 说"正在向警方求助"。录音里发言人提到的应对是banning a customer from the store（封禁顾客），从未提报警 / police。它顺着"安全事件常报警"的惯性硬接，属未提及。
借用原文：banning a customer from the store

stem: What did drivers on the motorway to Warsaw find?

options.text: The road was flooded.
The road was blocked.
The road was frozen with snow.
The road was covered with spilled gas.

explanation:
【题目】What did drivers on the motorway to Warsaw find?
【翻译】在通往华沙的高速公路上，司机们发现了什么？
A) 道路被水淹了。
B) 道路被堵住了。
C) 道路被雪冻住了。
D) 道路被洒出的汽油覆盖了。
【答案】B （细节题）The road was blocked.
【定位】Drivers on their way to the Polish capital of Warsaw on Wednesday morning found the road blocked by an unusual obstacle: tons of liquid chocolate that spilled onto the motorway.
周三早晨，前往波兰首都华沙的司机们发现道路被一个不寻常的障碍物堵住了：数吨洒到高速公路上的液态巧克力。
【信号】题干原话 found 直接对上。新闻开篇第一句就出现 Drivers on their way to the Polish capital of Warsaw on Wednesday morning found the road blocked，和题干 What did drivers on the motorway to Warsaw find? 用同一个动词 found、同一批主语drivers——题干词在录音里复现，就是答案句的最强信号。
【替换】found the road blocked ↔The road was blocked.
几乎原句，主被动微调
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音说 liquid chocolate that spilled onto the motorway（液态巧克力洒到路上），选项The road was flooded. 把"洒出液体"夸成"被水淹"。听到 liquid、spilled 就想到"淹"，但录音的状态词是 blocked（堵），不是 flooded（淹）。
借用原文：tons of liquid chocolate that spilled onto the motorway
C)
原词陷阱
录音后面消防员说清理巧克力 was worse than dealing with snow（比处理雪还难），只是拿"雪"作比较；选项 The road was frozen with snow. 却把"雪"说成路面真被雪冻住。snow 是录音念过的词，但它出现在比喻里，不是路的实际状况。
借用原文：removing the chocolate was worse than dealing with snow
D)
偷换概念
录音洒的是 liquid chocolate（液态巧克力），选项 The road was covered with spilled gas. 把"洒出物"偷换成 gas（汽油）。"路被洒出物覆盖"这个框架对，但具体物质被换错了。
借用原文：tons of liquid chocolate that spilled onto the motorway

stem: What does the report say about the accident?

options.text: A truck plunged into a pool of liquid chocolate.
The heavy snow made driving very difficult.
The truck driver dozed off while driving.
A truck hit a barrier and overturned.

explanation:
【题目】What does the report say about the accident?
【翻译】报道对这起事故是怎么说的？
A) 一辆卡车坠入了液态巧克力池中。
B) 大雪使得驾驶非常困难。
C) 卡车司机在驾驶时打瞌睡了。
D) 一辆卡车撞上护栏并侧翻了。
【答案】D （细节题）A truck hit a barrier and overturned.
【定位】A truck carrying the sweet load hit a road barrier and overturned, blocking two lanes.
一辆载着甜蜜货物的卡车撞上路边护栏后翻车，堵住了两条车道。
【信号】动作链 hit…and overturned 交代经过。这句 A truck carrying the sweet load hit a road barrier and overturned 用"撞护栏→翻车"的动作链直接讲清事故怎么发生，是题干问 about the accident 的正解所在；新闻顺听到第二句即落点。
【替换】hit a road barrier and overturned ↔A truck hit a barrier and overturned.
近乎原词，仅省 road
【排除】A)
与原文相反
选项 A truck plunged into a pool of liquid chocolate. 说卡车"冲进巧克力液池"，把巧克力当成事故起因；但录音是先 hit a road barrier and overturned、罐裂后才 spilled a pool of rapidly-hardening chocolate——巧克力是翻车的结果，不是起因。pool、liquid chocolate 都是录音原词，顺序却被颠倒。
借用原文：The cracked tank spilled a pool of rapidly-hardening chocolate
B)
原词陷阱
选项 The heavy snow made driving very difficult. 把事故归因于大雪，但录音里 snow只出现在 was worse than dealing with snow 的比喻中，根本没说当天下雪、更没说雪致驾驶困难。这是借"念过的 snow"硬造一个录音没有的起因。
借用原文：removing the chocolate was worse than dealing with snow
C)
未提及
选项 The truck driver dozed off while driving. 说司机开车打瞌睡，录音只提到 the driver was taken to hospital with a broken arm（司机手臂骨折送医），从没说他瞌睡。"卡车出事=司机疲劳"是常识脑补，录音并未提及。

stem: What did the firefighters' representative tell the local TV?

options.text: It was a long time before the cleanup was finished.
It was a hard task to remove the spilled substance.
It was fortunate that no passenger got injured.
It was difficult to contact the manufacturer.

explanation:
【题目】What did the firefighters' representative tell the local TV?
【翻译】消防员代表对当地电视台说了什么？
A) 清理工作过了很长时间才完成。
B) 清除洒出的物质是一项艰巨的任务。
C) 幸运的是没有乘客受伤。
D) 联系制造商很困难。
【答案】B （细节题）It was a hard task to remove the spilled substance.
【定位】A representative for the firefighters told the local TV that removing the chocolate was worse than dealing with snow.
消防部门的一位发言人告诉当地电视台，清除这些巧克力比处理积雪还要麻烦。
【信号】told 引出的直接引语。录音 A representative for the firefighters told the local TV that removing the chocolate was worse than dealing with snow 用 told the local TV 引出发言人原话，与题干 What did the firefighters' representative tell the local TV? 的 tell the local TV 一字对应——"told"就是答案句的信号词。
【替换】removing the chocolate was worse than dealing with snow ↔ It was a hard task to remove the spilled substance.
"比雪还糟"="很难"，巧克力=洒出物
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
选项 It was a long time before the cleanup was finished. 说清理"花了很久"。录音里确有 the long task ahead 暗示任务漫长，但那是叙述者的话、不是发言人 told 的内容；发言人说的是"难"（worse than snow），不是"久"。盗用了 long 一词，又张冠李戴换了说话人。
借用原文：cheerful about the long task ahead
C)
未提及
选项 It was fortunate that no passenger got injured. 说幸好没乘客受伤，但录音明说the driver was taken to hospital with a broken arm——司机手臂骨折，且全程没提乘客。既与"有人受伤"相悖，也不是发言人说的内容。
D)
原词陷阱
选项 It was difficult to contact the manufacturer. 说难联系厂家。录音确有 After contacting the chocolate manufacturer（联系了厂家之后），说明厂家已联系上、根本不难；contact、manufacturer 都是原词，却凭空加了"困难"，且非发言人 told 的内容。
借用原文：After contacting the chocolate manufacturer, the firefighters resorted to spraying hot, pressurized water

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation,you will hear four questions. Both the conversations and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the center.

stem: Why did the woman decide to go back to cash for payment?

options.text: She wanted to save for a new phone.
She found it much safer to use cash.
She could enjoy discount with cash.
She had been cheated using phone apps.

explanation:
【题目】Why did the woman decide to go back to cash for payment?
【翻译】这位女士为什么决定回归使用现金支付?
A) 她想为一部新手机存钱。
B) 她发现使用现金安全得多。
C) 她用现金可以享受折扣。
D) 她使用手机应用程序时被骗过。
【答案】A （细节题）She wanted to save for a new phone.
【定位】I'm trying to save money for a new phone, and I find that using cash rather than payment apps helps me to save.
我正想攒钱买部新手机，而且我发现用现金而不用支付 App 能帮我省钱。
【信号】被问者的直接应答。男方一开口就问她为何用现金，女方紧接着应答 I'm trying to save money for a new phone——这是被问者对"为什么"的直接交代，问题落在回答方，这一句就是答案句。
【替换】save money for a new phone ↔save for a new phone
近乎同义·略去 money

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 借用了录音反复出现的 using cash 这个原词，但她说用现金是为了"省钱"，全程没说现金"更安全（safer）"，B 把"省钱"偷换成了"安全"，听到 cash 就选会中招。
借用原文：using cash rather than payment apps
C)
未提及
C 说用现金能"享受折扣（discount）"，但录音里女方只讲省钱与心理感受，从未提到现金有任何折扣，属凭空添加的理由。
D)
原词陷阱
D 借用录音里的 using an app / phone apps 这一原词，编出"用 App 被骗过（cheated）"的理由，但录音从头到尾没提任何"被骗"的事，是用熟词加吓人情节做的干扰。
借用原文：transfer from your bank account to the seller's bank account using an app

stem: What happens when people use apps for payment according to the woman?

options.text: They can save a lot more time and trouble.
They find it less difficult to make purchases.
They derive greater pleasure from buying things.
They are less aware of the value of their money.

explanation:
【题目】What happens when people use apps for payment according to the woman?
【翻译】根据这位女士的说法,人们使用应用程序支付时会发生什么?
A) 他们可以节省大量时间和麻烦。
B) 他们发现购物不那么困难了。
C) 他们从购物中获得更大的乐趣。
D) 他们对自己金钱的价值不那么敏感。
【答案】D （细节题）They are less aware of the value of their money.
【定位】I believe we have less connection with the value of our money when we just tap the "Approve" buttons on our phones.
我觉得，当我们只是在手机上点一下"确认"键时，我们和钱的价值之间的联系就变弱了。
【信号】观点句 I believe 引出结论。女方用 I believe we have less connection with the value of our money 给出明确判断，I believe 是她下结论的信号词，加上题干限定 according to the woman，这句正是答案句。
【替换】we have less connection with the value of our money ↔ They are less aware of the value of their money.
同义替换·connection 换成 aware

【排除】A)
答非所问
A 说用 App"省时省力（save time and trouble）"，听上去是手机支付的常识好处，但女方这段讲的是"对钱的价值感变弱"，根本没说省时省事，A 是用生活常识脑补、答非所问。
B)
答非所问
B 说用 App 让人"更容易买东西（less difficult to make purchases）"，与女方强调的"对钱的价值更没感觉"不是一回事，是另一个看似合理却未被女方说出的方向。
C)
未提及
C 说人们"从买东西中获得更多快乐（greater pleasure）"，但录音里女方谈的是花钱时的心理"麻木"，从未说更快乐，pleasure 是凭空加进来的情绪词。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What might the man tend to buy with payment apps?

options.text: More valuable items.
More non-essential things.
Everyday necessities.
Electronic devices.

explanation:
【题目】What might the man tend to buy with payment apps?
【翻译】这位男士可能倾向于用支付应用程序购买什么?
A) 更有价值的物品。
B) 更多非必需品。
C) 日常必需品。
D) 电子设备。
【答案】B （细节题）More non-essential things.
【定位】Since I stopped carrying cash around and started using my phone apps to pay, I may have developed a tendency to buy more small or non-essential items.
自从我不再随身带现金、开始用手机 App 付款以来，我可能养成了买更多小件或非必需品的倾向。
【信号】被问者本人自述 tendency to buy。题目问"the man"买什么，答案就在男方自陈 a tendency to buy more small or non-essential items 这句——这是当事人对自己购买倾向的直接陈述，tendency to buy 是定位信号。
【替换】buy more small or non-essential items ↔More non-essential things.
近乎原义·items 换 things

【排除】A)
与原文相反
A 说买"更贵重的东西（valuable items）"，借用了录音 items 这个原词，但男方说的是买"small（小件）"非必需品，与"贵重"正好相反，极性反了。
借用原文：buy more small or non-essential items
C)
与原文相反
C 的"everyday necessities（日常必需品）"与录音 non-essential items 只差一个否定前缀，盗用了"essential"这个词根，却把"非必需"偷换成"必需"，意思正好掉头。
借用原文：non-essential items
D)
未提及
D 说买"电子产品（electronic devices）"，因为整段在聊"手机、App"显得很搭，但录音从没说男方买电子产品，是借话题氛围编出来的干扰。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man think of electronic payment?

options.text: It can improve shopping efficiency.
It is altering the way of shopping.
It may lead to excessive spending.
It appeals more to younger people.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man think of electronic payment?
【翻译】这位男士如何看待电子支付?
A) 它可以提高购物效率。
B) 它正在改变购物方式。
C) 它可能导致过度消费。
D) 它对年轻人更有吸引力。
【答案】C （态度观点题）It may lead to excessive spending.
【定位】I stopped using my credit card because I found I was spending excessively. Perhaps I should take the same approach of paying using my phone.
我已经不用信用卡了，因为我发现自己花钱太过头。也许我对手机付款也该采取同样的做法（不用它）。
【信号】负面措辞 spending excessively 透态度。男方说 I found I was spending excessively 并打算对手机付款"take the same approach"（即也要戒掉），spending excessively 这个负面措辞，加上他把电子支付与刷爆的信用卡相提并论，暴露了他认为电子支付会让人"过度消费"的态度。
【替换】I found I was spending excessively ↔It may lead to excessive spending.
同根改写·动词转名词

【排除】A)
答非所问
A 说电子支付"提高购物效率（improve shopping efficiency）"，是手机支付的常识优点，但男方全程在讲它让人乱花钱，从没夸它效率高，A 靠常识脑补、与他的负面态度不符。
B)
答非所问
B 说电子支付"正在改变购物方式（altering the way of shopping）"，这话本身没错、也算贴题，但它只是客观描述"在变"，没表明男方"怎么看"，题问的是态度（think of），B 答非所问。
D)
未提及
D 说电子支付"更吸引年轻人（appeals more to younger people）"，但录音里两人从没谈到年龄或年轻人，younger people 是凭空添加的内容。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第14页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why did the man call the woman?

options.text: He wanted to order some wooden furniture.
He had to change the furniture delivery time.
He had a problem with the furniture delivered.
He wanted the furniture store to give him a refund.

explanation:
【题目】Why did the man call the woman?
【翻译】男士为什么给女士打电话?
A) 他想订购一些木制家具。
B) 他不得不更改家具配送时间。
C) 他对配送的家具有问题。
D) 他想让家具店给他退款。
【答案】C （目的题）He had a problem with the furniture delivered.
【定位】M: No, no. The table is fine. The problem is the chairs.
男：不不，桌子没问题。问题出在椅子上。
【信号】男方应答点出问题所在。女方先问是不是桌子出了问题，男方应答 The problem is the chairs.，这是被问者的直接应答、也是他亮明来意的落点——他打电话正是因为送来的椅子有问题，应答句里的 problem 就是答案信号。
【替换】The problem is the chairs. ↔He had a problem with the furniture delivered.
chairs 上位概括为 furniture
the delivery was this morning ↔the furniture delivered
delivery 名词转 delivered 分词

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音开头女方提到 the wooden table，后文又有 purchased、order 等词，A 项 He wanted to order some wooden furniture 把 wooden、order 这些原词拼起来，但男方打电话不是去下新订单，而是投诉送错货，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：the wooden table
B)
原词陷阱
录音确实多次出现 delivery、this morning、tomorrow 9 a.m. 等时间与送货词，B 项 He had to change the furniture delivery time 借这些词制造假象，但男方从没要求更改送货时间，改时间的话是女方为退换货才提的。
借用原文：the delivery was this morning
D)
未提及
买家投诉容易让人联想到要退款，但录音里男方只要求换成对的椅子，女方也只承诺换货，自始至终没人提 refund，D 项 He wanted the furniture store to give him a refund 是凭常识脑补、录音未提及。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the woman ask the man to do?

options.text: Send the furniture back to the store.
Describe the furniture he received.
Collect the furniture he ordered.
Buy another brand of furniture.

explanation:
【题目】What did the woman ask the man to do?
【翻译】女士要求男士做什么?
A) 把家具退回商店。
B) 描述他收到的家具。
C) 取他订购的家具。
D) 购买另一个品牌的家具。
【答案】B （细节题）Describe the furniture he received.
【定位】W: Do you mind describing the chairs that were delivered to your apartment, Mr. Brown?
女：布朗先生，您介意描述一下送到您公寓的那些椅子吗？
【信号】Do you mind 是请求信号。女方说 Do you mind describing the chairs，Do you mind加动名词是典型的礼貌请求句式，这正是她请男方做某事的那一句，请求的动作就是describing，是本题答案信号。
【替换】describing the chairs that were delivered ↔Describe the furniture he received
describe 换形且 chairs 概括为 furniture

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
录音后文女方说 We will send a van to collect those four，是商家派车来取、把货送回店里，A 项 Send the furniture back to the store 把这个送回动作安到男方头上，可这是商家做的、不是女方请男方做的，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：We will send a van to collect those four
C)
原词陷阱
录音里 collect 出自女方的 send a van to collect those four，是商家来取货，C 项Collect the furniture he ordered 借 collect 一词制造假象，但取货是商家的事，且collect 的是错送的椅子不是他订的货，方向也反了。
借用原文：send a van to collect those four
D)
未提及
D 项 Buy another brand of furniture 说让男方另买一个牌子的家具，录音里女方只承诺换成原来订的 Milano 椅子，从没让他改买别的品牌，brand 一词也未出现，属未提及。

stem: What did the woman promise to do for the man?

options.text: Correct their mistake.
Improve their service.
Apologize to his wife.
Give the money back.

explanation:
【题目】What did the woman promise to do for the man?
【翻译】女士承诺为男士做什么?
A) 纠正他们的错误。
B) 改进他们的服务。
C) 向他的妻子道歉。
D) 把钱退回。
【答案】A （细节题）Correct their mistake.
【定位】W: ... I'm terribly sorry. We will send a van to collect those four and replace them with the Milano you purchased. Will tomorrow 9 a.m. be okay, Mr. Brown?
女：……非常抱歉。我们会派一辆车来把这四把收走，换成您当初买的 Milano 椅子。明天上午九点方便吗，布朗先生？
【信号】We will 是承诺信号。女方用将来时 We will send a van to collect those four and replace them with the Milano you purchased，We will 表明这是商家做出的承诺，承诺的核心动作是收走错货、换成对的，正是本题答案信号。
【替换】replace them with the Milano you purchased ↔Correct their mistake
具体换货概括为纠正错误
there must have been some confusion with the order ↔mistake
confusion 同义于 mistake

【排除】B)
未提及
B 项 Improve their service 说商家承诺改进服务，但录音里女方只承诺这一单的换货处理，从没说今后要改善服务，service 一词也没出现，属凭印象拔高、未提及。
C)
原词陷阱
录音里女方确实说了 I'm terribly sorry，C 项 Apologize to his wife 借这个道歉做文章，但她是向男方布朗先生道歉、不是向他妻子，且本题问的是承诺去做的事，道歉是当场动作不是承诺，方向也错。
借用原文：I'm terribly sorry
D)
未提及
D 项 Give the money back 退钱，是顾客投诉时最容易联想到的结果，但录音里女方的承诺是换货不是退款，全程没出现 refund 或 money back，属凭常识想当然、未提及。

stem: What did the woman do at the end of the conversation?

options.text: She recommended a new style.
She offered some gift to the man.
She apologized to the man once more.
She checked all the items with the man.

explanation:
【题目】What did the woman do at the end of the conversation?
【翻译】女士在对话结束时做了什么?
A) 她推荐了一种新款式。
B) 她给男士提供了一些礼品。
C) 她再次向男士道歉。
D) 她和男士核对了所有物品。
【答案】C （细节题）She apologized to the man once more.
【定位】W: Okay, great. Once again, I'm sorry for the confusion and trouble caused.
女：好的。再一次，对于这次弄错和造成的麻烦我很抱歉。
【信号】末句 Once again sorry 是收尾道歉。录音最后一句女方说 Once again, I'm sorry for the confusion and trouble caused，Once again 加 sorry 是对话结尾再次致歉的明确信号，正对应题干的 at the end，是本题答案句。
【替换】Once again, I'm sorry ↔She apologized to the man once more
be sorry 转 apologize、once again 转 once more

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passages and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the center.
【排除】A)
未提及
A 项 She recommended a new style 说女方推荐新款式，但录音里她只承诺换回男方原订的 Milano，从没推荐任何新样式，style、recommend 都没出现，属未提及。
B)
未提及
B 项 She offered some gift to the man 说女方送礼，录音里女方只做了道歉和安排换货，从未提供任何礼物，gift 一词全程没出现，属未提及。
D)
原词陷阱
录音前文男方自己核对过 The mirror and two paintings are here 等物品，D 项 She checked all the items with the man 借这个核对场景做文章，但核对清单的是男方、且发生在对话中段不是结尾，本题问的是女方在结尾做的事，人和时点都对不上。
借用原文：The mirror and two paintings are here
