stem: What is Marie Kondo's TV show about?

options.text: Reading books of wisdom.
Tidying up one's home.
Sharing with others.
Donating to charity.

explanation:
【题目】What is Marie Kondo's TV show about?
【翻译】Marie Kondo 的电视节目是关于什么的?
A) 阅读智慧书籍。
B) 整理自己的家。
C) 与他人分享。
D) 捐赠给慈善机构。
【答案】B （主旨题）Tidying up one's home.
【定位】Say hello to a TV show called "Tidying Up with Marie Kondo", a home improvement show based on her wildly popular book The Life-Changing Magic of Tidying Up.
来认识一档叫《和近藤麻理惠一起整理》的电视节目，这是一档家居改善类节目，改编自她那本极受欢迎的书《怦然心动的人生整理魔法》。
【信号】开头点题句直接报出节目名与定位。录音一开篇就用 a TV show called "Tidying Up with Marie Kondo", a home improvement show 点明节目名和它“家居改善”的定位，这是主旨题最典型的“开头点题”信号——主题在第一句就交代了。
【替换】Tidying Up with Marie Kondo ↔Tidying up one's home.
节目名里的 Tidying Up 概括为“整理家”
a home improvement show ↔Tidying up one's home.
home improvement = 整理 one's home
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音确有 her wildly popular book 和 share the wisdom of the "KonMari" method，A把 book、wisdom 两个原词拼成 Reading books of wisdom.，但那本书只是节目的来源、wisdom 指整理方法的智慧，节目本身不是“读智慧之书”，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：share the wisdom of the "KonMari" method
C)
原词陷阱
录音说近藤 share the wisdom of the "KonMari" method，C 借 share 造出 Sharing with others.，可原文 share 的宾语是“整理方法的智慧”，不是“和别人分享东西”，主题更不是分享，属答非所问的原词陷阱。
借用原文：share the wisdom of the "KonMari" method
D)
原词陷阱
录音后半提到人们 bringing piles of donation bags to used goods stores，D 据此造出Donating to charity.，但捐赠只是节目带来的“效果”而非节目本身的主题，且原文是捐到二手店、并非 charity，既偷换概念又答非所问。
借用原文：bringing piles of donation bags to used goods stores
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What things can be kept in one's home according to Marie Kondo?

options.text: Things that make one happy.
Things that are becoming rare.
Things that occupy little space.
Things that cost a lot of money.

explanation:
【题目】What things can be kept in one's home according to Marie Kondo?
【翻译】根据 Marie Kondo 的说法,什么东西可以保留在家中?
A) 让人感到快乐的东西。
B) 正在变得稀有的东西。
C) 占用空间小的东西。
D) 花费很多钱的东西。
【答案】A （细节题）Things that make one happy.
【定位】...examine each item—all of them—to see if it sparks joy. If it does, you keep it.
……逐一检视每件物品——全部都要——看它是否让你心动（带来喜悦）。如果会，你就留下它。
【信号】条件句 If it does, you keep it 给出“留下”的标准。录音用 to see if it sparks joy. If it does, you keep it. 这个条件—结果句直接给出判断标准：会带来 joy 的就留下。这里keep 与题干 kept 对应、joy 是判定信号，正是答案句。
【替换】if it sparks joy ↔Things that make one happy.
sparks joy = make one happy
you keep it ↔can be kept
you keep it 主动 = can be kept 被动
【排除】B)
未提及
录音判定标准只有“是否 spark joy”，全程没有任何关于“东西稀有/将变稀有”的说法，Things that are becoming rare. 是凭空添加的标准。
C)
未提及
原文整理的标准是 joy，与物品占地大小无关；Things that occupy little space. 把一个常识里合理、但录音没说的标准塞进来，属未提及。
D)
未提及
近藤的标准是看是否 sparks joy，与价格无关，甚至贵而不让你心动的也该丢；Things that cost a lot of money. 既非原文标准，又与“按心动取舍”的精神相左。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about one used bookstore this January?

options.text: It joined the city's clean-up campaign.
It sold as many as fifty boxes of books.
It received an incredibly large number of donated books.
It did little business because of the unusual cold weather.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about one used bookstore this January?

【翻译】关于今年一月的一家旧书店,我们了解到什么?
A) 它加入了该市的清理运动。
B) 它售出了多达五十箱书。
C) 它收到了数量极其庞大的捐赠书籍。
D) 由于异常寒冷的天气,它几乎没有生意。
【答案】C （细节题）It received an incredibly large number of donated books.
【定位】One used bookstore received a month's worth of books in donations in a week when a man gave over fifty boxes of books from his home.
一家二手书店在一周内收到的捐书量相当于平常一个月，因为有一个人把家里五十多箱书都捐了出来。
【信号】对象 + 时间复现，紧跟的动词 received 是落点。录音出现 One used bookstore received a month's worth of books in donations in a week，与题干的 used bookstore、January 对象时间吻合，紧跟的动词 received（收到）正是这家书店“发生了什么”的核心信号。
【替换】received a month's worth of books in donations in a week ↔ received an incredibly large number of donated books
“一周收到一个月的量”=“收到大量捐书”
gave over fifty boxes of books ↔an incredibly large number of donated books
fifty boxes 是“数量大”的实证
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
录音说 People seemed determined to clean up their homes，A 借 clean-up 造出 It joined the city's clean-up campaign.，可 clean up 的主语是“人们整理自家”，根本没说书店参加什么城市清理活动，属张冠李戴式原词陷阱。
借用原文：People seemed determined to clean up their homes
B)
原词陷阱
录音原文是一个人 gave over fifty boxes of books（捐出五十多箱给书店），B 直接搬来数字造出 It sold as many as fifty boxes of books.，把动作从“收到捐赠”偷换成“书店卖出”，数字耳熟但方向全反，是最毒的原词陷阱。
借用原文：gave over fifty boxes of books from his home
D)
与原文相反
录音说一月通常因为 it's cold and people don't want to bother 捐赠少，但 not this January——今年反而捐赠暴增；D 造出 It did little business because of the unusual cold weather.，既偷用 cold，又取了被 but 否定掉的“前半”，与原文结论相反。
借用原文：January is usually the stores' slow season for donations because it's cold ... but not this January
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does Mike Hannon do to help people in his town?

options.text: Give free meals to the homeless.
Provide shelter for the homeless.
Help the vulnerable to cook lunches.
Call for change in the local government.

explanation:
【题目】What does Mike Hannon do to help people in his town?
【翻译】Mike Hannon 做了什么来帮助他镇上的人们?
A) 为无家可归者提供免费餐食。
B) 为无家可归者提供庇护所。
C) 帮助弱势群体烹饪午餐。
D) 呼吁地方政府做出改变。
【答案】A （细节题）Give free meals to the homeless.
【定位】"Mike's Lunches of Love" has fed more than 2,000 of the town's most vulnerable residents. Mike delivers meals to the homeless.
迈克的爱心午餐已经为镇上 2000 多名最弱势的居民提供了食物。迈克把饭菜送到无家可归者手中。
【信号】反复出现的核心动作 fed / delivers meals。定位信号是这个动作被连说两遍且是全篇主线——先说 has fed more than 2,000，紧接着 Mike delivers meals to the homeless，喂饭、送饭反复强调，正是他帮人的核心行为，答案句就在这里。

【替换】Mike delivers meals to the homeless ↔Give free meals to the homeless.
delivers meals 同义改写为 Give free meals
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
Provide shelter for the homeless. 借用了原文里的 the homeless 这个原词来制造听到就想选的诱惑，但录音说的是送饭（meals），从没说提供住处（shelter），把帮助方式偷换了。
借用原文：Mike delivers meals to the homeless
C)
原词陷阱
Help the vulnerable to cook lunches. 偷用了原文 most vulnerable residents 的vulnerable 一词，且 lunches 让人联想到 Lunches of Love，听着很耳熟；但原文是他亲自送饭给弱势者，不是帮弱势者自己做午饭，动作主体和方式都被改了。
借用原文："Mike's Lunches of Love" has fed more than 2,000 of the town's most vulnerable residents.
D)
原词陷阱
Call for change in the local government. 里的 change 看似呼应原文 change them，但原文的 change 指改变受助者的内心，而非呼吁地方政府改革；原文通篇讲做善事，根本没提向政府提诉求。
借用原文：spark something in them that can change them
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第24页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does Mike hope others will do?

options.text: Strengthen co-operation.
Promote understanding.
Win national support.
Following his example.

explanation:
【题目】What does Mike hope others will do?
【翻译】Mike 希望其他人做什么?
A) 加强合作。
B) 促进理解。
C) 赢得全国支持。
D) 效仿他的榜样。
【答案】D （细节题）Following his example.
【定位】He hopes his acts of charity will influence others to spread positive actions in their own towns.
他希望自己的慈善之举能影响别人，让他们在自己的城镇也去传播积极的行动。
【信号】愿望动词 hopes 直接领出期望。定位信号是表愿望的动词 He hopes——它后面那句 will influence others to spread positive actions 就是他希望别人做的事。听到 hope 立刻锁定其后内容，这是愿望类细节题的硬定位点。
【替换】influence others to spread positive actions in their own towns ↔Following his example.
影响别人去做同样的事即效仿他

【排除】A)
未提及
Strengthen co-operation. 是个听着很正面的大词，但原文从没说他希望大家加强合作；他要的是别人各自在自己城镇行善（spread positive actions），不是彼此协作。属于原文未出现的内容。
B)
未提及
Promote understanding. 同样是个正面大词，原文没有任何关于增进理解的表述。他的愿望明确是 spread positive actions（传播积极行动），与增进理解不是一回事。
C)
原词陷阱
Win national support. 里的 national 容易呼应原文后文反复出现的 all over the country，让人听着耳熟；但赢得全国支持讲的是他自己声名远播的结果，不是他希望别人做的事，答非所问。
借用原文：His message and star power have spread all over the country.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: How are people all over the country responding to what Mike is doing?

options.text: Spreading news of his deeds.
Writing him thank-you notes.
Following the example he sets.
Sending him hand-made bags.

explanation:
【题目】How are people all over the country responding to what Mike is doing?
【翻译】全国各地的人们如何回应 Mike 所做的事情?
A) 传播他的事迹。
B) 给他写感谢信。
C) 效仿他树立的榜样。
D) 给他寄送手工制作的袋子。
【答案】D （细节题）Sending him hand-made bags.
【定位】People from all over the country are sending special handcrafted bags to help the young man with his mission to help those in need.
全国各地的人们正在寄送特制的手工袋子，来帮助这个少年完成他帮助困难者的使命。
【信号】他人动作进行时 People are sending。定位信号是描述他人正在做某事的进行时句People from all over the country are sending special handcrafted bags——题干问how people are responding，原文这句正面回答了人们在做什么，是答案句。
【替换】People from all over the country are sending special handcrafted bags ↔ Sending him hand-made bags.
handcrafted bags 同义为 hand-made bags

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Spreading news of his deeds. 借用了原文多次出现的 spread（spread positive actions / have spread all over the country）来制造耳熟，但原文 spread 的是积极行动和他的影响力，不是说人们在传播他事迹的新闻，答非所问。
借用原文：His message and star power have spread all over the country.
B)
张冠李戴
Writing him thank-you notes. 容易让人想起原文 Mike includes a handwritten message——但写手写留言的是迈克自己（写在每个袋子上），不是别人给迈克写感谢信。这是把迈克做的事安到别人头上的张冠李戴。
借用原文：Mike includes a handwritten message of joy on each bag.
C)
答非所问
Following the example he sets. 与 20 题答案 Following his example. 几乎同义，是迈克希望别人做的（his hope），不是别人实际的回应方式。原文讲别人实际在寄手工袋子，而非说人们已经在效仿他，把愿望偷换成了现实回应。
借用原文：influence others to spread positive actions in their own towns
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第26页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What were the college students in both groups required to do in the study?

options.text: To solve word search puzzles.
To send smartphone messages.
To test their eyesight using a phone app.
To install some audio equipment in a lab.

explanation:
【题目】What were the college students in both groups required to do in the study?
【翻译】研究中要求两组大学生做什么?
A) 解字谜游戏。
B) 发送智能手机消息。
C) 使用手机应用程序测试他们的视力。
D) 在实验室安装一些音频设备。
【答案】A （细节题）To solve word search puzzles.
【定位】two groups of college students were given word search puzzles.
两组大学生被分发了找词谜题（让他们解）。
【信号】实验开头交代任务的句子。答案句是篇章开头交代实验安排的那句 two groups of college students were given word search puzzles，‘被给了找词谜题’正是两组共同要做的事；细节题的答案句往往就落在交代任务/背景的起始句，听到 were given 这种安排动作即锁定。
【替换】were given word search puzzles ↔To solve word search puzzles.
被给谜题=去解谜题
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
To send smartphone messages. 把原文反复出现的 smartphones 拿来装样子，但原文里手机只是被‘放在视线内/挪走/打进来响’的实验变量，从没让学生去‘发短信’，是听到smartphone 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：smartphones in their line of sight
C)
未提及
To test their eyesight using a phone app. 听起来像个合理实验，但原文研究的是手机对‘注意力/专注’的干扰，全篇没提 eyesight 或 app，属凭常识臆造的未提及项。
D)
原词陷阱
To install some audio equipment in a lab. 借了原文第二组被告知手机会 interfere with the equipment 里的 equipment 一词，但 equipment 是实验里的‘设备’、是手机要被挪开的理由，绝非让学生去‘安装音频设备’，把无关动作硬安在学生头上。
借用原文：would interfere with the equipment in the experiment
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第28页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about many of the students in the second test group after the phone rang?

options.text: They could not go on until the ringing stopped.
They could no longer concentrate on their task.
They grabbed the phone and called back right away.
They asked their experimenter to hang up the phone.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about many of the students in the second test group after the phone rang?
【翻译】关于第二个测试组中的许多学生在手机响起后我们了解到什么?
A) 他们无法继续进行,直到铃声停止。
B) 他们无法再集中精力完成任务。
C) 他们立即抓起手机回拨。
D) 他们要求实验人员挂断电话。
【答案】B （细节题）They could no longer concentrate on their task.
【定位】Many of the students in that group were unable to focus from then on, becoming anxious and performing more poorly than the first group.
那一组里许多学生从那以后再也无法集中注意力，变得焦虑，表现比第一组更差。
【信号】事件之后紧跟的状态描述句。电话响（let it ring for a while before hanging up）这个事件之后紧接的描述句就是答案句：Many of the students in that group were unable to focus from then on。细节题里‘某事件之后怎样’的答案，几乎都落在事件句的下一句，听到 from then on 这种时间衔接就锁定。
【替换】were unable to focus from then on ↔They could no longer concentrate on their task.
无法集中=不再能专注
【排除】A)
与原文相反
They could not go on until the ringing stopped. 借了原文 let it ring for a while 的ring，编成‘要等铃声停了才能继续’。但原文是‘从那以后一直无法专注’，并非‘等铃停就好了’，恰恰相反——干扰是持续的，这是盗用 ring 又改了意思的陷阱。
借用原文：let it ring for a while before hanging up
C)
未提及
They grabbed the phone and called back right away. 描述学生抓起电话立刻回拨，原文里学生根本没碰电话（是 experimenter 打进来再挂掉），学生只是变得焦虑、表现变差，‘回拨’是凭想象添的动作。
D)
张冠李戴
They asked their experimenter to hang up the phone. 借了原文 experimenter 和hang up（before hanging up），但挂电话的是实验者本人主动挂的，不是学生要求他挂的，把动作的发起方安错了人。
借用原文：before hanging up
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第29页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: According to the passage, what is the most dramatic impact of smartphone use?

options.text: A rise in emotional problems.
A decline in sports activities.
A reduction in the amount of sleep.
A decline in academic performance.

explanation:
【题目】According to the passage, what is the most dramatic impact of smartphone use?
【翻译】根据文章,智能手机使用最显著的影响是什么?
A) 情绪问题的增加。
B) 体育活动的减少。
C) 睡眠时间的减少。
D) 学业成绩的下降。
【答案】C （细节题）A reduction in the amount of sleep.
【定位】Perhaps the most dramatic impact is the reduction in the amount of sleep, which leads to poor health and weight gain.
也许最显著的影响是睡眠量的减少，它会导致健康变差和体重增加。
【信号】最高级the most dramatic直接点题。答案句被最高级标记直接点亮：Perhaps the most dramatic impact is the reduction in the amount of sleep，与题干 the most dramatic impact 完全对应。听力里最高级 the most… 后面紧跟的就是答案，是最硬的定位信号。
【替换】the reduction in the amount of sleep ↔A reduction in the amount of sleep.
几乎原句搬到选项
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A rise in emotional problems. 蹭了第二段 express emotions 里的 emotion，但原文那句讲的是人们改用社交媒体表达情绪、并未说情绪问题‘上升’，更没把它列为‘最突出’的影响，属盗用 emotion 一词的陷阱。
借用原文：many express emotions and engage in deep conversations through social media sites
B)
未提及
A decline in sports activities. 说体育活动减少，原文只提到 human interactions（人际互动）减少，从未提及 sports，属凭常识联想（手机多→运动少）添出来的未提及项。
D)
答非所问
A decline in academic performance. 对应原文 leads to poor grades，学业下滑原文确实提了，但它只是并列后果之一、没被冠以 the most dramatic，被最高级点名的是睡眠，故D是真有其事却答错重点的诱选。
借用原文：which leads to poor grades
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第30页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the speaker suggest people do?

options.text: Protect the eyesight of the younger generation.
Take effective measures to raise productivity.
Realize the disruptive effects of technology.
Ensure they have sufficient sleep every day.

explanation:
【题目】What does the speaker suggest people do?

【翻译】说话者建议人们做什么?
A) 保护年轻一代的视力。
B) 采取有效措施提高生产力。
C) 认识到技术的破坏性影响。
D) 确保他们每天有充足的睡眠。
【答案】C （目的题）Realize the disruptive effects of technology.
【定位】Technology is a great tool; however, it's important to recognize its downsides.
科技是个很好的工具；然而，认清它的负面作用很重要。
【信号】转折however后的主张句。答案句藏在转折之后：先扬 Technology is a great tool，转折however, it's important to recognize its downsides 才是说话人真正要强调的主张。转折however 后、又带 it's important to 这种态度口吻的句子，正是说话人立场的落点，是目的题最强的信号。
【替换】recognize its downsides ↔Realize the disruptive effects of technology.
认清负面=意识到破坏性影响
【排除】A)
未提及
Protect the eyesight of the younger generation. 拼了原文末句 the future generation的 generation，但 protect eyesight（保护视力）原文从没提，是借 generation 一词又凭常识添出来的未提及项。
借用原文：the effect on the future generation
B)
原词陷阱
Take effective measures to raise productivity. 借了第三段 reduction of productivity 的productivity，但原文把 productivity 下降列为科技的‘坏处之一’，说话人的主张是‘认清这些坏处’，而非‘采取措施提高生产力’，盗词又跑题。
借用原文：reduction of productivity
D)
答非所问
Ensure they have sufficient sleep every day. 蹭了第二、三段反复出现的 sleep，但‘保证充足睡眠’只是科技危害里的一个具体侧面，说话人结尾给的是总括主张‘认清科技的负面’，D把局部当成了说话人的整体建议。
借用原文：Lack of sleep, reduction of productivity and weight gain are only a few.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第31页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: The first type is apparent in people being stressed about the __(26)__ ups and downs of investment markets—actually not so much the ups, but __(27)__ the downs.

options.text: appearance
argued
avoid
considerable
definitely
extreme
inaction
incredibly
normal
possibly
proposition
repelled
statement
tend
traditional

explanation:
26. people being stressed about the __(26)__ ups and downs of investment markets
【答案】I) normal
形容词
【词性槽】形容词修饰名词短语 ups and downs
【依据】normal ups and downs = 正常的起伏
the normal ups and downs of investment markets = 投资市场『正常的』起起落落——这是为下文做铺垫：正是这种『本属正常』的波动让某些人焦虑，凸显其抗压力不足（unable or unprepared to endure the long haul）。
【竞争词】D) considerable
considerable『相当大的』把锅推给市场，与下句『这些人无法忍受长期持有』的主旨方向相反
如果填 considerable，意思变成『市场剧烈起伏让人焦虑』，那就是合理反应，与下句强调『这些人本身不耐长期持有』的主旨矛盾——作者要说的是『连正常波动他们都受不了』。且D considerable 留给 28 题做 a considerable percentage 才是命题人最常用的搭配（见第28 题）。
O) traditional traditional『传统的』与 ups and downs 搭配不自然
市场的起伏一般用 normal/regular/usual 描述其常态，traditional 多用于传统做法/传统行业，与『市场波动』搭配生硬。
【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 D) —— considerable 看似合理实则反主旨。the __(26)__ ups and downs of investment markets 处不少考生会填 considerable『相当大的』，把锅推给市场剧烈波动；但下句 These people are usually unable or unprepared to endure the long haul. 明确指出问题在『当事人不耐长期持有』，所以这里应是 normal『正常的』——连正常波动都受不了，才凸显当事人抗压不足。防坑：形容词题先看作者立场指向当事人还是指向外部。
answer_source: 完形填空（选词填空）解析.pdf 第3页

stem: In a __(28)__ percentage of cases of debt-induced financial stress, credit cards and loans will be a central element.

options.text: appearance
argued
avoid
considerable
definitely
extreme
inaction
incredibly
normal
possibly
proposition
repelled
statement
tend

stem: What does the author say may have an adverse impact on people?

options.text: Undergoing plastic surgeries in pursuit of beauty.
Imitating the lifestyles of heroes and role models.
Striving to achieve perfection regardless of financial cost.
Attempting to meet society's expectation of appearance.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author say may have an adverse impact on people? 用 What 直问作者所述的某种不利影响，是对原文事实信息的复述，不要求推理。
【拆句】What does the author say may have an adverse impact on people? 主干其实是 What may have an adverse impact on people（什么会对人产生不利影响），中间的 the author say 是插入说明「作者所说的」。考生若把 say 误当作主干动词，就会读不通；记住「主语+情态动词 have+宾语」才是句子骨架。
【定位】Trying to live up to the images of "perfect" models and movie heroes has a dark side: anxiety and depression, as well as unhealthy strategies for weight loss or muscle gain.
努力达到「完美」模特和电影英雄的形象是有阴暗面的：焦虑、抑郁，以及不健康的减肥或增肌方式。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
Undergoing plastic surgeries in pursuit of beauty（为了美而整形）只是 plastic surgery 在引子段被列举的现象之一，原文没说「整形」本身有 dark side，而是说「试图迎合完美形象」才有。
B)
偷换概念
Imitating the lifestyles of heroes and role models 偷偷把原文的 images（形象、外貌）替换成 lifestyles（生活方式），与原文 images of "perfect" models and movie heroes 强调的是「外貌形象」而非生活方式不符。
C)
无中生有
Striving to achieve perfection regardless of financial cost 的 regardless of financial cost（不计经济成本）在原文里没有依据；It also has a financial cost 只是说「同时也产生经济成本」，并非「不计成本」。
D)
✓ 正确
Trying to live up to the images of "perfect" models and movie heroes ↔ Attempting to meet society's expectation of appearance
Attempting to meet society's expectation of appearance 恰好把预判「迎合社会对外貌期待」逐字呈现，正中。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What have researchers found out about people's earnings?

options.text: They are closely related to people's social status.
They have to do with people's body weight and shape.
They seem to matter much less to men than to women.
They may not be equal to people's contributions.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What have researchers found out about people's earnings? 问研究者「发现了什么」，定位到结论句直接复述即可。
【拆句】What have researchers found out about people's earnings? 现在完成时强调「已经研究并得出结论」，主干是 What have researchers found out（研究者发现了什么），about people's earnings 是话题限定。结构平直，无陷阱。
【定位】Researchers have shown that body mass index is related to wages and income.
研究者已证明，身体质量指数（即体型胖瘦的衡量指标）与薪资和收入相关。
【选项】A)
无中生有
They are closely related to people's social status 的 social status（社会地位）在原文从未出现，原文只谈体重/体型与收入的关系。
B)
✓ 正确
body mass index is related to wages and income ↔ They have to do with people's body weight and shape
They have to do with people's body weight and shape 把定位句逐成分等值改写，是与预判最贴合的一项。
C)
答非所问
They seem to matter much less to men than to women 把比较关系错置在「收入」上，原文说的是「体重对女性收入的惩罚比男性明显」，而非「收入对男性意义更小」。题目问的是研究者发现的关于收入的事，而非男女对收入的看重程度。
D)
无中生有
They may not be equal to people's contributions（收入可能与贡献不匹配）涉及的「贡献」概念在原文完全不存在。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author's recent study focus on?

options.text: Previous literature on indicators of competitiveness in the workplace.
Traits that matter most in one's pursuit of success in the labor market.
Whether self-perception of body image impacts one's workplace success.
How bosses' perception of body image impacts employees' advancement.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author's recent study focus on? 直问研究焦点，需要在原文找到明确指明研究问题的句子。
【拆句】What does the author's recent study focus on? 主干 What does the study focus on（研究关注什么），author's recent 是修饰 study 的两个前置定语。结构清晰，无难点。
【定位】Does a person's own perception of body image matter to earnings and other indicators of success in the workplace? Our recently published study answered this question by tracking a large national random sample of Americans over a critical time period when bodies change from teenage shape into adult form and when people build their identities.
一个人自己对身体形象的感知是否影响其收入和其他职场成功指标？我们最近发表的研究通过追踪一批庞大的全国随机样本回答了这个问题——这些样本横跨人从青少年体型变成成年体型、并开始建立自我认同的关键时期。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
Previous literature on indicators of competitiveness in the workplace 写的是「前人文献」，但原文明确说「前人文献清楚雇主感知会影响职场成功，无人探究问题的另一面」——前人文献是背景而非作者研究焦点。
B)
无中生有
Traits that matter most in one's pursuit of success in the labor market 的 Traits（特质）一词原文未出现；原文讨论的是「自我感知」这一具体维度，而非泛泛的「特质」。
C)
✓ 正确
Does a person's own perception of body image matter to earnings and other indicators of success in the workplace? ↔Whether self-perception of body image impacts one's workplace success
Whether self-perception of body image impacts one's workplace success 把 P4 的疑问句逐成分改写，预判一对就中。
D)
与原文相反
How bosses' perception of body image impacts employees' advancement 的bosses' perception（雇主的感知）恰恰是原文 how employers and customers perceive your body image 这条已被前人研究透、作者明确表态「另一面没人探讨」的方向。作者研究焦点正是其对立面。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What is the finding of the author's recent research?

options.text: Being overweight actually does not do much harm to the overall well-being of employees.
People are not adversely affected in the workplace by false self-perception of body weight.
Self-esteem helps to combat gender inequality in the workplace.
Gender inequality continues to frustrate a lot of female employees.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What is the finding of the author's recent research? 问研究结论本身，是对原文We found... 句的同义复述。
【拆句】What is the finding of the author's recent research? 主干 What is the finding（结果是什么），of the author's recent research 是后置定语限定 finding 的来源。无难点。
【定位】We found no relationship between the average person's self-perception of weight and labor market outcomes, although self-perceived weight can influence self-esteem(自尊心), mental health and health behaviors.
我们发现普通人对自身体重的感知与劳动力市场结果之间没有关系，尽管自我感知的体重确实会影响自尊心、心理健康和健康行为。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
Being overweight actually does not do much harm to the overall well-being of employees 把研究主语从「自我感知体重」换成「真实超重」；原文研究的是 self-perception（自我感知），不是 actual overweight；且原文从未说真实超重「不损害」员工，P3 反而明确女性超重在职场上有 clear penalty。
B)
✓ 正确
no relationship between the average person's self-perception of weight and labor market outcomes
↔
People are not adversely affected in the workplace by false self-perception of body weight
People are not adversely affected in the workplace by false self-perception of body weight 是对 P7 结论句的标准被动改写，与预判完全一致。
C)
与原文相反
Self-esteem helps to combat gender inequality in the workplace 说「自尊心帮助对抗性别不平等」，与原文 self-perceived weight can influence self-esteem（自我感知体重影响自尊）方向完全相反，且原文没说自尊能对抗性别不平等。
D)
答非所问
Gender inequality continues to frustrate a lot of female employees 对应的是 the continued gender penalty in the labor market is frustrating 那句情绪表态，并非作者本次研究的核心发现；题干问 finding（研究结论），不是问情绪感受。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author think would help improve the condition in the labor market?

options.text: Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image.
Expanding protection of women against gender discrimination.
Helping employees change their own perception of beauty.
Excluding body shape as a category in the labor contract.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author think would help improve the condition in the labor market? 问作者认为什么能改善现状，对应原文末段的明确主张句。
【拆句】What does the author think would help improve the condition in the labor market?主干 What would help improve the condition（什么能帮助改善现状），the author think 插入说明「作者认为」，in the labor market 限定改善对象。结构稍长但平直，提醒考生把 the author think 当插入语处理即可。
【定位】Since employers' perception of weight is what matters in the labor market, changing discrimination laws to include body type as a category would also help. Michigan is the only state that prohibits discrimination on the basis of weight and height. We believe expanding such protections would make the labor market more fair and efficient.
既然在劳动力市场中真正起作用的是雇主对体重的感知，那么修改反歧视法、把体型也列入受保护类别就会有所帮助。密歇根州是唯一以法律禁止基于体重和身高进行歧视的州。我们相信扩大此类保护会让劳动力市场更公平、更高效。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
changing discrimination laws to include body type as a category ↔ Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image
Michigan is the only state that prohibits discrimination on the basis of weight and height ↔ Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image
Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image 把 P9 的法律建议浓缩为一句，预判对比即中。
B)
偷换概念
Expanding protection of women against gender discrimination 把保护对象偷偷换成「女性免受性别歧视」，但原文末段主张扩大的是「基于体型的反歧视保护」（body type），不是性别歧视保护；P8 提到 gender penalty 但作者紧接着说 our finding... is more heartening，并未把性别保护作为主推方案。
C)
与原文相反
Helping employees change their own perception of beauty 主张「帮助员工改变自我审美感知」；但原文 Since employers' perception of weight is what matters in the labor market 明确表态「起作用的是雇主感知」，作者要改的是法律环境而不是员工自我感知。
D)
与原文相反
Excluding body shape as a category in the labor contract 写的是「把体型排除在劳动合同范畴之外」，与原文 include body type as a category 中 include（纳入）形成Excluding（排除）的反义对立，完全反向。

stem: What does the author suggest by saying "The work-life balance is dead"?

options.text: The hope of achieving a thriving life is impossible to realize.
The pursuit of a fulfilling career involves personal sacrifice.
The imbalance between work and life simply doesn't exist anymore
The concept of work-life balance contributes little to a fulfilling life.

explanation:
【答案】D （词义句意题）
【判型】题干用 What does the author suggest by saying 的句式，直接询问作者说这句话想表达什么，是典型的句意理解题。
【拆句】主干是 What does the author suggest，by 引导的方式状语 by saying "The work-life balance is dead" 修饰 suggest，引号内是宾语从句的内容，整体平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】The work-life balance is dead. By this, I'm not advocating that you should give up your pursuit of having a fulfilling career and a thriving personal life, and I'm definitely not saying that you have to give up one to have the other. I also acknowledge that we have a work-life problem, but I'm arguing that the concept of balance has never been helpful, because it's too limiting.
「工作-生活平衡」这个说法已经死了。我说这话不是劝你放弃追求充实的事业和蓬勃的私人生活，更不是说你必须放弃其一才能拥有另一个。我承认我们确实存在工作-生活问题，但我主张「平衡」这个概念从来都没什么用，因为它把人框得太死。
【选项】A)
把对「概念」的否定偷换成对「目标」的否定
选项说「实现充实人生的希望根本不可能实现」，而作者明确否认了这种解读：I'm not advocating that you should give up your pursuit of having a fulfilling career and a thriving personal life——他根本没说目标做不到，只说「平衡」这个词不好用。
B)
无中生有
选项说追求充实事业需要「个人牺牲」，文中通篇没讨论过 sacrifice 或牺牲——作者只是要换掉 balance 的提法，没说追求事业要牺牲生活。
C)
与原文相反
选项说工作和生活的失衡现象不再存在了，作者却紧接着承认 I also acknowledge that we have a work-life problem——他承认问题真实存在，只是反对 balance 这个概念，与选项正相反。
D)
✓ 正确
the concept of balance has never been helpful ↔ The concept of work-life balance contributes little to a fulfilling life
a fulfilling career and a thriving personal life ↔a fulfilling life
The concept of work-life balance contributes little to a fulfilling life 用「贡献甚微」换「从来没帮助」、用「充实人生」概括「事业加私生活」，正是定位句 the concept of balance has never been helpful 的同义改写。

source_file: cet4/2020-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say about our use of language?

options.text: It impacts how we think and behave.
It changes with the passage of time.
It reflects how we communicate.
It differs from person to person.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author say about our use of language 直接问作者关于某具体对象的明确表述，要求复述原文观点。
【拆句】主干 What does the author say，about 介词短语 about our use of language 限定 say的内容范围，句式简单。
【定位】You see, our language makes a difference, and how we refer to things matters because it affects our thinking and therefore our actions.
你看，我们的语言会造成不同，我们如何称呼事物很重要，因为它影响我们的思维，进而影响我们的行动。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
it affects our thinking and therefore our actions ↔It impacts how we think and behave
It impacts how we think and behave 同时覆盖「思维」和「行动」两个语义点，与定位句中的因果链完全对应，是定位句的最简同义改写。
B)
无中生有
选项说语言「随时间推移而变化」，原文谈的是语言对思维的影响，从未讨论语言本身的历时演变。
C)
偷换概念
选项说语言「反映」我们如何沟通，定位句说语言「影响」思维和行动——reflect（反映）和 affect（影响）方向相反：一个是被动镜像，一个是主动塑造。
D)
无中生有
选项说语言「因人而异」，原文谈的是语言对所有人的共同效应（影响思维与行动），完全没讨论个体差异。

stem: What does the author say we do in an ideal world?

options.text: We do work that betters the lives of our families and friends.
We do work that gives us bursts of joy each new day.
We do meaningful work that contributes to society.
We do demanding work that brings our capacity into full play.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author say we do in an ideal world 限定在 ideal world 这一条件下询问具体做法，是单点细节复述。
【拆句】主干 What does the author say we do，we do 是宾语从句省略 that，in an ideal world是地点状语；句式直白。
【定位】In the ideal world, we're all doing work that we're proud of and that provides meaning and purpose to us. But even if your job doesn't give you shivers of joy each new day, working is a part of what each of us does and the contribution we make to society.
在理想世界里，我们都在做让自己自豪、能为我们提供意义与目的的工作。但即便你的工作不会让你每天都因喜悦而颤抖，工作仍是我们每个人所做的事情之一，是我们对社会做出的贡献。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
选项说工作让「家人与朋友」的生活变得更好，原文说的是 the contribution we make to society——贡献对象是「社会」，不是「家人与朋友」；且 support …our families, and the people around us 是讲「养活」，不是「理想世界中的工作内容」。
B)
与原文相反
原文 even if your job doesn't give you shivers of joy each new day 用 even if 引导让步：即便工作不带来 shivers of joy，工作也仍是贡献——意味着作者承认「很多人的工作并不带来 shivers of joy」，选项却把「带来 shivers of joy」说成「理想世界的状态」，与原文意图相反。
C)
✓ 正确
provides meaning and purpose to us ↔meaningful work
the contribution we make to society ↔contributes to society
We do meaningful work that contributes to society 同时打中「有意义的工作」和「对社会有贡献」两个语义点，与定位句两层并列对应。
D)
无中生有
选项说「做让我们能力全开的高难度工作」，原文谈的是工作的「意义、目的、对社会贡献」，从未涉及工作难度或能力发挥维度。

stem: What does the author advise us to do?

options.text: Make life as simple as possible.

Strive for a more fulfilling life.

explanation:
【答案】D （主旨题）
【判型】What does the author advise us to do 不指向某段细节，而问作者贯穿全文给读者的最终主张，落在末段总结句，本质是主旨或态度类问题。
【拆句】What does the author advise us to do，主干 the author advise us，to do 是不定式宾语补足语，结构平直。
【选项】A)
无中生有
选项说让生活「尽可能简单」，原文从未谈过 simple 或 simplicity——作者主张的是「更宏大美好的 fulfillment」，与「简化」无关。

以偏概全

与原文相反

a lot more living ↔a more fulfilling life
Strive for a more fulfilling life 用 strive for 对接末段 think bigger and better about，用 a more fulfilling life 对接 work-life fulfillment 加 a lot more living——选项准确覆盖全文呼吁的两个核心词 fulfillment 与 living。

全文主旨
航空公司偏爱蓝色座椅的心理学缘由
全文围绕航空业普遍选用蓝色机舱座椅这一现象展开，开篇即点题 Airlines across the globe __(26)__ various shades of blue in their cabin seats, and it is no __(27)__，并由资深航空设计师Nigel Goode 解释：蓝色与信任、安静、平和等积极心理特质相关，能营造放松、家一般的乘机环境。
D I S T R A C T O R S · 干扰词复盘
这 5 个词始终没被任何空选用
词库 15 词里有 5 个是命题人埋的干扰词——它们词性看着也对、词义也沾点边，却不该填进任何一个空。下面逐个剖析它们最像哪个空的答案、为什么是陷阱。
C) determined 最像 28 题答案的过去分词干扰

E) enormous 最像 29 题答案的形容词干扰
enormous 词性与 recognizable 同为形容词，看似可以放进 make it more __(29)__ 形容品牌"巨大"。识破方法：紧贴上文 reinforce the airline's brand 的真实目的是提高识别度而非体量，故应选 recognizable。
F) imitate 最像 26 题答案的动词原形干扰
imitate 与 integrate 都是动词原形，配复数主语 Airlines 在形态上同样合规。识破方法：把宾语various shades of blue 代入——"模仿各种蓝色"在常识上荒谬，而"采用/融入各种蓝色"才符合"航司主动选择颜色"的全文主旨。
G) indication 最像 27 题答案的名词干扰
indication 与 coincidence 同为名词，紧跟 no 在语法上都能接受。识破方法：no indication 意为"没有迹象"，会和紧接下文 There does appear to be some psychology behind it 的肯定语气相互矛盾，而 no coincidence（非偶然）则与之顺接。

stem: What do we learn from the passage about reverse graffiti?

options.text: It uses paint to create anti-pollution images.
It creates a lot of trouble for local residents.
It causes lots of distraction to drivers.
It turns dirty walls into artistic works.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do we learn from the passage about reverse graffiti? 问的是关于这个概念的客观信息，答案应该是对原文某句的同义转述，不需要推断
【拆句】题干 What do we learn from the passage about reverse graffiti? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 we learn，from the passage 是状语，about reverse graffiti 修饰 learn 的内容；无从句、无否定、无比较，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱
【定位】They find dirty surfaces and paint them with images or messages using cleaning brushes or pressure hoses. Either way, it's the same principle: the image is made by cleaning away the dirt.
他们找到脏污的表面，用清洁刷或高压水管在上面「画」出图像或讯息。无论哪种方式，原理都一样：图像是通过清除脏污而形成的。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
uses paint to create anti-pollution images 把原文的核心做法说反了——反向涂鸦恰恰不用颜料，而是清除污渍
B)
无中生有
creates a lot of trouble for local residents 文中无对应描述；麻烦的是市议会的执法逻辑，居民层面文中只提到他们 want to live in clean and attractive neighbourhoods，并未说反向涂鸦给居民带来麻烦
C)
张冠李戴
原文提到的是 Made up of a series of white skulls(颅骨), the painting reminds drivers of the effect their pollution is having on the planet——是提醒司机，而非分散司机注意力；且这是 Orion 一人的做法，并非反向涂鸦的普遍特征
D)
✓ 正确
the image is made by cleaning away the dirt ↔turns dirty walls into artistic works
预判要的是「在脏面上靠清洁形成图像」，turns dirty walls into artistic works 正是这层意思的同义改写
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第2页

stem: What do reverse graffiti artists try to do?

options.text: Publicise their artistic pursuit.
Beautify the city environment.
Raise public awareness of environmental pollution.
Express their dissatisfaction with local governments.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do reverse graffiti artists try to do? 问群体共同意图，原文必有明文交代，仅需找出该明文即可
【拆句】题干 What do reverse graffiti artists try to do? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主语reverse graffiti artists，谓语 try to do；try to do 是固定结构，表示「试图、致力于做某事」；句法平直，无陷阱
【定位】Each artist has their own individual style but all artists share a common aim: to draw attention to the pollution in our cities.
每个艺术家都有自己独特的风格，但所有艺术家都拥有一个共同的目标：唤起人们对城市污染的关注。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
Publicise their artistic pursuit 把原文中的「让公众关注城市污染」偷换成「宣传他们自己的艺术追求」——原文 a common aim 是污染议题，不是他们个人艺术名声
B)
无中生有
Beautify the city environment 文中无对应；尽管反向涂鸦的产物确实清洁了表面，但艺术家自陈的目的是「让人关注污染」，而非「美化城市」
C)
✓ 正确
to draw attention to the pollution in our cities ↔ Raise public awareness of environmental pollution
预判要的是「让公众关注污染」，Raise public awareness of environmental pollution 是其标准同义改写
D)
过度推断
Express their dissatisfaction with local governments 把作者在第三段对市议会的暗讽错当成全体反向涂鸦艺术家的目的；原文意图句仅指向污染议题，并未把矛头对准政府

C)
无中生有
suggested banning all polluting cars 文中无对应；Orion 的原话仅是批评驾驶者不顾环境代价 they don't give any consideration to the price their comfort has for the environment，并未提出禁止任何污染车辆的建议
D)
以偏概全
was fond of doing creative artworks 把原文一次具体的隧道清洁创作扩大成「热衷于做创意艺术品」这一普遍性格描述；原文 P2 只提到一次具体行动与一次发言，未对其性格倾向作概括评价
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页

stem: What does the author imply about Leeds City Council's decision?

options.text: It is simply absurd.
It is well-informed.
It is rather unexpected.
It is quite sensible.

explanation:
【答案】A （推断题）
【判型】题干 What does the author imply about Leeds City Council's decision? 中 imply 是推断题的标志词，问作者对市议会决定的隐含态度
【拆句】题干 What does the author imply about Leeds City Council's decision? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主语 the author，谓语 imply，about 引导对象状语；imply 一词把本题定性为推断题，是关键信号
【定位】Moose was ordered to "clean up his act." How was he supposed to do this: by making all property he had cleaned dirty again?
穆斯被勒令「整改其行为」。他该怎么做呢：把他已经清洁过的所有地方再弄脏一遍？
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
How was he supposed to do this: by making all property he had cleaned dirty again? ↔ simply absurd
预判要的是「作者觉得这决定荒诞」，simply absurd 是该态度的最直接形容词替换
B)
与原文相反
well-informed（消息灵通、了解情况）是正面评价，与作者用归谬反问表达的否定态度方向相反
C)
偷换概念
rather unexpected 把作者的「不合理、说不通」误写成「出乎意料」；原文并未表达「我没想到他们会这么决定」，而是表达「这决定本身就站不住脚」
D)
与原文相反
quite sensible（相当明智）是正面评价，作者用归谬反问明显否定这一决定，方向相反
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页

stem: How did Sao Paulo city officials handle Alexandre Orion's reverse graffiti?

options.text: They made him clean all the tunnels in Sao Paulo.
They took drastic action to ban all reverse graffiti.
They charged him with polluting tunnels in the city.
They made it impossible for him to practice his art.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 How did Sao Paulo city officials handle Alexandre Orion's reverse graffiti? 问官方采取了什么客观行动，原文必有明文，按细节题处理
【拆句】题干 How did Sao Paulo city officials handle Alexandre Orion's reverse graffiti? 是How 引导的特殊疑问句，handle 意为「处理、应对」；主体是官方，宾语是艺术家的作品；结构清晰，无陷阱
【定位】The city officials then decided to take drastic action. They not only cleaned the whole tunnel but every tunnel in Sao Paulo.
市政官员随后决定采取激烈手段。他们不仅清洁了那条隧道，还清洁了圣保罗的每一条隧道。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
made him clean all the tunnels 把清洁主体偷换成艺术家本人；原文 They not only cleaned the whole tunnel 明确主语是 they（官方），不是艺术家
B)
过度推断
ban all reverse graffiti 把官方动作上升为「禁止反向涂鸦」的法规层面；原文 the authorities were annoyed but could find nothing to charge him with 明确说找不到罪名，因此他们没有也无法颁布禁令，只是用清洁的方式釜底抽薪
C)
与原文相反
charged him with polluting tunnels 与原文明文 the authorities were annoyed but could find nothing to charge him with 直接矛盾——原文说「找不到罪名可控告」，选项却说「以污染隧道为罪起诉了他」
D)
✓ 正确
They not only cleaned the whole tunnel but every tunnel in Sao Paulo ↔ made it impossible for him to practice his art
The city officials then decided to take drastic action ↔ made it impossible for him to practice his art
预判要的是「让艺术家无法继续创作」，made it impossible for him to practice his art 正是该后果的客观表述；反向涂鸦的前提是脏面，官方清光所有脏面即从根本上让他无法操作
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What do some experts think about paying children for doing chores?

options.text: It may benefit children in more ways than one.
It may help children learn the worth of labor.
It may not turn out to be the best thing to do.
It may not be accepted by low-income parents.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do some experts think about paying children for doing chores? 直接问"某些专家怎么看",指向原文里一处明确观点句,属于客观转述类细节。
【拆句】题干 What do some experts think about paying children for doing chores? 是一个wh- 疑问句,主干是 What do some experts think,后接介词短语 about paying children for doing chores 作 think 的对象,paying 是动名词、doing 是动名词作介词 for 的宾语;结构平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【定位】Although many parents believe that paying an allowance for completing chores benefits their children, a range of experts expressed concern that tying allowance very closely to chores may not be ideal.
尽管许多父母认为按完成家务发零花钱对孩子有益,一批专家却表达了担忧,认为把零花钱与家务紧密挂钩可能并非理想做法。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
It may benefit children in more ways than one 说"给孩子付钱做家务在不止一方面对孩子有益",正是原文 many parents believe that paying an allowance for completing chores benefits their children 中父母的观点,而非专家的观点;父母与专家在原文里立场相反,这一项把"父母信念"安到了"专家观点"头上。
B)
无中生有
It may help children learn the worth of labor 说付钱能让孩子学到"劳动的价值",原文从未在专家口中出现 worth of labor 或近义表达,属于凭常识脑补。
C)
✓ 正确
may not be ideal ↔may not turn out to be the best thing to do
tying allowance very closely to chores ↔paying children for doing chores
选项 It may not turn out to be the best thing to do 与预判"未必是最好的做法"语义完全吻合,情态词 may 和否定 not 都对齐,故锁定为答案。
D)
无中生有
It may not be accepted by low-income parents 说低收入父母可能不接受,原文通篇没有讨论 low-income parents 这一群体,纯属节外生枝。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: According to Suniya Luthar, doing chores will help children learn to ____.

options.text: share family responsibilities
appreciate the value of work
cultivate the spirit of independence
manage domestic affairs themselves

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 According to Suniya Luthar, doing chores will help children learn to ____. 用According to + 人名指明出处,要求补全她的观点细节。
【拆句】题干 According to Suniya Luthar, doing chores will help children learn to ____. 主干是doing chores will help children learn to ____,doing chores 是动名词作主语,help sb. learn to do 是固定结构,空位接动词原形;结构平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【定位】Luthar is not opposed to giving allowances, but she thinks it's important to establish that chores are done not because they will lead to payment, but because they keep the household running.
Luthar 并不反对给零花钱,但她认为重要的是要明确:做家务不是因为家务会带来报酬,而是因为家务能让家庭正常运转。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
they keep the household running ↔share family responsibilities
选项 share family responsibilities 与预判"为家庭运转分担一份力"的语义吻合,核心都是"为家庭"而非"为钱"或"为自身"。
B)
无中生有
appreciate the value of work 与 Q51 中的 learn the worth of labor 几乎同款,都是原文未出现的"劳动价值"口号,Luthar 强调的是"为家庭运转"而非"劳动的价值"。
C)
偷换概念
cultivate the spirit of independence(培养独立精神)是常见的家务教育口号,但 Luthar通篇没有谈 independence,她谈的是 household running(家庭运转),把焦点从"家庭"挪到了"个人独立"。
D)
过度推断
manage domestic affairs themselves 说孩子自己"管家务",反身代词 themselves 强调"独自",原文只说让家庭运转,从未要求孩子独立"打理家务",且年龄段也对不上。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does Ron Lieber think should be the goal of giving children allowances?

options.text: To help to strengthen family ties.
To teach them how to manage money.
To motivate them to do more housework.
To show parents' appreciation of their help.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does Ron Lieber think should be the goal of giving children allowances?直接问 Lieber 认为发零花钱的目的是什么,原文必有对应观点。
【拆句】题干 What does Ron Lieber think should be the goal of giving children allowances?是宾语从句嵌入疑问句的结构:What 实际是宾语从句 What should be the goal of giving children allowances 中的主语,Ron Lieber think 是插入语,giving children allowances 是动名词短语作 of 的宾语;结构稍复杂但无陷阱。
【定位】Luthar's suggested approach to allowance is compatible with that of writer Ron Lieber, who advises that allowances be used as a means of showing children how to save, give, and spend on things they care about.
Luthar 的零花钱主张与作家 Ron Lieber 的主张一致,Lieber 建议把零花钱用作教孩子如何储蓄、给予以及在他们在意的事情上花钱的手段。
【选项】A)
无中生有
To help to strengthen family ties 说零花钱能加强家庭纽带,family ties(家庭纽带)在原文中无任何对应表述。
B)
✓ 正确
showing children how to save, give, and spend on things they care about ↔ To teach them how to manage money
选项 To teach them how to manage money 把 save/give/spend 三者上位化为manage money,与预判"教孩子理财"完全吻合。
C)
与原文相反
To motivate them to do more housework 说零花钱用来"激励孩子多做家务",正是Lieber 与 Luthar 共同反对的观点(原文末引文 not with the expectation of compensation),把他立场完全反转。
D)
偷换概念
To show parents' appreciation of their help 说零花钱是为表达父母对孩子帮助的感谢,Lieber 谈的是"教孩子"而非"父母表达感激",方向完全错位。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does David Lancy say about 18-month-olds?

options.text: They have a natural instinct to help around the house.
They are too young to request money for what they do.
They should learn to understand family responsibilities.
They need a little incentive to get involved in housework.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does David Lancy say about 18-month-olds? 直接问 Lancy 关于 18 个月孩子说了什么,原文必有出处。
【拆句】题干 What does David Lancy say about 18-month-olds? 是 wh- 疑问句,主干是 What does David Lancy say,about 18-month-olds 是介词短语作 say 的对象状语,18-month-olds 是带连字符的复合名词,意为"18 个月大的孩子";结构平铺直叙。
【定位】At about 18 months of age, Lancy says, most children become eager to help their parents, and in many cultures, they begin helping with housework at that age.
Lancy 说,大约 18 个月大时,大多数孩子就变得渴望帮父母,在许多文化中,他们就是从这个年龄开始参与家务的。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
become eager to help their parents ↔have a natural instinct to help around the house
选项 They have a natural instinct to help around the house 与预判"自发想帮父母做家务"完全吻合,natural instinct 把 eager 的强度感与自发性都吃下来了。
B)
无中生有
They are too young to request money for what they do 说他们太小不会要钱,too young to 是"太……以至于不能"结构,原文从未谈 18 个月孩子是否"要钱",纯属脑补。
C)
偷换概念
They should learn to understand family responsibilities 用 should 提出应然主张,但原文 Lancy 是在描述 18 个月孩子"已经渴望帮忙"这一事实,而非主张他们"应该去理解家庭责任";动作主体也被悄悄换成了"教孩子去理解"。
D)
与原文相反
They need a little incentive to get involved in housework 说他们需要"一点激励"才参与家务,这恰是 Lancy 反对的观点;原文明确说他们 become eager to help,根本不需要外在 incentive,而文末 Lancy 又直接说 not to try to use money as an incentive。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does David Lancy advise American parents to do?

options.text: Set a good example for children in doing housework.
Make children do housework without compensation.
Teach children how to do housework.
Accept children's early bids to help.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does David Lancy advise American parents to do? 问 Lancy 给美国父母的建议,原文末尾必有明示建议句。
【拆句】题干 What does David Lancy advise American parents to do? 是 wh- 疑问句,主干是What does David Lancy advise,advise sb. to do sth. 是固定结构,American parents 是advise 的宾语,to do 是不定式作宾补;What 实指 to do 后省去的动词宾语;结构平铺直叙。
【定位】The solution to this problem is not to try to use money as an incentive to do housework, but to get children involved in housework much earlier, when they actually want to do it.
对这个问题的解决办法,不是用钱当作做家务的激励,而是让孩子在他们真的想做家务的更早年龄就参与进来。
【选项】A)
无中生有
Set a good example for children in doing housework 说父母要做榜样,原文从未谈set a good example/role model 类内容,Lancy 谈的是"时机"而非"示范"。
B)
以偏概全
Make children do housework without compensation 说要让孩子无偿做家务;without compensation 虽呼应了 Lieber 的 not with the expectation of compensation,但 Lancy 的核心建议不是"无偿",而是"趁早"(timing),把重点偏移到了"是否给钱"上。
C)
偷换概念
Teach children how to do housework 说教孩子"怎么做家务"的技能,原文重点是"何时让他们做"(timing)而非"如何教他们做"(skill);两者方向不同。
D)
✓ 正确
We deny our children's bids to help ↔Accept children's early bids to help
get children involved in housework much earlier, when they actually want to do it ↔ Accept children's early bids to help
选项 Accept children's early bids to help 把 deny → accept 反义对换,early、bids to help 原词保留,与预判"趁早接住孩子主动"完全吻合。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2020-09/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What is reported in the news?

options.text: Many people have been attacked by Devil Firefish.
The Mediterranean is a natural habitat of Devil Firefish.
Invasive species are driving away certain native species.
A deadly fish has been spotted in the Mediterranean waters.

explanation:
【题目】What is reported in the news?
【翻译】新闻报道了什么?
A) 许多人遭到魔鬼火鱼的攻击。
B) 地中海是魔鬼火鱼的天然栖息地。
C) 入侵物种正在驱逐某些本地物种。
D) 地中海水域发现了一种致命鱼类。
【答案】D （主旨题）A deadly fish has been spotted in the Mediterranean waters.
【定位】A poisonous fish which has a sting strong enough to kill a human is invading the Mediterranean, warn scientists.
科学家警告说，一种毒刺强到足以杀死人类的毒鱼正在入侵地中海。
【信号】新闻首句即导语。答案就在录音第一句 A poisonous fish which has a sting strong enough to kill a human is invading the Mediterranean。新闻的开头第一句是"导语"，按惯例把"什么东西、在哪、发生了什么"一次性压缩说完，主旨题的答案几乎必在这里，不必等后文。
【替换】A poisonous fish which has a sting strong enough to kill a human ↔A deadly fish
毒到能致命＝deadly
is invading the Mediterranean ↔has been spotted in the Mediterranean waters
正在入侵＝已被发现于该海域

【排除】A)
未提及
录音只说毒刺"强到足以杀人"、且明说 fatalities are rare（致死案例罕见），并没说"很多人已被攻击"。选项 Many people have been attacked 盗用了录音里 kill a human、sting 的危险氛围，把"有杀人的潜力"偷换成"很多人已遭攻击"，是无中生有的夸大。
借用原文：Although fatalities are rare, the stings can cause extreme pain and stop people breathing
B)
与原文相反
录音明说这鱼 Native to the South Pacific and Indian Ocean（原产南太平洋和印度洋），是"入侵"地中海，恰恰说明地中海不是它的天然栖息地。选项 The Mediterranean is a natural habitat 盗用了 the Mediterranean 这个高频地名，却把"入侵地"歪曲成"原产地"，与原文相反。
借用原文：Native to the South Pacific and Indian Ocean, the potentially deadly fish has poisonous hooks
C)
过度推断
录音只说环保人士"担心"这鱼"could endanger"其他海洋生物（还没发生），选项 Invasive species are driving away certain native species 用现在时把"可能危及"说成"正在赶走本地物种"这一既成事实，且 Invasive species 用复数泛指多种入侵物种，与本则只报道一种鱼的范围不符。它盗用了 invasive 这个原词。
借用原文：environmentalists fear its arrival could endanger other types of marine life
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the environmentalist concerned about the spread of Devil Firefish in the Mediterranean?

options.text: It could badly pollute the surrounding waters.
It could pose a threat to other marine species.
It could disrupt the food chains there.
It could add to greenhouse emissions.

explanation:
【题目】What is the environmentalist concerned about the spread of Devil Firefish in the Mediterranean?
【翻译】环保主义者对魔鬼火鱼在地中海扩散有何担忧?
A) 它可能严重污染周围水域。
B) 它可能对其他海洋物种构成威胁。
C) 它可能破坏那里的食物链。
D) 它可能增加温室气体排放。
【答案】B （细节题）It could pose a threat to other marine species.
【定位】The fish, often known as Devil Firefish, is a highly invasive species, and environmentalists fear its arrival could endanger other types of marine life.
这种鱼通常被称为"魔鬼蓑鲉"，是一种高度入侵性的物种，环保人士担心它的到来可能危及其他类型的海洋生物。
【信号】fear＋题干同源词触发定位。答案句里 environmentalists fear 的 fear（担心）与题干的concerned（担心）是同一意思，这个"担忧"信号词一响，紧跟其后的 could endanger other types of marine life 就是担忧的具体内容——担忧类细节题，答案永远在"担心"这个词后面那个对象上。

【替换】could endanger other types of marine life ↔pose a threat to other marine species
危及＝构成威胁
other types of marine life ↔other marine species
海洋生物＝海洋物种
【排除】A)
未提及
录音通篇只说这鱼"有毒、毒刺能伤人、会危及其他海洋生物"，从没提它会"污染水体"。选项 badly pollute the surrounding waters 是考生听到"poisonous（有毒）"后顺着常识联想出的"有毒→污染水"，但原文根本没这句话。
C)
过度推断
disrupt the food chains（扰乱食物链）听上去比"威胁生物"更像专业的环保表述，很能唬人；但录音对担忧的描述只到 endanger other types of marine life 为止，没有展开到"食物链"这一层。它是"听起来更高级、更该说"造成的诱惑，并非原文内容。
D)
未提及
add to greenhouse emissions（增加温室气体排放）和"毒鱼威胁海洋生物"这个话题毫不相干，录音从头到尾没提温室气体或气候，是明显的凑数干扰项。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What will happen on World Car-Free Day in Paris?

options.text: Cars will not be allowed to enter the city.
Pedestrians will have free access to the city.
About half of its city center will be closed to cars.
Buses will be the only vehicles allowed on its streets.

explanation:
【题目】What will happen on World Car-Free Day in Paris?
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.

【翻译】巴黎的世界无车日将会发生什么?
A) 汽车将不被允许进入该城市。
B) 行人将可以免费进入该城市。
C) 该城市约一半的市中心将对汽车关闭。
D) 公共汽车将是其街道上唯一允许通行的车辆。
【答案】C （细节题）About half of its city center will be closed to cars.
【定位】Almost half the center of Paris will be accessible only by foot or bicycle this Sunday to mark World Car-Free Day.
本周日，巴黎市中心将近一半的区域只能靠步行或骑自行车进入，以此纪念"世界无车日"。
【信号】新闻首句直接点出当天安排。新闻往往开门见山，第一句 Almost half the center of Paris will be accessible only by foot or bicycle this Sunday 就交代了无车日当天的核心安排——"市中心近一半只能步行或骑车进入"。这正是"那天会怎样"的答案句，信号就是它处在新闻开头、与题干"What will happen"直接对应。
【替换】Almost half the center of Paris will be accessible only by foot or bicycle ↔ About half of its city center will be closed to cars.
正面"只能步行骑车"＝反面"对汽车关闭"
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说 Cars will not be allowed to enter the city.，盗用了录音里的 "Paris" 和"汽车不能进"的意思，但把范围从"近一半市中心"（Almost half the center of Paris）偷偷放大到"整座城市（the city）"。录音明明说的是"half the center"，A 漏掉了"half"和"center"这两个范围限定，范围被夸大，故错。
借用原文：Almost half the center of Paris
B)
未提及
B 说 Pedestrians will have free access to the city.。录音只说"只能靠步行或自行车进入"（accessible only by foot or bicycle），意思是"限定方式"，根本没提行人"free（免费/免许可）"。"free"是录音里没有的信息，属于无中生有。
D)
偷换概念
D 说 Buses will be the only vehicles allowed on its streets.。录音说当天"只能靠步行或自行车"进入（only by foot or bicycle），allowed 的是 foot/bicycle，根本没提 buses。D 借用了"only…allowed"的句式结构来唬人，却把允许的对象从"步行、自行车"偷换成了"公交车"，张冠李戴。
借用原文：accessible only by foot or bicycle
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What motivated the mayor of Paris to promote the first World Car-Free Day in her city?

options.text: The unbearable traffic noise.
The worsening global warming.
The ever-growing cost of petrol.
The rising air pollution in Paris.

explanation:
【题目】What motivated the mayor of Paris to promote the first World Car-Free Day in her city?
【翻译】是什么促使巴黎市长在她的城市推动首个世界无车日?
A) 难以忍受的交通噪音。
B) 日益恶化的全球变暖。
C) 不断增长的汽油成本。
D) 巴黎不断上升的空气污染。
【答案】D （细节题）The rising air pollution in Paris.
【定位】This is in response to rising air pollution that made Paris the most polluted city in the world for a brief time.
这是为了应对不断加剧的空气污染——这种污染曾一度让巴黎成为世界上污染最严重的城市。
【信号】因果信号 in response to 引出动机。答案句靠 in response to（为了应对……）这个明确的因果信号锁定。"This is in response to rising air pollution"——"应对不断加剧的空气污染"正是搞无车日的动机。听到 "in response to" 就知道后面紧跟的就是原因，无需犹豫。
【替换】in response to rising air pollution ↔The rising air pollution in Paris.
几乎原句搬选项，仅补回地点
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说 The unbearable traffic noise.。录音确实在结尾提到了声音——"sound levels dropped by 50 percent"，但那是无车日带来的"效果"，而且是"声音降了"，不是"难以忍受的噪音"促使办无车日。A 盗用了录音里关于 sound 的内容，却把"结果"错当成"动机"，答非所问。
借用原文：sound levels dropped by 50 percent in the city's center
B)
未提及
B 说 The worsening global warming.。"global warming（全球变暖）"在整段录音里从未出现，是凭"环保话题就该和变暖有关"的常识硬塞进来的。录音给的动机明确是 air pollution，不是 global warming。
C)
未提及
C 说 The ever-growing cost of petrol.。"cost of petrol（油价）"录音里完全没提，同样是"汽车／环保话题常和油价挂钩"的想当然。录音说的动机是空气污染，与油价无关。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What happened to the Philippine fisherman one day?

options.text: His house was burnt down in a fire.
Many of his possessions were stolen.
His good luck charm sank into the sea.
His fishing boat got wrecked on a rock.

explanation:
【题目】What happened to the Philippine fisherman one day?
【翻译】菲律宾渔民有一天发生了什么事？
A) 他的房子在一场火灾中被烧毁了。
B) 他的许多财物被盗了。
C) 他的幸运符沉入了海里。
D) 他的渔船在一块岩石上失事了。
【答案】A （细节题）His house was burnt down in a fire.
【定位】A Philippine fisherman was feeling down on his luck when a house fire forced him to clear out his possessions and change locations.
一名菲律宾渔夫正觉得自己运气背，这时一场房屋火灾迫使他清空家当、搬离原地。
【信号】录音开篇第一句即点事件。新闻往往把核心事件放在开篇，这里第一句 a house fire forced him to clear out his possessions 就直接交代了发生的事——一场房屋火灾。新闻题与播报同序，第 5 题问“发生了什么”，答案就落在最先念出的这句。
【替换】a house fire forced him to clear out his possessions ↔His house was burnt down in a fire
house fire 与 burnt down in a fire 同义

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音里确有 possessions 一词，forced him to clear out his possessions 说的是火灾逼他“清理/搬走”家当，不是被偷。选项 Many of his possessions were stolen. 盗用了possessions 这个原词，却把“清空”偷换成 stolen（被偷），听到 possessions 就选会中招。
借用原文：clear out his possessions
C)
原词陷阱
录音确实提到 good luck charm（护身符）和 ocean/sea，a good luck charm that he had kept under his bed，但护身符是放在床下、并由海里捞出，从未沉入海中。选项 His good luck charm sank into the sea. 拼接了 charm 和 sea 两个原词，编出一个录音没说的事件。
借用原文：a good luck charm that he had kept under his bed
D)
原词陷阱
录音里 rock 确实出现，his anchor got stuck on the rock 说的是“船锚卡在岩石上”，因此捞起了珍珠，渔船并没有触礁损毁。选项 His fishing boat got wrecked on a rock. 盗用了rock 这个原词，把“锚卡石头”夸大成“船触礁失事”，与录音不符。
借用原文：his anchor got stuck on the rock
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What was the fisherman forced to do?

options.text: Change his fishing locations.
Find a job in a travel agency.
Sell the pearl he had kept for years.
Spend a few nights on a small island.

explanation:
【题目】What was the fisherman forced to do?
【翻译】这位渔民被迫做什么？
A) 改变他的捕鱼地点。
B) 在一家旅行社找一份工作。
C) 出售他保存多年的珍珠。
D) 在一个小岛上度过几个晚上。
【答案】C （细节题）Sell the pearl he had kept for years.
【定位】When he was forced to sell it, the shocked tourist agent at Puerto Princesa told him that the 77-pound giant pearl ... was the biggest pearl in the world.
当他被迫卖掉这颗珍珠时，普林塞萨港那位震惊的旅游代理告诉他，这颗 77 磅的巨型珍珠是世界上最大的珍珠。
【信号】题干强制语 forced 在原文原样出现。题干问 forced to do，录音里出现 When he was forced to sell it——forced 这个强制语在原文照样念出，它后面紧跟的动词 sell 就是答案动作。强制语原词重现是最直接的定位信号。
【替换】When he was forced to sell it ↔Sell the pearl he had kept for years
sell it 与 Sell the pearl 同指

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音里 change locations 确实念到，forced him to clear out his possessions and change locations 指火灾后“搬家/换住处”，不是换打鱼的地方。选项 Change his fishing locations. 盗用 change locations 并擅自加上 fishing，把“搬家”偷换成“换渔场”。
借用原文：change locations
B)
答非所问
录音提到 tourist agent（旅游代理人），the shocked tourist agent at Puerto Princesa，选项 Find a job in a travel agency. 借这个相近词造出“去旅行社找工作”，但录音从没说渔夫去旅行社上班，是答非所问。
借用原文：tourist agent at Puerto Princesa
D)
原词陷阱
录音确有 island，while sailing off the coastal island in the Philippines 是说他在海边小岛附近航行时捞到珍珠，并非被迫去岛上住几晚。选项 Spend a few nights on a small island. 盗用 island 这个原词编出一个录音没有的动作。
借用原文：sailing off the coastal island in the Philippines
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the fisherman learn from the tourist agent?

options.text: His pearl could be displayed in a museum.
His monstrous pearl was extremely valuable.
The largest pearl in the world weighs 14 pounds.
A New York museum has the world's biggest pearl.

explanation:
【题目】What did the fisherman learn from the tourist agent?
【翻译】渔民从旅游代理那里了解到什么？
A) 他的珍珠可以在博物馆展出。
B) 他的巨型珍珠极其珍贵。
C) 世界上最大的珍珠重14磅。
D) 纽约的一家博物馆拥有世界上最大的珍珠。
【答案】B （细节题）His monstrous pearl was extremely valuable.
【定位】the shocked tourist agent ... told him that the 77-pound giant pearl that he'd kept hidden in his run-down wooden house was the biggest pearl in the world, which was valued at 76 million pounds.
那位震惊的旅游代理告诉他，他藏在破旧木屋里的这颗 77 磅巨型珍珠是世界上最大的珍珠，价值 7600 万英镑。
【信号】告知动词 told him that 后接答案。题干问“从代理那里得知什么”，录音里 told him that the 77-pound giant pearl ... was the biggest pearl in the world, which was valued at 76 million pounds——告知动词 told him that 后面的整句就是他获知的信息，世界最大、价值 7600 万英镑都在此。
【替换】was the biggest pearl in the world, which was valued at 76 million pounds ↔ His monstrous pearl was extremely valuable
最大/值 7600 万 概括为 extremely valuable

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversations and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the center.
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
录音末尾确有 going on display 与 museum，before hopefully going on display to attract more tourists，但这是记者对珍珠未来去向的补充，不是 tourist agent 告诉渔夫的内容。题问“从代理处得知什么”，A 盗用了 display 原词却把出处张冠李戴。
借用原文：going on display to attract more tourists
C)
与原文相反
录音里 14 pounds 确实念到，The pearl of Allah, which is currently on display in a New York museum only weighs 14 pounds，但 14 磅是纽约馆那颗“真主之珠”的重量，且它比渔夫这颗小 5 倍，绝非“世界最大”。选项 The largest pearl in the world weighs 14 pounds. 把 14 磅安到“世界最大珍珠”头上，与原文相反。
借用原文：only weighs 14 pounds. That is 5 times smaller than the pearl that the fisherman just handed in
D)
与原文相反
录音提到 New York museum，The pearl of Allah, which is currently on display in a New York museum，但纽约馆藏的“真主之珠”比渔夫这颗小 5 倍，世界最大的是渔夫这颗。选项 A New York museum has the world's biggest pearl. 盗用 New York museum原词，却把“世界最大”错按在它头上，与原文相反。
借用原文：The pearl of Allah, which is currently on display in a New York museum only weighs 14 pounds
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the woman's company?

options.text: It boasts a fairly long history.
It has over 50 business partners.
It has 75 offices around the world.
It produces construction materials.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the woman's company?
【翻译】关于这位女士的公司我们了解到什么?
A) 它拥有相当悠久的历史。
B) 它有超过50个业务合作伙伴。
C) 它在全球有75个办事处。
D) 它生产建筑材料。
【答案】A （细节题）It boasts a fairly long history.
【定位】Astra Consultants has branches in over 50 countries, offering different business services. We are a global company with 75 years of history, and our clients include some of the world's largest companies.
Astra 咨询公司在 50 多个国家设有分支机构，提供各类商务服务。我们是一家拥有 75 年历史的全球性公司，客户中不乏世界上一些最大的企业。

【信号】女士自述公司即被介绍方的应答。这是女士在介绍『我们公司』的应答段，凡她报出的数字与年限都是答案候选。关键句 We are a global company with 75 years of history 把『75 年历史』直接念出，对应『历史悠久』这一条。
【替换】with 75 years of history ↔It boasts a fairly long history.
具体年限概括成『历史悠久』
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音说的是 branches in over 50 countries——50 多个『国家』有分支，B 却说 It has over 50 business partners.『50 多个商业伙伴』。它偷了原文的数字 50，却把 countries偷换成 partners，是听到数字就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：branches in over 50 countries
C)
原词陷阱
C 说 It has 75 offices around the world.『全球 75 个办公室』，数字 75 确在录音里，但原文是 75 years of history——75 修饰的是『年』不是『办公室』。它把 years 偷换成offices，又是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：75 years of history
D)
张冠李戴
D 说 It produces construction materials.『生产建筑材料』，但生产建筑用石材的是男士的家族企业 We manufacture and export stone for buildings，女士公司是做咨询的。这是把男方公司的业务安到女方公司头上的张冠李戴。
借用原文：We manufacture and export stone for buildings and other constructions
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about his own company?

options.text: It was started by his father.
It has about 50 employees.
It is over 100 years old.
It is a family business.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about his own company?
【翻译】这位男士关于他自己的公司说了什么?
A) 它是由他父亲创办的。
B) 它有大约50名员工。
C) 它已有100多年的历史。
D) 它是一家家族企业。
【答案】D （细节题）It is a family business.
【定位】This is a family business started by my grandfather in 1950. We employ just over 100 people.
这是一家由我祖父在 1950 年创办的家族企业。我们雇用的员工刚刚超过 100 人。
【信号】男方应答中亲口定性『家族企业』。这是男士回应女士『介绍一下你公司』的应答句，他亲口说 This is a family business，直接给出公司性质——被问者的应答里直陈的定性就是答案落点。
【替换】This is a family business ↔It is a family business.
公司性质几乎原义对应

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说 It was started by his father.『父亲创办』，录音确有『谁创办』这一信息，但原文是started by my grandfather——是『祖父』。它偷换了亲属辈分，是听到『started by』就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：started by my grandfather in 1950
B)
原词陷阱
B 说 It has about 50 employees.『约 50 名员工』，录音是 We employ just over 100 people『100 多人』。它借用了『员工人数』这个点，却把数字从 100 改成 50，是数字型原词陷阱。
借用原文：We employ just over 100 people
C)
原词陷阱
C 说 It is over 100 years old.『有 100 多年历史』，录音里 100 确实出现，但 just over 100 people 的 100 修饰的是『人』。原文还说创办于 in 1950，到今不足百年。它把『100 个人』偷换成『100 年』，是数字张冠李戴的原词陷阱。
借用原文：We employ just over 100 people
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the main problem with the man's company?

options.text: Outdated product design.
Loss of competitive edge.
Shortage of raw material supply.
Legal disputes in many countries.

explanation:
【题目】What is the main problem with the man's company?
【翻译】这位男士的公司面临的主要问题是什么?
A) 产品设计过时。
B) 丧失竞争优势。
C) 原材料供应短缺。
D) 在许多国家存在法律纠纷。
【答案】B （细节题）Loss of competitive edge.
【定位】Our main challenge is that our national currency is rising, and we're losing competitive advantage to stone producers in India.
我们的主要挑战是本国货币正在升值，我们正在对印度的石材生产商失去竞争优势。
【信号】challenge 一词直接引出困难句。男方用 Our main challenge is that 这个标志短语亲口宣布主要困难，其后半句 we're losing competitive advantage 就是答案落点——『main challenge』几乎等同于题干的『main problem』，信号极明确。
【替换】we're losing competitive advantage to stone producers in India ↔Loss of competitive edge.
动词短语名词化、advantage=edge

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说 Outdated product design.『产品设计过时』。男方讲的是客户要 a special kind of stone cut in a special design，只提到『按特殊设计切割石材』，从没说设计『过时』。这是借 design 一词、却把『特殊设计』曲解为『过时设计』的诱导。
借用原文：a special kind of stone cut in a special design
C)
未提及
C 说 Shortage of raw material supply.『原料供应短缺』。男方明说主要挑战是 our national currency is rising『货币升值』导致竞争力下降，全程没提原料短缺。这是把真实困难偷换成另一种听上去合理的麻烦。
D)
原词陷阱
D 说 Legal disputes in many countries.『多国法律纠纷』。录音确实出现了印度和『国家』，但 stone producers in India 说的是印度的竞争对手，不是法律纠纷；女士提的legal issues 也只是顾问可服务范围，与男方困难无关。它借了原文的地点与法律词来设套。
借用原文：losing competitive advantage to stone producers in India
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页

stem: What does the woman suggest doing to help the man's company?

options.text: Introducing innovative marketing strategies.
Seeking new ways to increase its exports.
Providing training for its staff members.
Conducting a financial analysis for it.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman suggest doing to help the man's company?
【翻译】这位女士建议做什么来帮助这位男士的公司?
A) 引入创新的营销策略。
B) 寻求新的方式来增加出口。
C) 为其员工提供培训。
D) 为其进行财务分析。
【答案】D （细节题）Conducting a financial analysis for it.
【定位】I would suggest that you let us first conduct a financial analysis of your company, together with an analysis of your competitors in India.
我建议你先让我们对贵公司做一次财务分析，同时分析一下你在印度的竞争对手。
【信号】I would suggest 直接引出建议。女士用 I would suggest that 这一建议标志句开口，紧跟的动作 conduct a financial analysis 就是她建议先做的事；suggest 与题干 suggest doing 严丝合缝，信号最明确。
【替换】conduct a financial analysis of your company ↔Conducting a financial analysis for it.
动词原形改成动名词、措辞几近一致

【排除】A)
未提及
A 说 Introducing innovative marketing strategies.『引入创新营销策略』。女士只笼统说能在 from market analysis to legal issues『从市场分析到法律问题』各方面提供建议，但具体建议的第一步是财务分析，从未提『营销策略』。这是借 market 一词诱导的未提及项。
借用原文：from market analysis to legal issues
B)
原词陷阱
B 说 Seeking new ways to increase its exports.『想办法增加出口』。录音里 export 确实出现，但来自男方介绍业务 We manufacture and export stone，女士的建议是做财务分析，没说去增加出口。它盗用 export 一词，把男方的业务说成女方的建议。
借用原文：We manufacture and export stone for buildings and other constructions
C)
未提及
C 说 Providing training for its staff members.『为员工提供培训』。录音里既无 training也无 staff，女士的建议只有财务分析与竞争对手分析。这是录音根本没出现过的内容。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第14页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the woman from the conversation?

options.text: She is a real expert at house decorations.
She is really impressed by the man's house.
She is well informed about the design business.
She is attracted by the color of the sitting room.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the woman from the conversation?
【翻译】从对话中我们了解到关于这位女士的什么信息?
A) 她是房屋装饰方面的真正专家。
B) 她对这位男士的房子印象深刻。
C) 她对设计行业非常了解。
D) 她被起居室的颜色所吸引。
【答案】B （推断题）She is really impressed by the man's house.
【定位】W: I honestly am impressed. I know I could probably repaint the walls in my house over a weekend or something, but not a full renovation.
女：说真的，我太佩服了。我知道自己周末大概能把家里的墙重新刷一遍之类，但做不了整套翻新。
【信号】本人直陈感受+转折露底。信号有两层：一是她直接说 I honestly am impressed（亲口表态被打动）；二是转折 but not a full renovation，承认自己最多刷刷墙、做不了整套翻新——转折后才是她的真实水平。两处合起来锁定她是「被打动的外行」，而非行家。
【替换】I honestly am impressed ↔She is really impressed by the man's house.
原话补出对象

【排除】A)
与原文相反
a real expert at house decorations 与事实相反：她明说 not a full renovation、I wouldn't know where to start，自认不会整套翻新，根本不是装修专家。decorations 一词贴着话题，听到容易顺手选。
借用原文：I wouldn't know where to start
C)
原词陷阱
well informed about the design business 偷用了对话里的话题词 design——但谈design 的是男士的房子像请了 professional interior designer，并非说「她」懂设计行业。她从未表现出对设计行业内行，反而说不知从何下手。
借用原文：professional interior designer
D)
未提及
attracted by the color of the sitting room 里「客厅 sitting room」确实在末段她自己家那句出现过（renovating our sitting room），但那是说她想翻新自家客厅，录音从没说她被「男士客厅的颜色」吸引，color 更是原文没提的。
借用原文：renovating our sitting room

source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Where did the man get his ideas for the project?

options.text: From a construction businessman.
From his younger brother Greg.
From home design magazines.
From a professional interior designer.

explanation:
【题目】Where did the man get his ideas for the project?
【翻译】这位男士从哪里获得了这个项目的想法?
A) 从一位建筑商人那里。
B) 从他的弟弟Greg那里。
C) 从家居设计杂志上。
D) 从一位专业室内设计师那里。
【答案】C （细节题）From home design magazines.
【定位】M: Well, for a while now, I've been regularly buying home design magazines. Every now and then, I'd save a picture I liked.
男：嗯，有一阵子了，我一直定期买家居设计杂志。时不时地，我会把喜欢的图片存下来。
【信号】被问者对Where的直接应答。女方刚问 Where did you get your ideas?，男方的应答 I've been regularly buying home design magazines 正是对这个 Where 的直接回答——对话题里，答案就落在被问者紧接着的回应中。
【替换】buying home design magazines ↔From home design magazines.
近乎同词的来源

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
a construction businessman 偷用原文 He's actually in the construction business—— Greg 确实搞建筑，但那是帮忙施工 / 拿到折扣材料，不是点子的来源。把「帮忙的人」当成「点子来源」正是出题陷阱。
借用原文：He's actually in the construction business
B)
张冠李戴
his younger brother Greg 用了原文人名 Greg（a little help from my brother Greg），但 Greg 是帮他施工、弄到折扣材料的人，点子是他自己从杂志攒来的。听到人名就选是典型失分点。
借用原文：a little help from my brother Greg
D)
与原文相反
a professional interior designer 偷用原文 professional interior designer——但那句是女方猜「看起来像请了专业设计师吧？」，男方紧接着否认 No. I did it all by myself。原文恰恰说没请设计师，选项却拿它当来源。
借用原文：No. I did it all by myself
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the man say about the project he recently completed?

options.text: The cost was affordable.
The style was fashionable.
The effort was worthwhile.
The effect was unexpected.

explanation:
【题目】What did the man say about the project he recently completed?
【翻译】关于他最近完成的项目,这位男士说了什么?
A) 费用是可以承受的。
B) 风格是时尚的。
C) 付出的努力是值得的。
D) 效果是出乎意料的。
【答案】A （细节题）The cost was affordable.
【定位】M: Actually it was surprisingly affordable. I managed to sell a lot of my old furniture and put that extra money towards the new material.
男：其实它便宜得出乎意料。我设法卖掉了不少旧家具，把那笔额外的钱投到新材料上。
【信号】对贵不贵之问的直接应答。女方先问 Was it very expensive?，男方应答 Actually it was surprisingly affordable，正面回答了「花费」这一维——被问者对「贵不贵」的直接表态，就是答案句。
【替换】surprisingly affordable ↔The cost was affordable.
同词换说花费
Was it very expensive ↔The cost was affordable.
问贵被否再正向作答

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
The style was fashionable. 里 style 偷用了原文 my overall style was quite minimal ——但他说自己风格是「极简 minimal」，从没说「时髦 fashionable」，且这题问的是他对工程的总评，原文正面谈的是花费不是风格。
借用原文：my overall style was quite minimal
C)
未提及
The effort was worthwhile. 说付出值得，但录音里他谈的是花费便宜、卖旧家具凑钱，从没正面说「这份付出值不值」。worthwhile 是原文没给出的评价。
D)
偷换概念
The effect was unexpected. 说效果出乎意料。原文 surprisingly 修饰的是「affordable（便宜得意外）」，而不是「效果」；把 surprisingly 错接到「effect」上，是偷换对象。
借用原文：surprisingly affordable
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why does the woman invite the man to her house next week?

options.text: She'd like him to talk with Jonathan about a new project.
She'd like to show him around her newly-renovated house.
She wants to discuss the house decoration budget with him.
She wants him to share his renovation experience with her.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the woman invite the man to her house next week?
【翻译】这位女士为什么邀请这位男士下周去她家?
A) 她想让他和Jonathan谈谈一个新项目。
B) 她想带他参观她新装修的房子。
C) 她想和他讨论房屋装修预算。
D) 她想让他分享他的装修经验。
【答案】D （目的题）She wants him to share his renovation experience with her.
【定位】W: Jonathan and I are thinking of renovating our sitting room... And we'd love to get some inspiration from your experience. Are you free to come over for a coffee early next week?
女：我和 Jonathan 正考虑翻新我们的客厅……我们很想从你的经验里取点灵感。你下周早些时候有空过来喝杯咖啡吗？
【信号】邀请前的I'd love to表目的。请求句 Are you free to come over 之前那句 we'd love to get some inspiration from your experience 正点明邀请缘由——「I'd love to + 想得到什么」是目的题的落点信号。
【替换】get some inspiration from your experience ↔ She wants him to share his renovation experience with her.
取经=请其分享经验
pick your brains a bit more ↔share his renovation experience with her
习语pick your brains=取经

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passages and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D).   Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the center.
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
talk with Jonathan about a new project 偷用原文人名 Jonathan（Jonathan and I are thinking of renovating）——但 Jonathan 是和她一起想翻新客厅的人，她从没说请男士去「和 Jonathan 谈一个新项目」。听到 Jonathan 就选是陷阱。
借用原文：Jonathan and I are thinking of renovating
B)
与原文相反
show him around her newly-renovated house 说带他参观她「已翻新」的家——但她明说 thinking of renovating our sitting room, not the whole house, not yet anyway，是「正打算翻、还没翻」。把她还没做的事说成已完成，是时态 / 事实陷阱。
借用原文：not the whole house, not yet anyway
C)
未提及
discuss the house decoration budget 里 budget 是钱的话题，蹭了前文谈花费（affordable）的印象——但她请他来是为取经，全程没提要和他谈「预算」。这是把别处的话题硬搬过来。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第19页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does England spend an annual three million pounds on?

options.text: Paying hospital bills for emergency cases.
Doing research on ear, nose and throat diseases.
Removing objects from patients' noses and ears.
Providing routine care for small children.

explanation:
【题目】What does England spend an annual three million pounds on?
【翻译】英格兰每年在什么方面花费三百万英镑？
A) 支付急诊病例的住院费用。
B) 研究耳鼻喉疾病。
C) 从患者的鼻子和耳朵中取出异物。
D) 为幼儿提供常规护理。
【答案】C （细节题）Removing objects from patients' noses and ears.
【定位】Removing foreign objects from ears and noses costs England almost three million pounds a year, a study suggests.
一项研究显示，从耳朵和鼻子里取出异物每年要花费英国近三百万英镑。
【信号】花费数字句——costs…three million pounds。答案句的信号是"动作 + 花费 + 三百万"这一结构：Removing foreign objects from ears and noses costs England almost three million pounds a year 直接把题干里的 three million pounds 和它的用途（取异物）绑在一句，听到 costs…three million pounds 就锁定这是答案句。
【替换】Removing foreign objects from ears and noses ↔ Removing objects from patients' noses and ears.
foreign objects=objects、词序调换的同义改写

【排除】A)
答非所问
录音通篇在讲医院取异物，孩子会联想到"付医院账单"，但原文从未说这三百万是用来Paying hospital bills for emergency cases.，只说花在"取异物"这个动作上，付账单是凭"医院"二字脑补出来的。
B)
原词陷阱
录音后文确实出现 Any ear, nose and throat surgeon，选项 Doing research on ear, nose and throat diseases. 原样搬来 ear, nose and throat 这串词，但那是在讲外科医生的奇闻，不是说三百万花在"做研究"上，听到熟词就选会中招。
借用原文：Any ear, nose and throat surgeon has many weird stories
D)
原词陷阱
录音反复提到 children，选项 Providing routine care for small children. 借这个高频词编出"日常护理"，但原文说钱花在"取异物"这个具体动作上，从没说花在"日常护理"，属拿熟词编新用途。
借用原文：Children were responsible for the vast majority of cases
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from England's Hospital Episode Statistics?

options.text: Children aged one to four are often more curious than older children.
Five- to nine-year-olds are the most likely to put things in their ears.
Many children like to put foreign objects in their mouths.
Many children like to smell things they find or play with.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from England's Hospital Episode Statistics?
【翻译】我们从英格兰医院事件统计中了解到什么？
A) 一到四岁的儿童往往比年龄较大的儿童更有好奇心。
B) 五到九岁的儿童最有可能把东西塞进耳朵里。
C) 许多儿童喜欢把异物放进嘴里。
D) 许多儿童喜欢闻他们找到或玩耍的东西。
【答案】B （细节题）Five- to nine-year-olds are the most likely to put things in their ears.
【定位】According to England's Hospital Episode Statistics, children aged one to four were the most likely to need help from doctors for a foreign object in their nose. Five- to nine-year-olds come to the hospital with something in their ears the most.
根据英国医院病例统计，1 到 4 岁的儿童最有可能因为鼻子里有异物而需要医生帮助。5 到9 岁的儿童最常因为耳朵里有东西而到医院就诊。
【信号】专有名词 + 两个年龄段并列。信号是题干专有名词的原样复现 According to England's Hospital Episode Statistics，紧接其后是两句年龄段并列陈述，把"1-4 岁→鼻""5-9 岁→耳"分别说清，正是要核对的答案句。
【替换】Five- to nine-year-olds come to the hospital with something in their ears the most ↔ Five- to nine-year-olds are the most likely to put things in their ears.
come to hospital with…the most=most likely to put…，结果换说成行为

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音确有 children aged one to four were the most likely to need help…for a foreign object in their nose，但说的是"1-4 岁→鼻子"，选项 Children aged one to four are often more curious than older children. 盗用了 one to four 这个年龄段，却把后半改成原文没说的"比大孩子更好奇"，年龄对、结论错。
借用原文：children aged one to four were the most likely to need help from doctors for a foreign object in their nose
C)
偷换概念
录音只讲鼻（nose）和耳（ears），选项 Many children like to put foreign objects in their mouths. 借 foreign objects 这个原词，却把部位换成了"嘴 mouths"，原文从未说孩子往嘴里塞东西。
借用原文：Removing foreign objects from ears and noses
D)
未提及
选项 Many children like to smell things they find or play with. 说孩子"喜欢闻东西"，但这份统计句里只讲塞鼻塞耳、就医取物，全篇都没提"smell（闻）"这个行为，属凭"鼻子"联想脑补。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is generally believed to account for children putting things in their ears or noses?

options.text: They want to attract attention.
They tend to act out of impulse.
They are unaware of the potential risks.
They are curious about these body parts.

explanation:
【题目】What is generally believed to account for children putting things in their ears or noses?
【翻译】人们普遍认为儿童把东西塞进耳朵或鼻子的原因是什么？
A) 他们想吸引注意力。
B) 他们往往出于冲动行事。
C) 他们没有意识到潜在的风险。
D) 他们对这些身体部位感到好奇。
【答案】D （细节题）They are curious about these body parts.
【定位】According to the study, the occurrence of foreign objects in children is generally attributed to curiosity. Children have an impulse to explore their noses and ears.
根据这项研究，儿童体内出现异物的情况通常被归因于好奇心。孩子有一种探索自己鼻子和耳朵的冲动。
【信号】因果信号 attributed to 后面的 curiosity。答案信号是因果短语 is generally attributed to curiosity——attributed to（归因于）正是"导致原因"的信号，它后面紧跟的 curiosity就是公认原因，听到 attributed to 立刻锁定其后那个词。
【替换】is generally attributed to curiosity ↔They are curious about these body parts.
名词 curiosity ↔ 形容词 curious，名词转形容词
Children have an impulse to explore their noses and ears ↔curious about these body parts
"想探索鼻耳"="对这些身体部位好奇"，详述换概括

【排除】A)
未提及
选项 They want to attract attention. 把原因说成"想引起注意"，但录音归因句明说原因是curiosity，全篇没提 attract attention，属另起一个原文没有的原因。
B)
原词陷阱
录音确有 Children have an impulse to explore their noses and ears，选项 They tend to act out of impulse. 原样搬来 impulse 这个词，但原文的"冲动"是"探索鼻耳的冲动"、用来佐证好奇，并非把"一时冲动"本身当作公认原因，题目问的公认原因是 curiosity。
借用原文：Children have an impulse to explore their noses and ears
C)
原词陷阱
录音后文提到 Batteries can pose a particular danger，让"没意识到风险"显得合理，但选项 They are unaware of the potential risks. 说的"没意识到危险"原文从未当作孩子塞东西的原因，公认原因是好奇，这是把后文的"危险"错接成原因。
借用原文：Batteries can pose a particular danger
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did ReBicycle do to help Leila Rahimi?

options.text: It gave her a used bicycle.
It paid for her English lessons.
It delivered her daily necessities.
It provided her with physical therapy.

explanation:
【题目】What did ReBicycle do to help Leila Rahimi?
【翻译】ReBicycle 做了什么来帮助 Leila Rahimi?
A) 它给了她一辆二手自行车。
B) 它支付了她的英语课程费用。
C) 它配送了她的日常生活必需品。
D) 它为她提供了物理治疗。
【答案】A （细节题）It gave her a used bicycle.
【定位】At this time, ReBicycle got involved and gave Leila a second-hand bicycle.
就在这时，ReBicycle 介入进来，给了 Leila 一辆二手自行车。
【信号】人名出场后紧跟的动作句。题干点的人名 Leila 在原文反复出现，而真正承载「为她做了什么」的，是 ReBicycle got involved and gave Leila a second-hand bicycle 这句——机构名 ReBicycle 与人名 Leila 同时出现、又带了 gave 这个给予动作，正是答案句的信号。
【替换】a second-hand bicycle ↔a used bicycle
second-hand = used 同义替换
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
原文确实提到 English language lessons，但那是说有了车之后通勤去上英语课的时间从三小时减到一小时，机构并没有为 Leila 付英语课学费。B 项 It paid for her English lessons.把听到的 English lessons 原词搬过来，却安了个原文没有的 paid for，是典型「听到原词就想选」的陷阱。
借用原文：they used to spend walking to and from English language lessons
C)
原词陷阱
原文里 Leila 起初是自己 walk to the supermarket for basic supplies（走去超市买生活必需品），这是说她从前的困境，并非机构帮她送货。C 项 It delivered her daily necessities. 借用了 supplies/necessities 这层「生活必需品」的原词印象，编出一个机构「配送」的动作，实际机构给的是车不是货。
借用原文：walk to the supermarket for basic supplies
D)
过度推断
原文说 Leila 骑车后 her depression had begun to ease（抑郁开始缓解），这是骑车带来的心理变化，并不等于机构提供了 physical therapy（理疗）。D 项 It provided her with physical therapy. 抓住「身体/康复」的联想做了过度推断，原文从没说过理疗。

stem: What is ReBicycle doing to help those in need?

options.text: Expanding bike-riding lessons.
Providing free public transport.
Offering walking tours to visitors.
Asking local people for donations.

explanation:
【题目】What is ReBicycle doing to help those in need?
【翻译】ReBicycle 正在做什么来帮助那些有需要的人?
A) 扩大自行车骑行课程。
B) 提供免费公共交通。
C) 为游客提供步行游览。
D) 向当地居民募捐。
【答案】A （细节题）Expanding bike-riding lessons.
【定位】To date, ReBicycle has donated more than 200 bikes to those in need, and is now expanding bike-riding lessons as demand soars.
迄今为止，ReBicycle 已向有需要的人捐赠了 200 多辆自行车，如今正随着需求激增而扩大自行车骑行课程。
【信号】now + 进行时标出当下举措。句中 is now expanding bike-riding lessons 同时含 now和进行时 is expanding，正是「当下正在做的举措」的信号；题干 those in need 也原样出现在这句，双重提示这就是答案句。
【替换】is now expanding bike-riding lessons ↔Expanding bike-riding lessons.
几乎原句压缩，去掉时态助词
【排除】B)
偷换概念
原文讲的是给人自行车、让人能 travel farther but for almost no cost（几乎零成本走得更远），核心是「自行车」。B 项 Providing free public transport. 借「免费、出行」的听感，把自行车偷换成 public transport（公共交通），概念被掉包，原文从未说提供公共交通。
借用原文：travel farther but for almost no cost
C)
原词陷阱
原文提到人们从前 they used to spend walking（过去常常靠走路）通勤，是要被自行车取代的旧状态。C 项 Offering walking tours to visitors. 抓住 walking 这个原词，编出「为游客提供步行游」，既反了原文（机构是要减少走路、不是组织走路），也无中生有了visitors。
借用原文：The three hours a day, they used to spend walking to and from English language lessons
D)
偷换概念
原文说机构 urgently looking for more volunteers（急招志愿者），求的是人手不是钱。D 项 Asking local people for donations. 把「求助于本地人」这层意思保留，却把要的东西换成 donations（捐款），张冠李戴成募捐，原文没有向人要钱。
借用原文：we are urgently looking for more volunteers

stem: What do we learn from the passage about ReBicycle?

options.text: It is a sports club.
It is a language school.
It is a counseling center.
It is a charity organization.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the passage about ReBicycle?
【翻译】我们从文章中了解到关于 ReBicycle 的什么信息?
A) 它是一个体育俱乐部。
B) 它是一所语言学校。
C) 它是一个咨询中心。
D) 它是一个慈善组织。
【答案】D （主旨题）It is a charity organization.
【定位】Today, I would like to talk to you about my charity ReBicycle. ... To date, ReBicycle has donated more than 200 bikes to those in need ... we are urgently looking for more volunteers.
今天我想跟大家谈谈我的慈善机构 ReBicycle。……迄今为止，ReBicycle 已向有需要的人捐赠了 200 多辆自行车……我们正急切地寻找更多志愿者。
【信号】开头自报性质 + 全篇行为印证。开篇 my charity ReBicycle 直接点明它是 charity（慈善机构），再由 has donated more than 200 bikes to those in need 免费捐车、looking for more volunteers 招募志愿者等行为印证——开头点题加全篇行为合起来锁定性质，是主旨题的定位信号。
【替换】my charity ReBicycle ↔a charity organization
charity → charity organization 概括化
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
原文提到 Leila 曾被邀请加入 a local bike club（当地一个自行车俱乐部），那是另一个组织，不是 ReBicycle 本身。A 项 It is a sports club. 借 bike club 的「俱乐部/运动」印象，把 ReBicycle 错认成体育俱乐部，张冠李戴到了别的组织头上。
借用原文：she was invited to join a local bike club
B)
原词陷阱
原文里 English language lessons 只是用来说明有了车之后通勤时间缩短，机构本身不教英语。B 项 It is a language school. 抓 English lessons 的原词，把机构错定成语言学校，原文从未说它是教语言的学校。
借用原文：walking to and from English language lessons
C)
过度推断
原文说 Leila 起初 quite down and unhappy、骑车后 depression 缓解，这是受助者的情绪变化。C 项 It is a counseling center. 抓住「情绪低落、好转」的线索，过度推断机构是心理咨询中心，原文从没说它做心理咨询。
借用原文：After a few months of being quite down and unhappy
