stem: What is the prospect of the bike industry according to Ryan Rzepecki?

options.text: More will be invested in bike battery research.
The sales of ebikes will increase.
It will profit from ebike sharing.
It will make a difference in people's daily lives.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What is the prospect of the bike industry according to Ryan Rzepecki? 用 according to + 人名，问的是他对前景的具体看法，答案应在他的原话里直接拿到，是定向细节题。
【拆句】What is the prospect of the bike industry according to Ryan Rzepecki? 是简单疑问句：主干 What is the prospect，of the bike industry 修饰 prospect，according to Ryan Rzepecki 限定信息源，无陷阱。
【定位】This is the beginning of a long-term shift away from regular pedal(踏板) to electric bikes.
这是从普通脚踏自行车向电动自行车长期转变的开端。
【选项】A)
无中生有
CEO 原话谈的是「骑行体验」和「长期转向」，与「投资电池研究」无关；原文第 3 段提到电池技术从其他行业受益，但从未说会加大对电池研究的投入。
B)
✓ 正确
This is the beginning of a long-term shift away from regular pedal(踏板) to electric bikes. ↔ The sales of ebikes will increase.
预判的「销量会持续增长」与 The sales of ebikes will increase. 在语义上一致；且第 2段已铺垫 the U.S. market has grown to 263,000 bikes, a 25% gain from the prior year，这种「长期转向」在 CEO 嘴里说出，结合销量背景，必然指向「销量上升」。
C)
偷换概念
原文确实在 P4 P5 介绍了 Jump Bikes 等公司的共享业务，但 CEO 的原话谈的是「骑行体验与长期转向」，没有说整个产业会「靠共享盈利」。
D)
过度推断
CEO 原话只说「是一次长期转向的开端」，并未上升到「改变人们日常生活」的层级；考生若把「长期转向」凭印象拔高，就会过度推断。

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What prevented Chris Cocalis from developing ebikes sooner? 问的是阻碍发生在过去的具体事实，需要在原文找到对应的客观陈述，属典型细节题。
【拆句】What prevented Chris Cocalis from developing ebikes sooner? 主干是 What prevented Chris Cocalis，from developing ebikes sooner 是 prevent sb from doing sth 的固定搭配，意为「阻止他更早开发电动车」；考生若没掌握这个搭配，容易把prevent ... from 理解反，需特别留意。
【定位】Two years ago, CEO Chris Cocalis of Pivot Cycles, which sells high-end mountain bikes, found that U.S. bike shops weren't interested in stocking ebikes. Some retailers warned Cocalis that they'd drop the brand if it came out with an electric bike.
两年前，主营高端山地车的 Pivot Cycles 公司 CEO Chris Cocalis 发现，美国的自行车商店并没有兴趣进电动自行车。一些零售商警告 Cocalis，如果他出电动车，他们就停售他的品牌。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
Some retailers warned Cocalis that they'd drop the brand if it came out with an electric bike. ↔ Retailers' refusal to deal in ebikes.
预判的「零售商不愿进货+威胁停售」与 Retailers' refusal to deal in ebikes. 完全等值；refusal to deal in（拒绝经营）是 weren't interested in stocking + warned ... they'd drop the brand 的概括。
B)
无中生有
原文只说 Pivot Cycles, which sells high-end mountain bikes，介绍公司业务，未提及「传统车带来高利润」或他舍不得放弃高利润；考生凭「高端=高利润」的常识硬补，是无中生有。
C)
无中生有
全文从未提到 risk of ebike riding（电动车骑行风险）或 users' concern（用户担忧）；阻碍来自零售商，而不是用户的安全顾虑。
D)
偷换概念
Pivot Cycles, which sells high-end mountain bikes 只是介绍公司业务的非限制性定语从句，是背景；并不是「他专注卖高端山地车」导致他没做电动车——阻碍来自零售商，不来自他自己。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页

stem: What makes Chris Cocalis believe there is a greater opportunity for ebike sales?

options.text: The further lowering of ebike prices.
The public's concern for their health.
The increasing interest in mountain climbing.
The younger generation's pursuit of comfortable riding.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What makes Chris Cocalis believe there is a greater opportunity for ebike sales? 问的是导致他形成某观点的具体理由，答案应在他原话里给出，属于定向细节题。
【拆句】What makes Chris Cocalis believe there is a greater opportunity for ebike sales? 主干What makes Chris Cocalis believe ...，make sb do sth 表「使某人……」，believe 后接that 从句（that 省略），从句主干是 there is a greater opportunity，for ebike sales 修饰 opportunity；结构层级清晰，但 make sb believe 后接长从句，基础薄弱考生可能把believe 误当成名词，需提醒。
【定位】There's tremendous opportunity to get a generation of people for whom suffering isn't their thing. Ebike riders get the enjoyable part of cycling without the massive suffering of climbing huge hills.
存在一个巨大的机会，能争取到一整代不愿吃苦的人。骑电动车的人可以享受骑行的乐趣，而不必承受爬大坡那种痛苦折磨。
【选项】A)
答非所问
电动车价格下降在 cheaper options 与 the price of batteries used on ebikes fell 中出现过，但 Cocalis 在 P7 谈到机会时，理由是「一代人不愿吃苦」，与价格无关。
B)
答非所问
health benefits 确实是电动车整体吸引力之一，但 Cocalis 在 P7 谈机会时，给出的理由是「不愿吃苦」，与公众健康关注无关。
C)
与原文相反
原文 without the massive suffering of climbing huge hills 说的是骑电动车可以免去爬坡的折磨——也就是说人们想避开爬坡，而不是对爬山兴趣上升。
D)
✓ 正确
There's tremendous opportunity to get a generation of people for whom suffering isn't their thing.
↔The younger generation's pursuit of comfortable riding.
预判的「新一代不愿吃苦、追求舒适」与 The younger generation's pursuit of comfortable riding. 完全对应；原话两句一起构成完整因果：「有一代人不愿吃苦」+「电动车让骑行享受而不痛苦」——这正是他看到机会的依据。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: Why did politicians use the two terms "global warming" and "climate change"?

options.text: To sway public opinion of the impact of human activities on Earth.
To more accurately describe the consequences of human activities.
To win more popular votes in their campaign activities.
To assure the public of the safety of existing industries.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】Why did politicians use the two terms 问的是政客使用这两个词的具体原因，属对文中明示原因的事实性提问。
【拆句】题干 Why did politicians use the two terms "global warming" and "climate change"?主干是 "Why did politicians use the two terms"，引号里的两个术语只是 the two terms的同位补充，句式平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Later, political strategists adopted the terms to influence public opinion.
后来，政治策略家们采用这些术语，是为了影响公众舆论。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
to influence public opinion ↔To sway public opinion
how humans continue to alter the planet ↔the impact of human activities on Earth
把 to influence public opinion 改成 To sway public opinion 再叠加上文 "how humans alter the planet" 的名词化转述，正好等价于 To sway public opinion of the impact of human activities on Earth.。
B)
张冠李戴
To more accurately describe the consequences of human activities. 这是Scientists shaped the history of the terms while attempting to accurately describe how humans continue to alter the planet. 里科学家的目的，被错配到政客头上。
C)
无中生有
To win more popular votes in their campaign activities. 文章只字未提选举或拉票；launched a campaign 中的 campaign 指"运动"而非"竞选活动"。
D)
与原文相反
To assure the public of the safety of existing industries. 与原文相反——launched a campaign to sow doubt 表明政客是制造怀疑、并非给公众吃定心丸。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: As used in a National Academy of Sciences report, the term "climate change" differs from "global warming" in that_________.

options.text: it sounds less vague
it looks more scientific
it covers more phenomena
it is much closer to reality

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】As used in a National Academy of Sciences report, the term "climate change" differs from "global warming" in that_________. 问的是该报告里两词的具体差异，属事实层提问。
【拆句】题干 As used in a National Academy of Sciences report, the term "climate change" differs from "global warming" in that_________. 是个待补全的陈述句，主干 "the term climate change differs from global warming in that ..."，As 引导的状语限定范围；空格由 in that 引导的从句填，选项即从句内容。
【定位】In 1979, a National Academy of Sciences report used the term "global warming" to define increases in the Earth's average surface temperature, while "climate change" more broadly referred to the numerous effects of this increase, such as sea-level rise and ocean acidification(酸化).
1979 年，美国国家科学院的一份报告用 global warming 这个术语来指地球地表平均温度的上升，而 climate change 则更广泛地指这一升温带来的诸多影响，例如海平面上升和海洋酸化。
【选项】A)
答非所问
it sounds less vague 谈的是"听起来更不含糊"，可这个报告本身比较的是两术语的指代范围，不是听感；听感是 P5 里 Luntz 的话题，与本题报告无关。
B)
无中生有
it looks more scientific 谈"显得更科学"，原文从未比较两术语的科学性观感，纯属编造。
C)
✓ 正确
more broadly referred to the numerous effects ↔it covers more phenomena
预判已经定调"climate change 范围更宽"，四个选项里只有 it covers more phenomena 直接讲范围差异，与定位句中 more broadly + numerous effects 一一对位。
D)
无中生有
it is much closer to reality 说"更贴近现实"，原文并未在该报告中比较两术语谁更接近实际，是无中生有。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What did industrialists of the late 20th century resort to in order to mislead Americans?

options.text: Made-up survey results.
False research findings.
Hired climate experts.
Deliberate choice of words.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What did industrialists of the late 20th century resort to in order to mislead Americans? 问的是实业家采取的具体手段，属对文中明示信息的事实性提问。
【拆句】题干 What did industrialists of the late 20th century resort to in order to mislead Americans? 主干 "What did industrialists resort to"，of the late 20th century 修饰industrialists，in order to mislead Americans 是目的状语；resort to 意为"诉诸于"，是高频四级词组。
【定位】Word use played a critical role in developing that doubt. For example, the language and polls expert Frank Luntz wrote a memo encouraging the use of "climate change" because the phrase sounded less scary than "global warming," reported the Guardian.
用词起到了关键作用，造就了那种怀疑。例如，语言与民调专家 Frank Luntz 写了一份备忘录，建议使用 climate change，因为它听起来不像 global warming 那么吓人——《卫报》报道。
【选项】A)
无中生有
Made-up survey results. 说"伪造调查结果"，原文只字未提调查造假，纯属编造。
B)
无中生有
False research findings. 说"虚假的研究发现"，原文从未提及实业家发布假研究，只提了使用词汇上的策略。
C)
张冠李戴
Hired climate experts. 把 the language and polls expert Frank Luntz 的身份错置——Luntz 是语言与民调专家，并非气候专家，且原文未说他被实业家雇佣。
D)
✓ 正确
Word use played a critical role in developing that doubt. ↔Deliberate choice of words.
预判已明确"在用词上做手脚"，四个选项里只有 Deliberate choice of words. 谈选词，其他三个分别引到调查、研究、专家，都不是文中点出的手段。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: Why did NASA choose the term "climate change"?

options.text: To obtain more funds.
For greater precision.
For political needs.
To avoid debate.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】Why did NASA choose the term "climate change"? 是 Why 提问，问 NASA 选这个术语的原因，原文必有直接对应句。
【拆句】题干 Why did NASA choose the term "climate change"? 是简单疑问句，主干 "Why did NASA choose the term"，引号短语作 choose 的宾语，句式无陷阱。
【定位】NASA used the term "climate change" because it more accurately reflects the wide range of changes to the planet caused by increasing amounts of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.
美国国家航空航天局之所以使用 climate change 这个术语，是因为它能更准确地反映由大气中温室气体增加所引发的地球范围广泛的变化。
【选项】A)
无中生有
To obtain more funds. 谈"获取更多资金"，原文从未提及 NASA 的预算或经费问题。
B)
✓ 正确
more accurately reflects ↔For greater precision
预判已经给出"为了更准确"这个核心，四个选项里只有 For greater precision 谈精准度，其他三个引到资金、政治、避免争论，都没在 P7 中出现过。
C)
张冠李戴
For political needs. 谈"出于政治需要"，这是 political strategists 与 industrialists and politicians 的动机，而非 NASA 的；NASA 的选词理由是科学准确性。
D)
无中生有
To avoid debate. 说"为了避免争论"，原文 P7 只字未提 NASA 想回避争论；P8 反而表明争论一直存在、不可回避。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What is the author's final conclusion?

options.text: Global warming is the more accurate term.
Accuracy of terminology matters in science.
Human activities have serious effects on Earth.
Politics interferes with serious scientific debate.

explanation:
【答案】C （主旨题）
【判型】What is the author's final conclusion? 问的是作者的最终结论，是对全文中心的提问，不靠某一句的细节解决。
【拆句】题干 What is the author's final conclusion? 是 What is 句型，主干极简，author's final是 conclusion 的双层修饰，提示找全文末尾的总结表态。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
Global warming is the more accurate term. 说 global warming 更准确，恰好和NASA used the term "climate change" because it more accurately reflects the wide range of changes 与 whatever you call it 的立场相反。
B)
以偏概全
Accuracy of terminology matters in science. 把"术语精确度"当作全文主旨，但这只是 P3、P7 这两个局部所谈，作者在末段已明确越过术语之争，落点在"人类影响"。
C)
✓ 正确
human behavior is warming the planet, with grave consequences ahead ↔ Human activities have serious effects on Earth.
Human activities have serious effects on Earth. 既概括了 P8 末句的核心判断，也覆盖前文 P3 提到的海平面上升、海洋酸化等具体后果，是唯一兼顾主线与全文铺垫的选项。
D)
以偏概全
Politics interferes with serious scientific debate. 说"政治干预严肃科学辩论"，这只是P4\~P5 局部话题，且原文未给出"干预了严肃科学辩论"这样的明确价值判断，更不是作者最终结论。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2020-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What did Joe's parents decide to do?

options.text: Enrol him in a Newcastle football club.
Send him to an after-school art class.
Forbid him to draw in his workbook.
Help him post his drawings online.

explanation:
【题目】What did Joe's parents decide to do?
【翻译】Joe的父母决定做什么?
A) 让他加入Newcastle足球俱乐部。
B) 送他去课后美术班。
C) 禁止他在作业本上画画。
D) 帮他把画作发布到网上。
【答案】B （细节题）Send him to an after-school art class.
【定位】Rather than shutting down the habit of drawing in his school's workbook, Joe's parents decided to encourage his creativity by sending their son to an after-school art class.
乔的父母没有去扼杀他在校练习册上画画的习惯，反而决定鼓励他的创造力，把儿子送去上一个课后美术班。
【信号】Rather than后的转折落点。答案信号是句首的 Rather than shutting down the habit of drawing——"而不是去扼杀"。Rather than 是一个含蓄否定的转折标志：它先抛出一个被否定的做法（禁止画画），真正做的事在它后面的 decided to encourage his creativity by sending their son to an after-school art class。转折/否定之后才是落点，这是听力定位的核心信号。
【替换】sending their son to an after-school art class ↔Send him to an after-school art class.
几乎原句对应

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说"给他报名 Newcastle 足球俱乐部"。录音确实念到了 He's great at football. 和地名Newcastle，但那是第3段描述乔"球踢得好"，第2段 Newcastle 是餐厅所在地，根本没有"父母给他报足球队"这回事。它把零散原词拼成了假事件。
借用原文：He's great at football.
C)
与原文相反
C 说"禁止他在练习册上画画"。录音里 shutting down the habit of drawing in his school's workbook 确实提到"扼杀在练习册上画画的习惯"，但它前面有 Rather than——是父母"没有"做的事。C 恰恰取了被转折否定掉的那半句，方向反了。
借用原文：shutting down the habit of drawing in his school's workbook
D)
张冠李戴
D 说"帮他把画发到网上"。录音里 His teacher recognized Joe's talent and posted all his work online 确实有"发到网上"，但做这件事的是"老师"，不是"父母"。题问的是父母，把老师的行为安到父母头上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：His teacher recognized Joe's talent and posted all his work online
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the restaurant "Number 4" do?

options.text: Contacted Joe to decorate its dining-room.
Hired Joe to paint all the walls of its buildings.
Renovated its kitchen and all the dining-rooms.
Asked Joe for permission to use his online drawings.

explanation:
【题目】What did the restaurant "Number 4" do?
【翻译】名为"Number 4"的餐厅做了什么?
A) 联系Joe装饰其餐厅。
B) 雇用Joe粉刷其建筑物的所有墙壁。
C) 翻新了其厨房和所有餐厅。
D) 请求Joe允许使用他在网上的画作。
【答案】A （细节题）Contacted Joe to decorate its dining-room.
【定位】A restaurant named "Number 4" in Newcastle contacted Joe's teacher to ask if the 9-year-old could come and decorate its dining-room with his drawings.
一家位于纽卡斯尔、名叫"Number 4"的餐厅联系了乔的老师，问这个9岁的孩子能不能来用他的画装饰餐厅的用餐区。
【信号】题目同序顺听定位。新闻题目通常与播报同序：第1题答案在第1段，第2题就顺听到第2段。本段开头 A restaurant named "Number 4" in Newcastle contacted Joe's teacher 一出现餐厅这个主语，就是第2题的答案句。顺着播报次序接题，不用回跳。
【替换】contacted Joe's teacher to ask if the 9-year-old could come and decorate its dining-room ↔ Contacted Joe to decorate its dining-room.
concise概括对应

【排除】B)
过度推断
B 说"雇佣乔粉刷其建筑的所有墙面"。录音确实有 put his ideas straight on the wall（把想法画到墙上），但 B 把它夸成 paint all the walls（所有墙），还说成 Hired（雇佣、含付薪），录音只说 contacted...to ask（联系询问），既没说付钱雇佣、也没说所有墙面。
借用原文：put his ideas straight on the wall
C)
偷换概念
C 说"翻新了厨房和所有的用餐区"。录音说的是 decorate its dining-room——装饰"用餐区"，C 一是把 decorate（用画装饰）偷换成 Renovated（整体翻新装修），二是凭空加了kitchen（厨房）和 all（所有），范围和动作都被放大，录音都没说。
借用原文：decorate its dining-room
D)
原词陷阱
D 说"请求乔授权使用他网上的画"。录音里 posted all his work online 确有"发到网上"，但那是老师发画的动作，餐厅这边只是 contacted Joe's teacher to ask if the 9-year-old could come——请人来现场画，根本没有"求授权用网上的画"这回事。online 是被挪用的原词。
借用原文：posted all his work online
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is Kirsteen Marshall trying to do?

options.text: Get her pet dog back.
Identify the suspect on the security video.
Beg for help from the police.
Post pictures of her pet dog on social media.

explanation:
【题目】What is Kirsteen Marshall trying to do?
【翻译】Kirsteen Marshall 正试图做什么?
A) 找回她的宠物狗。
B) 辨认监控视频中的嫌疑人。
C) 向警方求助。
D) 在社交媒体上发布她宠物狗的照片。
【答案】A （细节题）Get her pet dog back.
【定位】Kirsteen Marshall, a 34-year-old mum of one, posted a tearful video on social media Wednesday, begging for the safe return of her beloved pet dog.
34 岁、育有一子的母亲 Kirsteen Marshall 周三在社交媒体上发布了一段含泪的视频，恳求让她心爱的宠物狗平安归来。
【信号】begging 点出真实目的。这一句里 begging for the safe return of her beloved pet dog是表意图的动词短语，直接道出她做这一切的根本目的，是承载答案的信号句；前面posted a tearful video 只是她采取的手段。
【替换】begging for the safe return of her beloved pet dog ↔Get her pet dog back
求平安归来=把狗找回
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音确实说她 posted an image of a man suspected of stealing the dog，B 盗用了这里的 suspect 原词，但发嫌疑人照片是她找狗路上的一个中间手段，不是她『努力要达成』的目的，答非所问。
借用原文：After combing through the security video outside a Gorbals shop, Kirsteen has now posted an image of a man suspected of stealing the dog
C)
答非所问
录音末尾只说 Police are investigating the incident.，是警方在查案，并没有说她去『乞求警方帮忙』；C 把警方的存在偷换成她的诉求，与题干问的『她想做什么』错位。
借用原文：Police are investigating the incident.
D)
原词陷阱
录音说她 posted a tearful video on social media，D 盗用 social media、post 原词，但发社交媒体只是她为找回狗采取的途径，跟 B 一样是手段而非她要达成的目的。
借用原文：posted a tearful video on social media Wednesday
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the news report say about Kirsteen Marshall's family?

options.text: It is suffering a great deal from the incident.
It is helping the police with the investigation.
It is bringing the case to the local district court.
It is offering a big reward to anyone who helps.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say about Kirsteen Marshall's family?
【翻译】新闻报道关于 Kirsteen Marshall 的家人说了什么?
A) 他们正因这一事件遭受巨大痛苦。
B) 他们正在协助警方调查。
C) 他们正在把案件提交到当地地方法院。
D) 他们正在向任何提供帮助的人提供丰厚奖励。
【答案】D （细节题）It is offering a big reward to anyone who helps.
【定位】The family is now offering a £5,000 reward for the safe return of the dog after launching a social media campaign to find the thief.
在发起社交媒体行动寻找窃贼之后，这家人如今正悬赏 5000 英镑以换回狗的平安归来。
【信号】family+具体金额坐实。这一句以题干主语 The family 起头，并给出具体金额 offering a £5,000 reward，主语对上、又带数字，正是承载答案的信号句；预读时圈的 reward 在此被坐实。
【替换】offering a £5,000 reward for the safe return of the dog ↔ offering a big reward to anyone who helps
5000镑=一大笔悬赏
We'll pay that to anyone who brings him home ↔to anyone who helps
带它回家者=帮忙者
【排除】A)
过度推断
录音第一段说她发了 a tearful video（含泪视频），A 据此推出全家『受了很大煎熬』，但报道只描述了行动（发视频、悬赏），并未陈述家人正承受痛苦这一事实，属于在原文情绪线索上推过了头。
借用原文：posted a tearful video on social media Wednesday
B)
张冠李戴
录音说 Police are investigating the incident.，是警方在调查；B 盗用 police、investigation 原词，却把『警方查案』安到了家人头上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：Police are investigating the incident.
C)
未提及
全篇只讲发视频、贴嫌疑人照片、悬赏、警方调查，从没说过把案子告上 local district court；C 是录音里完全没有依据的动作，属凭空添加。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does Guy Wilson say his café aims to do?

options.text: Provide free meals to the local poor.
Help people connect with each other.
Help eliminate class difference in his area.
Provide customers with first-class service.

explanation:
【题目】What does Guy Wilson say his café aims to do?
【翻译】Guy Wilson 说他的咖啡馆旨在做什么?
A) 为当地穷人提供免费餐食。
B) 帮助人们彼此建立联系。
C) 帮助消除他所在地区的阶层差异。
D) 为顾客提供一流的服务。
【答案】B （细节题）Help people connect with each other.
【定位】Owner Guy Wilson says his café aims to build community, rather than profits. He wants to provide a bridge for people to connect in an area that has been divided by class and wealth by providing affordable breakfasts.
店主盖伊·威尔逊说，他的咖啡馆志在营造社区，而非赚取利润。他想在一个被阶层和财富割裂的地区，通过提供负担得起的早餐，为人们搭起一座相互连接的桥梁。

【信号】表目的的 aims to / wants to。这句里 aims to build community和 wants to provide a bridge for people to connect接连出现两个表目的的信号词；预读时锁定的就是它们，听到"aims to"后面那串内容即答案区，无须再往后听。
【替换】provide a bridge for people to connect ↔Help people connect with each other.
搭桥让人连接=帮人互相连接
【排除】A)
偷换概念
原文说店主靠 providing affordable breakfasts（提供负担得起的早餐）来搭桥，affordable 是"付得起、便宜"，并不等于 free（免费）；A 把"affordable"夸大成 free meals，又添了"the local poor（当地穷人）"这个原文没指明的对象，是听到"早餐"就误选的陷阱。
借用原文：providing affordable breakfasts
C)
原词陷阱
原文只说该地区 has been divided by class and wealth（被阶层和财富所割裂），店是想在这种环境里"搭桥连接"，从没说要 eliminate（消除）阶层差异。C 盗用了 class 这个原词，再把"搭桥"夸大成"消除差异"——听到 class 就选它正中陷阱。
借用原文：has been divided by class and wealth
D)
未提及
原文明确老板要的是 build community, rather than profits（营造社区而非利润），目标根本不在"服务档次"上；D 的 first-class service（一流服务）属于无中生有，还隐隐与"不追求利润"的取向相反，是用一个听起来"高大上"的褒义短语来诱选。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the news report say about Eggs & Bread café?

options.text: It does not supervise its employees.
It donates regularly to a local charity.
It does not use volunteers.
It is open round the clock.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say about Eggs & Bread café?
【翻译】新闻报道关于 Eggs & Bread 咖啡馆说了什么?
A) 它不监督其员工。
B) 它定期向当地慈善机构捐款。
C) 它不使用志愿者。
D) 它全天候营业。
【答案】C （细节题）It does not use volunteers.
【定位】The café doesn't use volunteers, but pays its staff to ensure consistency in its service.
这家咖啡馆不使用志愿者，而是付薪给员工，以确保服务的稳定一致。
【信号】否定 doesn't + 转折 but。答案句靠 doesn't use volunteers这个明确否定，加上 but pays its staff的转折点出真意——"不用义工、改用付薪员工"。否定词与转折词同现，正是答案落点的强信号。

【替换】doesn't use volunteers ↔It does not use volunteers.
doesn't=does not，几乎原句
【排除】A)
与原文相反
原文说店 has two members of staff or supervisors on shift every day（每天有两名员工或主管值班），明明是"有人盯班、管得到"；A 盗用 supervisors / staff 这层意思却反过来说 does not supervise its employees（不监管员工），与原文相反，是听到"supervisor"就误选的陷阱。
借用原文：has two members of staff or supervisors on shift every day
B)
原词陷阱
原文说店 doesn't take donations and doesn't want to be seen as a charity（不接受捐款、也不想被当成慈善机构）；B 盗用 donations / charity 两个原词，却说成 donates regularly to a local charity（定期向当地慈善机构捐款），方向完全反了——这是"听到charity 就选"的高诱惑陷阱。
借用原文：doesn't take donations and doesn't want to be seen as a charity
D)
偷换概念
原文说店 is open in the mornings every day of the year（一年中每天早上营业）；D 的open round the clock 是"24 小时全天候"，把"每天早上"夸大成"全天不打烊"，是听到open every day 就误选的时间细节陷阱。
借用原文：is open in the mornings every day of the year
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What happens when people start to know each other according to Guy Wilson?

options.text: They will realise the importance of communication.
They will come to the café even more frequently.
They will care less about their own background.
They will find they have something in common.

explanation:
【题目】What happens when people start to know each other according to Guy Wilson?
【翻译】根据 Guy Wilson 的说法,当人们开始相互了解时会发生什么?
A) 他们会意识到沟通的重要性。
B) 他们会更频繁地来到这家咖啡馆。
C) 他们会不那么在意自己的背景。
D) 他们会发现彼此有共同之处。
【答案】D （细节题）They will find they have something in common.
【定位】Mr. Wilson says, when people start to know other people around them, they realize they're not that different. And whatever their financial background, or their educational background, most people will have something in common with each other.
威尔逊先生说，当人们开始认识身边的人，就会意识到彼此并没有那么不同。而且无论财务背景还是教育背景如何，大多数人彼此之间都会有一些共同之处。

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D).Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【信号】条件 when + 结果 they realize / will have。答案句以 when people start to know other people around them起头，后面 they realize they're not that different和 most people will have something in common就是结果。题干的 when 与原文的 when 对齐，结果就在 when 之后，顺着听即可锁定。
【替换】most people will have something in common with each other ↔ They will find they have something in common.
have something in common 原样保留
【排除】A)
未提及
原文老板谈的是人们会 realize they're not that different（意识到彼此没那么不同），从没说他们会意识到 communication（沟通）的重要性；A 的"沟通"是原文没有的概念，属凭"咖啡馆=交流"的常识补出来的项。
B)
原词陷阱
café 一词录音里反复出现，B 的 come to the café even more frequently（更频繁地来店）就借这个原词诱选；但原文谈的是人熟了之后"意识到彼此相似"，根本没说人们会更常来，属听到 café 就选的答非所问。
借用原文：when people start to know other people around them
C)
偷换概念
原文说 whatever their financial background, or their educational background, most people will have something in common（无论何种背景，大多有共同点）；C 盗用background 原词，却把结论换成 care less about their own background（更少在意自己的背景）——原文讲"有共同点"，不是讲"在意程度变低"，是 D 的近义干扰项。
借用原文：whatever their financial background, or their educational background, most people will have something in common
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

options.text: A surprise party for Paul's birthday.
Travel plans for the coming weekend.
Preparations for Saturday's get-together.
The new market on the other side of town.

explanation:
【题目】What are the speakers mainly talking about?
【翻译】说话者主要在谈论什么?
A) 为Paul的生日举办惊喜派对。
B) 即将到来的周末的旅行计划。
C) 周六聚会的准备工作。
D) 城镇另一边的新市场。
【答案】C （主旨题）Preparations for Saturday's get-together.
【定位】M: So what time do you think we should have the party on Saturday? W: How about inviting people to come at 6:00 p.m.? Then we'll have the afternoon to prepare food and drink, and stuff like that.
男：那你觉得我们周六的聚会该几点开始？女：邀请大家下午六点来怎么样？这样我们就有一下午来准备食物和饮料之类的东西。

【信号】开头点题定主线。对话第一句 what time do you think we should have the party on Saturday 一上来就把周六聚会摆出来，紧接着女方说 we'll have the afternoon to prepare food and drink，之后几段一直在谈准备食物、买饮料、放音乐——开头点题加上全程不离筹备聚会，主线就此锁定。
【替换】prepare food and drink ↔Preparations
动词 prepare 转名词 Preparations
the party on Saturday ↔Saturday's get-together
party 与 get-together 同义
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A surprise party for Paul's birthday. 借了录音末尾真出现的人名 Paul，但原文 we should ask Paul to bring his computer and speakers 只是请 Paul 带设备放音乐，从没说这是给 Paul 办的生日惊喜会，听到 Paul 就选属于原词陷阱。
借用原文：ask Paul to bring his computer and speakers
B)
未提及
Travel plans for the coming weekend. 借了周末这个时间框，但全程谈的是在家办聚会、买东西，没有半句出行旅行，把周末筹备聚会偷换成周末旅行计划，属未提及内容。
D)
原词陷阱
The new market on the other side of town. 确实是录音 that big new supermarket on the other side of town 念到的，但它只是买饮料时顺带提的一个去处，是细节而非全篇主线，主旨题选了细节就以偏概全。
借用原文：that big new supermarket on the other side of town
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why does the woman say it is a good idea to serve foods that guests can help themselves to?

options.text: It makes the hostess's job a whole lot easier.
It enables guests to walk around and chat freely.
It saves considerable time and labor.
It requires fewer tables and chairs.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the woman say it is a good idea to serve foods that guests can help themselves to?
【翻译】女士为什么说提供客人可以自取的食物是个好主意?
A) 这让女主人的工作轻松了许多。
B) 这让客人能够四处走动并自由交谈。
C) 这节省了大量时间和劳动。
D) 这需要更少的桌椅。
【答案】B （细节题）It enables guests to walk around and chat freely.
【定位】so that people can just help themselves, rather than getting everyone to sit down at the table to eat a meal. I think that's a bit too formal. It's better to let people walk around and talk to each other, or sit where they like.
这样大家就能自助取用，而不必让所有人坐到桌边吃一顿正餐。我觉得那样有点太正式了。还是让大家走动走动、互相聊聊、想坐哪儿坐哪儿更好。

【信号】it's better to 引出真正理由。女方先说自助取餐 so that people can just help themselves，再用 It's better to let people walk around and talk to each other 给出她认为好的真正原因——it's better to 这个引出理由的信号句，正是答案落点。
【替换】let people walk around and talk to each other ↔enables guests to walk around and chat freely
talk 换 chat、let 换 enables
【排除】A)
未提及
It makes the hostess's job a whole lot easier. 听着合理，但原文女方给的理由是让客人能走动交谈，从没说这能让女主人活儿更轻松，属于自己顺势补的推断，原文未提。
C)
未提及
It saves considerable time and labor. 是常识里自助餐的好处，但本题问的是女方说的理由，她说的是社交自由不是省时省力，录音并未把节省时间精力当作理由，属未提及。
D)
原词陷阱
It requires fewer tables and chairs. 原文虽提到 sit down at the table，但只是说不必正式围桌吃饭，从没说自助能少用桌椅，这是借了 table 一词的推断，原文未作此理由。
借用原文：getting everyone to sit down at the table
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say about the new supermarket?

options.text: It offers some big discounts.
It is quite close to her house.
It is more spacious and less crowded.
It sells local wines and soft drinks.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about the new supermarket?
【翻译】女士对新超市说了什么?
A) 它提供一些大幅折扣。
B) 它离她家非常近。
C) 它更宽敞、不那么拥挤。
D) 它出售当地的葡萄酒和软饮料。
【答案】A （细节题）It offers some big discounts.
【定位】And I heard that the new supermarket offers some big discounts to attract customers. So going there should be a great idea.
而且我听说这家新超市为了吸引顾客提供很大的折扣，所以去那儿应该是个好主意。
【信号】女方直接陈述听到的信息。题干问的是 the woman，而正是女方在第 6 段说 I heard that the new supermarket offers some big discounts——说话人正确（女方）加上直接陈述新超市的特点，这句就是答案句。
【替换】the new supermarket offers some big discounts ↔It offers some big discounts.
几近原句的精简

【排除】B)
未提及
It is quite close to her house. 原文从没说这家新超市离谁家近，反而男方说 the other side of town（在城另一头），与近相反，属未提及甚至相反。
C)
未提及
It is more spacious and less crowded. 听着像大超市该有的样子，但录音对新超市只说了打折和在城另一头，从没提宽敞或人少，属未提及。
D)
原词陷阱
It sells local wines and soft drinks. 借了录音里真出现的 some beer and wine、other soft drinks，但那是男方说我们要买的饮料清单，不是在描述新超市卖什么，把买什么错安成超市卖什么，属原词陷阱兼张冠李戴。
借用原文：get some beer and wine, and some fruit juice, and other soft drinks
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man suggest they ask Paul to do?

options.text: Cook a dish for the party.
Arrive 10 minutes earlier.
Prepare a few opening remarks.
Bring his computer and speakers.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man suggest they ask Paul to do?
【翻译】男士建议他们让Paul做什么?
A) 为聚会做一道菜。
B) 提前10分钟到达。
C) 准备几句开场白。
D) 带上他的电脑和扬声器。
【答案】D （细节题）Bring his computer and speakers.
【定位】Maybe we should ask Paul to bring his computer and speakers, so that we can play some music.
也许我们该请 Paul 把他的电脑和音箱带来，这样我们就能放点音乐了。
【信号】ask…to 引出被建议的动作。男方用提议句 Maybe we should ask Paul to bring his computer and speakers——Maybe we should ask…to 这个建议信号直接点出请 Paul做的事，是答案句。
【替换】bring his computer and speakers ↔Bring his computer and speakers.
近乎原词的动作短语

【排除】A)
答非所问
Cook a dish for the party. 蹭了前文谈食物 prepare some sandwiches and snacks 的话题，但请 Paul 做的事是带设备放音乐，跟做菜无关，属答非所问。
借用原文：prepare some sandwiches and snacks
B)
未提及
Arrive 10 minutes earlier. 原文只在第 2 段说客人六点来，从没让 Paul 早到十分钟，数字和动作都是凭空添的，属未提及。
C)
未提及
Prepare a few opening remarks. 原文从没提让 Paul 致辞或准备开场白，整个对话也没出现演讲环节，纯属凭空编造，属未提及。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第14页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why does the woman want to have a car?

options.text: For commuting to work.
For long-distance travel.
For getting around in Miami.
For convenience at weekends.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the woman want to have a car?
【翻译】女士为什么想要一辆车?
A) 为了通勤上班。
B) 为了长途旅行。
C) 为了在迈阿密四处出行。
D) 为了周末方便。
【答案】D （细节题）For convenience at weekends.
【定位】I wouldn't need to use it every day, but I think it would be very convenient to have one for the weekends.
我不用每天都开它，但我觉得周末有辆车会很方便。
【信号】转折 but 之后落真意。女士先说 I wouldn't need to use it every day（不用每天开），紧跟一个转折 but，but 之后 very convenient to have one for the weekends 才是她真正想要车的理由。听力里转折词后面那半句几乎总是落点，前半句多是铺垫或干扰。
【替换】convenient to have one for the weekends ↔For convenience at weekends.
形容词转名词、说法基本同形
【排除】A)
未提及
For commuting to work."为了上下班通勤"是常识里买车最常见的理由，听起来很顺，但全文女士从没说过上班通勤，反而强调 I wouldn't need to use it every day（不用每天开），与通勤正相反。
B)
未提及
For long-distance travel."用于长途出行"原文同样只字未提；女士只说周末用、不必天天用，没有任何关于长途旅行的信息。
C)
原词陷阱
For getting around in Miami. 盗用了原文出现过的地名 Miami 和短语"代步"，但原文 I actually owned a car for a little while when I lived in Miami 说的是"过去住 Miami时"曾有车，那是往事，不是她现在想买车的理由。听到 Miami 就选，正中圈套。
借用原文：when I lived in Miami

stem: What does the woman say about German cars?

options.text: They are reliable.
They are compact.
They are spacious.
They are easy to drive.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about German cars?
【翻译】女士对德国车有什么看法?
A) 它们很可靠。
B) 它们很紧凑。
C) 它们很宽敞。
D) 它们很容易驾驶。
【答案】A （细节题）They are reliable.
【定位】I've heard that German cars are very reliable, but I haven't decided on a specific model yet.
我听说德国车很可靠，但我还没定下具体的车型。
【信号】钩子词 German cars 后的直接评价。原文 I've heard that German cars are very reliable里，钩子词 German cars 一出现，紧跟的形容词 reliable 就是女士给出的评价，正是答案句。这里的信号是"听音钩子词 + 其后的描述词"。
【替换】German cars are very reliable ↔They are reliable.
原词保留＋代词替名词
【排除】B)
张冠李戴
They are compact."小巧"挪用了女士后面说的 I'd also like it to be small（希望车小一点），但那是她对"想买的车"的个人偏好，并不是她"对德国车的评价"，把愿望安到了德国车头上，问的是德国车特点，答非所问。
借用原文：I'd also like it to be small
C)
未提及
They are spacious."宽敞"原文完全没出现，且与女士"想要小车"的偏好正好相反，是用一个和 B 反义的形容词来凑数干扰。
D)
张冠李戴
They are easy to drive. 盗用了原文 so that it's easy to drive in the city，但那句是接着"想要小车"说的——小车在城里好开，讲的是她想买的小车，不是德国车的特点，对象搞错了。
借用原文：so that it's easy to drive in the city

stem: What does the man recommend the woman do?

options.text: Buy a second-hand car.
Trust her own judgment.
Seek advice from his friend.
Look around before deciding.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man recommend the woman do?

【翻译】男士建议女士做什么?
A) 买一辆二手车。
B) 相信她自己的判断。
C) 向他的朋友寻求建议。
D) 在决定之前多看看。
【答案】C （细节题）Seek advice from his friend.
【定位】I have a friend who sells second-hand cars. He's a really nice guy, and he knows a lot about cars. I could give you his phone number if you want, and you could call him and ask him questions.
我有个卖二手车的朋友。他人很好，对车很在行。你愿意的话我可以把他的电话给你，你可以打给他问问题。
【信号】建议句 I could…/you could… 是落点。男士用 I could give you his phone number 和you could call him and ask him questions 这种 could 引出的婉转建议句给出主意——找他那位懂车的朋友咨询。建议类题目的答案就落在这种 "you could… / I could…" 句上。
【替换】I have a friend who sells second-hand cars ↔Seek advice from his friend
his friend 原义保留
you could call him and ask him questions ↔Seek advice from his friend
详述动作概括为求教
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Buy a second-hand car. 盗用了原文 a friend who sells second-hand cars 里的 second-hand cars，但那只是介绍朋友"卖二手车"的身份，男士建议的是"去问他"，不是"去买二手车"；女士还明确说 I don't want to feel obliged to buy one of his cars（不想被逼着买车）。听到 second-hand 就选即落陷阱。
借用原文：a friend who sells second-hand cars
B)
与原文相反
Trust her own judgment."相信自己的判断"恰好和原文相反：女士最后说 I could use some help in deciding、Speaking to an expert would be a good idea（需要帮助、找行家聊聊好），说明她接受了"求助"而非"靠自己判断"，更不是男士的建议。
借用原文：I could use some help in deciding
D)
未提及
Look around before deciding."先多看看再决定"是买东西的常识做法，听着合理，但男士的建议自始至终是"找他朋友问"，从没说过"先到处比较"，属脑补出来的干扰。

stem: What do we learn about the man's friend from the conversation?

options.text: He sells new cars.
He can be trusted.
He is starting a business.
He is a successful car dealer.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the man's friend from the conversation?

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【翻译】从对话中我们了解到男士的朋友什么信息?
A) 他销售新车。
B) 他值得信赖。
C) 他正在创业。
D) 他是一位成功的汽车经销商。
【答案】B （细节题）He can be trusted.
【定位】Oh, no, he's not like that. He's a good friend of mine, and he would never try to pressure you or cheat you.
哦，不，他不是那种人。他是我的好朋友，绝不会给你压力或欺骗你。
【信号】对人品的强调：never pressure or cheat。男士强调 he would never try to pressure you or cheat you（绝不施压、绝不欺骗），加上女士随后说 if you trust him, then, I guess it should be OK，两处合起来把重点落在"这位朋友可信"上。信号是"对人品的反复强调 + 对方表示信任"。
【替换】he would never try to pressure you or cheat you ↔He can be trusted
否定式具体描述＝肯定式概括评价
if you trust him, then, I guess it should be OK ↔He can be trusted
trust 原词印证可信
【排除】A)
与原文相反
He sells new cars. 借用了原文"卖车"的信息，却把车型说反了：原文是 a friend who sells second-hand cars（卖二手车），不是新车。听到"sells…cars"就选，会被 new/second-hand 的差别绊倒。
借用原文：a friend who sells second-hand cars
C)
原词陷阱
He is starting a business. 盗用了原文 I think his family owns the business 里的business，但原文说的是"他家族拥有这门生意（早就在做）"，不是"他正在创业（starting）"，把"已有生意"听成"开始创业"就中招。
借用原文：his family owns the business
D)
过度推断
He is a successful car dealer. 顺着"家里开车行、懂车"往下推出"成功的车商"，但原文只说他 knows a lot about cars、人好，从没评价生意"成功（successful）"，这是从已有信息多走了一步的过度推断。
借用原文：he knows a lot about cars
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第19页

stem: What do we learn about early pigs in North America?

options.text: Many escaped from farms and became wild.
They were actually native to North America.
Many got killed in the wild when searching for food.
They were hunted by Spanish and Russian explorers.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about early pigs in North America?
【翻译】关于北美早期的猪，我们了解到什么？
A) 许多猪从农场逃脱并变成了野猪。
B) 它们实际上原产于北美。
C) 许多猪在野外觅食时被杀死。
D) 它们被西班牙和俄罗斯探险家猎杀。
【答案】A （细节题）Many escaped from farms and became wild.
【定位】This practice also allowed many pigs to escape from farms and live in the wild, which became a problem.
这种做法也使得许多猪从农场逃走、生活在野外，这就成了一个问题。

【信号】讲来历的开头句。本段是交代猪"从哪来"的起源段，承载答案的是收束这段经过的 This practice also allowed many pigs to escape from farms and live in the wild——它正面说出了"许多猪逃离农场进入野外"这一结果，是答案句。
【替换】many pigs to escape from farms and live in the wild ↔ Many escaped from farms and became wild
live in the wild=became wild
【排除】B)
原文开篇即说 Pigs are not native to North America（猪并非北美土生），而 They were actually native to North America 恰恰说成"本来就是北美土生"，极性反了。
借用原文：Pigs are not native to North America
C)
未提及
原文只说猪 escape from farms and live in the wild（逃走进野外），从未提到"许多猪在野外觅食时被杀"，Many got killed in the wild when searching for food 是无中生有，只是借用了原文 in search of food 的影子。
D)
原文确有 Spanish and Russian explorers and settlers，但说的是他们"introduced（引入）"了猪，They were hunted by Spanish and Russian explorers 却把动作改成"hunted（猎杀）"，盗了专名、换了行为，是答非所问。
借用原文：introduced to California by Spanish and Russian explorers and settlers
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第20页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why are wild pigs a threat to humans?

options.text: They often make sudden attacks on people.
They break up nature's food supply chain.
They cause much environmental pollution.
They carry a great many diseases.

explanation:
【题目】Why are wild pigs a threat to humans?
【翻译】为什么野猪对人类构成威胁？
A) 它们经常对人发动突然袭击。
B) 它们破坏了自然界的食物供应链。
C) 它们造成了严重的环境污染。
D) 它们携带大量疾病。
【答案】D （细节题）They carry a great many diseases.
【定位】They also harbor dozens of diseases that threaten both humans and farm animals.
它们还携带数十种威胁人类和家畜的疾病。
【信号】唯一含humans的句子。全段讲危害的句子很多，但点名"threaten...humans"的只有这一句 harbor dozens of diseases that threaten both humans and farm animals，题眼"对人"直接对上它，是答案句。
【替换】harbor dozens of diseases that threaten both humans ↔They carry a great many diseases
harbor=carry、dozens=many

【排除】A)
原文从未提野猪"主动攻击人"，只说携带疾病威胁人；They often make sudden attacks on people 是凭"野猪凶猛"的常识脑补，原文无据。
B)
答非所问
原文确实提到野猪扰乱食物链类的生态危害（eating other animals or their food supply），但那是对其他动物/生态的危害，不是题眼问的"对人"；They break up nature's food supply chain 盗用了原文真讲过的危害，却答非所问。
借用原文：In addition to either eating other animals or their food supply
C)
原文说野猪 rooting up grasses and rubbing on trees（拱草、蹭树）破坏原生栖息地，这是物理破坏栖息地，不是"环境污染"；They cause much environmental pollution 偷换成了 pollution，且仍不是"对人"。
借用原文：damage native habitats by rooting up grasses and rubbing on trees

source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say about the native foxes on the US island?

options.text: They lived peacefully with wild pigs.
They ran out of food completely.
They fell victim to eagles.
They reproduced quickly.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about the native foxes on the US island?
【翻译】文章关于美国岛屿上的本地狐狸说了什么？
A) 它们与野猪和平共处。
B) 它们的食物完全耗尽了。
C) 它们成了老鹰的猎物。
D) 它们繁殖迅速。
【答案】C （细节题）They fell victim to eagles.
【定位】The eagles began breeding on the island, and also feeding on a species of native fox. The foxes were almost wiped out completely.
老鹰开始在岛上繁殖，也开始捕食一种本地狐狸。这些狐狸几乎被彻底消灭。
【信号】狐狸出现处的因果链。本段结尾交代了"野猪招来老鹰→老鹰捕食狐狸→狐狸几乎灭绝"的因果链，承载答案的是 feeding on a species of native fox 与 The foxes were almost wiped out completely 这两句，直接说出狐狸的下场，是答案句。
【替换】feeding on a species of native fox ↔They fell victim to eagles
被老鹰捕食=成老鹰的猎物

【排除】A)
原文说狐狸几乎被消灭，谈不上"和平共处"；They lived peacefully with wild pigs 借用了原文反复出现的 wild pigs，却把惨烈结局说成"和平相处"，与原文相反。
借用原文：The foxes were almost wiped out completely
B)
原文谈"food supply"是说野猪抢夺动物的食物来源，并未说狐狸"彻底断粮"；They ran out of food completely 盗用了原文的 food supply 与 completely，张冠李戴到狐狸"断粮"上，实际狐狸是被老鹰吃掉。
借用原文：eating other animals or their food supply
D)
原文说 The eagles began breeding on the island（老鹰开始在岛上繁殖），They reproduced quickly 把"繁殖"这个动作从老鹰头上挪到了狐狸头上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：The eagles began breeding on the island

stem: What are a pair of entrepreneurs planning to do?

options.text: Taste coffee while in outer space.
Roast coffee beans in outer space.
Develop a new strain of coffee bean.
Use a pressurised tank to brew coffee.

explanation:
【题目】What are a pair of entrepreneurs planning to do?
【翻译】一对企业家正计划做什么?
A) 在外太空品尝咖啡。
B) 在外太空烘焙咖啡豆。
C) 培育一种新的咖啡豆品种。
D) 使用加压罐冲泡咖啡。
【答案】B （细节题）Roast coffee beans in outer space.
【定位】A pair of entrepreneurs are planning to build and launch a spacecraft that would carry and roast coffee beans in outer space.
两位创业者正计划建造并发射一艘能在外太空运载并烘焙咖啡豆的飞行器。
【信号】原文 planning to 与题干同词，是直接应答信号。录音第一句就用 are planning to 直接对上题干的 planning to do，这种题干问什么、原文紧接着用同一表计划的词说出来的句子，就是答案句，顺着这个信号锁定即可。
【替换】roast coffee beans in outer space ↔Roast coffee beans in outer space.
原文短语与选项几乎逐词对应
【排除】A)
答非所问
Taste coffee while in outer space. 借了后文做咖啡、卖咖啡的话题诱你联想到品尝，但原文这两人计划的是 roast 烘焙，从没说要在太空 taste 品尝咖啡，属答非所问。
C)
未提及
Develop a new strain of coffee bean. 说培育咖啡豆新品种，原文通篇只讲烘焙现有的豆子、从未提培育新品种，属无中生有。
D)
原词陷阱
Use a pressurised tank to brew coffee. 盗用了原文 in a pressurised tank 这个真出现过的原词来骗你，但原文那个加压罐是用来 roast 烘焙豆子的，不是 brew 冲泡咖啡，听到熟词就选正中圈套。

stem: What does the passage say about coffee beans roasted on Earth?

options.text: They can easily get burned.
They float around in the oven.
They have to be heated to 360℃.
They receive evenly distributed heat.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about coffee beans roasted on Earth?

【翻译】文章关于在地球上烘焙的咖啡豆说了什么?
A) 它们很容易被烤焦。
B) 它们在烤箱中四处漂浮。
C) 它们必须被加热到360℃。
D) 它们受到均匀分布的热量。
【答案】A （细节题）They can easily get burned.
【定位】The businessmen say that on Earth, beans can easily break apart and get burned in the roaster.
这些商人说，在地球上，咖啡豆在烘焙机里容易裂开并被烧焦。
【信号】原文 on Earth 与题干限定词重合，是定位锚。录音 on Earth, beans can easily break apart and get burned 里的 on Earth 与题干限定词完全一致，听到这个限定词就锁定本句；其后 But if gravity is removed 一转，转折后讲的是太空情形，不可拿来答on Earth。
【替换】get burned in the roaster ↔They can easily get burned.
原文与选项共用 get burned，连 easily 都对上
【排除】B)
张冠李戴
They float around in the oven. 盗用原文 the beans float around in a heated oven 这句真念过的话，可那是 But if gravity is removed 之后讲的太空情形，题问的是 on Earth地球，张冠李戴。
C)
原词陷阱
They have to be heated to 360℃. 盗用原文 360 degrees of evenly distributed heat 里的 360 这个真念过的数字，可原文 360 degrees 指的是太空里受热的方位360度而非加热到360℃，且讲的也是太空情形，数字陷阱加错情形双重出错。

stem: What did the two Italian companies do in 2015?

options.text: They charged a high price for their space-roasted coffee beans.
They set up a branch in Dubai to manufacture coffee roasters.
They collaborated on building the first space coffee machine.
They abandoned the attempt to roast coffee beans in space.

explanation:
【题目】What did the two Italian companies do in 2015?
【翻译】两家意大利公司在2015年做了什么?
A) 它们为其太空烘焙的咖啡豆定了高价。
B) 它们在Dubai设立分公司制造咖啡烘焙机。
C) 它们合作建造了第一台太空咖啡机。
D) 它们放弃了在太空烘焙咖啡豆的尝试。
【答案】C （细节题）They collaborated on building the first space coffee machine.

【定位】In 2015, two Italian companies collaborated on the construction of a similar type of spacecraft, which was the first coffee machine designed for use in space.
2015年，两家意大利公司合作建造了一艘类似的飞行器，那是首台为太空使用而设计的咖啡机。
【信号】原文 In 2015 与题干年份重合，是定位锚。录音 In 2015, two Italian companies collaborated on the construction 同时出现 In 2015 与 two Italian companies 两个题干锚，听到它们就锁定本句，本句的主动作 collaborated 即答案。
【替换】collaborated on the construction of a similar type of spacecraft ↔ They collaborated on building the first space coffee machine.
construction 概括为 building，意思等值
the first coffee machine designed for use in space ↔the first space coffee machine
原文长定语压缩成选项短语，所指相同
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
They charged a high price for their space-roasted coffee beans. 盗用前文 how much they would charge 关于收费的话，可那是讲前文那对创业者卖咖啡定价、且只说不清收多少，根本不是2015年两家意大利公司做的事，张冠李戴。
B)
原词陷阱
They set up a branch in Dubai to manufacture coffee roasters. 盗用前文 sold for the first time in Dubai 里真念过的 Dubai，可 Dubai 只是前文那对创业者公司的所在地，原文从没说意大利公司去 Dubai 设分部造烘焙机，属无中生有加张冠李戴。
D)
与原文相反
They abandoned the attempt to roast coffee beans in space. 盗用原文 the first attempt to take coffee into space 里的 attempt，可原文是说2015年并非首次尝试、那两家公司是合作建成了机器，根本没说放弃，方向相反。

stem: Why do a lot of people come to the village of Takotna every March?

options.text: It is the best time for sightseeing.
A race passes through it annually.
They come to clean the Iditarod Trail.
It is when the villagers choose a queen.

explanation:
【题目】Why do a lot of people come to the village of Takotna every March?
【翻译】为什么每年三月都有很多人来到Takotna村？
A) 这是观光的最佳时间。
B) 一场比赛每年都会经过这里。
C) 他们来清理Iditarod Trail。
D) 这是村民们选举女王的时候。
【答案】B （细节题）A race passes through it annually.
【定位】Each March, this tiny village swells up in numbers, because it is located in the middle of a race that takes place every year.
每年三月，这个小村庄人数都会激增，因为它正位于一场每年举办的比赛的途中。
【信号】因果连词 because 引出真因。这句的答案信号是因果连词 because：题干问 "为什么三月人多"，录音正好用 because it is located in the middle of a race that takes place every year 给出原因——听到 because 就该锁定其后内容为答案句。
【替换】a race that takes place every year ↔A race passes through it annually
takes place every year = annually
it is located in the middle of a race ↔A race passes through it
村在赛道中 = 赛事穿村而过

【排除】A)
未提及
It is the best time for sightseeing. 说三月是观光最佳时节，但录音只讲了比赛带来人流，全程没提观光或景色好坏，属凭常识脑补出来的理由。
C)
原词陷阱
They come to clean the Iditarod Trail. 偷用了录音里真出现过的赛事名 Iditarod Trail 来骗 "听到就想选"，但录音说人们是来参赛/被吸引，根本没说来 "打扫"（clean）这条小径，盗了名字却安了个录音没有的动作。
借用原文：It is a seven-day race, called the Iditarod Trail
D)
原词陷阱
It is when the villagers choose a queen. 借了录音末尾 started to refer to Jan as Queen of Takotna（村民称 Jan 为 "塔科特纳王后"）里的 queen 一词，但那只是对一个人的尊称，并非 "三月选王后" 的活动，更不是人们来访的原因，把后文的称呼挪来当来访理由。
借用原文：Proud residents then started to refer to Jan as Queen of Takotna

stem: What is the village of Takotna famous for?

Its great food variety.

explanation:
【题目】What is the village of Takotna famous for?
【翻译】Takotna村以什么而闻名？
A) 孩子们的烘焙技艺。
B) 独特的冬季景色。
C) 美味的水果派。
D) 丰富多样的食物。
【答案】C （细节题）Its tasty fruit pies.
【定位】Lucky for them, Takotna is famous for its delicious fruit pies.
对他们来说幸运的是，塔科特纳以美味的水果派而闻名。
【信号】标志短语 famous for 直接点题。答案信号就是题干同款短语 famous for：录音原话Takotna is famous for its delicious fruit pies 与题干 famous for 用词几乎对照，听到famous for 就锁定其后的 fruit pies 为答案。
【替换】its delicious fruit pies ↔Its tasty fruit pies
delicious = tasty 同义替换

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Its children's baking skills. 搬用了录音里真出现的 developing their baking skills（孩子们练就烘焙手艺），但录音说孩子练手艺只是全村备战的一个细节，村子 "出名" 的点录音明确说是水果派，不是孩子的手艺——盗了 baking skills 却答非所问。
借用原文：who end up developing their baking skills at an early age
B)
未提及
Its unique winter scenery. 说村子以独特冬景闻名，录音开头确实提到 cold and snowy Alaska（寒冷多雪的阿拉斯加）这一背景，但从没说村子靠 "冬景" 出名，是把 "地处雪国"脑补成了 "以雪景著称"。
借用原文：In cold and snowy Alaska
D)
偷换概念
Its great food variety. 借了第二段 pies of all kinds, such as apple, orange, lemon or banana（各种口味的派）的 "多样" 印象，但那是在讲招待racers的派有多种口味，而村子"出名" 的点录音说的是 fruit pies 这一招牌本身，不是 "食物种类丰富"——把口味多偷换成了出名理由。
借用原文：delightful pies of all kinds, such as apple, orange, lemon or banana

答非所问

stem: What does the passage say about Jan Newton?

options.text: She owned a restaurant in Idaho.
She married her husband in 1972.
She went to Alaska to compete in a race.
She helped the village to become famous.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about Jan Newton?
【翻译】文章关于Jan Newton说了什么？
A) 她在Idaho拥有一家餐厅。
B) 她在1972年与丈夫结婚。
C) 她去Alaska参加比赛。
D) 她帮助这个村庄变得出名。
【答案】D （细节题）She helped the village to become famous.
【定位】Her rich and filling-fruit pies quickly got the racers' attention, and the village gained some fame as a result.
她那香浓饱腹的水果派很快吸引了参赛选手的注意，村子也因此小有名气。
【信号】结果信号 as a result 点出她的贡献。答案信号是结果状语 as a result：录音说她的派吸引选手注意，the village gained some fame as a result（村子因此出了名）——这处因果落点正对应 "Jan 让村子出名"，是核对四项后唯一与原文相符的陈述。
【替换】the village gained some fame as a result ↔She helped the village to become famous
因她而村子出名 = 她帮村子出名
gained some fame ↔become famous
gain fame = become famous

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
She owned a restaurant in Idaho. 偷用了录音里真出现的地名 Idaho，但录音说 Jan 是moved from Idaho（从 Idaho 搬出来）后才 opened a restaurant，餐馆其实是开在Takotna，不是 Idaho——盗了地名却把餐馆地点安错了。
借用原文：Jan moved from Idaho with her husband in 1972 and opened a restaurant
B)
原词陷阱
She married her husband in 1972. 偷用了录音真出现的年份 1972，但录音 Jan moved from Idaho with her husband in 1972 说的是 1972 年 "她带着丈夫搬来"（搬家），并没说 1972 年 "结婚"——而且 with her husband 说明搬来时已是丈夫，把搬家的年份硬安给了结婚。
借用原文：Jan moved from Idaho with her husband in 1972
C)
张冠李戴
She went to Alaska to compete in a race. 借了通篇反复出现的 race（比赛）一词，但录音说 Jan 是搬来开餐馆、做派招待选手，从没说她 "去阿拉斯加参赛"——去参赛的是racers，不是 Jan，把比赛这条线张冠李戴到了她头上。
借用原文：Her rich and filling-fruit pies quickly got the racers' attention

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author say about educators 问的是作者对教育者说了什么客观陈述，没有 infer/imply/mainly about，是定位 + 转述型细节题。
【拆句】What does the author say about educators 主干是 "the author say what about educators" 的疑问倒装，about 后面跟话题对象，结构简单、无陷阱。
【定位】Teachers want to prepare students for a successful future.
教师想让学生为成功的未来做好准备。
【选项】A)
无中生有
They seek advice from technology companies to achieve teaching goals 说教师向科技公司寻求建议，原文只说双方有共同点 Educators and business leaders have more in common than it may seem，并没有任何「教师向公司讨教」的方向性陈述。
B)
与原文相反
They have been successful in preparing the workforce for companies 用现在完成时说教师已经成功地把劳动力交付给公司，原文只说 Teachers want to prepare students for a successful future——是 want to 的愿望，不是已实现的成果。
C)
✓ 正确
Teachers want to prepare students for a successful future ↔ They help students acquire the skills needed for their future success
预判要求「准备 + 未来 + 学生」三要素齐全，They help students acquire the skills needed for their future success 把三个要素一一对应，无新增也无遗漏，是定位句的标准同义替换。
D)
偷换概念
They partner with technology companies to enhance teaching efficiency 说教师与公司合作以提升教学效率，原文虽然提到 technology companies are partnering with educators to bring back good, old-fashioned play，但目的是把游戏带回课堂，不是「提升教学效率」。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: How can educators better develop students' STEM skills, according to the author?

options.text: By blending them with traditional, stimulating activities.
By inviting business leaders to help design curriculums.
By enhancing students' ability to think in a critical way.
By showing students the best way to learn is through play.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 How can educators better develop students' STEM skills 问的是具体方法，需要回原文找一句明确的「办法」陈述，属于方法型细节题。
【拆句】How can educators better develop students' STEM skills, according to the author：主干 educators develop STEM skills，better 是副词修饰 develop，according to the author 是插入语，整句问的是方法，结构简单。
【定位】Focusing on STEM skills is important, but the reality is that STEM skills are enhanced and more relevant when combined with traditional, hands-on creative activities.
关注 STEM 技能很重要，但事实是，只有当 STEM 技能与传统的、动手的创造性活动相结合时，这些技能才能得到强化，也才更具相关性。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
STEM skills are enhanced and more relevant when combined with traditional, hands-on creative activities
↔By blending them with traditional, stimulating activities
预判的三要素「结合 + 传统 + 动手/创意」，By blending them with traditional, stimulating activities 命中「结合」「传统」两项硬词，「动手创意」被合理上位化为stimulating，整体语义等值。
B)
无中生有
By inviting business leaders to help design curriculums 说请商业领袖来帮忙设计课程，原文只说商业领袖与教师有共同利益、且科技公司与教师合作把游戏带回来technology companies are partnering with educators to bring back good, old-fashioned play，没有任何「商业领袖设计课程」的说法。
C)
偷换概念
By enhancing students' ability to think in a critical way 把方法说成「增强批判性思维」，但原文里 the most important 21st-century skills aren't related to specific technologies or subject matter, but to creativity 列出的是 creativity、imagination、problem-solving，并没有 critical thinking 这一项。
D)
过度推断
By showing students the best way to learn is through play 说告诉学生学习的最佳方式是玩，原文虽然反复肯定 play 的价值 Play may be the answer，但用 may 表推测，且没有把 play 表述为 the best way to learn，属于对原文力度的放大。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: How do children acquire the skills needed for the 21st century?

options.text: By engaging in activities involving specific technologies.
By playing with things to solve problems on their own.
By familiarizing themselves with high-tech gadgets.
By mastering basic principles through teamwork.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 How do children acquire the skills needed for the 21st century 是 How + 一般疑问，问获得方式，定位 → 同义替换即可，不需要主旨级归纳。
【拆句】How do children acquire the skills needed for the 21st century：主干 children acquire the skills，needed for the 21st century 是过去分词后置定语修饰 skills，等价于the skills which are needed for the 21st century。
【定位】These are skills acquired when kids tinker.
这些（21 世纪所需的）能力，正是孩子们在鼓捣小玩意时获得的。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
By engaging in activities involving specific technologies 说通过涉及具体技术的活动来获得能力，但 the most important 21st-century skills aren't related to specific technologies or subject matter, but to creativity 明确说不是关联于 specific technologies，选项与原文方向相反。
B)
✓ 正确
These are skills acquired when kids tinker ↔ By playing with things to solve problems on their own
预判核心「自己动手 + 鼓捣 / 玩耍」在 By playing with things to solve problems on their own 中以 playing with things + on their own 完整复现，并把要获得的能力具体化为 solve problems，与同段的 problem-solving 完全一致。
C)
与原文相反
By familiarizing themselves with high-tech gadgets 说让孩子熟悉高科技装置，但 it doesn't take 21st-century technology to foster 21st-century skills 明确说培养这些技能并不需要 21 世纪的高科技。
D)
张冠李戴
By mastering basic principles through teamwork 把方式说成「通过团队合作掌握基本原理」，原文同段列出的能力清单 skills like imagination, problem-finding and problem-solving, teamwork, optimism, patience and the ability to experiment and take risks 里虽然出现 teamwork，但 teamwork 是要获得的能力之一，不是获得能力的途径，且 basic principles 出现在第四段说的是数学几何，与 21 世纪技能不是同一回事。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What can we do to help children learn the basics of math and geometry?

options.text: Stimulate their interest as early as possible.
Spend more time playing games with them.
Encourage them to make things with hands.
Allow them to tinker freely with calculators.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What can we do to help children learn the basics of math and geometry 问的是建议性做法，回原文找一句明确的做法陈述即可，属于方法型细节题。
【拆句】What can we do to help children learn the basics of math and geometry：主干 we do what，to help 是目的状语，help children learn 是 help sb. do 结构，learn the basics of math and geometry 是 help 的宾补，无难点。
【定位】This type of play—especially with building blocks—helps children discover and develop key principles in math and geometry.
这种游戏——尤其是搭积木——能帮助孩子发现并掌握数学和几何中的关键原理。
【选项】A)
无中生有
Stimulate their interest as early as possible 说要尽早激发兴趣，原文虽提到 four-and five-year-olds Research shows that given 15 minutes of free play, four- and five-year-olds will spend a third of this time engaged in spatial, mathematical, and architectural activities，但并没有提出「激发兴趣」这一做法，更没有「越早越好」的表态。
B)
偷换概念
Spend more time playing games with them 说大人花更多时间陪孩子玩游戏，原文的关键是「孩子自己搭建」 This type of play—especially with building blocks— helps children discover and develop key principles in math and geometry，并未要求大人陪玩，更没说 more time 这一程度。
C)
✓ 正确
This type of play—especially with building blocks—helps children discover and develop key principles in math and geometry ↔Encourage them to make things with hands
预判核心「动手 + 搭建/制作」，Encourage them to make things with hands 同时命中 make（建造/制作）与 with hands（动手），无新增信息，是 building blocks 的合理上位概括。
D)
与原文相反
Allow them to tinker freely with calculators 把鼓捣的对象换成计算器，原文却强调building blocks 这类纯动手物件；且 it doesn't take 21st-century technology to foster 21st-century skills 已经否定了高科技工具的必要性，calculators 属于反向。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author advise disadvantaged schools and communities to do?

options.text: Train students to be makers to meet future market demands.
Develop students' creative skills with the resources available.
Engage students with challenging tasks to foster their creativity.
Work together with companies to improve their teaching facilities.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author advise disadvantaged schools and communities to do 是定向问作者建议，需要找一句明确针对弱势学校的建议句，是定位型细节题，不需要全篇归纳。
【拆句】What does the author advise disadvantaged schools and communities to do：主干the author advise sb. to do sth.，advise sb. to do 是固定搭配，disadvantaged ... communities 整体作 advise 的宾语，结构清晰。
【定位】This is especially important for under-resourced schools and communities. Taking whatever materials are handy and tinkering with them is a simple way to engage those important "maker" skills.
这一点对于资源匮乏的学校和社区尤为重要。拿手边任何能找到的材料动手鼓捣，就是激发这些重要「制造者」能力的一种简单办法。
【选项】A)
无中生有
Train students to be makers to meet future market demands 把目的设为「满足未来市场需求」，原文里反复说的是培养 maker / creator 等能力 Children are born builders, makers, and creators，从未出现 market demands 这类商业目的。
B)
✓ 正确
Taking whatever materials are handy and tinkering with them is a simple way to engage those important "maker" skills ↔Develop students' creative skills with the resources available
it doesn't take 21st-century technology to foster 21st-century skills ↔ Develop students' creative skills with the resources available
预判的「现有/手边资源 + 创造性能力」，Develop students' creative skills with the resources available 同时命中 with the resources available（现有资源）与 creative skills（创造性能力），两项语义点齐全且力度匹配。
C)
与原文相反
Engage students with challenging tasks to foster their creativity 说让学生做有挑战性的任务，原文却强调 fostering 21st-century skills may be as simple as giving kids room to play, tinker and try things out，用的是 as simple as，方向是「越简单越好」。
D)
张冠李戴
Work together with companies to improve their teaching facilities 说与公司合作改善教学设施，原文虽然在首段提到 Educators and business leaders have more in common than it may seem，但末段给资源匮乏地区的建议只是用手边材料鼓捣，从未提到「与公司合作改善设施」。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say about working in IT?

options.text: It is envied by many.
It does not appeal to him.
It is financially rewarding.
It does not match his abilities.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say about working in IT? 用 what 引导，问作者对某一具体对象的明确表态，属于带主观色彩的细节题，而不是 infer/imply。
【拆句】题干是简单疑问句，主干为 What does the author say about working in IT?，about 引出话题，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Being an information technology, or IT, worker is not a job I envy.
成为一名信息技术（即 IT）工作者，不是一份我会羡慕的工作。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
It is envied by many. 把作者 not a job I envy 的态度改成"很多人羡慕"，方向完全相反，且原文也没说"很多人羡慕"。
B)
✓ 正确
not a job I envy ↔does not appeal to him
预判"作者不羡慕 IT 工作"与 It does not appeal to him. 同义；其余选项与作者表态相反或与文意无关。
C)
无中生有
It is financially rewarding. 称 IT 工作"经济回报丰厚"，但全文从未谈及薪资或金钱收益，纯属编造。
D)
偷换概念
It does not match his abilities. 说 IT 工作"与他的能力不匹配"，原文只说作者不羡慕、并描述 IT 工作辛苦，从未涉及作者本人的能力是否够格。
最近一项针对工作依赖IT支持的员工的调查有何发现?
A) IT有助于提高生产力。
B) IT有助于改善质量控制。
C) 许多员工对IT深感沮丧。
D) 大多数员工在工作中严重依赖IT。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What is the finding of a recent survey on employees who have a job reliant on IT support?

options.text: IT helps boost productivity.
IT helps improve quality control.
Many employees are deeply frustrated by IT.
Most employees rely heavily on IT in their work.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What is the finding of a recent survey 直接问一项调查的发现，是对原文具体信息的复述，属于细节题。
【拆句】主干 What is the finding of a recent survey on employees，on 引出调查对象、who 从句进一步限定。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】According to a recent survey, employees who have a job reliant on IT support consider IT a major source of job dissatisfaction.
根据一项最新调查，工作依赖 IT 支持的员工把 IT 视为工作不满的主要来源。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
IT helps boost productivity. 说 IT 提升生产力，与原文 their productivity deteriorating（生产力下降）完全相反。
B)
与原文相反
IT helps improve quality control. 说 IT 改善质量控制，但原文是 quality control non-existent，质控"不复存在"，方向反转。
C)
✓ 正确
consider IT a major source of job dissatisfaction ↔ Many employees are deeply frustrated by IT
预判"员工对 IT 极度不满"与 Many employees are deeply frustrated by IT. 完全吻合；其他三项要么把 IT 说成正面作用，要么扯到使用频率，均偏离结论。
D)
答非所问
Most employees rely heavily on IT in their work. 说"大多数员工严重依赖 IT"，但题干问的是调查的 finding，而原文 finding 是"员工不满"，不是"员工依赖"；"依赖"只是调查对象的限定条件，不是调查结论。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What is said to happen when IT is functioning properly?

options.text: There is a big boost in employees' work efficiency.
Employees become more dependent on machines.
There are no longer any boring or repetitive tasks.
Employees become more confident in their work.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What is said to happen when IT is functioning properly? 问在某条件下会发生什么具体结果，是原文已有陈述的复述题，属细节题。
【拆句】题干主干 What is said to happen，when 从句修饰 happen，is said 是被动语态，弱化作者主观色彩，照常按客观细节处理。
【定位】When IT is operating as it should, employee self-confidence swells.
当 IT 像它本应那样运转时，员工的自信心便会膨胀。
【选项】A)
过度推断
There is a big boost in employees' work efficiency. 把答案换成"工作效率大幅提升"，原文只说自信和工作满意度上升，并未在 IT 正常运转时给出"效率大幅提升"的结论；"a big boost"也属于原文未表达的程度夸大。
B)
偷换概念
Employees become more dependent on machines. 说员工"更依赖机器"，原文谈的是 IT 正常时员工"自信增强"，未涉及依赖加深；"依赖加深"通常是负面评价，与本段 IT正常时的正向描述也不符。
C)
过度推断
原文 well-functioning machines relieve them of dull tasks or repetitive processes说机器"减轻"枯燥重复任务，There are no longer any boring or repetitive tasks. 却说"不再有任何"重复任务，把"缓解"夸大为"彻底消除"。
D)
✓ 正确
employee self-confidence swells ↔Employees become more confident in their work
预判"员工自信增强"与 Employees become more confident in their work. 几乎逐字同义；其余选项不是过度推断就是与原文相反。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What should business leaders do before implementing new IT initiatives?

options.text: Consider the various expectations of their customers.
Draw up a list of the efficiencies to be promised.
Assess the swollen cost of training the employees.
Think about the possible effects on their employees.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What should business leaders do before implementing new IT initiatives? 问"应当做什么"，对应原文里直接给出建议/批评的句子，是细节题。
【拆句】主干 What should business leaders do，before 引导时间状语 before implementing new IT initiatives，implementing 是动名词作介词宾语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Which is why managers should appreciate just how influential the IT user experience is to their employees, and exert substantial effort in ensuring their IT team eliminates programming errors and application crashes.
正因如此，管理者应当意识到 IT 用户体验对员工有多大影响，并下大力气确保 IT 团队消除程序错误与应用崩溃。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
Consider the various expectations of their customers. 把考虑对象从员工换成"客户"，但全文从未谈及 customers，关注点始终是 employees/end user。
B)
与原文相反
Draw up a list of the efficiencies to be promised. 把"承诺的效率"列成清单，原文恰恰批评 a long list of promised efficiencies has been reversed，即"承诺过的效率被打回原形"，是失败之处而非应做之事。
C)
无中生有
Assess the swollen cost of training the employees. 借用 swollen expectations have been popped 中的 swollen 拼出"激增的培训成本"，但原文 swollen 形容的是expectations（被吹胀的预期），从未提培训成本。
D)
✓ 正确
with little consideration of how those changes will impact the end user ↔ Think about the possible effects on their employees
managers should appreciate just how influential the IT user experience is to their employees ↔ Think about the possible effects on their employees
预判"先考虑对员工的影响"和 Think about the possible effects on their employees.高度吻合；A/B/C 要么换错对象，要么偏离核心动作。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: How can a business help improve its employees' experience in using IT?

options.text: By designing systems that suit their needs.
By ensuring that their mental health is sound.
By adjusting their work to suit the IT system.
By offering them regular in-service training.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】How can a business help improve its employees' experience in using IT? 问公司具体如何改善，对应原文给出的具体做法句，属细节题。
【拆句】主干 How can a business help improve its employees' experience，in using IT 是后置介词短语修饰 experience。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Therefore, businesses need to set up their IT infrastructure so that it is designed to fit in with their employees' work, rather than adjust their work to fit in with the company's IT limitations.
因此，企业需要这样搭建其 IT 基础设施：使其设计去适配员工的工作，而不是让员工调整工作去迁就公司的 IT 局限。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
set up their IT infrastructure so that it is designed to fit in with their employees' work ↔ By designing systems that suit their needs
预判"IT 去适配员工"严丝合缝对应 By designing systems that suit their needs.；B/C/D 要么扯心理健康、要么取了 rather than 后的反向做法、要么属于无中生有的培训。
B)
偷换概念
By ensuring that their mental health is sound. 借用 what employees experience mentally when they use IT 里的 mentally 拼出"确保心理健康"，但原文是"理解员工使用 IT 时的心理体验"，不是"维护员工心理健康"，且这一点也不是末段给出的总对策。
C)
与原文相反
By adjusting their work to suit the IT system. 把 rather than 后的反面做法 adjust their work to fit in with the company's IT limitations 当成对策，方向完全反转。
D)
无中生有
By offering them regular in-service training. 提到"定期在职培训"，全文从未谈及培训这件事，纯属新概念。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What did the old age pensioner plan to do?

options.text: See the Pope.
Go to Newcastle.
Travel to Germany.
Tour an Italian city.

explanation:
【题目】What did the old age pensioner plan to do?
【翻译】这位领取养老金的老人计划做什么?
A) 见教皇。
B) 去纽卡斯尔。
C) 去德国旅行。
D) 游览一座意大利城市。
【答案】A （细节题）See the Pope.
【定位】The old age pensioner was on a mission to see the Pope, who is head of the Catholic Church, and decided to make his way there by car.
这位领养老金的老人肩负着去见教皇（天主教会的领袖）的使命，并决定开车前往那里。
【信号】表目的的 on a mission to + decided to。答案信号是表 "目的 / 决意" 的措辞：on a mission to see the Pope（肩负见教皇的使命）和 decided to make his way there（决定前往）。听力里 "on a mission to / decided to / plan to" 后面跟的就是主人公的目标，一听到就锁定，这正是 plan 类题的落点。
【替换】on a mission to see the Pope ↔See the Pope.
去修饰语后核心动作不变

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音里 trying to get from Newcastle 确实念到了 Newcastle，但那是他的 "出发地"，不是要 "go to" 的目的地。选项 Go to Newcastle. 盗用这个原词，把起点说成终点，听到Newcastle 就选必中招。
借用原文：trying to get from Newcastle, Great Britain, to Rome, Italy
C)
答非所问
Germany 是他 "误打误撞最后到达" 的地方（ended up in Germany by accident），并非他 "打算" 去的地方。选项 Travel to Germany. 把 "意外结果" 安到 "计划" 头上，正是本题问 plan 时最阴的干扰。
借用原文：ended up in Germany by accident
D)
偷换概念
罗马（Italian city）虽是他的真正目的地，但 Tour an Italian city. 把目的说成 "游览一座意大利城市"，与录音 on a mission to see the Pope（去见教皇）这一明确目的不符——他不是去观光，是去见教皇。选项借意大利城市这层背景来诱选。
借用原文：on a mission to see the Pope
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What finally happened to the old man?

options.text: He was taken to hospital in an ambulance.
His car hit a sign and was badly damaged.
His GPS system went out of order.
He ended up in the wrong place.

explanation:
【题目】What finally happened to the old man?
【翻译】这位老人最后怎么样了?
A) 他被救护车送往医院。
B) 他的车撞到了标志牌,严重损坏。
C) 他的GPS系统出现故障。
D) 他最终到了错误的地方。
【答案】D （细节题）He ended up in the wrong place.
【定位】An 81-year-old man ended up in Germany by accident after trying to get from Newcastle, Great Britain, to Rome, Italy.
一位 81 岁的老人在试图从英国纽卡斯尔前往意大利罗马的途中，意外地落到了德国。
【信号】结果词 ended up + by accident。答案信号是表 "最终结果" 的措辞 ended up in Germany by accident：ended up（最终落到…）+ by accident（出于意外）直接点出"跑错了地方" 这个结局。问 finally happened 的题，就抓 ended up / finally / in the end这类收束词。
【替换】ended up in Germany by accident ↔He ended up in the wrong place.
具体地名概括成 wrong place

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音 an ambulance was called to check on the pensioner 是 "叫了救护车来查看"，并没说把他送进医院。选项 He was taken to hospital in an ambulance. 盗用 ambulance这个原词，再加码成 "被送往医院"，听到 ambulance 就选必错。
借用原文：an ambulance was called to check on the pensioner
B)
与原文相反
车确实 hit a sign（撞了路牌），但录音明说 did not appear to be seriously damaged（看起来没严重损坏）。选项 His car hit a sign and was badly damaged. 前半句盗用原词为真、后半 badly damaged 与原文相反，是典型 "半真半假" 陷阱。
借用原文：did not appear to be seriously damaged
C)
张冠李戴
录音里 GPS 一直正常工作（his GPS system told him he had arrived），错的是老人把目的地 "Rom" 输错了，不是 GPS 坏了。选项 His GPS system went out of order. 盗用 GPS这个高频原词，硬安一个 "故障" 给它，把人为输错说成机器失灵。
借用原文：his GPS system told him he had arrived
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the news report?

options.text: Scotland will reach the national target in carbon emissions reduction ahead of schedule.
Glasgow City Council has made a deal with ScottishPower on carbon emissions.
Glasgow has pledged to take the lead in reducing carbon emissions in the UK.
First Minister Nicola Sturgeon urged ScottishPower to reduce carbon emissions.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the news report?
【翻译】我们从新闻报道中了解到什么?
A) 苏格兰将提前完成碳排放减排的国家目标。
B) Glasgow市议会已与ScottishPower就碳排放达成协议。
C) Glasgow承诺在英国率先减少碳排放。
D) 首席大臣Nicola Sturgeon敦促ScottishPower减少碳排放。
【答案】C （主旨题）Glasgow has pledged to take the lead in reducing carbon emissions in the UK.
【定位】Glasgow has pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK.
格拉斯哥已承诺要成为英国第一个碳中和城市。
【信号】新闻首句即点题。信号是「新闻第一句」：英文短消息几乎都把最重要的事放在开头第一句。Glasgow has pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK. 正是全篇核心事件，主旨题答案就藏在这句里。
【替换】pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK ↔ pledged to take the lead in reducing carbon emissions in the UK
「第一个碳中和」=「带头减排」
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 盗用了录音 the new national target of 2045 里的 national target 一词，编出「苏格兰将提前达成全国减排目标」。但录音只说格拉斯哥要「赶在 2045 全国目标之前（ahead of）」实现零碳，是这一座城市立下承诺，并非「苏格兰整体将提前达标」，属听到 target就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：the new national target of 2045
B)
答非所问
B 盗用了录音多次出现的 ScottishPower 和 Glasgow City Council，说成「市议会与ScottishPower 就碳排放达成一桩交易」。录音里二者确有合作（announced a range of strategies），但新闻主旨是「格拉斯哥承诺成为英国首个零碳城市」这件大事，B 把主旨缩成一个次要的「达成 deal」细节，以偏概全。
借用原文：The city's council and ScottishPower have announced a range of strategies
D)
张冠李戴
D 盗用了录音里的 First Minister Nicola Sturgeon 和 ScottishPower 两个专名，编成「Sturgeon 敦促 ScottishPower 减排」。但录音里 Sturgeon 是 welcomed the pledge（对承诺表示欢迎），并没有「敦促」ScottishPower，方向与事实都不符，是把人名拼凑成假信息的张冠李戴。
借用原文：First Minister Nicola Sturgeon welcomed the pledge
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did ScottishPower's chief executive say ahead of the All Energy Conference?

options.text: Glasgow needs to invest in new technologies to reach its goal.
Glasgow is going to explore new sources of renewable energy.
Stricter regulation is needed in transforming Glasgow's economy.
It's necessary to create more low-emission zones as soon as possible.

explanation:
【题目】What did ScottishPower's chief executive say ahead of the All Energy Conference?
【翻译】ScottishPower的首席执行官在All Energy Conference之前说了什么?
A) Glasgow需要投资新技术才能实现其目标。
B) Glasgow将探索可再生能源的新来源。
C) 在转变Glasgow经济方面需要更严格的监管。
D) 有必要尽快建立更多低排放区。
【答案】A （细节题）Glasgow needs to invest in new technologies to reach its goal.
【定位】Now, we need to invest in the technologies and programmes that transform the rest of Glasgow's economy and make us net zero before anyone else.
现在，我们需要投资于那些能够改造格拉斯哥其余经济、让我们比任何人都更早实现净零排放的技术与项目。
【信号】主张句 we need to… 是落点。信号是说话人亲口的主张句 we need to invest in the technologies and programmes：题问「他说了什么」，答案就在他原话里 we need to（我们需要）这个表态结构后面，这是观点的直接落点。
【替换】we need to invest in the technologies and programmes ↔ Glasgow needs to invest in new technologies to reach its goal
「投资于技术」原意保留，仅换措辞
make us net zero before anyone else ↔to reach its goal
「率先实现净零」概括成「达成目标」
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 盗用了录音 a large supply of renewable energy 里的 renewable energy。但说话人说的是「我们已经拥有大量可再生能源」，是现状陈述，并非主张「去探索新的可再生能源来源（explore new sources）」。听到 renewable energy 就选 B 正中圈套。
借用原文：We have a large supply of renewable energy on our doorstep
C)
未提及
C 说「改造格拉斯哥经济需要更严格的监管（Stricter regulation）」。录音里说话人主张的是 invest in the technologies and programmes（投资技术与项目），从头到尾没提regulation 或加强监管，C 属录音根本没说的内容。
D)
原词陷阱
D 盗用了录音 one of the only two low emission zones in action 里的 low emission zones。但说话人是把「已经在运行的低排放区」当作格拉斯哥的现有优势来陈述，并没有主张「有必要尽快多建低排放区（create more … as soon as possible）」，是把现状包装成主张的陷阱。
借用原文：one of the only two low emission zones in action across the UK

1 A Japanese IT firm has officially introduced an "office cat" policy to combat the stressful environment of the workplace.
一家日本IT公司正式推出了"办公室猫"政策,以应对压力重重的工作环境。
2 A total of nine furry friends freely wander around in the office and do whatever their little hearts desire.
共有九只毛茸茸的朋友在办公室里自由走动,做着它们内心想做的任何事情。
3 Hidenobu Fukuda, who heads the firm, introduced the pet policy, upon request from one of his employees, allowing staff to bring their own cats to work.
公司负责人Hidenobu Fukuda应一位员工的要求推出了这项宠物政策,允许员工将自己的猫带到工作场所。
4 Employee Eri Ito is grateful for their animals' comforting ways. "Cats are sleeping just beside us. It's healing." she said. Not only does Fukuda encourage bringing cats to the job, but he also encourages his employees to rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets. He gives 5,000 yen, about 45 US dollars a month to those who rescue a cat.
员工Eri Ito对这些动物带来的慰藉心怀感激。她说:"猫就睡在我们身边,这很治愈。"Fukuda不仅鼓励员工带猫上班,还鼓励员工从过度拥挤的收容所或街头救助猫。他每月向救助猫的员工提供5000日元,约合45美元。
5 While the positives are many, there are still some obstacles. "Sometimes a cat will walk on a phone and cut off the call, or they shut down the computers by walking onto the off switch," Ito says.
虽然好处很多,但仍存在一些障碍。Ito说:"有时猫会走到电话上挂断通话,或者它们走到关机开关上把电脑关掉。"
6 Still, cats in the workplace have been a tremendous success for the company. The policy has led to various other companies doing the same.
尽管如此,办公室里的猫对公司来说仍是一项巨大的成功。这项政策促使其他多家公司也采取了同样的做法。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the news report about the Japanese IT firm?

options.text: It donates money to overpopulated animal shelters.
It permits employees to bring cats into their office.
It gives 5,000 yen to employees who keep pet cats.
It allows workers to do whatever their hearts desire.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the news report about the Japanese IT firm?
【翻译】从新闻报道中我们了解到这家日本IT公司的什么情况?
A) 它向动物数量过多的收容所捐款。
B) 它允许员工把猫带到办公室。
C) 它给养宠物猫的员工发放5000日元。
D) 它允许员工做任何他们心里想做的事。
【答案】B （细节题）It permits employees to bring cats into their office.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does Fukuda encourage his employees to do?

options.text: Keep cats off the street.
Rescue homeless cats.
Volunteer to help in animal shelters.
Contribute to a fund for cat protection.

explanation:
【题目】What does Fukuda encourage his employees to do?
【翻译】Fukuda鼓励他的员工做什么?
A) 让猫远离街道。
B) 救助流浪猫。
C) 自愿到动物收容所帮忙。
D) 向猫保护基金捐款。
【答案】B （细节题）Rescue homeless cats.

【定位】Not only does Fukuda encourage bringing cats to the job, but he also encourages his employees to rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets.
福田不仅鼓励员工把猫带来上班，还鼓励他们去救助来自爆满的收容所或街上的流浪猫。
【信号】encourages领起的鼓励句。题干问 encourage 什么，原文里正好两次出现 encourage，answer 落在 he also encourages his employees to 后面跟的动词 rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets，听到"encourages…to rescue"即可锁定。
【替换】rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets ↔Rescue homeless cats
from shelters or streets≈homeless
【排除】A)
与原文相反
原文说的是把街上的猫"救回来（rescue from streets）"，本项 Keep cats off the street.借用了"街"这个意象，却说成"让猫别上街"，动作方向正好相反。
借用原文：rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets
C)
原词陷阱
本项 Volunteer to help in animal shelters. 盗用了原文出现的 shelters，但原文只说"从收容所救猫"，从没说鼓励员工"去收容所做义工"。听到 shelters 就选 C，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets
D)
偷换概念
原文是"公司给救猫的员工 5,000 日元"，钱是公司发出去的；本项 Contribute to a fund for cat protection. 却说成"员工往护猫基金捐钱"，把给钱方向倒置，且"基金"原文从未出现。
借用原文：He gives 5,000 yen, about 45 US dollars a month to those who rescue a cat
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the news report say about the firm's policy?

options.text: It has contributed tremendously to the firm's fame.
It has helped a lot to improve animals' well-being.
It has led some other companies to follow suit.
It has resulted in damage to office equipment.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say about the firm's policy?
【翻译】新闻报道对该公司政策有何评价?
A) 它极大地提升了公司的知名度。
B) 它对改善动物福祉帮助很大。
C) 它促使其他一些公司效仿。
D) 它导致了办公设备的损坏。
【答案】C （细节题）It has led some other companies to follow suit.
【定位】Still, cats in the workplace have been a tremendous success for the company. The policy has led to various other companies doing the same.
尽管如此，办公室养猫对这家公司而言已是巨大的成功。这项政策还促使其他多家公司纷纷效仿。

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D).Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【信号】结尾Still转折后的总评。末段以 Still 转折，把前一段的"小麻烦"翻过去，落到对政策的总评"a tremendous success"，紧接 The policy has led to various other companies doing the same 是结果句——新闻结尾的转折+收束，正是答案所在。
【替换】The policy has led to various other companies doing the same ↔ It has led some other companies to follow suit
doing the same≈follow suit
【排除】A)
过度推断
原文只说政策是 a tremendous success（巨大成功），并未说提升了公司"名气"。本项 It has contributed tremendously to the firm's fame. 盗用了 tremendous 这个词，把"成功"擅自推成"出名"，属听到 tremendous 就想选的原词陷阱叠加过度推断。
借用原文：cats in the workplace have been a tremendous success for the company
B)
未提及
本项 It has helped a lot to improve animals' well-being. 听着与"救助流浪猫"沾边，但新闻评价政策结果时讲的是"对公司的成功"和"被别家效仿"，并没有评价它"改善了动物福祉"，这句结论原文未提。
D)
原词陷阱
原文确有猫踩电话、踩关机键的内容，但那被归为 some obstacles（一些小障碍），且被末段 Still 转折掉，并非对政策的总体评价。本项 It has resulted in damage to office equipment. 盗用了"电脑/电话"这段细节冒充总评，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：they shut down the computers by walking onto the off switch
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man want to do?

options.text: Find out where Jimmy is.
Borrow money from Jimmy.
Make friends with Jimmy.
Ask Jimmy what is to be done.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man want to do?
【翻译】这位男士想做什么?
A) 找出Jimmy在哪里。
B) 向Jimmy借钱。
C) 和Jimmy交朋友。
D) 问Jimmy该做什么。
【答案】A （细节题）Find out where Jimmy is.
【定位】But I need to see him, because my friends and I lent him some money last month. We haven't heard from him since. I heard he comes here a lot, so I thought I'd come in and check with you.
可我得见到他，因为上个月我和朋友们借给了他一些钱，之后就一直没他的消息。我听说他常来这儿，所以想着进来跟你打听一下。

【信号】I need to see him 直陈来意。答案信号是男士直接道出目的的句子 I need to see him，加上 I thought I'd come in and check with you——"来打听、确认他的下落"。这是说话人主动交代意图的应答，听到 need to / I thought I'd 就该锁定。
【替换】I thought I'd come in and check with you ↔Find out where Jimmy is.
check with you=find out where
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音里钱是男士他们"借给"Jimmy（lent him some money），不是向 Jimmy 借。选项Borrow money from Jimmy. 盗用了"money"和借钱情节，却把方向倒过来，答非所问。
借用原文：lent him some money
C)
未提及
男士只想找到 Jimmy 把欠款的事说清，全程没有"和 Jimmy 交朋友"之意；Make friends with Jimmy. 是凭空添加的。
D)
偷换概念
男士是来"打听 Jimmy 在哪"，不是要"问 Jimmy 该怎么处理"；Ask Jimmy what is to be done. 借用了"找 Jimmy、解决问题"的氛围，却把"找到他"偷换成"向他请教对策"。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the man who came to see the woman yesterday?

options.text: He was unsure what kind of fellow Jimmy was.
He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
He wanted to make a sincere apology to Jimmy.
He wanted to invite her to join in a study project.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the man who came to see the woman yesterday?
【翻译】关于昨天来看这位女士的男士,我们了解到什么?
A) 他不确定Jimmy是什么样的人。
B) 他正在和Jimmy一起做一个研究项目。
C) 他想向Jimmy真诚地道歉。
D) 他想邀请她加入一个研究项目。
【答案】B （细节题）He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
【定位】Some other fellow came in asking for Jimmy just yesterday, a real nervous, pushy type of fellow, saying he needed Jimmy for some study project they were working on.
就在昨天，另有一个家伙进来打听 Jimmy，一个特别紧张、咄咄逼人的家伙，说他需要Jimmy 一起做他们正在搞的一个学习项目。
【信号】some other fellow 引入新角色。答案信号是引入新人物的标志句 Some other fellow came in asking for Jimmy just yesterday，紧接着 saying he needed Jimmy for some study project they were working on 就是对他的正面交代。听到"another/some other fellow"就知道题目问的人来了。
【替换】he needed Jimmy for some study project they were working on ↔ He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
几乎直述，仅换说法

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
对 Jimmy 是个什么人拿不准的是男士本人（后文 I did think it was a bit weird），不是昨天来的那个人；He was unsure what kind of fellow Jimmy was. 把感受安错了人头。
借用原文：a real nervous, pushy type of fellow
C)
原词陷阱
"道歉"出现在女士对 Jimmy 撞车一事的猜测里（if you still wanted to give money as some sort of apology），与昨天来的这个人无关；He wanted to make a sincere apology to Jimmy. 盗用了 apology 一词错接到他身上。
借用原文：some sort of apology
D)
偷换概念
录音说他需要 Jimmy 来做项目（he needed Jimmy for some study project），不是邀请女士加入；He wanted to invite her to join in a study project. 借用 study project 却把对象从 Jimmy 偷换成 her。
借用原文：he needed Jimmy for some study project
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页

stem: What did Jimmy say happened to him one day?

options.text: He got a ticket for speeding.
He got his car badly damaged.
He was involved in a traffic accident.
He had an operation for his injury.

explanation:
【题目】What did Jimmy say happened to him one day?
【翻译】Jimmy说有一天他发生了什么事?
A) 他因超速而被开罚单。
B) 他的车严重损坏了。
C) 他卷入了一起交通事故。
D) 他因受伤做了手术。
【答案】C （细节题）He was involved in a traffic accident.
【定位】He told us he'd got into an accident. Nothing serious, mind you, but he damaged someone's car and wanted to get some money together to make up for the damage he'd caused.
他跟我们说他出了一场事故。不严重，注意啊，但他撞坏了别人的车，想凑点钱来赔偿他造成的损失。
【信号】He told us he'd got into an accident 转述。答案信号是男士转述 Jimmy 原话的句子He told us he'd got into an accident——"told us"标明这是 Jimmy 说自己遇到的事，正对题干"Jimmy say happened to him"。听到"He told us…"就锁定。
【替换】he'd got into an accident ↔He was involved in a traffic accident.
got into=be involved in

【排除】A)
未提及
Jimmy 只说出了事故、撞坏别人车，从没提"超速被开罚单"；He got a ticket for speeding. 是凭空添加的情节。
B)
原词陷阱
录音是 he damaged someone's car，撞坏的是"别人的车"；He got his car badly damaged. 盗用 damaged/car，却把"别人的车"偷换成"他自己的车"，所属关系反了。
借用原文：he damaged someone's car
D)
过度推断
录音明说 Nothing serious，受伤动手术更无从谈起；He had an operation for his injury.借"accident"联想到受伤手术，属过度推断。
