source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why did Jimmy borrow money according to the man?

options.text: He needed to make some donations to charity.
He found the 60 pounds in his pocket missing.
He wanted to buy a gift for his mother's birthday.
He wanted to conceal something from his parents.

explanation:
【题目】Why did Jimmy borrow money according to the man?
【翻译】根据这位男士所说,Jimmy为什么借钱?
A) 他需要向慈善机构捐款。
B) 他发现口袋里的60英镑不见了。
C) 他想为母亲的生日买一份礼物。
D) 他想向父母隐瞒某事。
【答案】D （细节题）He wanted to conceal something from his parents.
【定位】But I thought maybe he doesn't want his parents to know about what happened. So he'd rather come to us and keep things quiet.
但我当时想，也许他是不想让父母知道这件事，所以他宁愿来找我们，把事情悄悄了结。
【信号】But I thought…So… 男士给出原因。答案信号是转折 But 之后男士自己的推断 But I thought maybe he doesn't want his parents to know about what happened，加因果So。题干限定 according to the man，而这正是男士（the man）给出的原因，转折+因果信号双重锁定。
【替换】he doesn't want his parents to know about what happened ↔ He wanted to conceal something from his parents.
not want parents to know=conceal from parents

【排除】A)
未提及
全程没有"捐款给慈善"之说；He needed to make some donations to charity. 是凭空添加。
B)
原词陷阱
录音里 just 60 pounds between the three of us 说的是三人借出的总额，不是 Jimmy"口袋里丢了 60 镑"；He found the 60 pounds in his pocket missing. 盗用数字 60 pounds编造"丢钱"情节。
借用原文：just 60 pounds between the three of us
C)
未提及
借钱缘由是赔偿撞车、瞒着父母，从无"为母亲生日买礼物"；He wanted to buy a gift for his mother's birthday. 凭空捏造。

stem: What did the woman want to ask Max about?

options.text: Shopping delivery.
Shopping online.
Where he goes shopping.
How often he does shopping.

explanation:
【题目】What did the woman want to ask Max about?
【翻译】女士想问Max什么事情?
A) 购物配送。
B) 网上购物。
C) 他去哪里购物。
D) 他多久购物一次。
【答案】B （细节题）Shopping online.
【定位】I wanted to ask you about ordering shopping online.
我想问问你关于网上下单购物的事。
【信号】开场"I wanted to ask you about…"直接点题。女方开口的 I wanted to ask you about ordering shopping online 用 "I wanted to ask you about…" 这一典型的挑明话题句式，直接交代了她来请教的事，是开场点题信号。
【替换】ordering shopping online ↔Shopping online
ordering shopping online压缩为Shopping online
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
下文 I love getting my shopping delivered 反复出现 "送货" 一词，Shopping delivery正是盗这个原词。但女方开口请教的话题是 "网购"（online），送货只是网购的一个环节、是男方后面才展开的内容，并非她问的主题，答非所问。
借用原文：I love getting my shopping delivered
C)
答非所问
录音结尾女方才问 which supermarket do you think is the best to order from（去哪家订），Where he goes shopping 像是套这处 "where/哪家"，但那是对话末尾她自己抛出的新问题，而非她一开始来请教的主题；且问的是 "哪家超市" 不是 "他在哪买"，方向也偏。
借用原文：which supermarket do you think is the best to order from
D)
未提及
How often he does shopping 问购物频率，但全篇没有任何关于 "多久买一次" 的内容，是利用选项里 shopping 一词凑出的无中生有项。

stem: What does the man think is a problem with shopping in supermarkets?

options.text: Searching in the aisles.
Dealing with the traffic.
Driving too long a distance.
Getting one's car parked.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man think is a problem with shopping in supermarkets?
【翻译】男士认为在超市购物有什么问题?
A) 在过道里寻找商品。
B) 应对交通状况。
C) 开车距离太远。
D) 停车。
【答案】D （细节题）Getting one's car parked.
【定位】It makes life so much simpler—no carrying heavy shopping bags in the rain, or trying to park the car on those huge supermarket car parks then not being able to find it again after you come out of the shops.
（送货上门）让生活简单多了——不用在雨里拎沉甸甸的购物袋，也不用费劲把车停进超市那些巨大的停车场、逛完店出来又找不到车。
【信号】他用"再也不用……"反衬出实体购物的麻烦。男方夸网购好时，用一串 "no…"、"trying to… then not being able to…" 反衬实体购物的烦恼，其中 trying to park the car on those huge supermarket car parks then not being able to find it again 把 "停车难、停完找不到车" 当成最具体的一桩麻烦点出，这处对比式抱怨就是答案信号。
【替换】trying to park the car on those huge supermarket car parks then not being able to find it again ↔ Getting one's car parked
把停车找车的长句概括为Getting one's car parked
【排除】A)
未提及
Searching in the aisles（在超市货架通道里找东西）是实体购物常见的麻烦联想，但录音里男方只抱怨了拎袋子和停车，从没提过 "在货架间找东西"，属凭常识补出来的未提及项。
B)
偷换概念
录音出现 park the car on those huge supermarket car parks，满是 car、car parks 等开车相关词，Dealing with the traffic 借这股 "开车" 气味把麻烦偷换成 "应付交通/堵车"，可录音说的是 "停车找不到车"，不是路上交通，概念被换了。
借用原文：trying to park the car on those huge supermarket car parks
C)
张冠李戴
Driving too long a distance（开太远）像是搭后文 I live quite far away from my local supermarket 的 "住得远"，但那是男方在第6段讲网购更省钱时提的省油背景，并非他这里点名的实体购物麻烦；本题问的麻烦是停车，不是开车距离，张冠李戴了。
借用原文：I live quite far away from my local supermarket
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the woman's concern about shopping online?

options.text: The after-sales service.
The replacement policy.
The quality of food products.
The damage to the packaging.

explanation:
【题目】What is the woman's concern about shopping online?
【翻译】女士对网上购物有什么顾虑?
A) 售后服务。
B) 退换政策。
C) 食品的质量。
D) 包装的损坏。
【答案】C （细节题）The quality of food products.
【定位】But there must be some problems. I mean, how do you know that you won't get bad fruit, or that the eggs won't be broken?
但肯定有些问题吧。我是说，你怎么知道不会收到坏掉的水果，或者鸡蛋不会碎呢？
【信号】转折But+反问how do you know引出疑虑。女方用 But there must be some problems的转折先表态有顾虑，再用 how do you know that you won't get bad fruit 的反问点出具体担心，转折 But 加反问句是她抛出 concern 的双重信号。
【替换】bad fruit, or that the eggs won't be broken ↔The quality of food products
坏水果\碎鸡蛋上升为食品质量
【排除】A)
答非所问
The after-sales service（售后服务）像是搭男方后文 they will give you the money back or replace the item 的处理措施，但那是男方解释 "出问题怎么办"，不是女方的担心；况且女方担心的是收到坏东西本身，不是售后，答非所问。
借用原文：they will give you the money back or replace the item
B)
原词陷阱
录音男方说 replace the item（换货），The replacement policy（退换政策）正是盗replace 这个原词。但那是男方的解决办法，不是女方的担心；女方的 concern 是食物质量，不是退换政策，原词陷阱。
借用原文：they will give you the money back or replace the item
D)
偷换概念
女方提到 the eggs won't be broken（鸡蛋别碎），The damage to the packaging（包装破损）借这个 broken 把 "食物本身坏/碎" 偷换成 "外包装破损"。可她担心的是水果坏、蛋碎这种食物质量，不是包装，概念被悄悄换了。
借用原文：the eggs won't be broken
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man find about shopping online?

options.text: It saves money.
It offers more choice.
It increases the joy of shopping.
It is less time-consuming.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man find about shopping online?
【翻译】男士发现网上购物有什么特点?
A) 省钱。
B) 提供更多选择。
C) 增加购物的乐趣。
D) 更省时间。
【答案】A （细节题）It saves money.
【定位】I actually found that it was cheaper for me, as I live quite far away from my local supermarket. So with the deliveries, I'm actually saving on petrol.
我其实发现对我来说（网购）更便宜，因为我住得离本地超市挺远的。所以靠送货上门，我其实省下了油钱。
【信号】I found that+cheaper\saving的结论评价句。男方用 I actually found that it was cheaper for me 直接下结论，又用 I'm actually saving on petrol 点明省的是油钱，"I found that…" 加比较级 cheaper、saving 是给网购下正面结论的答案信号。
【替换】it was cheaper for me ↔It saves money
cheaper等于saves money
I'm actually saving on petrol ↔It saves money
saving on petrol是saves money的具体落点
【排除】B)
未提及
It offers more choice（网购选择更多）是网购公认的好处之一，但录音里男方只讲了省钱、省力、食品一样好，从没提过 "选择多"，属凭常识补的未提及项。
C)
过度推断
男方开头说 I love getting my shopping delivered，It increases the joy of shopping（增加购物乐趣）像是顺着这个 "love" 推出来的，但 "喜欢送货上门" 不等于 "购物变得更快乐"，且本题问的是他 find 的好处，他明确 find 的是省钱，把喜好夸大成乐趣属过度推断。
借用原文：I love getting my shopping delivered
D)
偷换概念
录音说网购 makes life so much simpler，It is less time-consuming（更省时）像是从"生活更简单、不用拎袋停车" 推出的省时，但 "省力、简单" 不等于 "省时间"，而他明确find 的好处是 cheaper（省钱），把省力偷换成省时了。
借用原文：It makes life so much simpler
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第19页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did a recent study find about some British children?

options.text: They have little talent for learning math.
They need medical help for math anxiety.
They need extra help to catch up in the math class.
They have strong negative emotions towards math.

explanation:
【题目】What did a recent study find about some British children?
【翻译】最近一项研究发现了英国儿童的什么情况?
A) 他们学习数学的天赋很少。
B) 他们需要医疗帮助来应对数学焦虑。
C) 他们需要额外帮助才能在数学课上赶上进度。
D) 他们对数学有强烈的负面情绪。
【答案】D （细节题）They have strong negative emotions towards math.
【定位】A recent study found that 10 percent of British children suffer from math anxiety. This means they have overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject, ranging from rage to despair.
最近一项研究发现，10% 的英国孩子受数学焦虑困扰。这意味着他们对这门学科怀有压倒性的负面情绪，从暴怒到绝望不等。
【信号】found 后接结论加 This means 解释。信号有两层：先是 A recent study found that 直接打出「研究发现」的旗号，这后面就是答案区；紧接着 This means they have overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject 用 This means 把「数学焦虑」翻译成大白话——正是这句「换种说法解释」给出了答案。听到 found 锁定区域、听到This means 锁定那一句。
【替换】overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject ↔strong negative emotions towards math
overwhelming=strong、the subject=math
ranging from rage to despair ↔strong negative emotions
rage 到 despair 是 negative emotions 的具体化
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
little talent for learning math 借了话题词 math 来制造熟悉感，但录音通篇讲的是「情绪」，从没说这些孩子「缺乏天赋」——恰恰相反，后文还强调他们能力中上。这是把「焦虑」想当然地等同于「没天赋」的常识误判。
借用原文：suffer from math anxiety
B)
原词陷阱
medical help for math anxiety 原样搬来录音的 math anxiety，又把后文的身体症状 a racing heart or struggling to catch breath 误读成「需要医疗帮助」。但录音只是描述症状，从没说这些孩子需要看病求医，属于借原词、推过头。
借用原文：a racing heart or struggling to catch breath
C)
未提及
extra help to catch up in the math class 蹭了 math 这个话题，但「需要额外帮助跟上数学课」在录音里完全没有对应——录音讲的是情绪，不是学业进度落后。属于无中生有的干扰。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the widespread misunderstanding about math anxiety?

options.text: It will gradually pass away without teachers' help.
It affects low performing children only.
It is related to a child's low intelligence.
It exists mostly among children from poor families.

explanation:
【题目】What is the widespread misunderstanding about math anxiety?
【翻译】关于数学焦虑的普遍误解是什么?
A) 它会在没有教师帮助的情况下逐渐消失。
B) 它只影响成绩差的儿童。
C) 它与儿童的低智商有关。
D) 它主要存在于来自贫困家庭的儿童中。
【答案】B （细节题）It affects low performing children only.
【定位】There's a widespread misunderstanding that only low performing children suffer from math anxiety. People automatically assume children are anxious about math because they are poor achievers.
存在一种普遍的误解：认为只有成绩差的孩子才会有数学焦虑。人们想当然地以为孩子焦虑是因为他们成绩差。
【信号】widespread misunderstanding that 直接引出误解内容。信号词是 a widespread misunderstanding that——它和题干用词几乎一模一样，that 后面那句就是误解的具体内容。紧跟的 People automatically assume 再用「人们想当然地以为」把同一误解复述一遍，进一步坐实。听到 misunderstanding that 就锁后半句。
【替换】only low performing children suffer from math anxiety ↔ It affects low performing children only
suffer from 换成 affects，主被动对调
【排除】A)
未提及
It will gradually pass away without teachers' help. 说焦虑会在没有老师帮助下自行消退——录音从没这么说，反而强调 in the long term their performance is negatively affected（长期看会损害成绩）。属于录音没提、且与原意相悖的编造。
C)
偷换概念
It is related to a child's low intelligence. 借了录音 low performing 里的 low，把「成绩差（low performing / poor achievers）」偷换成了「智力低（low intelligence）」。录音谈的是学业表现，从没说焦虑跟智商有关，是典型的偷换概念。
借用原文：only low performing children
D)
原词陷阱
It exists mostly among children from poor families. 蹭了话题词 children，又把录音的poor achievers（成绩差的人）误读成 poor families（贫困家庭）——poor 一词两义被混用。录音从未把焦虑和家庭贫富挂钩，属误读原词。
借用原文：they are poor achievers
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say about British students with math anxiety?

options.text: Most of them have average to strong math ability.
Most of them get timely help from their teachers.
They will regain confidence with counselling.
They are mostly secondary school students.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about British students with math anxiety?
【翻译】文章关于有数学焦虑的英国学生说了什么?
A) 他们中的大多数具有中等到较强的数学能力。
B) 他们中的大多数从老师那里得到及时的帮助。
C) 他们通过咨询会重新获得信心。
D) 他们大多数是中学生。
【答案】A （细节题）Most of them have average to strong math ability.
【定位】But importantly—and surprisingly—this new study suggests that the majority of students experiencing math anxiety have normal to high math ability.
但重要而且令人意外的是，这项新研究表明，大多数有数学焦虑的学生其实拥有正常到较高的数学能力。
【信号】But 加 importantly 加 surprisingly 三重强调收尾。信号极强：But importantly—and surprisingly 同时用了转折 but、强调 importantly、反直觉 surprisingly 三个标记叠在一起，等于作者在大喊「这句才是重点」。篇章独白里这种结尾的强调句几乎必是考点。听到but 加 surprisingly，立刻把后面整句记下。
【替换】the majority of students experiencing math anxiety ↔Most of them
the majority of=Most of
have normal to high math ability ↔have average to strong math ability
normal=average、high=strong
【排除】B)
与原文相反
Most of them get timely help from their teachers. 录音恰恰相反：their math anxiety will go unnoticed because their performance is good——因为成绩好，焦虑往往被忽视、得不到关注，谈何「及时得到老师帮助」。这是与原文相反的干扰。
借用原文：their math anxiety will go unnoticed
C)
未提及
They will regain confidence with counselling. 里的 counselling（心理咨询）在录音里从头到尾没出现过，「靠咨询恢复信心」完全是编造。录音只提到 a subsequent lack or loss of confidence（信心丧失），但从没说怎么靠咨询找回。
D)
原词陷阱
They are mostly secondary school students. 借了录音 in both primary and secondary school 里的 secondary school，却偷偷把「小学和中学都有」缩成「主要是中学生」。录音明说两个学段都受影响，选项却用 mostly 把范围卡死，属范围偷改。
借用原文：both primary and secondary school

stem: What is said of people with addictive behavior?

options.text: They prioritize their favored activity over what they should do.
They do their favored activity whenever and wherever possible.
They are unaware of the damage their behavior is doing to them.
They are unable to get rid of their addiction without professional help.

explanation:
【题目】What is said of people with addictive behavior?
【翻译】关于有成瘾行为的人,有什么说法?
A) 他们把自己喜欢的活动置于应该做的事情之上。
B) 他们随时随地尽可能从事自己喜欢的活动。
C) 他们没有意识到自己的行为对他们造成的伤害。
D) 他们无法在没有专业帮助的情况下摆脱成瘾。
【答案】A （细节题）They prioritize their favored activity over what they should do.

【定位】Such people make computer games a priority over their responsibilities.
这类人把电子游戏看得比自己的责任更重要。
【信号】指示词"Such people"领起对该类人的刻画。录音用 Such people make computer games a priority over their responsibilities. 中的"Such people"（这类人）回指上文的成瘾者，正是题干"people with addictive behavior"指向的对象，这句对其行为的概括就是答案句信号。
【替换】make computer games a priority over their responsibilities ↔ They prioritize their favored activity over what they should do.
"把游戏看得比责任重"="把爱做的事置于该做的事之上"
【排除】B)
未提及
B They do their favored activity whenever and wherever possible. 说成瘾者"随时随地都玩"，但录音从头到尾没说过"whenever and wherever（任何时间任何地点）"，它只说这些人拿游戏顶替了上学、工作、社交 They may play games instead of attending school, or work, or socializing.，"随时随地"是凭常识脑补出来的。
C)
原词陷阱
C They are unaware of the damage their behavior is doing to them. 说成瘾者"意识不到自己受的伤害"，录音确实提到这种行为会 damage a person's relationships or performance（损害关系或表现），但只说"有危害"，从没说成瘾者"没意识到"，C 把"有危害"偷换成了"本人不自知"。
借用原文：damage a person's relationships or performance at school or work
D)
未提及
D They are unable to get rid of their addiction without professional help. 说成瘾者"离了专业帮助戒不掉"，录音通篇在讨论"算不算病"，从未提及"professional help（专业帮助）"或"戒不掉"，这是套用对"成瘾"的刻板印象添加的内容。

stem: What do some behavior experts think of addiction to computer games?

options.text: It may be less damaging than previously believed.
There will never be agreement on its harm to people.
It may prove to be beneficial to developing creativity.
There is not enough evidence to classify it as a disease.

explanation:
【题目】What do some behavior experts think of addiction to computer games?
【翻译】一些行为专家如何看待电脑游戏成瘾?
A) 它的危害可能比之前认为的要小。
B) 人们永远不会就其危害达成一致。
C) 它可能被证明有益于培养创造力。
D) 没有足够的证据将其归类为一种疾病。
【答案】D （态度观点题）There is not enough evidence to classify it as a disease.

【定位】Still not all behavior experts agree. Some argue that there's not enough research on the subject. Thus, they claim it is too early to call computer game addiction a disorder.
不过，并非所有行为专家都赞同。有些专家认为这方面的研究还不够。因此，他们声称现在就把电子游戏成瘾称作一种障碍还为时过早。
【信号】转折词 Still 领出反对声音。录音用 Still not all behavior experts agree. 中的"Still"（不过、然而）把语气从前文 WHO 的定论转向反方，紧接着的 Some argue that there's not enough research 才是这"某些专家"的真实立场——转折之后才是落点，这正是态度题最典型的答案信号。
【替换】there's not enough research on the subject ↔ There is not enough evidence to classify it as a disease.
"研究不够"="证据不足以定性为疾病"
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A It may be less damaging than previously believed. 说"危害可能比以前认为的小"，录音里反方专家质疑的是"研究够不够、能不能现在就定性"，从没比较过"危害大小"，damaging 一词虽在第 3 段出现过 damage a person's relationships，但"less damaging（危害更小）"是录音没有的比较。
借用原文：damage a person's relationships or performance at school or work
B)
过度推断
B There will never be agreement on its harm to people. 说"永远不会就其危害达成一致"，录音只说现在"not all…agree（并非都同意）"、还需要更多研究，是"暂时未达成一致"，绝不是"永远不会一致"，never 把话推到了录音没有的极端。
借用原文：Still not all behavior experts agree.
C)
未提及
C It may prove to be beneficial to developing creativity. 说游戏成瘾"可能有益于培养创造力"，录音通篇在争论"算不算病"，从未出现 beneficial（有益）或 creativity（创造力）任何相关内容，这是凭空添加的好处。

stem: What do we learn about most European passports?

options.text: They are relatively uniform in color and design.
They appear more formal than other passports.
They are a shade of red bordering on brown.
They vary in color from country to country.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about most European passports?
【翻译】关于大多数欧洲护照我们了解到什么?
A) 它们在颜色和设计上相对统一。
B) 它们看起来比其他护照更正式。
C) 它们是一种近乎棕色的红色。
D) 它们的颜色因国家而异。
【答案】C （细节题）They are a shade of red bordering on brown.
【定位】Switzerland's passport is dark red, for example, while most European countries prefer a shade of red. That's almost brown.
举例来说，瑞士护照是深红色，而大多数欧洲国家偏爱一种红色，那种红几乎接近棕色。
【信号】听到题干对象就锁定。录音念到 most European countries prefer a shade of red，正好对应题干的 most European passports，这就是答案句的信号——题干问什么对象，录音里点到这个对象的那一句即是答案句。紧接其后的 That's almost brown 补出近棕色的细节。

【替换】most European countries prefer a shade of red ↔They are a shade of red bordering on brown.
原话原词搬进选项
That's almost brown ↔bordering on brown
almost 与 bordering on 同义
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
relatively uniform in color and design 借了原文反复出现的 color、design 话题词制造熟悉感，但录音说欧洲护照偏爱某种红色，并未说各国颜色与设计相对统一，属于听到原词就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：slight variations
B)
张冠李戴
more formal than other passports 把后文第 4 段讲深色封面显得正式 they appear more official 张冠李戴到欧洲护照颜色这题上，且 formal 与 official 近义诱人，但本题问的是欧洲护照颜色，不是封面为何显正式。
借用原文：they appear more official
D)
与原文相反
vary in color from country to country 与录音相反——录音强调 most European countries prefer a shade of red，即多数欧洲国家偏爱同一种红色，是趋同而非各国不同，选项把意思反了。
借用原文：most European countries prefer a shade of red

stem: What does the passage say about the design of passports?

options.text: They must endure wear and tear.
They must be of the same size.
They must be made from a rare material.
They must follow some common standards.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about the design of passports?
【翻译】文章关于护照的设计说了什么?
A) 它们必须经得起磨损。
B) 它们必须尺寸相同。
C) 它们必须由稀有材料制成。
D) 它们必须遵循一些共同标准。
【答案】D （细节题）They must follow some common standards.
【定位】There are no official rules regarding passport colors, but countries follow a certain set of norms when designing them.
关于护照颜色并没有官方规定，但各国在设计护照时会遵循一套特定的规范。
【信号】转折 but 后是真意。There are no official rules 先说没有官方规定，but 之后才转到countries follow a certain set of norms when designing them，转折 but 后面才是设计这一问的落点——前半的没有规定是干扰铺垫。

【替换】follow a certain set of norms ↔follow some common standards
norms 与 standards 同义
countries follow ↔They must follow
动词 follow 对应
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
endure wear and tear 里的磨损来自第 4 段 hide dirt and wear，录音确实念过 wear，但那是讲深色封面能藏脏污磨损，不是回答护照设计要遵守什么，听到 wear 就选即落入原词陷阱。
借用原文：hide dirt and wear
B)
原词陷阱
of the same size 看似与第 2 段 size 沾边，但录音只说建议各国采用合适的类型、尺寸与样式，从未说护照必须大小相同，属借 size 一词的原词陷阱兼未提及。
借用原文：size
C)
原词陷阱
made from a rare material 借了第 3 段 made from a material 的 material 一词，但录音只要求材料能弯折，从未说稀有，rare 是凭空加上去的，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：made from a material that bends

stem: Why are dark colors chosen for passport covers?

options.text: They look more traditional.
They look more official.
They are favored by airlines.
They are easily identifiable.

explanation:
【题目】Why are dark colors chosen for passport covers?
【翻译】为什么护照封面选择深色?
A) 它们看起来更传统。
B) 它们看起来更正式。
C) 它们受到航空公司的青睐。
D) 它们容易识别。
【答案】B （细节题）They look more official.
【定位】Simply put, countries stick to darker and more conservative colors because they appear more official.
简单说，各国坚持用更深、更保守的颜色，是因为这些颜色显得更正式、更官方。
【信号】because 引出原因。录音 Simply put 提示要给结论，紧接 because they appear more official 用 because 直接交代原因——这正是 Why 题的答案信号，because 后面那句即是答案。
【替换】they appear more official ↔They look more official.
appear 与 look 同义

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
look more traditional 与正确项 look more official 仅一词之差，traditional（传统）与official（官方）近义易混，但录音 because 后说的是 more official，从未说 traditional，命题人就靠这对近义词诱你听岔。
借用原文：more conservative colors
C)
张冠李戴
favored by airlines 蹭了第 2 段提到的国际民航组织 The International Civil Aviation Organization 这一航空背景，但录音从没说深色封面受航空公司青睐，把民航组织硬扯成airlines 偏好，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：The International Civil Aviation Organization
D)
答非所问
easily identifiable 是另起的一个特征，录音讲深色封面的原因是显官方、还能藏脏污磨损hide dirt and wear，从未说深色是为了易于辨识，与本题原因不符，属答非所问。
借用原文：hide dirt and wear

stem: What is one special function of the images inside many passports?

options.text: For beauty.
For variety.
For visibility.
For security.

explanation:
【题目】What is one special function of the images inside many passports?
【翻译】许多护照内部的图像有什么特殊功能?
A) 为了美观。
B) 为了多样性。
C) 为了可见性。
D) 为了安全性。
【答案】D （细节题）For security.
【定位】The passports of many countries can take images of their well-known geographical features and wildlife, which also function as security features as some are only visible under a special light.
许多国家的护照内页印有本国著名的地理风貌和野生动物图案，这些图案还起到防伪作用，因为有些图案只在特殊光线下才能看到。
【信号】function as 点出作用。录音 which also function as security features 用 function as 直接点明图案的作用是安全防伪——这正是问 function 一题的答案信号，function as 后面的security features 即答案落点。后半的 only visible under a special light 是对这一安全功能的解释。
【替换】function as security features ↔For security.
security 原词即功能

【排除】A)
过度推断
For beauty. 看似与内页印著名地理风貌、野生动物图案 images of their well-known geographical features and wildlife 沾边，会让人觉得图案是为好看，但录音说的功能是安全防伪，从未说为了美观，属过度推断兼未提及。
借用原文：images of their well-known geographical features and wildlife
B)
答非所问
For variety. 蹭了录音讲各国内页图案不同、内页比封面有变化这层意思 the same cannot be said for the pages，但那是说内页设计较多样，不是图案的功能，把内页多样性误当成图案功能，属答非所问。
借用原文：the same cannot be said for the pages
C)
原词陷阱
For visibility. 直接盗用录音 only visible under a special light 里的 visible 一词，且与正确项 For security 拼写相近极易混，但原文说的是图案只在特殊光下可见、这恰恰服务于安全防伪，可见只是手段、安全才是功能，听到 visible 就选即落入原词陷阱。
借用原文：only visible under a special light

explanation:
30. It can lead to very serious health __(30)__ for individuals
【答案】C) consequences
名词
【词性槽】形容词 serious 后接名词
【依据】"导致严重后果"是固定搭配
lead to very serious health __(30)__：lead to（导致）后接的、又能被 serious（严重的）修饰的、还是讲健康层面的，正是 consequences（后果）。"严重的健康后果" 语义最顺，且与全文"孤独危害健康"的主旨完全咬合。
【竞争词】E) dimensions 义不对：维度而非后果
dimensions 指"维度／方面"，"严重的健康维度"不通；这里要的是 lead to 导出的结果，不是某个方面。
I) implication 已被空 26 用掉
implication 是空 26 的答案，已从词库划走，按"每词最多用一次"不再参与。
B) appointments 搭配不成立
appointments 指"预约"，"严重的健康预约"讲不通，且它另有归属（空 27）。
H) idiom 义不对：习语
idiom 是"习语"，与 lead to 导致的健康结果毫无关系。
N) survey 义不对：调查
survey 是"调查"，"严重的健康调查"不合逻辑；它更贴空 34。

explanation:
31. a "Let's Talk Loneliness" campaign that __(31)__ difficult conversations across Britain
【答案】L) sparked
动词
【词性槽】that 引导定语从句缺谓语
【依据】"引发了……对话"
campaign that __(31)__ difficult conversations across Britain：一场运动"在英国各地引发／激起了难以启齿的对话"，sparked（引发、激起）与 conversations 搭配地道，sparked discussions/conversations 是高频组合，语义指向"运动带来积极效果"。
【竞争词】O) touches 时态与搭配都差
touches 是单数现在时，与本段过去语境不符，且"触及对话"不如"引发对话"自然；touches 更贴空 29。
G) hindered 逻辑指向相反
hindered（阻碍）意思反了——运动是要促进而非阻碍交流，与积极主旨冲突。
M) splitting 形态与义都不对
splitting 是 -ing 形式不能直接作过去式谓语，且"分裂对话"语义怪异。
J) pushing 形态不合且另有归属
pushing 为 -ing 形式，作 that 从句谓语需 pushed，形态不对；且 push 更贴空 33 的"pushing to"。
D) debating 形态不合且另有归属
debating 为 -ing 形式，此处需过去式谓语；debating 更贴空 28 的进行时结构。
【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 G) —— hindered 形态对、逻辑反。空 31 要过去式动词，hindered 形态完全合规，光看语法分不出对错。防坑：回到语义方向——"Let's Talk Loneliness" 运动是要"引发"对话而非"阻碍"对话，逻辑指向决定选 sparked。

explanation:
35. 30% of relationships are __(35)__ strained
【答案】K) severely
副词
【词性槽】修饰形容词 strained 的状语
【依据】"严重紧张"程度副词
30% of relationships are __(35)__ strained：severely（严重地）修饰 strained，"30%的关系严重紧张"，程度副词与"strained（紧张）"语义同向、自然加强，呼应本段"即便已婚也有大量关系出问题"的论点。
【竞争词】A) abruptly 义不对：突然 vs 程度
abruptly 表"突然地"，强调方式/时间，不是程度；"突然紧张"与 strained 这种持续状态不搭，这里要的是"紧张的严重程度"。
【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 A) —— abruptly 词性对、易抢答。空 35 副词只有 abruptly 与severely 两候选，词性都对，慌乱中可能凭眼熟选 abruptly。防坑：先问空修饰的是"程度"还是"方式"——are __(35)__ strained 要的是"严重程度"，选程度副词 severely。
W O R D B A N K · 词库分类表
15 个候选词 · 词性与词义
选词填空文后的共享词库共 15 个词（A–O），为 10 个空各选一个、每词最多用一次。下面给出每个词的词性与中文词义；标注「用于第 N 空」的 10 个为答案，其余 5 个为干扰词。
A) abruptly
副词
突然地，唐突地
干扰词 · 未选用
B) appointments
名词
预约，约见（如看病预约）
用于第 27 空
C) consequences
名词
后果，结果（多指不好的）
用于第 30 空
D) debating
动词
争论，讨论（debate 的 -ing 形式）
用于第 28 空
E) dimensions
名词
维度，方面，尺寸
干扰词 · 未选用
F) friendly
形容词
友好的，亲切的
用于第 32 空
G) hindered
动词
形容词
阻碍，妨碍（hinder 的过去式/过去分词）
干扰词 · 未选用
H) idiom
名词
习语，成语，惯用语
干扰词 · 未选用
I) implication
名词
含意，言外之意，启示
用于第 26 空
J) pushing
动词
形容词
推动，推进，努力争取（push 的 -ing 形式）
用于第 33 空
K) severely
副词
严重地，严厉地
用于第 35 空
L) sparked
动词
引发，激起（spark 的过去式/过去分词）
用于第 31 空
M) splitting
动词
形容词
分裂，劈开（split 的 -ing 形式）
干扰词 · 未选用
N) survey
名词
动词
调查，问卷调查
用于第 34 空
O) touches
动词
名词
触及，影响，接触
用于第 29 空
全文主旨
孤独是被低估的重大健康风险
全文围绕一个观点展开：孤独（loneliness）对健康的危害比肥胖、吸烟还大。开篇即定调Social isolation poses more health risks than obesity or smoking 15 cigarettes a day，随后从孤独如何伤身、各国公共卫生专家如何应对、再到英美的统计数据，层层铺陈。抓住"孤独=隐形健康杀手"这条主线，后面每个空填什么词、是褒是贬，都有了判断的工作台。
D I S T R A C T O R S · 干扰词复盘
这 5 个词始终没被任何空选用
词库 15 词里有 5 个是命题人埋的干扰词——它们词性看着也对、词义也沾点边，却不该填进任何一个空。下面逐个剖析它们最像哪个空的答案、为什么是陷阱。
A) abruptly 最像空 35 的副词
abruptly 是词库仅有的两个副词之一，词性与空 35 30% of relationships are __(35)__ strained 完全对得上，极易和 severely 二选一。识破点：abruptly 表"突然地"是方式/时间副词，而空要的是"紧张的程度"，程度副词 severely 才对。
E) dimensions 冒充各名词空的诱饵
dimensions 是名词，词性能套进空 26、30、34 任一个，看着"也沾边"。识破点：它意为"维度"且是复数——空 26 The __(26)__ is 的 is 要单数、空 30/34 语义要"后果/调查"，逐个代入读半句它都不通。
G) hindered 最像空 31 的过去式动词
hindered 是过去式，形态正好套进空 31 campaign that __(31)__ difficult conversations 这种过去叙事的谓语位置，易和 sparked 混。识破点：hindered（阻碍）逻辑指向相反——运动是促进交流，须填"引发"义的 sparked。
H) idiom 名词词性对但义离题
idiom 是名词，词性可套空 26、27、30、34 等任一名词空。识破点：它意为"习语"，与本篇"孤独/健康/调查"话题毫不相干，靠词义一读即知离题，是纯凑数干扰。
M) splitting 最像 -ing 动词空的诱饵
splitting 是 -ing 形式，形态能套进空 28、33 这类进行时位置，和 debating、pushing 争。识破点：split（分裂、劈开）既不搭 "how to"、也不搭 "to stop"，语义放进去都怪，代入读半句即排除。

explanation:
【答案】C 段（强锚点）
【锚点】数量很小也跟不上变化
【定位】Responses suggest that anumeric people have some trouble keeping track of how many nuts remain in the can, even if there are only four or five in total.
实验结果表明，无数字者很难追踪罐子里还剩多少颗坚果，即便总共只有四到五颗。

具体数→抽象数的上位替换

模糊量词替换具体数字
始印欧语是十进制的。原始印欧语是十进制导向的,因为正如在许多文化中一样,我们祖先的手是通往"一只手上的五根手指与另一只手上的五根手指相同"这一认识的门户。这种瞬间的想法被用语言表达出来并代代相传。这就是为什么许多语言中"五"这个词源自"手"这个词。因此,大多数数字系统是两个关键因素的副产品:人类的语言能力和我们关注手和手指的倾向。这种对手的固着——用两条腿直立行走的间接副产品——帮助在大多数文化中产生了数字,但并非全部。
J) Cultures without numbers also offer insight into the cognitive influence of particular numeric traditions. Consider what time it is. Your day is ruled by minutes and seconds, but these concepts are not real in any physical sense and are nonexistent to numberless people. Minutes and seconds are the verbal and written representations of an uncommon base-60 number system used in ancient Mesopotamia. They reside in our minds, numerical artifacts(人工制品) that not all humans inherit conceptually.
没有数字的文化也为我们提供了对特定数字传统的认知影响的洞察。想想现在是什么时间。你的一天由分钟和秒钟支配,但这些概念在任何物理意义上都不是真实的,对没有数字的人来说也是不存在的。分钟和秒钟是古代美索不达米亚使用的一种不常见的六十进制数字系统的口头和书面表达。它们存在于我们的头脑中,是并非所有人类在概念上都继承的数字人工制品。
K) Research on the language of numbers shows, more and more, that one of our species' key characteristics is tremendous linguistic(语言的) and cognitive diversity. If we are to truly understand how much our cognitive lives differ cross-culturally, we must continually explore the depths of our species' linguistic diversity.
对数字语言的研究越来越多地表明,我们这个物种的关键特征之一是巨大的语言和认知多样性。如果我们要真正理解我们的认知生活在跨文化中有多大差异,我们必须不断探索我们物种语言多样性的深度。

stem: What did Harvard scientists do 50 years ago?

options.text: They raised public awareness of the possible causes of heart disease.
They turned public attention away from the health risks of sugar to fat.
They placed the sugar industry in the spotlight with their new findings.
They conducted large-scale research on the role of sugar in people's health.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What did Harvard scientists do 50 years ago? 问的是过去某个具体行为，答案应是定位段对该行为的客观陈述。
【拆句】What did Harvard scientists do 50 years ago? 是 what 引导的一般疑问句，主语Harvard scientists，时间状语 50 years ago，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Sugar shocked. That describes the reaction of many Americans this week following revelations that, 50 years ago, the sugar industry paid Harvard scientists for research that shifted the focus away from sugar's role in heart disease—and put the spotlight(注意的中心) squarely on dietary fat.
糖业震惊。这描述了本周许多美国人在得知一桩内幕后的反应——50 年前，糖业出钱请哈佛科学家做研究，把心脏病的责任焦点从糖身上挪开，狠狠地压在了膳食脂肪头上。
【选项】A)
无中生有
raised public awareness of the possible causes of heart disease 说哈佛科学家"提高了公众对心脏病病因的认知"，但原文只说他们"转移焦点"，从未提及"提高认知"，且行为方向相反——是误导而非启蒙。
B)
✓ 正确
shifted the focus away from sugar's role in heart disease—and put the spotlight(注意的中心) squarely on dietary fat ↔turned public attention away from the health risks of sugar to fat
预判内容"把心脏病矛头从糖转向脂肪"与 turned public attention away from the health risks of sugar to fat 在框架、对象、方向上完全重合，即同义替换型正确项。
C)
与原文相反
placed the sugar industry in the spotlight with their new findings 说研究让"糖业"成为焦点，与原文 put the spotlight(注意的中心) squarely on dietary fat 恰恰相反——焦点是脂肪而非糖业。
D)
无中生有
conducted large-scale research on the role of sugar in people's health 强调"大规模"研究，但原文未提及研究规模，只说糖业出钱资助；且研究内容不是"糖与健康的作用"而是"转移焦点"。

stem: What does Marion Nestle say about present-day nutrition studies?

options.text: They took her a full year to track and analyze.
Most of them are based on systematic reviews.
They depend on funding from the food industries.
Nearly all of them serve the purpose of the funders.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does Marion Nestle say about present-day nutrition studies? 直接索取一个人对一事的具体说法，答案应是文中该人原话的转述。
【拆句】What does Marion Nestle say about present-day nutrition studies? 主干 What...does Marion Nestle say，about 引出宾语补足语限定 say 的内容范围；句法直白。
【定位】"Roughly 90% of nearly 170 studies favored the sponsor's interest," Nestle tells us.
Nestle 告诉我们："在近 170 项研究里，约 90% 的结果都偏向了资助方的利益。"
【选项】A)
答非所问
They took her a full year to track and analyze 说"研究花了她一整年追踪"，对应原文spent a year informally tracking，但这是关于 Nestle 的研究方法，不是她对"present-day nutrition studies"本身的看法，答非所问。
B)
张冠李戴
Most of them are based on systematic reviews 把"systematic reviews"安到"present-day nutrition studies"头上，但原文 Other systematic reviews support her conclusions 是说"其他系统性综述支持 Nestle 的结论"，systematic reviews 是支持她的工具，不是被她评论的研究的本质。
C)
偷换概念
They depend on funding from the food industries 说"研究依赖食品业资助"，是"资金来源"层面的事实，而原文 Nestle 强调的是"研究结论偏向资助方"——把"结论偏袒"偷换成了"资金依赖"。两者层面不同。
D)
✓ 正确
Roughly 90% of nearly 170 studies favored the sponsor's interest ↔ Nearly all of them serve the purpose of the funders
预判"九成研究服务资助方利益"与 Nearly all of them serve the purpose of the funders 在数量级、动作、对象三层全部对齐，是教科书级同义替换正确项。

stem: What did Coca-Cola-funded studies claim?

options.text: Exercise is more important to good health than diet.

Drinking Coca-Cola does not contribute to weight gain.
The food industry plays a major role in fighting obesity.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What did Coca-Cola-funded studies claim? 问被可口可乐资助的研究主张了什么，答案是文中明示的论断。
【拆句】What did Coca-Cola-funded studies claim? 主语 Coca-Cola-funded studies 是"名词-funded 复合形容词+名词"结构，意为"被可口可乐资助的研究"；句意直白。
【定位】Last year, The New York Times revealed how Coca-Cola was funding well-known scientists and organizations promoting a message that, in the battle against weight gain, people should pay more attention to exercise and less to what they eat and drink.
去年《纽约时报》披露，可口可乐资助知名科学家和组织，宣扬这样一种主张：在对抗体重增长的战斗中，人们应更看重运动，而不是吃了什么、喝了什么。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
in the battle against weight gain, people should pay more attention to exercise and less to what they eat and drink ↔Exercise is more important to good health than diet
预判"重运动而轻饮食"与 Exercise is more important to good health than diet 的"运动比饮食更重要"严格等价；定位句的 more/less 平行结构本身就是隐性比较。
B)
与原文相反
Choosing what to eat and drink is key to weight control 说"吃喝选择是控重关键"，与原文 less to what they eat and drink"少在乎吃喝"完全相反——可口可乐研究恰恰要弱化饮食责任。
C)
无中生有
Drinking Coca-Cola does not contribute to weight gain 凭空捏造一句"喝可乐不会增重"，原文从未出现此论断；可口可乐资助研究只是"转移注意力"到运动，并未直接为可乐本身辩护。
D)
偷换概念
The food industry plays a major role in fighting obesity 说"食品业在抗肥胖中起重要作用"，看似与原文相关，但原文是说"可口可乐资助研究让人忽视饮食"，并未把食品业塑造为"抗肥胖功臣"；把"产业操纵议程"偷换成了"产业贡献抗肥胖"。

stem: What does Liebman say about industry-funded research?

options.text: It simply focuses on nutrition and health.
It causes confusion among consumers.
It rarely results in objective findings.
It runs counter to the public interest.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What does Liebman say about industry-funded research? 同 Q47 同款句式，仍是细节题，定位到 Liebman 引语即可。
【拆句】What does Liebman say about industry-funded research? 结构同 Q47；industry-funded 是"名词-过去分词"复合形容词，表被动"被产业资助的"。
【定位】"When the food industry pays for research, it often gets what it pays for." And what it pays for is often a pro-industry finding.
"当食品业出钱做研究时，它常常能买到自己想要的结论。"而它想买的，往往是一个对产业有利的结果。
【选项】A)
答非所问
It simply focuses on nutrition and health 只说研究"聚焦营养健康"，是话题描述，未触及 Liebman 对"业内资助偏袒"的核心评价；属答非所问。
B)
无中生有
It causes confusion among consumers 说"造成消费者困惑"，原文 P5 Liebman 谈的是"研究结论偏袒产业"，未提及消费者困惑这一后果——"困惑"是后文（P6）作者建议引出的语境，但不是 Liebman 的直接评价。
C)
✓ 正确
what it pays for is often a pro-industry finding ↔It rarely results in objective findings
When the food industry pays for research, it often gets what it pays for ↔ It rarely results in objective findings
预判"买到的多是偏袒产业的结论"与 It rarely results in objective findings 是同一事实的正反描述：常偏袒=极少客观。
D)

It runs counter to the public interest 跨越"研究偏袒产业"直接推到"与公众利益对立"——这是合理但过度的引申。原文只说结论亲产业，没有明示"对立于公众利益"，且 Liebman 所在机构名 Center for Science in the Public Interest 是机构名而非她的论断。

【定位】Success was once defined as being able to stay at a company for a long time and move up the corporate ladder. The goal was to reach the top, accumulate wealth and retire to a life of ease. My father is a successful senior executive. In 35 years, he worked for only three companies.
成功曾经被定义为能在一家公司长期任职、并沿企业晋升阶梯向上攀升。其目标是登上顶峰、积累财富、退休享福。我父亲是一位成功的高级主管。35年里他只为三家公司工作过。
【选项】A)
把例子局部细节当成例证目的=以偏概全
A项How long people took to reach the top of their career.只截取了例子里"长期任职"这层片面信息，且"花多久到顶"是文中未直接给出的时间细节。
B)
拎走并列项里的一个=以偏概全
B项How people accumulated wealth in his father's time.把原文里accumulate wealth截出来做主旨，但accumulate wealth只是论点中目标的一个并列项，并非例子要说明的核心。
C)
✓ 正确
Success was once defined as being able to stay at a company for a long time and move up the corporate ladder. ↔How people viewed success in his father's time.
C项把"父辈时代人们如何看待成功"完整对应原文论点句的语义，例子（35年三家公司）正是这个看法的证据。
D)
把例子字面=目的，是答非所问
D项How long people usually stayed in a company.几乎是父亲例子（he worked for only three companies 35年）的复述，问的是"例子表面讲了啥"，而题问的是"例子用来证明啥"。

如果你没在每三四年换一次公司，那你的职业基本就没在前进。
【选项】A)
无中生有

stem: What does the author say about people now working for several businesses at the same time?

options.text: They are often regarded as most treasured talents.
They are able to bring their potential into fuller play.
They have control over their life and work schedules.
They feel proud of being outstanding problem solvers.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say about people now working for several businesses at the same time?问的是作者对该群体的具体评价，原文应有直接陈述。
【拆句】What does the author say about people now working for several businesses at the same time?主干What does the author say about people，working for several businesses at the same time是people的现在分词后置定语；now是时间副词，把范围限定在当下。
【定位】Today, consulting or freelancing for five businesses at the same time is a badge of honor. It shows how valuable an individual is.
如今，同时为五家公司做咨询或自由职业是一种荣誉徽章，它显示一个人有多么有价值。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
It shows how valuable an individual is. ↔ They are often regarded as most treasured talents.
a badge of honor ↔are often regarded as
从预判出发，A项把badge of honor+how valuable汇总成most treasured talents，最贴合作者对这群人的评价。
B)
张冠李戴（错段拼接）
B项They are able to bring their potential into fuller play.说他们"能把潜力发挥得更充分"，原文未在53题的定位段说这件事，潜力发挥要到P4再讨论focused and productive。

D)
偷换概念（叙述视角+部分原因）
D项They feel proud of being outstanding problem solvers.说他们"为自己作为解决问题者而自豪"，原文里badge of honor是社会对他们的视角，不是他们自己feel proud；problem solvers也只是企业聘他们的部分原因。

stem: What have businesses come to recognize now?

options.text: Who is capable of solving problems with ease.
How people can be more focused and productive.
What kind of people can contribute more to them.
Why some people are more passionate about work.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What have businesses come to recognize now?问当下企业认识到了什么，是问事实细节，不是推断。
【拆句】What have businesses come to recognize now?现在完成时have come to recognize表示从过去到现在累积形成的认识，now强调当下状态，结构无陷阱。
【定位】Most important, there is a growing recognition that people who balance work and play, and who work at what they are passionate about, are more focused and productive, delivering greater value to their clients.
最重要的是，人们越来越认识到：那些工作与休息平衡、并从事自己所热爱之事的人，更专注、更高产，能给客户带来更大的价值。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴+偷换程度
A项Who is capable of solving problems with ease.里solving problems with ease（轻松解决问题）来自solve problems their full-time teams can't，但P3说的是"解决全职团队搞不定的问题"，并非"轻松"，且和"现在认识到的"语境不符。
B)
答非所问（偷换疑问词）
B项How people can be more focused and productive.问的是"如何变得更专注高产"，而原文给的是"哪类人更专注高产"，疑问词错位，且companies的认知对象是人，不是方法。
C)
✓ 正确
people who balance work and play, and who work at what they are passionate about, are more focused and productive, delivering greater value to their clients ↔What kind of people can contribute more to them.
原文that从句的真正主语是people who...，整句重心是这类人能为客户贡献更多价值；C项的"What kind of people can contribute more to them"精准对位该重心。
D)
答非所问+偷换重心
D项Why some people are more passionate about work.问"为什么有些人对工作更热情"，但原文里passionate只是描述这类人的特征之一，并未解释"原因"，且重心是其价值，不是热情的成因。

stem: What does the author say about the gig economy?

options.text: It may force companies to reform their business practice.
It may soon replace the traditional economic model.
It will drive technological progress on a global scale.
It will bring about radical economic and social changes.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say about the gig economy?问的是作者对零工经济的具体陈述；答案直接在原文有对应句而非需要推断。
【拆句】What does the author say about the gig economy?结构简单：主干What does the author say，about the gig economy是介词短语修饰say，无陷阱。
【定位】Perhaps more important, as the global economy continues to be disrupted by technology and other massive change, the gig economy will itself become an engine of economic and social transformation.
或许更重要的是，随着全球经济持续被技术和其他剧变所颠覆，零工经济本身将成为经济与社会变革的引擎。
【选项】A)
过度推断
A项It may force companies to reform their business practice.说零工经济会"迫使企业改革其业务实践"，原文并未提到"迫使企业改革"这一动作，create a bridge between traditional enterprises and this emerging economy说的是搭桥而非迫使改革。
B)
与原文相反
B项It may soon replace the traditional economic model.说零工经济会"很快取代传统经济模式"，原文里始终是"搭桥""成为引擎"，从未表达替代关系。
C)
与原文相反（因果颠倒）
C项It will drive technological progress on a global scale.说零工经济"将驱动全球技术进步"，但原文里是"global economy被technology颠覆"，技术是动因、零工经济是结果之一，方向被反过来。
D)
✓ 正确
the gig economy will itself become an engine of economic and social transformation ↔ It will bring about radical economic and social changes.
从预判"将带来经济与社会变革"出发，D项把engine of transformation改写成bring about radical changes，逐字段语义匹配，是定位句的直接同义替换。

stem: What have studies found about boredom?

options.text: It facilitates innovative thinking.
It is a result of doing boring tasks.
It helps people connect with others.
It does harm to one's mental health.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What have studies found about boredom? 直接问研究的客观发现，未出现infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号
【拆句】现在完成时一般疑问句 What have studies found about boredom?，主干是 studies have found what about boredom；about boredom 是 found 的范围状语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱
【定位】Studies point to how boredom is good for creativity and innovation, as well as mental health.
研究指出无聊有益于创造力和创新（思维），也有益于心理健康。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
boredom is good for creativity and innovation ↔It facilitates innovative thinking.
预判的「无聊带来好处+创新」两要素在 It facilitates innovative thinking. 中都被精确还原——facilitates 对应 is good for，innovative thinking 对应 creativity and innovation
B)
与原文相反
原文说 people are more creative following the completion of a tedious task——是完成无聊任务之后人更有创造力，并非无聊本身是做无聊任务的结果；It is a result of doing boring tasks. 把因果方向倒过来，是典型的与原文相反
C)
无中生有
P1 谈的是无聊与创造力、创新、心理健康的关系，未提及无聊「帮人和他人连接」；It helps people connect with others. 的内容在 P1 中没有任何对应句
D)
与原文相反
原文明确说无聊 as well as mental health（与心理健康并列在 good for 之后，意为对心理健康有益），It does harm to one's mental health. 说的是「有害」——评价极性完全反转

stem: What does the author say boredom might indicate?

options.text: A need to be left alone.
A desire to be fulfilled.
A conflict to be resolved.
A feeling to be validated.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author say boredom might indicate? 是对作者陈述的直接发问，无推断或主旨信号
【拆句】宾语从句 What does the author say boredom might indicate?，主句 the author say +宾语从句 boredom might indicate what；what 是宾语从句里 indicate 的宾语前移；结构常见，无陷阱
【定位】As it turns out, boredom might signal the fact that you have a need that isn't being met.
事实证明，无聊可能是在告诉你：你有一种需求没有被满足。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文未提「希望独处」；A need to be left alone. 是把后文 P3 关于「真实连接」的话题反向推断出来的伪命题，但 P2 中根本没有这层意思
B)
✓ 正确
a need that isn't being met ↔A desire to be fulfilled.
预判的「需求+未被满足」两要素被 A desire to be fulfilled. 完整保留——desire 替换need，to be fulfilled 替换被动定语从句
C)
偷换概念
A conflict to be resolved. 谈「冲突」，但 P2 全段未提任何 conflict（冲突）的概念——need 是「需求」不是「冲突」，两者不能等同
D)
偷换概念
A feeling to be validated. 说「需要被确认的感觉」，但原文说的是「需求未被满足」——「确认感觉」与「满足需求」不是一回事；validate 与 meet 不能等价替换

与原文相反
原文 may result in more connections 说的是社交媒体带来更多连接（在数量上扩大），而 It may be an obstacle to expanding one's connections. 说它「妨碍扩大连接」——评价方向反转
B)
偷换概念
原文未提 social status（社会地位）；It may get in the way of enhancing one's social status. 中「妨碍提升社会地位」在 P3 中无任何对应——social 一词共用但status 完全没出现
C)
✓ 正确
can get in the way of building a real sense of belonging ↔ It may prevent people from developing a genuine sense of community.
预判的「妨碍」+「真正的归属感」两要素被 prevent people from developing a genuine sense of community 完整对应——动词短语、形容词、核心名词全部同步同义替换
D)
偷换概念
It may make people feel that they ought to fit in with the outside world. 说「让人觉得自己必须融入外部世界」，但原文 the feeling that you fit in with others around you 把 fit in 作为「归属感」的一部分（是好事），不是说社交媒体让人觉得「必须迎合」
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页

stem: What does the author suggest people do to get rid of boredom?

options.text: Count the likes they get on their posts.
Reflect on how they relate to others.
Engage in real-life interactions.
Participate in online discussions.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author suggest people do to get rid of boredom? 问作者明文给出的建议，无推断信号
【拆句】宾语从句 + 不定式状语 What does the author suggest people do to get rid of boredom?，主句 the author suggest + 宾语 people do what；to get rid of boredom是目的状语；结构稍复杂但无陷阱
【定位】So take the step of joining an organization to build face-to-face relationships. You'll find depth that you won't get from your screen no matter how many likes you get on your post.
所以请采取行动，加入一个组织，去建立面对面的关系。你会从中获得屏幕给不了的深度——无论你的帖子收到多少点赞。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文 no matter how many likes you get on your post 明确否定「数点赞」的价值；Count the likes they get on their posts. 反而把「数点赞」当作建议——完全反向
B)
答非所问
Reflect on how they relate to others. 说「反思自己如何与他人相处」，但作者的建议是「采取行动加入组织」，不是「反思」；reflect 与 take action 是两种完全不同的应对方式
C)
✓ 正确
build face-to-face relationships ↔Engage in real-life interactions.
预判的「面对面/线下」+「关系/互动」两要素被 Engage in real-life interactions. 整体保留，且未做任何延伸
D)
与原文相反
Participate in online discussions. 说「参与线上讨论」——而原文恰恰让人远离屏幕，转向 build face-to-face relationships；线上与线下方向反转
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What should people do to enhance their sense of meaning?

options.text: Try to do something original.
Confront significant challenges.
Define boredom in their unique way.
Devote themselves to a worthy cause.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What should people do to enhance their sense of meaning? 直接问该做什么，无推断信号
【拆句】情态动词疑问句 + 不定式状语 What should people do to enhance their sense of meaning?，主干 people should do what；to enhance... 是目的状语；结构清晰，无陷阱
【定位】If you want to reduce boredom and increase your sense of meaning, seek work where you can make a unique contribution, or find a cause you can support with your time and talent.
如果你想减少无聊、增强意义感，就去寻找一份你能做出独特贡献的工作，或者找到一项你能用时间和才华去支持的事业。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
Try to do something original. 说「做原创的事」，但原文 make a unique contribution 强调的是「做独特贡献」——unique contribution（独特贡献）与something original（原创之物）不是同一概念，前者强调贡献的「不可替代性」，后者强调内容的「首创性」
B)
张冠李戴
Confront significant challenges. 说「直面重大挑战」，但 P4 通篇未提 challenge（挑战）；该词只在 more significant challenges 出现，是 P5 谈「摆脱无聊」的总建议，不是 P4 谈「增强意义感」的具体做法
C)
答非所问
Define boredom in their unique way. 说「用自己独特的方式定义无聊」——这与题目所问的「增强意义感」无关；该项把 If your definition of boredom is being quiet, mindful, and reflective 中的 definition 一词嫁接到本题
D)
✓ 正确
find a cause you can support with your time and talent ↔ Devote themselves to a worthy cause.
原文给的两个建议中，选项命中第二个 find a cause you can support with your time and talent——Devote themselves to a worthy cause. 是它的精准凝练
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页

stem: What did the author suspect back in 2016?

options.text: Calorie consumption had fallen drastically over the decades.
Most people surveyed were reluctant to reveal what they ate.
The national statistics did not reflect the actual calorie consumption.
Most people did not include snacks when reporting their calorie intake.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What did the author suspect back in 2016 问的是一个具体过去时间点上的具体事实，没有 infer/imply 之类信号词，属于事实细节题。
【拆句】题干 What did the author suspect back in 2016? 是一个简单的特殊疑问句，主语 the author，谓语 suspect，宾语用 what 提问，back in 2016 是时间状语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】We originally had this suspicion back in 2016, puzzled by the fact that national statistics showed calorie consumption falling dramatically over past decades.
我们最初是在 2016 年产生这种怀疑的——我们困惑于一个事实：国家统计数据显示，过去几十年里热量消费在大幅下降。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
Calorie consumption had fallen drastically over the decades. 复述的是统计数据本身的表象，作者恰恰是怀疑这个表象不可信，而非相信它。
B)
无中生有
原文只说人们 drastically under-reporting——漏报，没有任何文字表明他们 reluctant to reveal——主观上不愿透露；后文第 5 段更解释为自我欺骗或愿景式思维，而非拒绝回答。
C)
✓ 正确
national statistics showed calorie consumption falling dramatically over past decades ↔ The national statistics did not reflect the actual calorie consumption.
预判落点是“统计与现实不符”，四个选项里只有 The national statistics did not reflect the actual calorie consumption. 直接说统计没有反映真实情况，与预判完全吻合。
D)
张冠李戴
Most people did not include snacks when reporting their calorie intake. 接近第 1段 every snack bar in your car 和第 6 段 snacking 的内容，但那些不是 2016 年的怀疑，而是后续展开的具体机制。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What has the Office for National Statistics verified?

options.text: People's calorie intake was far from accurately reported.
The missing out of main meals leads to the habit of snacking.
The nation's obesity level has much to do with calorie intake.
Calorie consumption is linked to the amount of snacks one eats.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What has the Office for National Statistics verified? 直问某机构核实了什么事实，无推断信号词，属事实细节题。
【拆句】题干 What has the Office for National Statistics verified? 是现在完成时的特殊疑问句，主语是机构名，谓语 verified，结构清晰，无障碍。
【定位】Now the Office for National Statistics has confirmed that we are consuming 50% more calories than our national statistics claim.
如今国家统计局已证实：我们实际摄入的热量比国家统计声称的高出 50%。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
we are consuming 50% more calories than our national statistics claim ↔ People's calorie intake was far from accurately reported.
People's calorie intake was far from accurately reported. 把“实际比上报高出 50%”这件事精确概括为“摄入量远未被准确上报”，与预判一一对应。
B)
无中生有
The missing out of main meals leads to the habit of snacking. 把“漏掉正餐”和“养成吃零食的习惯”绑成因果，原文从未提及这种因果链——文中说的是“忘记零食”而非“漏掉正餐导致吃零食”。
C)
张冠李戴
The nation's obesity level has much to do with calorie intake. 涉及肥胖与热量摄入的关系，那是第 4 段 rise in obesity levels 后面的讨论，不是国家统计局证实的内容。
D)
张冠李戴
Calorie consumption is linked to the amount of snacks one eats. 类似第 6 段对零食的讨论，但那是作者推论的“潜在原因之一”，不是国家统计局已证实的事实。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about obese people from the passage?

options.text: They usually keep their eating habits a secret.
They overlook the potential causes of obesity.
They cannot help eating more than they should.
They have difficulty recalling what they have eaten.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about obese people from the passage? 限定主体为某类人，问关于他们的文本陈述，仍是文中明示的细节而非推断。
【拆句】题干 What do we learn about obese people from the passage? 是 What 引导的疑问句，about obese people 限定 learn 的对象，from the passage 是出处状语，句意直白。
【定位】Under-reporting rates are much higher for obese people, because they simply consume more food, and thus have more to remember.
肥胖人群的漏报率要高得多，因为他们吃得本来就多，需要回想的食物也就更多。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
They usually keep their eating habits a secret. 把客观上的漏报误读成主观上对外保密，原文没有任何表示故意隐瞒的字眼。
B)
张冠李戴
They overlook the potential causes of obesity. 把“忽视肥胖原因”安到肥胖人群头上，但全文中“指出潜在原因”的是作者（We can point to at least three potential causes），与肥胖人群无关。
C)
过度推断
They cannot help eating more than they should. 加入了 cannot help（情不自禁）和 more than they should（超出应吃的量）两个主观限制，原文只是说 simply consume more food——“就是吃得多些”，并未涉及自控力或应有量。
D)
✓ 正确
they simply consume more food, and thus have more to remember ↔ They have difficulty recalling what they have eaten.
预判落在“记不清吃了什么”，四个选项中只有 They have difficulty recalling what they have eaten. 直接说回忆困难，与预判完美对应。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What often goes unnoticed in surveys on food consumption?

options.text: The growing trend of eating out.
The potential causes of snacking.
People's home energy consumption.
People's changing diet over the years.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What often goes unnoticed in surveys on food consumption? 问的是调查中常被漏掉的某个具体类别，属于事实细节而非推断。
【拆句】题干 What often goes unnoticed in surveys on food consumption? 主语 what，goes unnoticed 是系表结构（go + 形容词，表“处于…状态”），in surveys on food consumption 是地点状语限定情境，结构无陷阱，关键要识别 go unnoticed 的固定搭配含义。
【定位】Again, there is evidence that food consumed out of the home is one of the most poorly recorded categories in surveys.
再者，有证据表明：在家以外吃的东西，是调查中被记得最差的类别之一。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
food consumed out of the home ↔The growing trend of eating out.
an increase in snacking and eating out over recent decades ↔ The growing trend of eating out.
段末明确说在家外吃饭是漏报最严重的类别之一，只有 The growing trend of eating out. 把“外出就餐”作为答案给出，与定位句完全对应。
B)
答非所问
题干问“调查中常被漏掉的是什么”，The potential causes of snacking. 谈的是“吃零食的潜在原因”，方向跑偏；且原文也没说零食的“原因”被漏报。
C)
偷换概念
People's home energy consumption. 字面上像“家庭能源消费”，与“在家吃饭”完全是两个领域；原文谈的是 energy intake（能量摄入），不是 energy consumption（能源消费）。
D)
以偏概全
People's changing diet over the years. 用“饮食习惯随年份变化”这种大词把整篇主旨偷换上来，原文段落讲的是某一类食物在调查中被漏报，不是泛泛“饮食变化”。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2021-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author suggest policymakers do about obesity?

options.text: Remind people to cut down on snacking.
Make sure people eat non-fattening food.
Ensure people don't miss their main meals.
See that people don't stick to the same diet.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does the author suggest policymakers do about obesity? 问作者对决策者的具体建议，文中尾段已明示，属细节题而非主旨题。
【拆句】题干 What does the author suggest policymakers do about obesity? 是 What 引导的疑问句，谓语 suggest 后接的是省略 that 的宾语从句 policymakers do ...，从句动词用原形 do（suggest 类动词的虚拟语气），about obesity 限定建议主题。
【定位】Also, we should be looking for new ways to ensure what people eat wouldn't have much impact on their waistlines.
此外，我们应当寻找新方法，确保人们吃下去的东西不会对腰围产生多大影响。
【选项】A)
无中生有
Remind people to cut down on snacking. 让人们少吃零食，仅来自 snacking and eating out 的现象描述，文中并未在 P7 提出“提醒减少零食”这一具体政策建议。
B)
✓ 正确
what people eat wouldn\'t have much impact on their waistlines ↔ Make sure people eat non-fattening food.
Make sure people eat non-fattening food. 把“吃了不会胖到腰围”换说成“吃不发胖的食物”，是从定位句的反向角度切入同一件事——与预判正对。
C)
与原文相反
Ensure people don\'t miss their main meals. 让人们别漏掉正餐，与全文主旨方向相反——文章说人们漏报、吃得多，不是吃得少，更不存在“应该多吃几顿正餐”的建议。
D)
偷换概念
See that people don\'t stick to the same diet. 让人们不要长期保持同一种饮食，原文从未提及对单一饮食的看法；唯一相关的 stick to a diet 谈的是减肥者难以坚持节食，与让大众放弃单一饮食毫无关系。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页

stem: What does the news report say about United Airlines?

options.text: It found a pet dog on board a plane to a city in Texas.
It had one of its cargo planes land at a wrong airport.
It sent two dogs to the wrong destinations.
It had two of its domestic flights mixed up.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say about United Airlines?
【翻译】新闻报道关于美国联合航空公司说了什么?
A) 在一架飞往德克萨斯州某城市的飞机上发现了一只宠物狗。
B) 其中一架货运飞机降落在了错误的机场。
C) 将两只狗送到了错误的目的地。
D) 将其两个国内航班搞混了。
【答案】C （细节题）It sent two dogs to the wrong destinations.
【定位】Both of the dogs had been sent to the wrong destinations on connecting flights from Denver, with Buddy mistakenly being sent to Japan instead.
两只狗都在从丹佛转机时被送错了目的地，其中 Buddy 被错送到了日本。
【信号】Both…wrong destinations 直陈事故。这句以 Both of the dogs had been sent to the wrong destinations 正面点出事故核心——两只狗都被送错目的地，是整则新闻交代『航空公司做了什么』的事实落点；句中 Both 与 wrong destinations 是直接承载答案的信号词。
【替换】Both of the dogs had been sent to the wrong destinations ↔ It sent two dogs to the wrong destinations.
Both the dogs = two dogs

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项盗用了原文里 Texas 这个地名（their new home city in Texas），但原文是说一家人本应在得州的新家与狗团聚，并非『在飞往得州的飞机上发现一只狗』；它把真实情节拼凑改写，属听到 Texas 就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：They were meant to be reunited with the pet in their new home city in Texas.
B)
偷换概念
原文反复说送错的是 dog（shipping an American family's pet dog…in the wrong direction），是『狗被运错方向』，从没说『一架货机降错机场』；选项把错送对象从狗偷换成 cargo plane、把『送错目的地』偷换成『降错机场』，与原文不符。
借用原文：United Airlines has apologised for mistakenly shipping an American family's pet dog thousands of miles in the wrong direction
D)
答非所问
原文是两只狗在转机时被送错（on connecting flights from Denver），出错的是狗的去向；选项却说是『两个国内航班被搞混』，把出错对象从狗换成 flights，且原文只字未提『国内航班搞混』，属答非所问。
借用原文：Both of the dogs had been sent to the wrong destinations on connecting flights from Denver
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2021-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the spokesperson for United Airlines say they would do after the incident?

options.text: Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
Give the two pets a physical checkup.
Hire a charter jet to bring the pets back.
Send another plane to continue the flight.

explanation:
【题目】What did the spokesperson for United Airlines say they would do after the incident?
【翻译】美国联合航空公司的发言人表示事件发生后他们会做什么?
A) 尽快纠正他们的错误。
B) 给这两只宠物做身体检查。
C) 租用包机把宠物送回来。
D) 派另一架飞机继续该航班。
【答案】A （细节题）Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
【定位】We will arrange to return the pets to them as soon as possible.
我们会尽快安排把宠物送还给他们。
【信号】We will 未来承诺。这句出自发言人原话，以 We will arrange to return the pets to them as soon as possible 的 We will 领头，是典型的官方补救承诺句；will 这个未来时信号正对应题干 say they would do，故为答案句。
【替换】We will arrange to return the pets to them as soon as possible ↔ Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
送还宠物=纠正错误

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
选项盗用了原文真出现的 physical checkup（Buddy was given a physical checkup），但那是 Buddy 到东京后已经做过的事，不是发言人承诺『事故后将要做』的动作；时间错位，张冠李戴到发言人头上。
借用原文：Buddy was given a physical checkup when he arrived at Tokyo's International Airport.
C)
原词陷阱
选项盗用原文的 charter jet（sent back to the U.S. on a private charter jet），但那是叙述 Buddy 已经被私人包机送回美国的既成事实，不是发言人对今后的承诺；选项把已发生说成将要做，且 Hire（雇用）也非原文所述。
借用原文：The dog was then sent back to the U.S. on a private charter jet.
D)
未提及
原文从没说要『再派一架飞机继续这趟飞行』；发言人只承诺尽快把宠物送还（return the pets to them as soon as possible）。选项 Send another plane to continue the flight.是凭 plane/flight 这类话题词臆造的动作，未提及。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2021-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the mother elephant Semba?

options.text: She weighs 130 kilograms.
She has had babies before.
She was brought from Africa.
She has a big family of six.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the mother elephant Semba?
【翻译】关于母象Semba我们了解到什么?
A) 她体重130公斤。
B) 她以前生过小象。
C) 她是从非洲带来的。
D) 她有一个六口之家的大家庭。
【答案】B （细节题）She has had babies before.
【定位】Semba has given birth before.
Semba 以前生过孩子（不是第一次生产）。
【信号】直陈母象过往经历。答案句是录音里专门交代 Semba 经历的一句 Semba has given birth before.，它直接陈述了关于这只母象本身的一项事实，与题干 "关于 Semba 我们了解到什么" 严丝合缝，是无需转折提示、直接点出的事实句。
【替换】has given birth before ↔has had babies before
生过=有过孩子
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 She weighs 130 kilograms. 盗用了录音里真实出现的数字 130 公斤，但录音说的是新生小象 she weighs nearly 130 kilograms，主语是 baby 而非母亲 Semba，把宝宝的体重安到了母亲头上，对象搞错。
借用原文：she weighs nearly 130 kilograms
C)
偷换概念
选项 She was brought from Africa. 借用了录音里的 Africa 一词，但录音只说 Semba, her mother, is a 30-year-old African elephant.——她是一头 "非洲象"（品种），并没有说 "她是从非洲被带来的"，把物种来源偷换成了运输来历。
借用原文：a 30-year-old African elephant
D)
原词陷阱
选项 She has a big family of six. 盗用了录音末尾的数字 six，但录音说 The new baby expands the zoo's elephant herd to six.——是 "动物园象群扩大到六只"，描述的是整个园区象群规模，而非 "母亲 Semba 有一个六口之家"，对象与口径都被改了。
借用原文：expands the zoo's elephant herd to six

stem: What does the report say about the birth of the new baby elephant?

options.text: It took 22 hours.
It had some complications.
It was smooth.
It was monitored by Dr. Sue Tygielski.

explanation:
【题目】What does the report say about the birth of the new baby elephant?

【翻译】报道中关于新生小象的出生说了什么?
A) 花了22小时。
B) 有一些并发症。
C) 很顺利。
D) 由Sue Tygielski博士监护。
【答案】C （细节题）It was smooth.
【定位】She said the elephant's birth went smoothly and that there were no complications.
她（动物园动物运营主管 Sue Tygielski 博士）说，这次大象的出生过程很顺利，没有出现任何并发症。
【信号】对出生过程的直接定性。答案句 the elephant's birth went smoothly and that there were no complications 是录音里唯一对 "出生过程怎么样" 下定性的句子，went smoothly 是正面评价词、no complications 是配套补充，直接回答了题干 "出生说了什么"，靠这个 "定性词" 信号即可锁定。
【替换】went smoothly ↔It was smooth.
副词转形容词同义
there were no complications ↔It was smooth.
无并发症佐证顺利
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 It took 22 hours. 盗用了数字 22，但录音里的 22 是 The pregnancy lasted 22 months.——是怀孕 22 个 "月"，且说的是孕期长短不是 "出生过程用了多久"，单位（hours↔months）和对象（出生过程↔整个孕期）双双被换。
借用原文：The pregnancy lasted 22 months
B)
与原文相反
选项 It had some complications. 直接盗用录音原词 complications，但录音是 there were no complications——明确说 "没有" 并发症，选项却说 "有一些"，把否定改成了肯定，极性正好相反。
借用原文：there were no complications
D)
张冠李戴
选项 It was monitored by Dr. Sue Tygielski. 把录音里真实出现的人名 Sue Tygielski 搬来当出生过程的监控者，但录音说被密切监控的是 during this pregnancy, she was closely monitored——监控的是 Semba 的 "孕期"，而 Tygielski 博士只是在 Dr. Sue Tygielski is the zoo's director 里被介绍头衔并转述 "出生很顺利"，并没说出生由她监控，把 "孕期被监控" 和 "这位博士" 硬拼到一起。
借用原文：during this pregnancy, she was closely monitored
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2021-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the restaurant?

options.text: It enjoyed great popularity.
It started business three years ago.
It was frequented by newly-weds.
It was built above the sea-water.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the restaurant?
【翻译】关于这家餐厅我们了解到什么?
A) 它非常受欢迎。
B) 它三年前开始营业。
C) 它经常有新婚夫妇光顾。
D) 它建在海面上。
【答案】D （细节题）It was built above the sea-water.
【定位】The restaurant was built on a wooden structure above the sea-water.
这家餐厅建在海水之上的一个木质结构上。
【信号】录音里唯一直接描述餐厅本身的句子。全篇只有这一句在正面描述餐厅这个事物本身—— The restaurant was built on a wooden structure above the sea-water.，其余句子讲的是戒指、经理、服务员的动作；当题问某事物的事实，就锁定录音里主语正是该事物、且在交代它属性的那句。
【替换】built on a wooden structure above the sea-water ↔It was built above the sea-water.
选项是原句的压缩概括

【排除】A)
未提及
It enjoyed great popularity. 说餐厅很受欢迎，但录音通篇只讲戒指失而复得，从未评价餐厅的人气或生意好坏，属于无中生有。
B)
原词陷阱
It started business three years ago. 借了录音开头的 three years ago，但 Three years ago, a couple was enjoying a meal 里这个时间是指三年前有对夫妇在此用餐、戒指掉落，根本不是讲餐厅三年前开业；把三年前从用餐时间偷换成开业时间，是典型的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Three years ago, a couple was enjoying a meal at a beach restaurant.
C)
过度推断
It was frequented by newly-weds. 说餐厅常被新婚夫妇光顾；录音只提到一对夫妇曾来用餐 a couple was enjoying a meal，既没说他们是新婚、更没说这里常有新婚夫妇来，属于由一对夫妇过度推断成常客群体。
借用原文：a couple was enjoying a meal at a beach restaurant
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2021-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the restaurant manager decide to do recently?

options.text: Expand his business on the beach.
Replace the restaurant's wooden deck.
Post a picture of his restaurant online.
Celebrate his silver wedding anniversary.

explanation:
【题目】What did the restaurant manager decide to do recently?
【翻译】这家餐厅的经理最近决定做什么?
A) 在海滩上扩展他的生意。
B) 更换餐厅的木质平台。
C) 在网上发布他餐厅的照片。
D) 庆祝他的银婚纪念日。
【答案】B （细节题）Replace the restaurant's wooden deck.
【定位】Recently, the restaurant manager Ryan Krivoy decided to replace the wooden deck and he found an old gold coin, some $100 bills and a silver wedding ring while replacing the deck.
最近，餐厅经理 Ryan Krivoy 决定更换那个木质平台，他在换平台时发现了一枚古老的金币、一些百元钞票和一枚银质结婚戒指。
【信号】decided to 直接给出经理的决定动作。the restaurant manager Ryan Krivoy decided to replace the wooden deck 里 decided to 后面紧跟的动词短语，就是题目要的决定；听到decided to 这种表决定的信号词，后面接的动作即是答案落点。
【替换】decided to replace the wooden deck ↔Replace the restaurant's wooden deck.
几乎同表述，仅补出所属

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Expand his business on the beach. 里的 beach 借自录音背景中的海边餐厅（beach restaurant），但录音从没说经理要扩张生意，他决定的是换平台 replace the wooden deck；把场景词 beach 拿来拼一个原文没有的动作，是原词陷阱加无中生有。
借用原文：a beach restaurant
C)
张冠李戴
Post a picture of his restaurant online. 里发照片到网上这件事，录音里做的人是女服务员 The restaurant waitress Sasha Formica posted a picture of the ring on Facebook.，且发的是戒指照片不是餐厅照片；既把动作的人从服务员张冠李戴到经理，又把戒指换成餐厅，双重偷换。
借用原文：The restaurant waitress Sasha Formica posted a picture of the ring on Facebook.
D)
原词陷阱
Celebrate his silver wedding anniversary. 里的 silver wedding 拼自录音的 silver wedding ring（银质结婚戒指），但 a silver wedding ring 说的是经理找到的一枚银戒指，根本不是他要庆祝结婚周年；把 silver wedding ring 截成 silver wedding，是诱人的原词陷阱。
借用原文：a silver wedding ring
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2021-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the waitress do about the recovered ring?

options.text: She sold it for two thousand dollars.
She took it to the restaurant manager.
She posted its picture on Facebook.
She returned it to its owner right away.

explanation:
【题目】What did the waitress do about the recovered ring?
【翻译】女服务员对找回的戒指做了什么?
A) 她以两千美元的价格把它卖了。
B) 她把它交给了餐厅经理。
C) 她在Facebook上发布了它的照片。
D) 她立即把它归还给了失主。
【答案】C （细节题）She posted its picture on Facebook.
【定位】The restaurant waitress Sasha Formica posted a picture of the ring on Facebook.
餐厅女服务员 Sasha Formica 把戒指的照片发到了脸书上。
【信号】主语正是 waitress、动作直接针对 ring。The restaurant waitress Sasha Formica posted a picture of the ring on Facebook. 这一句主语恰是题目问的 waitress、动作posted 又直接落在 ring 上，人、物、动作三者齐全；当题目锁定某人对某物的动作，就找主语是该人、宾语含该物的那一句。
【替换】posted a picture of the ring on Facebook ↔She posted its picture on Facebook.
几乎原句，仅用 its 回指 ring

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
She sold it for two thousand dollars. 里的两千美元搬自录音结尾 the gold coin was very rare. It was from 1855 and worth as much as $2,000，但这金额是说那枚稀有金币值两千美元、并非服务员把戒指卖了两千；既盗用了金额数字，又把对象从金币偷换成戒指，是原词陷阱加偷换概念。
借用原文：It was from 1855 and worth as much as $2,000.
B)
未提及
She took it to the restaurant manager. 说服务员把戒指交给经理，但录音里其实是经理先发现戒指 he found ... a silver wedding ring、服务员再去发照片，戒指并非由服务员上交经理；这是个原文没发生、还把人物关系方向弄反的干扰项。
D)
张冠李戴
She returned it to its owner right away. 借了录音里确有的归还戒指情节，但还戒指的是餐厅而非服务员 The restaurant mailed the ring back to the happy couple.，而且是失主三天后来认领 Three days later, the happy wife called to claim the ring 才寄还，并非right away（立刻）；张冠李戴加篡改时间。
借用原文：The restaurant mailed the ring back to the happy couple.
