stem: What is the popular view of obesity?

options.text: It is difficult to define.
It is a modern disease.
It has much to do with one's genes.
It results from a lack of self-control.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What is the popular view of obesity? 问的是「大众对肥胖的看法是什么」，要找的是原文中对大众观点的客观陈述，属于细节题。
【拆句】题干 What is the popular view of obesity? 是简单的 what is + 名词短语 结构，「of obesity」是 popular view 的修饰，限定看法的对象；结构简单，无陷阱。
【定位】Yet the widespread view is that obesity is self-induced and that it is entirely the individual's responsibility to do something about it.
然而，普遍的观点认为，肥胖是自找的，并且完全是个人自己的责任去采取行动加以解决。
【选项】A)
无中生有：抓住选项与原文方向相反的反例
It is difficult to define. 关于「肥胖难以定义」的说法在原文找不到任何依据；原文 P1明确给出了肥胖的定义（excess body fat …），反而是「易定义」的方向，与本选项相反。
B)
答非所问：与题干所问对象不对齐
It is a modern disease. 想说「肥胖是一种现代疾病」，但原文 the widespread view描述的大众观点是「自找的、个人责任」，从未把大众观点概括为「现代疾病」；而且大众观点恰恰是「不视为疾病」，与「modern disease」方向冲突。
C)
张冠李戴：用对立方观点冒充本方观点
It has much to do with one's genes. 实际上是 Wilding 教授的主张（more than 200 genes influence weight），而非大众观点；原文用 Yet 把大众观点与 Wilding 主张明确切开——大众恰好是不认基因这一论的。
D)
✓ 正确
obesity is self-induced ↔results from a lack of self-control
it is entirely the individual's responsibility to do something about it ↔a lack of self-control
预判要点「自找的 + 自己负责」分别对应到 results from a lack of self-control 中的「self-control」与「lack of」，D 是唯一同时覆盖这两点的选项。

stem: Why are some people opposed to labelling obesity as a disease?

options.text: Obese people would not feel responsible to take any action.
Obese people would not be able to afford the medical costs.
Obese people would be overwhelmed with anxiety.
Obese people would be discriminated against.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】Why are some people opposed to labelling obesity as a disease? 问的是反方反对的具体原因，对应原文反方论据的明确陈述，属于细节题。
【拆句】题干 Why are some people opposed to labelling obesity as a disease? 主干是 why + be + 主语 + 过去分词作表语 (opposed to)，labelling … as a disease 是动名词短语作 to的宾语；结构稍长但平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】But labelling obesity as a disease "risks reducing autonomy, disempowering and robbing people of the intrinsic motivation that is such an important enabler of change."
但把肥胖定性为疾病「有可能削弱人的自主性，让人失去权能感，并夺走对改变如此重要的内在动力。」
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
reducing autonomy, disempowering and robbing people of the intrinsic motivation ↔ not feel responsible to take any action
other common diseases, such as high blood pressure and diabetes, require people to take action to manage their condition ↔to take any action
预判要点「失去自主与改变动力」在四个选项里只有 Obese people would not feel responsible to take any action. 能落地——「失去内在动力 + 失去自主」≈「不觉得自己有责任行动」。
B)
无中生有：把次相关话题拉来当依据
Obese people would not be able to afford the medical costs. 关于「肥胖者支付不起医疗费用」在原文找不到任何对应；原文末段提到的费用相关内容是 health insurance and clinical guidelines promote treatment with drugs and surgery，谈的是谁受益（机构与药企），不是谁付不起。
C)
偷换概念：把动力问题偷换为情绪问题
Obese people would be overwhelmed with anxiety. 把原文「失去 intrinsic motivation」（失去改变的内在动力）偷换为「被焦虑压垮」（情绪问题）——前者关乎主体动力是否减弱，后者关乎情绪是否上升，方向不一致。
D)
张冠李戴：把正方支持理由当反方反对理由
Obese people would be discriminated against. 实际上是 Wilding 在 should help reduce the stigma and discrimination experienced by many people with obesity提到的——把肥胖视为疾病可以**减少**歧视，是 Wilding 支持贴标签的理由；本题问的是**反对**贴标签的理由，正反阵营完全相反。

stem: What does Dr. Richard Pile think of the dictionary definition of disease?

options.text: It is of no use in understanding obesity.
It is too inclusive and thus lacks clarity.
It helps little to solve patients' problems.
It matters little to the debate over obesity.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does Dr. Richard Pile think of the dictionary definition of disease? 问的是具名人物对一个具体概念的看法，原文中有他直接的评价句，属于细节题。
【拆句】题干 What does Dr. Richard Pile think of the dictionary definition of disease? 主干是what + do/does + 主语 + think of + 宾语，think of 是固定搭配「对……的看法」；结构常规，无陷阱。
【定位】He believes that the dictionary definition of disease "is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease" and says the question is not whether we can, but whether we should, and to what end.
他认为，对 disease 一词的字典定义「过于含糊，以至于我们几乎可以把任何东西都归入疾病」，并说问题不在于「我们能不能」，而在于「我们该不该，以及目的何在」。
【选项】A)
过度推断：把局部批评放大成全盘否定
It is of no use in understanding obesity. 把 Pile 的「定义含糊」推得过远——他只是说定义太宽泛而已，没说「字典定义对理解肥胖毫无用处」；恰恰相反，他的论证起点正是「按字典定义看，肥胖确实可被归入 disease」（the question is not whether we can）。
B)
✓ 正确
is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease ↔ too inclusive and thus lacks clarity
is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease ↔and thus
预判要点「过于含糊 + 范围过广」在选项里精准对位为 too inclusive and thus lacks clarity，是唯一覆盖两个语义点的选项。
C)
答非所问：偷偷把问域换到下一步
It helps little to solve patients' problems. 谈的是「字典定义对解决患者问题帮助不大」，把焦点从「定义本身的特性」偏移到「定义对患者的影响」；题干 What does Dr. Richard Pile think of the dictionary definition of disease? 问的是 Pile 对**定义本身**的看法。
D)
与原文相反：极性反转
It matters little to the debate over obesity. 说「字典定义对肥胖之争没什么关系」，但 Pile 在 P3 整段都在围绕字典定义展开批评，并以此为立论起点（the dictionary definition of disease is so vague）；可见字典定义对他**至关重要**，与「matters little」语义相反。

stem: What is Dr. Richard Pile's concern about classifying obesity as a disease?

options.text: It may affect obese people's quality of life.
It may accelerate the spread of obesity.
It may cause a shortage of doctors.
It may do little good to patients.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What is Dr. Richard Pile's concern about classifying obesity as a disease? 问的是 Pile担忧的具体内容，原文末段有明确陈述，属于细节题。
【拆句】题干 What is Dr. Richard Pile's concern about classifying obesity as a disease? 主干是what + be + 主语，「about classifying obesity as a disease」是 concern 的修饰短语，限定担忧的对象；结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】What's more, making obesity a disease "may not benefit patients, but it will benefit healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical industry when health insurance and clinical guidelines promote treatment with drugs and surgery," he warns.
此外，他警告说，把肥胖变成一种疾病「未必使患者受益，但当医保和临床指南推动用药物和手术进行治疗时，它将让医疗机构和制药业受益」。
【选项】A)
无中生有：用合理却未现的概念顶替
It may affect obese people's quality of life. 关于「影响肥胖者生活质量」在原文找不到对应表述；Pile 的担忧落在「医疗效用」和「自主与动力」上，不是「生活质量」这个独立维度。
B)
与原文相反/混搭：把背景趋势伪装成反方担忧
It may accelerate the spread of obesity. 说贴疾病标签会「加速肥胖蔓延」，但原文Pile 担忧的是「会让人失去改变动力」（robbing people of the intrinsic motivation）——这是「不利于改善」的间接后果，但与「加速蔓延」是两码事；而且P1 中肥胖的扩张趋势是 Wilding 立场的背景数据，与 Pile 的担忧无关。
C)
无中生有：用相邻话题词凭空造命题
It may cause a shortage of doctors. 关于「导致医生短缺」在原文找不到任何依据；原文末段提到 healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical industry 会受益，恰恰是「医疗供给方得利」的方向，与「短缺」相反。
D)
✓ 正确
may not benefit patients ↔may do little good to patients
may not benefit patients, but it will benefit healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical industry ↔do little good to patients
四个选项里只有 It may do little good to patients. 在主体（患者）与极性（益处不大）两端都与 Pile 的核心担忧一致；其余选项要么换了担忧对象，要么改了担忧内容。

options.text: It helps raise children's awareness of gender roles.

explanation:

【拆句】题干What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.?是个特殊疑问句，主干是 What do we learn from the first paragraph，about early childhood education in the U.S. 是 learn 的话题补足，整体平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【定位】Nationwide, only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male in the U.S. Experts say this can have an impact on young children whose understanding of gender roles and identity are rapidly forming.
全美范围内，幼教队伍中男性仅约百分之三。专家说这会对处于性别角色与身份认知快速形成期的幼儿产生影响。

与原文相反
It helps raise children's awareness of gender roles.说幼教「帮助提升」孩子的性别角色意识，但原文只说男教师缺失「影响」孩子正在形成的性别角色认知，并未说幼教在主动培养这种意识，把「被动塑造期」误读为「主动培养」。
B)
张冠李戴
It exposes children to different ways of interaction.说的是文中「师资多样性」才能带来的好处，原文限定语是having access to diverse teachers，而题干问的是 early childhood education 整体——把条件子句的局部好处当成整体属性，是张冠李戴。
C)
✓ 正确
only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male ↔a lack of male teachers

预判是「男教师缺失带来负面影响」，It is negatively impacted by a lack of male teachers.正好把「缺失」与「负面影响」两块信息都点到了，是定位句的浓缩同义版。
D)

尽管完全避免身体接触听起来很安全，可以不冒犯任何人，但缺乏触碰可能在人际关系中暗示冷漠的态度或漠不关心。

✓ 正确

options.text: What social class people belong to.
How civilized the communicators are.
What family background people come from.
How close the communicators' relationships are.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does physical contact in communication suggest? 问"肢体接触暗示了什么"，答案是原文一条直接陈述，不涉及全文主旨或作者态度。
【拆句】Q47 是疑问句，主干 "physical contact ... suggest"，in communication 是介词短语作后置定语修饰 physical contact。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Haptics in communication often suggest the level of intimacy.
沟通中的触觉行为常常暗示人际关系的亲密程度。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文谈的是 intimacy（亲密程度），没有涉及阶层。
B)
无中生有
原文谈的是亲密度、不是文明程度。
C)
无中生有
原文没有把肢体接触和家庭出身挂钩。
D)
✓ 正确
the level of intimacy ↔How close the communicators' relationships are
选项 How close the communicators' relationships are. 与预判"暗示亲密程度"完全等值，且 communicators 与原文 in communication 呼应。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页

stem: What do we learn about people in high-contact cultures?

options.text: They are sensitive to the way people express their emotions.
They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions.
They attach great importance to close ties among people.
They tend to be more open in interpersonal relationships.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do we learn about people in high-contact cultures? 问"我们对高接触文化的人了解到了什么"，要求复述原文对该群体的具体描述。
【拆句】Q48 主干 "What do we learn about people"，in high-contact cultures 是后置定语，限定 people 的身份。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】People from the rest of the world, such as Latin America, are considered to be in high-contact cultures, where they tend to expect touching in social interactions and feel more comfortable with physical closeness.
世界其余地区的人，比如拉丁美洲，被认为属于高接触文化；在这种文化里，人们倾向于在社交互动中期待触碰，并对身体上的亲近感觉更自在。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文没说他们对"情感表达方式"敏感，只说他们期待触碰本身。
B)
✓ 正确
they tend to expect touching in social interactions ↔ They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions
选项 They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions. 等同于预判中的"把触碰当社交常态"，且与原文 expect touching in social interactions 在介词短语上一字不差。
C)
过度推断
原文只说"对身体接近觉得舒服"，没说他们"重视亲密的人际关系"——这是从触觉偏好做的过度推论。
D)
过度推断
原文谈触碰频率、舒适度，没有谈"开放程度"这种性格倾向。

stem: What do we learn about social customs in Arabian countries?

options.text: Men can show friendship in public through physical affection.
Non-traditional romantic relationships are simply unacceptable.
Physical contact between unfamiliar people is negatively perceived.
People of different ages and genders show affection in different ways.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do we learn about social customs in Arabian countries? 问"我们了解到阿拉伯国家的社交风俗是什么"，原文有直接描述，属客观信息复述。
【拆句】Q49 主干 "What do we learn about social customs"，in Arabian countries 是后置定语限定 social customs。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】In contrast, in certain Arabian, African, and Asian countries, men can publicly hold hands or show physical affection as signs of brotherhood or friendship while these behaviors may suggest a romantic relationship in other parts of the world.
相比之下，在某些阿拉伯、非洲和亚洲国家，男性可以公开牵手或表现身体上的亲热，作为兄弟情谊或友谊的象征；而这些行为在世界其他地方则可能暗示着恋爱关系。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
men can publicly hold hands or show physical affection as signs of brotherhood or friendship ↔ Men can show friendship in public through physical affection
选项 Men can show friendship in public through physical affection. 把定位句前半句的所有要素重新排序后完整保留：主语 men、情态 can、动作公开化、目的友谊、手段身体亲热，与预判一致。
B)
偷换概念
原文只说异性非家庭成员的肢体接触在阿拉伯国家被负面看待，没有讨论"非传统的恋爱关系"。
C)
偷换概念
原文限制的是 persons of opposite sexes who are not family members（非家庭成员的异性），而不是"不认识的人"——选项把性别条件偷换成了熟悉度。
D)
无中生有
原文只提性别，没说"不同年龄的人表达感情方式不同"。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页

stem: What does the author tell us to do concerning tactile communication?

options.text: Lay emphasis on nonverbal communication.
Learn to use appropriate body language first.
Pay attention to the differences between genders.
Take other people's preference into consideration.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author tell us to do concerning tactile communication? 问"作者就触觉沟通让我们做什么"，对应原文最后一句的建议，是直接陈述而非推断。
【拆句】Q50 主干 "What does the author tell us to do"，concerning tactile communication是 concerning 引导的介词短语作状语，限定建议涉及的话题。concerning=关于。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Therefore, if you are someone who loves to show physical affection, you should not be afraid to show it or drastically change your behaviors—just ask for consent beforehand!
因此，如果你是那种喜欢表现身体亲昵的人，你不必害怕表达，也不必大幅改变自己的行为——只要事先征得对方同意就好！
【选项】A)
答非所问
原文虽然第二段把肢体接触归在非言语沟通下，但末段并未让读者"侧重"非言语沟通——题目问的是末段的建议。
B)
无中生有
原文并未要求读者"先学会用恰当的肢体语言"——作者只让你"问"对方愿不愿意，并未提学习这件事。
C)
以偏概全
原文第五段确实提及性别在拉美贴面礼中起作用 gender matters more for them，但这是举例支撑"复杂因素"，并非作者最终给读者的建议。
D)
✓ 正确
just ask for consent beforehand ↔Take other people's preference into consideration
选项 Take other people's preference into consideration. 把作者末句的具体建议"事先征得同意"抽象为"顾及他人偏好"，与预判方向一致，且未超出原文支持范围。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页

stem: What does the author say about the world today?

options.text: It faces problems that are getting more varied and complicated.
It has done away with many of the traditional ways of thinking.
It is undergoing radical and profound changes.
It is witnessing various types of innovations.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say about the world today? 用 What does ... say about ... 直接问对象的属性，没有 infer/suggest/imply 这类推断信号。
【拆句】What does the author say about the world today? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干the author say，介词短语 about the world today 限定 say 的内容；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】From climate change to the ongoing pandemic and beyond, the issues facing today's world are increasingly complex and dynamic.
从气候变化到当下这场大流行病再到更远的将来，当今世界面临的问题愈发复杂多变。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
complex and dynamic ↔varied and complicated
are increasingly ↔are getting more
the issues facing today's world ↔It faces problems
It faces problems that are getting more varied and complicated 把定位句的主语、谓语、表语三处都做了同义替换，没增没减，符合「正确项=定位句同义替换」的范式。
B)
偷换概念
requires new approaches that extend beyond traditional ways of thinking 只是说「需要超越传统思路」，并未说「已经摒弃了传统思路」，把 require beyond 偷换为done away with。
C)
过度推断
原文只说 issues 变得 complex and dynamic，并没有说世界「正在经历根本性、深刻变化」这种更强的程度判断。
D)
偷换概念
原文 may spark this type of innovation 只是说成长型思维可能「催生」创新，并未说世界「正在见证各种创新」；选项把对未来潜能的描述偷换为对当下现象的事实陈述。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页

stem: What did Professor O'Keefe find in his earlier studies?

options.text: People's interests tend to change with age.
People's interests determine their mindsets.
People are divided about the nature of interest.
People of different ages have different mindsets.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What did Professor O'Keefe find in his earlier studies? 直问「发现了什么」，要的是原文已陈述的事实，不是推断。
【拆句】What did Professor O'Keefe find in his earlier studies? 是 What 引导的疑问句，主语 Professor O'Keefe，谓语 find，介词短语 in his earlier studies 锁定时间范围；结构清晰。
【定位】Professor O'Keefe established in earlier studies that people hold different beliefs about the nature of interest.
奥基夫教授在早期研究中确立：人们对「兴趣的本质」持有不同的看法。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文谈的是不同人对兴趣本质的不同看法，没有任何句子涉及「兴趣随年龄变化」这一时间维度。
B)
与原文相反
原文 Those with a growth mindset of interest tend to believe that interests can be developed 是先有 mindset、再决定对 interest 的看法；选项却说 interests determine mindsets，主从颠倒。
C)
✓ 正确
hold different beliefs ↔are divided about the nature of interest ↔about the nature of interest
people ↔People
People are divided about the nature of interest 与定位句结构几乎一一对应，只把hold different beliefs 改写为 are divided，正是「正确项=定位句同义替换」的范式。
D)
无中生有
原文区分人群依据是「思维倾向」（growth vs fixed），与年龄毫无关系；选项凭空引入 ages 维度。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2021-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What is the focus of Professor O'Keefe's recent research?

options.text: How boundaries can be removed between arts and science disciplines.
How feasible it is to create new disciplines like computational economics.
How students in arts and sciences view the two types of mindset of interest.
How a growth mindset of interest can contribute to cross-disciplinary thinking.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What is the focus of Professor O'Keefe's recent research? 直问焦点，对应原文的目的句，仍属定位题而非推断题。
【拆句】What is the focus of Professor O'Keefe's recent research? 是 What 引导的疑问句，主干 the focus is what，of 短语层层修饰：of ... recent research 限定焦点的归属；结构清晰。
【定位】Building on these findings, the latest research examined how a growth mindset of interest can boost integrative thinking across the traditional disciplinary boundaries of arts and sciences.
在前述发现的基础上，最新研究考察了「兴趣的成长型思维倾向」如何促进跨越文理传统学科边界的整合性思维。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文是研究「成长型思维如何促进跨学科思维」，并不是研究「学科边界如何被去除」；boundaries 一词被借用，但研究对象偷换。
B)
偷换概念
原文只是用 computational economics 一词举例佐证研究结论，并未把「创建这种新学科是否可行」当作研究焦点。
C)
偷换概念
研究的是成长型思维对跨学科思维的促进作用，不是「文理学生如何看待两种思维」；主体与对象都被偷换。
D)
✓ 正确
a growth mindset of interest can boost ↔a growth mindset of interest can contribute to
integrative thinking across the traditional disciplinary boundaries ↔ cross-disciplinary thinking
how ... can boost ↔How ... can contribute to
How a growth mindset of interest can contribute to cross-disciplinary thinking 把boost 换成 contribute to、把 integrative ... across boundaries 浓缩为 cross-disciplinary thinking，主语与从句结构原样保留。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2021-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author want to illustrate with the example of smartphones?

options.text: Hi-tech products are needed in interdisciplinary research.
Improved technology gives birth to highly popular products.
Making innovative products needs multidisciplinary knowledge.
Hi-tech products can boost people's integrative thinking.

explanation:
【答案】C （例证目的题）
【判型】What does the author want to illustrate with the example of smartphones? 同时出现example 与 illustrate，明牌例证目的题。
【拆句】What does the author want to illustrate with the example of smartphones? What 疑问句，谓语 want to illustrate（不定式作宾语），with 短语 with the example of smartphones 指明所用的例子；结构清晰。
【定位】Take smartphones for example. You need not only computer science and engineering knowledge, but also an understanding of psychology and visual design to create a better product.
以智能手机为例：你不仅需要计算机科学与工程学的知识，还需要心理学与视觉设计方面的理解，才能造出更好的产品。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文是举智能手机说明「制造好产品需要多学科」，不是说「跨学科研究需要高科技产品」；主客体倒置。
B)
偷换概念
原文重点在「需要多种知识」，不在「技术进步催生了热门产品」；选项偷换了论证目的。
C)
✓ 正确
not only computer science and engineering knowledge, but also an understanding of psychology and visual design ↔multidisciplinary knowledge
to create a better product ↔Making innovative products
You need ↔needs
Making innovative products needs multidisciplinary knowledge 把例子里四类知识整体收束为 multidisciplinary knowledge，把 to create a better product 转写为主语Making innovative products，整句保留 need 关系。
D)
与原文相反
原文是「需要整合思维 → 造出好产品」，选项却说「高科技产品 → 推动整合思维」，把例子的目的反过来当因。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页

stem: What is the author's suggestion to those who are seeking employment?

options.text: Learning practical skills.
Broadening their interests.
Staying safe in the pandemic.
Knowing their pressing issues.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What is the author's suggestion to those who are seeking employment? 直问作者的建议是什么，对应原文具体语句，不是宏观主旨。
【拆句】What is the author's suggestion to those who are seeking employment? What 疑问句，主干 the author's suggestion is what；to those 是介宾短语，who are seeking employment 是限定 those 的定语从句；结构清晰。
【定位】Having a growth mindset of interest can help job seekers expand their interests and become more adaptable to different fields, and take the initiative to learn new skills.
拥有兴趣的成长型思维，能帮助求职者拓展兴趣、对不同领域更具适应力，并主动学习新技能。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文 take the initiative to learn new skills 强调「主动学新技能」，重心在 take the initiative；选项掐头去尾只留 learning skills 还加上原文没有的 practical 限定词。
B)
✓ 正确
expand their interests ↔Broadening their interests
their interests ↔their interests
Broadening their interests 只是把 expand their interests 改写为 Broadening their interests 的动名词形式，与原文建议三件事中的第一件完全对应；选项虽只覆盖三件事中的一件，但其他选项无一对得上，B 仍是唯一合规答案。
C)
无中生有
原文只把疫情列为背景说明就业压力大，从未给出「在疫情中保持安全」这条建议；属于借背景词造选项。
D)
偷换概念
This is a pressing issue 是作者用来说明问题紧迫性的描述，不是给求职者的建议；选项把背景描述偷换成建议对象。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页

stem: What do we learn about the new study from the news report?

options.text: It studied the effects of exercise on sleep.
Its participants came from various walks of life.
Its findings confirmed those of previous studies.
It ran for as long as some thirty years.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the new study from the news report?
【翻译】从新闻报道中我们对这项新研究了解到什么?
A) 它研究了运动对睡眠的影响。
B) 它的参与者来自各行各业。
C) 它的研究结果证实了先前研究的结论。
D) 它持续了长达约三十年的时间。
【答案】D （细节题）It ran for as long as some thirty years.
【定位】They were followed for approximately three decades.
他们被跟踪研究了大约三十年。
【信号】时长事实 three decades。答案句的信号是一个明确的时长数据 followed for approximately three decades，three decades 即三十年；新闻里凡出现具体年限、数字，往往就是出题落点，听到就应锁定。
【替换】approximately three decades ↔as long as some thirty years
three decades = thirty years
They were followed for ↔It ran for
被跟踪＝研究持续

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说研究的是运动对睡眠的影响，盗用了录音 questions about sleep and exercise 里真出现过的 sleep、exercise 两个原词；但录音里这两项只是参与者被问到的调查内容之一，本研究的真正主题是含糖饮料与死亡风险，并非研究运动对睡眠的影响，听到原词就选正中圈套。
借用原文：questions about sleep and exercise and health
B)
与原文相反
B 说参与者来自各行各业（various walks of life），但录音明说 Participants worked in the health profession.，即都是医疗卫生行业的人；B 与原文事实相反，是对参与者构成的曲解。
借用原文：Participants worked in the health profession.
C)
未提及
C 说本研究证实了以往研究的结论，但录音通篇没提与任何 previous studies 的比较，反而在结尾强调 it did not prove that drinks with added sugar cause early death——只是关联、未下定论；C 属录音根本没说的内容。

stem: What is the scientists' recommendation?

options.text: Eating more vegetables instead of meats.
Drinking water instead of beverages with added sugar.
Consuming more energy drinks and sports drinks.
Forming the habit of exercising regularly.

explanation:
【题目】What is the scientists' recommendation?
【翻译】科学家们的建议是什么?
A) 多吃蔬菜而不是肉类。
B) 喝水而不是含添加糖的饮料。
C) 摄入更多能量饮料和运动饮料。
D) 养成定期锻炼的习惯。
【答案】B （细节题）Drinking water instead of beverages with added sugar.
【定位】They argue we should replace them with other drinks, with water being the best choice.
他们主张我们应当用其他饮品来替代含糖饮料，其中水是最佳选择。
【信号】建议句 should + 最佳选择。答案句同时出现两个强信号：建议词 we should replace them 和择优表达 water being the best choice；should 表建议、the best choice 直接点名最优做法，是这句成为答案句的标志。
【替换】replace them with other drinks, with water being the best choice ↔ Drinking water instead of beverages with added sugar
用水替换＝喝水代替
them ↔beverages with added sugar
代词 them 还原即含糖饮料

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说多吃蔬菜代替肉，盗用了录音 not eating enough vegetables 与 consuming too much meat 里出现过的 vegetables、meat；但录音里这两项是研究者考虑过的其他影响健康的因素，不是科学家给出的建议，把干扰因素当成建议正是陷阱。
借用原文：lack of exercise and not eating enough vegetables
C)
与原文相反
C 让人多喝能量饮料和运动饮料，盗用录音 soda, energy drinks and sports drinks 里的原词；但录音明确说这些正是含糖饮料、应当限制，C 把该少喝的说成多喝，与原文意思相反。
借用原文：These beverages included soda, energy drinks and sports drinks.
D)
原词陷阱
D 说养成规律运动的习惯，盗用录音 lack of exercise 里的 exercise；但运动同样只是研究者排查的其他健康因素之一，录音从未把规律运动作为科学家的建议提出，D 答非所问。
借用原文：These factors included lack of exercise

stem: What did German police say about a 64-year-old man?

options.text: He asked them about his lost paintings.
He knew the owner of two missing paintings.
He left his paintings at a highway rest stop.
He found two 17th-century oil paintings.

explanation:
【题目】What did German police say about a 64-year-old man?
【翻译】德国警方关于一名64岁男子说了什么?
A) 他向警方询问他丢失的画作。
B) 他知道两幅失踪画作的主人。
C) 他把自己的画作落在了高速公路休息站。
D) 他发现了两幅17世纪的油画。
【答案】D （细节题）He found two 17th-century oil paintings.
【定位】Police said a 64-year-old man found the paintings in a garbage pile at a highway rest stop last month.
警方称，上个月一名 64 岁的男子在一处高速公路服务区的垃圾堆里发现了这些画。
【信号】对象出场即答案句。录音念到 a 64-year-old man 这个题干点名的对象时，紧跟其后的动词 found the paintings 就是答案落点——细节题的答案句信号，就是题干那个专有对象一出现。
【替换】found the paintings ↔found two 17th-century oil paintings
the paintings 还原为完整名称
【排除】A)
与原文相反
选项把 his lost paintings 安在男子头上，可录音说的是他在垃圾堆里发现（found）画并上交，画不是他丢的、更不是他来打听自己丢的画，方向正好反了。
B)
原词陷阱
选项盗用了录音 owners、rightful owner 里反复出现的 owner 一词，编出 "他认识两幅失踪画的主人"，可录音只说警方在找失主，从没说这位男子认识失主，是听到 owner 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：if the rightful owner is not found
C)
原词陷阱
选项盗用录音 at a highway rest stop 这个真地点，却把动作篡改成 left（把画留在那里），而录音说的是他在那里 found（发现）画，地点是真的、动作是假的，典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：at a highway rest stop

stem: What is the art expert's conclusion about the two framed paintings?

options.text: They are imitations.
They are originals.
They were stolen by an Italian boy.
They came from the same artist.

explanation:
【题目】What is the art expert's conclusion about the two framed paintings?

【翻译】艺术专家对这两幅装裱画作得出了什么结论?
A) 它们是仿制品。
B) 它们是真品。
C) 它们被一个意大利男孩偷走了。
D) 它们出自同一位艺术家之手。
【答案】B （细节题）They are originals.
【定位】An initial assessment by an art expert concluded the two framed paintings were originals, police said.
警方称，一位艺术专家的初步鉴定认为这两幅装框画作是真迹。
【信号】结论动词 concluded 引出定性。录音里 An initial assessment by an art expert concluded 用 concluded（得出结论）这个下结论的信号词，后面紧跟的 were originals就是专家的定性，正是题干要的答案。
【替换】were originals ↔They are originals.
几乎原句保留
【排除】A)
与原文相反
选项 imitations（赝品）与专家结论 were originals（真迹）意思正好相反，是把定性极性反转的陷阱；A、B 一真一假对立，听准 originals 就该排除 A。
借用原文：were originals
C)
原词陷阱
选项盗用录音第 4 段 the Italian artist 的 Italian 和 a painting of a boy 的 boy，拼成 "被一个意大利男孩偷走"，可录音根本没提偷画，画里有个男孩、画家是意大利人都被偷换成了偷窃情节，原词陷阱。
借用原文：a painting of a boy by the 17th-century Dutch artist
D)
与原文相反
录音第 4 段明说一幅是意大利画家 Pietro Bellotti 所作、另一幅出自荷兰画家 Samuel van Hoogstraten，是两位不同画家；选项却说出自 same artist，与原文事实直接矛盾。
借用原文：One is a landscape painted by the Italian artist Pietro Bellotti dating to 1665. The other is a painting of a boy by the 17th-century Dutch artist Samuel van Hoogstraten

stem: What did the four-year-old girl attempt to do?

options.text: Look after her grandfather.
Leave the remote cold region.
Save her sick grandmother.
Flee from the threat of bears.

explanation:
【题目】What did the four-year-old girl attempt to do?
【翻译】这个四岁女孩试图做什么？
A) 照顾她的祖父。
B) 离开偏远寒冷地区。
C) 救她生病的祖母。
D) 逃离熊的威胁。
【答案】C （细节题）Save her sick grandmother.
【定位】A four-year-old girl has walked eight kilometers through a snowy forest to seek help for her sick grandmother who later died of a heart attack.
一个四岁女孩徒步八公里穿过白雪覆盖的森林，去为她生病的奶奶求助，奶奶后来死于心脏病发作。
【信号】目的状语 to seek help for 直指意图。本句用不定式目的状语 to seek help for her sick grandmother 点明女孩此行的目的——"问意图"的题，答案就藏在 to do 这个目的状语里，这是定位的信号。
【替换】to seek help for her sick grandmother ↔Save her sick grandmother.
为奶奶求助=救奶奶（概括同义）

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音第 2 段确实念到 her blind grandfather，A 项 Look after her grandfather. 就盗用这个"爷爷"原词制造"听到就选"的诱惑；但女孩求助的对象是奶奶不是爷爷，对象张冠李戴。
借用原文：her blind grandfather
B)
原词陷阱
录音念到 through a remote region in Siberia，B 项 Leave the remote cold region. 盗用 remote region 把女孩动机歪曲成"为自己离开寒冷地区"；实际她是为奶奶求助而穿越该地区，不是想离开它。
借用原文：through a remote region in Siberia
D)
原词陷阱
录音念到 braved the threat of bears，D 项 Flee from the threat of bears. 把这个醒目画面词搬进选项；但原文是说女孩"冒着"熊的威胁去求助，不是"为逃避熊"才出门，目的被偷换。
借用原文：braved the threat of bears

stem: What do we learn from the news report about the girl's mother?

options.text: She has to face a criminal charge.
She was found lying motionless in the snow.
She searched for her daughter in freezing cold.
She works in childcare services.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the news report about the girl's mother?
【翻译】从新闻报道中我们了解到关于这个女孩母亲的什么信息？
A) 她不得不面临刑事指控。
B) 她被发现一动不动地躺在雪地里。
C) 她在严寒中寻找她的女儿。
D) 她在儿童看护服务机构工作。
【答案】A （细节题）She has to face a criminal charge.
【定位】As a result, the girl's mother is facing a criminal case. She stands accused of leaving a minor in danger in the care of the elderly.
结果，女孩的母亲正面临一桩刑事案件。她被指控把一个未成年人置于危险之中，交由老人照看。
【信号】专门讲 mother 的那句直接应答题干。录音里唯一正面交代母亲的句子是 the girl's mother is facing a criminal case，紧接着用 stands accused of 补充指控内容——题干专问母亲，答案就锁定在这"专讲母亲"的两句上。
【替换】is facing a criminal case ↔She has to face a criminal charge.
面临刑事案件=要面临刑事指控（近义词替换）

【排除】B)
张冠李戴
录音第 1 段说"奶奶"被发现时 motionless，B 项 She was found lying motionless in the snow. 把这个画面安到"母亲"头上；motionless 是原词，但躺着不动的是奶奶不是妈妈。
借用原文：waking up to find her grandmother motionless
C)
未提及
录音通篇讲严寒（negative 26 degrees Celsius 等），C 项 She searched for her daughter in freezing cold. 借"严寒"主题编出"母亲冒寒找女儿"的情节；但原文从没说母亲外出寻找，是女孩自己出门求助。
D)
原词陷阱
录音念到 investigation from childcare services，D 项 She works in childcare services.盗用 childcare services 这个机构词；但原文是该机构要"调查"这件事，不是说母亲"在那儿工作"。
借用原文：She also faces investigation from childcare services

stem: What happened to the little girl according to the news report?

options.text: She was found in a forest after three days.
She lay totally unconscious for three days.
She suffered from the effects of severe cold.
She was finally rescued by her relatives.

explanation:
【题目】What happened to the little girl according to the news report?
【翻译】根据新闻报道，这个小女孩发生了什么事？
A) 她在三天后被发现在森林里。
B) 她完全失去意识躺了三天。
C) 她遭受了严寒的影响。
D) 她最终被她的亲属救出。
【答案】C （细节题）She suffered from the effects of severe cold.
【定位】But though she was suffering from the effects of extreme cold, the child reportedly suffered no life-threatening effects.
但尽管她正遭受极度寒冷带来的影响，据报道这个孩子并未出现危及生命的状况。
【信号】末段交代结果，让步状语 though 引出真实状况。答案落在末段交代女孩结局的一句，信号是让步连词 though：though 引出的 suffering from the effects of extreme cold 正是女孩的真实遭遇，后半句"无生命危险"是补充，问遭遇就抓 though 这半句。
【替换】suffering from the effects of extreme cold ↔She suffered from the effects of severe cold.
extreme cold=severe cold（近义形容词替换）

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
录音末句说"去年一个三岁男孩" survived alone for three days in a remote forest，A 项She was found in a forest after three days. 盗用 forest 和 three days，把男孩的旧事安到这个女孩头上。
借用原文：a three-year-old boy survived alone for three days
B)
过度推断
B 项 She lay totally unconscious for three days. 借男孩那句的 three days 拼出"女孩昏迷三天"；原文既没说女孩昏迷，也没说她经历三天，no life-threatening effects 反而说明她无大碍，程度被严重夸大。
借用原文：the child reportedly suffered no life-threatening effects
D)
与原文相反
录音里女孩是"独自外出为亲属求助"，D 项 She was finally rescued by her relatives. 把方向反过来说成"被亲属救出"；relatives 算原文涉及的关系词，但谁救谁正相反。
借用原文：to seek help for her sick grandmother

stem: What does the woman say about her new friend Susan?

options.text: She shows a real passion for taking photos.
She has just returned from her hometown.
She comes from the city of Cape Town.
She has a truly amazing appearance.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about her new friend Susan?
【翻译】女士对她的新朋友Susan有何评价?
A) 她对摄影表现出真正的热情。
B) 她刚从家乡回来。
C) 她来自开普敦市。
D) 她有着真正惊人的外表。
【答案】C （细节题）She comes from the city of Cape Town.
【定位】Her name is Susan and she's from South Africa.
她叫 Susan，来自南非。

【信号】女士介绍朋友的开场陈述。对话一开口，女士就主动交代 she's from South Africa，这是"被介绍人的出身"，正面回答了"关于 Susan"。随后第5段又点出家乡 It's called Cape Town.，两处合起来坐实她来自开普敦这座城市。
【替换】she's from South Africa ↔She comes from the city of Cape Town.
from = comes from，国家细化到城市
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音说的是 She has very cool photos on her social media.——朋友圈有好照片，并没说她"热爱拍照"。选项把"有酷照片"偷换成"对拍照有热情"，是听到 photos 就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：She has very cool photos on her social media.
B)
原词陷阱
录音里 hometown 出现在 The photos of her hometown look amazing.，说的是"家乡的照片好看"，根本没说她"刚从家乡回来"。选项借 hometown 这个原词编了个时间动作。
借用原文：The photos of her hometown look amazing.
D)
张冠李戴
录音里 amazing 形容的是 The photos of her hometown look amazing.——家乡的照片惊艳，不是说"她本人长相惊艳"。选项把形容"照片"的词安到了"她的外貌"上。
借用原文：The photos of her hometown look amazing.

stem: What does the woman say about Table Mountain?

options.text: It is as famous as Cape Town.
It has a flat surface at the top.
It is green and free from pollution.
It was named by European settlers.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about Table Mountain?
【翻译】女士对桌山有何评价?
A) 它和开普敦一样出名。
B) 它的顶部有一个平坦的表面。
C) 它是绿色的且没有污染。
D) 它是由欧洲殖民者命名的。
【答案】B （细节题）It has a flat surface at the top.
【定位】The mountain is called Table Mountain because it's flat at the top.
这座山叫桌山，因为它顶部是平的。
【信号】因果 because 后给出命名缘由即特征。The mountain is called Table Mountain because it's flat at the top. 中 because 后那句才是关键——它解释了山名的由来，也正面给出了这座山的物理特征"顶部平坦"。because 引出的正是答案落点。
【替换】it's flat at the top ↔It has a flat surface at the top.
flat at the top = flat surface at the top

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音提到 It's called Cape Town. 是城市名，但从没说桌山"和开普敦一样有名"。选项借Cape Town 这个原词，凭空造了个"知名度比较"。
借用原文：It's called Cape Town.
C)
偷换概念
录音说 it's very green and windy——这是形容开普敦这座城市"很绿、多风"，既不是说桌山，也没说"无污染"。选项把 green 扩大成 free from pollution，程度被悄悄拔高。
借用原文：it's very green and windy
D)
张冠李戴
录音里 European settlers 出现在 The city was built by European settlers.——欧洲移民"建了这座城"，命名桌山的依据是"顶平"而非欧洲移民。选项把"建城"换成"给山命名"。
借用原文：The city was built by European settlers.

source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the conversation about the woman's friend Susan?

options.text: She has British ancestors.
She is of mixed blood.
She grew up in India.
She speaks several languages.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the conversation about the woman's friend Susan?
【翻译】从对话中我们对女士的朋友Susan有何了解?
A) 她有英国血统。
B) 她是混血儿。
C) 她在印度长大。
D) 她会说多种语言。
【答案】A （细节题）She has British ancestors.
【定位】Susan is white. She says her ancestors were from Britain.
Susan 是白人。她说她的祖先来自英国。
【信号】明确指向 Susan 本人的直接陈述。第7段先讲南非"很混杂"，但话锋一转点名 Susan is white. She says her ancestors were from Britain.——主语明确是 Susan 本人，正面交代了她的血统来源，是答案句。前面那句"很混杂"是说整个国家，不是说她。
【替换】her ancestors were from Britain ↔She has British ancestors.
ancestors from Britain = British ancestors

【排除】B)
张冠李戴
录音 South Africa is very mixed 说的是"南非（这个国家/人口）很混杂"，紧接着却明说Susan is white.——她是白人，不是混血。选项把形容国家的 mixed 安到了她头上。
借用原文：South Africa is very mixed
C)
原词陷阱
录音只说南非有 Indian people（印度裔居民），从没说 Susan"在印度长大"。选项借Indian 这个原词编了段她个人的成长史。
借用原文：Indian people
D)
与原文相反
录音说 Many languages are spoken in South Africa, but she only speaks English.——南非语言多，但她只会英语。选项说她"会好几门语言"，正好把 but 之后"只说英语"的真意说反了。
借用原文：Many languages are spoken in South Africa, but she only speaks English.

stem: What does the woman say about rugby in South Africa?

options.text: It is an extremely violent sport.
It is becoming a national sport.
It is originated in New Zealand.
It is more popular than football.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about rugby in South Africa?
【翻译】女士对南非的橄榄球运动有何评价?
A) 它是一项极其暴力的运动。
B) 它正在成为一项全国性运动。
C) 它起源于新西兰。
D) 它比足球更受欢迎。
【答案】D （细节题）It is more popular than football.
【定位】I think they play football, but it's not as popular as rugby.
我想他们踢足球，但足球不如橄榄球受欢迎。
【信号】转折 but 后给出真正的流行度比较。I think they play football, but it's not as popular as rugby. 中 but 之后才是落点——"足球不如橄榄球受欢迎"，等于说橄榄球比足球更火。but后那句承载了答案，前半"他们踢足球"是铺垫。
【替换】it's not as popular as rugby ↔It is more popular than football.
football not as popular as rugby = rugby more popular than football

【排除】A)
过度推断
录音说 the players push each other 且 I think it's very complicated.——只说球员互相推挤、规则复杂，从没说它"极度暴力"。选项借"推挤/复杂"的印象夸大成 extremely violent。
借用原文：the players push each other
B)
未提及
录音只说它在南非比足球受欢迎、在英国及前殖民地也流行，从没说它"正在成为国球"。national sport 在原文里根本没出现，是无中生有。
C)
原词陷阱
录音 it's also popular in Britain and in other former British colonies like Australia and New Zealand 说新西兰是"它也流行"的地方之一，并非"起源地"。选项把"流行地"偷换成"起源于新西兰"。
借用原文：it's also popular in Britain and in other former British colonies like Australia and New Zealand

stem: What does the woman advise the man to do?

options.text: Prepare a study guide.
Consult his advisors.
Go over his notes regularly.
Take stress-relief sessions.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman advise the man to do?
【翻译】女士建议男士做什么?
A) 准备一份学习指南。
B) 咨询他的导师。
C) 定期复习他的笔记。
D) 参加减压课程。
【答案】A （细节题）Prepare a study guide.
【定位】Have you considered making a study guide? It's a tool you can make yourself to take the stress out of studying.
你考虑过做一份学习指南吗？这是一个你可以自己制作的工具，能帮你把学习的压力卸下来。
【信号】建议信号 Have you considered 引出的提议。女方用 Have you considered making a study guide? 这个建议句式回应男方的求助，「考虑过……吗」就是典型的提建议信号，信号后跟的 making a study guide 即为她建议的动作。

【替换】Have you considered making a study guide? ↔Prepare a study guide.
making 改写成 Prepare，同义动词替换
【排除】B)
未提及
选项 Consult his advisors. 说的「咨询顾问」在整段对话里从未出现，女方建议的是自己做学习指南，不是去找顾问。
C)
原词陷阱
选项 Go over his notes regularly. 借了对话里反复出现的 notes 来诱你，但女方此处的建议是做 study guide，并未叫他「定期复习笔记」；regularly（定期）更是录音里没有的。
借用原文：my study folder is full of notes and worksheets
D)
原词陷阱
选项 Take stress-relief sessions. 抓住录音里 take the stress out of studying 的 stress 做文章，但录音说的是「学习指南能卸掉压力」，不是叫他去「上减压课程」；stress-relief sessions 是凭 stress 一词编出来的。
借用原文：take the stress out of studying
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the biggest problem the man has with his studies?

options.text: His worksheets are terribly messy.
He finds the workload too heavy.
His study folder is badly disorganized.
He has difficulty taking notes quickly.

explanation:
【题目】What is the biggest problem the man has with his studies?
【翻译】男士在学习上遇到的最大问题是什么?
A) 他的作业纸非常凌乱。
B) 他觉得学习负担太重。
C) 他的学习文件夹严重缺乏条理。
D) 他很难快速记笔记。
【答案】C （细节题）His study folder is badly disorganized.
【定位】My main problem is that my study folder is full of notes and worksheets, and is badly disorganized.
我主要的问题是，我的学习文件夹里塞满了笔记和练习题，而且乱得一塌糊涂。
【信号】强调信号 My main problem is 直接点题。男方用 My main problem is 这个强调句式亲口点出最大困扰，main problem 就是直接指向答案的信号，其后描述的状况即为答案内容。
【替换】my study folder is full of notes and worksheets, and is badly disorganized ↔ His study folder is badly disorganized.
study folder 与 badly disorganized 原句几乎直取

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
选项 His worksheets are terribly messy. 借了录音的 worksheets，但录音说乱的是整个study folder，worksheets 只是文件夹里装着的东西之一；把「乱」单独安到 worksheets头上是偷换对象。
借用原文：my study folder is full of notes and worksheets
B)
原词陷阱
选项 He finds the workload too heavy. 抓住男方开场 struggling with this semester's workload 的 workload，但那只是他来求助的引子，他亲口说的 main problem 是文件夹乱，不是工作量大。
借用原文：I'm really struggling with this semester's workload
D)
原词陷阱
选项 He has difficulty taking notes quickly. 借录音里的 notes 做文章，但录音只说文件夹里塞满 notes 且很乱，从没提男方「记笔记速度慢」这个困难，taking notes quickly 是凭 notes 一词编造的。
借用原文：my study folder is full of notes and worksheets
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What kind of learner does the woman say she is?

options.text: A visual learner.
An emotional learner.
An organized learner.
A logical learner.

explanation:
【题目】What kind of learner does the woman say she is?
【翻译】女士说她是什么类型的学习者?
A) 视觉型学习者。
B) 情感型学习者。
C) 条理型学习者。
D) 逻辑型学习者。
【答案】B （细节题）An emotional learner.
【定位】I'm an emotional learner, which means I need to connect to information emotionally to understand it.
我是一个情感型学习者，意思是我需要在情感上与信息建立联结才能理解它。
【信号】第一人称自指 I'm an emotional learner。女方在介绍完 visual、logical 两类后，用 I'm an emotional learner 这个第一人称自指句点明自己的类别，I'm 就是「这是说我自己」的信号，与前面介绍他人类别区分开。
【替换】I'm an emotional learner ↔An emotional learner.
emotional learner 原词对应

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
选项 A visual learner. 借了录音里 visual learners 这一类，但视觉型对应的是男方（他说I'm very much dependent on vision），女方自称的是情感型；把男方的类别安给女方即张冠李戴。
借用原文：visual learners prefer using images, pictures, colors, and maps
C)
原词陷阱
选项 An organized learner. 蹭了全篇「整理笔记 organize」的氛围，但录音介绍的三类是visual、logical、emotional，从没有 organized learner 这一类，更不是女方的自称。
借用原文：reorganizing your notes using color-coded sections
D)
张冠李戴
选项 A logical learner. 取了录音 Logical learners have a linear mind 这一类，但那是女方泛指介绍的一类人，她自称的是 emotional，不是 logical；安到女方头上属张冠李戴。
借用原文：Logical learners have a linear mind and would rather use logic, reasoning and systems
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman think the man can do with his notes?

options.text: Arrange them using color and pictures.
Restructure them in a logical way.
Commit them to memory after class.
Organize them into a well-connected story.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman think the man can do with his notes?
【翻译】女士认为男士可以如何处理他的笔记?
A) 使用颜色和图片来整理它们。
B) 以符合逻辑的方式重新组织它们。
C) 课后把它们记在脑子里。
D) 把它们组织成一个联系紧密的故事。
【答案】A （细节题）Arrange them using color and pictures.
【定位】Well, I suggest reorganizing your notes using color-coded sections in your study guides, or using idea mapping to lay out the information.
嗯，我建议你用彩色分区的方式重新整理笔记放进学习指南里，或者用思维导图把信息铺陈出来。
【信号】建议信号 I suggest 引出给男方的方法。女方用 I suggest reorganizing your notes using color-coded sections 直接给男方建议，I suggest 是明确的建议信号，your notes表明是针对男方的笔记，信号后跟的「彩色分区、思维导图」即建议内容。
【替换】using color-coded sections in your study guides, or using idea mapping ↔ Arrange them using color and pictures.
color-coded、idea mapping 概括成 color and pictures
arrange my notes using color and pictures in place of text ↔ Arrange them using color and pictures.
男方复述确认，几乎原句对应 A

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
选项 Restructure them in a logical way. 借了录音介绍 logical learners 时的 logic 一词，但女方给男方（视觉型）的建议是用颜色和图，不是「按逻辑重构」；logical 属另一类学习者的特征。
借用原文：Logical learners have a linear mind and would rather use logic, reasoning and systems
C)
原词陷阱
选项 Commit them to memory after class. 蹭了录音 more quickly accessible 的「快」感，但录音说的是用颜色图让信息更快被取用，从没建议「课后把笔记背下来」；memory、after class 都是录音没有的。
借用原文：make it more quickly accessible
D)
张冠李戴
选项 Organize them into a well-connected story. 取了录音 I organize my notes into a story，但那是女方作为情感型学习者「自己」的做法，不是建议给视觉型的男方的；把女方的做法安成给男方的建议即张冠李戴。
借用原文：As an emotional learner, I organize my notes into a story that I can connect to and recite to myself
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第19页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the passage about the golden rule?

options.text: It is mainly based on a society's religion.
It is interpreted differently in different times.
It is a code of conduct based on laws and ethics.
It is a moral principle to guide people's behavior.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the passage about the golden rule?
【翻译】从文章中我们了解到关于黄金法则的什么信息?
A) 它主要基于社会的宗教信仰。
B) 它在不同时代有不同的解释。
C) 它是基于法律和伦理的行为准则。
D) 它是指导人们行为的道德原则。
【答案】D （细节题）It is a moral principle to guide people's behavior.
【定位】The golden rule is a moral principle which states that you should treat others the way you want to be treated yourself.
黄金法则是一条道德准则，它主张你应当以你希望被别人对待的方式去对待别人。
【信号】开篇“X is...”下定义句即落点。录音第一句就用 The golden rule is a moral principle which states that you should treat others the way you want to be treated yourself.直接给 golden rule 下定义，这种篇首“主题词 + is + 定义”的句子就是定义题的答案句信号，开篇即点题。
【替换】a moral principle which states that you should treat others the way you want to be treated ↔ a moral principle to guide people's behavior
“主张你该怎样待人”=“指导人的行为”

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音确实提到 the religion in their society，但只是说不同人接触到的“形式”受宗教等因素影响，从没说它“mainly based on religion”。A 项盗了 religion 这个原词，把“影响形式的因素之一”偷换成“主要建立在宗教上”，是听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：based on factors such as the religion in their society
B)
偷换概念
录音说 Different people tend to be exposed to different forms——是“不同人接触不同形式”，B 项 17B 式地改成“interpreted differently in different times”（不同时代有不同解读），把“不同人/不同形式”偷换为“不同时代”，且录音第 3 段强调 all forms... revolve around the same concept（内核其实相同），与 B 相悖。
借用原文：Different people tend to be exposed to different forms of the golden rule
C)
原词陷阱
a code of conduct based on laws and ethics 里的 laws and ethics 录音里确实反复出现（如 laws and ethical principles），但那是讲它与法律伦理的“冲突”关系，并非说 golden rule 本身“基于法律伦理”。录音定义它是 a moral principle（道德准则），C 把它的本质错挂到法律伦理上，是张冠李戴式的原词陷阱。
借用原文：when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is a notable criticism of the golden rule?

options.text: It may lead to misunderstanding despite good intentions.
It assumes that human beings are all good-natured.
It may sometimes produce undesirable outcomes.
It fails to consider the complexity of human relationships.

explanation:
【题目】What is a notable criticism of the golden rule?
【翻译】对黄金法则的一个显著批评是什么?
A) 尽管出于好意,它可能导致误解。
B) 它假设人类都是善良的。
C) 它有时可能产生不良后果。
D) 它未能考虑人际关系的复杂性。
【答案】C （细节题）It may sometimes produce undesirable outcomes.
【定位】A notable criticism of the golden rule is that its application can lead to undesirable outcomes, when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles.
对黄金法则一条显著的批评是：当它与法律和伦理原则相冲突时，其应用可能导致不良后果。
【信号】信号词 criticism 直接领出答案句。录音第 4 段以 A notable criticism of the golden rule is that... 开头，criticism 这个批评信号词一出，紧跟的 that 从句就是批评的具体内容——这正是答案句，靠信号词定位而非逐句扫读。
【替换】its application can lead to undesirable outcomes ↔ It may sometimes produce undesirable outcomes.
lead to=produce，原词 undesirable outcomes 几乎照搬

【排除】A)
未提及
It may lead to misunderstanding despite good intentions. 里的 misunderstanding（误解）和 good intentions（好意）录音通篇没提，批评句讲的是“与法律伦理冲突导致不良后果”，与误解无关，属凭常识想象的未提及项。
B)
过度推断
It assumes that human beings are all good-natured. 是录音从未表达的论断——录音只说不同形式都 help you treat others better，并没说“它假设人人本性善良”。B 借“better/good”的善意语感引申出“假设人皆善良”，属过度推断。
借用原文：they help you treat others better
D)
未提及
It fails to consider the complexity of human relationships. 听着像个高级批评，但录音对它的批评只指向“与法律伦理冲突”，从未说它“没考虑人际关系的复杂性”。这是一个原文未提及、却被包装得很像批评的干扰项。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the example of someone breaking the law serve to show?

options.text: The golden rule is often in conflict with certain laws and ethical principles.
The golden rule must sometimes give way to more important principles.
Failure to follow the golden rule may lead to violation of laws and ethics.
Observing the golden rule is the first step to becoming a responsible citizen.

explanation:
【题目】What does the example of someone breaking the law serve to show?
【翻译】某人违法的例子用来说明什么?
A) 黄金法则常常与某些法律和伦理原则相冲突。
B) 黄金法则有时必须让位于更重要的原则。
C) 未能遵循黄金法则可能导致违反法律和伦理。
D) 遵守黄金法则是成为负责任公民的第一步。
【答案】B （细节题）The golden rule must sometimes give way to more important principles.
【定位】Specifically, in the example described above, most individuals and societies choose to place laws and ethical principles above the golden rule. This means that they strive to implement the golden rule whenever possible, as long as it doesn't clash with a more important concept.
具体来说，在上面描述的例子里，大多数个人与社会选择把法律和伦理原则置于黄金法则之上。这意味着，只要不与更重要的理念相冲突，他们就尽力践行黄金法则。
【信号】例后“This means”总结句即论点落点。违法的例子在第 5 段，但作者在第 7 段用 most individuals and societies choose to place laws and ethical principles above the golden rule 与 This means that... 把例子升华成论断——“This means”这种总结信号之后才是例子真正要说明的观点。

【替换】place laws and ethical principles above the golden rule ↔ The golden rule must sometimes give way to more important principles.
“把法律置于其上”=“黄金法则让位于更重要原则”
as long as it doesn't clash with a more important concept ↔sometimes give way to
“一旦与更重要理念冲突”=“有时须让位”
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
The golden rule is often in conflict with certain laws and ethical principles. 借了录音里的 conflict（conflicts with、clash）。但录音说的是“冲突时如何处理（让位）”，不是强调“它经常与法律冲突”；A 把例子的用意偷换成“频繁冲突”，且 often 程度过强，是原词陷阱。
借用原文：when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles
C)
与原文相反
Failure to follow the golden rule may lead to violation of laws and ethics. 用了laws、violation 等近义词，但录音的逻辑是“遵守黄金法则反而可能让违法者逍遥（we should let them go）”，即遵守它才可能冲突法律，而非“不遵守它就违法”。C 把因果方向整个弄反了。
借用原文：the golden rule would suggest that we should let them go
D)
过度推断
Observing the golden rule is the first step to becoming a responsible citizen. 听着正能量，但录音从没说遵守它是“成为合格公民的第一步”，反而强调它要让位于更重要原则。D 借“principle、society”的语境拔高出一个原文没有的结论，属过度推断。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the current statistics about diversity in large corporations?

options.text: Many of them find it rather difficult to manage.
They have not seen as much diversity as desired.
Many of them have an increasingly diversified staff.
They have not quite grasped the concept of diversity.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the current statistics about diversity in large corporations?
【翻译】从目前关于大型企业多样性的统计数据中我们可以了解到什么？
A) 许多企业发现这相当难以管理。
B) 它们并未实现预期的多样性水平。
C) 许多企业的员工日益多元化。
D) 它们尚未完全理解多样性的概念。
【答案】B （细节题）They have not seen as much diversity as desired.
【定位】Obviously, the desire to bring about diversity has not translated into corporate reality.
显然，想要实现多元化的愿望并没有变成公司里的现实。
【信号】否定句 has not 是落点。这句的答案信号是含蓄否定 has not translated into corporate reality，前面 many large corporations stress the importance of diversity 是铺垫的美好愿望，转到 has not 才是真意——愿望没落地，这正是细节题要抓的结论句。
【替换】the desire to bring about diversity has not translated into corporate reality ↔ have not seen as much diversity as desired
愿望未落地=未达期望

【排除】A)
答非所问
选项 Many of them find it rather difficult to manage. 听上去像盗用了后文 it might be difficult to work with someone who has completely different views 的 difficult，但那是讲人们对多元化的顾虑，不是 current statistics 这道题问的统计现状，属答非所问。
借用原文：it might be difficult to work with someone who has completely different views
C)
与原文相反
选项 Many of them have an increasingly diversified staff. 盗用了 diversified 这个原词，方向却反了：录音明说 the typical manager in America still tends to be white and male，统计显示多元化并未实现，C 却说员工日益多元，与原文相反。
借用原文：the typical manager in America still tends to be white and male
D)
未提及
选项 They have not quite grasped the concept of diversity. 说公司没理解多元化的概念，但录音只说愿望没落实为现实，从没说公司不懂这个概念，属未提及、无中生有。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the newly published study focused on?

options.text: Initiatives to achieve diversity in large corporations.
Advantages and disadvantages of a diversified team.
People's attitudes towards diversity at the workplace.
Innovative ideas and solutions resulting from diversity.

explanation:
【题目】What is the newly published study focused on?
【翻译】这项新发表的研究重点关注什么？
A) 大型企业实现多样性的举措。
B) 多元化团队的优势和劣势。
C) 人们对工作场所多样性的态度。
D) 多样性带来的创新想法和解决方案。
【答案】C （主旨题）People's attitudes towards diversity at the workplace.
【定位】A team of researchers from the University of Basel published their new study about people's attitudes towards diversity at work.
巴塞尔大学的一组研究者发表了他们关于人们对职场多元化态度的新研究。
【信号】study about 直接点题。答案信号是介绍研究时的点题结构 published their new study about people's attitudes towards diversity at work，about 后面紧跟的就是研究主题，这是主旨题最该锁定的总括句。
【替换】people's attitudes towards diversity at work ↔ People's attitudes towards diversity at the workplace.
at work=at the workplace

【排除】A)
答非所问
选项 Initiatives to achieve diversity in large corporations. 蹭了 diversity in large corporations 这串原词，但 achieve diversity 的举措是第三、四段给组织的建议，不是这项研究本身聚焦的主题，把分论点冒充主旨，以偏概全。
借用原文：These findings could help organizations become more diverse.
B)
偷换概念
选项 Advantages and disadvantages of a diversified team. 对应录音第二段 On the one hand / On the other hand 讲的多元化利弊，但那是人们态度的具体内容（人们一方面看到价值、一方面担心），属于主题之下的一个层面，拿来当全篇主旨则范围偏小，以偏概全。
借用原文：On the one hand, many see value in diversity ... On the other hand, they assume that it might be difficult
D)
原词陷阱
选项 Innovative ideas and solutions resulting from diversity. 盗用了 generate innovative solutions 的原词，但那只是多元化的众多好处之一，是态度里看到价值的细节，远不是研究聚焦的总主题，属以偏概全。
借用原文：encourage new ideas, and generate innovative solutions

stem: What do the findings of the new study show?

options.text: People prefer to work with team members similar to themselves.
Employers attach great importance to their corporations' diversity.
Employers differ from employees in their perspectives on diversity.
Doubts about the practicability of diversity are gradually disappearing.

explanation:
【题目】What do the findings of the new study show?
【翻译】这项新研究的发现表明了什么？
A) 人们更愿意与相似的团队成员共事。
B) 雇主非常重视其企业的多样性。
C) 雇主与员工对多样性的看法存在差异。
D) 对多样性实用性的质疑正在逐渐消失。
【答案】A （细节题）People prefer to work with team members similar to themselves.
【定位】In other words, when a person's own work group is involved, they tend to prefer team members who are similar to themselves.
换句话说，当涉及一个人自己的工作团队时，他们往往倾向于选择和自己相似的团队成员。
【信号】In other words 后是结论。答案信号是总结性标志 In other words，它后面紧跟的就是对前文的提炼结论 they tend to prefer team members who are similar to themselves，细节题正应锁定这句被点明的发现。
【替换】they tend to prefer team members who are similar to themselves ↔ People prefer to work with team members similar to themselves.
tend to prefer=prefer to work with

【排除】B)
张冠李戴
选项 Employers attach great importance to their corporations' diversity. 蹭了 many large corporations stress the importance of diversity 的 importance、diversity，但那是开头讲公司在网站上的表态，不是这项研究的 findings，张冠李戴地把背景当成了发现。
借用原文：many large corporations stress the importance of diversity on their websites
C)
偷换概念
选项 Employers differ from employees in their perspectives on diversity. 偷换了主体：录音区分的是 when a person's own work group is involved 与 when people make decisions for others（自己是否被直接波及），而非 employers 和 employees 两种身份，属偷换概念。
借用原文：when a person's own work group is involved ... But when people make decisions for others
D)
与原文相反
选项 Doubts about the practicability of diversity are gradually disappearing. 盗用了Doubts about the practicability of diversity 整串原词，方向却反了：录音说当人被直接波及时这种疑虑 have a greater weight（分量更重），并非在逐渐消失，与原文相反。
借用原文：Doubts about the practicability of diversity have a greater weight if a person is directly affected

stem: What is a major key to success in international business according to the passage?

options.text: Choosing the best time for signing a business contract.
Changing one's form of communication from time to time.
Laying equal stress on written and spoken communication.
Using different forms of communication appropriately.

explanation:
【题目】What is a major key to success in international business according to the passage?
【翻译】根据文章，国际商务成功的一个主要关键是什么?
A) 选择签订商业合同的最佳时机。
B) 不时改变自己的沟通形式。
C) 同等重视书面沟通和口头沟通。
D) 恰当地使用不同的沟通形式。
【答案】D （细节题）Using different forms of communication appropriately.
【定位】Understanding when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another can be a major key to success in international business.
懂得在什么时候适合把一种沟通形式换成另一种，可以是国际商务成功的一个重要关键。
【信号】题干原词 major key to success 在录音里原句重现。这句里 a major key to success in international business 与题干几乎逐字相同，是直接点题的下结论句，听到 key to success 就该锁定它，再回头听它前半 Understanding when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another 才是答案的实质。
【替换】when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another ↔ Using different forms of communication appropriately
换一种形式=用不同形式，appropriate=appropriately

【排除】A)
答非所问
Choosing the best time for signing a business contract. 借了录音的商务背景和appropriate（合适）的影子，把它偷换成挑签合同的最佳时机，但录音说的是恰当地切换沟通形式，根本没讲签合同的时间点，属答非所问。
B)
偷换概念
Changing one's form of communication from time to time. 借用了换形式这个动作，却把录音强调的 when it's appropriate（看场合）偷换成 from time to time（时不时地）的随意更换，录音讲的是合适与否而非更换频率，属偷换概念。
C)
与原文相反
Laying equal stress on written and spoken communication. 借了书面与口头这对原文概念，却说要对两者等量看重，而录音通篇强调的是看场合选用合适的那种，不是一视同仁，方向正好相反。
借用原文：Understanding when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another

stem: What does the passage say about spoken word agreements in some Middle East countries?

options.text: They are regarded as seriously binding.
They are seldom honored by business partners.
They are taken as memos of understanding.
They are to be confirmed in written form.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about spoken word agreements in some Middle East countries?
【翻译】关于一些中东国家的口头协议,文章说了什么?
A) 它们被视为具有严肃的约束力。
B) 它们很少被商业伙伴遵守。
C) 它们被视为谅解备忘录。
D) 它们需要以书面形式确认。
【答案】A （细节题）They are regarded as seriously binding.
【定位】In parts of the Middle East, you'll find spoken word agreements are seen as seriously binding.
在中东部分地区，你会发现口头约定被看作具有严肃约束力。
【信号】地名 Middle East 后紧跟对口头约定的定性。录音 In parts of the Middle East 一出现就锁定答案区，紧跟的 spoken word agreements are seen as seriously binding 正是对题干对象的直接定性，是顺着地名定位到的答案句。
【替换】spoken word agreements are seen as seriously binding ↔They are regarded as seriously binding
seen as=regarded as，几乎原义对应

【排除】B)
与原文相反
They are seldom honored by business partners. 与录音相反，录音说中东口头约定 are seen as seriously binding 且 A person's word is linked to their honor（一个人的话与荣誉相连，被高度看重），seldom honored（很少被信守）恰好反了过来。
借用原文：A person's word is linked to their honor
C)
张冠李戴
They are taken as memos of understanding. 盗用了录音原句 written contracts are taken as memos of understanding，但录音里被当作谅解备忘录的是书面合同（written contracts），不是题干问的口头约定，属张冠李戴——听到原词 memos of understanding 就选会中招。
借用原文：written contracts are taken as memos of understanding
D)
未提及
They are to be confirmed in written form. 借用了 written（书面）这个原文话题词，但录音对中东口头约定只说其约束力强，从未说它要以书面形式确认，属无中生有。

stem: What do we learn about the Western working culture?

options.text: It has reached the highest level of evolution.
It places a high value on written contracts.
It regards written contracts as unalterable.
It has seen a decline in verbal agreements.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the Western working culture?
【翻译】关于西方工作文化,我们了解到什么?
A) 它已达到最高的演进水平。
B) 它高度重视书面合同。
C) 它将书面合同视为不可更改的。
D) 它的口头协议已经减少。
【答案】B （细节题）It places a high value on written contracts.
【定位】Western working culture tends to place a high value on the written word, and this reaches its highest level of intensity when it comes to contracts.
西方工作文化往往很看重书面文字，而这种看重在涉及合同时达到最强的程度。
【信号】对象名 Western working culture 后紧跟其定性主干。录音 Western working culture tends to place a high value on the written word 一出现题干对象就锁定，紧跟的主干 place a high value on the written word 即对该文化的定性，是顺对象名定位到的答案句。
【替换】place a high value on the written word ↔It places a high value on written contracts
the written word 与 written contracts 同指书面，且原句下文点明 contracts

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
It has reached the highest level of evolution. 盗用了录音 reaches its highest level of intensity 里的 highest level，却把 intensity（程度）换成 evolution（进化），还擅自拔高成进化最高级，录音从未说西方文化进化到顶，属过度推断+偷换原词。
借用原文：this reaches its highest level of intensity
C)
过度推断
It regards written contracts as unalterable. 把录音 something that must be strictly carried out（必须严格执行）推到 unalterable（绝对不可更改），严格执行讲的是履行，不可更改讲的是能否修改，录音没说合同不能改，属过度推断。
借用原文：written contracts tend to be seen as something that must be strictly carried out
D)
未提及
It has seen a decline in verbal agreements. 借了 verbal/口头这个话题词，但录音讲西方文化只说它看重书面合同，从未提到口头协议出现下降，属无中生有。

stem: How does a Japanese firm tend to view a written contract?

options.text: Its details cannot be renegotiated.
It has to be carried out to the letter.
It strengthens business partnerships.
Its terms may not be strictly binding.

explanation:
【题目】How does a Japanese firm tend to view a written contract?
【翻译】日本公司倾向于如何看待书面合同?
A) 其细节不能重新谈判。
B) 它必须严格执行。
C) 它加强了商业伙伴关系。
D) 其条款可能不具有严格的约束力。
【答案】D （态度观点题）Its terms may not be strictly binding.
【定位】For example, a Japanese firm may have signed a contract, but they may not feel bound by every detail of it—particularly if circumstances later change.
举例来说，一家日本公司可能已经签了合同，但他们未必觉得受合同每一条细节的约束——尤其是当后来情况发生变化时。
【信号】转折 but 之后才是真意，且 may not 软化约束。录音 may have signed a contract, but they may not feel bound by every detail 里转折词 but 后面才是落点，may not feel bound（未必感到受约束）是日本公司对合同的真实态度，转折+may not 两个信号合起来指向弱约束。
【替换】they may not feel bound by every detail of it ↔Its terms may not be strictly binding
not feel bound 主动表述=not be binding 被动表述，detail≈terms

【排除】A)
与原文相反
Its details cannot be renegotiated. 借了上文 renegotiate terms 的原词，但录音正说情况变化时这类公司可能想重新协商条款，并非不能重谈，cannot be renegotiated 与原意相反。
借用原文：if your business partner wants to renegotiate terms that you thought were already agreed on
B)
张冠李戴
It has to be carried out to the letter. 盗用了第6段说西方文化的 something that must be strictly carried out，但严格照字面执行讲的是西方文化（美法德），不是题干问的日本公司，张冠李戴——听到 carried out 就选会中招。
借用原文：written contracts tend to be seen as something that must be strictly carried out
C)
与原文相反
It strengthens business partnerships. 与录音相反，录音说这种价值观差异 tend to cause many problems when it comes to business relationships（往往给商业关系带来很多问题），而非巩固伙伴关系，属与原文相反兼无中生有。
借用原文：tend to cause many problems when it comes to business relationships

stem: What does the author say about students enrolled in online classes?

options.text: They can access course materials easily.
They are unmotivated to learn.
They can learn at their own pace.
They rarely fulfil the course requirements.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say about students enrolled in online classes? 在问「就上网课的学生这件事，作者具体说了什么」，是对单一陈述的事实核对。
【拆句】题干主干是 What does the author say about X，标准的 say about 双宾结构，关于 X 的对象是 students enrolled in online classes，其中 enrolled in online classes 是过去分词短语作 students 的后置定语，等于 students who are enrolled in online classes，无陷阱。
【定位】First of all, students lack the desire to learn, and they simply complete their assignments to receive credit for a passing grade rather than genuinely engage with the course material.
首先，学生缺乏学习的欲望，他们只是完成作业以拿到及格分数，而不是真正与课程内容打交道。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴：宣传方观点≠作者观点
They can access course materials easily. 取自 P1 对网课的宣传性描述，并非作者本人就「学生」给出的评价，问的是作者对学生说了什么，不是对网课说了什么。
B)
✓ 正确
lack the desire to learn ↔unmotivated to learn
预判要找「学生没有学习动力」的表达，四个选项里只有 They are unmotivated to learn. 直接对应 lack the desire to learn，故锁定。
C)
张冠李戴：照抄被驳斥的卖点
They can learn at their own pace. 原句正是 learn the material at their own pace 的近乎照抄，是作者列为反驳对象的卖点，不是作者对学生的论断。
D)
与原文相反：rarely 类否定词反转事实
They rarely fulfil the course requirements. 说学生很少完成课程要求，但 they simply complete their assignments to receive credit for a passing grade 明示他们恰恰会完成作业、只是为拿学分，方向相反。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author think of online course assignments?

options.text: They are made convenient to mark.
They are meant to facilitate interaction.
They are based on easily accessible material.
They are given to accommodate students' needs.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author think of online course assignments? 指向作者对某一具体事物的判断句，仍属细节核对。
【拆句】主干 What does the author think of X，think of 在此意为「认为…如何」，相当于 What is the author’s opinion of X，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】They are not designed for students to interact with the material in depth but designed to be graded easily to accommodate such a large number of students.
这些作业的设计不是为了让学生深入与材料互动，而是为了便于打分，以应对如此庞大的学生群体。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
designed to be graded easily ↔made convenient to mark
预判锁定「便于打分」的语义，仅 They are made convenient to mark. 直接对应；其他选项要么扯到互动，要么扯到材料/学生需求，不在 designed to 的目的范围。
B)
与原文相反：not…but… 的前半句反着用
They are meant to facilitate interaction. 把作业说成「促进互动」，但 not designed for students to interact with the material in depth 明确否定了「互动」目的。
C)
无中生有：制造原文未提及的属性
They are based on easily accessible material. 说作业基于「容易获取的材料」，原文P4 没有任何句子谈论材料的获取难易，凭空捏造。
D)
偷换概念：动词宾语被替换
They are given to accommodate students' needs. 把 accommodate 的对象从原文to accommodate such a large number of students 中的「大量学生（人数）」偷换成「学生的需求」，目的指向被改。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say is one disadvantage of online classes?

options.text: They are frequently scheduled at irregular times.
They make professors' offices much less accessible.
They tend to increase professors' burden of responding to students' emails.
They provide little chance for students to build relationships with each other

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say is one disadvantage of online classes? 中 one disadvantage 是单数，明示只问其中一个具体缺点，是定点取信息的细节题。
【拆句】题干主干 What does the author say is one disadvantage of online classes，say 后是省略 that 的宾语从句 (that) one disadvantage of online classes is what，what 提前到句首形成疑问，需注意「what 在从句里实为表语」这一点，否则容易把 say 误读成不及物。
【定位】There is also little interaction amongst students. It can be harder for students to create study groups and form relationships with their peers.
学生之间的互动也很少。要想组建学习小组、和同伴建立关系会更难。
【选项】A)
偷换概念 + 与原文相反
They are frequently scheduled at irregular times. 说直播课「频繁地」被安排在不规律时间，原文 Live sessions are infrequent 恰恰说直播课很少，且原文谈的是「时间冲突」而非「时间不规律」。
B)
偷换概念：时间不便 ≠ 空间不可达
They make professors' offices much less accessible. 把焦点放在「办公室更不可达」，但 The office hours of the professor may also be during inconvenient times只说「办公时间不便」，没有说办公室不可达，accessible 与 convenient times 不是同义。
C)
无中生有：从一个事实派生未提及的后果
They tend to increase professors' burden of responding to students' emails. 谈教授回邮件「负担加重」，原文 Most interaction with the professor has to be through email which is often impersonal 只说邮件互动「冷冰冰」，并未提教授负担。
D)
✓ 正确
form relationships with their peers ↔students to build relationships with each other
It can be harder for students to create study groups ↔provide little chance
预判核心是「学生 + 学生之间难建立关系」，They provide little chance for students to build relationships with each other 在主体、动作、方向上全部命中。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What problem may arise if classes go online?

options.text: More students may find it easy to be absent from them.
Teachers will worry about poor internet connections.
Some students may have difficulty attending them.
Schools with limited resources will be at a disadvantage.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What problem may arise if classes go online? 问「在网课条件下会出现什么问题」，问的是文中已写明的某一具体后果，不需要推论。
【拆句】主干 What problem may arise，后接 if 条件状语从句 if classes go online，arise 为不及物动词「出现」，结构清晰；注意 go online 这个搭配指「转为线上」，不要望文生义译作「上网」。
【定位】Not all students have access to these types of resources, whether it is for financial or other reasons, and some students can be put at a disadvantage.
并非所有学生都能用上这些资源，无论是出于经济还是其他原因，有些学生因此可能处于不利地位。
【选项】A)
无中生有：把后果嫁接到主观行为
More students may find it easy to be absent from them. 谈学生「更容易缺席」，原文从未谈学生主观逃课难易，凭空添加。
B)
张冠李戴：替换受影响主体
Teachers will worry about poor internet connections. 把网络问题的担忧者换成teachers，原文 P7 通篇是 students 受影响，无任何关于教师担忧的描述。
C)
✓ 正确
Not all students have access to these types of resources ↔ Some students may have difficulty attending them
some students can be put at a disadvantage ↔may have difficulty
预判核心「部分学生上不了网课」，选项 Some students may have difficulty attending them 主体、动作、可能性三要素与原文一一对位。
D)
张冠李戴：把人替换成机构
Schools with limited resources will be at a disadvantage. 把 at a disadvantage的主体换成 schools，但 some students can be put at a disadvantage 明确主语是 students。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author think constitutes a key part of genuine education?

options.text: Acquisition of useful knowledge.
Training of real-life skills on campus.
Development of students' personalities.
Cultivation of analytical thinking ability.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the author think constitutes a key part of genuine education? 仍是问作者明示的具体内容，文末已直接点出，无需推断。
【拆句】题干主干 What does the author think X constitutes Y，think 后为宾语从句，从句里What 同时是 constitutes 的主语，constitutes = 构成；该结构需要把 What 还原到从句主语位才能读顺，是四级长难句的小考点。
【定位】However, they fail to provide a genuine education with an emphasis on convenience rather than critical thinking.
然而，网课未能提供真正的教育，因为它强调便利而非批判性思维。
【选项】A)
以偏概全：用常识替代作者主张
Acquisition of useful knowledge. 把「真教育」化约为「获取有用知识」，但 P8 强调的是思维而非知识，且原文也未把「有用知识」列为真教育的关键。
B)
无中生有：用文章主题的相邻概念造干扰
Training of real-life skills on campus. 强调「校园里」「真实生活技能」两个限定，但P8 既未谈 real-life skills 也未谈 on campus，是利用「网课—线下」对立常识捏造的对立项。
C)
无中生有：搬用流行教育口号
Development of students' personalities. 把真教育的关键说成「学生人格的发展」，原文 P8 通篇未涉及 personalities/character 之类的人格概念。
D)
✓ 正确
critical thinking ↔analytical thinking ability
预判核心是 critical thinking，四个选项里只有 Cultivation of analytical thinking ability. 直接对应 critical thinking 的同义改写，故锁定。

stem: What does the author think open debate can do?

options.text: Help the public to better understand science.
Clear up confusion in the scientific community.
Settle disputes between universities and government agencies.
Prevent information from being used incorrectly by the public.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author think open debate can do是一个具体的做什么问题，不含infer、imply、mainly about等推断或主旨信号词，属于围绕一个话题点的细节定位题
【拆句】主干是What does the author think open debate can do，think后省略that，引出宾语从句open debate can do (what)。问句的What其实是宾语从句里do的宾语，被前置到句首。结构简单、无陷阱。
【定位】If this trend spurs scientists to agree more quickly about the best solutions to our problems— and at the same time helps the public observe the process of scientific discourse more clearly —then this is good for everyone, including scientists.
如果这一趋势能推动科学家更快地就我们面临问题的最佳解决方案达成一致，并同时帮助公众更清楚地观察科学讨论的过程，那么对所有人，包括科学家在内，都是好事。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
helps the public observe the process of scientific discourse more clearly ↔ Help the public to better understand science
预判让公众更清楚地观察、理解科学讨论与Help the public to better understand science在语义上同构，仅是observe到understand、scientific discourse到science的上下位替换
B)
偷换概念
Clear up confusion in the scientific community说的是消除科学界内部的困惑，但原文potential for information to be used incorrectly, leading to public confusion点明confusion存在于公众一侧、而非科学界内部
C)
无中生有
Settle disputes between universities and government agencies声称开放辩论能解决高校与政府机构之间的纠纷；原文虽提及halls of universities and government agencies，但只是说辩论的发生地，并未说要去settle什么disputes
D)
与原文相反
Prevent information from being used incorrectly by the public把防止信息被误用说成open debate的功能；但原文there's potential for information to be used incorrectly, leading to public confusion里，这一可能性是开放辩论的副作用而非它的解决目标

stem: Why did a recent debate published in The New York Times arouse concerns among experts?

options.text: It might hinder the progress in medical research.
It might breed public distrust in modern medicine.
It might add to the difficulty of getting research funds.
It might prevent medical scientists reaching consensus.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】Why did a recent debate published in The New York Times arouse concerns among experts问的是某一具体事件下专家担心的具体原因，原因可在文中直接找到，不需要跨段推断
【拆句】主干是Why加did加a recent debate加arouse加concerns。a recent debate后带过去分词短语published in The New York Times作后置定语，限定是哪一场debate；among experts限定concerns的范围。理清后题干即那场登在某报上的辩论，为何让专家担心。
【定位】But some experts worried that such public speculation might lead people to believe that disagreement about the details meant a lack of adequate scientific consensus over the safety and efficiency of modern-day medicine.
但一些专家担心，这种公开揣测可能让人们相信：对细节的分歧意味着科学界对现代医药的安全与效率缺乏足够的共识。
【选项】A)
无中生有
It might hinder the progress in medical research谈的是阻碍医学研究的进展，原文只说公开辩论可能让公众产生误解，并未说会拖慢医学研究本身
B)
✓ 正确
might lead people to believe that disagreement about the details meant a lack of adequate scientific consensus over the safety and efficiency of modern-day medicine ↔It might breed public distrust in modern medicine
预判中的对现代医药产生不信任正好对应public distrust in modern medicine；原文的多步表述被压缩成一个名词distrust，是典型的名词化同义替换
C)
无中生有
It might add to the difficulty of getting research funds说会增加获得研究经费的难度；原文从未提及funds、funding、money相关概念
D)
偷换概念
It might prevent medical scientists reaching consensus说会阻止医学科学家达成共识；原文是meant a lack of adequate scientific consensus——即让公众以为科学界没共识，但事实是科学界已有共识，并不是公开辩论会真的让科学家无法达成共识

stem: Why does the author say some experts' anxiety seems misplaced?

options.text: Debating scientific issues at a conference is now old-fashioned.
Diverse topics can be debated by both scientists and the public.
Debates about science are accessible to the public anyway.
Scientists can voice their opinions whatever way they like.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】Why does the author say some experts' anxiety seems misplaced问的是作者下此判断的依据，依据明示在原文紧随其后的句子中，属于因果细节
【拆句】Why does the author say后接一个宾语从句some experts' anxiety seems misplaced。anxiety前是some experts'所有格作定语；seems是系动词、misplaced是表语形容词。理解为为什么作者说某些专家的担心是放错地方的。
【定位】Gone are the days of going to a conference and debating scientific issues, and that's good because those gatherings were not diverse enough and excluded many important voices. These days, the public can access debates about science regardless of where they take place.
去开会、在会上辩论科学问题的日子已经过去了，这是好事，因为那些聚会不够多元，把许多重要的声音排除在外。如今，无论辩论在哪里举行，公众都能接触到。

以偏概全

stem: What does previous research about social media reveal?

options.text: Most employees think positively of it.
It improves employees' work efficiency.
It enables employees to form connections.
Employees spend much of their work time on it.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does previous research about social media reveal? 用 what...reveal 直接问研究揭示的事实，没有 infer/imply 等推断信号，是典型细节题。
【拆句】题干主干 What does previous research about social media reveal? 结构平铺：what 作reveal 的宾语前置，about social media 是修饰 research 的介词短语。无陷阱。
【定位】Research has shown that 82% of employees think social media can improve work relationships and 60% believe it can support decision-making processes.
已有研究表明：82% 的员工认为社交媒体能改善工作关系，60% 的员工相信它有助于决策过程。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
82% of employees think social media can improve work relationships and 60% believe it can support decision-making processes ↔Most employees think positively of it
原文两条数据都是正面态度的多数比例，恰好对应预判中的"多数员工肯定它"，整段不含工作效率提升或工作时间被占用的客观数据，故锁定选项首字母为 A。
B)
偷换概念
原文只说员工"认为"社交媒体能改善关系和决策，是主观看法；It improves employees' work efficiency 把这种看法说成了已被证明的客观事实，且把 work relationships 偷换成 efficiency。
C)
以偏概全
It enables employees to form connections 把原文 improve work relationships 改成"建立联系"，并把"员工的看法"偷换成"它实际能够"，只触及关系一项却丢了决策，且把主观信念伪装成已证事实。
D)
无中生有
原文只说员工 connecting with colleagues on social media, even during work hours，并没有给出"花费大量工作时间在上面"的程度判断；Employees spend much of their work time on it 凭空加上了"花费大量时间"的数量评估。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What did the author's own research find about social media?

options.text: It influences employees' work negatively.
It does much harm to employee loyalty.
It kills employees' motivation for work
It affects employers' decision-making.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What did the author's own research find about social media? 用 what...find 问研究的客观发现，是典型细节题。
【拆句】题干 What did the author's own research find about social media? 主语 the author's own research，谓语 find，about social media 是 find 后的话题状语。结构清楚，无陷阱。
【定位】Social media doesn't reduce productivity nearly as much as it kills employee retention.
社交媒体降低生产力的程度，远远比不上它对员工留任的杀伤力。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
原文 Social media doesn't reduce productivity nearly as much as it kills employee retention 已点明社交媒体并不显著降低生产力，所以"对工作产生负面影响"过于宽泛——它只在留任这一面有显著负面，工作本身（生产力、动力）并没有受到普遍负面影响。
B)
✓ 正确
Social media doesn't reduce productivity nearly as much as it kills employee retention ↔ It does much harm to employee loyalty
not...as much as... 句式的语义重心在后半句"as much as"之后，定位句的论点核心是"对员工留任的杀伤更大"，恰好对应预判与首字母 B 的选项。
C)
张冠李戴
原文第 2 段并未谈及对员工动力（motivation）的杀伤——动力一词出现在第 3 段，且第 3 段中社交媒体反而是"使员工 more motivated"。本选项把作者研究的核心结论说成"扼杀动力"，与原文位置和方向都不符。
D)
答非所问
原文第 1 段提及社交媒体被员工认为 can support decision-making processes，主语是"员工的决策"，而非"雇主的决策"；本选项把"对雇主决策的影响"放进作者己研结论里，既错位也答非所问。
