stem: What did the author find in his study about the effect of online social interactions?

options.text: It differs from employee to employee.
It tends to vary with the platform used.
It has much to do with whom employees interact with.
It is hard to measure when employees interact with outsiders.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What did the author find in his study about the effect of online social interactions?同样是 what...find 句式，问研究中的具体发现。
【拆句】题干主干是 What did the author find，in his study 是状语，about the effect of online social interactions 是 find 的宾语介词短语，进一步限定要找的发现内容。结构略长，但层层并列，无陷阱。
【定位】I found employees who engage in online social interactions with co-workers through social media blogs tend to be more motivated and come up with innovative ideas. But when employees interact with individuals outside the organization, they are less motivated and show less initiative.
我发现：通过社交媒体博客与同事进行在线社交互动的员工，往往更有动力、能想出更多新点子；但当员工与组织外的人互动时，他们反而动力下降、缺少主动性。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文并未说"因人而异"或"每个员工不一样"，而是把员工按互动对象分成两类得出两种结果；It differs from employee to employee 把分类标准偷换成"员工个体差异"。
B)
无中生有
原文 platforms like Facebook, Twitter, or LinkedIn 仅作为研究背景，没有把不同平台作为造成结果差异的原因；It tends to vary with the platform used 把背景信息硬升级成变量来源。
C)
✓ 正确
employees who engage in online social interactions with co-workers ... tend to be more motivated / when employees interact with individuals outside the organization, they are less motivated
↔It has much to do with whom employees interact with
原文两个分句除了对象不同（同事 vs. 外部人士）几乎所有别的条件都相同，结果却完全相反——这正是"效果取决于互动对象"的最直接证据，故锁定首字母 C。
D)
与原文相反
原文恰恰已经测量出员工与外部人士互动会导致 less motivated and show less initiative，研究是给出了明确结果的，并不"难以衡量"。本选项与原文方向相反。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What problem was found with employees using social media for work?

options.text: They seldom expressed their inner thoughts.
Most of them explored new job opportunities.
They were reluctant to collaborate with others.
Many of them ended with lower productivity.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What problem was found with employees using social media for work? 用what...found 问研究中发现的问题，仍是问客观事实。
【拆句】题干 What problem was found with employees using social media for work? 是 what作主语的被动疑问句：problem 与 what 共同作主语，be found 是谓语，with employees using social media for work 是介词短语修饰 problem。读不顺时把它倒过来想成 "researchers found what problem with these employees" 即可。
【定位】I found 76% of employees using social media for work took an interest in other organizations they found on social media. When I examined how respondents expressed openness to new careers and employers, I found that they engaged in some key activities including researching new organizations and making new work connections.
我发现：76% 用社交媒体办公的员工会关注他们在社交媒体上看到的其他组织。当我考察这些受访者如何表达对新职业、新雇主的开放态度时，我发现他们会从事几项关键活动，包括研究新公司、建立新的工作联系。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文第 4 段没有提到员工"是否表达内心想法"——只说他们关注其他组织、研究新公司、建立新人脉，这些都是外向行为；They seldom expressed their inner thoughts把不存在的话题拉进来。
B)
✓ 正确
76% of employees using social media for work took an interest in other organizations they found on social media ↔Most of them explored new job opportunities
openness to new careers and employers ↔explored new job opportunities
76% 的覆盖面+关注新公司、研究新公司、建立新人脉、对新职业开放等多项行为同向叠加，正对应"多数人在物色新工作"，故锁定首字母 B。
C)
与原文相反
原文第 3 段已说与同事互动会让员工 more motivated and come up with innovative ideas，本身就是合作意愿强；They were reluctant to collaborate with others 与之方向相反。
D)
与原文相反
原文第 2 段已经否定 Social media doesn't reduce productivity nearly as much as it kills employee retention，社交媒体并未明显降低生产力；本选项却说"很多人最终生产力降低"，是把作者明确否定的结论又重新放回来。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author suggest managers do to neutralize the retention risk?

options.text: Give promotions to employees for their accomplishments.
Create opportunities for employees to share success stories.
Acknowledge employees' achievements through social media.
Encourage employees to increase their visibility on social media.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What does the author suggest managers do to neutralize the retention risk? 虽含suggest，但问的是作者明文给出的建议方案，原文必有对应句，仍属细节题。
【拆句】题干主干 What does the author suggest managers do，managers do 是 suggest 后省略 that 的虚拟语气从句（suggest sb. do），to neutralize the retention risk 是表目的的不定式。难点在虚拟语气省略 that 的结构，主体考生易把 managers 看成全句主语。
【定位】Managers can also use social media to directly reduce turnover(跳槽) intentions, by recognizing employees' accomplishments and giving visibility to employees' success stories.
管理者还可以利用社交媒体直接降低跳槽意向：方法是表彰员工取得的成就、让员工的成功故事更被看见。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文动作是 recognizing employees' accomplishments（公开承认成就），不是"提拔"；Give promotions to employees for their accomplishments 把"承认"偷换成"提拔"，并丢掉了"通过社交媒体"这一关键媒介。
B)
张冠李戴
原文是管理者借社交媒体 giving visibility to employees' success stories——动作发起者是管理者；Create opportunities for employees to share success stories 把动作主体换成员工自己分享，与原文恰好对调，且回避了"用社交媒体"这一关键媒介。
C)
✓ 正确
Managers can also use social media to directly reduce turnover(跳槽) intentions, by recognizing employees' accomplishments and giving visibility to employees' success stories ↔Acknowledge employees' achievements through social media
预判要求"用社交媒体表彰成就"中的动作与媒介两要素同时对齐，只有首字母 C 把"承认成就"与"借助社交媒体"都准确保留，其余选项要么换错动作、要么丢掉媒介。
D)
偷换概念
原文是管理者 giving visibility to employees' success stories——是"让员工的事迹可见"，主导者是管理者；Encourage employees to increase their visibility on social media 把"被表彰的事迹"偷换成"员工的曝光度"，且把管理者的动作变成鼓励员工自己增加曝光，正好是文章想抑制的"个人外向行为"。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What mainly accounts for the possibility that distance learning could become the norm?

options.text: Advances in education technology.
Shrinking financial resources.
Shortage of school facilities.
Lack of qualified teachers.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What mainly accounts for the possibility that distance learning could become the norm?问「是什么导致」，是对文本中明确陈述事实的提取，不是态度也不是推断。
【拆句】题干主干是What mainly accounts for the possibility，that引导同位语从句解释possibility的内容；that distance learning could become the norm整体作possibility的同位语；副词mainly限定account for，提示要找「主要」原因而非次要原因。结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】In the coming era of budget cuts to education, distance learning could become the norm.
在即将到来的教育预算削减时代，远程教育可能成为常态。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文未提及教育技术本身的进步是导致远程教育常态化的原因；P1只字未提技术进步，只谈预算。
B)
✓ 正确
budget cuts to education ↔Shrinking financial resources
预判「教育预算削减」与Shrinking financial resources「财政资源缩水」是同一概念的不同表述，是细节题最典型的同义替换。
C)
偷换概念
Shortage of school facilities是「校舍短缺」，而原文School facilities are expensive to build and maintain说的是校舍「造价高、维护贵」，是「贵」不是「缺」；且这是第二段提到的，并非第一段中远程教育常态化的原因。
D)
无中生有
原文从未提及「合格教师短缺」是远程教育常态化的原因；teachers are expensive to employ说的是教师「贵」，不是「缺」或「不合格」。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say is one possible benefit of students attending school physically?

options.text: Developing the habit of getting up early.
Eating nutritionally well-balanced meals.
Growing into living and breathing human beings.
Cultivating relationships with peers and teachers.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say is one possible benefit问「作者说了什么好处」，是对作者明示信息的提取。
【拆句】题干主干是What does the author say is one possible benefit，省略了关系代词的宾语从句结构「the author say (that) [what] is one possible benefit」；介词of短语of students attending school physically作benefit的定语，其中students是动名词attending的逻辑主语。结构无陷阱，注意one possible暗示文中可能列了多个好处，选项里只要有一个对得上即可。
【定位】Physically attending school has hidden benefits: getting up every morning, interacting with peers, and building relationships with teachers are essential skills to cultivate in young people.
实地上学有隐性的好处：每天早起、与同伴互动、与老师建立关系，这些都是年轻人需要培养的关键能力。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
Developing the habit of getting up early虽然对应原文getting up every morning，但原文这只是三项并列好处之一，且作者强调的核心是skills to cultivate，而getting up属于日常生活动作；将「早起」提炼为「养成早起的习惯」是把动作误读成了一种习惯养成训练，与原文核心语义有偏差。
B)
张冠李戴
原文末尾They are now places that provide meals提到学校提供餐食，但作者并未说「营养均衡的餐食」是attending school physically的benefit；nutritionally well-balanced属于无中生有的修饰语，且provide meals被原文归入「学校的社会职能」而非「实地上学的好处」——主体不同。
C)
偷换概念
原文a living, breathing human being teaches and interacts with students中living, breathing是修饰teacher的形容词，强调「活生生的」教师；选项Growing into living and breathing human beings把「形容老师的状态词」偷换成「学生成长的目标」，且growing into是「成长为」的方向性动词，原文完全没有这层意思。
D)
✓ 正确
interacting with peers, and building relationships with teachers ↔ Cultivating relationships with peers and teachers
选项Cultivating relationships with peers and teachers精准合并了预判中的第二、三项内容，且与原文cultivate呼应。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author think of the latest technology in education?

options.text: It may have potential disadvantages.
It may render many teachers jobless.
It may add to students' financial burden.
It may revolutionize classroom teaching

explanation:
【答案】A （态度题）
【判型】What does the author think of直问作者对某事物的看法，是典型态度类信号。
【拆句】题干主干是What does the author think of the latest technology in education，think of是固定搭配「对……怎么看」；the latest是形容词最高级作定语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Those policy-makers are often fascinated by the latest technology in education and its potential to "transform" education overnight. But online education does not allow a teacher to keep a struggling student after class and offer help.
那些政策制定者常常被教育领域最新技术及其「一夜变革」教育的潜力所迷住。但在线教育不允许教师把学习吃力的学生留下来课后辅导。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
online education does not allow a teacher to keep a struggling student after class and offer help ↔It may have potential disadvantages
Distance education will never match the personal teaching in a traditional classroom ↔ It may have potential disadvantages
预判得出作者对新技术持质疑或保留态度，It may have potential disadvantages恰好用「可能有不足」概括了这种保留立场，与原文极性一致。
B)
无中生有
原文未提及新技术会「让教师失业」；作者讨论的是技术替代教师在功能上的局限，不是技术造成教师失业的社会后果。
C)
张冠李戴
原文谈的是节约预算者的成本动机resulting in greater savings，从未提及学生的财务负担会因此增加；把「学校省钱」误读为「学生多花钱」，方向完全相反。
D)
与原文相反
It may revolutionize classroom teaching即「可能彻底变革课堂教学」是政策制定者的看法，不是作者的；原文用"transform"加引号、用But转折、用Distance education will never match the personal teaching in a traditional classroom反驳，明确否定了这种乐观看法。考生若把fascinated误读成作者本人也「被迷住」，就会反选此项。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say teachers are expected to do?

options.text: Enhance students' leadership capacity.
Elevate students to managerial positions.
Enable students to adapt to the changes in life.
Prepare students to be competitive in the future.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say teachers are expected to do?问「教师被期望做什么」，是对原文明示信息的客观提取。
【拆句】题干主干是What does the author say teachers are expected to do，author say后省略了that引导的宾语从句；从句主干是「teachers are expected to do (what)」，be expected to do是固定结构「被期望做」。结构无陷阱。
【定位】Yet teachers are expected to prepare them to be responsible citizens, cultivate their social skills, encourage successful time management, and enhance their capacity to flourish in an increasingly harsh labor market.
然而，教师却被期望让他们成为有责任感的公民，培养他们的社交能力，鼓励他们成功管理时间，并增强他们在日益严酷的劳动力市场上立足发展的能力。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文四项期望中没有提到培养「领导力」（leadership capacity）；社交能力不等于领导力，二者不可等同。
B)
偷换概念
原文没有任何「把学生提升到管理岗位」的内容；该项利用原文management一词（time management）做望文生义的偷换——time management是「时间管理」，managerial positions是「管理职位」，二者只是共享management词根，语义完全不同。
C)
无中生有
原文四项期望中没有「让学生适应生活变化」（adapt to the changes in life）这一项；adapt to changes是常见教育鸡汤，但原文未提及。
D)
✓ 正确
enhance their capacity to flourish in an increasingly harsh labor market ↔ Prepare students to be competitive in the future
预判得出最后一项enhance their capacity to flourish in an increasingly harsh labor market，选项Prepare students to be competitive in the future恰是此项的抽象提炼。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: Why couldn't technology replace a good teacher?

options.text: It lacks humanity.
It is still immature.
It cannot track students' growth.
It cannot cater to personal needs.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】Why couldn't technology replace a good teacher?问「为什么不能」，是对原文中给出的明确原因的提取；末段P4给出了直接答案句，不需推断。
【拆句】题干主干是Why couldn't technology replace a good teacher?，否定情态动词couldn't与why连用，表达「为何不能」，注意这不是疑问句的常规反问，而是给定「不能取代」的前提下追问原因。结构无陷阱，重点抓couldn't的否定意味。
【定位】The power of the classroom is rooted in the humanity of the people gathered in the same place, at the same time.
课堂的力量根植于聚集在同一地点、同一时间的人们身上的人性。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
The power of the classroom is rooted in the humanity of the people gathered in the same place, at the same time ↔It lacks humanity
Technology, no matter how advanced, should simply be a tool of a good teacher ↔ It lacks humanity
预判得出原因为「技术缺乏人性」，选项It lacks humanity使用与原文同一个抽象名词humanity，是同根词的正反极性替换，匹配度最高。
B)
与原文相反
原文未提及技术「尚不成熟」（still immature）；作者用no matter how advanced反而承认了技术可以非常先进，否定的是技术的本质属性（非人性），不是技术的发展阶段。
C)
无中生有
原文没有任何关于「技术无法追踪学生成长」的表述；track students' growth这一说法是作者批评教育技术时未涉及的另一个方向。
D)
以偏概全
It cannot cater to personal needs即「不能满足个性化需求」听起来很对，且与第三段online education does not allow a teacher to keep a struggling student after class and offer help有局部对应，但题目55题问的是技术为何不能取代好教师，根本原因应回末段P4的humanity，而不是第三段的某个具体功能局限；选It cannot cater to personal needs是把局部理由当作根本理由，犯以偏概全的错误。这是本题最有迷惑性的干扰项。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2022-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the news report about the study?

options.text: It examines the effect of cholesterol on people's health.
Its participants all had high blood cholesterol levels.
It questions the benefits of a vegetarian protein diet.
Its finding came as a surprise to the researchers.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the news report about the study?
【翻译】从新闻报道中我们对这项研究了解到什么?
A) 它检验了胆固醇对人们健康的影响。
B) 它的参与者都有高血胆固醇水平。
C) 它质疑素食蛋白饮食的益处。
D) 它的发现让研究人员感到意外。
【答案】D （细节题）Its finding came as a surprise to the researchers.
【定位】This finding surprised researchers, who admitted they didn't expect that eating white meat would lead to higher blood cholesterol levels.
这一发现令研究者们感到意外,他们承认自己没有料到吃白肉会导致血液胆固醇水平升高。
【信号】情绪信号词 surprised。答案落点不是平铺的数据句,而是带情绪色彩的 This finding surprised researchers,再用 who admitted they didn't expect 加重——新闻里出现"意外/没料到"这种态度词,往往就是出题点。
【替换】This finding surprised researchers ↔Its finding came as a surprise to the researchers
动词 surprised 改写成名词 a surprise
who admitted they didn't expect ↔came as a surprise
"没料到"与"意外"同义互证

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 借了原文反复出现的 blood cholesterol levels 里的 cholesterol 一词,把研究说成"考察胆固醇对健康的影响";但录音考察的是"不同肉类的饮食对胆固醇的影响",胆固醇是被测的结果而非被研究的起因,A 把对象说反了。
借用原文：blood cholesterol levels
B)
与原文相反
B 说参与者"都是高胆固醇",但第二段原文是 researchers looked at 113 healthy people(113 名健康人);B 盗用了 cholesterol levels 这个反复出现的词,再加个绝对的 all,把"健康人"悄悄换成"高胆固醇人群",与原文相反。
借用原文：researchers looked at 113 healthy people
C)
原词陷阱
C 说研究"质疑素食蛋白饮食的好处",借的是原文真出现过的 a vegetarian protein diet;但原文第四段恰恰是 eat...more vegetarian protein(建议多吃素食蛋白),研究从头到尾力挺素食蛋白、绝无质疑,属无中生有又反向。
借用原文：a vegetarian protein diet
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the researchers acknowledge?

options.text: They do not know all the effects of eating meat.
Red meat itself does not cause heart diseases.
White meat may be healthier than red meat.
Vegetarian protein may be easier to absorb.

explanation:
【题目】What did the researchers acknowledge?
【翻译】研究人员承认了什么?
A) 他们不知道吃肉的所有影响。
B) 红肉本身不会导致心脏病。
C) 白肉可能比红肉更健康。
D) 素食蛋白可能更容易被吸收。
【答案】C （细节题）White meat may be healthier than red meat.
【定位】The team acknowledged that it is possible that white meat is better for our health than red meat despite their findings.
研究团队承认,尽管有这些发现,白肉仍有可能比红肉更有益于我们的健康。
【信号】题干同词 acknowledged 引出让步。答案句正是题干 acknowledge 在原文里的对应词The team acknowledged that it is possible that,其后 white meat is better for our health than red meat 就是承认的内容;"题干动词在原文复现"是最稳的定位信号。
【替换】white meat is better for our health than red meat ↔White meat may be healthier than red meat
better for our health 改写成 healthier
it is possible that ↔may be
it is possible that 等于 may

【排除】A)
过度推断
A 借了第四段 other effects of red meat consumption 里的 effects,说研究者"承认还不了解吃肉的全部影响";但原文只说红肉"另有别的影响可能致病",并没说研究者"不知道全部影响",A 把局部说法夸大成笼统的"全不知",属过度推断。
借用原文：other effects of red meat consumption
B)
与原文相反
B 借了原文 contribute to heart disease 里的 heart disease,说"红肉本身不致心脏病";但原文恰说红肉的别的影响"可能促成心脏病",方向正相反,B 把原文的肯定关系反成了否定。
借用原文：contribute to heart disease
D)
未提及
D 借了原文反复出现的 vegetarian protein,却安上一个原文压根没提的角度 absorb(更易吸收);全文只说建议多吃素食蛋白、它对胆固醇影响更小,从未谈"吸收",属无中生有。
借用原文：vegetarian protein

stem: What does the news report say about the accident at the crossing of High Street in Milton?

options.text: It may have been due to the lorry driver's drunk driving.
It may affect the local supply of turkeys for Christmas.
It interrupted traffic for several hours running.
It was caused by a lorry running into a trailer.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say about the accident at the crossing of High Street in Milton?
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.

【翻译】新闻报道关于Milton High Street路口事故说了什么?
A) 这可能是由于卡车司机酒后驾驶造成的。
B) 这可能影响当地圣诞节火鸡的供应。
C) 这使交通连续中断了几个小时。
D) 这是由一辆卡车撞上拖车引起的。
【答案】B （细节题）It may affect the local supply of turkeys for Christmas.
【定位】It is reported that nobody was hurt in the incident, but police said it may affect traffic and Christmas dinners. With just one week to go before Christmas, there are worries that local supermarket supplies of this holiday favorite may be affected.
据报道，事故中无人受伤，但警方表示这可能影响交通和圣诞晚餐。距圣诞节仅剩一周，人们担心当地超市这一节日抢手货的供应可能受影响。
【信号】转折 but 后接真正落点。答案藏在转折词后面：nobody was hurt in the incident, but police said it may affect traffic and Christmas dinners 里 but 之后才是报道强调的影响，紧接着 supplies of this holiday favorite may be affected 进一步点明"节日抢手货"（即火鸡）供应受影响，这正是答案句。
【替换】supplies of this holiday favorite may be affected ↔ It may affect the local supply of turkeys for Christmas.
this holiday favorite=turkeys
may be affected ↔It may affect
被动转主动·affect 同词根
【排除】A)
偷换概念
录音说司机 had been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving（涉嫌危险驾驶被捕），选项却写成 drunk driving（酒驾）。dangerous driving 与 drunk driving 长得像、都沾"driving"，但危险驾驶不等于酒驾，原文从没提到喝酒，属偷换。
借用原文：the driver of the lorry had been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving
C)
原词陷阱
选项 interrupted traffic for several hours running 里"中断交通"沾了原文 it may affect traffic 的边——traffic 确实被念到，所以听到就想选；但原文只说"可能影响交通"，从没说"中断了好几个小时"，several hours 是凭空加的时长。
借用原文：it may affect traffic and Christmas dinners
D)
原词陷阱
选项 It was caused by a lorry running into a trailer 把 lorry、trailer 两个原词都用上了，极像答案；但原文是 a trailer attached to a lorry turned over——挂在卡车上的拖车翻倒，并不是"一辆卡车撞上一辆拖车"，选项把"翻车"歪曲成了"撞车"，动作对不上。
借用原文：a trailer attached to a lorry turned over at the crossing of High Street
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the crossing on High Street?

options.text: It has been the scene of several fatal accidents recently.
It is the spot that causes the local police a lot of worry.
It has witnessed several traffic accidents this year.
It is a location frequented by local traffic police.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the crossing on High Street?
【翻译】关于High Street路口我们了解到什么?
A) 这里最近发生过几起致命事故。
B) 这是让当地警方十分担忧的地点。
C) 这里今年发生过几起交通事故。
D) 这是当地交警经常出现的地点。
【答案】C （细节题）It has witnessed several traffic accidents this year.
【定位】The crossing on High Street is a well-known accident blackspot. This year alone, there have been seven traffic accidents at this location. Thankfully, none of these accidents have resulted in serious injury.
高街的这个路口是出了名的事故黑点。仅今年一年，这个地点就发生了七起交通事故。所幸这些事故没有一起造成严重伤亡。
【信号】数字+时间范围·具体数据句。答案落在带具体数据的那句：This year alone, there have been seven traffic accidents at this location——"今年"这个时间范围加上"七起"这个数字，正是新闻里最常被设题的信息点，听到数字就该锁定。
【替换】there have been seven traffic accidents ↔It has witnessed several traffic accidents
seven=several·具体数概括成"几起"
This year alone ↔this year
时间范围一致·this year
【排除】A)
与原文相反
选项 several fatal accidents 借用了原文 accident 一词，但 fatal（致命的，会死人）与原文恰好相反——录音明说 none of these accidents have resulted in serious injury（没有一起造成严重伤亡），更别提致命，方向反了。
借用原文：none of these accidents have resulted in serious injury
B)
未提及
选项 causes the local police a lot of worry 用了 police 这个原文出现过的词（A police spokeswoman、officers were currently in attendance）来诱选，但原文只说警方到场处理、发言人通报，从没说这个路口"让警方很担忧"，担忧是凭空加的。
借用原文：officers were currently in attendance at the scene
D)
原词陷阱
选项 frequented by local traffic police 把 traffic（原文 it may affect traffic 念过）和police（A police spokeswoman 念过）拼在一起，听着字字耳熟；但原文从没说"交警经常光顾这个路口"，frequented 这层意思是编出来的。
借用原文：A police spokeswoman said that officers were currently in attendance at the scene
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

A) 获得批准增加更多航线。
B) 吸引更多国际游客。

stem: What do we learn from the news report about the helicopter taxi ride?

options.text: It costs more than twice as much as a car ride.
It is gaining popularity among ordinary Indians.
It symbolizes India's advancement in high-tech.
It can get anywhere in the city within 15 minutes.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the news report about the helicopter taxi ride?
【翻译】从新闻报道中我们对直升机出租车服务了解到什么?
A) 它的费用是汽车车费的两倍多。
B) 它在普通印度人中越来越受欢迎。
C) 它象征着印度在高科技领域的进步。
D) 它可以在15分钟内到达城市的任何地方。
【答案】A （细节题）It costs more than twice as much as a car ride.

【定位】Helicopter taxi is not an affordable option for many travelers. A car ride for the same journey costs less than half as much.
直升机出租车对许多旅客来说并不便宜。同样的行程，打车的花费还不到它的一半。
【信号】价格比较句。答案句是带比较结构的事实陈述 A car ride for the same journey costs less than half as much，含 less than half 这种倍数/比例信号，正对应选项里的价格数字题，是听力里"听到数字/比较就锁定"的典型答案句。
【替换】A car ride for the same journey costs less than half as much ↔ It costs more than twice as much as a car ride
比例反向换算
【排除】B)
与原文相反
选项 It is gaining popularity among ordinary Indians. 与录音 not an affordable option for many travelers（对许多人并不便宜）相悖——既然普通人嫌贵，就谈不上在"普通印度人"中流行；选项借"印度"这个大背景词制造熟悉感，实则与原文相反。
借用原文：not an affordable option for many travelers
C)
过度推断
选项 It symbolizes India’s advancement in high-tech. 把这项服务上升到"象征印度高科技进步"，但录音通篇只讲它的线路、价格、客户、运营方，从未做这种象征性评价，属录音根本没说的过度拔高。
D)
原词陷阱
选项 It can get anywhere in the city within 15 minutes. 盗用录音的 15 分钟，但原文ferry customers the 40 miles between Bangalore’s Electronic City tech hub and the International Airport terminal in 15 minutes 说的是"特定两点间 40 英里 15 分钟"，选项偷偷把范围放大成"城内任何地方"，数字对、范围被改大，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：between Bangalore’s Electronic City tech hub and the International Airport terminal in 15 minutes
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Who are the targeted customers of the helicopter taxi service?

options.text: International tourists.
High-class travelers.
Prominent superstars.
Customers in a hurry.

explanation:
【题目】Who are the targeted customers of the helicopter taxi service?
【翻译】直升机出租车服务的目标客户是谁?
A) 国际游客。
B) 高端旅客。
C) 知名超级明星。
D) 赶时间的顾客。
【答案】B （细节题）High-class travelers.

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【定位】"A large number of high-class travelers, including CEOs, have to spend more than three hours by road to get there and that is a loss of time," a Bangalore airport spokesperson said.
"包括首席执行官在内的大量高端旅客，开车去那里要花三个多小时，这是时间上的损失，"班加罗尔机场一位发言人说。
【信号】发言人点名人群。答案句是发言人原话里直接点名的人群 A large number of high-class travelers, including CEOs，新闻里"官方发言人/负责人"的引语常承载关键信息，且这里直接报出目标客户，是最可靠的答案信号。
【替换】A large number of high-class travelers, including CEOs ↔High-class travelers
原话即选项措辞
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 International tourists. 借 International 勾连录音里多次出现的 International Airport terminal，但原文从没说目标客户是"国际游客"，International 只属于机场名字，属听到原词就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：International Airport terminal
C)
未提及
选项 Prominent superstars.（知名巨星）在录音里根本没出现，发言人点的是 high-class travelers 和 CEOs，从未提明星；这是"凭直觉觉得贵东西该卖给名人"的常识陷阱，原文无据。
D)
原词陷阱
选项 Customers in a hurry. 盗用录音 tech executives in a hurry 里的 in a hurry，但原文 in a hurry 只是修饰"赶时间的科技高管"，回答"为谁服务"的官方表述用的是 high-class travelers 这个上位称呼；选项抓住次要修饰语 in a hurry 当答案，偷换了概念层级，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：tech executives in a hurry

source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman plan to do for the weekend?

options.text: Treat her friends in a bar.
Take a trip to Washington.
Make some cheese.
Throw a party.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman plan to do for the weekend?
【翻译】女士周末打算做什么?
A) 在酒吧请她的朋友们。
B) 去华盛顿旅行。
C) 做一些奶酪。
D) 举办一个聚会。
【答案】D （细节题）Throw a party.
【定位】It will be very casual. We will just be a small group of friends gathering together at Washington Park. There will be around 20 of us, including children.
会很随意。我们就是一小群朋友聚在华盛顿公园，大约20个人，还带着孩子。
【信号】女方自述聚会安排。答案藏在女方对自己活动的描述里：a small group of friends gathering together 加上前文 a barbecue this weekend，合起来说明她要办一场朋友聚会/派对，这是问"她计划做什么"时该锁定的自述句。
【替换】a small group of friends gathering together ↔Throw a party.
聚会即办派对
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
原文确实有 friends，但聚会在 Washington Park 公园而非酒吧，bar 是凭空加的；选项借"朋友"这个原词诱你选，地点对不上。
借用原文：a small group of friends gathering together at Washington Park
B)
原词陷阱
原文 Washington Park 只是聚会地点，选项把 Washington 拎出来说成 take a trip，把"在华盛顿公园聚会"歪曲成"去华盛顿旅行"。
借用原文：gathering together at Washington Park
C)
原词陷阱
全程女方是去 buy some cheese，从没说要"做"奶酪；选项借高频词 cheese 诱选，把buy 偷换成 make。
借用原文：buy some cheese for a barbecue

source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man suggest the woman do?

options.text: Spend no more than 30 dollars.
Buy different kinds of cheese.
Help him prepare the barbecue.
Find out different people's tastes.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man suggest the woman do?

【翻译】男士建议女士做什么?
A) 花费不超过30美元。
B) 购买不同种类的奶酪。
C) 帮他准备烧烤。
D) 了解不同人的口味。
【答案】B （细节题）Buy different kinds of cheese.
【定位】I would suggest having at least one soft cheese and one hard cheese. That will offer you a good variety to suit different people's tastes.
我建议至少买一种软奶酪和一种硬奶酪。这样能提供丰富的选择，照顾到不同人的口味。
【信号】建议信号词 suggest。I would suggest having at least one soft cheese and one hard cheese 里的 suggest 是明确的建议信号，紧随其后的内容就是男方给的建议，正是答案落点。
【替换】one soft cheese and one hard cheese ↔Buy different kinds of cheese.
软硬各一=多种
a good variety to suit different people's tastes ↔Buy different kinds of cheese.
丰富选择即多种
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
30 dollars 出自女方 Let's say $30.，是她自报的预算，不是男方的建议；选项盗用这个数字，又把它说成"花不超过30"，与"男方建议"无关。
借用原文：Let's say $30.
C)
原词陷阱
barbecue 在 a barbecue this weekend 出现过，但男方从未建议女方"帮忙准备烧烤"，help prepare 是凭空添加。
借用原文：a barbecue this weekend
D)
原词陷阱
different people's tastes 确在原文 to suit different people's tastes，但它是"买软硬两种"想达到的目的，不是男方让她"去了解口味"这个动作；选项盗用原词却答非所问。
借用原文：to suit different people's tastes

source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about Spanish goat cheese?

options.text: It is the best kind of hard cheese.
It is the most popular in Spain.
It is more delicious than honey.
It is a good choice for children.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about Spanish goat cheese?
【翻译】男士对西班牙山羊奶酪有何评价?
A) 它是最好的硬质奶酪。
B) 它在西班牙最受欢迎。
C) 它比蜂蜜更美味。
D) 它对儿童来说是个好选择。
【答案】D （细节题）It is a good choice for children.

【定位】I would suggest something like this Spanish goat cheese. It's only $15, a very good price. You can spread it on bread with a knife, and then add a tiny bit of honey on top. It's delicious. Children love it.
我建议这种西班牙山羊奶酪。只要15美元，价格很划算。你可以用刀把它抹在面包上，再在上面加一点蜂蜜，很美味，孩子们都爱吃。
【信号】落点在 Children love it。讲西班牙山羊奶酪的几句里，结尾 Children love it. 是最贴近选项的评价句，这句直接给出"孩子爱吃"这一可与选项对应的信息。
【替换】Children love it. ↔It is a good choice for children.
孩子爱吃=适合孩子
【排除】A)
偷换概念
西班牙山羊奶酪在原文是作为软奶酪 soft cheeses are creamy 举例的，根本不是 hard cheese，更没说"最好的硬奶酪"；best 也是凭空拔高。
借用原文：soft cheeses are creamy and go well with sweet things
B)
原词陷阱
Spanish 确实出现在 Spanish goat cheese，但原文只说它产自西班牙/价格好，从没说它"在西班牙最受欢迎"；most popular 是无中生有。
借用原文：this Spanish goat cheese
C)
原词陷阱
honey 出自 add a tiny bit of honey on top，原文是说"加点蜂蜜更美味"，并没拿奶酪和蜂蜜比谁更好吃；选项把"配蜂蜜"歪成"比蜂蜜好吃"。
借用原文：add a tiny bit of honey on top. It's delicious.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the woman going to do at the end of the conversation?

options.text: Buy what the man recommended.
Have a taste of both of the cheeses.
Choose one of the two types of cheese.
Ask the man to cut the cheese into slices.

explanation:
【题目】What is the woman going to do at the end of the conversation?
【翻译】对话结束时女士打算做什么?
A) 购买男士推荐的奶酪。
B) 品尝这两种奶酪。
C) 在两种奶酪中选择一种。
D) 让男士把奶酪切成片。
【答案】A （细节题）Buy what the man recommended.
【定位】Okay, I'll take both. Thank you for your help.
好的，两种我都要。谢谢你的帮助。
【信号】结尾表态 I'll take both。对话末句 I'll take both. 是女方的最终拍板，I'll 是结尾决定的信号，这句决定了她要怎么做。

【替换】I'll take both. ↔Buy what the man recommended.
都要=买他推荐的
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
女方说的是 I'll take both.（两种都买下），不是"先尝两种"；选项盗用"两种"这个概念却把take（买）偷换成 taste（尝）。
借用原文：I'll take both.
C)
与原文相反
原文 I'll take both. 明说"都要"，选项却说"二选一"，方向正好相反；two types 这个原词对得上，结论却反了。
借用原文：I'll take both.
D)
张冠李戴
cut...into slices 出自男方介绍硬奶酪 You can cut it into thin slices，是吃法说明，女方结尾从没让对方切片；选项把男方的话安到女方动作上。
借用原文：You can cut it into thin slices and eat it on its own.

source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say about using e-textbooks?

options.text: New teachers and staff have to be recruited.
It might take some time for students to adapt.
It involves buying lots of tablets and software.
The software has to be constantly upgraded.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about using e-textbooks?
【翻译】女士对使用电子教材有何看法?
A) 需要招聘新的教师和工作人员。
B) 学生可能需要一些时间来适应。
C) 这涉及购买大量平板电脑和软件。
D) 软件必须不断升级。
【答案】C （细节题）It involves buying lots of tablets and software.
【定位】What about the cost, not only buying all those tablets, but the software and electronic infrastructure that goes with it, not to mention retraining all the teachers and administration staff?
那成本怎么办呢？不光是买那些平板，还有随之而来的软件和电子基础设施，更别提还要重新培训所有教师和行政人员了。

【信号】女士用反问抛出顾虑。男士刚说期待换电子书，女士立刻用 Really? What about the cost反问抛出"成本"这一顾虑——对话里一方的质疑/反问句往往就是该方观点的答案句，这句把"买平板和软件"列在最前。
【替换】buying all those tablets, but the software ↔buying lots of tablets and software
原话"买平板和软件"=选项"买大量平板和软件"
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音说的是 retraining all the teachers and administration staff（重新培训现有教师和行政人员），A 把它偷换成 New teachers and staff have to be recruited.（招聘新教师和员工）。"培训"不等于"招新人"，听到 staff 一词就选 A 正中陷阱。
借用原文：retraining all the teachers and administration staff
B)
未提及
It might take some time for students to adapt. 说学生适应需要时间，但女士的顾虑全在成本和环境上，整段对话没有任何一句谈"学生适应电子书要花时间"，属凭常识脑补的未提及项。
D)
张冠李戴
The software has to be constantly upgraded. 的"软件升级"出自男士 the software for electronic readers can be updated instantly，而且男士是把它当"好处"说的；本题问女士的顾虑，把男士的话张冠李戴到女士头上、又把好处当代价，双重错位。
借用原文：the software for electronic readers can be updated instantly
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: According to the man, how can the use of tablets benefit students?

options.text: It can greatly improve their learning efficiency.
It can help them to interact more with teachers.
It can save their trouble of carrying printed books.
It can develop their skills in using electronic devices.

explanation:
【题目】According to the man, how can the use of tablets benefit students?
【翻译】根据男士的说法,使用平板电脑如何能使学生受益?
A) 它可以大大提高他们的学习效率。
B) 它可以帮助他们与教师进行更多互动。
C) 它可以省去他们携带纸质书籍的麻烦。
D) 它可以培养他们使用电子设备的技能。
【答案】A （细节题）It can greatly improve their learning efficiency.
【定位】Anyway, tablets help students learn up to 80% faster.
总之，平板能帮学生的学习速度提升多达 80%。
【信号】男士用 Anyway 收束抛出核心好处。男士先回应成本问题，再用 Anyway, tablets help students learn up to 80% faster 把话题收回到"平板的好处"上——Anyway 后的总结句配上 80% 这个具体数字，正是他强调的核心益处，是答案句。
【替换】tablets help students learn up to 80% faster ↔greatly improve their learning efficiency
"学得快 80%"="大幅提升学习效率"

【排除】B)
未提及
It can help them to interact more with teachers. 说能多和老师互动，但男士讲的好处是"学得快"和能高亮、记笔记、快速搜索，没有一句提到"与老师互动更多"，是凭"电子设备促进互动"的印象脑补出来的。
C)
原词陷阱
录音多次出现 printed textbooks/printed books，C 借这个原词编出 It can save their trouble of carrying printed books.（省去背纸质书的麻烦）。但男士说的好处是高亮、记笔记、搜索快，从没说"省得背书"，是听到 printed books 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：printed textbooks
D)
偷换概念
录音谈的是 tablets contain many technological features（平板有很多技术功能），D 把它偷换成 It can develop their skills in using electronic devices.（培养学生用电子设备的技能）。男士讲的是功能带来的便利，不是"练会用设备"，借 technological/electronic 这层词制造混淆。
借用原文：tablets contain many technological features
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say about students using tablets?

options.text: They may have trouble comprehending texts.
They may encounter technological problems.
They may pay less respect to teachers.
They may get distracted more easily.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about students using tablets?
【翻译】女士对学生使用平板电脑有何看法?
A) 他们可能在理解文本方面遇到困难。
B) 他们可能会遇到技术问题。
C) 他们可能对教师较少尊重。
D) 他们可能更容易分心。
【答案】D （细节题）They may get distracted more easily.
【定位】Not necessarily. Tablets have too many distractions. Students may pay attention to apps, games and websites instead of their teachers.
未必。平板有太多让人分心的东西。学生可能会去关注各种应用、游戏和网站，而不是听老师讲课。
【信号】Not necessarily 否定后才是女士真意。女士用 Not necessarily 先否定男士"学得快"的说法，紧接着抛出 Tablets have too many distractions——否定/转折之后亮出的才是她真正要说的弊端，distractions 这个词直接对应"分心"。
【替换】Tablets have too many distractions ↔get distracted more easily
"有太多让人分心的东西"="更容易分心"

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音说 people who read printed text comprehend more（读纸质的人理解得更多），A借 comprehend 这个词编成 They may have trouble comprehending texts.（理解文字有困难）。原文是"读纸质理解更多"的对比，不是说学生用平板"看不懂"，听到comprehend 就选即落陷阱。
借用原文：people who read printed text comprehend more
B)
未提及
They may encounter technological problems. 说学生会遇到技术问题，但女士谈的是分心和纸质阅读理解更好，全程没说"学生用平板会碰到技术故障"，是凭"用电子设备会出故障"的常识补出来的。
C)
偷换概念
录音说学生可能 pay attention to apps, games and websites instead of their teachers（去看应用游戏而非听老师），C 借 teachers 偷换成 They may pay less respect to teachers.（不那么尊重老师）。原文说的是"注意力不在老师身上"，不是"不尊重老师"，听到 teachers 就选即中招。
借用原文：pay attention to apps, games and websites instead of their teachers
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say about making electronic readers?

options.text: It generates a great deal of electronic garbage.
It does a lot of damage to the environment.
It emits huge amounts of harmful radiation.
It accelerates the exhaustion of rare minerals.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about making electronic readers?
【翻译】女士对制造电子阅读器有何看法?
A) 它产生大量电子垃圾。
B) 它对环境造成很大破坏。
C) 它排放大量有害辐射。
D) 它加速稀有矿物的枯竭。
【答案】B （细节题）It does a lot of damage to the environment.
【定位】Actually, manufacturing tablets is environmentally destructive and dangerous to human health. A lot of minerals are extracted from the earth to make electronic readers. It does far more damage to the environment.
实际上，制造平板对环境有破坏性，也危害人体健康。要从地里开采大量矿物来制造电子阅读器。它对环境造成的破坏要大得多。
【信号】末句 It does far more damage 是收束结论。女士这段先说制造平板 environmentally destructive，列举健康危害和开采矿物，最后用 It does far more damage to the environment 一句收束——段末的总括性结论句正是她对"制造电子阅读器"的核心表态，是答案句。
【替换】It does far more damage to the environment ↔does a lot of damage to the environment
"破坏环境大得多"="对环境造成很大破坏"

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
未提及
It generates a great deal of electronic garbage. 说产生大量电子垃圾，但女士谈的是健康危害、开采矿物、破坏环境，没有一句提到"电子垃圾/garbage"，是把环保话题往"电子垃圾"这个常见印象上靠的未提及项。
C)
未提及
It emits huge amounts of harmful radiation. 说释放大量有害辐射，听上去很吓人，但女士只说 destructive、dangerous to health、extract minerals，从没说"辐射/radiation"，是凭"电子产品有辐射"的印象编的未提及项。
D)
原词陷阱
录音说 A lot of minerals are extracted from the earth to make electronic readers（开采大量矿物来造电子阅读器），D 借 minerals 编成 It accelerates the exhaustion of rare minerals.（加速稀有矿物枯竭）。原文说的是"开采矿物"这一事实，没说"加速枯竭"这个后果，且本题要的是女士的总括结论（破坏环境），D 是中途细节的过度引申。
借用原文：A lot of minerals are extracted from the earth to make electronic readers
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第19页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say we tend to do every day?

options.text: Communicate with our coworkers.
Encounter people in different places.
Judge people based on our first impressions.
Engage in a variety of psychological activities.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say we tend to do every day?
【翻译】文章说我们每天倾向于做什么？
A) 与同事交流。
B) 在不同地方遇见人。
C) 根据第一印象判断他人。
D) 从事各种心理活动。
【答案】C （细节题）Judge people based on our first impressions.
【定位】Consider how often you make this kind of judgment every day. When you meet with a new coworker, you immediately begin to develop an initial impression of this person.
想想你每天多频繁地做出这种评判。当你见到一位新同事，你立刻就开始形成对这个人的最初印象。
【信号】every day 原词复现+举例佐证。录音用 Consider how often you make this kind of judgment every day 直接点出我们每天都在做的这件事就是 judgment（评判），随后用见新同事就 develop an initial impression 的例子佐证，every day 与题干同词，是答案句的定位信号。
【替换】this kind of judgment ↔Judge people based on our first impressions
judgment 名词→Judge 动词同根
develop an initial impression ↔based on our first impressions
initial impression=first impression 同义

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音确实出现 When you meet with a new coworker，A 项 Communicate with our coworkers. 借了 coworker 这个原词，但录音说的是见到新同事时会形成印象，不是与同事沟通，盗词却答非所问。
借用原文：When you meet with a new coworker
B)
偷换概念
录音有 When you visit the grocery store 这个去不同地方的例子，B 项 Encounter people in different places. 借此包装成在不同地方遇见人，但录音此处讲的仍是对收银员形成评判，不是强调遇见人这件事本身，属把例子细节偷换成选项主语。
借用原文：When you visit the grocery store
D)
过度推断
录音讲的是一种具体行为——做评判、形成印象，D 项 Engage in a variety of psychological activities. 用 a variety of psychological activities 把它说得又大又泛，范围被夸大，不是录音点名的那一件每天做的事。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about person perception from this passage?

options.text: It is an objective evaluation of a person's character.
It is a mental process influenced by many factors.
It contributes to the formation of personal traits.
It varies greatly among different social groups.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about person perception from this passage?
【翻译】从这篇文章中我们对人际知觉了解到什么？
A) 它是对一个人性格的客观评价。
B) 它是一个受许多因素影响的心理过程。
C) 它有助于个人特质的形成。
D) 它在不同社会群体中差异很大。
【答案】B （细节题）It is a mental process influenced by many factors.
【定位】Obviously, person perception is a very subjective process that can be affected by a number of variables, including the characteristics of the person you are observing, the context of the situation, your own personal traits, and your past experiences.
显然，识人知觉是一个非常主观的过程，会受到许多变量的影响，包括你所观察对象的特征、情境的背景、你自身的性格特质，以及你过往的经历。
【信号】Obviously 强调+定性句。录音用 Obviously 加重语气引出对该概念的定性，紧接着 a very subjective process that can be affected by a number of variables 直接说它是主观的、受许多变量影响，这是专门给 person perception 定性的答案句。
【替换】a very subjective process ↔It is a mental process influenced by many factors
subjective process=mental process
affected by a number of variables ↔influenced by many factors
affected by variables=influenced by factors

【排除】A)
与原文相反
录音明说它是 a very subjective process（主观过程），A 项 It is an objective evaluation of a person's character. 却说成 objective（客观），把性质说反了，且evaluation、character 也只是蹭话题词。
借用原文：a very subjective process
C)
原词陷阱
录音里 your own personal traits 是影响 person perception 的因素之一，C 项 It contributes to the formation of personal traits. 却反过来说它造就了性格特质，借了personal traits 这个原词，但把因果方向整个调反了。
借用原文：your own personal traits
D)
未提及
D 项 It varies greatly among different social groups. 说它在不同社会群体间差异巨大，但录音讲的是它受个人层面的多种变量影响，从未提到社会群体之间的差异，属凭空添加。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the problem with using social categorization in person perception?

options.text: It can lead to incorrect judgments.
It can cause mistrust among people.
It can result in instant losses.
It can give rise to gender bias.

explanation:
【题目】What is the problem with using social categorization in person perception?
【翻译】在人际知觉中使用社会分类有什么问题？
A) 它可能导致错误的判断。
B) 它可能引起人与人之间的不信任。
C) 它可能造成即时损失。
D) 它可能引发性别偏见。
【答案】A （细节题）It can lead to incorrect judgments.
【定位】Problems with this technique include the fact that it can lead to errors and prejudice.
这种方法的问题包括：它会导致错误和偏见。
【信号】Problems 原词+lead to errors。录音用 Problems with this technique 直接对应题干的problem，紧跟 it can lead to errors and prejudice 点出弊端就是导致错误和偏见，Problems 一词与题干同义，是定位答案句的强信号。
【替换】it can lead to errors ↔It can lead to incorrect judgments
errors=incorrect judgments

【排除】B)
未提及
B 项 It can cause mistrust among people. 说会造成人际不信任，但录音讲的弊端是errors and prejudice（错误与偏见），从没说到不信任，属凭空添加的后果。
C)
原词陷阱
录音例子结尾说被偷了钱包 leading to the loss of your wallet，C 项 It can result in instant losses. 借 loss 这个原词包装成即时损失，但那只是一个具体例子的细节，本题问的是 social categorization 的整体弊端（错误与偏见），盗词答非所问，且 instant 也是录音没有的。
借用原文：leading to the loss of your wallet
D)
偷换概念
录音说弊端含 prejudice（偏见），D 项 It can give rise to gender bias. 借偏见这层意思却收窄成性别偏见，录音例子讲的是凭老妇与壮汉的外貌分类，从没限定为性别偏见，属以偏概全。
借用原文：prejudice
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the new study suggest about young people today and those from the previous generation?

options.text: Both groups spend a lot of time on mobile devices.
Both groups attach importance to social connections.
They are equally competent in using new technology.
They are similar in terms of social skills.

explanation:
【题目】What does the new study suggest about young people today and those from the previous generation?
【翻译】新研究对当今年轻人和上一代人有何提示?
A) 两个群体都在移动设备上花费大量时间。
B) 两个群体都重视社会联系。
C) 他们在使用新技术方面同样有能力。
D) 他们在社交技能方面相似。
【答案】D （细节题）They are similar in terms of social skills.
【定位】Despite smartphones and social media, young people today are as socially competent as those from the previous generation.
尽管有智能手机和社交媒体，今天的年轻人在社交能力上与上一代人不相上下。
【信号】让步 Despite 后才是真意。答案信号是让步词 Despite smartphones and social media ——让步状语先抛出一个看似负面的前提，真正的研究结论在它之后的主句 young people today are as socially competent as those from the previous generation，这种Despite／Although 后的主句正是篇章听力的高频落点。
【替换】as socially competent as those from the previous generation ↔ They are similar in terms of social skills.
as…as 等同改写成 similar

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音开头确实念到 smartphones and social media，A 项 Both groups spend a lot of time on mobile devices. 借这个原词诱你选，但原文只说尽管有手机、社交能力照样相当，从没说两代人都花大量时间在设备上，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：smartphones and social media
B)
未提及
B 项 Both groups attach importance to social connections. 说两代都重视社交联系，但原文只比较社交能力强弱（competent），从未说他们重视或看重社交，研究里没有这层意思。
C)
偷换概念
录音提到 mobile devices were widespread，C 项 They are equally competent in using new technology. 借 technology 与 competent 两个耳熟词诱选，但原文说的是社交能力（socially competent）相当，不是使用技术的能力相当，把社交能力偷换成了用技术的能力。
借用原文：mobile devices were widespread
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the study find about children who accessed social networking sites many times a day?

options.text: Their social skills were negatively affected.
Their school performance was slightly lower.
Their emotions were much harder to regulate.
Their relations with peers were badly strained.

explanation:
【题目】What did the study find about children who accessed social networking sites many times a day?
【翻译】该研究对每天多次访问社交网站的儿童有何发现?
A) 他们的社交技能受到了负面影响。
B) 他们的学业表现略有下降。
C) 他们的情绪更加难以调节。
D) 他们与同龄人的关系严重紧张。
【答案】A （细节题）Their social skills were negatively affected.
【定位】There was one exception: Social skills were slightly lower for children who accessed online games and social networking sites many times a day.
有一个例外：对于每天多次玩网络游戏和上社交网站的孩子，他们的社交能力略低一些。
【信号】例外 one exception 即落点。答案信号是转折式提示词 There was one exception——前文一直说社交能力保持不变或提升，唯独这个 exception 后面交代了负面发现 Social skills were slightly lower，例外句是典型的答案落点。
【替换】Social skills were slightly lower ↔Their social skills were negatively affected.
变低概括为受负面影响

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音里 slightly lower 修饰的是 social skills（社交能力），B 项 Their school performance was slightly lower. 原封不动搬来 slightly lower，却把对象换成学业表现，原文从没说成绩略低，属听到 slightly lower 就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：Social skills were slightly lower
C)
张冠李戴

stem: What is adults' worry about technological change?

options.text: It may pose a threat to their children's safety.
It may affect society's traditional values.
It may hurt their relations with children.
It may change their children's ethical values.

explanation:
【题目】What is adults' worry about technological change?
【翻译】成年人对技术变革的担忧是什么?
A) 它可能对他们孩子的安全构成威胁。
B) 它可能影响社会的传统价值观。
C) 它可能损害他们与孩子的关系。
D) 它可能改变他们孩子的伦理价值观。
【答案】C （细节题）It may hurt their relations with children.
【定位】Adults are worried when technological change starts to undermine traditional relationships, particularly the parent-child relationship.
当科技变化开始侵蚀传统关系、尤其是亲子关系时，成年人会感到担忧。
【信号】worried 直陈担忧 + particularly 点重点。答案信号是表担忧的谓语 Adults are worried，其担忧对象由 undermine traditional relationships 给出，再由强调词particularly the parent-child relationship 把重点收窄到亲子关系——particularly 后面的限定正是答案要的具体落点。
【替换】undermine traditional relationships, particularly the parent-child relationship ↔ It may hurt their relations with children.
undermine=hurt，parent-child=with children

【排除】A)
未提及
A 项 It may pose a threat to their children's safety. 借耳熟的 children 诱选，但原文成年人担忧的是亲子关系被侵蚀，从没提孩子的人身安全（safety），属新增内容。
B)
偷换概念
录音念过 traditional relationships 与第 6 段的 moral panic，B 项 It may affect society's traditional values. 借 traditional 诱选，但原文担忧的是传统关系（relationships），不是社会传统价值（values），把关系偷换成了价值观。
借用原文：traditional relationships
D)
过度推断
第 6 段提到 moral panic，D 项 It may change their children's ethical values. 借这条道德暗线诱选，但 moral panic 指成年人面对新技术的恐慌情绪，原文从未说科技会改变孩子的道德／伦理价值观，属由 moral 一词过度推断。
借用原文：moral panic

stem: What does the speaker say about inspiration from consuming others' ideas and success stories?

options.text: It is motivating.
It is passive.
It is incredible.
It is impracticable.

explanation:
【题目】What does the speaker say about inspiration from consuming others' ideas and success stories?
【翻译】说话人对于从他人的想法和成功故事中获取灵感有何看法?
A) 它具有激励作用。
B) 它是被动的。
C) 它令人难以置信。
D) 它不切实际。
【答案】B （细节题）It is passive.
【定位】The problem is that consuming the success and ideas of others is passive inspiration.
问题在于，消费他人的成功与想法，是一种被动的灵感。
【信号】下定义句 is + 定性词。这句用 consuming the success and ideas of others is passive inspiration 的 "A is B" 结构，直接给 "消费他人成功" 贴上 passive inspiration 的标签，是典型的下定义信号，定性题答案就藏在这种 "...is..." 的判断里。
【替换】passive inspiration ↔It is passive.
原词原义直接对应
【排除】A)
与原文相反
录音把 consuming 来的灵感判为 passive（被动），而 It is motivating. 说它有激励性，恰与原文相反，是把被动说成主动激励。
借用原文：passive inspiration
C)
原词陷阱
录音 P1 确实出现过 incredible videos, articles and news stories，incredible 是用来形容那些视频文章 "很精彩"，并不是给 passive inspiration 的定性；选项 It is incredible. 盗这个原词来骗 "听到就选"。
借用原文：incredible videos, articles and news stories
D)
未提及
录音从未说 consuming 来的 inspiration 是 impracticable（不切实际的），原文只说它passive、不能代替自己创造，并没有 "不可行" 这层意思，属凭空添加。

stem: What do we learn from the passage about active inspiration?

options.text: It results in short-term excitement.
It helps us avoid making mistakes.
It breeds long-term passion and enthusiasm.
It is bound to help us achieve greater success.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the passage about active inspiration?
【翻译】从文章中我们对主动灵感了解到什么?
A) 它会产生短期的兴奋感。
B) 它帮助我们避免犯错。
C) 它孕育长期的热情和热忱。
D) 它必定会帮助我们取得更大的成功。
【答案】C （细节题）It breeds long-term passion and enthusiasm.
【定位】Furthermore, active inspiration is what results in long-term passion and enthusiasm.
此外，主动的灵感正是带来长久热情与激情的东西。
【信号】递进 Furthermore 后给定论。Furthermore, active inspiration is what results in long-term passion and enthusiasm 由 Furthermore 引出对 active inspiration 的进一步定论，递进词后常接观点落点；同时 results in 是因果信号，直接给出它的结果。
【替换】results in long-term passion and enthusiasm ↔It breeds long-term passion and enthusiasm.
results in 同义替换为 breeds
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
录音说 short-term 的是 watching 别人成功带来的兴奋——Watching someone else's success might leave you feeling excited for a few minutes，那是 passive 一侧的效果；It results in short-term excitement. 把这份 "短暂兴奋" 安到 active inspiration 头上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：Watching someone else's success might leave you feeling excited for a few minutes
B)
与原文相反
录音讲 active inspiration 包含 making mistakes（犯错）才认识自我，从没说它能 avoid making mistakes（避免犯错），It helps us avoid making mistakes. 把原文里的 "犯错"反着安成 "避免犯错"，原文无此说法。
借用原文：making mistakes that we discover who we are
D)
过度推断
录音只说 active inspiration 带来长期热情、给你 power，并没有保证它 "必然带来更大成功"；It is bound to help us achieve greater success. 中 bound to（必定）把效果夸成必然成功，推过了头。
借用原文：active inspiration is what results in long-term passion and enthusiasm

stem: What does the passage say passive inspiration can do?

options.text: Drive us forward.
Bring us power.
Spur us to action.
Give us ideas.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say passive inspiration can do?
【翻译】文章指出被动灵感能做什么?
A) 推动我们前进。
B) 给我们带来力量。
C) 激励我们采取行动。
D) 给我们提供想法。
【答案】D （细节题）Give us ideas.
【定位】Passive inspiration can give you ideas, but active inspiration will give you power.
被动的灵感能给你想法，但主动的灵感会给你力量。
【信号】对比句 but 两侧分派功能。Passive inspiration can give you ideas, but active inspiration will give you power 用 but 把两种 inspiration 的功能并排对照，passive 给ideas、active 给 power；对比句两侧的分工正是答案点，须按主语取属于 passive 的那半句。
【替换】Passive inspiration can give you ideas ↔Give us ideas.
give you ideas 改 give us ideas
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
录音 P4 说 creating, producing, and experimenting is what drives you forward，drive forward 是 active 一侧（创造、试验）的功能；Drive us forward. 把它安到 passive 头上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：creating, producing, and experimenting is what drives you forward
B)
原词陷阱
对比句明说 active inspiration will give you power，给 power 的是 active；Bring us power. 盗用原词 power 却把它派给 passive，正中 but 后半句被对调的陷阱。
借用原文：active inspiration will give you power
C)
原词陷阱
录音 P3 出现过 taking action and applying a new idea to your life，action 是讲 active inspiration 的语境，且原文并无 "passive 能 spur us to action" 的说法；Spur us to action. 借 action 这个原词制造熟悉感，却答非所问。
借用原文：taking action and applying a new idea to your life

stem: Where does the best inspiration come from according to the passage?

options.text: Listening to success stories.
Applying ideas to one's life.
Following the advice of experts.

explanation:
【题目】Where does the best inspiration come from according to the passage?

A) 倾听成功故事。

最好的灵感来自对想法的应用，而非对它们的消费。
【信号】结尾总括句 the best...comes from。The best inspiration comes from the application of ideas, not the consumption of them 是末段收束的总括定调句，the best...comes from 直接给出结论，且用 not 把对立的 consumption 排掉，是篇章结尾的答案落点信号。

名词 application 还原为动词 applying

D)

wrong 是形容词，能往 32 题 than __(32)__ personal missions 塞，且全文开头 Public perception of success in the U.S. might be totally misguided. 谈“误解”，让人误以为哪里要个“错误的”。但 32 处要正面描述年轻人向往的使命，wrong（错误的，贬义）色彩相反。识破点：形容词先看褒贬，色彩与上下文冲突即排除。

stem: What do we learn from the study by the Josephson Institute of Ethics?

options.text: Over half of the students interviewed were unaware they were cheating.
Cheating was becoming a way of life for a majority of high school teens.
More than half of the interviewees felt no sense of guilt over cheating.
Cheating was getting more and more difficult for high school students.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn from the study 是对某项具体研究内容的客观转述提问,不涉及推断、主旨、态度,属于针对单一信息源的细节题。
【拆句】结构是 What do we learn from the study by the Josephson Institute of Ethics?——主干是 what do we learn from + 名词短语,介词短语 by the Josephson Institute of Ethics修饰 the study,语序简单、无陷阱。
【定位】Of the teens surveyed, 51 percent said that they had knowingly cheated at some point on an exam but that they did not feel uneasy about the behavior.
在受访的青少年中,51% 的人说他们曾在某次考试中明知故犯地作弊,但对这种行为并不感到不安。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
Over half of the students interviewed were unaware they were cheating. 说"过半受访者不知道自己在作弊",但定位句明明用了 knowingly,与之相反;"不知情作弊"是后文Common Sense Media 部分讨论的内容,被偷换到本题。
B)
过度推断
Cheating was becoming a way of life for a majority of high school teens. 把"曾在某次考试作弊"升级为"成为生活方式",程度被无端拔高;定位句只说"曾经作弊过",并未说"已成为日常"。
C)
✓ 正确
51 percent said that they had knowingly cheated ↔More than half of the interviewees
did not feel uneasy about the behavior ↔felt no sense of guilt over cheating
More than half of the interviewees felt no sense of guilt over cheating. 把"过半"和"无负罪感"同时对上定位句,正是细节题最干净的同义替换。
D)
与原文相反
Cheating was getting more and more difficult for high school students. 说作弊变得越来越难,但全文核心论点是 technology has made it easier than ever,方向完全相反。

stem: What did the Common Sense Media survey reveal?

options.text: Most parents tended to overprotect their children.
Many students committed cheating unknowingly.
Students were in urgent need of ethical education.
Parents and kids had conflicting ideas over cheating.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What did the Common Sense Media survey reveal? 同样指向某项具体调查的客观发现,属于客观转述,不涉态度/推断。
【拆句】What did the Common Sense Media survey reveal?——主谓宾极简单,reveal 在此当及物动词"揭示",一个主语一个宾语,无修饰、无从句。
【定位】A Common Sense Media survey found that 35 percent of students had cheated via smartphone, though the parents surveyed in that particular study did not believe their kids had ever cheated. In many cases, students did not realize that strategies like looking up answers on a smartphone were actually cheating at all.
Common Sense Media 的一项调查发现 35% 的学生曾用智能手机作弊,尽管该项调查中受访的家长并不相信自己的孩子曾经作弊。很多情况下,学生根本没意识到用手机查答案这种做法其实就是作弊。
【选项】A)
无中生有
Most parents tended to overprotect their children. 中 overprotect(过度保护)是原文里完全没出现的概念,文中只说家长 did not believe their kids had ever cheated(不相信孩子作过弊),这是"不知情"而非"过度保护"。
B)
✓ 正确
students did not realize that strategies like looking up answers on a smartphone were actually cheating at all ↔Many students committed cheating unknowingly
looking up answers on a smartphone were actually cheating ↔committed cheating
Many students committed cheating unknowingly. 同时覆盖"作弊"和"不自知"两个要点,正是定位句最干净的同义替换。
C)
答非所问
Students were in urgent need of ethical education. 是"应该"层面的建议(末段才有类似主张),并非该调查所揭示的事实;47 题问的是 reveal,要求是事实,不是该做什么。
D)
偷换概念
Parents and kids had conflicting ideas over cheating. 把家长不知情与学生不自知放在一起描述为"观念冲突",但原文里两方都不认为自己/孩子在作弊,实际上是"双方都没认识到",不是冲突,而是同向盲区。

stem: Why do students rarely get caught cheating nowadays?

options.text: They copy formulas on their palms.
They help each other to cover up their acts.
They keep changing their ways of cheating.
They make use of modern technology.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】Why do students rarely get caught cheating nowadays? 用 Why 问原因,但原因往往在原文同一句或紧邻句给出,不需多步推理,仍属细节定位。
【拆句】Why do students rarely get caught cheating nowadays?——副词 rarely 是隐性否定"很少/几乎不",get caught doing 是"被抓到正在做某事"的固定结构,nowadays 限定时间。基础薄弱考生注意:rarely 不是"罕见"的名词,而是"很少"的副词。
【定位】In today's classrooms, students who cheat are rarely caught. There are no formulas written on the insides of hands or students looking across the aisle, or whispering answers to their classmates. Today's students use smartphones, tablets or even in-class computers to aid their cheating attempts and leave no trace of their crimes.
在今天的教室里,作弊的学生很少被抓到。没人再在手心写公式、隔着过道偷看,或者向同学小声报答案。今天的学生用智能手机、平板,甚至课堂电脑辅助作弊,不留任何痕迹。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
They copy formulas on their palms. 实际上正是原文用 no formulas written on the insides of hands 否定掉的旧做法,选项把这条已经被否定的现象当成"现在"还在做,方向恰好反了。
B)
无中生有
They help each other to cover up their acts. 中 cover up(掩盖)的描述在原文里完全没有;原文只说技术让作弊"不留痕迹",并未说学生互相帮忙打掩护。
C)
偷换概念
They keep changing their ways of cheating. 描述"学生不断改变作弊方式",但原文是"作弊方式随时代而变"——主语是"作弊方式",不是"学生";而且 keep changing 强调持续变化,原文只比较了"以前 vs 现在"两个时点。
D)
✓ 正确
use smartphones, tablets or even in-class computers ↔They make use of modern technology
to aid their cheating attempts ↔make use of
They make use of modern technology. 用 modern technology 一词覆盖原文三种设备,且对应了 to aid their cheating attempts 的"借助"语义,是干净的概括化替换。

stem: What does the author think schools should do to tackle cheating?

options.text: Bring policies against cheating up to date.
Reform their exam methods constantly.
Take advantage of the latest technologies.
Alert parents to their children's behaviour.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author think schools should do 问的是作者对学校的具体建议,原文末段是直接的祈使/must 句,属客观陈述,不是推断。
【拆句】What does the author think schools should do to tackle cheating?——主句 What does the author think,后接宾语从句 schools should do,不定式 to tackle cheating 作目的状语,逻辑就是"作者认为学校该做什么来解决作弊"。
【定位】Schools must develop anti-cheating policies that include technology and these policies must be updated consistently.
学校必须制定包含科技因素的反作弊政策,并且这些政策必须不断更新。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
these policies must be updated consistently ↔Bring policies against cheating up to date
anti-cheating policies ↔policies against cheating
Bring policies against cheating up to date. 把"持续更新政策"这一并列要点提炼出来,正命中原文 must be updated consistently;且 against cheating 等值替换anti-cheating。
B)
无中生有
Reform their exam methods constantly. 提到"改革考试方式",但原文末段对学校的建议只涉及"制定/更新政策",未谈考试方式的改革。
C)
与原文相反
Take advantage of the latest technologies. 让学校利用最新技术(去解决作弊),但原文里技术是问题源——students learn that answers exist conveniently at their fingertips through search engines——学校要做的是把技术纳入政策约束,而非利用技术解决问题。
D)
张冠李戴
Alert parents to their children's behaviour. 让学校去提醒家长,但原文末段对学校只字未提家长这件事;"alert"一词原文里出现在家长对孩子的位置 alert them to unethical behaviours。

stem: What does the author suggest teachers do in the classroom?

options.text: Prevent students from overusing electronic devices.
Develop more effective anti-cheating strategies.
Find more ways to curb students' unethical acts.
Guard against students' misuse of technology.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the author suggest teachers do in the classroom? 仍是对原文一句建议句的转述,无推断需求,属细节题。
【拆句】What does the author suggest teachers do in the classroom?——suggest 后接省略that 的宾语从句 teachers (should) do,基础薄弱考生注意:suggest 后从句的 should 常省略,do 是动词原形而不是名词。
【定位】Teachers must stay on guard when it comes to what their students are doing in classrooms and how technology could be playing a negative role in the learning process.
老师必须时刻警惕——既要警惕学生在课堂里都在做什么,也要警惕科技可能在学习过程中扮演的负面角色。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
Prevent students from overusing electronic devices. 把"科技扮演负面角色"窄化为单一的"过度使用电子设备";原文要警惕的核心不是"用得太多",而是"用得不当"(作弊)。
B)
张冠李戴
Develop more effective anti-cheating strategies. 让老师去"制定更有效的反作弊策略",但末段把"develop policies"的任务给了 schools,老师只是"stay on guard"。
C)
过度推断
Find more ways to curb students' unethical acts. 让老师"找出更多办法去遏制不道德行为",但原文里老师的动作只是"警惕",并未要求老师去找新办法或主动出击。
D)
✓ 正确
Teachers must stay on guard ↔Guard against
how technology could be playing a negative role in the learning process ↔ students' misuse of technology
Guard against students' misuse of technology. 把"警惕"与"科技的负面作用"两块拼成一个干净的动宾结构,正命中原文要点。

stem: What does the author say companies should do in the context of remote work?

options.text: Reform performance evaluation.
Rethink the organizational fundamentals.
Reexamine its effects on employees' behaviors.
Reflect on its differences from working in the office.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say companies should do 在问作者具体让公司做什么，落点是文中明示的一条做法，没有 infer / imply / mainly about 之类的字眼，因此走常规定位路径即可。
【拆句】题干主干是 What does the author say companies should do，what 既是 say 的宾语从句中 do 的宾语，也是整句的疑问焦点；句尾 in the context of remote work 是介词短语状语，限定背景。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Organizations should reconsider the appropriateness of their performance evaluation procedures in light of the shift to remote work.
组织应当鉴于向远程办公的转变，重新审视其绩效评估程序是否仍然适当。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
reconsider the appropriateness of their performance evaluation procedures ↔ Reform performance evaluation
Reform performance evaluation 既保留了 "重新审视"（reform）的动作，也保留了"绩效评估"（performance evaluation）的对象，完全覆盖预判语义。
B)
偷换概念
Rethink the organizational fundamentals 把原文的 "绩效评估制度" 偷换成 "组织根本"；原文虽提 a fundamental rethinking of what organizations expect from employees，但 fundamental 在原文是修饰 rethinking 的副词性形容词，并非要 "重审组织根本" 这一对象。
C)
无中生有
Reexamine its effects on employees' behaviors 谈的是 "重新审视远程办公对员工行为的影响"，原文从未谈论 "对员工行为的影响" 这一对象，只谈对评估制度的影响。
D)
答非所问
Reflect on its differences from working in the office 说的是 "反思远程办公与在办公室办公的差异"，仅对应原文铺垫句 Remote work is about more than just working from home—it means working differently，没有触及作者真正提出的 "重审绩效评估" 这一行动建议。

stem: What should be prioritized in assessing employees' remote work?

options.text: The quantity of their output.
The length of their work time.
The quality of their contribution.
The flexibility of their work schedules.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What should be prioritized 问 "什么应被优先考虑"，问的是一个具体的优先项；无推断信号，原文必有明示。
【拆句】题干为 What should be prioritized in assessing employees' remote work：被动语态should be prioritized，主语 what 是被优先项；in V-ing 短语作状语，标明范围。结构直白，无陷阱。
【定位】It is likely that the "first to arrive and last to leave" mentality is no longer relevant, but should be replaced by a regard for the quality of an employee's contribution to the organization.
"早到晚走" 的心态很可能已不再适用，应该被对员工对组织所作贡献的质量的看重所取代。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
The quantity of their output 关心的是 "产出的数量"，与原文 the quality of an employee's contribution 中的 quality 形成数 vs 质的直接对立；第三段 Focusing on output alone can have unintended consequences 也明确反对单看产出。
B)
与原文相反
The length of their work time 即 "工作时长"，恰恰是原文 the "first to arrive and last to leave" mentality 所代表的旧心态，被作者明确判为 "no longer relevant"。
C)
✓ 正确
the quality of an employee's contribution to the organization ↔ The quality of their contribution
The quality of their contribution 把 but 之后的新标准短语几乎原样搬过来，完全等于预判结果。
D)
张冠李戴
The flexibility of their work schedules 谈 "工作时间安排的弹性"，对应的是第六段flexible work schedules，那里讨论的是 "补偿" 而非 "评估优先项"，被嫁接到了第52 题。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What quality in the employees would be of great importance in a remote work context?

options.text: The ability to produce quality work.
The ability to maximize work efficiency.
The ability to finish tasks in a timely manner.
The ability to work with the least supervision.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What quality ... would be of great importance 问的是一项被作者点名为重要的素质，原文必有明示项。
【拆句】题干主干 What quality in the employees would be of great importance in a remote work context：what 修饰 quality，构成疑问焦点；in the employees 与 in a remote work context 都是 in 短语作定语 / 状语；would be 是表 "一般陈述" 的虚拟语气。无陷阱。
【定位】Qualities like flexibility and the ability to work under minimal supervision might become critical.
诸如灵活性以及在极少督导下工作的能力之类的素质可能会变得至关重要。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
The ability to produce quality work 谈 "产出高质量工作"，回到的是第二段 the quality of the work，与第 52 题答案重合；第三段开头 Focusing on output alone can have unintended consequences 已明确不再单看产出。
B)
无中生有
The ability to maximize work efficiency 提出 "工作效率最大化"，原文从未出现efficiency 或与之对应的概念；远程办公段也未谈效率优化。
C)
张冠李戴
The ability to finish tasks in a timely manner 谈 "按时完成任务"，把第四段的 timely feedback 嫁接到第三段；原文谈的是反馈要及时，并非要求员工按时交付。
D)
✓ 正确
the ability to work under minimal supervision ↔ The ability to work with the least supervision
The ability to work with the least supervision 与预判 "在极少督导下工作的能力" 在动词、对象、形容词强度上一一对应。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: Why is it important for firms to provide timely feedback during the pandemic?

options.text: To evaluate their employees of similar rank in a consistent way.
To keep a watchful eye on those employees who perform poorly.
To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment.
To maintain connections with their employees away from office.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 Why is it important for firms to provide timely feedback 问 "为何及时反馈很重要"，原文必然存在与之对应的 "to do / so that / in order to" 类目的句。
【拆句】题干 Why is it important for firms to provide timely feedback during the pandemic：句型 "why is it important for sb to do sth"，it 是形式主语、to provide 是真正主语；during the pandemic 介词短语作状语限定时间。无陷阱。
【定位】This allows managers to both keep an eye on struggling employees and provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting to their new work environment.
这样做既能让管理者关注陷入困境的员工，又能持续就员工如何适应新的工作环境提供反馈。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
To evaluate their employees of similar rank in a consistent way 谈 "以一致方式评估同级员工"，对应的是第二段 in a way that is consistent for employees of similar rank，那里讲的是绩效度量、不是反馈目的。
B)
以偏概全
To keep a watchful eye on those employees who perform poorly 只对应原文 keep an eye on struggling employees 这一半目的，遗漏了 provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting；而且 perform poorly 把中性词 struggling 偷换成了带负面评价的 "表现差劲"。
C)
✓ 正确
provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting to their new work environment ↔ To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment
keep an eye on struggling employees ↔employees in need
To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment 同时命中原文目的中的两个核心元素——struggling employees（in need）与 adapting to their new work environment（adapt to the new work environment）。
D)
无中生有
To maintain connections with their employees away from office 谈 "维持与异地员工的联系"，原文从未把 timely feedback 的目的描述为 "维持联系"，连 connection 一词都没出现。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What is the author's suggestion to employers who experience the financial impact of the pandemic?

options.text: Urging their employees to adapt to the new situation.
Rewarding their employees in unconventional ways.
Identifying employees who make little contribution.
Allowing their employees to look for part-time jobs.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What is the author's suggestion 问一条明示的建议，落点具体，无推断信号词。
【拆句】题干 What is the author's suggestion to employers who experience the financial impact of the pandemic：主干 "What is the author's suggestion"，to employers 是suggestion 的对象状语，who 引导定语从句修饰 employers。结构略长但逻辑清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】For organizations that have struggled to keep the lights on due to the pandemic, this might mean thinking of non-financial ways to reward employees, like unpaid time off or flexible work schedules.
对于那些因疫情挣扎着维持运营的组织而言，这或许意味着要考虑用非财务的方式来奖励员工，比如无薪假期或弹性工作安排。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
Urging their employees to adapt to the new situation 把建议的发出对象与动作都改了：原文要求雇主 "改用非金钱奖励"，而本项变成 "催促员工适应新形势"。adapt to the new situation 又把 adapting to their new work environment 拼贴过来。
B)
✓ 正确
non-financial ways to reward employees ↔ Rewarding their employees in unconventional ways
Rewarding their employees in unconventional ways 既保留了原文的核心动作reward，又把 non-financial 抽象到 unconventional，与预判 "用非金钱 / 非常规方式奖励员工" 完全合拍。
C)
无中生有
Identifying employees who make little contribution 谈 "识别低贡献员工"，原文从未提出在疫情下要 "挑出低贡献员工" 这种建议；contribution 一词只在第二段衡量标准中出现，与第六段建议无关。
D)
过度推断
Allowing their employees to look for part-time jobs 谈 "允许员工找兼职"，原文虽提到 unpaid time off or flexible work schedules，但没有任何 "找兼职" 的建议；二者不可等同。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2022-09/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What happened at one of Australia's largest gold mines?

options.text: Part of its dam wall collapsed.
It released a lot of harmful gases.
It was destroyed by an earthquake.
Some miners were trapped underground.

explanation:
【题目】What happened at one of Australia's largest gold mines?
【翻译】澳大利亚最大的金矿之一发生了什么？
A) 其大坝墙体部分坍塌。
B) 它释放了大量有害气体。
C) 它被地震摧毁。
D) 一些矿工被困在地下。
【答案】A （细节题）Part of its dam wall collapsed.
【定位】Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had to be temporarily suspended on Friday after a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams.
澳大利亚一座最大的金矿之一不得不在周五暂停作业，原因是该矿其中一个尾矿坝的坝体发生了局部坍塌。
【信号】新闻导语首句锁定核心事件。Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had to be temporarily suspended on Friday after a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams. 是整篇新闻的导语句，结构「结果（停产）+ after + 原因（坝体局部坍塌）」完整地把核心事件交代清楚——after 之后的 partial wall collapse 就是事件本身，对应第 1 题答案。
【替换】a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams ↔Part of its dam wall collapsed.
名词化 ↔ 主谓化

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音第 4 段 materials which are harmful to the environment and human health 出现了 harmful 这个词，但说的是「坝里盛着的矿渣可能对环境与人体有害」，并非「这次事件释放了有害气体」。选项 B 把 harmful 这个原词盗过来，再加上原文从未提及的 gases，制造了「听到 harmful 就选」的诱惑。
借用原文：materials which are harmful to the environment and human health
C)
原词陷阱
录音第 2 段 The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit the area. 只说「坝塌发生在两次地震几天之后」，并未说「金矿被地震毁了」；第 6 段更明说 The company was unable to confirm whether the recent earthquakes had contributed to the dam's wall collapse——连地震是否与坝塌有关都未确认。选项 C 把 earthquakes 这个原词盗过来，硬生生升级成「被地震毁」，是典型的过度推断。
借用原文：The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit the area.
D)
未提及
录音从头到尾只讲「坝体局部坍塌、暂停作业、调查中」，第 7 段反而明说 the break had posed no safety threat to workers——发言人特意说事故对工人没有安全威胁。选项 D描述的「矿工被困井下」完全是矿难常见画面，凭考生的「常识联想」来骗人，原文无任何依据。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the spokesperson say about the incident?

options.text: It posed a safety threat to the miners.
It caused damage too heavy to assess.
It brought the mine's operations to a halt.
It was followed by two more earthquakes.

explanation:
【题目】What did the spokesperson say about the incident?
【翻译】发言人对这一事件说了什么？
A) 它对矿工的安全构成了威胁。
B) 它造成的损失过于严重而无法评估。
C) 它使该矿的运营陷入停顿。
D) 它之后又发生了两次地震。
【答案】C （细节题）It brought the mine's operations to a halt.
【定位】A company spokesperson said the operations at the site had been halted while the investigation is ongoing and that the break had posed no safety threat to workers.
公司发言人表示，调查期间该矿区已停止作业，并称这次坝体破裂并未对工人构成任何安全威胁。
【信号】spokesperson said 引述信号词。第 7 段开头 A company spokesperson said 是最强的引述信号，直接告诉考生「下面这句就是发言人的原话」。句中包含两个并列宾语从句（halted while investigation + no safety threat），把「停产」和「对工人无安全威胁」一并说出，正是第 2 题的答案句。

【替换】the operations at the site had been halted ↔It brought the mine's operations to a halt.
被动 ↔ 主动 + 动词名词化
had to be temporarily suspended on Friday ↔It brought the mine's operations to a halt.
suspend = halt
【排除】A)
与原文相反
录音第 7 段明确说 the break had posed no safety threat to workers——发言人特意强调「没有」构成安全威胁。选项 A 把 posed、safety threat 这几个高辨识度原词原样照搬，唯独把 no 去掉，含义彻底反转。这是听力里最经典的「否定词陷阱」。
借用原文：the break had posed no safety threat to workers
B)
过度推断
录音第 6 段说 said it was conducting a thorough investigation——公司正在做全面调查；选项 B 却把「在调查」升级成「损失大到无法评估」 It caused damage too heavy to assess.，凭空加上了 too heavy to assess 这一程度判断，原文无任何依据。
借用原文：said it was conducting a thorough investigation
D)
原词陷阱
录音第 2 段说 The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit the area.——坝塌发生在两次地震「之后」（事件 ← 两次地震在前）；选项 D It was followed by two more earthquakes. 却说「这次事件之后又有两次地震」，时序刚好相反，更多了 more 这个原文没有的词。选项 D 把 two earthquakes 这个原词盗过来，把时序对调。
借用原文：The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit the area.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the hospital do for the delivery of the babies?

options.text: It prepared beds for all the six new citizens.
It assigned a team of doctors for each expected baby.
It made ample preparations for various possibilities.
It brought in the most advanced instruments.

explanation:
【题目】What did the hospital do for the delivery of the babies?
【翻译】医院为婴儿的分娩做了什么?
A) 它为所有六位新公民准备了床位。
B) 它为每个预产婴儿指派了一个医生团队。
C) 它为各种可能性做了充分准备。
D) 它引进了最先进的仪器。
【答案】B （细节题）It assigned a team of doctors for each expected baby.
【定位】The doctors prepared from early in the morning to help deliver five tiny citizens. They were in the operating room with five teams of doctors, one for each baby.
医生们从清晨就开始做准备，迎接五个小公民的降生。他们和五组医生一起守在产房，每个宝宝都配一组医生。
【信号】动词 prepared 直接对接题干 do。题干问 do，录音里出现 The doctors prepared from early in the morning——同一语义场的动词 prepared 就是答案信号；紧接着的 five teams of doctors, one for each baby 把"准备"具体化为"按预计人数一对一配"，两句合起来构成完整答案句。
【替换】five teams of doctors, one for each baby ↔a team of doctors for each expected baby
one for each baby ↔ a team for each baby
five teams of doctors ↔a team of doctors for each expected baby
总数→分配视角的转换

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
It prepared beds for all the six new citizens. 把"六个新公民都准备了床"安在医院头上，但录音 all baby beds were occupied. And then all of a sudden, it turned out there was another waiting to come out 说前五张床被占满后突然来了第六个，恰恰证明医院只准备了五张床，第六个是意外。选项里的 six 是听到的原词，却用在错误事实上。
借用原文：all baby beds were occupied. And then all of a sudden, it turned out there was another waiting to come out
C)
It made ample preparations for various possibilities. 听起来像"做了充分应对各种可能性的准备"，但录音里没有任何"应对多种可能性"的话——医院其实只按五个宝宝准备，第六个是意外，恰恰说明它并未为"各种可能"做准备。这是用空泛大词诱选的典型。
借用原文：all of a sudden, it turned out there was another waiting to come out
D)
It brought in the most advanced instruments. 说医院引进了最先进的仪器，可录音通篇都没提到任何 instrument 或 advanced 之类的词，纯属无中生有。最高级 the most 一旦录音里没有等值表述就不能选。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the doctor say about the newborns?

options.text: They had to undergo 2-3 physical checkups.
They were all of normal size except the sixth.
They could go home together with their mother a day later.
They needed to stay in the hospital for a couple of months.

explanation:
【题目】What did the doctor say about the newborns?
【翻译】医生对新生儿说了什么?
A) 他们必须接受2到3次体检。
B) 除了第六个婴儿外,他们的体型都正常。
C) 他们可以在一天后与母亲一起回家。
D) 他们需要在医院住几个月。
【答案】D （细节题）They needed to stay in the hospital for a couple of months.
【定位】The doctor said the babies were in healthy condition, but could not go home immediately. They needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months for medical supervision.
医生说宝宝们身体状况良好，但不能马上回家。他们需要在医院留观两到三个月以接受医疗监护。
【信号】the doctor said 直接领出答案句。录音里出现的 The doctor said 完美对应题干中的 the doctor say，紧接着的 but 转折引出真正落点：could not go home immediately. They needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months——but 之后才是答案。
【替换】needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months ↔ They needed to stay in the hospital for a couple of months.
two to three months ↔ a couple of months

【排除】A)
偷换概念
They had to undergo 2-3 physical checkups. 把录音里听到的 two to three 借走，却安在 physical checkups（体检次数）上——可录音里 two to three 修饰的是 months（月数）。这是把同一数字偷换修饰对象的典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：two to three months for medical supervision
B)
They were all of normal size except the sixth. 说"除第六个外都是正常大小"，但录音里医生只说 the babies were in healthy condition（健康），并未提任何"大小是否正常"，更没说第六个例外。这是"加细节诱选"。
C)
原词陷阱
They could go home together with their mother a day later. 把"一天后回家"安在宝宝身上，但录音 The mother who is in stable condition could return home a day later 明确指出 a day later 是妈妈的安排；而宝宝那边是 could not go home immediately。选项盗用了 a day later 这个原词，把妈妈的待遇张冠到宝宝头上。
借用原文：The mother who is in stable condition could return home a day later
1 A Spanish island called Palmador has been bought by a family from Europe for 18 million euros. The island is often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers.
一座名为Palmador的西班牙岛屿已被一个欧洲家族以1800万欧元购得。这座岛屿常被度假者形容为人间天堂。
2 For decades tourists have been flocking to Palmador, which is located off the southeast coast of Spain. They come to enjoy its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters. Its natural beauty is protected as it lies inside a natural park.
数十年来，游客纷纷涌向位于西班牙东南海岸外的Palmador岛。他们来此享受未受破坏的海滩和清澈见底的海水。由于该岛位于自然公园内,其自然美景受到保护。
3 Although Palmador is one of the most famous private islands in the world, its seafront is public land and is a favorite destination for famous people. When the island was put up for sale, it was offered to the local government but proved too expensive for the local authorities. It is unclear whether the new owners have the power to ban tourists from the island. But with their newfound luxury comes the responsibility for its protection and maintenance. The island is less than two miles long and half a mile wide. It is said to have a remarkable location that few other private islands of this size can match, according to estate agents. Palmador is the perfect place to retreat to, somewhere to get away from the city noise and relax in beautiful surroundings with zero stress.
尽管Palmador是世界上最著名的私人岛屿之一,但其海滨属于公共土地,是名人最喜爱的目的地。当该岛挂牌出售时,曾提供给当地政府,但对当地政府来说价格过于昂贵。目前尚不清楚新业主是否有权禁止游客登岛。但随着新获得的奢华享受,他们也肩负着保护和维护该岛的责任。该岛长度不到两英里,宽度半英里。据房地产经纪人称,该岛拥有卓越的地理位置,少有其他同等规模的私人岛屿能与之媲美。Palmador是完美的隐居之地,可以远离城市喧嚣,在美丽的环境中放松身心,毫无压力。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页

stem: What do we learn from the news report about the Spanish island Palmador?

options.text: It is owned by the local government.
It has been turned into a public park.
It has been bought by an American.
It is a perfect tourist destination.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the news report about the Spanish island Palmador?
【翻译】从新闻报道中我们了解到关于西班牙岛屿Palmador的什么信息?
A) 它归当地政府所有。
B) 它已被改建成公共公园。
C) 它已被一位美国人购买。
D) 它是一个完美的旅游目的地。
【答案】D （细节题）It is a perfect tourist destination.
【定位】A Spanish island called Palmador has been bought by a family from Europe for 18 million euros. The island is often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers.
一个名叫帕尔马多尔的西班牙岛屿已被一个来自欧洲的家庭以 1800 万欧元买下。这个岛常被度假者形容为「人间天堂」。
【信号】新闻导语+总括赞美句。答案信号有两层：一是开头第一句作为新闻导语，交代核心事实「a family from Europe（欧洲家庭）买下了岛」；二是紧接的总括赞美 often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers——heaven on earth 这种总括式形容词，正是与选项 a perfect tourist destination 对应的同义信号。
【替换】often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers ↔a perfect tourist destination
总括赞美·同义改写
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项说岛 owned by the local government，但原文 has been bought by a family from Europe 与第三段 it was offered to the local government but proved too expensive for the local authorities 明确说「曾打算卖给地方政府，但地方政府嫌太贵买不起」——所以买家是欧洲家庭，不是政府，A 反了。
借用原文：it was offered to the local government but proved too expensive for the local authorities
B)
偷换概念
原文只说「它位于一个 natural park 里面」（its natural beauty is protected as it lies inside a natural park），是说岛位于自然公园之内、受保护；并没有说岛本身「被变成了公共公园」。选项 turned into a public park 偷换了「位于公园内」和「自身变成公园」。
借用原文：its natural beauty is protected as it lies inside a natural park
C)
原词陷阱
原文 has been bought by a family from Europe 明确说买家来自欧洲（Europe），选项bought by an American 把国籍换成了美国人——动作（bought）原音照搬，国籍偷换，是典型的「原词陷阱+张冠李戴」组合。
借用原文：has been bought by a family from Europe

stem: What do holidaymakers come to Palmador to enjoy?

options.text: Its seafood.
Its unusual coastline.
Its unspoiled beaches.
Its architecture.

explanation:
【题目】What do holidaymakers come to Palmador to enjoy?
【翻译】度假者来Palmador享受什么?
A) 它的海鲜。
B) 它不同寻常的海岸线。
C) 它未受破坏的海滩。
D) 它的建筑。
【答案】C （细节题）Its unspoiled beaches.
【定位】For decades tourists have been flocking to Palmador, which is located off the southeast coast of Spain. They come to enjoy its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters.
几十年来，游客们一直涌向帕尔马多尔，它位于西班牙东南海岸外。他们来这里是为了享受未受破坏的海滩和清澈见底的海水。
【信号】原音 come to enjoy 直接点题。答案信号是原音里 They come to enjoy its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters 出现的 come to enjoy——它与题干 come to…enjoy完全同构，紧跟其后的两个名词短语就是答案的两个候选。
【替换】its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters ↔Its unspoiled beaches
原词原音直接复现
【排除】A)
未提及
全文未出现任何与 seafood 相关的词。这项是预读时就预警过的「海岛+seafood」刻板印象陷阱——主体考生容易凭「海岛大概有好吃的海鲜」这种常识脑补出答案，但原文没说就是没说。
B)
原词陷阱
原文提及 coast（located off the southeast coast of Spain）只是说岛「位于西班牙东南海岸外」，是定位用语，不是描述岛本身的海岸线独特。选项 Its unusual coastline 借了coast 这个原词，并加了一个原文没有的形容词 unusual。
借用原文：located off the southeast coast of Spain
D)
未提及
原文通篇没有提到岛上有什么建筑（无任何 building / architecture / house 的描述），与选项 Its architecture 完全无对应原文。

stem: What do estate agents say about Palmador?

options.text: It has an unmatched location.
It is worth over 18 million euros.
It has beautiful weather all year round.
It is an ideal place to meet famous stars.

explanation:
【题目】What do estate agents say about Palmador?

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【翻译】房地产经纪人对Palmador有何评价?
A) 它拥有无与伦比的地理位置。
B) 它价值超过1800万欧元。
C) 它全年气候宜人。
D) 它是邂逅著名明星的理想场所。
【答案】A （细节题）It has an unmatched location.
【定位】It is said to have a remarkable location that few other private islands of this size can match, according to estate agents.
据房产中介称，这座岛拥有非凡的地理位置，少有同等大小的其他私人岛屿能与之匹敌。
【信号】引述标志 according to + 最高级语义。答案信号有两层：①引述定位词 according to estate agents 与题干 estate agents say 完全对应——这是这道题答案句的硬信号；②引述句内含最高级语义 few other private islands of this size can match（少有同等大小的私人岛能比得过），与选项 unmatched location 的最高级语义一一对应。
【替换】a remarkable location that few other private islands of this size can match ↔ It has an unmatched location
最高级语义·同义浓缩
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
18 million euros 确实出现在原音里（bought by a family from Europe for 18 million euros），但它是新闻导语里的成交价格，不是房产中介对这座岛的评价。预读时就把 18 million euros 标为数字陷阱预警——正是为这一题做准备。
借用原文：has been bought by a family from Europe for 18 million euros
C)
未提及
全文没有出现 weather / climate / sunshine 等任何与天气有关的描述。选项 beautiful weather all year round 是基于「度假胜地通常天气好」做的常识脑补，并不来自原音。
D)
偷换概念
原文 its seafront is public land and is a favorite destination for famous people 说海滨是「名人爱来的地方」，但这与选项 an ideal place to meet famous stars（一个见明星的理想场所）不同——前者讲名人来此度假，后者讲普通人来此能「遇见」明星。同时该句也不是 estate agents 说的，而是新闻自己的陈述，连发话人都对不上。
借用原文：its seafront is public land and is a favorite destination for famous people
