stem: What do we learn about the woman from the conversation?

options.text: She has been attending some group classes.
She has registered for two new gym classes.
She became a member of the gym two months ago.
She is entitled to a discount on all the gym exercises.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the woman from the conversation?
【翻译】从对话中我们了解到关于这位女士的什么信息?
A) 她一直在参加一些团体课程。
B) 她报名参加了两门新的健身房课程。
C) 她两个月前成为了健身房的会员。
D) 她有资格享受健身房所有运动项目的折扣。
【答案】C （细节题）She became a member of the gym two months ago.
【定位】Yes, I signed up two months ago, but I haven't been to any of the group classes yet.
是的，我两个月前就注册了，不过我还一节团体课都没上过。
【信号】被问者应答 = 答案落点。前一句 Are you already a member? 是询问者抛出的问题，被问的女士紧接着用 Yes, I signed up two months ago 给出直接应答——对话题里，问句之后被问者的应答几乎就是答案句。
【替换】I signed up two months ago ↔She became a member of the gym two months ago
signed up = became a member

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 She has been attending some group classes. 借用了录音 any of the group classes 这一原词，但女士说的是 I haven't been to any of the group classes yet(还没上过)——典型听到原词就想选的原词陷阱，方向恰好相反。
借用原文：I haven't been to any of the group classes yet
B)
偷换概念
选项 She has registered for two new gym classes. 把录音里 two of our brand new classes 拼到女士头上，但全文女士只在最后报名了一门 hot yoga，根本没有「报了两门」，且打电话之初仍只是咨询阶段——属偷换「咨询/报名」的概念。
借用原文：two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning
D)
选项 She is entitled to a discount on all the gym exercises. 里的 all 是范围词陷阱：原文明确 the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes，折扣只限两门新课、不及于所有项目——把「局部」扩成「全部」。
借用原文：the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes

stem: What is the gym center doing right now?

options.text: Considering the promotion of its regular classes.
Taking measures to expand its exercise programs.
Recruiting coaches for hot yoga and advanced spinning.
Offering existing members a discount off two new classes.

explanation:
【题目】What is the gym center doing right now?
【翻译】健身中心现在正在做什么?
A) 考虑推广其常规课程。
B) 采取措施扩展其运动项目。
C) 招聘高温瑜伽和高级动感单车的教练。
D) 为现有会员提供两门新课程的折扣。
【答案】D （细节题）Offering existing members a discount off two new classes.
【定位】Currently we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning, but the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes I'm afraid.
目前我们正给老会员提供两门全新课程的折扣——热瑜伽和高级动感单车，但是这个折扣不适用于任何常规课程，很抱歉。
【信号】时间副词 Currently 直接领出现行举措。Currently we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes 用 Currently+we are offering 把「当前正在做什么」摆得明明白白，正是题干 right now 的同义信号。
【替换】we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes ↔ Offering existing members a discount off two new classes.
几乎逐字对应的同义改写

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 Considering the promotion of its regular classes. 借用了录音里 regular classes 的原词，但原文是 the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes——常规课程恰恰是「不打折」的对象，健身房并未推广常规课程。
借用原文：the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes
B)
过度推断
选项 Taking measures to expand its exercise programs. 里的「扩展锻炼项目」在录音里没有任何句子支撑——录音只说推出了两门新课的折扣，并未提「扩张/扩展」。属于把「推新课折扣」过度推断为「扩张项目」。
C)
原词陷阱
选项 Recruiting coaches for hot yoga and advanced spinning. 把录音 hot yoga, and advanced spinning 这两个原词照搬过来，但行为是「招教练」——录音里从未提到招聘，是听到课程名就想选的典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning

stem: What does the man say is a pity for the woman?

options.text: She missed the deadline for the 10-week course.
She missed out on the gym's general discount.
She didn't sign up for membership in time.
She wasn't so much interested in hot yoga.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say is a pity for the woman?
【翻译】男士说对这位女士来说什么是遗憾的?
A) 她错过了10周课程的报名截止日期。
B) 她错过了健身房的普遍折扣。
C) 她没有及时注册会员资格。
D) 她对高温瑜伽不太感兴趣。
【答案】B （细节题）She missed out on the gym's general discount.
【定位】The same discount of 20% is being offered to everyone at the door on a "first come, first served" basis for the first month. It's a shame you missed out on the general discount.
首月对所有人在现场都按「先到先得」提供同样的 20% 折扣。可惜你错过了这个普通折扣。
【信号】惋惜句标志 It's a shame…。It's a shame you missed out on the general discount 用It's a shame 把男方的「惋惜」明明白白说出口，正与题干 a pity 一一对应；shame 之后跟的就是「错过了什么」。
【替换】you missed out on the general discount ↔She missed out on the gym's general discount.
几乎原词复现的同义改写

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 She missed the deadline for the 10-week course. 借用录音里 the 10-week course on Thursday evenings 的原词，但 10-week course 是女士最后真正报上的课、不存在「错过截止日」；男方的惋惜对象是 general discount，不是 10-week course。
借用原文：Can you sign me up for the 10-week course on Thursday evenings?
C)
与原文相反
选项 She didn't sign up for membership in time. 与录音 I signed up two months ago直接冲突：女士两个月前已经入会，根本不存在「没及时入会」的问题。
借用原文：I signed up two months ago
D)
与原文相反
选项 She wasn't so much interested in hot yoga. 与录音 I am only really interested in hot yoga 完全相反——女士只对热瑜伽感兴趣，而非「不感兴趣」。属盗用 hot yoga 原词的反向陷阱。
借用原文：I am only really interested in hot yoga

stem: Why is the woman unwilling to pay in advance?

options.text: She doesn't want to reveal her card details over the phone.
She doesn't think it wise to pay before attending any class.
She might have to cancel her registration any minute.
She prefers to have the fee added to her monthly bill.

explanation:
【题目】Why is the woman unwilling to pay in advance?
【翻译】为什么这位女士不愿意提前付款?
A) 她不想通过电话透露她的银行卡信息。
B) 她认为在参加任何课程之前付款是不明智的。
C) 她可能随时不得不取消她的注册。
D) 她更愿意将费用加到她的月账单上。
【答案】A （细节题）She doesn't want to reveal her card details over the phone.
【定位】No, I don't like giving my card details over the phone anyway.
不用，反正我也不喜欢在电话里报我的卡号细节。
【信号】表态句 No+理由句 I don't like… 紧贴在一起。No 是女士对 Would you prefer to pay in advance? 的明确拒绝，紧跟其后的 I don't like giving my card details over the phone就是拒绝的原因——这种「先表态、后给因」的结构是对话原因题的标志答案句。
【替换】I don't like giving my card details over the phone ↔ She doesn't want to reveal her card details over the phone.
don't like giving = doesn't want to reveal

【排除】B)
未提及
选项 She doesn't think it wise to pay before attending any class. 听起来合理，但录音里女士的原因仅围绕「电话里报卡号」，完全没有「上课前付不明智」这种判断——属凭常识替原文补理由。
C)
未提及
选项 She might have to cancel her registration any minute. 中「随时可能退课」在录音里没有任何句子支持——女士反而紧接着报了 10-week course，并未表现出要退的迹象。
D)
原词陷阱
选项 She prefers to have the fee added to her monthly bill. 借用 the fee of the class will just be added to your monthly bill 的原词，但 monthly bill 是男方在女士拒绝预付之后才提出的替代方案，并不是女士拒绝预付的原因——属把「结果」当「原因」的原词陷阱。
借用原文：the fee of the class will just be added to your monthly bill

stem: Why are the speakers in China?

options.text: To make investments.
To sign a business contract.
To research new markets.
To open a new office.

explanation:
【题目】Why are the speakers in China?
【翻译】说话者为什么在中国?
A) 进行投资。
B) 签署商业合同。
C) 研究新市场。
D) 开设新办公室。
【答案】C （细节题）To research new markets.
【定位】There are lots of great potential markets here in China. So I'm sure that the head office in London will be pleased once we get back and present our research.
这里中国市场潜力很大。我相信我们回去把调研结果汇报给伦敦总部，他们一定会满意的。
【信号】research 一词定位。答案落点不靠『目的信号词 to do』，而是靠对此行成果的总结句present our research。当对话里一方在概括『我们这趟做了什么/带回什么』，那句往往就是目的题的答案句——做的事就是来此的目的。
【替换】present our research ↔To research new markets.
名词化转动作
potential markets here in China ↔To research new markets.
潜在=新

【排除】A)
录音从头到尾没有 invest/investment/money 之类的词，To make investments. 属于『未提及』型干扰，靠的是听众对『商务出差=投资』的常识联想。
B)
未提及
录音没出现 contract/sign/deal 等词，To sign a business contract. 是『未提及』型干扰，与 A 同属『商务=签合同』的常识误判。
D)
原词陷阱
录音多次出现 the head office in London，To open a new office. 盗用了 office 这个原词，让人听到 office 就想选；但录音里 office 始终指『已经存在的伦敦总部』，没有任何『开设新办公室』的动作。
借用原文：the head office in London

source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Where will the man stop over on his way to London?

options.text: Dubai.
Beijing.
Amsterdam.
Earl's Court.

explanation:
【题目】Where will the man stop over on his way to London?
【翻译】男士在去伦敦的途中将在哪里中转?

B) 北京。

【答案】A （细节题）Dubai.
【定位】There's a flight arriving the following morning, with a two-hour stopover in Dubai, or a flight arriving at 11:30 in the evening, with a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam.
有一班次日早晨到达、在迪拜中转两小时的航班；还有一班晚上 11:30 到达、在阿姆斯特丹中转五小时的航班。
【信号】两项并列与男方应答。答案不在女方那句『二选一』里，而在男方第 5 段的应答 Well, that's obvious then, isn't it? 之后、女方第 6 段的确认 okay, so that's Dubai. ——这是对话题的标志性信号：被问者/被选方的应答才是落点。
【替换】so that's Dubai ↔Dubai.
确认句直给

【排除】B)
flights from Beijing to London 里 Beijing 是出发城市，不是中转地。Beijing. 盗用了这个原词，制造『一听到 Beijing 就选』的陷阱。
借用原文：flights from Beijing to London
C)
a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam 中 Amsterdam 确实是中转，但属于男方放弃的『晚到+长候机』那条线——男方那句 Well, that's obvious then, isn't it? 暗示选 short stopover（两小时的 Dubai）。Amsterdam. 盗用 Amsterdam 原词，但选错了那条线。
借用原文：a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam
D)
The nearest metro station is Earl's Court. 中 Earl's Court 是伦敦酒店附近的地铁站，是男方到达伦敦后的活动地点，与『中转』毫无关系。Earl's Court. 盗用了一个完全异类的地名做干扰。
借用原文：The nearest metro station is Earl's Court.

stem: What does the man ask the woman to do?

options.text: Rent a bike for him to get around the town.
Reserve a meeting room in the head office.
Help him prepare his presentation.
Send him a map of the hotel area.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man ask the woman to do?
【翻译】男士请女士做什么?
A) 为他租一辆自行车以便在镇上出行。
B) 在总部预订一间会议室。
C) 帮他准备演示文稿。
D) 给他发送一份酒店区域地图。
【答案】D （细节题）Send him a map of the hotel area.
【定位】Can you find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online?
你能找一份显示酒店位置的地图，然后线上发给我吗？
【信号】Can you 请求信号。Can you find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online? 是男方说出口的请求句，Can you 是最经典的请求信号——本题答案就在这一句里。
【替换】find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online ↔ Send him a map of the hotel area.
详述变概括
send it to me online ↔Send him a map of the hotel area.
代词与人称转换

【排除】A)
I want to see if I can get one of those rental bicycles and ride to the office just for fun. 这是男方自己想做的事，主语是 I，不是请求女方。Rent a bike for him to get around the town. 盗用了 rental bicycles 这个原词，制造『听到 bike 就选』的陷阱。
借用原文：I want to see if I can get one of those rental bicycles and ride to the office just for fun.
B)
Do you remember the capacity of their meeting room? 男方只是问女方『记不记得容量』，I'll check. 是女方主动表示要去查，没人请她去『预订（reserve）会议室』。Reserve a meeting room in the head office. 盗用 meeting room 原词、把 capacity 偷换成 reserve。
借用原文：Do you remember the capacity of their meeting room?
C)
For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector. presentation 由男方自己准备（I'll bring…），没有请求女方帮忙。Help him prepare his presentation. 盗用 presentation 原词，制造『听到就选』。
借用原文：For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.

stem: What did the woman remind the man to do at the end of the conversation?

options.text: Bring his projector.
Keep all his receipts.
Submit his claims form.
Pay with his credit card.

explanation:
【题目】What did the woman remind the man to do at the end of the conversation?
【翻译】对话结束时女士提醒男士做什么?
A) 带上他的投影仪。
B) 保留他所有的收据。
C) 提交他的报销单。
D) 用他的信用卡支付。
【答案】B （细节题）Keep all his receipts.
【定位】No problem. Just remember to keep all your receipts. You remember the trouble you had last time.
没问题。记得把所有发票留好。你记得上次遇到的麻烦吧。
【信号】Just remember to 提醒信号。答案信号是 Just remember to keep all your receipts.中的 Just remember to——这是英语里最典型的『提醒』句式，直接对应题干 remind…to do。
【替换】Just remember to keep all your receipts. ↔Keep all his receipts.
祈使变陈述

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
hook it up to their projector 中 projector 指对方公司已有的，男方说 I'll hook it up ——根本没有『自带投影仪』的意思，更不是女方的提醒。Bring his projector. 是张冠李戴 + 与原文相反双重错。
借用原文：hook it up to their projector
C)
I'll submit my claims form afterwards. 是男方自己说『事后我会提交报销单』，主语是I，不是女方提醒。Submit his claims form. 盗用 claims form 这个原词制造陷阱，让人听到 submit/claims 就选。
借用原文：I'll submit my claims form afterwards.
D)
I'll pay everything with my own card, right? 是男方自己交代会用自己的卡付款，并非女方提醒。Pay with his credit card. 盗用 card 原词。
借用原文：I'll pay everything with my own card, right?

stem: What did the researchers of the new study try to determine?

options.text: Whether a country's educational level is linked to women's rights.
Whether women's rights are making good progress around the world.
Whether a country's protection of women's rights is related to its public health.
Whether women's rights are more often overlooked in less-developed countries.

explanation:
【题目】What did the researchers of the new study try to determine?
【翻译】这项新研究的研究人员试图确定什么?
A) 一个国家的教育水平是否与妇女权利相关联。
B) 妇女权利在世界范围内是否正在取得良好进展。
C) 一个国家对妇女权利的保护是否与其公共卫生相关。
D) 妇女权利在欠发达国家是否更常被忽视。
【答案】C （细节题）Whether a country's protection of women's rights is related to its public health.
【定位】Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health.
因此，他们想要确定女性权利的保护与公共健康之间是否存在某种联系。
【信号】因果信号 Thus 引出研究目的句。Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health. 由 Thus 引出，是前文铺垫之后的结论性目的句；同时 wanted to determine 与题干 try to determine 是同义改写，双重信号锁定本句为答案句。

【替换】if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health ↔ Whether a country's protection of women's rights is related to its public health.
if↔Whether、a link↔is related to 的同义替换
【排除】A)
未提及
选项 Whether a country's educational level is linked to women's rights. 用了一个录音根本没提的 educational level；录音只谈 protection of women's rights and public health，根本没有把教育水平作为研究对象，属于未提及式干扰。
B)
原词陷阱
选项 Whether women's rights are making good progress around the world. 借用了录音 many parts of the world have made good economic progress 里的 good progress与 the world 两个原词，但录音说的是经济进展不错而女性权利常被忽视，并不是在问女性权利本身有没有进展；属于盗用原词答非所问。
借用原文：many parts of the world have made good economic progress, but women's rights are often overlooked
D)
原词陷阱
选项 Whether women's rights are more often overlooked in less-developed countries. 盗用录音原词 often overlooked，但录音只说 women's rights are often overlooked，并没有把这种忽视限定到 less-developed countries；选项擅自加了一个原文没有的范围限定。
借用原文：women's rights are often overlooked
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say about countries lacking in medical resources?

options.text: Their people still have better health if women's rights are respected.
They must make efforts to increase women's access to health care.
Their people tend to attach importance to women's rights.
They need to invest more in hospital staff and facilities.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about countries lacking in medical resources?
【翻译】关于缺乏医疗资源的国家,文章说了什么?
A) 如果妇女权利得到尊重,这些国家的人民仍然拥有更好的健康状况。
B) 它们必须努力增加妇女获得医疗保健的机会。
C) 这些国家的人民倾向于重视妇女权利。
D) 它们需要在医院人员和设施方面投入更多资金。
【答案】A （细节题）Their people still have better health if women's rights are respected.
【定位】Furthermore, in countries where women's rights were most respected, but where access to hospitals and doctors was below average, health outcomes were still better than in countries rated as moderate or poor.
此外，在那些最尊重女性权利但医院与医生资源低于平均水平的国家里，健康结果仍然要好于那些评级为中等或较差的国家。

【信号】转折信号 but+still 锁定反差结论。in countries where women's rights were most respected, but where access to hospitals and doctors was below average, health outcomes were still better 中的 but 与 still 是双重转折/让步信号，听到 but…still 几乎就等于答案句敲钟，篇章里这种条件下仍如何的句子是出题点的常态。
【替换】access to hospitals and doctors was below average ↔ Their people still have better health if women's rights are respected.
缺医疗资源↔lacking medical resources 同义概括
health outcomes were still better ↔still have better health
health outcomes↔health、still better↔still better 的近乎逐词等值
in countries where women's rights were most respected ↔if women's rights are respected
where 从句条件化↔if 条件句的等值改写
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
选项 They must make efforts to increase women's access to health care. 借用录音里access to hospitals and doctors 的 access 一词，但录音是在客观描述这些国家医疗资源不足下仍有好的健康结果，根本没有说他们必须做什么；选项把客观陈述偷换成主观对策，又强加了 women's access to health care 这种原文没有的提法。
借用原文：access to hospitals and doctors was below average
C)
张冠李戴
选项 Their people tend to attach importance to women's rights. 把录音里关于这些国家本身尊重女性权利的客观描述，偷换为这些国家的人民倾向于重视女性权利；录音说的是国家层面的尊重程度，并没有谈人民的态度倾向。
借用原文：in countries where women's rights were most respected
D)
原词陷阱
选项 They need to invest more in hospital staff and facilities. 借用了录音 hospitals and doctors 里的 hospitals，但录音从未说这些国家需要投入更多在医院上；选项把缺资源仍健康好这一反差客观结论，偷换成需要加大投入的对策。
借用原文：access to hospitals and doctors was below average
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What has often been questioned regarding women's rights?

options.text: Their link with a country's public health.
Their potential impact on social progress.
Their value to a country's international image.
Their positive effect on economic development.

explanation:
【题目】What has often been questioned regarding women's rights?
【翻译】关于妇女权利,什么经常受到质疑?
A) 妇女权利与一个国家公共卫生的关联。
B) 妇女权利对社会进步的潜在影响。
C) 妇女权利对一个国家国际形象的价值。
D) 妇女权利对经济发展的积极作用。
【答案】D （细节题）Their positive effect on economic development.

【定位】They note that the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint.
他们指出，女性权利的价值常常从经济角度受到质疑。
【信号】题干同根词 questioned 直接对应。the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint 几乎是题干 What has often been questioned regarding women's rights? 的逐词同根回响：questioned 对 questioned、women's rights 对 women's rights，定位极其稳。
【替换】the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint ↔ Their positive effect on economic development.
from an economic standpoint↔on economic development 的角度替换
ensuring those rights would limit progress, but this study indicates the opposite ↔ positive effect on economic development
否定的反面=正面效应的等值推理
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 Their link with a country's public health. 借用了录音前文 protection of women's rights and public health 的 public health 一词，但 18 题问的是被质疑的内容，而录音里女性权利与公共健康的关系是被研究证实的，并非被质疑的对象；属于盗用原词答非所问。
借用原文：protection of women's rights and public health
B)
偷换概念
选项 Their potential impact on social progress. 借用了录音 ensuring those rights would limit progress 里的 progress，但录音里的 progress 是与 economic 挂钩的，且选项加了一个 social 修饰；录音从未谈过对 social progress 的潜在影响，属于偷换概念。
借用原文：Some have argued that ensuring those rights would limit progress
C)
未提及
选项 Their value to a country's international image. 谈的是对国家国际形象的价值，录音从头到尾都没谈过 international image 或与之相关的概念，属于未提及式干扰。

source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say about hot sunshine?

options.text: It creates a wonderful setting for dating.
It may cause strange physical reactions.
It turns parks into picnic sites.
It may result in a crowded beach.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about hot sunshine?
【翻译】文章关于炎热的阳光说了什么？
A) 它为约会创造了美妙的环境。
B) 它可能引起奇怪的身体反应。
C) 它把公园变成了野餐场所。
D) 它可能导致海滩拥挤。
【答案】B （细节题）It may cause strange physical reactions.
【定位】Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics and parks and trips to beaches, but they can make your body react in some strange ways.
阳光和高温可能意味着野餐、公园和海滩之旅，但它们可能让你的身体以一些奇怪的方式作出反应。
【信号】but 转折后才是真意。答案信号在 but they can make your body react in some strange ways 的 but——前半 Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics and parks and trips to beaches 列举的野餐、公园、海滩都是 A/C/D 选项的来源（陷阱区），but之后才是文章真正要讲的主题：让身体出现奇怪反应。
【替换】make your body react in some strange ways ↔cause strange physical reactions
同义改写：make…react ≈ cause…reactions

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 It creates a wonderful setting for dating. 借后文第二段提到 You may think that summer is the perfect time to go on a date 里的 "date" 制造"听到约会就想选"的诱惑，但录音说的是"你以为夏天适合约会"，是一个被推翻的设定，不是"阳光创造了约会良机"这一主张。
借用原文：You may think that summer is the perfect time to go on a date or chat with an attractive boy or girl.
C)
原词陷阱
选项 It turns parks into picnic sites. 盗用了第一段铺垫中的 picnics and parks，但picnics 和 parks 在录音里只是 but 前的场景列举，根本没说"阳光把公园变成野餐地"——纯粹靠原词诱导的干扰。
借用原文：Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics and parks and trips to beaches
D)
未提及
选项 It may result in a crowded beach. 盗用了 trips to beaches 里的 beaches 制造熟悉感，但录音里只有"去海滩"这件事，从未说 crowded（拥挤的）——"拥挤的海滩"是额外想象出来的细节。
借用原文：trips to beaches
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第26页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say is a negative side effect of water loss?

options.text: Breathing difficulty.
Bad breath.
Excessive sweating.
High blood pressure.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say is a negative side effect of water loss?
【翻译】文章说水分流失的负面副作用是什么？
A) 呼吸困难。
B) 口臭。
C) 过度出汗。
D) 高血压。
【答案】B （细节题）Bad breath.
【定位】But excessive heat can cause you to lose water, which has been proven to have a pretty unattractive side effect—bad breath.
但是过度的高温会让你失去水分，而水分流失已被证明有一个相当不雅观的副作用——口臭。
【信号】破折号后的解释就是答案。答案信号是 a pretty unattractive side effect—bad breath 这个破折号结构：unattractive side effect 与题干 negative side effect 直接对应，破折号后面的 bad breath 就是这个 side effect 的具体所指。
【替换】a pretty unattractive side effect ↔a negative side effect of water loss
unattractive 与 negative 同义
bad breath ↔Bad breath
答案点原词复现

【排除】A)
选项 Breathing difficulty. 利用 breathing 与录音 bad breath 中 breath 的近形——只差一字，听感几乎相同，最容易让靠耳朵抓"差不多的词"的考生上当。但 breath 是"口气"，breathing 是"呼吸"，录音从未提到呼吸困难。
借用原文：bad breath
C)
选项 Excessive sweating. 利用了第三段 Sunshine can stop you from sweating, too. 里的 sweating 一词，但录音说的是 stop you from sweating（让你停止出汗），与excessive sweating（过度出汗）方向恰好相反。
借用原文：Sunshine can stop you from sweating, too.
D)
未提及
选项 High blood pressure. 听起来像是常见的高温副作用，但录音里讲水分流失的副作用时只提到 bad breath，从未出现 high blood pressure 或 blood pressure 之类的词——纯属凭常识脑补出来的干扰。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第27页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is said to be a positive effect of sunshine?

options.text: It protects people against bacteria.
It enables people to build up endurance.
It accelerates people's blood circulation.
It provides people with extra energy.

explanation:
【题目】What is said to be a positive effect of sunshine?
【翻译】阳光的积极作用是什么？
A) 它保护人们免受细菌侵害。
B) 它使人们能够增强耐力。
C) 它加速人们的血液循环。
D) 它为人们提供额外的能量。
【答案】D （细节题）It provides people with extra energy.
【定位】However, the sun can have a positive influence on your body by raising your energy levels. You might feel like the sun is giving you extra energy for your day, which is actually happening.
然而，阳光可以通过提高你的能量水平对身体产生积极的影响。你可能感觉阳光在为你这一天提供额外的能量，而这其实是真的在发生。
【信号】However 转折+ positive influence 极性词。答案信号是双重的：However 把话题从前文负面反应扳向正面作用；紧接着 positive influence 与题干 positive effect 直接对应；再后面给出具体方式 raising your energy levels 和加倍说明 giving you extra energy——三处叠加锁死答案句。
【替换】raising your energy levels ↔provides people with extra energy
raise levels ≈ provide extra
the sun is giving you extra energy ↔provides people with extra energy
give 与 provide 同义、extra energy 原词复现

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 It protects people against bacteria. 借用第三段 Bacteria accumulate because there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away 里的 bacteria 制造熟悉感，但录音说的是"细菌会累积"，根本没说阳光保护人免受细菌侵害——把细菌的角色彻底搞反了。
借用原文：Bacteria accumulate because there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away
B)
未提及
选项 It enables people to build up endurance. 中的 endurance（耐力）在录音里完全没有对应表述——既没说运动耐力，也没说体力持久；纯粹是凭"阳光对身体好"这种泛印象塞进来的诱选项。
C)
选项 It accelerates people's blood circulation. 的 blood circulation（血液循环）听起来非常"科学"，但录音里从未出现 blood、circulation 或任何对应表达；这是利用考生"阳光促进血液循环"的常识印象设计的陷阱。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第28页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say about left-handed people?

options.text: They are more likely to win in combat sports.
They are in the minority among the population.
They have a higher chance of joining sports teams.
They have more disadvantages in getting ahead.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about left-handed people?
【翻译】文章关于左撇子说了什么?
A) 他们更有可能在格斗运动中获胜。
B) 他们在人口中占少数。
C) 他们有更高的机会加入运动队。
D) 他们在取得成功方面有更多劣势。
【答案】A （细节题）They are more likely to win in combat sports.
【定位】Research found that they were overrepresented among fighters in combat sports. Left-handed fighters also had higher chances to win.
研究发现，他们（左撇子）在搏击运动的拳手中占比偏高。左撇子拳手获胜的概率也更高。
【信号】Research found 是研究结论信号。Research found that 是非常典型的"研究结论"信号，听力篇章一旦出现 Research found / Studies show / Scientists discovered，紧跟的那句几乎一定是出题点；这里跟着两句具体结论，正好对应一个选项。
【替换】Left-handed fighters also had higher chances to win ↔ They are more likely to win in combat sports.
had higher chances to win = more likely to win

【排除】B)
未提及
B 项 They are in the minority among the population. 借了讲者 they were overrepresented among fighters in combat sports 里 overrepresented 涉及"人群占比"的话题，但讲者说的是"在搏击拳手中占比偏高（overrepresented）"，根本没说他们在总人口中是"少数（in the minority）"。一个是"在某个子群里偏多"，一个是"在总人口里偏少"，方向完全不一样。
C)
原词陷阱
C 项 They have a higher chance of joining sports teams. 用 higher chance 这个原文里出现的搭配勾人，但 Left-handed fighters also had higher chances to win 说的是"赢的概率更高"，不是"加入运动队的概率更高"。原词 higher chances 被留下，宾语却从 win被偷换成了 joining sports teams。
D)
与原文相反

stem: What is said to be special about left-handed people?

options.text: Their brain is more powerful than that of right-handed people.
The left side of their brain is more powerful than its right side.
They tend to be a lot more aggressive than right-handed people.
Their brain has a stronger connection between its two sides.

explanation:
【题目】What is said to be special about left-handed people?
【翻译】据说左撇子有什么特别之处?
A) 他们的大脑比右撇子的大脑更强大。
B) 他们大脑的左侧比右侧更强大。
C) 他们往往比右撇子更具攻击性。
D) 他们大脑两侧之间的连接更强。
【答案】D （细节题）Their brain has a stronger connection between its two sides.
【定位】Left-handers may also be better at remembering events. The explanation is that the two brain spheres of left-handers are more strongly connected.
左撇子在记忆事件方面可能也更出色。原因是左撇子的两个脑半球之间联系更紧密。
【信号】The explanation is 是因果信号。The explanation is that 直接告诉考生"接下来这句是解释/原因"，是答案句典型路标；并且这句正好给出大脑结构特征 the two brain spheres of left-handers are more strongly connected，与选项群里 brain 相关那一项直接对位。
【替换】the two brain spheres of left-handers are more strongly connected ↔ Their brain has a stronger connection between its two sides.
brain spheres = two sides; strongly connected = stronger connection

【排除】A)
过度推断
A 项 Their brain is more powerful than that of right-handed people. 借了原文 brain这个核心词，但讲者只说"两脑半球之间连接更强（more strongly connected）"，并没有说"整个大脑都比右撇子强"。从"连接性"被扩大到了"整体性能"。
B)
偷换概念
B 项 The left side of their brain is more powerful than its right side. 借了原文 brain 与spheres 这两个原词的话题，却把讲者"两个脑半球连接更强（two brain spheres … more strongly connected）"偷换成了"左半球比右半球更强"。一个讲"连接"，一个讲"哪一侧更强"，根本不在同一维度。
C)
未提及
C 项 They tend to be a lot more aggressive than right-handed people. 利用第 1 段fighters in combat sports 这种暗示攻击性的话题做联想，但讲者全篇没有任何"左撇子更具攻击性（aggressive）"的描述，更没有把它当作"特殊之处"提出。

stem: Why are left-handed people better at solving more difficult problems?

options.text: They have a larger brain.
It still remains unknown.
It is related to their genes.
They are better at reasoning.

explanation:
【题目】Why are left-handed people better at solving more difficult problems?
【翻译】为什么左撇子更擅长解决更困难的问题?
A) 他们有更大的大脑。
B) 这仍然未知。
C) 这与他们的基因有关。
D) 他们更擅长推理。
【答案】B （细节题）It still remains unknown.
【定位】An Italian study found that for simple arithmetic there was little difference between right- and left-handed performance, but for more difficult problem-solving, left-handers won out. No one understands the reason for this.
一项意大利研究发现，在简单算术方面，左右撇子之间表现差别不大；但在更难的解题方面，左撇子胜出。然而没人弄清楚其中的原因。
【信号】No one understands the reason 是"未知"信号。No one understands the reason for this 是非常明确的"原因尚不清楚"型信号句，与选项 It still remains unknown. 的语义直接对应，是听力里最容易被忽视但出题率极高的句式之一。
【替换】No one understands the reason for this ↔It still remains unknown.
No one understands = remains unknown

【排除】A)
未提及
A 项 They have a larger brain. 想借第 2 段 brain 这个原词诱选，但讲者全篇没有任何"左撇子大脑更大"的描述。
C)
未提及
C 项 It is related to their genes. 在常识上很像"科学解释"，但讲者在第 3 段明明说 No one understands the reason for this，根本没有把原因归到基因。
D)
答非所问
D 项 They are better at reasoning. 借了第 3 段讲到的"在更难的解题里胜出（for more difficult problem-solving, left-handers won out）"的话题，但 problem-solving（解题）≠ reasoning（推理）；而且讲者从未把 reasoning 当作"为什么更擅长难题"的解释。

stem: What should parents do about a left-handed child?

options.text: Teach them how to perform tasks with their right hand.
Help them fully develop their mathematical abilities.
Encourage them to play fast-paced interactive sports.
Advise them to choose jobs that require quick reactions.

explanation:
【题目】What should parents do about a left-handed child?
【翻译】父母应该如何对待左撇子孩子?
A) 教他们如何用右手完成任务。
B) 帮助他们充分发展数学能力。
C) 鼓励他们参加快节奏的互动运动。
D) 建议他们选择需要快速反应的工作。
【答案】C （细节题）Encourage them to play fast-paced interactive sports.
【定位】So if you have a left-handed child, you should encourage them to play table tennis, baseball and tennis.
所以如果你的孩子是左撇子，就应该鼓励他们去打乒乓球、棒球和网球。
【信号】you should encourage 是直给建议信号。you should encourage them 几乎是听力里最干脆的建议信号——should + encourage 直接对位题干 should do，紧跟的动作就是答案句的内容。
【替换】encourage them to play table tennis, baseball and tennis ↔ Encourage them to play fast-paced interactive sports.
三项具体运动 = fast-paced interactive sports
you should encourage them ↔Encourage them
should encourage 与 encourage 动宾完全对位

【排除】A)
与原文相反
A 项 Teach them how to perform tasks with their right hand. 让父母教孩子"用右手做事"，与全文为左撇子鸣不平、最后还鼓励他们发展左撇子优势的基调相反——讲者从未要求父母把孩子扳成右撇子。
B)
原词陷阱
B 项 Help them fully develop their mathematical abilities. 借了第 3 段 Being left-handed might be a factor in mathematical ability 里 mathematical 这个原词，但讲者从未让父母"帮孩子开发数学能力"，那一段只是描述现象、没给建议。
D)
偷换概念
D 项 Advise them to choose jobs that require quick reactions. 借了原文 Those that require the fastest reaction 里 reaction 这个高识别度词做诱饵，但讲者说的是"需要最快反应的运动（sports）"，根本不是"需要快速反应的职业（jobs）"。修饰词 quick reactions 留下了，对象却被偷换。

stem: What characterizes Japanese and Chinese foods?

options.text: Variety.
Flavor.
Color.
Naturalness.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What characterizes Japanese and Chinese foods? 是 what 直接询问客观特征，没有 infer/suggest/imply 之类的推断信号，要的就是原文写明的事实。
【拆句】题干 What characterizes Japanese and Chinese foods? 是标准的 what 主语疑问句：what 作主语，characterizes 作谓语，Japanese and Chinese foods 是宾语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】He noted that Japanese people ate a wonderful variety of seaweeds, and that Chinese people tried to include at least five different colors in every meal.
他注意到日本人吃种类繁多的海藻，中国人则努力让每餐都包含至少五种不同的颜色。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
a wonderful variety of seaweeds ↔Variety
at least five different colors in every meal ↔Variety
预判核心是"多样性"，Variety 既能覆盖 variety of seaweeds，也能覆盖 five different colors，是把两条并列事实的最大公约数提炼出来的上位词，与预判一致。
B)
无中生有
定位句 He noted that Japanese people ate a wonderful variety of seaweeds, and that Chinese people tried to include at least five different colors in every meal. 通篇讲海藻种类和颜色，没有任何 flavor/taste 的描述；选项 Flavor 在原文里没有对应。
C)
以偏概全
选项 Color 只对应 at least five different colors in every meal 这一半，根本不能解释a wonderful variety of seaweeds——日本人吃海藻种类多与颜色无关；以局部冒充整体。
D)
无中生有
Naturalness 意为"天然性、未加工"，原文定位句没有 natural/unprocessed/raw 之类的词；海藻和颜色多样不等于"自然"。

【拆句】题干主干是 what is typical of Americans，in the way of eating 是修饰 typical 的范围介词短语；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】For starters, Americans eat much bigger portions than people in other countries.
首先，美国人吃的分量比其他国家的人要大得多。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文 We don't prioritize eating seasonally or locally, and we also add lots of salt, sugar and thickening agents to our foods 说的是美国人"不"重视当季当地、还要加大量盐糖增稠剂——明显是不健康、不重营养的做法，emphasize nutrition 与原文方向相反。
B)
✓ 正确

than people in other countries ↔tend to

C)
无中生有

无中生有

stem: What features are in Mediterranean, Nordic and Okinawan diets?

options.text: Fruits and vegetables.
Olive oil and red wine.
Seasonal local produce.
Unprocessed ingredients.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What features are in Mediterranean, Nordic and Okinawan diets? 直接询问几种饮食"具备什么特征"，答案应是原文明写的共同特征。
【拆句】题干 What features are in Mediterranean, Nordic and Okinawan diets?：what features 作主语、are 系动词、in Mediterranean, Nordic and Okinawan diets 是表语介词短语，把范围限定在这三种饮食里；结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】Contrast that to the healthy Mediterranean, Nordic and Okinawan diets listed in Pasternak's book. They all seem to stick to the ethos(特质) of regional, seasonal produce.
把这一点（指美国人的饮食习惯）与 Pasternak 书中列出的健康的地中海、北欧和冲绳饮食对比一下。它们似乎都坚守着"当地、当季食材"这一特质。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
fruits, vegetables 出现在 P4 段对地中海饮食的展开里；但题目问的是三种饮食的共有特征，Fruits and vegetables 只是地中海饮食的成分，不能说北欧和冲绳饮食也以这两样为主——选项错把局部例证当全局共性。
B)
以偏概全
olive oil 与 red wine 同样出现在 P4 段对地中海饮食的描写里，是地中海饮食的特色，但不是北欧和冲绳饮食的特征；选项把地中海饮食的标志当成三地共同点。
C)
✓ 正确
regional, seasonal produce ↔Seasonal local produce
预判核心"当地、当季、食材"三层在 Seasonal local produce 中一一对应，无遗漏；这是细节题正确项最干净的样子——预判几个要素，选项几乎逐词对接。
D)
无中生有
原文中谈到三地饮食的共同点只有 regional, seasonal produce（当地当季食材），并未出现 unprocessed/raw/whole 之类强调"未加工"的语义；Unprocessed ingredients 是凭健康饮食的常识印象生造的特征。

stem: What do people in most healthy eating cultures have in common?

options.text: They get the whole family to eat at a table.
They eat their meals regularly and punctually.
They consume plenty of cereal for breakfast.
They attach great importance to their meals.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do people in most healthy eating cultures have in common? 直问"共同之处"，不含推断信号词，只要找原文的归纳句即可。
【拆句】题干 What do people in most healthy eating cultures have in common?：what 作have 的宾语前置，主语是 people in most healthy eating cultures；have…in common是固定搭配"有共同点"，结构无陷阱。
【定位】Most other healthy eating cultures also make meals an event—say, multiple courses around the family table, or a glass or two of red wine at a long lunch—as opposed to hastily wolfing down handfuls of cereal above the kitchen sink and calling it dinner.
大多数其他健康饮食文化都把吃饭当作一件"大事"——例如全家围桌吃几道菜，或者午餐时悠悠喝上一两杯红酒——而不是匆匆抓把麦片站在水槽边解决一顿。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
get the whole family to eat at a table 只对应 multiple courses around the family table 这一个例子，没覆盖另一例 a glass or two of red wine at a long lunch，更没覆盖"重视用餐"这个主旨；以一个例子冒充整段共性。
B)
无中生有
原文 P5 只说 long lunch（漫长的午餐），完全没有 regularly/punctually/on time这类"规律/守时"的语义；选项 eat their meals regularly and punctually 在原文里无对应。
C)
与原文相反
原文中 handfuls of cereal above the kitchen sink 是用来作"反例"的——讽刺美国人草率吃法的——而选项 consume plenty of cereal for breakfast 反而把这条反例当成健康文化的优点，方向南辕北辙。
D)
✓ 正确
make meals an event ↔attach great importance to their meals
预判核心"重视用餐"与 attach great importance to their meals 字字对应；同时这一表达覆盖了原文后面三个例证（围桌、几道菜、长午餐），是所有例证背后的统一主旨。

stem: Compared with the average American, people in healthy societies ___________.

options.text: walk at least 4 miles a day
do considerably more walking
pay more attention to body shape
consume a lot more organic food

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 Compared with the average American, people in healthy societies ___________.是补全句、内容来自原文的事实性对比陈述，不要求做推断，按细节题走。
【拆句】题干 Compared with the average American, people in healthy societies ___________.是不完整陈述句：Compared with the average American 是过去分词短语作状语，逻辑主语是后面的 people in healthy societies；选项是句子谓语的延续，需保证主谓搭配自然。
【定位】The only overlapping feature in most of these healthy countries is that they all walk way more than the average American.
这些健康国家唯一的共同特征是：他们走路都远远多于普通美国人。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文 if someone's walking four miles more than you each day 中的 four miles 是Pasternak 的进一步举例性数字，且是"多走 4 英里"（每天比对方多 4 英里），不是"至少走 4 英里"；选项 walk at least 4 miles a day 把"多走的差值"偷换成"日行的总数"，并加了原文没有的 at least。
B)
✓ 正确
walk way more than the average American ↔do considerably more walking
预判核心"走路远多于美国人"被 do considerably more walking 完整保留——比较级more、程度副词 considerably（= 原文 way）、活动 walking，三层信息一一对应。
C)
偷换概念
原文 they're going to be a lot thinner 是"会瘦很多"——这是走路多带来的结果，不是健康社会的人"在意身材"这一主观倾向；选项 pay more attention to body shape是把客观结果错读成主观态度。
D)
无中生有
整篇文章谈份量、海藻、五色、当地当季食材、用餐重视度、走路——通篇没出现organic（有机的）这个词；选项 consume a lot more organic food 在原文中完全无对应。

stem: What is the finding of the new study?

options.text: Emotional intelligence helps people get along with others.
Emotional intelligence is generally beneficial to its bearer.
People who are aware of others' feelings may experience more stress.
People who are emotionally stressed may have trouble making friends.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What is the finding of the new study?直接问研究的发现，没有 infer/imply/suggest 等推断信号词，答案应能在原文中找到客观对应。
【拆句】Q51是一个简单 What is + 主语 + of 短语的疑问句，主干是the finding of the new study，of 引导的介宾短语限定 finding 的归属，无从句、无否定，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】But a new study suggests that being sensitive to people's feelings may sometimes come with an extra dose of stress.
但一项新研究指出，对他人情绪敏感，有时会带来额外的压力。
【选项】A)
答非所问
Emotional intelligence helps people get along with others.说的是「情商有助于与人相处」，这是Recognizing when a friend or colleague feels sad, angry or surprised is key to getting along with others.这句旧常识，而不是题干问的the new study的发现。
B)
与原文相反
Emotional intelligence is generally beneficial to its bearer.恰恰是新研究要challenge的主流观点，原文用This and other research challenge the prevailing view that emotional intelligence is uniformly beneficial to its bearer.明确反对它，把它当 finding 是把靶子当结论。
C)
✓ 正确
being sensitive to people's feelings ↔People who are aware of others' feelings
come with an extra dose of stress ↔may experience more stress
预判的「敏锐感知他人情绪的人会承受更多压力」与People who are aware of others' feelings may experience more stress.从主语到谓语完全对应，且程度词 sometimes与 may 等值，无超译。
D)
无中生有
People who are emotionally stressed may have trouble making friends.说的是「情绪压力大→交不到朋友」——原文谈的方向恰好相反：「敏锐感知情绪→压力更大」，且原文根本没提「交不到朋友」。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页

stem: What was the purpose of psychologist Myriam Bechtoldt's experiment?

options.text: To define different types of human feelings.
To assess the impacts of being emotionally clever.
To demonstrate how to distinguish different feelings.
To identify gender differences in emotional intelligence.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What was the purpose of psychologist Myriam Bechtoldt's experiment?问的是实验目的，是可在原文中找到客观依据的事实信息，不是推断或主旨。
【拆句】Q52主干是What was the purpose ... experiment?，of 后面跟一长串名词同位修饰psychologist Myriam Bechtoldt's experiment，结构是简单的 What + be + 主语，没有从句和否定，无陷阱。
【定位】In a study, psychologist Myriam Bechtoldt of the Frankfurt School of Finance and Management in Germany asked 166 male university students a series of questions to measure their emotional intelligence.
在一项研究中，德国法兰克福金融与管理学院的心理学家 Myriam Bechtoldt 向 166 名男大学生提了一系列问题，以测量他们的情商。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
To define different types of human feelings.意为「定义不同种类的人类情绪」，但原文they showed the students photographs of people's faces and asked them to what extent feelings such as happiness or disgust were being expressed.中「看脸辨情绪」是测量情商的手段细节，不是研究目的。
B)
✓ 正确
to measure their emotional intelligence ↔To assess the impacts of being emotionally clever
The findings suggest that some people may be too emotionally clever for their own good ↔ the impacts of being emotionally clever
定位句给出的是研究手段（测量情商加测压力激素），而P1与P3共同指明，这一手段服务于「评估情商高带来的影响」这一目的，与B完全对应。
C)
无中生有
To demonstrate how to distinguish different feelings.意为「演示如何区分不同情绪」，但实验是测量学生情商，不是教学生区分情绪；原文没有 demonstrate / teach类动词。
D)
无中生有
To identify gender differences in emotional intelligence.说研究目的是识别性别差异，但实验对象是166 male university students——全是男生，根本没设性别对照；末段还提到More research is needed to see how exactly the relation between emotional intelligence and stress would play out in women——女性差异是「待研究」，不是本研究的目的。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the finding of Myriam Bechtoldt's study indicate?

options.text: Greater emotional cleverness means less trouble in one's life.
Emotional intelligence helps people succeed in job interviews.
People's psychological wellbeing is related to various factors.
People may suffer from having a high emotional intelligence

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the finding of Myriam Bechtoldt's study indicate?问的是研究结果所「表明」的内容，原文有研究者亲口下的结论句作为依据，仍属细节题，不需要超出原文做推断。
【拆句】Q53结构是 What does + 主语 + indicate？主语the finding of Myriam Bechtoldt's study由 of 介宾限定，全句是简单宾语从句式提问，无否定无比较，无陷阱。
【定位】The findings suggest that some people may be too emotionally clever for their own good, says Bechtoldt.
研究者 Bechtoldt 说，研究结果表明，有些人的情商可能高过头反害了自己。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
Greater emotional cleverness means less trouble in one's life.说情商越高麻烦越少，与原文Sometimes you can be so good at something that it causes trouble完全相反。
B)
无中生有
Emotional intelligence helps people succeed in job interviews.说情商帮人在求职面试中成功——但原文里give job talks in front of judges只是实验任务场景（求职演讲），原文从未说情商高能让人面试成功；恰恰相反，情商高的人压力更大。
C)
答非所问
People's psychological wellbeing is related to various factors.「心理健康与多种因素有关」在常识上无可指摘，但原文研究只讲情商与压力的关系，没有讨论「多种因素」，是模糊化的万能选项。
D)
✓ 正确
some people may be too emotionally clever for their own good ↔ People may suffer from having a high emotional intelligence
Sometimes you can be so good at something that it causes trouble ↔ suffer from having a high emotional intelligence
预判「情商高反受其害」与People may suffer from having a high emotional intelligence在主语、谓语、宾语三层完全咬合，且都保留 may 的不确定语气，是定位句的标准同义改写。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about emotional intelligence from a number of studies?

options.text: People suffering from depression are emotionally immature.
People who look at the dark side of life often feel depressed.
Some people may take advantage of it and benefit themselves.
Some people may lack it and are easily manipulated by others.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about emotional intelligence from a number of studies?问的是「从多项研究我们得知什么」，对应原文综述段的事实罗列，不是推断或主旨。
【拆句】Q54主干是 What do we learn? 后接 about + 话题 + from + 来源两个介宾短语限定learn 的范围；about 限定话题、from 限定信息来源，两个限定都不能丢，结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】Furthermore, several studies have implied that emotional intelligence can be used to manipulate others for personal gains.
此外，多项研究还暗示，情商可被用来操纵他人以谋取私利。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
People suffering from depression are emotionally immature.说抑郁者情绪不成熟——但原文emotionally perceptive people might be particularly influenced by feelings of depression and hopelessness说的是「情绪敏锐者更易受抑郁影响」，主语和因果都被改了。
B)
偷换概念
People who look at the dark side of life often feel depressed.说「看人生消极面的人常抑郁」——这是日常常识，但原文谈的是「情绪敏锐者易受抑郁情绪影响」，主语错配、因果也错。
C)
✓ 正确
emotional intelligence can be used to manipulate others for personal gains ↔ Some people may take advantage of it and benefit themselves
预判的「情商可被用来操纵他人谋私」与Some people may take advantage of it and benefit themselves在主语、动词短语、目的三段完全对位，且 may 与 can 都是表「可能性」的弱情态，无超译。
D)
与原文相反
Some people may lack it and are easily manipulated by others.说「有些人缺乏情商，因此易被他人操纵」——但原文谈的是「情商高的人可以操纵别人」，而不是「缺情商的人被人操纵」，施事与受事正好反过来。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author suggest sensitive individuals do?

options.text: Avoid burdening themselves with others' feelings.
Rid themselves of worries over worldly affairs.
Learn to cope with people's negative feelings.
Help people to deal with their troubles in life.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author suggest sensitive individuals do?问作者给敏感者的具体建议，原文应有明示的建议句作为依据。
【拆句】Q55是 What does + 主语 + suggest + 宾语从句的疑问句；宾语从句省略 that，形式为sensitive individuals do——主语 sensitive individuals + 动词原形 do，是 suggest sb. (should) do 的虚拟语气省略式，do 表「做（什么）」，对应选项里的动词短语。
【定位】For example, some sensitive individuals may assume responsibility for other people's sadness or anger, which ultimately stresses them out. Remember, as Bechtoldt says, "you are not responsible for how other people feel."
举例来说，一些敏感的人可能会替别人的悲伤或愤怒揽责任，结果反而把自己压垮。记住Bechtoldt 的话：你不必为别人的感受负责。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
you are not responsible for how other people feel ↔ Avoid burdening themselves with others' feelings
some sensitive individuals may assume responsibility for other people's sadness or anger, which ultimately stresses them out ↔burdening themselves with others' feelings
预判的「别替别人的情绪扛锅」与Avoid burdening themselves with others' feelings在动词、宾语、隐含主语三层完全对位，且都保留「避免、不要」的建议口吻。
B)
无中生有
Rid themselves of worries over worldly affairs.说「摆脱对世俗琐事的忧虑」——但原文谈的是「别人的情绪」，不是「世俗琐事」；worldly affairs 在原文完全没有对应。
C)
偷换概念
Learn to cope with people's negative feelings.建议敏感者去「应对他人的负面情绪」——但原文you are not responsible for how other people feel给的建议恰恰相反：「不必为别人感受负责」，根本不主张主动去处理别人的情绪。要注意原文确实有learn to also properly cope with emotions—both others' and your own，但那是给所有人的总建议、且强调「包括自己的」；针对 sensitive individuals 的针对性建议是 not responsible 这一句。
D)
与原文相反
Help people to deal with their troubles in life.建议敏感者去「帮别人解决生活中的麻烦」——这与作者的建议方向完全相反，作者明示you are not responsible for how other people feel。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第7页

stem: What event will take place in Glasgow?

options.text: A free car show.
A yearly concert.
A sports competition.
A pipe band contest.

explanation:
【题目】What event will take place in Glasgow?
【翻译】什么活动将在格拉斯哥举行?
A) 一场免费车展。
B) 一场年度音乐会。
C) 一场体育比赛。
D) 一场风笛乐队比赛。
【答案】D （细节题）A pipe band contest.
【定位】The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in Glasgow on Saturday.
「世界风笛乐队锦标赛」将于周六在格拉斯哥举行。
【信号】开篇点题句。新闻首句 The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in Glasgow on Saturday. 与题干 What event will take place in Glasgow? 在结构上几乎一一对应(will take place in Glasgow 完全相同)，这就是新闻「导语 = 答案」的强信号。
【替换】The World Pipe Band Championships ↔A pipe band contest
championships 同义替换为 contest
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音通篇没出现任何 car show、汽车相关表述，A free car show. 属凭空想象。它唯一沾边的是 free 这个词——录音里 The event is free. 确实说了 free，于是把「免费」错按到「车展」上，是典型的把原词嫁接到错对象。
借用原文：The event is free.
B)
原词陷阱
录音说的是 the annual event，annual 与选项里的 yearly 同义，但核心活动是 pipe band championships，不是 concert(音乐会)。yearly 这个原义被偷出来盖到一个录音从未提到的 concert 上。
借用原文：the annual event
C)
偷换概念
A sports competition. 中 competition 与 D 项的 contest 几乎同义——录音里的Championships 翻译成 competition 也讲得通，但风笛比赛属于音乐文化赛事，不是体育(sports)赛事。把 sports 这一定语换成 pipe band 才对。
借用原文：Over 120 of the world's best pipe bands will compete at the championships.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does Glasgow City Council say the event will do?

options.text: Improve the image of Glasgow city.
Enrich the local culture of Glasgow.
Contribute a lot to the local economy.
Entertain people in local communities.

explanation:
【题目】What does Glasgow City Council say the event will do?
【翻译】格拉斯哥市议会说这个活动将会做什么?
A) 改善格拉斯哥市的形象。
B) 丰富格拉斯哥的当地文化。
C) 为当地经济做出很大贡献。
D) 娱乐当地社区的人们。
【答案】C （细节题）Contribute a lot to the local economy.
【定位】Glasgow City Council says it is estimated to bring £300,000 to the local economy.
格拉斯哥市议会表示，预计本次活动将为当地经济带来 30 万英镑的收入。
【信号】题干主语 + 金额词同时命中。原文 Glasgow City Council says it is estimated to bring £300,000 to the local economy. 与题干 What does Glasgow City Council say the event will do? 在「Glasgow City Council says」上几乎逐字对接，再叠加金额£300,000，是双重答案信号。
【替换】bring £300,000 to the local economy ↔Contribute a lot to the local economy.
bring 金额 = contribute a lot
【排除】A)
未提及
录音通篇无 image / reputation 等谈论城市形象的字眼。它和 C 在「为城市好」的方向上同方向，容易让考生「感觉对」，但题目问的是 Council 实际说了什么，没说就是没说。
B)
张冠李戴
录音里 The first World Pipe Band Championships were held in Edinburgh in 1947. 等句确实交代了赛事历史，乍听有文化色彩，但「丰富格拉斯哥本地文化」 (Enrich the local culture of Glasgow.) 这一定性并不是 Glasgow City Council 给的，更不是题干所问。
借用原文：It has been held regularly in Glasgow since 1986.
D)
过度推断
录音里 Over 4,000 pipers and drummers are expected to descend on the city for the annual event. 说的是有 4000 名风笛手鼓手前来参赛，并未提及「娱乐当地社区居民」。选项把「热闹场面」这一表象误读成「让 local communities 开心」，方向偏。
借用原文：Over 4,000 pipers and drummers are expected to descend on the city for the annual event.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is scientists' warning in the news report?

options.text: Surprising rise in global sea levels.
Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.
Changing weather patterns in summer.
Record growth of Greenland's ice sheets.

explanation:
【题目】What is scientists' warning in the news report?
【翻译】新闻报道中科学家们发出了什么警告?
A) 全球海平面出人意料地上升。
B) 格陵兰岛危险的冰层融化。
C) 夏季天气模式的变化。
D) 格陵兰岛冰盖创纪录的增长。
【答案】B （主旨题）Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.
【定位】Summer doesn't begin for two more days, but scientists are already sounding the alarm about dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland.
夏天还有两天才开始，但科学家们已经在为格陵兰岛正在发生的危险融冰拉响警报。
【信号】导语 + 转折 but + sounding the alarm。答案信号有三层叠加：第一，这是新闻第一句（导语，新闻惯例第一句点题）；第二，句中 but 是强转折，新闻里 but 之后才是真正要说的事；第三，紧跟 sounding the alarm（拉响警报）正是题干 warning 的同义信号，三者合在一起把答案句钉死在这一句。

【替换】sounding the alarm ↔scientists' warning
拉响警报等于发出警告
dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland ↔Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.
几乎是原句压缩
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 借用原文第 2 段 raise global sea levels by six meters 里的 sea levels 做诱饵，但原文那句只是『如果冰盖融化，可能抬升海平面 6 米』，是一个假设性的后果，且 surprising rise in global sea levels 并未在录音中实际宣布，把『潜在后果』当成『已经发生的警告』，属偷换概念。
借用原文：which if melted can raise global sea levels by six meters
C)
未提及
C 盗用原文里 Summer 与第 3、4 段反复出现的『季节、夏季』语境，把话题悄悄从『冰融』扩大到『夏季天气模式的变化』。整则新闻没有讨论 weather patterns（如降雨、风暴等气象格局），范围被无故放大。
借用原文：Summer doesn't begin for two more days
D)
与原文相反
D 把录音里 ice melts、ice sheet 这些原词搬过来，但把动作整个反过来说成 record growth of Greenland's ice sheets（『创纪录地增长』），与原文 its ice has melted faster than ever before 方向相反，是典型的『反向』诱饵。
借用原文：its ice has melted faster than ever before
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about this year's ice melting?

options.text: It began in late May.
It lasted three months.
It started a month earlier than usual.
It ended a month earlier than before.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about this year's ice melting?
【翻译】关于今年的冰层融化我们了解到什么?
A) 它始于五月下旬。
B) 它持续了三个月。
C) 它比往常提前一个月开始。
D) 它比以前提前一个月结束。
【答案】C （细节题）It started a month earlier than usual.
【定位】But this year, the melting season began in early May. That's a month earlier than normal and something that's happened only once before in the historical record in 2016.
但今年，融冰季在 5 月初就开始了。这比往年提前了一个月，是历史上仅在 2016 年出现过一次的情况。
【信号】转折 But this year 加时间反常。信号有两层：第一，But this year 是强转折，前面在讲『通常的融冰周期』，But 一拐就来到『今年反常』的落点；第二，紧跟出现的 a month earlier than normal 与题干 this year 严丝合缝，正是答案承载句。

【替换】the melting season began in early May ↔It started a month earlier than usual.
began 对应 started
a month earlier than normal ↔a month earlier than usual
than normal 等于 than usual
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 借用原文 began in early May 里的 May 做诱饵，但把 early May（5 月初）偷换成 late May（5 月底）；只要听清 early 与 late 这一字之差，就能识破。
借用原文：the melting season began in early May
B)
未提及
B 项 It lasted three months. 在录音中完全没有出现『三个月』或任何与 three months 对应的时长表述，是利用考生听到 Longer melt seasons 就想去补一个具体时长的心理凭空捏造的数字。
D)
与原文相反
D 与正确项 C 只差一个动词：started 变 ended。原文清清楚楚说的是融冰季『开始』提前一个月（began in early May），而非『结束』提前一个月；D 把动作整个反向，是典型的『开始或结束』互换陷阱。
借用原文：the melting season began in early May
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What happened on the streets of Blackhall Colliery?

options.text: Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.
A villager was searching for his lost cash.
Local policemen came across bundles of £20 notes.
A bundle containing thousands of pounds got stolen.

explanation:
【题目】What happened on the streets of Blackhall Colliery?
【翻译】Blackhall Colliery 的街道上发生了什么？
A) 成捆的20英镑纸币不断出现。
B) 一位村民正在寻找他丢失的现金。
C) 当地警察偶然发现了成捆的20英镑纸币。
D) 一捆装有数千英镑的现金被盗。
【答案】A （细节题）Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.
【定位】Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash keep turning up on the streets of Blackhall Colliery in northern England, according to police.
据警方称，装有数千英镑现金的成捆钞票不断出现在英格兰北部布莱克霍尔矿区的街道上。
【信号】新闻导语首句即落点。答案信号是"导语首句"：Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash keep turning up on the streets 正是全篇第一句，新闻把核心事件放在开头，无需转折、就是它。
【替换】keep turning up on the streets ↔kept turning up
时态变体的同一短语
Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash ↔Bundles of £20 notes
概括与具体互指同物

【排除】B)
B 说 A villager was searching for his lost cash.（一名村民在找他丢失的现金），但录音是钱不断"出现"、村民是"捡到"，从无谁在"找丢失的钱"，方向与原文相反。
C)
原词陷阱
C 盗用了录音原词 came across 与 policemen 拼成 Local policemen came across bundles of £20 notes.，但原文是 Residents of the village have been coming across bundles of £20 notes——"撞见"现金的是村民居民，不是警察，把发现者张冠李戴了。
借用原文：Residents of the village have been coming across bundles of £20 notes
D)
原词陷阱
D 说 A bundle containing thousands of pounds got stolen.（一捆数千英镑被偷），盗用了原文 Bundles containing thousands of pounds 的措辞，却把"出现并被上交"歪曲成"被偷"，与全篇"现金被发现、还给失主"的事实相反。
借用原文：Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do the local police do with the money if not claimed in two weeks?

options.text: They give it to charity.
They return it to the finder.
They hand it over to the local government.
They place a notice in The Northern Echo.

explanation:
【题目】What do the local police do with the money if not claimed in two weeks?
【翻译】如果两周内无人认领，当地警方会如何处理这笔钱？
A) 他们将其捐给慈善机构。
B) 他们将其归还给拾得者。
C) 他们将其移交给当地政府。
D) 他们在 The Northern Echo 上刊登启事。
【答案】B （细节题）They return it to the finder.
【定位】The owner has two weeks to collect the cash, which is then returned to the finder if not claimed, according to Peterlee Police.
据彼得利警方称，失主有两周时间来领取现金，如果无人认领，这笔钱随后会归还给发现者。
【信号】条件状语后的处置动词。答案信号是条件 + 处置动词：which is then returned to the finder if not claimed 里 if not claimed（若无人认领）正对题干 not claimed in two weeks，紧跟的动词 returned to the finder 就是处置结果。
【替换】returned to the finder ↔return it to the finder
被动转主动的同一动作

【排除】A)
A 说 They give it to charity.（捐给慈善），录音通篇没出现 charity 或捐赠的说法，是凭"无主之财常做公益"的常识硬填，属未提及。
C)
C 说 hand it over to the local government（上交当地政府），录音里出现的是 Peterlee Police、Durham Police 这些警方，从未说交给 local government（地方政府），把接收对象张冠李戴了。
D)
原词陷阱
D 说 place a notice in The Northern Echo（在《北方回声报》登启事），盗用了录音原词 The Northern Echo，但那是警察 John Forster 后文受访的报纸，与"无人认领后怎么处置钱"毫无关系，答非所问。
借用原文：He told The Northern Echo
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the policeman John Forster say about the villagers?

options.text: They cooperated well with the police.
They enjoyed a fairly affluent life.
They were puzzled by the mystery.
They had a strong community spirit.

explanation:
【题目】What did the policeman John Forster say about the villagers?
【翻译】警察 John Forster 对村民们说了什么？
A) 他们与警方配合良好。
B) 他们过着相当富裕的生活。
C) 他们对这个谜团感到困惑。
D) 他们有很强的社区精神。
【答案】D （态度观点题）They had a strong community spirit.
【定位】It isn't an affluent part of the world, so for them to find cash of that amount and instantly think about taking it to the police stations shows the community spirit there is.
这里并不是个富裕的地方，所以他们能捡到那么多现金、还立刻想到把钱送去警局，这显示出了当地的社区精神。
【信号】so…shows 引出结论评价。答案信号是"因果连词 so + 总结动词 shows"：so for them to find cash…instantly think about taking it to the police stations shows the community spirit，so 后是 Forster 对村民的总结性定性，shows 后面那个词就是他真正想说的评价。
【替换】shows the community spirit there is ↔They had a strong community spirit.
结论原词直接对应
instantly think about taking it to the police stations ↔strong community spirit
行为佐证情感程度

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
A 说 They cooperated well with the police.（他们与警方配合良好），录音里村民确有"把钱送去警局"的行为，但 Forster 并未据此评价他们"配合警方"，而是上升为社区精神——A 是对行为的过度推断。
B)
B 说 They enjoyed a fairly affluent life.（过着相当富裕的生活），盗用了录音原词affluent，但原文是 It isn't an affluent part of the world——明明说"不富裕"，B 把否定去掉、反了极性。
借用原文：It isn't an affluent part of the world
C)
原词陷阱
C 说 They were puzzled by the mystery.（他们被这谜团困惑），盗用了录音原词 The circumstances remain a mystery 的 mystery，但感到费解的是警方（Forster 说 remain a mystery、想 get to the bottom），不是村民，把困惑者张冠李戴了。
借用原文：The circumstances remain a mystery
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: How does the man often feel on his birthday?

options.text: Excited.
Delighted.
Indifferent.
Strange.

explanation:
【题目】How does the man often feel on his birthday?
【翻译】这位男士在生日时常常有什么感觉?
A) 兴奋的。
B) 高兴的。
C) 无所谓的。
D) 奇怪的。
【答案】D （态度观点题）Strange.
【定位】I often feel strange on my birthday. It's like my brain decides to have a crisis.
我过生日时常常觉得怪怪的。就好像我的大脑决定要闹一场危机似的。
【信号】被问者的直接应答 + 原话情绪词。女士先问"生日有什么打算"，男士开口就答 I often feel strange on my birthday，这是被问者的直接应答，且 often feel strange 几乎是直接给出心情词，正是答案句的强信号。
【替换】I often feel strange on my birthday ↔Strange.
原词直接对应

【排除】A)
未提及
Excited. 是大家默认"过生日该有"的情绪，靠常识容易误选，但录音男士从头到尾没说兴奋，反而说怪怪的、像要闹危机，与 A 相反。
B)
未提及
Delighted.(高兴)同样是想当然的"生日心情"，录音并未表达欢喜，男士说的是 strange，故排除。
C)
偷换概念
Indifferent.(无所谓)看似贴近"不太在乎生日"，但录音说的是 feel strange、brain has a crisis，是"心绪不宁"而非"无所谓"，态度强度对不上。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say many people tend to do on their birthday?

options.text: Search for the meaning of their life.
Look back on their years at school.
Call on their relatives and friends.
Talk about future plans with friends.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say many people tend to do on their birthday?
【翻译】这位女士说许多人在生日时往往会做什么?
A) 寻找他们人生的意义。
B) 回顾他们在校的岁月。
C) 拜访他们的亲戚和朋友。
D) 与朋友谈论未来的计划。
【答案】A （细节题）Search for the meaning of their life.
【定位】Many begin to search for the meaning of their existence, leading to behaviors such as ending or starting a relationship, or plans, like starting a vigorous diet or fitness program.
许多人开始寻找自己存在的意义，由此引发一些行为，比如结束或开始一段感情，或是制订计划，比如开始严格的节食或健身方案。
【信号】Many begin to… 的群体行为陈述。女士说 Many begin to search for the meaning of their existence，主语 Many 正对题干的 many people，begin to + 动作 直接给出"多数人会做的事"，是答案句的明确信号。
【替换】search for the meaning of their existence ↔Search for the meaning of their life.
近义词 existence=life

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音确实提到 their achievements in life in the past decade 里的"过去十年/过去一年"，让人联想到"回顾在校岁月"，但原文说的是回顾"成就"、并未提 school 或"回顾学生时代"，Look back on their years at school. 把"回顾过往成就"偷换成了"回顾学校岁月"。
借用原文：their achievements in life in the past decade, or their accomplishments of the past year
C)
未提及
Call on their relatives and friends.(拜访亲友)是大家想象中"过生日"的常见举动，但录音列举的群体行为是"找人生意义、结束/开始感情、节食健身"，从未提走访亲友，属常识脑补、无原文支撑。
D)
原词陷阱
录音里有 or plans, like starting a vigorous diet or fitness program，出现了 plans 一词，Talk about future plans with friends. 顺手盗用 plans 设套；但原文的 plans 指"制订节食/健身计划"这类行动，并非"和朋友谈未来打算"，对象与方式都被改了。
借用原文：or plans, like starting a vigorous diet or fitness program
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about birthday celebrations?

options.text: He prefers to have them shown on social media.
He loves them but does not want to make a fuss.
He enjoys celebrating others' birthdays rather than his own.
He looks forward to receiving presents from his close friends.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about birthday celebrations?
【翻译】这位男士对生日庆祝有什么看法?
A) 他更喜欢把它们展示在社交媒体上。
B) 他喜欢生日庆祝但不想大张旗鼓。
C) 他喜欢庆祝别人的生日而不是自己的。
D) 他期待收到亲密朋友送的礼物。
【答案】C （细节题）He enjoys celebrating others' birthdays rather than his own.
【定位】I have wonderful friends and I love celebrating their birthdays. But I don't like being the center of attention, receiving gifts and having a fuss made.
我有很棒的朋友，我很喜欢为他们庆祝生日。但我不喜欢成为众人焦点、收礼物、被大张旗鼓地庆祝。
【信号】转折 But 切出真意。前半 I love celebrating their birthdays 说爱给别人过，转折词 But I don't like being the center of attention 之后才是落点——爱别人的、却不愿自己被庆祝，But 后才是答案信号。
【替换】I love celebrating their birthdays ↔He enjoys celebrating others' birthdays
love=enjoy、their=others'
I don't like being the center of attention ↔rather than his own
否定句概括成 rather than

media.

fuss.

than his own.

his close friends.
【排除】A)
与原文相反
录音确有 social media too can intensify things as birthdays now play out more publicly，但男士是说社交媒体让生日更公开、加重了他的不安，He prefers to have them shown on social media. 却说他"偏爱在社交媒体上展示"，与原文态度正相反。
借用原文：social media too can intensify things as birthdays now play out more publicly
B)
原词陷阱
He loves them but does not want to make a fuss. 用了录音原词 fuss(见 having a fuss made)且"喜欢但不想张扬"也部分贴合男士的话，极具迷惑性；但 B 漏掉了关键对比"喜欢的是别人的生日、不喜欢的是自己的"，泛指 them 反而把"自己 vs 别人"这层最核心的区分抹掉了，不如 C 精准。
借用原文：But I don't like being the center of attention, receiving gifts and having a fuss made
D)
与原文相反
录音里 receiving gifts 是男士"不喜欢"的事，He looks forward to receiving presents from his close friends. 却把它说成"盼着收礼物"，gifts/presents 同义但态度被彻底反转。
借用原文：I don't like being the center of attention, receiving gifts
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman suggest the man do about his birthday celebration at the end of the conversation?

options.text: Hold it on a modest scale to remove birthday anxieties.
View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
Extend invitation to those he trusts most.
Make it an occasion to collect donations.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman suggest the man do about his birthday celebration at the end of the conversation?
【翻译】在对话结束时,这位女士建议这位男士如何处理他的生日庆祝?
A) 以适度的规模举办以消除生日焦虑。
B) 把它看作人们社交和娱乐的机会。
C) 向他最信任的人发出邀请。
D) 把它作为募集捐款的场合。
【答案】B （细节题）View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
【定位】Exactly. Or even simply see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun.
正是如此。或者干脆把你的生日看作一个把大家聚到一起、让他们开心玩乐的机会。
【信号】结尾处女士的建议句。题干限定 at the end，而这正是对话最后一句女士的话 see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun，see…as an opportunity to 是明显的建议口吻，落在末尾，正是答案信号。
【替换】bring people together for them to have fun ↔ View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
聚人=socialize、机会=chance

anxieties.

and have fun.

【排除】A)
答非所问
对话前段女士确实围绕生日焦虑(birthday blues)给过"别孤立自己、逐步面对"的话，Hold it on a modest scale to remove birthday anxieties. 借"消除焦虑"设套；但"小规模操办以消焦虑"并非女士结尾(at the end)所说，且原文没说"小规模"，定位错位。
借用原文：to deal with the birthday blues, you should not isolate yourself
C)
原词陷阱
录音 gradually face your birthday with people you trust 出现了 trust，Extend invitation to those he trusts most. 盗用 trust 设套；但那是女士在对话中段说的，且原文是"和你信任的人一起逐步面对"，不是"只邀请最信任的人"，既非结尾建议、内容也被改了。
借用原文：It's best to gradually face your birthday with people you trust
D)
张冠李戴
录音里 asking people to make a donation instead of buying a gift 提到捐款，Make it an occasion to collect donations. 盗用 donation；但这是"男士"自己提出的想法，题干问的是"女士"在结尾的建议，张冠李戴了。
借用原文：asking people to make a donation instead of buying a gift

stem: What does the woman say about her subway ride?

options.text: It was absolutely exhausting.
There was a terrible smell.
There was too long a delay.
She got off at the wrong station.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about her subway ride?
【翻译】女士对她乘坐地铁的经历有何评价?
A) 绝对令人精疲力竭。
B) 有一股难闻的气味。
C) 延误时间太长了。
D) 她在错误的站下车了。
【答案】A （细节题）It was absolutely exhausting.

【定位】No, but the train was so packed that I could barely move, and it was difficult to breathe too... Once I did get out, I was totally exhausted.
不是(晚点)，但车厢太挤了，我几乎动不了，连呼吸都困难……等我终于挤出来，已经累得精疲力竭了。
【信号】先否定再描述，落点在收尾。她先用 No否掉"晚点"，再细数挤、喘不上气，最后用 I was totally exhausted收束——"totally(完全)"的加重语气正是答案信号，整段抱怨归到"累"上。
【替换】I was totally exhausted ↔It was absolutely exhausting.
同义词+主被动改写
【排除】C)
原词陷阱
男方问 was there a delay?，女方明确回 No。选项 There was too long a delay.正是盗用了录音里反复出现的 delay 一词，但"晚点"恰恰是她否认的，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：No, but the train was so packed
B)
未提及
录音说 it was difficult to breathe too，原因是太挤、不是有味道。There was a terrible smell.借"呼吸"联想出"异味"，是无中生有的过度引申，原文并未提到任何 smell。
D)
偷换概念
录音只说她 could hardly get out(挤得几乎下不了车)，是"难下车"不是"下错站"。She got off at the wrong station.把"下车困难"偷换成"下错站"，原文无此意。
借用原文：When I got to my station, I could hardly get out

stem: Why hasn't the woman got her own car?

options.text: She hasn't saved enough money.
She is worried about traffic jams.
She hasn't passed the driving test yet.
She is used to taking public transport.

explanation:
【题目】Why hasn't the woman got her own car?
【翻译】女士为什么没有自己的汽车?
A) 她还没有攒够钱。
B) 她担心交通堵塞。
C) 她还没有通过驾驶考试。
D) 她习惯了乘坐公共交通工具。
【答案】A （细节题）She hasn't saved enough money.
【定位】I've got a driver's license, but that's all. I'm saving up to buy something reasonably small and cute, but it's still a bit expensive for me, and it'll take a while before I have enough money.
我有驾照，但也就这样了。我正在攒钱想买辆小巧可爱点的车，但对我来说还是有点贵，得过一阵子才能攒够钱。
【信号】转折 but 后才是真原因。她先说 I've got a driver's license(有驾照)，紧接 but it's still a bit expensive for me——转折 but 之后的"贵、还没攒够钱"才是真正没车的原因，前半句"有驾照"是用来排除C的。

【替换】it'll take a while before I have enough money ↔She hasn't saved enough money.
肯否转换+概括
【排除】C)
与原文相反
选项 She hasn't passed the driving test yet.借"driving"语境制造混淆，但录音开口就是I've got a driver's license(已有驾照)，正好与"还没考过"相反——没车的卡点在钱，不在证。
借用原文：I've got a driver's license
B)
张冠李戴
She is worried about traffic jams.里的"拥挤/慢"其实对应她吐槽地铁公交 The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded.，与"为什么没车"无关，把别处的抱怨安到这题上。
借用原文：it's just as crowded
D)
与原文相反
She is used to taking public transport.与原文相反：她一开口就在抱怨地铁、还在saving up to buy车，分明想摆脱公共交通，并非"习惯并满足于"它。
借用原文：I'm saving up to buy something
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say about electric motorbikes?

options.text: They are popular.
They are dangerous.
They are a bit expensive for her.
They are environmentally friendly.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about electric motorbikes?
【翻译】女士对电动摩托车有何评价?
A) 它们很受欢迎。
B) 它们很危险。
C) 对她来说它们有点贵。
D) 它们环保。
【答案】B （态度观点题）They are dangerous.
【定位】I consider that for maybe a minute. But honestly, I've just seen too many horrible accidents involving those dangerous monsters.
我也就考虑了大概一分钟。但说实话，我见过太多那些"危险怪物"造成的可怕事故了。
【信号】But honestly 后的强烈贬词。她先敷衍"考虑了一分钟"，转折 But honestly后甩出horrible accidents与 dangerous monsters——"honestly"加重、"dangerous/horrible"是强烈负面评价，态度信号集中在此。
【替换】those dangerous monsters ↔They are dangerous.
原词点评直接对应

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
They are popular.盗用了男方下一句 those popular shared bikes里的 popular，但那是评价"共享单车"、且出自男方之口，并非女方对电摩的看法，张冠李戴。
借用原文：those popular shared bikes
C)
张冠李戴
They are a bit expensive for her.盗用了她在买车时说的 it's still a bit expensive for me，但"贵"评价的是要买的小车，对电动摩托车她说的是危险、从未说贵。
借用原文：it's still a bit expensive for me
D)
未提及
They are environmentally friendly.听起来很符合"电动"的常识联想，但全篇没有任何一句说电摩环保，属凭电动二字脑补出来的未提及项。

stem: How was the woman going to get to work?

options.text: By bus.
By jogging.
By renting a bike.
By sharing a ride.

explanation:
【题目】How was the woman going to get to work?
【翻译】女士打算如何去上班?
A) 乘公交车。
B) 慢跑。
C) 租一辆自行车。
D) 拼车。
【答案】D （细节题）By sharing a ride.
【定位】M: Not if you use a ride sharing app. W: Good idea. I'll download one immediately. Thank you.
男：用拼车app就不贵了。女：好主意。我这就下载一个。谢谢。
【信号】结尾"Good idea+这就去做"的拍板。前面公交、单车、慢跑、出租都被她一一否掉或挑刺，直到男方提 a ride sharing app，她答 Good idea. I'll download one immediately ——"Good idea"+立刻行动是明确的最终拍板信号。
【替换】use a ride sharing app ↔By sharing a ride.
动名词概括+去掉app
Good idea. I'll download one immediately ↔By sharing a ride.
认可信号坐实最终选择

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
By bus.盗用对话里讨论过的 bus，但她明确说 The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded.——又慢又挤，早被否掉，属"提过即否"的陷阱。
借用原文：The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded.
C)
原词陷阱
By renting a bike.对应 those popular shared bikes，她回 that's a possibility——只是"一种可能"，并未像拼车那样"Good idea+这就去做"，停在备选阶段。
借用原文：that's a possibility
B)
原词陷阱
By jogging.盗用她自己提的 jog to work，但她紧接着说 the air pollution is a real problem，因污染把慢跑否了，并非最终选择。
借用原文：the air pollution is a real problem

stem: What do we learn about Steve Miller?

options.text: He is a sign language interpreter.
He is a deaf person working in IT.
He doesn't like speaking at meetings.
He doesn't use email or text messages.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about Steve Miller?
【翻译】关于Steve Miller我们了解到什么?
A) 他是一名手语翻译员。
B) 他是一名在IT行业工作的聋人。
C) 他不喜欢在会议上发言。
D) 他不使用电子邮件或短信。
【答案】B （细节题）He is a deaf person working in IT.
【定位】Steve Miller began his career in IT back in the late 1980s. Being a deaf person in tech required a huge amount of effort in organization.
史蒂夫·米勒在上世纪80年代末开始了他在 IT 行业的职业生涯。作为科技行业里的一名聋人，这需要在组织安排上付出巨大的努力。
【信号】开篇直接交代身份。篇章开头第一句就点出他的处境——Being a deaf person in tech，介绍人物的篇章往往一开口就交代身份，这句即是答案句。
【替换】a deaf person in tech ↔a deaf person working in IT
tech 与 IT 同义、in 改 working in
began his career in IT ↔working in IT
'开启IT生涯'='在IT工作'

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
原文确实念到 He needed a sign language interpreter for every meeting，但那是说他'需要'一名手语翻译，不是说他'是'手语翻译；选项 He is a sign language interpreter.把'他需要的人'安到他自己头上。
借用原文：He needed a sign language interpreter for every meeting
C)
偷换概念
原文说 Communicating in meetings was very difficult.(开会沟通'很困难')，这是客观障碍；选项 He doesn't like speaking at meetings. 偷换成'他不喜欢在会上发言'的主观好恶，文中从未提他喜不喜欢。
借用原文：Communicating in meetings was very difficult.
D)
与原文相反
原文是 there was no email or text message service——当年(80年代末)根本'没有'这种服务，是时代背景；选项 He doesn't use email or text messages. 偷换成'他(现在)不用'电邮短信，把'当时不存在'歪曲为'他个人不用'。
借用原文：there was no email or text message service
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does Miller say is making things better for people like him?

options.text: Improved communication skills.
Speech recognition technology.
Big advances in sign language.
Transformation in the IT industry.

explanation:
【题目】What does Miller say is making things better for people like him?
【翻译】Miller说什么正在改善像他这样的人的处境?
A) 沟通技能的提升。
B) 语音识别技术。
C) 手语的巨大进步。
D) IT行业的变革。
【答案】B （细节题）Speech recognition technology.
【定位】Big advances in speech recognition technology have enabled communication tools to turn live speech into text in real time on your smartphone or laptop, and sign language into text as well.
语音识别技术的巨大进步，使得沟通工具能够在智能手机或笔记本电脑上实时把现场语音转成文字，也能把手语转成文字。
【信号】因果信号 enabled 点出真正推动者。句子主语 Big advances in speech recognition technology 后接 have enabled(使……得以)，enabled 是因果信号，前面那个名词正是'带来改善'的诱因，即答案句。
【替换】Big advances in speech recognition technology ↔Speech recognition technology
选项是原文核心名词的浓缩

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
原文反复出现 communication(如 communication tools)，选项 Improved communication skills. 借这个熟词造干扰，但原文说变好的是'沟通工具'靠技术运转，不是'沟通技能'提高了，文中也没说他技能改善。
借用原文：communication tools
C)
原词陷阱
原文确实念到 sign language into text as well，选项 Big advances in sign language. 借sign language 造干扰，但原文的'大进步(advances)'是修饰 speech recognition technology 的，并非'手语本身的大进步'。
借用原文：sign language into text as well
D)
过度推断
原文话题虽在 IT 行业，但带来改善的是一项具体技术；选项 Transformation in the IT industry. 借 IT 一词把'语音识别技术'夸大成'整个 IT 行业的变革'，范围被无限放大，原文没说行业整体变革。
借用原文：a good time to be a deaf person in tech
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: In what way can Miller benefit from attending meetings via video?

options.text: He can avoid being mistaken.
He can take notes on the spot.
He can understand with ease.
He can see the speakers' images.

explanation:
【题目】In what way can Miller benefit from attending meetings via video?
【翻译】Miller通过视频参加会议能在哪方面受益?
A) 他可以避免被误解。
B) 他可以当场做笔记。
C) 他可以轻松理解。
D) 他可以看到发言者的影像。
【答案】C （细节题）He can understand with ease.
【定位】He can employ lip-reading and have meetings via video instead of on the phone. These things have made a huge difference. He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand.
他可以借助唇读，并通过视频而非电话开会。这些做法带来了巨大的改变。他再也不必担心自己能否听懂了。
【信号】结果句 no longer has to worry 点出好处。在 have meetings via video 之后，原文用These things have made a huge difference 收束，再接 He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand——'不再担心能否听懂'正是视频开会带来的好处，即答案句。
【替换】He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand ↔ He can understand with ease
'不再担心能否听懂'=肯否转换为'能轻松听懂'

【排除】A)
未提及
选项 He can avoid being mistaken. 说'能避免被误解'，原文谈的是他能否'听懂'，从未提到'被误解'这回事，属凭空添加。
B)
未提及
选项 He can take notes on the spot. 说'能当场记笔记'，原文虽提到技术能把语音转成text(文字)，但从没说他'记笔记'，是把'转文字'歪联想成'记笔记'。
D)
原词陷阱
题干和原文都念到 have meetings via video，选项 He can see the speakers' images. 借video 字面推出'能看到说话人画面'，但原文说视频开会的好处是'不再担心能否听懂'，而非'看到画面'本身；越和 video 字面像，越是诱人下钩的原词陷阱。
借用原文：have meetings via video
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do people want upon returning home according to the passage?

options.text: To find pure white walls shining.
To enter a house well looked after.
To get a hug from family members.
To see cheerful colours all around.

explanation:
【题目】What do people want upon returning home according to the passage?
【翻译】根据文章,人们回到家后想要什么?
A) 发现纯白色的墙壁闪闪发光。
B) 进入一个照料良好的房子。
C) 得到家人的拥抱。
D) 看到周围都是令人愉快的色彩。
【答案】D （细节题）To see cheerful colours all around.
【定位】When people return home, they want to see colours that cheer them up and give them a hug.
人们回家时，想看到能让自己振奋、给自己一个拥抱的色彩。
【信号】want 直陈诉求。录音用 they want to see colours that cheer them up 直接点出回家想要什么，want to 后面就是答题落点；紧接着 Pure white walls simply don't do that. 又用否定把白墙排除，进一步确认想要的是彩色而非白墙。
【替换】colours that cheer them up ↔cheerful colours
动词转形容词
see colours ↔see cheerful colours all around
动作原词保留

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
To find pure white walls shining. 盗用了原文里 Pure white walls 这个原词，但原文紧接着说 Pure white walls simply don't do that.，白墙恰恰是被否定的、不能给人拥抱的东西，听到 white walls 就选正好掉坑。
借用原文：Pure white walls simply don't do that.
B)
偷换概念
To enter a house well looked after. 借用了原文 They don't look after you. 里的 look after，但原文说的是色彩照顾人（you），不是人想进入一座被照看好的房子，主语和对象都被偷换了。
借用原文：They don't look after you.
C)
未提及
To get a hug from family members. 用了原文的 hug，但原文是 give them a hug——给拥抱的是色彩，根本没提 family members，把拥抱的来源安给了原文没说的家人。
借用原文：give them a hug
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say people should avoid doing in home decoration?

options.text: Choosing a colour because it is fashionable.
Painting the interior of their cupboards.
Doing the painting job all by themselves.
Designing all window frames the same way.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say people should avoid doing in home decoration?
【翻译】文章说人们在家居装饰中应该避免做什么?
A) 因为流行而选择一种颜色。
B) 粉刷橱柜的内部。
C) 自己完成所有粉刷工作。
D) 把所有窗框设计成同样的样式。
【答案】A （细节题）Choosing a colour because it is fashionable.
【定位】Don't go for a colour because it's in fashion, or you've seen it in a magazine.
不要因为某种颜色正流行、或你在杂志上见过它，就去选它。
【信号】Don't 否定建议。录音用祈使否定句 Don't go for a colour because it's in fashion 直接给出劝阻——别因为时髦而选色，Don't 就是该避免做法的信号词，这句即答案句。
【替换】because it's in fashion ↔because it is fashionable
名词短语转形容词
go for a colour ↔Choosing a colour
动词同义替换

【排除】B)
与原文相反
Painting the interior of their cupboards. 盗用了原文 the inside of a cupboard，但原文把刷柜子内部当作试色的好办法来推荐，而非要避免的事，态度正好相反。
借用原文：test your tolerance with smaller spaces, such as the inside of a cupboard
C)
未提及
Doing the painting job all by themselves. 里 all by themselves（亲力亲为）原文从未提及，录音只谈选什么色、刷哪里，没说该不该自己动手。
D)
原词陷阱
Designing all window frames the same way. 借了原文出现过的 window frame（a bright window frame），但原文说的是把窗框作为试色的小空间，没说所有窗框要设计成同一款式，更没说要避免。
借用原文：a bright window frame
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第26页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What can one do to make a room look bigger?

options.text: Fit most of the cupboards into walls.
Hang landscape paintings all around.
Match the room's ceiling with all the furniture in colour.
Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour.

explanation:
【题目】What can one do to make a room look bigger?
【翻译】怎样做可以让房间看起来更大?
A) 把大部分橱柜嵌入墙内。
B) 在四周悬挂风景画。
C) 使房间的天花板与所有家具颜色相配。
D) 把木制框架和墙壁刷成同一颜色。
【答案】D （细节题）Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour.
【定位】One can also paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls, helping the rooms look bigger.
也可以把木质框架刷成与墙壁相同的颜色，这有助于让房间显得更大。

stem: What does the passage say parents increasingly understand?

options.text: Children must read at least 3 times a week.
Reading is a habit every child can develop.
Reading to their children is important.
Children should start reading at age 3.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say parents increasingly understand?
【翻译】文章指出父母越来越理解什么?
A) 孩子必须每周至少阅读3次。
B) 阅读是每个孩子都能养成的习惯。
C) 给孩子读书很重要。
D) 孩子应该在3岁开始阅读。
【答案】C （细节题）Reading to their children is important.
【定位】Parents often hear that reading to their children is critical for supporting development, and the message is getting through to them.
父母常听到『给孩子读书对支持其发展至关重要』这一说法，而且这个信息正在被他们接收（理解）。
【信号】开篇点题句 + getting through 表领悟。答案信号是开篇直接点题：reading to their children is critical for supporting development，紧跟 the message is getting through to them，getting through 正对应题干的 understand，是承载答案的那一句。
【替换】reading to their children is critical for supporting development ↔ Reading to their children is important.
critical=important 同义替换
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 Children must read at least 3 times a week. 把原文 three or more times per week 的频次盗来，但原文说的是『父母给孩子读』的统计数据，不是『孩子自己必须每周读3次』的要求，答非所问。
借用原文：three or more times per week
B)
未提及
选项 Reading is a habit every child can develop. 听起来很正确很顺耳，但全文只谈父母给孩子读书的好处与选书，从未说『阅读是每个孩子都能养成的习惯』，属凭常识脑补、原文无据。
D)
原词陷阱
选项 Children should start reading at age 3. 借用原文 between the ages of three and five 里的 three，但那是统计样本的年龄段，不是『孩子应3岁开始读书』的建议，数字真听到了、意思全拧了。
借用原文：between the ages of three and five

stem: What can predict children's reading skills according to recent research?

options.text: The number of books they have read by age four.
The speed of their brain development in infancy.
The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.
The quality and quantity of time parents spend playing with them.

explanation:
【题目】What can predict children's reading skills according to recent research?
【翻译】根据近期研究,什么可以预测孩子的阅读能力?
A) 他们在四岁前读过的书籍数量。
B) 他们婴儿期大脑发育的速度。
C) 父母在婴儿期给他们读的书籍的数量和质量。
D) 父母与他们玩耍所花费时间的质量和数量。
【答案】C （细节题）The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.
【定位】In fact, recent research has found that both the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy predicted later childhood vocabulary and reading skills.
事实上，最近的研究发现，婴儿期共同读书的质量和数量都预测了孩子日后的词汇和阅读能力。
【信号】研究发现信号 recent research has found + predicted。答案信号是表研究结论的recent research has found 和动词 predicted，predicted 直接对应题干 predict，其前面的主语 the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy 就是被点名的预测因素。
【替换】the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy ↔ The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.
quantity=number、shared book reading=books parents read
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 The number of books they have read by age four. 借用原文 four-year-old children 的 four，但原文 four 是说『四岁孩子身上的发展益处』，从没说『到四岁读了多少本书』能预测能力，数字听到了、意思编造了。
借用原文：four-year-old children
B)
原词陷阱
选项 The speed of their brain development in infancy. 借了原文 brain development，但原文是说『读书有助于语言和大脑发育』，大脑发育是『结果/益处』，不是『预测阅读能力的原因』，把因果位置弄反了。
借用原文：reading to young children helps their language and brain development
D)
偷换概念
选项 The quality and quantity of time parents spend playing with them. 几乎照抄原文的 quality and quantity 结构，却把核心动作从『读书』换成 playing（玩），原文谈的始终是 reading，不是陪玩，偷换了概念。
借用原文：the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy

stem: What kind of books are said to help babies learn more?

options.text: Books with specifically labeled images.
Books with pictures of dolls and toys.
Books describing the lives of animals.
Books telling very interesting stories.

explanation:
【题目】What kind of books are said to help babies learn more?
【翻译】什么样的书据说能帮助婴儿学到更多?
A) 带有明确标注图像的书。
B) 带有玩偶和玩具图片的书。
C) 描述动物生活的书。
D) 讲述非常有趣故事的书。
【答案】A （细节题）Books with specifically labeled images.
【定位】It followed infants across the second six months of life and found that when parents showed babies books that had faces or objects with specific labels, they learned more.
研究跟踪了出生后第二个半年的婴儿，发现当父母给婴儿看『带有具体标签的面孔或物体』的书时，他们学得更多。
【信号】因果/条件句 when…they learned more。答案信号是条件结果句 when parents showed babies books that had faces or objects with specific labels, they learned more，learned more 正对应题干 learn more，其条件部分点名的书就是答案；后文 This is in contrast to 进一步用对比反衬，强化了这一类。
【替换】books that had faces or objects with specific labels ↔Books with specifically labeled images.
faces or objects=images、specific labels=specifically labeled
【排除】B)
过度推断
选项 Books with pictures of dolls and toys. 把原文 objects（物体）具体化为『玩偶和玩具』，原文从未指明是玩偶玩具，是凭常识把抽象的 objects 想象成具体玩具，属脑补。
借用原文：faces or objects with specific labels
C)
未提及
选项 Books describing the lives of animals. 看似贴近『讲动物』，但原文 P3 全程没提animals，更没说『描写动物生活的书』有用，纯属无中生有。
D)
偷换概念
选项 Books telling very interesting stories. 把『有用的书』偷换成『很有趣的故事书』，原文判定标准是『有没有具体标签』，不是『故事有不有趣』，换了一套评价维度。
借用原文：books that had faces or objects with specific labels
