stem: What are parents advised to do at the end of the passage?

options.text: Read as many books as possible to their children.
Choose carefully what to read to their children.
Share experience with other parents.
Create picture books for their children.

explanation:
【题目】What are parents advised to do at the end of the passage?

【翻译】文章结尾建议父母做什么?
A) 尽可能多地给孩子读书。
B) 仔细选择给孩子读什么。
C) 与其他父母分享经验。
D) 为孩子创作图画书。
【答案】B （细节题）Choose carefully what to read to their children.
【定位】Not all books are created equal, so parents need to choose the books they share with their children with great care.
并非所有书都一样（有价值），所以父母需要非常用心地挑选要和孩子共读的书。
【信号】结尾因果建议句 so parents need to…。答案信号是篇章结尾的因果建议句 so parents need to choose the books they share with their children with great care，so 引出结论、need to 是直接建议，正是题干要的『结尾建议』。
【替换】choose the books they share with their children with great care ↔ Choose carefully what to read to their children.
with great care=carefully、share=read to
【排除】A)
与原文相反
选项 Read as many books as possible to their children. 主张『尽量多读』，但结尾恰恰强调 Not all books are created equal『书有好坏之分』、要『用心选』，方向与原文相反——原文要的是质而非量。
借用原文：Not all books are created equal
C)
原词陷阱
选项 Share experience with other parents. 借了一个似曾相识的 share，但原文的 share是 the books they share with their children（与孩子共读书），从没说『与其他父母分享经验』，对象被换且原文无此建议。
借用原文：the books they share with their children
D)
未提及
选项 Create picture books for their children. 借了原文反复出现的 books 和图像概念，但原文建议父母『挑选』书，从没说『为孩子创作绘本』，create 是无中生有的动作。
借用原文：parents need to choose the books they share with their children

动词

32. For mums, __(32)__, compared to women without children, the results weren't quite as positive.

副词
【词性槽】两个逗号之间的插入语，是连接副词
【依据】上文说父亲情况好、本句说妈妈"不那么积极"，是转折，用 however
前一段 Fathers also did better than men without kids, reporting greater happiness 说父亲更好，本句 For mums, __(32)__, compared to women without children, the results weren't quite as positive. 转向妈妈"结果没那么积极"，前后是对比转折，填however 最贴。

stem: What does the author say is remarkable about the fish we eat?

options.text: They reproduce quickly.
They are mostly farmed.
They have become as important as grain.
They have a longer history than humans.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author say is remarkable about the fish we eat? 用 say 引出作者明确表态的内容，不是让考生自行推断。
【拆句】题干 What does the author say is remarkable about the fish we eat? 主干是 What does the author say，宾语从句省略了 that，从句里 is remarkable about the fish we eat 又内嵌一个省略 that 的定语从句 we eat修饰 fish。结构属常规嵌套，无陷阱。
【定位】For the first time in human history, most of our aquatic(水产的) food now comes from farming rather than fishing.
人类历史上第一次，我们大多数的水产食物来自养殖而非捕捞。
【选项】A)
无中生有
They reproduce quickly 涉及鱼的繁殖能力，原文从第 1 段到第 3 段只谈消费量与来源，未出现任何关于鱼繁殖速度的内容。
B)
✓ 正确
most of our aquatic(水产的) food now comes from farming rather than fishing ↔ They are mostly farmed
预判答案是「大多是养殖的」，They are mostly farmed 几乎一一对应——主语 They回指题干 the fish we eat，谓语 are mostly farmed 等价于定位句的 most … comes from farming。
C)
偷换概念
They have become as important as grain 把鱼与谷物相提并论，原文 That grain— and the water needed to grow it—could be consumed by people instead 谈的是「养鱼比养牛省粮」，并未把鱼的重要性提升到与谷物同等的高度。
D)
无中生有
They have a longer history than humans 称鱼的历史比人类长，文中 For the first time in human history 只是用「人类历史上第一次」这一时间状语，并未对比鱼与人类哪个历史更悠久。

【判型】题干 What do we need to do if we keep consuming fish at the current rate? 问的是文中给出的具体应对动作，答案应在原文中直接呈现。
【拆句】题干主句是 What do we need to do，后接 if 条件状语从句 if we keep consuming fish at the current rate；keep + 动名词 consuming 表示持续，at the current rate 修饰consuming。结构清晰，对基础薄弱者唯一难点是把 if 从句视作整体条件而非干扰信息。
【定位】To keep eating fish at the current rate, we're definitely going to need to keep aquaculture(水产养殖) developing.
要想保持目前的吃鱼速度，我们绝对需要让水产养殖持续发展下去。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
Increase the fishing volume considerably 主张大幅增加捕捞量，而 the volume of fish caught in the wild has leveled off since the 1990s 与 more than three-tenths are 已经说明海洋鱼资源被过度捕捞，再增加捕捞与原文方向背离。
B)
无中生有
Develop more advanced fishing technology 谈的是发展更先进的捕鱼技术，原文从P4 到 P6 完全没有出现 technology、advanced 等任何技术升级方面的表达。
C)
答非所问
Enlarge the marine fish stocks effectively 称要扩大海洋鱼类存量，Only a tenth of our oceans' fish stocks could sustain heavier fishing than current levels 说明现实情况是大多数鱼类资源已被过度捕捞，扩大存量并非作者提出的对策——作者提的对策是「转向养殖」。
D)
✓ 正确
keep aquaculture(水产养殖) developing ↔Expand the scale of fish-farming continuously
预判要点是「继续 / 发展 / 水产养殖」三个成分；Expand the scale of fish-farming continuously 用 continuously / expand the scale / fish-farming 三个对应件——同义替换全部命中。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say about China in terms of aquatic food?

options.text: It places increasing emphasis on fishing now.
It boasts of the world's largest fishing stocks.
It raises more fish than caught from the wild.
It supplies 60% of the world's fish products.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author say about China in terms of aquatic food? 围绕中国这个具体对象问事实陈述，作者在文中应有正面交代。
【拆句】题干 What does the author say about China in terms of aquatic food? 主干同 46 题，介词短语 in terms of aquatic food 起范围限定，意为「就水产食物而言」。考生若不识 in terms of 容易整句失焦，需点明它的限定功能。
【定位】A lot of that is coming from China, which produces 60% of the world's farmed fish. In fact, some 35 countries, including China, now produce more farmed than wild-caught fish.
其中很大一部分来自中国，中国生产了全球 60% 的养殖鱼。事实上，包括中国在内的约 35个国家如今生产的养殖鱼已经超过野生捕捞的鱼。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
It places increasing emphasis on fishing now 称中国正在加大对捕捞的重视，但fish-farming has been growing at a fast rate. A lot of that is coming from China说明中国的重点恰恰是养殖而非捕捞。
B)
偷换概念
It boasts of the world's largest fishing stocks 声称中国拥有世界最大鱼资源量，而原文 P6 只说中国生产了全球 60% 的养殖鱼，并没有把 fishing stocks（野生鱼资源储量）与中国挂钩。
C)
✓ 正确
some 35 countries, including China, now produce more farmed than wild-caught fish ↔ It raises more fish than caught from the wild
预判指出关于中国的本质判断是「养殖量超过捕捞量」，It raises more fish than caught from the wild 正是这一结构对比；至于 60% 那条数据是关于「全球养殖鱼里中国占比」，不是答案。
D)
偷换概念
It supplies 60% of the world's fish products 把原文限定语 farmed fish 改写成 fish products（鱼制品/水产品总和），范围被悄悄扩大。原文只说中国占全球养殖鱼的六成，并未说占全部水产品的六成。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: Why does the author say aquaculture is so important these days?

options.text: It is a must for feeding the world's fast-growing population.
It proves a reliable source of protein for humans and animals
It is essential to maintaining both mental and physical health.
It ensures a balanced healthy diet for people the world over.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 Why does the author say aquaculture is so important these days? 用 say 限定为作者明说的原因，不需要考生自行推断。
【拆句】题干 Why does the author say aquaculture is so important these days? 主句 Why does the author say 后接宾语从句，从句主干 aquaculture is so important，时间状语these days 表「如今」。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】it's also crucial to ensuring food security and sustainability. By 2050, the world will need to feed an estimated 9.7 billion people.
（这种向水产养殖的转变）对保障食品安全和可持续性也至关重要。到 2050 年，全世界将不得不养活约 97 亿人。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
the world will need to feed an estimated 9.7 billion people ↔ It is a must for feeding the world's fast-growing population
crucial to ensuring food security and sustainability ↔a must
预判核心是「为养活快速增长的人口」，It is a must for feeding the world's fast-growing population 用 a must / feeding / fast-growing population 三处分别对位原文的 crucial / feed / 9.7 billion people——逐一吻合。
B)
以偏概全
It proves a reliable source of protein for humans and animals 称水产养殖为人类与动物都提供蛋白质，但 They'll have to get their protein somewhere 中的 They 是指9.7 billion people，并没有把蛋白质来源扩大到 animals。
C)
无中生有
It is essential to maintaining both mental and physical health 谈维持身心健康，原文 P7 谈的是粮食安全（food security）与可持续性（sustainability），从未涉及mental health 这一维度。
D)
过度推断
It ensures a balanced healthy diet for people the world over 强调「全世界人民的均衡健康饮食」，原文 P7 只说养殖能提供蛋白质来源，并未承诺它能保障均衡饮食。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author imply by saying aquaculture is no silver bullet?

options.text: Shrimp-farming is a risky business.
Fish-farming will not be sustainable.
Fish-farming may cause serious problems too.
Shrimp-farming can become quite expensive.

explanation:
【答案】C （推断题）
【判型】题干 What does the author imply by saying aquaculture is no silver bullet? 出现imply，要求把习语的隐含意翻译成具体含义。
【拆句】题干 What does the author imply by saying aquaculture is no silver bullet? 主干What does the author imply，介词短语 by saying aquaculture is no silver bullet 作方式状语；by + 动名词短语 saying 后接宾语从句，从句是一句完整的判断句。结构看似复杂，实则只需把方式状语整块理解为「通过说这句话」。
【定位】However, aquaculture is no silver bullet. In some southeast Asian countries, shrimp farming does disastrous damage to marine ecosystems.
然而，水产养殖也并非万灵药。在一些东南亚国家，对虾养殖给海洋生态系统造成了灾难性的破坏。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
Shrimp-farming is a risky business 只锁定对虾养殖一项，而题干问的是 aquaculture整体；原文 shrimp farming 只是论据，结论是关于整个 aquaculture 的。
B)
过度推断
Fish-farming will not be sustainable 把原文「不是万灵药」推断为「将不可持续」，跨度过大；Despite these problems, however, shrimp continues to be among the most popular sea foods worldwide 反而暗示养殖仍在继续，并未走向不可持续。
C)
✓ 正确
aquaculture is no silver bullet ↔Fish-farming may cause serious problems too
shrimp farming does disastrous damage to marine ecosystems ↔serious problems
预判内容是「养殖也会带来严重问题」，Fish-farming may cause serious problems too 用 fish-farming 替代 aquaculture、用 may 表示推断的不确定性、用 serious problems 涵盖 disastrous damage——一一对位，且只推一步。
D)
偷换概念
Shrimp-farming can become quite expensive 把养殖的代价定为「变得昂贵」，原文disastrous damage to marine ecosystems 谈的是对生态系统的破坏，是环境代价而不是金钱代价。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the WFP's winning of the Nobel Peace Prize make us realize?

options.text: More and more people in the world are suffering from starvation.
All of us can be affected by food instability one way or another.
It is hazardous to leave millions of people poor and vulnerable.
It is morally wrong to think helping the poor is not our business.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the WFP's winning of the Nobel Peace Prize make us realize? 是用 What提问的具体内容题，问的是文中明示的某句话，不涉及推断或主旨。
【拆句】主干是 What does ... make us realize，the WFP's winning of the Nobel Peace Prize 是动名词短语作主语，winning 由所有格 the WFP's 修饰、of 短语补足对象；理解上等价于"世界粮食计划署获诺贝尔和平奖这件事让我们认识到什么"。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Its Nobel Prize reminds us all of the moral hazard in imagining that the poor and vulnerable are somebody else's problem.
它（世界粮食计划署）获诺贝尔和平奖一事提醒我们所有人：把贫困者与脆弱群体想成是别人的问题，是一种道德上的危险。
【选项】A)
答非所问
More and more people in the world are suffering from starvation. 说的是饥饿人数在增加，这只是 P3 中的一项数据陈述，并非诺贝尔奖让我们意识到的道德层面的道理。
B)
无中生有
All of us can be affected by food instability one way or another. 称所有人都会以某种方式受食物不稳定影响，原文从未做此论断；P2 强调的是不能把扶贫当别人的事，而非"每个人都会饿肚子"。
C)
偷换概念
It is hazardous to leave millions of people poor and vulnerable. 说"让人陷入贫困是危险的"，把"危险"指向贫困者的处境；而原文 the moral hazard in imagining that ... somebody else's problem 中危险指的是"把扶贫想成别人的事"这种道德态度，主语错位。
D)
✓ 正确
the moral hazard in imagining that the poor and vulnerable are somebody else's problem ↔ morally wrong to think helping the poor is not our business
预判要求的两个关键义素"道德层面"与"不该认为帮穷人与己无关"都在 It is morally wrong to think helping the poor is not our business. 里齐备，匹配最严丝合缝。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the WFP's effort to eliminate hunger?

options.text: It has ensured a sufficient food supply to millions.
It is still far from its goal despite the progress made.
It has done a good job in combating natural disasters.
It is preventing starvation occurring on a global scale.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about ... 问的是关于某一具体话题的明示信息，答案应是原文对该话题的直接陈述。
【拆句】WFP's effort to eliminate hunger 是 about 的宾语；effort 后接动词不定式 to eliminate hunger 作后置定语，相当于"为消除饥饿所做的努力"。整句无陷阱。
【定位】Despite decades of effort to eliminate hunger, the latest estimate is that about 11% of people on the planet (about 820 million people) are suffering daily undernourishment. Progress at reducing undernourishment has stopped despite gains through the 1990s and 2000s.
尽管已为消除饥饿付出了数十年的努力，最新估计仍有约 11%（约 8.2 亿人）正在遭受日常营养不良。尽管 20 世纪 90 年代和 21 世纪头十年取得过进展，减少营养不良的进展已经停止。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
It has ensured a sufficient food supply to millions. 称已确保数百万人的充足食物，原文 11% of people ... are suffering daily undernourishment 恰恰相反——8.2 亿人仍营养不良，谈不上已确保充足供给。
B)
✓ 正确
Progress at reducing undernourishment has stopped despite gains through the 1990s and 2000s ↔still far from its goal despite the progress made
预判要求的"取得过进展"与"目标未达"两要素，分别由 despite the progress made 与still far from its goal 一一承接，且语气与原文同样冷静客观，匹配最优。
C)
答非所问
It has done a good job in combating natural disasters. 把话题偏移到自然灾害，P3谈的是消除饥饿、营养不良，未对该机构在自然灾害方面的表现下结论。
D)
过度推断
It is preventing starvation occurring on a global scale. 称正在全球范围内阻止饥饿发生，原文 Progress at reducing undernourishment has stopped 明确说进展已停滞，更未给出该机构在阻止全球饥饿发生。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What will happen when food aid is offered at a price?

options.text: The rich will become richer and the poor poorer.
More people will be willing to join in the effort.
More food will be made available to the needy.
The relief effort will be rendered less sustainable.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What will happen when food aid is offered at a price? 询问的是某条件下的具体后果，文中应有明示的结果句。
【拆句】主干 What will happen，when 引导时间状语从句 when food aid is offered at a price，从句采用被动语态 is offered；at a price 是固定搭配，意为"有代价地、附带条件地"，不是字面"以一个价格"。基础薄弱考生若按字面理解 at a price 易跑偏，需把它当短语整体记住。
【定位】When aid is offered with heavy conditions attached, like loan repayment or food for resources, it often widens the gap between rich and poor and sustains the old world order.
当援助被附加沉重条件（例如要求偿还贷款或以资源换食物）时，它往往会拉大贫富差距并维持旧有的世界秩序。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
widens the gap between rich and poor ↔The rich will become richer and the poor poorer
预判中"贫富差距更大"的核心义素，恰好被 richer ... poorer 比较级并列对偶句精确锁定，且与定位句方向、程度完全一致。
B)
无中生有
More people will be willing to join in the effort. 称会有更多人愿意加入援助行动，原文未做此推断，P4 的结果聚焦在贫富差距与旧秩序，与此选项无关。
C)
与原文相反
More food will be made available to the needy. 称会有更多食物送达需要的人，与P4 强调附条件援助的负面后果（差距拉大、旧秩序延续）方向相反。
D)
偷换概念
The relief effort will be rendered less sustainable. 把后果转到"援助行动可持续性降低"，原文未讨论可持续性，只说附条件援助维持旧秩序、扩大差距，未对援助本身能否持续下结论。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: How can scientists help cope with poverty and hunger?

options.text: By collaborating closely with world economic institutions.
By sharing expertise with peers in poverty-stricken nations.
By setting up more food research programs in developing countries.
By building self-respect in people suffering from undernutrition.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】How can scientists help cope with poverty and hunger? 以 How 询问途径，文中通常以 by 短语或具体动作句给出明示答案。
【拆句】How can scientists help cope with poverty and hunger? 中 help 后接动词原形 cope（省略 to 的动词不定式），相当于"帮助应对"；structure 平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】By sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger, scientists can help reduce these problems.
通过与最易陷入贫困和饥饿的国家的同行分享农业和气候知识，科学家可以帮助减少这些问题。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
By collaborating closely with world economic institutions. 称与世界经济机构紧密合作，P5 提到 world economic institutions 时是否定语气——说该能力不会来自这些机构，并未让科学家与之合作。
B)
✓ 正确
sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger
↔sharing expertise with peers in poverty-stricken nations
预判中三个要素"分享""知识/专业""贫困国家同行"在 By sharing expertise with peers in poverty-stricken nations 中一一对应，结构与原文方式状语完全平行。
C)
无中生有
By setting up more food research programs in developing countries. 称在发展中国家设立更多食品研究项目，原文 P5 仅讲分享知识，未提建立研究项目。
D)
偷换概念
By building self-respect in people suffering from undernutrition. 称在营养不良的人身上建立自尊，原文 self-confident people using open and shared scientific knowledge 谈的是"自信的人借科学知识自救"——是结果导向的论断，并非给科学家的方法；且 self-respect（自尊）与 self-confident（自信）也并不等同。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What message does the author try to convey at the end of the passage?

options.text: Wealthy nations should solve their own food problems first.
Rich countries should be more generous in providing food aid.
Poor nations should enhance their own ability to solve their food shortages.
World economic institutions should play a bigger role in fighting hunger.

explanation:
【答案】C （主旨题）
【判型】What message does the author try to convey at the end of the passage? 询问作者在尾段要传递的核心讯息，需要把末段功能整体串起来，属于局部主旨题。
【拆句】主干 What message does the author try to convey，at the end of the passage 是地点状语限定位置；try to convey 是"试图传达"，比单独 convey 更柔和，提示作者意图层面的解读。结构清晰，无陷阱。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
Wealthy nations should solve their own food problems first. 把 wealthy countries, which may have food problems of their own 这句插入语当作末段主旨；插入语只是解释富国为何帮不上忙，并非作者要传达的核心讯息。
B)
与原文相反
Rich countries should be more generous in providing food aid. 主张富国应更慷慨地提供食物援助，而 P5 明确指出能力不会来自富国贷款，P4 更指出附条件援助会扩大贫富差距，作者对"加大富国援助"持否定态度。
C)
✓ 正确
This ability will be built upon self-confident people using open and shared scientific knowledge to pull themselves out of their misery ↔Poor nations should enhance their own ability to solve their food shortages
will not come from loans from wealthy countries ... or world economic institutions ↔ Poor nations should enhance their own ability
Poor nations should enhance their own ability to solve their food shortages. 既覆盖末段肯定主线（自身能力解决食物短缺），又自然回应否定主线（不靠富国与机构），与末段两层意思全对齐。
D)
与原文相反
World economic institutions should play a bigger role in fighting hunger. 主张世界经济机构发挥更大作用，will not come from ... or world economic institutions 已明确把这些机构排除在能力来源之外。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman suggest the man do about his birthday celebration at the end of

options.text: Hold it on a modest scale to remove birthday anxieties.
View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
Extend invitation to those he trusts most.
Make it an occasion to collect donations.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman suggest the man do about his birthday celebration at the end of
the conversation?
【翻译】在对话结束时,这位女士建议这位男士如何处理他的生日庆祝?
A) 以适度的规模举办以消除生日焦虑。
B) 把它看作人们社交和娱乐的机会。
C) 向他最信任的人发出邀请。
D) 把它作为募集捐款的场合。
【答案】B （细节题）View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
【定位】Exactly. Or even simply see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun.
正是如此。或者干脆把你的生日看作一个把大家聚到一起、让他们开心玩乐的机会。
【信号】结尾处女士的建议句。题干限定 at the end，而这正是对话最后一句女士的话 see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun，see…as an opportunity to 是明显的建议口吻，落在末尾，正是答案信号。
【替换】bring people together for them to have fun ↔ View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
聚人=socialize、机会=chance

anxieties.

and have fun.

【排除】A)
答非所问

【定位】Thomas, now a speaker and author of several books, also created small, independently-run residences with their own bedrooms and bathrooms, and he has been preaching a singular message that getting old is not a bad thing.
如今他既是演讲者又是几本书的作者，他建立了独立运营、带独立卧室和卫生间的小型住所，并一直在传播一个核心讯息：变老并不是一件坏事。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
Good health is not just a privilege of the young 把话题从「对变老的看法」偷换成「健康权」；原文虽提 50\% drop in medical prescriptions，但讨论的是养老院环境改善的效果，并未上升为「健康是不是年轻人专属」的命题。
B)
以偏概全
Nursing homes should be strictly limited in size 借用 the buildings are so big 这一例证，伪装成他的「长期主张」。原文只是用大养老院解释轮椅多，并未上升为「养老院必须严格限制规模」的口号。
C)
✓ 正确
getting old is not a bad thing ↔Getting old is by no means something miserable
think of their age as an enriching new phase of life rather than the end of it ↔ Getting old is by no means something miserable
预判核心是「变老不糟糕」，Getting old is by no means something miserable 在主谓宾与否定逻辑上完全复现这一判断。
D)
以偏概全
Residences for seniors should be run independently 借用 created small, independently-run residences 这一具体做法，伪装成他的中心主张；但 preach a singular message 后的同位语清楚说明他反复在传的核心讯息是 getting old is not a bad thing，而非「独立运营」。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: How is Bill Thomas's new concept received?

options.text: It is gaining ground in many countries.
It is being heatedly debated worldwide.
It is considered revolutionary everywhere.
It is winning approval from the government.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】How is Bill Thomas\'s new concept received? 问「被如何接受」，原文必有一句直陈反响的句子，无须跨段推断。
【拆句】一般现在时被动语态 is received，主语是 new concept，问外界对其评价；how 在句首作方式状语。
【定位】The 56-year-old doctor's methods have been adopted in Australia, Japan, Canada, and America with enormous success.
这位 56 岁的医生的方法已经在澳大利亚、日本、加拿大和美国得到采纳，并大获成功。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
have been adopted in Australia, Japan, Canada, and America ↔ gaining ground in many countries
with enormous success ↔gaining ground
预判强调「被多国接受、正在扩展」，gaining ground in many countries 同时复现「多国」与「势头良好」两个要点。
B)
与原文相反
being heatedly debated worldwide 把「被接受」反扭成「被激烈争论」，原文enormous success 是正向评价，没有任何争议、反对的语义。
C)
以偏概全
considered revolutionary everywhere 既无原文支持的「革命性」评价，又把多国采用扩大为「everywhere」——原文只列了四国，不能等同于「到处」。
D)
无中生有
winning approval from the government 凭空虚构「获得政府批准」，原文只说被采用并成功，未指明任何一个政府机构层面的官方批准。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What can we learn from research on diets in developed countries?

options.text: Dietary recommendations are not fit for underprivileged people.
People from different social groups vary in their dietary habits.
People's choice of food depends on their individual taste
There is no consensus on what high-quality diets are.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What can we learn from research on diets in developed countries 没有 infer/imply 等推断信号，问的是研究的客观结论。
【拆句】题干 What can we learn from research on diets in developed countries 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干是 What can we learn，后接介词短语 from research on diets in developed countries 修饰 learn 的来源；无从句、无否定、无陷阱。
【定位】Research shows that in developed countries, more affluent and educated people tend to consume higher-quality diets—including more fruits and vegetables, fish and whole grains. On the contrary, economically disadvantaged people report diets that are nutrient-poor and energy-dense.
研究表明，在发达国家，更富裕且受过良好教育的人倾向于消费更高质量的饮食——包括更多水果蔬菜、鱼类和全谷物；相反，经济弱势人群所报告的饮食则是营养贫乏而能量密集的。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文只说弱势群体 less likely to have food-purchasing habits that conform to public health recommendations，是"他们不照做"，并非 Dietary recommendations are not fit for underprivileged people 这种"建议本身不适合"。
B)
✓ 正确
more affluent and educated people tend to consume higher-quality diets ... On the contrary, economically disadvantaged people report diets that are nutrient-poor and energy-dense ↔People from different social groups vary in their dietary habits
预判中的"不同社会群体在饮食上存在差异"恰好被 People from different social groups vary in their dietary habits 直接覆盖，匹配度最高。
C)
无中生有
全段讨论的是阶级、收入、教育对饮食的影响，没有任何关于 individual taste 的论述。
D)
无中生有
原文以列举 fruits and vegetables, fish and whole grains 等方式默认了高质量饮食的内涵，没有讨论是否存在 consensus。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say is important in formulating policies to improve diets and health?

options.text: A better understanding of the relationship between social class and health.
A greater emphasis on studying the cause of obesity and chronic diseases.
Prioritizing the provision of better nutrition for lower classes.
Designing education programs and initiatives on public health.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say is important 直接索取作者的明示判断，不是要考生自己推断。
【拆句】题干 What does the author say is important in formulating policies to improve diets and health 是嵌套疑问句，主语 the author，谓语 say，宾语为省略 that 的从句 What ... is important in formulating policies，to improve diets and health 是不定式作目的状语，结构清楚不绕。
【定位】However, the research does not explain why this is the case—a question that has significant implications for designing effective policies and initiatives to improve diets and prevent chronic diseases.
然而，研究并未解释"为何如此"——而这恰是一个对设计有效政策、推动饮食改善与慢病预防具有重大意义的问题。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
the research does not explain why this is the case—a question that has significant implications for designing effective policies ↔A better understanding of the relationship between social class and health
预判的"弄清阶级与健康关系的成因"被 A better understanding of the relationship between social class and health 一句直接对应。
B)
以偏概全
原文谈的是 designing effective policies 的关键，是"理解关系成因"；选项却把焦点收缩到 cause of obesity and chronic diseases，丢掉了"社会阶级"这一关键。
C)
偷换概念
原文强调政策制定需要先理解"为何如此"，并没有主张直接 Prioritizing the provision of better nutrition。
D)
张冠李戴
education programs and initiatives on public health 是第三段才出现的话题nutrition education，且作者后文持质疑态度，并非他认定为政策制定的关键。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does research reveal about adults in food-insecure households?

options.text: Their eating habits need to be changed.
Their food literacy has been improving.
They do not pay much attention to their food recipes.
They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does research reveal about adults in food-insecure households 问的是研究客观结论，正确项是原文一句的同义改写。
【拆句】题干 What does research reveal about adults in food-insecure households 主干research reveal，宾语为 What，about adults in food-insecure households 是宾语补足的范围状语，限定研究对象，结构无陷阱。
【定位】Research suggests that adults in food-insecure households are just as likely as those in food-secure households to adjust recipes to make them more healthy. They are also just as proficient in food preparation and cooking skills. There is no indication that increasing food skills or budgeting skills will reduce food insecurity.
研究表明，食物不安全家庭的成年人，在调整食谱以使其更健康方面，与食物安全家庭的成年人一样可能；他们在食物准备与烹饪技能上也同样熟练；没有迹象表明提升食物技能或预算技能能减少食物不安全。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文整段都在论证"他们的饮食与烹饪并无问题"，Their eating habits need to be changed 反而把矛头指向他们的饮食习惯。
B)
无中生有
原文说他们"已经一样熟练"，并未谈到 has been improving 这种"正在提升"的进程。
C)
与原文相反
原文明确说他们 adjust recipes to make them more healthy，反而是在认真对待食谱；do not pay much attention to their food recipes 与之相反。
D)
✓ 正确
just as proficient in food preparation and cooking skills ↔ They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills
There is no indication that increasing food skills or budgeting skills will reduce food insecurity ↔They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills
预判中的"不缺食物知识与预算技能"与 They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills 是肯定—否定的等值改写。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What would help improve food security among the disadvantaged groups in Canada?

options.text: Teaching them budgeting skills.
Increasing their food choices.
Enabling them to have more access to nutritious foods.
Taking more effective measures to increase food supplies.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What would help improve food security among the disadvantaged groups in Canada 问对应措施，原文应有明确陈述，不必推断。
【拆句】题干 What would help improve food security among the disadvantaged groups in Canada 主干 What would help improve food security，help 后省略 to，among the disadvantaged groups in Canada 是限定 food security 范围的介词短语，三层修饰但平铺直叙。
【定位】For example, low income is the strongest predictor of food insecurity in Canada, where one in eight households experiences insufficient access to nutritious foods.
举例来说，在加拿大，低收入是食物不安全最强的预测因子，那里有八分之一的家庭无法充分获取营养食物。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
第四段已明确 no indication that increasing food skills or budgeting skills will reduce food insecurity，作者直接驳斥 Teaching them budgeting skills 这种做法。
B)
偷换概念
原文谈的是 insufficient access to nutritious foods 即"获取渠道不足"，不是Increasing their food choices 即"扩大可选范围"。
C)
✓ 正确
one in eight households experiences insufficient access to nutritious foods ↔ Enabling them to have more access to nutritious foods
预判中的"让他们更多获取营养食物"与 Enabling them to have more access to nutritious foods 一一对应。
D)
偷换概念
原文聚焦弱势人群的低收入与获取不足，并未主张 increase food supplies 这种宏观供给端的对策。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author suggest disadvantaged people do to improve their health?

options.text: Adopt a positive attitude towards dietary guidelines.
Choose diets that are both healthy and affordable.
Make sure to purchase healthy foods on the internet.
Change their eating habits and consumption patterns.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does the author suggest disadvantaged people do to improve their health 问作者明示的建议，不是要考生跨段推断。
【拆句】题干 What does the author suggest disadvantaged people do to improve their health 是含 suggest 的特殊疑问句，宾语从句省略了 that 与 should，故 do 以原形出现；to improve their health 是不定式目的状语，整体结构清晰。
【定位】We can easily think of a number of foods and recipes that are both inexpensive and nutritious. The internet is full of recipes for "eating well on a budget."
我们可以轻易想到一些既便宜又有营养的食物与食谱；互联网上充满了"在预算内吃得好"的食谱。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文只提到弱势群体 find it difficult to adopt dietary guidelines，并未让他们 Adopt a positive attitude towards dietary guidelines。
B)
✓ 正确
foods and recipes that are both inexpensive and nutritious ↔ Choose diets that are both healthy and affordable
eating well on a budget ↔Choose diets that are both healthy and affordable
预判的"选择既健康又负担得起的饮食"与 Choose diets that are both healthy and affordable 是 both…and… 结构的整体同义改写。
C)
过度推断
原文只是说 The internet is full of recipes for "eating well on a budget."，是举例说明网上有这类食谱，并非建议人们"必须" Make sure to purchase healthy foods on the internet。
D)
与原文相反
作者反复说明弱势群体的饮食问题不出在饮食习惯本身，而在经济与获取层面，Change their eating habits and consumption patterns 把矛头重新指向习惯，与全文立场相悖。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2022-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What is the news report mainly about?

options.text: A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.
An agreement among 13 African countries to set up a free-trade zone.
A plan to invite all African countries to join the African Union.
An important initiative to permit tourists to visit Africa without a visa.

explanation:
【题目】What is the news report mainly about?
【翻译】这则新闻报道主要是关于什么的?
A) 一项允许非洲人在非洲境内免签旅行的拟议政策。
B) 13个非洲国家之间建立自由贸易区的协议。
C) 一项邀请所有非洲国家加入非洲联盟的计划。
D) 一项允许游客免签访问非洲的重要倡议。
【答案】A （主旨题）A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.
【定位】African leaders plan to turn the continent into a continent without borders. They will introduce a single passport policy, allowing free movement between countries.
非洲各国领导人计划把整个非洲大陆变成一个没有边界的大陆。他们将推出统一护照政策，允许各国之间自由通行。
【信号】开头点题即主旨。新闻类听力的导语句几乎就是主旨句。African leaders plan to turn the continent into a continent without borders. 这一句开门见山讲"非洲领导人要让整个非洲免边界（即免签）"，紧接着 They will introduce a single passport policy, allowing free movement between countries. 直接落到具体政策上——"政策+对象"全在这里。
【替换】turn the continent into a continent without borders ↔travel in Africa without a visa
"无边界"="免签通行"
allowing free movement between countries ↔Africans to travel in Africa
free movement=travel
The African Union, which represents 54 states, wants to abolish the requirement of a visa for Africans visiting other African countries. ↔A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.
原文反复点 Africans+visa

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 盗用了录音 Currently, 13 African countries have visa-free deals in place with each other. 里的 13 African countries 这个数字原词，但原文说的是"目前已有 13 国互相免签"，根本不是"13 国设立自贸区"——自贸区在原文里是另一桩"未来要做的事"，不限于 13国。
借用原文：Currently, 13 African countries have visa-free deals in place with each other.
C)
原词陷阱
C 盗用了原文 The African Union, which represents 54 states（非盟代表 54 个国家）中的 African Union 这一专名，制造"听到非盟就想选"的诱惑；但原文谈的是非盟"代表"54 国并推动免签自贸，根本没说要"邀请各国加入非盟"——加入与否不是本新闻的话题。
借用原文：The African Union, which represents 54 states
D)
张冠李戴
D 用 tourists 替换了原文里的 Africans——原文 Americans are able to travel to 20 of the continent's countries without a visa 是在拿"美国人（外来游客的代表）现状"与"非洲人现状"作对照，目的恰恰是说"非洲人反而不如外人方便、所以才要改"。把主体从"非洲人"偷换到"游客"，正好与新闻核心相反。
借用原文：Americans are able to travel to 20 of the continent's countries without a visa
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What benefit will a free trade deal bring to African economy?

options.text: It will attract more investments from all over the world.
It will help many African countries reduce trade deficits.
It will reduce the cost of trade between African countries.
It will allow Africans to play a bigger role in world trade.

explanation:
【题目】What benefit will a free trade deal bring to African economy?
【翻译】自由贸易协议将为非洲经济带来什么好处?
A) 它将吸引来自世界各地的更多投资。
B) 它将帮助许多非洲国家减少贸易逆差。
C) 它将降低非洲国家之间的贸易成本。
D) 它将使非洲人在世界贸易中发挥更大作用。
【答案】C （细节题）It will reduce the cost of trade between African countries.
【定位】It also wants to establish a free trade deal across the continent in the near future, as trade within the African continent costs more than any other region.
（非盟）还希望在不久的将来在整个非洲大陆建立自由贸易协定，因为目前非洲大陆内部的贸易成本比其他任何地区都要高。
【信号】as 引出原因即落点。答案句里出现因果信号词 as trade within the African continent costs more than any other region——as 在这里是"因为"。"自贸要解决的问题=非洲内部贸易最贵"，反过来推就是"自贸的好处=降低非洲内部贸易成本"。这就是听力"信号词后是落点"的典型用法。

【替换】trade within the African continent costs more than any other region ↔ reduce the cost of trade between African countries
因果对调＋反义改写
【排除】A)
未提及
录音通篇没提到 investment / invest 任何形式的词。A 听起来"很正确"是因为它符合考生对"自贸好处"的常识联想，但题目问的是录音里给出的好处，不是考生想到的好处。
B)
偷换概念
B 用 trade deficits（贸易逆差）替换了原文真正说的 trade costs（贸易成本）。"贸易成本"和"贸易逆差"是两个完全不同的经济概念——前者是"做生意要花多少钱"，后者是"进口比出口多多少"。选项利用了 trade 这个原词来诱选。
借用原文：trade within the African continent costs more than any other region
D)
过度推断
D 说的 a bigger role in world trade（在世界贸易中扮演更大角色）把范围从"非洲内部"扩到了"全世界"。原文里 free trade deal 限定的范围是 across the continent（在整个非洲大陆），目标是降低非洲国家之间的贸易成本，并未谈到非洲在世界贸易里的地位变化。
借用原文：establish a free trade deal across the continent
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What new method has been developed to help fight climate change?

options.text: Cooling down volcanic rock with sea water.
Storing carbon dioxide underground as a gas.
Capturing carbon dioxide and burying it under the sea.
Pumping carbon dioxide underground to form stone.

explanation:
【题目】What new method has been developed to help fight climate change?
【翻译】已经开发出什么新方法来帮助对抗气候变化？
A) 用海水冷却火山岩。
B) 以气体形式将二氧化碳储存在地下。
C) 捕获二氧化碳并将其埋在海底。
D) 将二氧化碳泵入地下使其形成石头。
【答案】D （细节题）Pumping carbon dioxide underground to form stone.
【定位】Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon dioxide underground and turning it into stone.
冰岛的研究人员发现了一种应对气候变化的新方法：把二氧化碳泵入地下，将其变成石头。
【信号】首句点题信号 a new way。Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change 中的 found a new way 与题干 new method 形成同义对接，是新闻典型的开门见山首句点题，这一句直接承载新方法是什么的答案。
【替换】pumping carbon dioxide underground ↔Pumping carbon dioxide underground
原词同形复现
turning it into stone ↔to form stone
turn into = form 的动词同义替换
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项把录音里两处出现的 volcanic rock 与 sea water 拼成 cooling down volcanic rock with sea water，但录音从未说过冷却火山岩这件事，cooling 是凭空造的动作。
借用原文：pumped the gas into volcanic rock
B)
张冠李戴
录音原文 Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.明确说把二氧化碳以气体形式储存是其他/已有方法，本则新闻要讲的恰恰是与之对照的新方法；选项 B 把旧方法当成新方法的答案，是典型张冠李戴。
借用原文：Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.
C)
偷换概念
录音说的是 burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone，埋的地方是地下（underground / volcanic rock），但选项 C 写成 burying it under the sea，把地点偷换成海底；只是单词长得像，意思完全偏。
借用原文：burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone

stem: What is a potential difficulty in applying the new technique?

options.text: Lack of burying ground.
Long time for processing.
High consumption of water.
Enormous cost of energy.

explanation:
【题目】What is a potential difficulty in applying the new technique?
【翻译】应用这项新技术的潜在困难是什么？
A) 缺乏掩埋场地。
B) 处理时间长。
C) 水消耗量大。
D) 能源成本巨大。
【答案】C （细节题）High consumption of water.
【定位】One potential difficulty is that for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water.
一个潜在的困难是，每埋藏一吨二氧化碳，这项技术需要 25 吨水。
【信号】题干原词信号 One potential difficulty。One potential difficulty is that 与题干potential difficulty 用词几乎完全一致，是录音替我们点出的答案句信号词；这是新闻收尾段最常见的转折/补充结构，信号词后那一句就是承载答案的句子。
【替换】requires 25 tons of water ↔High consumption of water
数量级 → 程度词，动词 → 名词化
for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water ↔ High consumption of water
1∶25 比例支撑 High 这一判断
【排除】A)
未提及
录音并未提到埋藏地点不够这件事，反而提到 the project in Iceland has been increased in scale to bury 10,000 tons of carbon dioxide each year，说明埋藏规模在扩大，不是缺地的问题；选项 A 属于无中生有。
B)
与原文相反
录音说的是 The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands of years researchers had predicted.，明确强调这项技术比预期快得多，并不是耗时长；选项 B 取了 hundreds of years 这一原词却反了方向。
借用原文：The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands of years researchers had predicted.
D)
原词陷阱
录音里的 Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas. But problems include a high cost and concern about leaks. 中的 high cost 是描述其他/旧方法的问题，且讲的是费用而非 energy；选项 D 把 cost 与 energy 拼到一起，既张冠李戴（说的是旧方法）、又偷换概念（cost ≠ energy）。
借用原文：problems include a high cost and concern about leaks

source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the news report say about French people's bread consumption?

options.text: It varies with the seasons.
It has been on the decline.
It has caused nationwide concern.
It is ninety grams daily on average.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say about French people's bread consumption?
【翻译】新闻报道关于法国人面包消费量说了什么?
A) 它随季节变化。
B) 它一直在下降。
C) 它引起了全国关注。
D) 平均每天九十克。
【答案】B （细节题）It has been on the decline.
【定位】The National Association of French Millers says bread consumption is on the decline, with French people eating nine grams less than in the previous year.
法国全国磨坊主协会表示，面包消费正在下滑，法国人比前一年少吃了 9 克。
【信号】权威主体+趋势动词直陈。The National Association of French Millers says bread consumption is on the decline 一句里，权威主体 says 引出对消费状况的直接断言，is on the decline 是清晰的趋势判定信号，是本题事实陈述题的典型答案句标志。
【替换】bread consumption is on the decline ↔It has been on the decline.
几乎原词直接对应

【排除】A)
未提及
It varies with the seasons. 在录音里找不到任何 season/seasonal/winter/summer 之类的踪迹，属于完全凭空捏造的方向。
C)
录音里说 The association is concerned about the effects this trend will have on their trade，关注者是行业协会、关注对象是他们的生意，选项 nationwide concern 把范围扩大到了'全国关注'，是典型的范围/程度放大。
借用原文：The association is concerned about the effects this trend will have on their trade
D)
原词陷阱
录音里的 90 grams 出现在 women eat 80 to 90 grams，特指女性消费区间的上限，不是全体法国人的日均量；选项 It is ninety grams daily on average. 盗用了原文中的 90 grams 这个原词，却安到了'整体平均'头上，是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：women eat 80 to 90 grams

stem: What do we learn about French women from their port?

options.text: They emphasize food variety.
They prefer French stick loaves.
They do more cooking than men.
They favor diets lower in calories.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about French women from their port?
【翻译】从报告中我们对法国女性了解到什么?
A) 她们强调食物多样性。
B) 她们更喜欢法式长棍面包。
C) 她们比男性做更多的烹饪。
D) 她们偏爱低热量饮食。
【答案】D （细节题）They favor diets lower in calories.
【定位】Firstly, the association cited changing diets, in particular, the switch to those low in calories, as a factor in the reduction of bread consumption. This could explain why the difference in consumption between genders is so big. Nowadays, men eat an approximate average of 140 grams of bread daily, whereas women eat 80 to 90 grams.
首先，协会指出饮食结构的变化、特别是转向低卡饮食，是面包消费下降的一个原因。这或许能解释为什么男女之间的消费差距如此之大。如今男性日均吃约 140 克面包，而女性只吃80 到 90 克。
【信号】因果链 explain why+男女对比。the switch to those low in calories 与 This could explain why the difference in consumption between genders is so big 通过 explain why 把低卡饮食与男女消费差异连成因果链，男性 140g/女性 80–90g 的对比正好印证女性更倾向低卡，这条因果链就是本题的答案信号。

【替换】the switch to those low in calories ↔favor diets lower in calories
the switch to=favor 的同义改写
women eat 80 to 90 grams ↔favor diets lower in calories
对比数据印证偏好
【排除】A)
They emphasize food variety. 在录音里找不到 variety/different kinds 之类的对应表达，属于无中生有。
B)
原词陷阱
录音 People in France are keeping away from the narrow French stick loaf 明确说法国人是'远离'法棍，而 They prefer French stick loaves. 偷换为'偏爱'，方向正好相反，且盗用了 French stick loaves 这一原词制造熟悉感。
借用原文：People in France are keeping away from the narrow French stick loaf
C)
偷换概念
They do more cooking than men. 在录音里完全没有 cook/cooking 的对应词，且男女对比的对象始终是'吃多少面包'而非'谁下厨'，属于编造对比维度。

stem: What is said about lifestyle changes of the French people?

options.text: They bake more bread at home.
They spend less time eating breakfast.
They eat more fruit than they used to.
They put jam instead of butter on bread.

explanation:
【题目】What is said about lifestyle changes of the French people?
【翻译】关于法国人的生活方式变化说了什么?
A) 他们在家烤更多面包。
B) 他们吃早餐的时间更少了。
C) 他们比过去吃更多水果。
D) 他们在面包上涂果酱而不是黄油。
【答案】B （细节题）They spend less time eating breakfast.
【定位】The second reason they say is lifestyle changes in the country, with people dedicating less time to breakfast when bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam.
他们说的第二个原因是这个国家的生活方式发生了变化——人们花在早餐上的时间变少了，而早餐传统上是把面包配上黄油和果酱来吃的。
【信号】明示 lifestyle changes 标题句。The second reason they say is lifestyle changes in the country 直接以 lifestyle changes 标题切入，紧接的 dedicating less time to breakfast 就是这条生活方式变化的具体内容，是本题答案句的明确信号。
【替换】dedicating less time to breakfast ↔They spend less time eating breakfast.
dedicate=spend 的同义替换

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
未提及
They bake more bread at home. 在录音里找不到 bake/at home 的踪迹，是无中生有的方向。
C)
eat more fruit than they used to 用了 used to 这种生活方式变化的常见框架来伪装，但fruit 在录音里完全没出现，属于借框架编内容。
D)
原词陷阱
录音里 bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam 表明的是传统上面包是'同时'配黄油和果酱来吃，并不存在'用果酱取代黄油'。选项 put jam instead of butter on bread 盗用了 butter 和 jam 两个原词，又添加 instead of 制造一个原文没有的替换关系。
借用原文：bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam

stem: When would the man like to leave for London?

options.text: After the rush hour.
Early in the morning.
As soon as possible.
Around lunch time.

explanation:
【题目】When would the man like to leave for London?
【翻译】这位男士想什么时候出发去伦敦?
A) 高峰时段之后。
B) 一大早。
C) 越快越好。
D) 午餐时间前后。
【答案】A （细节题）After the rush hour.
【定位】Well, after the rush hour, I think. We'd like to avoid the crowds if possible. So, probably sometime around 10 o'clock.
嗯，我想是早高峰之后吧。我们希望尽量避开人潮。所以大概十点钟左右。
【信号】被问者的直接应答。前一句售票员问 What time would you like to go?，紧接着男士开口Well, after the rush hour, I think.——这是"问—答"结构里答的那一句，是听力定位答案最稳的信号。

【替换】after the rush hour ↔After the rush hour.
原句原词整体回收
avoid the crowds ↔After the rush hour.
因果同义印证
【排除】B)
未提及
录音里没有任何 early in the morning 的表述；恰恰相反，男士说 after the rush hour，明显是"避开早高峰"——选 B 等于把"早高峰之后"反着理解成"清早"。
C)
与原文相反
As soon as possible. 与男士 after the rush hour avoid the crowds 的意思相反——他要的是错开高峰、不是越早越好。
借用原文：after the rush hour
D)
过度推断
男士说 sometime around 10 o'clock，10 点不是午餐时间；选 D 是把"10 点"误推到lunch time，属于对原词的过度引申。
借用原文：around 10 o'clock

stem: What is the man's other request?

options.text: Two first class seats.
Two seats together.
One window seat.
One seat near the exit.

explanation:
【题目】What is the man's other request?
【翻译】这位男士的另一个要求是什么?
A) 两个头等座位。
B) 两个相邻座位。
C) 一个靠窗座位。
D) 一个靠近出口的座位。
【答案】C （细节题）One window seat.
【定位】Second class is fine. Thanks. Is there any chance we could have a window seat for one of those?
二等座就行，谢谢。其中一张能不能给我们安排一个靠窗的座位？
【信号】请求句 Is there any chance。男士在确认席别后用 Is there any chance we could have a window seat for one of those? 主动提出一个"额外要求"，这种请求句式是答案信号；前半 Second class is fine. 是先答售票员问题，真正的 other request 在 chance 之后。
【替换】a window seat for one of those ↔One window seat.
数量+席位类型逐项对齐

【排除】A)
与原文相反
男士明确说 Second class is fine.——选的是二等座，不是头等座；A 项盗用了对话里讨论过的 first class 话题词，但极性反了。
借用原文：Second class is fine.
B)
张冠李戴
I've booked those seats next to each other for you. 是售票员主动给出的服务，不是男士提出的请求；B 项盗用了 next to each other = together 的语义，但来源不是男士——属于把售票员的话安到男士头上。
借用原文：I've booked those seats next to each other for you.
D)
未提及
One seat near the exit. 里的 exit 在录音中完全没念，属于凭常识或对窗口座位的反义臆造出的干扰项。

stem: Where should the man wait for the train?

options.text: In the middle of the platform.
At the far end of the platform.
Behind the yellow line.
In the waiting room.

explanation:
【题目】Where should the man wait for the train?
【翻译】这位男士应该在哪里等火车?
A) 在站台中间。
B) 在站台最远端。
C) 在黄线后面。
D) 在候车室。
【答案】B （细节题）At the far end of the platform.
【定位】All you need to do is wait at the far end of the platform.
你们要做的就是在站台的最远端等候。
【信号】All you need to do 的指示句。All you need to do is wait at the far end of the platform. 用 All you need to do 这种强调式的祈使指示句，等于给出一条明确指令，是答案信号；后面紧跟 When the train arrives, tell the train guard... 是补充流程，不是该等的地点。
【替换】at the far end of the platform ↔At the far end of the platform.
原句完整搬运

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音只说在 the far end of the platform 等车，没有说 middle；A 项盗用了原文里的platform 一词，把方位偷换成 middle。
借用原文：at the far end of the platform
C)
未提及
录音里完全没提 yellow line；这是日常乘车经验里的安全规则，主体考生容易凭母语常识硬选。
D)
未提及
录音里也没提 waiting room；男士被告知直接到 the far end of the platform 等车，不是去候车室。

stem: What should the man do to collect the bicycles?

options.text: Wait in a queue for his turn.
Go to the baggage claim area.
Pay an extra fee for the service.
Give the ticket to the train guard.

explanation:
【题目】What should the man do to collect the bicycles?
【翻译】这位男士应该做什么来取自行车?
A) 排队等候轮到他。
B) 去行李提取区。
C) 为这项服务支付额外费用。
D) 把车票交给列车员。
【答案】D （细节题）Give the ticket to the train guard.
【定位】When you arrive in London, hand the ticket to the guard and he will return the bicycles to you.
等你们到了伦敦，把票交给乘务员，他会把自行车还给你们。
【信号】When you arrive 的时间状语+祈使。When you arrive in London, hand the ticket to the guard and he will return the bicycles to you. 这一句的 When you arrive in London 正好对应题干 to collect the bicycles 的"到达后"语境；hand the ticket 是祈使动词，他/还给你 是结果——这是地道的答案信号。
【替换】hand the ticket to the guard ↔Give the ticket to the train guard.
同义动词替换
he will return the bicycles to you ↔Give the ticket to the train guard.
因果配套印证

【排除】A)
未提及
录音里没有 wait in a queue 或类似的排队动作；A 项是凭常识"想象车站要排队"硬塞的。
B)
偷换概念
baggage claim area 是机场用语；录音里说的是 he will help you secure the bicycles in the last carriage——在火车最后一节车厢交接，不存在行李提取区。B 项盗用了与"取回"语义相似的航空场景词。
借用原文：he will help you secure the bicycles in the last carriage
C)
与原文相反
售票员明确说 It's no extra cost. The price will be the same.——不会再收额外费用；C项却说要 pay an extra fee，与原文极性正相反。
借用原文：It's no extra cost.

source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about hat factories in Britain?

options.text: Almost all of them were operating at a deficit.
They have all been turned into movie theatres.
Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
They have adapted to meet fashion changes.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about hat factories in Britain?
【翻译】关于英国的帽子工厂，我们了解到什么？
A) 它们几乎全都在亏损经营。
B) 它们全都已被改造成电影院。
C) 它们几乎全都在几十年前就关闭了。
D) 它们已经适应了时尚变化。
【答案】C （细节题）Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
【定位】There used to be many hat factories in Britain until around the 1950s, but fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats. So practically all of those factories had to close down.
英国曾经有很多帽厂，一直延续到 1950 年代左右；但后来潮流变了，大多数人不再戴帽子，所以那些工厂几乎全都倒闭了。
【信号】but + So 的双重连接信号。but fashion changed 的 but 把话题从「曾经繁荣」掰向「后来衰落」，紧接 So practically all of those factories had to close down. 的 So 又把因果一锤定音——「but 转折 + So 结论」这一组连贯信号，正是答案句的标志。
【替换】practically all of those factories had to close down ↔ Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
practically ≈ nearly，1950s = decades ago

【排除】A)
未提及
录音从头到尾没提帽厂亏损的事，Almost all of them were operating at a deficit. 是把「衰落」这个事实换成了「亏损」这个具体的财务原因，原文并未给出。
B)
原词陷阱
They have all been turned into movie theatres. 盗用了 we transformed it into a movie theater 中「改造成电影院」的措辞——但录音明说这件事只发生在「这一家」帽厂（This one, in particular, was closed for 47 years before we transformed it into a movie theater.），把单数案例扩大到全部，是典型张冠李戴。
借用原文：This one, in particular, was closed for 47 years before we transformed it into a movie theater.
D)
与原文相反
录音说 fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats 才导致工厂关门——是被潮流「抛弃」，而非 They have adapted to meet fashion changes. 所说的「成功顺应潮流」，极性正好相反。
借用原文：fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats

source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is special about Cube Movie Theater?

options.text: It shows foreign movies exclusively.
It shows movies from the 1950s.
It is the oldest theatre in London.
It is located next to a hat factory.

explanation:
【题目】What is special about Cube Movie Theater?
【翻译】Cube电影院有什么特别之处？
A) 它专门放映外国电影。
B) 它放映20世纪50年代的电影。
C) 它是伦敦最古老的电影院。
D) 它位于一家帽子工厂旁边。
【答案】A （细节题）It shows foreign movies exclusively.
【定位】We are the only movie theater in the whole country that only shows foreign movies.
我们是全国唯一一家只放外语电影的影院。
【信号】the only + only 双重独家信号。the only movie theater in the whole country 用 the only 给独特性钉了第一颗钉子，that only shows foreign movies 又用 only 把范围进一步缩死——「the only ... only」这种双重限定，是答案句最强的信号。
【替换】only shows foreign movies ↔It shows foreign movies exclusively.
only ↔ exclusively 的同义替换

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
It shows movies from the 1950s. 把第 12 题里出现过的 until around the 1950s 这个时间数字盗过来当影院题材，制造「听到 1950s 就想选」的诱惑——可 1950s 在录音里讲的是「帽厂的年代」，而非影院上映的电影年代，是典型的张冠李戴。
借用原文：until around the 1950s
C)
未提及
It is the oldest theatre in London. 录音里压根没提「最老」，反而说 Cube Movie Theater has been around now for 11 years.——只有 11 年的影院显然算不上 oldest。
借用原文：Cube Movie Theater has been around now for 11 years.
D)
原词陷阱
It is located next to a hat factory. 利用了录音里 It's located in what used to be a hat factory. 的措辞——但原文说的是「影院开在原先的帽厂里」，next to（紧邻）与 in what used to be（开在旧址里）位置关系完全不同，是典型的偷换位置概念。
借用原文：It's located in what used to be a hat factory.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about most people in London?

options.text: They wear hats on social occasions.
They don't speak foreign languages.
They enjoy watching foreign movies.
They don't go to movie theatres often.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about most people in London?
【翻译】关于伦敦的大多数人，这位男士说了什么？
A) 他们在社交场合戴帽子。
B) 他们不会说外语。
C) 他们喜欢看外国电影。
D) 他们不常去电影院。
【答案】B （细节题）They don't speak foreign languages.
【定位】Is there enough demand for that? I would have thought that in London, most people don't speak foreign languages.
这种电影真有那么多人看吗？我本以为伦敦的大多数人是不懂外语的。
【信号】I would have thought + most people don't 的观点信号。I would have thought that ... 是男方亮出自己看法的标志性结构，紧跟其后的 most people don't speak foreign languages 就是他对伦敦多数人的判断——「I thought / I would have thought」之后那句是观点句，必抓。
【替换】most people don't speak foreign languages ↔They don't speak foreign languages.
几乎原句对原句，主语等值替换

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
They wear hats on social occasions. 利用录音里反复出现的 most people stopped wearing hats 这个词组制造熟悉感——但原文是说英国人「不再戴帽」，并非「在社交场合戴帽」，且这句话是关于「英国人对帽子的态度」，不是「伦敦人对外语的态度」，话题与说话人都对不上。
借用原文：most people stopped wearing hats
C)
与原文相反
They enjoy watching foreign movies. 的极性正好和男方观点相反——男方明说 most people don't speak foreign languages，正是在质疑「demand 够不够」，而非肯定他们爱看外语片；而后女方才反驳说外语片仍有市场，但那是女方的话，不是男方的。
借用原文：most people don't speak foreign languages
D)
未提及
They don't go to movie theatres often. 是关于伦敦人「去影院频率」的描述，录音里从未提及伦敦人「常不常去影院」，属于无中生有。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say about foreign movies shown in London?

options.text: They are meant mostly for immigrants.
They attract large crowds of young Londoners.
They are hard for English people to appreciate.
They have an English translation on the screen.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about foreign movies shown in London?
【翻译】关于在伦敦放映的外国电影，这位女士说了什么？
A) 它们主要是为移民准备的。
B) 它们吸引大批年轻的伦敦人。
C) 它们对英国人来说很难欣赏。
D) 它们在屏幕上有英文翻译。
【答案】D （细节题）They have an English translation on the screen.
【定位】Furthermore, I might add, all movies come with English text at the bottom of the screen. So even if you don't understand what the actors say, you can still read it.
另外我得补一句，所有的电影都在屏幕下方配有英文文字，所以哪怕听不懂演员说什么，你也能读字幕。
【信号】Furthermore + I might add 的补充强调信号。女方一连用 Furthermore 和 I might add两个补充强调标志把这条信息推到台前，紧跟其后给出「屏幕下方有英文」这一具体事实——「Furthermore + I might add」组合是答主特别想让人记住的那一句的信号灯。
【替换】all movies come with English text at the bottom of the screen ↔ They have an English translation on the screen.
English text ↔ English translation；at the bottom of the screen ↔ on the screen
even if you don't understand what the actors say, you can still read it ↔ They have an English translation on the screen.
补充句佐证字幕功能

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
未提及
They are meant mostly for immigrants. 把外语片的受众限定为「移民」，录音里完全没出现 immigrants 这个话题，是凭常识脑补出来的无中生有。
B)
原词陷阱
They attract large crowds of young Londoners. 利用了录音中 lots of people interested in watching such movies 与 London 的搭配——但原文只说「有很多人感兴趣」，并未限定为「年轻伦敦人」；选项把宽泛的 lots of people 偷换成具体的 young Londoners，加了原文没有的修饰语 young。
借用原文：lots of people interested in watching such movies
C)
与原文相反
They are hard for English people to appreciate. 的极性和女方观点相反——女方一直在反驳「外语片在伦敦没人看」的怀疑，强调 there's enough demand 和 lots of people interested，没有任何「难以欣赏」的意思。
借用原文：there's enough demand
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第19页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher?

options.text: She doesn't think smartphones can replace tablets.
She incorporates smartphones into her teaching.
She cannot stop children using smartphones.
She regards smartphones as a distraction.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher?
【翻译】关于中学数学教师Astrid Natley，我们了解到什么？
A) 她认为智能手机无法替代平板电脑。
B) 她将智能手机融入她的教学中。
C) 她无法阻止孩子们使用智能手机。
D) 她认为智能手机会分散注意力。
【答案】B （细节题）She incorporates smartphones into her teaching.
【定位】Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher, incorporates phones into her classroom.
Astrid Natley是一位中学数学老师，她把手机融入到了自己的课堂里。
【信号】人物登场首句即定调。原文Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher, incorporates phones into her classroom.是该人物在文中首次出现的那句话，篇章独白介绍人物时通常"姓名+身份+核心做法"一句话点题，这种"登场首句"就是关于该人物事实的答案信号。
【替换】incorporates phones into her classroom ↔incorporates smartphones into her teaching
phones=smartphones、classroom≈teaching

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音里她说My school doesn't have money for tablets，意思是"学校没钱买平板，所以才用手机"，盗用了原文的tablets一词，做成"她不认为手机能替代平板"这种相反观点，属于原词陷阱+与原文相反。
借用原文：My school doesn't have money for tablets
C)
偷换概念
录音If we stop children using phones, we're rejecting something they care about.是"如果我们阻止孩子用手机，等于拒绝他们在乎的东西"——是"不愿阻止"的价值判断；选项She cannot stop children using smartphones.盗用stop children using phones原词，却换成"无法阻止"，偷换了情态。
借用原文：If we stop children using phones, we're rejecting something they care about.
D)
与原文相反
原文她把手机视为a powerful tool in their hands，是正面评价；选项She regards smartphones as a distraction.却说她把手机视为"干扰"，立场与原文相反。
借用原文：a powerful tool in their hands
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why does Helen Lockhart, a registered nurse, support a complete ban on smartphone use in the classroom?

options.text: To enforce school discipline.
To make students concentrate.
To help children grow up to be professionals.
To cultivate children's good study habits.

explanation:
【题目】Why does Helen Lockhart, a registered nurse, support a complete ban on smartphone use in the classroom?
【翻译】注册护士Helen Lockhart为什么支持在课堂上完全禁止使用智能手机？
A) 为了执行学校纪律。
B) 为了让学生集中注意力。
C) 为了帮助孩子们成长为专业人士。
D) 为了培养孩子们良好的学习习惯。
【答案】C （细节题）To help children grow up to be professionals.
【定位】We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become.
我们需要教孩子们像他们将来要努力成为的那些专业人士一样去行事。
【信号】段尾"need to"目的陈述。原文We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become.位于Helen段落末尾，以We need to开头的句子是她整段论证的结论与目的——"need to"是表目的的强信号词，是答案信号。
【替换】teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become ↔ To help children grow up to be professionals
behave like professionals=grow up to be professionals

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音I will be subject to disciplinary procedure是她讲自己工作场所的纪律后果，作为引出"教孩子像专业人士"目的的铺垫；选项To enforce school discipline.盗用disciplinary原词，扭成"她支持禁手机的目的是维护校纪"，张冠李戴。
借用原文：I will be subject to disciplinary procedure
B)
未提及
录音里Helen段没有任何关于concentration/focus/attention的表述，选项To make students concentrate.是听上去合理但原文未提及的干扰项。
D)
未提及
录音里Helen段没有提到study habits或类似的"养成学习习惯"，选项To cultivate children's good study habits.是另一个"听上去禁手机的合理理由"，属于未提及陷阱。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What should students do in the classroom according to Richard Stone, an English teacher?

options.text: Use books and pens only.
Cut down their screen time.
Make full use of electronic devices.
Learn to use the internet for research.

explanation:
【题目】What should students do in the classroom according to Richard Stone, an English teacher?
【翻译】根据英语教师Richard Stone的说法，学生在课堂上应该做什么？
A) 只使用书本和笔。
B) 减少他们的屏幕使用时间。
C) 充分利用电子设备。
D) 学习使用互联网进行研究。
【答案】A （细节题）Use books and pens only.
【定位】so let's leave phones and laptops at home, and show them a different world in their lessons— one of books and pens
所以让我们把手机和笔记本电脑都留在家里，在课堂上向他们展示一个不一样的世界——一个由书本和钢笔构成的世界。
【信号】let's+破折号定义结论句。原文so let's leave phones and laptops at home, and show them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens以"so let's…"建议式结构开头，又用破折号引出对"a different world"的同位语解释"one of books and pens"——这是典型的"结论+具象化"信号，是答案句。
【替换】leave phones and laptops at home ↔Use books and pens only
把手机和电脑留家=不用电子设备
show them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens ↔Use books and pens only
books and pens的世界=只用书本和钢笔

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音Children are getting more than enough screen time in their lives without the need to bring their phone into the classroom.提到screen time，是Richard用以解释"为什么不该带手机进课堂"的背景论据，并非他对学生课堂行为的主张；选项Cut down their screen time.盗用screen time原词来制造听到就想选的诱惑。
借用原文：Children are getting more than enough screen time in their lives without the need to bring their phone into the classroom.
C)
与原文相反
Richard明确主张let's leave phones and laptops at home，是反对在课堂用电子设备；选项Make full use of electronic devices.反过来说"充分利用电子设备"，立场反向。
借用原文：let's leave phones and laptops at home
D)
与原文相反
录音The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool里，Richard明明在批评"互联网作为研究工具太简单、太不可靠"；选项Learn to use the internet for research.盗用internet、research原词，反过来说"学会用网做研究"，立场翻转。
借用原文：The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: How did Kate earn the reward from her mother?

options.text: By cleaning the kitchen floor.
By looking after her baby brother.
By helping her mother do the dishes.
By helping her brother wash windows.

explanation:
【题目】How did Kate earn the reward from her mother?
【翻译】Kate 是如何从她母亲那里获得奖励的?
A) 通过清洁厨房地板。
B) 通过照顾她的小弟弟。
C) 通过帮助她母亲洗碗。
D) 通过帮助她弟弟擦窗户。
【答案】D （细节题）By helping her brother wash windows.
【定位】Kate, a six-year-old girl, helped her brother wash windows to get a reward promised by her mother, a purple doll that she wanted.
凯特，一个六岁的小女孩，帮哥哥擦窗户，为的是拿到妈妈答应的奖励——一只她想要的紫色娃娃。
【信号】to get a reward 的目的状语。helped her brother wash windows to get a reward promised by her mother 这句里 to get a reward 是目的状语，前面的动作（helped her brother wash windows）就是为了拿奖励而做的事，正是题目问的 how earn the reward。
【替换】helped her brother wash windows ↔helping her brother wash windows
几乎原词复现，仅时态变形
【排除】A)
未提及
By cleaning the kitchen floor. 是常见家务但录音里完全没提，属于未提及型干扰，专骗那些把做家务挣奖励脑补成打扫卫生的考生。
B)
原词陷阱
By looking after her baby brother. 盗用了录音里的 brother 一词制造熟感，但录音里说的是 helped her brother wash windows，是凯特帮哥哥，而不是照看弟弟。
借用原文：helped her brother wash windows
C)
原词陷阱
By helping her mother do the dishes. 蹭了录音里 helped 与为妈妈做事的氛围，但录音里凯特帮的是 brother、做的是 wash windows，不是帮 mother do the dishes。
借用原文：promised by her mother
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did Kate do after her mother left the room?

options.text: She ordered a large number of dolls.
She checked if a purple doll was ordered.
She mistakenly canceled her mom's order.
She ordered a more expensive doll instead.

explanation:
【题目】What did Kate do after her mother left the room?
【翻译】Kate 的母亲离开房间后她做了什么?
A) 她订购了大量娃娃。
B) 她查看是否订购了紫色娃娃。
C) 她错误地取消了她妈妈的订单。
D) 她订购了一个更贵的娃娃。
【答案】A （细节题）She ordered a large number of dolls.
【定位】15 minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed the order and ran off to play.
15 分钟和几次点击之后，购物车里装着价值 350 多美元的娃娃，凯特下了单，跑去玩了。
【信号】总结性结尾句加数量爆炸。15 minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed the order 这句是这一段动作的收束句，350 美元、placed the order 几个反常细节直接交代了凯特在妈妈走后做了什么——她下了一大堆娃娃的订单。这种数量或价格爆表的细节，几乎一定是答案信号。
【替换】more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart ↔She ordered a large number of dolls.
数量上的同义改写
Kate placed the order ↔She ordered a large number of dolls.
动词短语到单动词的等值替换
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
She checked if a purple doll was ordered. 盗用了录音里 purple doll 和 check the shipping status 制造她检查了紫娃娃订单的幻觉，但录音里 check 的是 shipping status（物流），而且那是动作的起点不是后果，她做了什么的真正答案是后面的下单。
借用原文：Kate asked if she could check the shipping status
C)
张冠李戴
She mistakenly canceled her mom's order. 录音里恰恰是 cancel 这个词出现了，但执行者是妈妈第二天才取消的两单，不是凯特；凯特做的事是反方向的加单。
借用原文：She was able to cancel two of them
D)
偷换概念
She ordered a more expensive doll instead. 录音里凯特的问题不是换了一只更贵的，而是在原本一只之外又加了一大堆，重点是数量爆炸而不是单只价格升级，是过度推断式的偏移。
借用原文：more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第26页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did Kate's family do after the packages arrived?

options.text: They asked the children's hospital to pick them.
They took all of them to the children's hospital.
They opened all of them one by one.
They discussed where to keep them.

explanation:
【题目】What did Kate's family do after the packages arrived?
【翻译】包裹到达后 Kate 一家做了什么?
A) 他们请儿童医院来取这些包裹。
B) 他们把所有包裹带到了儿童医院。
C) 他们逐一打开了所有包裹。
D) 他们讨论了把这些包裹放在哪里。
【答案】B （细节题）They took all of them to the children's hospital.
【定位】Instead of sending back the dolls, her father suggested giving them to the local children's hospital. So the next week, Kate's family loaded up their car and took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital.
她父亲提议不要把娃娃寄回去，而是捐给当地的儿童医院。于是第二周，凯特一家装了一车，把所有娃娃送到了儿童医院的活动室。
【信号】结果句 So 加 took all the dolls。So the next week, Kate's family loaded up their car and took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital. 中的 So 是因果结果信号，把前面父亲提议的话变成实际行动，直接给出全家把所有娃娃送去了医院这个确定答案。
【替换】took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital ↔ They took all of them to the children's hospital.
几乎原句直译
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
They asked the children's hospital to pick them. 蹭了录音里的 children's hospital 制造熟感，但录音里是家里人把娃娃送去，不是请医院来挑，动作方向完全相反。
借用原文：took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital
C)
张冠李戴
They opened all of them one by one. 盗用了录音里 opened up all the boxes 这个动作，但执行人是凯特和医院里的小女孩患者们，不是凯特一家，而且发生地点也在医院里、不是包裹一到家就打开。
借用原文：they opened up all the boxes together
D)
未提及
discussed where to keep them. 这个动作完全没出现，录音直奔父亲提议捐医院，没经过商量放哪儿。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第27页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: According to recent research conducted in Australia, what has a lasting impact on one's life?

options.text: The time one starts school.
The classroom atmosphere.
The school that one attends.
The relationship with classmates.

explanation:
【题目】According to recent research conducted in Australia, what has a lasting impact on one's life?
【翻译】根据最近在澳大利亚进行的研究,什么对一个人的一生有持久影响?

B) 课堂氛围。
C) 一个人就读的学校。
D) 与同学的关系。
【答案】A （细节题）The time one starts school.

【定位】The researchers found that the time when a person starts school has an enduring impact on their lives.
研究者发现，一个人开始上学的时间会对其一生产生持久的影响。
【信号】researchers found 这一研究结论信号。篇章独白里 The researchers found that 是典型的结论提示词——后面紧跟的句子就是研究的核心发现，几乎必然是答案句。再加上 has an enduring impact on their lives 与题干 lasting impact on one's life 完全对应，可以确认就是这一句。
【替换】the time when a person starts school ↔The time one starts school.
句式压缩同义替换
has an enduring impact on their lives ↔a lasting impact on one's life
形容词同义替换
【排除】B)
未提及
录音从头到尾没有出现 atmosphere、classroom environment 这类表达，The classroom atmosphere. 属于教育话题里常用的凑数干扰，没有任何原文支撑。
C)
原词陷阱
The school that one attends. 借了录音里反复出现的 school 一词来制造熟悉感，但录音说的是 the time when a person starts school——重点在 time 不在 school 本身，把入学时间偷换成了上的什么学校，是典型的原词陷阱。
借用原文：the time when a person starts school
D)
原词陷阱
The relationship with classmates. 提到的 classmates 虽然在录音里以 compared to their classmates 出现过一次，但录音只是用 classmates 来做参照对象，没有讨论同学关系本身对人生的影响，属于借词不传义。

explanation:
【题目】What was the purpose of the Australian research?
【翻译】澳大利亚这项研究的目的是什么?

【答案】B （目的题）To find causes for differences in the participants' performance.

但澳大利亚的研究者们想要弄清楚究竟是什么在驱动这些差异。

【信号】but + wanted to discover 这一双重信号。But the Australian researchers wanted to discover what was driving these differences. 既有转折信号 but，又有目的结构 wanted to discover，两个信号叠加，几乎可以确认这就是研究目的的官方表述句。

偷换概念
To help parents decide when to send their children to school. 借了 starts school 的话题词，把研究目的偷换成给家长的择校建议，但录音从未提及 parents 或 advice，是典型的应用层偷换。

原词陷阱
To identify students having potential to be professional athletes. 借了录音里professional athletes 一词来制造听到就想选的诱惑，但录音里 athletes 只是顺带列举的成功人士之一，不是研究目的。

To offer constructive suggestions for making educational policies. 把研究目的拔高到教育政策层面，录音里完全没有出现 policy、policymaker 或 suggestion 等表达，属于无中生有。

【题目】According to the researchers, what is one characteristic of successful people?

【信号】while 让步 + it's also 转折强调。While risk-taking can be considered a negative attribute, it's also a characteristic of successful people 用 while 引导让步、随后 it's also 强调真正想说的一面——这种让步+强调结构里的强调句几乎必然是答案。

risk-taking ↔Risk-taking.

Leadership ability. 利用了录音末尾 political leaders 一词制造领导力联想，但录音说成功人士包括政界领袖，并没有把 leadership ability 列为他们的共性特征。

B)
未提及

D)

Self-confidence. 借了录音里多次出现的 self-confidence 与 feel confident，但录音只把self-confidence 作为研究的假设变量，最终结论强调的特征是 risk-taking，不是 self-confidence。

stem: What do we learn from the passage about the brightest people?

options.text: They can make silly mistakes in straightforward situations.
They usually turn a blind eye to their own weaknesses.
They are admired by people around them.
They can differ in their personalities.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do we learn from the passage about the brightest people? 是开放式问 "关于聪明人我们知道了什么"，没有 infer/imply 之类的推断信号，也不问主旨或态度——属于覆盖全篇的细节判断题。
【拆句】What do we learn from the passage about the brightest people? 主干是 what do we learn，about the brightest people 是后置介词短语修饰 learn 的内容范围；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】The brightest people and strongest leaders sometimes make errors others don't, especially in situations that require common sense.
最聪明的人和最强的领导者有时会犯别人不会犯的错，尤其是在那些需要常识的场合。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
make errors others don't, especially in situations that require common sense ↔ make silly mistakes in straightforward situations
They can make silly mistakes in straightforward situations. 把预判的 "在常识场景中犯错" 完整复现，且与定位句逐成分对应，是定位句的同义替换。
B)
无中生有
文章只说聪明人有 blind spots in how they use logic，并没有说他们对 "自己的弱点视而不见"——turn a blind eye to their own weaknesses 是凭文字面感受瞎想出来的关联。
C)
无中生有
文章只提到 intelligent people earn more money, accumulate more wealth, and even live longer，没说他们被人 "敬仰"——admired by people around them 属原文未提的事实陈述。
D)
答非所问
末段确实提到 Smart people develop overachieving personalities，但全文聚焦的是聪明人的共性问题，并未论述他们 "个性各异"——differ in their personalities 与文章问的 "我们了解到什么" 不在一个频道。

stem: What accounts for the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots?

options.text: Their irrational way of thinking.
Too much faith in their ability to think.
Their ignorance of behavioural science.
Too much concern about their work

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What accounts for the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots? 指向一个具体概念（逻辑盲点）的成因，是回到具体段落找因果句的细节题。
【拆句】What accounts for the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots? 主干what accounts for X，X 是 the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots（名词化结构，相当于问 "为什么聪明人会存在逻辑盲点"），把名词化拆回动词理解即可。
【定位】Intelligent people are more prone to silly mistakes because of blind spots in how they use logic. These blind spots exist because smart people tend to be overconfident in their reasoning abilities.
聪明人更容易犯傻错，是因为他们运用逻辑时存在盲点。这些盲点之所以存在，是因为聪明人倾向于对自己的推理能力过度自信。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文说聪明人 Rational thinking and intelligence don't tend to go hand in hand ——意思是聪明人未必理性，但这并不等于他们 "思维不理性" 就是盲点的成因；真正的成因是过度自信。irrational way of thinking 把伴生现象当成因，属于因果倒置。
B)
✓ 正确
overconfident in their reasoning abilities ↔Too much faith in their ability to think
Too much faith in their ability to think. 把原文 "对推理能力过度自信" 的核心搬过来，且 faith / ability to think 两个成分都能在定位句里逐一着落。
C)
无中生有
ignorance of behavioural science 把 "行为科学" 这种学科概念引进来——但文章自始至终没有提行为科学，是凭空捏造的成因。
D)
无中生有
文章没有说聪明人 "过度关心工作"——Too much concern about their work 是凭日常对 "聪明人=工作狂" 的刻板印象瞎编出来的。

【拆句】How do smart people react when they are found to be wrong? 主句 How do smart people react，when 引导时间状语从句限定情境；从句用被动语态 are found to be wrong（被发现错了），主体仍是 smart people。
