B)
与原文相反
原文恰恰说 It's hard for anyone to graciously accept the fact that they're wrong. It's even harder for smart people——聪明人尤其难以坦然接受。graciously accept the facts 直接照搬原文短语却把否定关系反过来，是典型反向陷阱。
C)
偷换概念
feel shocked 把 "被冒犯/受攻击感" 偷换成 "震惊"——shocked 强调对事实意外，offended 强调对自尊受损的反应，两种情绪不同。
D)
✓ 正确
being wrong can feel like a personal attack ↔They may get offended.
They may get offended. 把比喻 a personal attack 翻译成 get offended，是情绪反应的同义动词化，且 may 与原文 can 在语气上一致。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What may happen to smart people who find it difficult to accept suggestions?

options.text: They may suffer in their professional and private life.
They may lose faith in their administrative abilities.
They may commit more errors than ever before.
They may experience a lot of emotional stress.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What may happen to smart people who find it difficult to accept suggestions?问 "对接受不了建议的聪明人会发生什么"，是对特定情境后果的细节求证。
【拆句】What may happen to smart people who find it difficult to accept suggestions? 主干是 what may happen to smart people；who find it difficult to accept suggestions 是修饰 smart people 的定语从句，限定了 "哪一类聪明人"。
【定位】Not only does this tendency hinder their growth and performance, it can lead to harmful relationships, both personally and professionally.
这种倾向不仅会阻碍他们的成长与表现，还可能导致有害的人际关系——无论是私人层面还是职业层面。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
harmful relationships, both personally and professionally ↔ suffer in their professional and private life
suffer in their professional and private life 既覆盖了原文 "professionally" 又覆盖了"personally"——两个并列限定都能落地，是定位句的完整同义改写。
B)
偷换概念
原文说 hinder their growth and performance，是 "阻碍成长与表现"，并未说他们"对自己的管理能力失去信心"——lose faith in their administrative abilities 把 "成长与表现受阻" 偷换成 "对管理能力失去信心"。
C)
无中生有
原文没有把 "接受不了反馈" 与 "犯更多错" 直接挂钩——commit more errors than ever before 是把第一段的 errors 概念硬拉到第五段后果中。
D)
无中生有
experience a lot of emotional stress 把后果限定为 "情绪压力"——但原文说的是 "成长与表现受阻 + 关系有害"，从未提及情绪压力。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What is said about those working with or under overachieving people?

options.text: They put a lot of effort into their work.
They set higher goals for themselves.
They are under increasing pressure.
They take less time to get things done.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What is said about those working with or under overachieving people? 问 "关于和聪明人共事的人，文章说了什么"，是末段定位的细节题。
【拆句】What is said about those working with or under overachieving people? 主干 What is said about X；X 是 those working with or under overachieving people，其中working with or under overachieving people 是分词短语后置修饰 those，表示 "那些与过分追求成就的人共事或在其手下做事的人"。注意 with or under 是并列介词，对象都是overachieving people。
【定位】They set the bar too high, and when people take too long or don't get things quite right, they assume it's due to a lack of effort. So they push even harder.
他们把标杆定得太高，当别人花的时间过长或事情做得不够准确时，他们就认定这是因为对方努力不够，于是施压得更狠。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文说聪明人 assume it's due to a lack of effort——是聪明人 "以为" 别人不努力，并不是别人真的努力。put a lot of effort into their work 把聪明人的 "以为" 当成事实，恰好与原文意涵相反。
B)
张冠李戴
set higher goals for themselves 这一行为在原文里属于聪明人——They set the bar too high，主语是聪明人；选项却把它安在 "和聪明人共事的人" 头上，是把行为主体张冠李戴。
C)
✓ 正确
they push people too hard ↔They are under increasing pressure.
So they push even harder. ↔increasing pressure
They are under increasing pressure. 既覆盖 push people 的施压主轴（变成 under pressure），又覆盖 push even harder 的加码动态（变成 increasing），两个成分都能在原文找到落点。
D)
与原文相反
原文说聪明人 when people take too long——意思是这些人花的时间 "过长"，而take less time to get things done 把 "过长" 反成 "更短"，方向相反。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: Why is the U.S. State Department launching an online learning program for refugees?

options.text: To enable them to settle down in host countries.
To allow them to learn as many job skills as possible.
To offer them a platform to pursue advanced degrees.
To help them to meet new employment standards.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】Why is the U.S. State Department launching an online learning program for refugees?问的是一个具体的发起原因，答案应能在原文中明确找到对应句。
【拆句】Why is the U.S. State Department launching an online learning program for refugees?是一个 Why 引导的现在进行时疑问句，主语是机构名，介词短语for refugees点明服务对象，结构平铺、无陷阱。
【定位】Refugees who settle in other countries often find themselves unable to continue on their previous career path due to a new set of employer standards or skills requirements. To solve this problem, the U.S. State Department is posing a solution: online learning.
在他国安顿的难民常常发现，自己因雇主新一套的标准或技能要求而无法延续原来的职业路径。为解决这个问题，美国国务院正在推出一个方案：在线学习。
【选项】A)
偷换概念：把前提说成目的
To enable them to settle down in host countries.把项目目的说成帮助难民「在东道国安顿下来」，但原文中settle in other countries是难民已经发生的状态、是项目的前提，不是项目的目的。
B)
过度推断：拔高程度词
To allow them to learn as many job skills as possible.把目的扩成「学尽可能多的工作技能」，而原文目的是「应对一套新的雇主标准」，原文并没有用「尽可能多」这类极端量词。
C)
偷换概念：证书↔学位
To offer them a platform to pursue advanced degrees.把目的说成「追求高等学位」，但原文第二段说的是obtain professional certificates，是专业证书而非学位。
D)
✓ 正确
a new set of employer standards or skills requirements ↔new employment standards
To solve this problem, the U.S. State Department is posing a solution ↔To help them to meet
预判答案是「帮助难民应对他国雇主的新标准」，与To help them to meet new employment standards.在主语、动作、对象、目的状语上四点全部对应，是唯一与定位句构成同义替换的选项。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we know about "Coursera for Refugees"?

options.text: It provides refugees with a wide range of courses free of charge.
It offers free online data services for refugees around the world.
It allows refugees to obtain degrees in various academic fields.
It supplies refugees with a great variety of job opportunities.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What do we know about "Coursera for Refugees"?要求选出关于该项目可以确认的事实，属于客观信息核对。
【拆句】What do we know about "Coursera for Refugees"?结构非常简单，主句是What do we know，介词宾语就是引号里的专名，无干扰修饰。
【定位】They can apply for fully funded access to Coursera's course catalog, which means they can take all of the platform's classes and obtain professional certificates for free. The platform currently offers professor-led lectures on a broad range of topics, from data science to fashion design.
他们可以申请由项目全额资助的Coursera课程目录访问权限，这意味着他们可以免费修读该平台的所有课程并获得专业证书。该平台目前提供由教授主讲的讲座，主题广泛，从数据科学到时装设计。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
a broad range of topics ↔a wide range of courses
for free ↔free of charge
预判要求「免费+各种各样的课」，It provides refugees with a wide range of courses free of charge.在主语、动作、对象、范围、付费方式上五点齐备，是定位句最干净的同义复述。
B)
偷换概念：把举例项当成核心
It offers free online data services for refugees around the world.把项目说成「提供免费在线数据服务」，但原文from data science to fashion design中的 data science只是众多课程主题之一，不是项目所提供的服务内容。
C)
偷换概念：证书↔学位再现
It allows refugees to obtain degrees in various academic fields.说项目能让难民拿到「各学术领域的学位」，但原文是professional certificates——专业证书而非学位，也没有强调「学术领域」。
D)
无中生有：用近义类比制造跳跃
It supplies refugees with a great variety of job opportunities.把项目说成提供「多种多样的工作机会」，但原文从头到尾说的是「课程」与「证书」，不是「工作」。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say is a consequence of the global migrant crisis?

options.text: Instability increases in host countries.
The global economic crisis intensifies.
A lot more refugees die during migration.
Refugees find it more difficult to get a job.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the passage say is a consequence of the global migrant crisis?直接问「文章说……的后果是什么」，答案应能在原文明确找到。
【拆句】What does the passage say is a consequence of the global migrant crisis?是「What+助动词+主语+谓语+从句宾语」的疑问句，从句is a consequence of...提示答案的逻辑位置是后果一端，结构平铺。
【定位】As the world migrant crisis intensifies, employment is becoming a global concern.
随着全球移民危机加剧，就业正成为全球性的关切。
【选项】A)
过度推断：从一点滑向全局
Instability increases in host countries.说东道国整体不稳定上升，但原文只说就业一项成为全球关切，并未提社会稳定层面。
B)
张冠李戴：动词从一个主语挪到另一个主语
The global economic crisis intensifies.说全球经济危机加剧，但原文只说就业问题，不是「经济危机」；intensifies 在原文里是用来形容 migrant crisis 的，不是economic crisis。
C)
无中生有：用常识联想替代文本
A lot more refugees die during migration.说更多难民死于迁徙途中，但原文从头到尾没有涉及死亡话题，属典型无中生有。
D)
✓ 正确
employment is becoming a global concern ↔Refugees find it more difficult to get a job
a global concern ↔more difficult
预判结论是「就业难度上升」，本篇主体始终是难民，Refugees find it more difficult to get a job.既保留了主体，又把抽象的「关切」落地到「找工作变难」，是唯一与定位句因果直接对应的选项。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say causes refugees' difficulty in taking online courses?

options.text: Cultural environment.
Changed academic requirements.
Lack of language skills.
Difference in teaching platforms.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say causes refugees' difficulty in taking online courses?问的是「作者说」的具体原因，回原文找归因句即可。
【拆句】What does the author say causes refugees' difficulty in taking online courses?主干是What causes ... difficulty，does the author say是插入语，in taking online courses做后置定语限定 difficulty，结构稍绕但无陷阱。
【定位】For another, most of the classes on Coursera are in English, and though there are plans to add translations, language barriers can be a big obstacle.
另一方面，Coursera上的大多数课程都是英文授课，尽管有添加翻译的计划，语言障碍仍可能是一个大问题。
【选项】A)
无中生有：用相关话题替换原文话题
Cultural environment.把困难归因到「文化环境」，但原文第四段从未涉及文化差异，是无中生有。
B)
张冠李戴：把另一困难的原因装到本题
Changed academic requirements.想说的是「学术要求改变」，但原文can't simply rely on an online lecture to get them up-to-date on standards, policies, and practices说的是行业「标准、政策、做法」的更新，而非学术要求；且这是第一条困难，不是题54问的「上网课的困难原因」，而是「换行业的困难」。
C)
✓ 正确
language barriers can be a big obstacle ↔Lack of language skills
most of the classes on Coursera are in English ↔Lack of language skills
预判明确指向「语言」，四个选项中只有Lack of language skills.提及语言；与定位句构成最干净的因果对应。
D)
偷换概念：把对一物的质疑换成多物之差异
Difference in teaching platforms.说困难是「教学平台之间的差异」，但原文there are the questions over the value of massive open online courses (MOOCs) themselves谈的是对MOOCs整体价值的质疑，不是不同平台之间的差异。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What did the joint study find about the MOOCs several years ago?

options.text: They helped solve learners' financial problems.
They benefited most of the learners.
They changed some learners' career path.
They provided the most needed vocational skills.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What did the joint study find about the MOOCs several years ago?问一个具体研究的具体发现，是直白的事实核对。
【拆句】What did the joint study find about the MOOCs several years ago?是过去时一般疑问句，主语the joint study，宾语为 what，时间状语several years ago提示要找过去时句子，结构平铺。
【定位】In 2015, a joint study found 72% of people taking the MOOCs saw career benefits afterwards.
2015年，一项联合研究发现，参加MOOCs课程的人中有72%在之后获得了职业上的益处。
【选项】A)
偷换概念：用常识把「职业」换成「财务」
They helped solve learners' financial problems.说MOOCs帮学习者解决「财务问题」，但原文只说career benefits——职业益处，不是钱。
B)
✓ 正确
72% of people taking the MOOCs ↔most of the learners
saw career benefits afterwards ↔benefited
预判结论是「大多数学习者获益」，They benefited most of the learners.在主语、动词、对象上三点对应——只是用程度词代替数字、用动词代替名词短语，是最干净的同义改写。
C)
过度推断：把益处程度拔高到根本改变
They changed some learners' career path.说MOOCs「改变了某些学习者的职业路径」，但原文只说saw career benefits——获得职业益处，从「获益」到「改变路径」是过度推断。
D)
过度推断+无中生有：加最高级、加具体内容
They provided the most needed vocational skills.说MOOCs提供「最需要的职业技能」，但原文只笼统说「职业益处」，并未说提供了什么具体技能，更没有「最需要」这种最高级。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2023-03/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the report about the 55-year-old woman?

options.text: She was involved in a conflict with bird lovers.
She was charged with mistreating animals.
She was on bad terms with her neighbors.
She was accused of violating a city law.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the report about the 55-year-old woman?
【翻译】从报道中我们了解到关于这位55岁女性的什么信息?
A) 她卷入了与爱鸟人士的冲突。
B) 她被指控虐待动物。
C) 她与邻居关系不睦。
D) 她被指控违反了一项城市法律。
【答案】D （细节题）She was accused of violating a city law.
【定位】A woman was charged with allegedly violating a Rhode Island city law against feeding wild animals.
一名女子被指控涉嫌违反罗德岛市一项禁止投喂野生动物的市级法规。
【信号】导语句即答案句。A woman was charged with allegedly violating a Rhode Island city law against feeding wild animals. 是整则新闻的第一句导语，集中给出了「主体（女子）+ 动作（被指控）+ 内容（违反市法规）」，新闻体裁里「开篇就点核心」是最强的答案信号。
【替换】was charged with allegedly violating a Rhode Island city law ↔ was accused of violating a city law
charge≈accuse 同义替换

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
She was involved in a conflict with bird lovers. 利用录音多次提到的 birds / feeding birds 制造「她与爱鸟者起冲突」的假象，但录音通篇只说她「以为自己在喂鸟」，从未出现她和任何 bird lovers 群体的冲突，是典型的「听到 bird 就想选」。
借用原文：she's being charged for feeding birds
B)
偷换概念
She was charged with mistreating animals. 沿用了录音里 was charged with 的句式结构和 animals 这个词，但把违法内容从「违反禁止投喂的市法规」偷换成「虐待动物」——录音从未提及任何虐待行为，反而她声称是「出于爱」在喂。
借用原文：was charged with allegedly violating a Rhode Island city law against feeding wild animals
C)
过度推断
She was on bad terms with her neighbors. 利用录音 The 55-year-old woman's neighbors blame her 里出现的 neighbors blame 来诱选；但 blame 是针对此次鼠患的具体指责，新闻并未交代他们一贯关系不和，把「具体事件上的指责」升级成「长期关系恶劣」属于过度推断。
借用原文：The 55-year-old woman's neighbors blame her
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the director of the city administration say at the end of the news report?

options.text: It will take time to solve the rat problem.
All wild animals should be well protected.
The woman was not to blame for the situation.
No one should go unpunished for violating law.

explanation:
【题目】What did the director of the city administration say at the end of the news report?
【翻译】新闻报道最后市政管理部门主任说了什么?
A) 解决鼠患问题需要时间。
B) 所有野生动物都应该得到良好保护。
C) 这位女性对这种情况不应受到责备。
D) 任何人违法都不应逍遥法外。
【答案】A （细节题）It will take time to solve the rat problem.
【定位】Anthony Moretti, director of the city administration, said he saw more than 20 rats near the woman's home. He said it will take months to get the problem under control.
市政管理负责人安东尼·莫雷蒂说，他在这位女士家附近看到了 20 多只老鼠。他说要把问题控制住还需要几个月时间。
【信号】末段官员引语。He said it will take months to get the problem under control. 出现在新闻最后一段、由 director of the city administration 的引语收束，是题干「at the end」+「director said」两条线索的直接落点。
【替换】it will take months to get the problem under control ↔It will take time to solve the rat problem.
months≈time, under control≈solve

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
All wild animals should be well protected. 借用了录音里多次出现的 wild animals 做诱饵，但官员从未谈论「应保护所有野生动物」这种价值口号，他只是描述老鼠数量和耗时，All wild animals 属于绝对化范围扩大。
借用原文：It is prohibited to feed any wild animals including birds in Rhode Island City.
C)
与原文相反
The woman was not to blame for the situation. 与录音传递的态度相反——录音Nevertheless, while the woman's intention was to feed birds, it is clear that rats were also benefiting. 明确指出「尽管她本意是喂鸟，但老鼠也因此得利」，是把责任与她挂钩，而非为她开脱。
借用原文：Nevertheless, while the woman's intention was to feed birds, it is clear that rats were also benefiting.
D)
张冠李戴
No one should go unpunished for violating law. 看似呼应录音里 It is prohibited to feed any wild animals 的法律口吻，但这是新闻叙述者的背景交代，并非「director of the city administration」在末尾说的话，且 No one should go unpunished 这种绝对化执法口号录音中并未出现。
借用原文：It is prohibited to feed any wild animals including birds in Rhode Island City.

stem: What does NASA require the paid volunteers to do?

options.text: Communicate with astronauts in Mars Dune Alpha.
Work in an environment resembling Mars.
Build a Martian habitat in Houston.
Send in applications before Friday.

explanation:
【题目】What does NASA require the paid volunteers to do?
【翻译】NASA要求有偿志愿者做什么?
A) 与Mars Dune Alpha中的宇航员交流。
B) 在类似火星的环境中工作。
C) 在休斯顿建造火星栖息地。
D) 在周五之前提交申请。
【答案】B （细节题）Work in an environment resembling Mars.
【定位】The paid volunteers will work in an environment similar to Mars.
这些带薪志愿者将会在一个与火星类似的环境中工作。
【信号】题干主语原词复现。题干主体是 the paid volunteers，录音第 2 段开头 The paid volunteers will work in an environment similar to Mars. 一字不差地把这个主语再说一遍，且紧跟着就给出动作 will work in an environment similar to Mars——这是新闻题最典型的答案信号：题干里的主语在录音里原词出现的那一句，往往就是答案句。
【替换】will work in an environment similar to Mars ↔Work in an environment resembling Mars
similar to 替换 resembling

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项里出现了录音原词 Mars Dune Alpha，但录音从头到尾没说志愿者要去和宇航员通讯，只在第 2 段提了 They will have limited communications with family——是和家人有限通讯，不是和宇航员通讯。把 Mars Dune Alpha 这个专名扣到一个原文没说的动作上骗你听到原词就选。
借用原文：Mars Dune Alpha
C)
录音说 a 1,700-square-foot Martian habitat inside a building in Houston，确实有Martian habitat 和 Houston 两个原词，但志愿者是住进去而不是建。选项 Build a Martian habitat in Houston 把 habitat 和 Houston 拼到 Build 这个动词上，是把建造者的事安到志愿者头上，典型张冠李戴。
借用原文：a 1,700-square-foot Martian habitat inside a building in Houston
D)
录音第 1 段念了 NASA began taking applications Friday，第 5 段也说 The application process opens Friday——Friday 这个词真的反复出现，但说的是 NASA 周五开始收申请，而不是 NASA 要求志愿者周五前递申请。Friday 是被盗用来骗 听到就想选 的原词。
借用原文：NASA began taking applications Friday

stem: What will the participants in the project eat?

options.text: Ready-made food.
Food that is organic.
Food they grow.
Potatoes mostly.

explanation:
【题目】What will the participants in the project eat?
【翻译】该项目的参与者将吃什么?
A) 现成的食物。
B) 有机食物。
C) 他们种植的食物。
D) 主要是土豆。
【答案】A （细节题）Ready-made food.
【定位】Food will all be ready-to-eat space food. Some plants will be grown, but not potatoes like in the movie The Martian.
食物将全部是即食的太空食品。有一些植物会被种植，但不是像电影《火星救援》里那样的土豆。
【信号】Food 起首+all 强调。录音第 3 段那一句 Food will all be ready-to-eat space food. 以题干关键词 Food 起首，且用 all 这种范围最大、最绝对的修饰词强调全部都是即食太空食品——主语+all+表语结构在听力里几乎等同于这就是答案，要立刻锁。紧接着 but not potatoes 又用 but 否定了土豆，进一步把答案聚焦在即食食物上。

【替换】ready-to-eat space food ↔Ready-made food
ready-to-eat=ready-made
Food will all be ↔Ready-made food
all 等于唯一
【排除】B)
未提及
录音从头到尾没有出现 organic 这个词，也没说食物是天然有机的；选项 Food that is organic. 是凭电影或常识对火星实验食物的想象，属于录音没说就硬塞的未提及干扰。
C)
录音确实念了 Some plants will be grown，grown 这个原词被选项 Food they grow. 直接盗用；但原文用 Some 限定只是一些，且强调 Food will all be ready-to-eat——食物全部是即食的，植物种植只是次要补充，不是吃的来源。听到 grown 就想选 C 是这道题最大的诱惑。
借用原文：Some plants will be grown
D)
录音里 but not potatoes like in the movie The Martian 明确用 but not 否定了土豆，选项 Potatoes mostly. 却把它当作主食呈现，与原文方向完全相反。potatoes 这个原词被盗来诱惑那些被电影《火星救援》带偏的考生。
借用原文：but not potatoes like in the movie The Martian
1 A Japanese mayor apologized Thursday for biting the Olympic gold medal of a softball player. Nagoya mayor Takashi Kawamura had praised an athlete, Miu Goto, during a public media event. He asked her to put the medal around his neck. Kawamura then bit into it.
日本一位市长周四为咬了一名垒球运动员的奥运金牌道歉。名古屋市长河村隆之在一次公开媒体活动中表扬了运动员后藤希友。他请她把奖牌挂在他的脖子上。随后河村咬了那枚奖牌。
2 Biting a medal in front of journalists and photographers has become a common pose for Olympic medalists. However, it is only for the winners themselves, not others.
在记者和摄影师面前咬奖牌已成为奥运奖牌获得者的常见姿势。然而,这只适用于获奖者本人,而非其他人。
3 "I'm really sorry that I hurt the treasure of the gold medalist," Kawamura told reporters Thursday.
河村周四告诉记者:"我真的很抱歉伤害了金牌得主的珍宝。"
4 The mayor said the medal was undamaged, though he offered to pay for the cost of a new one.
市长表示奖牌没有损坏,不过他提出愿意支付一枚新奖牌的费用。
5 Goto, however, has accepted the International Olympic Committee's offer of a replacement, according to Japanese media reports.
然而,据日本媒体报道,后藤已接受国际奥委会提供的替换奖牌。

stem: What do the news reports say about the Japanese mayor Takashi Kawamura?

options.text: He apologized for scratching an athlete's gold medal.
He was asked to present a gold medal to Miu Goto.
He bit a softball player's Olympic gold medal.
He attracted public attention at a media event.

explanation:
【题目】What do the news reports say about the Japanese mayor Takashi Kawamura?
【翻译】新闻报道中关于日本市长河村隆志说了什么?
A) 他为刮花一名运动员的金牌而道歉。
B) 他被要求向后藤希友颁发一枚金牌。
C) 他咬了一名垒球运动员的奥运金牌。
D) 他在一场媒体活动中引起了公众关注。
【答案】C （细节题）He bit a softball player's Olympic gold medal.
【定位】A Japanese mayor apologized Thursday for biting the Olympic gold medal of a softball player.
一位日本市长在周四为咬了一名垒球运动员的奥运金牌一事道歉。
【信号】新闻首句即考点。新闻类录音的第一句往往就是核心事件概述，本题答案直接落在 A Japanese mayor apologized Thursday for biting the Olympic gold medal of a softball player. 这句新闻开篇句上，biting the Olympic gold medal of a softball player与 C 选项几乎逐词对应。
【替换】biting the Olympic gold medal of a softball player ↔bit a softball player's Olympic gold medal
动名词换过去式

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
A 项说他为 scratching（刮花）金牌道歉，但录音原文 apologized Thursday for biting道歉的对象是 bit（咬），不是 scratch。scratch 一词反而出现在第 7 段 I would not scratch it，是另一位运动员说的话，属于张冠李戴。
借用原文：I handle my own gold medal so gently that I would not scratch it
B)
与原文相反
B 项说市长被要求把金牌颁给 Miu Goto，但录音 He asked her to put the medal around his neck. 恰恰相反——是市长请运动员把奖牌挂在他自己脖子上，方向颠倒。
借用原文：He asked her to put the medal around his neck.
D)
原词陷阱
D 项说他在 media event 上吸引了公众关注。录音 during a public media event 确实出现 media event，但'吸引公众关注'是事件附带的结果，不是新闻报道的核心事件，与题干What do the news reports say about… 的核心不符。
借用原文：Nagoya mayor Takashi Kawamura had praised an athlete, Miu Goto, during a public media event.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did mayor Takashi Kawamura offer to do?

options.text: Have another picture taken with the Olympic medalist.
Apologize to the International Olympic Committee.
Get the damaged medal repaired.
Pay for the cost of a new medal.

explanation:
【题目】What did mayor Takashi Kawamura offer to do?
【翻译】市长河村隆志提出要做什么?
A) 与这名奥运奖牌获得者再拍一张照片。
B) 向国际奥林匹克委员会道歉。
C) 把损坏的奖牌修好。
D) 支付一枚新奖牌的费用。
【答案】D （细节题）Pay for the cost of a new medal.
【定位】The mayor said the medal was undamaged, though he offered to pay for the cost of a new one.
市长表示金牌并未受损，不过他主动提出愿意承担一枚新奖牌的费用。
【信号】题干原词直接命中。录音里 he offered to pay for the cost of a new one 直接出现题干的核心动词 offered，紧接其后的 to pay for the cost of a new one 就是承诺动作。同时though（转折）也是答案信号，提示前半句的 undamaged 是次要、后半句才是落点。
【替换】offered to pay for the cost of a new one ↔Pay for the cost of a new medal.
代词还原为名词

【排除】A)
未提及
A 项说再拍一张照。录音里确实出现 photographers（第 2 段），但市长并没有提出'再拍一张'，A 是无中生有。
B)
原词陷阱
B 项说他要向 International Olympic Committee 道歉。录音 Goto, however, has accepted the International Olympic Committee's offer of a replacement 里确实出现International Olympic Committee，但那是奥委会向运动员提供替换奖牌，与市长的道歉对象无关。市长道歉对象是 reporters（Kawamura told reporters Thursday）。
借用原文：Goto, however, has accepted the International Olympic Committee's offer of a replacement
C)
与原文相反
C 项预设奖牌已 damaged 需要修，但录音 the medal was undamaged 明确说市长称奖牌并未受损，故无需修复。前缀 un- 一字之差，方向完全相反。
借用原文：the medal was undamaged
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did some Olympians say they would do with their medals?

options.text: Allow no one to touch them.
See them as symbols of honor.
Treat them as treasures.
Keep them in a safe place.

explanation:
【题目】What did some Olympians say they would do with their medals?
【翻译】一些奥运选手说他们会如何处理自己的奖牌?
A) 不允许任何人触碰它们。
B) 把它们视为荣誉的象征。
C) 把它们当作珍宝对待。
D) 把它们保存在安全的地方。
【答案】C （细节题）Treat them as treasures.
【定位】Some Olympians said they treat their medals as treasures and that it was disrespectful and unacceptable for Kawamura to bite one.
一些奥运选手表示，他们把自己的奖牌视若珍宝，川村咬奖牌的行为是不尊重的、不可接受的。
【信号】题干引述结构对位。录音 Some Olympians said they treat their medals as treasures 几乎与题干 Some Olympians say they would do with their medals 一一对应，Some Olympians said 这个引述信号直接把答案句标了出来，紧随其后的 treat their medals as treasures 即处理方式。
【替换】they treat their medals as treasures ↔Treat them as treasures.
近乎原词复现

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
未提及
A 项说不让任何人碰。录音里没有任何一句话说'不允许任何人触碰'，运动员只是说视若珍宝、会轻拿轻放（I handle my own gold medal so gently），并没有提到 touch 这件事。
B)
过度推断
B 项把奖牌看作 symbols of honor（荣誉象征）。录音里运动员说的是 treat as treasures（视若珍宝）和 handle gently（轻拿轻放），并没有上升到'荣誉象征'这种抽象概念，属于过度推断。
D)
未提及
D 项说放在 safe place（安全的地方）。录音通篇没有提到把奖牌放在哪里这一存放地点信息，运动员的表述只关乎'如何对待'与'如何轻拿轻放'，不涉及存放位置。

stem: What did the woman do to her computer?

options.text: She covered its screen with a plastic sheet.
She connected it with her smartphone.
She decorated it with colorful stickers.
She bought some new software for it.

explanation:
【题目】What did the woman do to her computer?
【翻译】这位女士对她的电脑做了什么?
A) 她用塑料薄膜覆盖了屏幕。
B) 她把电脑和智能手机连接起来了。
C) 她用彩色贴纸装饰了电脑。
D) 她为电脑购买了一些新软件。
【答案】A （细节题）She covered its screen with a plastic sheet.
【定位】It's a plastic sheet that blocks blue light.
这是一张能阻挡蓝光的塑料薄膜。
【信号】被问者对 What's that 的直接应答。男士开口就问 What's that orange thing on your computer screen?，女士紧接着在 It's a plastic sheet that blocks blue light. 里给出直接回答。"问句紧跟答句"是对话题最强的答案信号——被问者的下一句就是命题点。
【替换】plastic sheet that blocks blue light ↔plastic sheet
选项原词复现自原文
I have one that I use to cover my phone screen too ↔covered its screen with a plastic sheet
use to cover 改写为 covered with

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 选项把 She connected it with her smartphone."把电脑连到手机"塞进来——但原文只是说 I have one that I use to cover my phone screen too，提到 phone 仅仅是说"我手机屏幕上也贴了一张"，根本没有"把电脑连到手机"的动作。
借用原文：I have one that I use to cover my phone screen too
C)
偷换概念
C 把女士的动作改成了 She decorated it with colorful stickers."用彩色贴纸装饰"，原文It's a plastic sheet that blocks blue light. 说的是"阻挡蓝光的塑料膜"，目的在于功能、不是装饰，颜色（橙）只是膜本身颜色而不是"贴纸"。
借用原文：It's a plastic sheet that blocks blue light.
D)
原词陷阱
D 把她买的东西说成 She bought some new software for it."新软件"，可原文清楚说 It's something I bought yesterday. It's a plastic sheet——买的是"塑料膜"这一实物，不是软件。
借用原文：It's something I bought yesterday.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say about blue light?

options.text: It may not be simply blue.
It includes unnatural light.
It is more harmful to young people.
It induces people to fall asleep.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about blue light?
【翻译】这位女士关于蓝光说了什么?
A) 它可能不仅仅是蓝色的。
B) 它包含非自然光。
C) 它对年轻人的危害更大。
D) 它促使人们入睡。
【答案】B （细节题）It includes unnatural light.
【定位】Blue light includes natural light, but it also includes light that isn't natural, for example, from computers, phones, televisions and other electronic devices.
蓝光既包含自然光，也包含非自然光，比如来自电脑、手机、电视和其他电子设备的光。
【信号】but … also includes 的修正信号。女士先给一个"轻"的说法 Blue light includes natural light，紧跟着 but it also includes light that isn't natural 用 but 修正——听力中 but 之后才是命题点。这个"先轻后重"的修正结构是判定答案句的关键信号。
【替换】light that isn't natural ↔unnatural light
isn't natural=unnatural
Blue light includes natural light, but it also includes light that isn't natural ↔ It includes unnatural light
也包含=includes

【排除】A)
偷换概念
It may not be simply blue."它可能不只是蓝色"说的是"颜色不只蓝"，可录音从未谈过蓝光"颜色"的复杂性，谈的是"光源"是否自然。两者讨论的层面不同。
借用原文：It isn't that simple.
C)
张冠李戴
录音中提到 Poor sleep might be a problem for older people, but surely young people can handle late nights. 是"男士"的看法，谈的是"年轻人 vs 老人扛夜"，并不是女士对"蓝光对年轻人更有害"的表态；女士全程没说蓝光对年轻人特别更糟。
借用原文：Poor sleep might be a problem for older people, but surely young people can handle late nights.
D)
与原文相反
It induces people to fall asleep. 说蓝光"让人入睡"，可女士明确表态 making it harder for us to fall asleep——蓝光过多反而让人更难入睡，方向完全相反。
借用原文：making it harder for us to fall asleep
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why does the man say he hasn't slept enough for months?

options.text: He has had much trouble falling asleep.
He has had some sort of health problems.
He has stayed up playing computer games.
He has been burdened with excessive work.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the man say he hasn't slept enough for months?
【翻译】这位男士为什么说他几个月来睡眠不足?
A) 他入睡一直很困难。
B) 他有某种健康问题。
C) 他熬夜玩电脑游戏。
D) 他承受着过重的工作负担。
【答案】D （细节题）He has been burdened with excessive work.
【定位】I haven't slept enough in months because I have too much work to do, and I feel fine.
我已经好几个月没睡够了，因为要做的工作太多，可我感觉挺好的。
【信号】because 的因果信号。男士在 I haven't slept enough in months because I have too much work to do 里用 because 直接给出原因——"工作太多"。because 是 Why 题最经典的答案信号，听到就直接锁。
【替换】too much work to do ↔been burdened with excessive work
too much=excessive
I have too much work to do ↔He has been burdened with excessive work
have work to do=be burdened with work

【排除】A)
偷换概念
He has had much trouble falling asleep. 是"努力睡却睡不着"，可男士说的是 I haven't slept enough in months because I have too much work to do——他不是睡不着，而是没时间睡。 trouble falling asleep（失眠）和 not having time to sleep（没时间睡）是两回事。
借用原文：making it harder for us to fall asleep
B)
偷换概念
He has had some sort of health problems. 暗示"有健康问题所以没睡够"，可原文里男士反而说 I feel fine——他根本没承认自己有健康问题；况且原文谈"健康问题"是作为"长期缺睡可能导致的后果"出现，不是男士没睡够的原因。
借用原文：not having enough sleep can contribute to serious health problems
C)
原词陷阱
He has stayed up playing computer games. 借 computer 这个录音里反复出现的原词制造"听见 computer 就想选"的诱惑。但原文里 computer 都用于 I'm on my computer very late most nights 等场合——他熬夜是在"用电脑工作"，根本没说在"玩游戏"。
借用原文：I'm on my computer very late most nights
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第14页

stem: What has the woman learned from the research she has read?

options.text: Exposure to blue light is the chief cause of obesity.
Sleep may be more important than people assumed.
Sleep may also be negatively affected by natural light.
Overuse of electronic devices may cause heart disease.

explanation:
【题目】What has the woman learned from the research she has read?
【翻译】这位女士从她读过的研究中了解到了什么?
A) 接触蓝光是肥胖的主要原因。
B) 睡眠可能比人们认为的更重要。
C) 睡眠也可能受到自然光的负面影响。
D) 过度使用电子设备可能导致心脏病。
【答案】B （细节题）Sleep may be more important than people assumed.
【定位】Well, the research I've read shows that sleep is probably even more important than we thought, and that not having enough sleep can contribute to serious health problems like obesity and heart disease.
嗯，我读到的研究表明，睡眠很可能比我们以为的还要重要，而睡眠不足可能导致肥胖和心脏病等严重的健康问题。
【信号】the research shows that 的结论句框。女士开口就用 the research I've read shows that这一典型结论句框启动答案句，紧跟着的 sleep is probably even more important than we thought 就是研究的核心结论。这是听力里最稳的命题信号之一。

【替换】even more important than we thought ↔more important than people assumed
we thought=people assumed
sleep is probably even more important ↔Sleep may be more important
probably=may
【排除】A)
过度推断
原文 not having enough sleep can contribute to serious health problems like obesity and heart disease 只说"缺睡可能导致肥胖等问题"，主语是"缺睡"，且用 contribute to 这种有限度的因果措辞；A 把锅甩到 Exposure to blue light 头上，并升级为 the chief cause of obesity 这种独占性主因——既偷换了主语，又夸大了因果强度。
借用原文：not having enough sleep can contribute to serious health problems like obesity and heart disease
C)
与原文相反
原文反复说 artificial blue light from electronic devices 干扰睡眠，矛头是"非自然 / 人造"蓝光；C Sleep may also be negatively affected by natural light. 偏偏把矛头扭到natural light，与原文方向完全相反。
借用原文：all the artificial blue light from electronic devices means we have to try harder to sleep well
D)
偷换概念
原文把 heart disease 仅作为 serious health problems like obesity and heart disease的举例之一，主语是"缺睡"；D Overuse of electronic devices may cause heart disease.把主语换成"过度使用电子设备"、把举例"心脏病"提到结论位置，既偷换主语又拉直因果链。
借用原文：not having enough sleep can contribute to serious health problems like obesity and heart disease

stem: What question were both speakers fed up with when they were kids?

options.text: What they wanted to be when grown up.
What their favorite cartoon character was.
What they learned from computer games.
What they liked to do most after school.

explanation:
【题目】What question were both speakers fed up with when they were kids?
【翻译】当两位说话者还是孩子的时候,他们厌烦了什么问题?
A) 长大后想成为什么样的人。
B) 他们最喜欢的卡通角色是什么。
C) 他们从电脑游戏中学到了什么。
D) 他们放学后最喜欢做什么。
【答案】A （细节题）What they wanted to be when grown up.
【定位】And I got sick every time adults asked me what I wanted to be when I grew up.
每次大人问我长大后想做什么，我都会觉得烦透了。

【信号】被问者的直接应答信号 got sick。女问 did you know what job you wanted to do when you grew up? 后，男方在第二段用 I got sick every time adults asked me what I wanted to be when I grew up. 直接回应，got sick 就是『厌烦』这一情绪的最强信号；紧接着第三段女方又说 It's the same with me. 表示自己也一样，双方共同厌烦的那个问题就此锁定。
【替换】what I wanted to be when I grew up ↔What they wanted to be when grown up.
人称与时态同义改写
【排除】B)
整段对话从未出现 cartoon 或具体的卡通形象名称，What their favorite cartoon character was. 属于无中生有。
C)
原词陷阱
录音第七段 spending 10 hours a day playing computer games 真的念了 computer games，但语境是女方说『家长希望孩子放学别只打游戏』，与『被问烦了的童年问题』完全无关；选项 What they learned from computer games. 借用了 computer games 这个原词来骗『听到就想选』。
借用原文：spending 10 hours a day playing computer games
D)
偷换概念
对话谈的是『长大后想做什么』，没有出现 after school 这种放学时段的具体话题，What they liked to do most after school. 属于偷换概念，把『长大目标』换成了『日常活动』。

stem: What occupation do adults see as both sensible and ambitious according to the woman?

options.text: A stock broker.
A pop singer.
A mechanical engineer.
A basketball player.

explanation:
【题目】What occupation do adults see as both sensible and ambitious according to the woman?
【翻译】根据这位女士的说法,成年人认为哪种职业既明智又有抱负?
A) 股票经纪人。
B) 流行歌手。
C) 机械工程师。
D) 篮球运动员。
【答案】C （细节题）A mechanical engineer.
【定位】My daughter's stock answers are basketball player, pop singer, mechanical engineer. Adults love that last one, as it's the perfect mix of the sensible and the ambitious.
我女儿的口头答案就是篮球运动员、流行歌手、机械工程师。大人们最喜欢最后那一个，因为它把『靠谱』和『有抱负』完美地结合在一起。
【信号】指代锁定 + 因果信号 as。原文用 that last one 指代列举里排在最后的 mechanical engineer，紧接着 as 引出原因 the perfect mix of the sensible and the ambitious，直接对应题干 both sensible and ambitious 两个条件，是典型的『指代+因果』双重信号锁定。

【替换】that last one ↔A mechanical engineer.
顺位指代还原
the perfect mix of the sensible and the ambitious ↔A mechanical engineer.
属性匹配题干修饰
【排除】A)
整段录音从未出现 stock broker 这个职业，A stock broker. 属无中生有，可能是利用『一听就显得 ambitious』的常识脑补干扰。
B)
录音里确实念到 pop singer，但它只是被列举的三个选项之一，并不是大人 love 的那一项；A pop singer. 借原词诱选，盗用了 pop singer 这个词。
借用原文：pop singer
D)
basketball player 也是被女方提到的列举项之一，但同样不是大人最喜欢那一项，A basketball player. 也是利用原词诱选。
借用原文：basketball player

stem: What kind of goal-setting does the woman like to see in children?

options.text: Ambitious.
Sensible.
Imaginative.
Practical.

explanation:
【题目】What kind of goal-setting does the woman like to see in children?
【翻译】这位女士希望在孩子身上看到什么样的目标设定?
A) 有抱负的。
B) 明智的。
C) 富有想象力的。
D) 切合实际的。
【答案】C （细节题）Imaginative.
【定位】When she was much younger, my daughter used to say she wanted to be Queen of the Clouds, which I loved. That's the kind of goal-setting I like to see in children, springing from their boundless imaginations.
在我女儿小得多的时候，她常说她想当『云之女王』，我当时特别喜欢。那才是我喜欢看到孩子们立的那种目标，是从他们无边的想象力里长出来的。
【信号】原话直引 the kind of goal-setting I like 与原因 springing from imaginations。原文女方直接说 That's the kind of goal-setting I like to see in children，几乎和题干一字不差；后半句 springing from their boundless imaginations 给出立目标的核心属性来自『无边想象力』，是定位的关键信号。
【替换】springing from their boundless imaginations ↔Imaginative.
名词到形容词的同源替换
Queen of the Clouds ↔Imaginative.
具体例子到抽象形容词的概括

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音里出现 the perfect mix of the sensible and the ambitious，ambitious 确被念到，但语境是『大人对 mechanical engineer 的评价』，不是女方喜欢的立目标类型，Ambitious. 借原词诱选。
借用原文：the ambitious
B)
原词陷阱
the sensible 同样出现在大人评价 mechanical engineer 那句里，并非女方喜欢的立目标类型；Sensible. 又是借原词诱选。
借用原文：the sensible
D)
女方明确表达自己喜欢的是『来自想象力』的目标，而 Practical. 偏务实，恰是和『想象力』相反的方向；男方第四段还说 we grown-ups can be tedious and limiting in our need for reality，说明双方都批评『太务实』，所以 Practical 与女方立场相反。
借用原文：we grown-ups can be tedious and limiting in our need for reality

stem: What does the woman suggest adults should do?

options.text: Relax their strict control of their kids.
Help their kids understand themselves.
Impose their own dreams on their kids.
Dismiss their high expectations of their kids.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman suggest adults should do?
【翻译】这位女士建议成年人应该做什么?
A) 放松对孩子的严格控制。
B) 帮助孩子了解自己。
C) 将自己的梦想强加给孩子。
D) 放弃对孩子的高期望。
【答案】B （细节题）Help their kids understand themselves.
【定位】We should be helping our kids understand who they are, even if that means letting go of who we think they should be.
我们应该帮助孩子明白他们究竟是谁，哪怕这意味着要放下我们心里想让他们成为的样子。
【信号】we should be+建议动作信号。女方在最后一段用 We should be helping our kids understand who they are 直接说出建议，we should 是最典型的建议信号；位置又在对话最后，是收束式落点，几乎可以确定就是这道建议题的答案句。
【替换】helping our kids understand who they are ↔Help their kids understand themselves.
宾语从句到反身代词的等值改写

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
录音并未谈到家长应放松对孩子的『严格控制』，只是说不要把自己的期望强加给孩子；Relax their strict control of their kids. 把『放下自己的预设』偷换成『放松严格控制』，扩大了原文范围。
C)
letting go of who we think they should be 表明女方主张『放下我们希望他们成为的样子』，等于反对把自己的梦强加给孩子；Impose their own dreams on their kids. 与原文立场完全相反，是反向陷阱。
借用原文：letting go of who we think they should be
D)
原词陷阱
录音第八段提到 false expectations，expectations 是原词，但语境是『问 What do you want to be 会带来虚假期望和失望』，并非要求家长 dismiss their high expectations；选项 Dismiss their high expectations of their kids. 借 expectations 这个原词诱选，又把『不要制造虚假期望』推断成『要彻底抛弃所有高期望』，过度推断。
借用原文：false expectations

stem: What are a number of phone companies trying to do in Africa?

options.text: Set up company branches.
Improve its infrastructure.
Introduce iPhones into its markets.
Promote Internet-ready phones.

explanation:
【题目】What are a number of phone companies trying to do in Africa?
【翻译】许多手机公司正试图在非洲做什么？
A) 建立公司分支机构。
B) 改善其基础设施。
C) 将iPhone引入其市场。
D) 推广支持互联网的手机。
【答案】D （细节题）Promote Internet-ready phones.
【定位】Now, some phone companies are trying to introduce Internet-ready phones into African markets.
如今，一些手机公司正试图将能上网的手机引入非洲市场。
【信号】句首 Now 引出新话题。Now, some phone companies are trying to introduce Internet-ready phones into African markets. 里句首 Now 是典型的话题切换信号，把镜头从'非洲上网难'切到'手机公司在做什么'，紧跟其后的就是题目要问的具体动作。
【替换】introduce Internet-ready phones ↔Promote Internet-ready phones.
introduce≈promote 同义替换
into African markets ↔Promote Internet-ready phones.
in Africa = into African markets

【排除】A)
未提及
Set up company branches. 在录音里根本没出现 set up 或 branches 这类词，是凭'公司+非洲'凑出的常识推论，属于未提及类干扰。
B)
Improve its infrastructure. 借了 tough to wire for Internet access 这类'基建落后'的语境制造既视感，但原文从未说手机公司去改善基础设施，而是说他们另辟蹊径推廉价手机，是典型的原词陷阱+偷换概念。
借用原文：Most Africans live in rural areas that are tough to wire for Internet access.
C)
Introduce iPhones into its markets. 盗用了原文段尾 Apple's top-of-the-line iPhone has $390 worth of stuff. 这一处 iPhone 原词，但原文恰恰是把 iPhone 当成对照——非洲推的是低价 KaiOS 手机、不是 iPhone，这是典型原词陷阱+与原文相反。
借用原文：Apple's top-of-the-line iPhone has $390 worth of stuff.

stem: How do KaiOS smartphones differ from smartphones of most other companies?

options.text: They cater to Africans' needs.
They are more expensive models.
They are more powerful and capable
They boast the longest battery life.

explanation:
【题目】How do KaiOS smartphones differ from smartphones of most other companies?
【翻译】KaiOS智能手机与其他大多数公司的智能手机有何不同？
A) 它们迎合非洲人的需求。
B) 它们是更昂贵的型号。
C) 它们更强大且功能更强。
D) 它们拥有最长的电池续航时间。
【答案】A （细节题）They cater to Africans' needs.
【定位】Most companies are trying to make phones ever more powerful and capable. But KaiOS went the other way. It made every effort to keep the essential capabilities of smartphones, but strip out costs and preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity.
大多数公司都在努力让手机越来越强大、功能越来越全。但 KaiOS 反其道而行：它竭力保留智能手机的核心功能，同时砍掉成本、保住续航，服务那些用电不稳的人群。
【信号】But + went the other way 双重转折。But KaiOS went the other way. 里的 But 与went the other way 是典型的双重转折信号，前一句 Most companies are trying to make phones ever more powerful and capable. 是被否定的对照基线，转折后那一句才是真正在讲 KaiOS 的差异点。
【替换】strip out costs and preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity ↔They cater to Africans' needs.
服务用电不稳人群→迎合非洲人需求
But KaiOS went the other way. ↔They cater to Africans' needs.
反其道而行=另辟需求侧

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
They are more expensive models. 借了 more expensive models 这个原词，但原文恰恰是说 KaiOS 给出更便宜的替代品、绕开 more expensive models，与原文方向完全相反，是原词陷阱+与原文相反。
借用原文：The KaiOS devices offer an alternative to the more expensive models that remain out of reach of many Africans
C)
They are more powerful and capable 直接照搬了 more powerful and capable 这串原词，但原文是说'多数公司在追求更强更全，而 KaiOS 反其道而行'，KaiOS 恰恰不是更强更全，原词陷阱+张冠李戴。
借用原文：Most companies are trying to make phones ever more powerful and capable.
D)
They boast the longest battery life. 盗用了 preserve battery life 这一处续航话题，但原文只说'保住/延长续航'，并没有说'最长'，longest 是程度的过度推断，未提及 + 与原文相反。
借用原文：preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What are KaiOS smartphones equipped with?

options.text: A large touchscreen.
An old-school keypad.
A voice-response device.
A digitally-designed system.

explanation:
【题目】What are KaiOS smartphones equipped with?
【翻译】KaiOS智能手机配备了什么？
A) 大型触摸屏。
B) 老式键盘。
C) 语音响应设备。
D) 数字化设计系统。
【答案】B （细节题）An old-school keypad.
【定位】Instead of a touchscreen, they're controlled with an old-school keypad.
它们不用触摸屏，而是用老式键盘来操控。
【信号】Instead of 一句给出'不是A、是B'。Instead of a touchscreen, they're controlled with an old-school keypad. 用 Instead of 这一对比信号，把两种硬件方案并排摆出来：前半否定 touchscreen、后半肯定 old-school keypad，结构上一句话同时回答了'不是什么+是什么'。
【替换】they're controlled with an old-school keypad ↔An old-school keypad.
原词级同义对应

【排除】A)
A large touchscreen. 盗用了原文 Instead of a touchscreen 的 touchscreen 原词，但原文用 Instead of 明确否定了 touchscreen，方向完全反了，是典型原词陷阱+与原文相反。
借用原文：Instead of a touchscreen, they're controlled with an old-school keypad.
C)
A voice-response device. 在录音里完全没有 voice 或 response 类词，是凭'智能手机也可能用语音控制'这种常识脑补的，属于未提及。
D)
A digitally-designed system. 与原文里描述 KaiOS 手机外观、控制方式的句子毫无对应，'数字化设计的系统'是个含义空泛的兜底干扰，属未提及。

stem: What is said about using recycled plastic to make plastic products in the past?

options.text: It ensured sustainable economic growth.
It was strongly opposed by manufacturers.
It was cheaper than using fossil fuel plastic.
It satisfied consumer demands on the whole.

explanation:
【题目】What is said about using recycled plastic to make plastic products in the past?
【翻译】关于过去使用回收塑料制造塑料产品,有何说法?
A) 它确保了可持续的经济增长。
B) 它遭到制造商的强烈反对。
C) 它比使用化石燃料塑料更便宜。
D) 它总体上满足了消费者的需求。
【答案】C （细节题）It was cheaper than using fossil fuel plastic.
【定位】For years, using recycled plastic to make plastic products was cheap. By contrast, fossil fuel plastic was more expensive. Thus this sustainable option was an economic option too.
多年来，用回收塑料制造塑料产品一直很便宜。相比之下，化石燃料塑料更贵。因此这种可持续的选项同时也是一种经济划算的选项。
【信号】对比信号 By contrast 锁定答案句。答案句的关键信号是 By contrast——它紧跟在"回收塑料便宜"之后，接出"化石燃料塑料更贵"的对比，正好把两者的价格高低关系明确点出。此外开头的 For years 对应题干的 in the past，是时间锚点。
【替换】using recycled plastic to make plastic products was cheap ↔ It was cheaper than using fossil fuel plastic.
录音两句并一句·形容词转比较级
fossil fuel plastic was more expensive ↔than using fossil fuel plastic
对比对象逐词对齐

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音原句是 this sustainable option was an economic option too，意思是"这种可持续选项同时也是经济划算的选项"，强调的是"便宜=经济"，与"保证可持续经济增长"完全不是一回事。选项把 sustainable + economic 这两个原词拼成 sustainable economic growth，但 growth（增长）在录音里根本没提。
借用原文：this sustainable option was an economic option too
B)
录音第一段只讲了"便宜"和"经济"，全篇也未出现 manufacturers oppose 这类否定/反对的措辞，strongly opposed 是凭空捏造的反向描述，属于典型的"未提及"。
D)
张冠李戴
录音确实提到 This may be because of consumer demands，但那是在解释"现在回收塑料反而更贵"的原因，发生在"现在"，与题干限定的 in the past 时间错位。选项盗用了consumer demand 这个原词把"现在"的信息安到"过去"，是典型的张冠李戴。
借用原文：This may be because of consumer demands

stem: What has led to more competitive price for new plastic?

options.text: The capacity to mass produce it.
The U.S. federal government's regulations.
A boom in market demand for clear plastic bottles.
A rapid increase in U.S. petroleum chemical production.

explanation:
【题目】What has led to more competitive price for new plastic?
【翻译】是什么导致新塑料的价格更具竞争力?
A) 大规模生产的能力。
B) 美国联邦政府的法规。
C) 透明塑料瓶市场需求的繁荣。
D) 美国石油化工产量的快速增长。
【答案】D （细节题）A rapid increase in U.S. petroleum chemical production.
【定位】Meanwhile, new plastic is becoming cheaper. This is because of a boom in petroleum chemical production from the U.S.
与此同时，新塑料正变得越来越便宜。这是因为美国的石油化工产量出现了大幅增长。
【信号】因果信号 This is because 锁定答案句。答案句靠 This is because of 这个清晰的因果信号锁定——录音里出现"new plastic is becoming cheaper"（结果）后紧接着用 This is because of 给出原因 a boom in petroleum chemical production from the U.S.，这就是题目要的原因。
【替换】a boom in petroleum chemical production from the U.S. ↔ A rapid increase in U.S. petroleum chemical production.
boom=rapid increase·同义词替换

【排除】A)
未提及
"大规模生产能力"听起来很合理（产能高自然成本低），但录音里从未提到 capacity 或mass produce，这是凭常识脑补出的答案，属于未提及。
B)
录音里 U.S. 只与 petroleum chemical production from the U.S. 搭配，是讲"美国石化产量"，全篇并未提到 U.S. federal government 的任何 regulation。选项盗用了原词 U.S.，又把后半段 The UK government 的"政府监管"语义错位拼到"美国"头上，是典型的"原词+张冠李戴"混合干扰。
借用原文：petroleum chemical production from the U.S.
C)
偷换概念
clear plastic bottles 确实在 Makers of clear plastic bottles may also opt for new fossil-fuel based plastic to save money 里出现过，但那是讲"透明塑料瓶的厂家会选新塑料"——是"新塑料更便宜"的结果之一，而不是它变便宜的原因。选项把"结果"包装成"原因"。
借用原文：Makers of clear plastic bottles may also opt for new fossil-fuel based plastic to save money

stem: What does the UK government plan to do about plastic?

options.text: Require companies to use 30% of new plastic.
Increase the supply of new plastic in the market.
Reduce the amount of plastic pollution in local areas.
Take measures to promote the use of recycled plastic.

explanation:
【题目】What does the UK government plan to do about plastic?
【翻译】英国政府计划对塑料采取什么措施?
A) 要求企业使用30%的新塑料。
B) 增加市场上新塑料的供应。
C) 减少当地地区的塑料污染量。
D) 采取措施促进回收塑料的使用。
【答案】D （细节题）Take measures to promote the use of recycled plastic.
【定位】The UK government plans to tax companies which don't use at least 30% recycled plastic in their products. Additionally, the government is planning to increase the quantity of recycled plastic in the market.
英国政府计划对那些产品中回收塑料使用比例不足30%的公司征税。此外，政府还计划增加市场上回收塑料的数量。
【信号】主体+计划信号 plans to / is planning to 双重锁定。本段同时出现两次明显的"计划"信号：The UK government plans to 与 the government is planning to——主体+plan to的合体两次出现，构成两条并列计划，是无可争议的答案句。

【替换】tax companies which don't use at least 30% recycled plastic ↔ Take measures to promote the use of recycled plastic.
具体措施→抽象概括
increase the quantity of recycled plastic in the market ↔promote the use of recycled plastic
增加供应=促进使用·名词化与动词化对调
【排除】A)
偷换概念
录音原文是 tax companies which don't use at least 30% recycled plastic，30% 限定的是 recycled plastic（回收塑料），政府要求的是"至少用30%的回收塑料"。选项把数字30% 原样搬过来，但偷偷把 recycled plastic 换成 new plastic（新塑料），方向完全反了——典型的"数字原词陷阱+正话反说"。
借用原文：tax companies which don't use at least 30% recycled plastic in their products
B)
偷换概念
录音说政府计划 increase the quantity of recycled plastic in the market——增加的是回收塑料的量。选项把 recycled plastic 偷换成 new plastic（新塑料），把"增加回收塑料供应"扭曲成"增加新塑料供应"，正好相反。又是把 increase 原词留着、偷换名词的伎俩。
借用原文：the government is planning to increase the quantity of recycled plastic in the market
C)
录音里 reduce plastic pollution 的目标是 reducing the enormous amount of plastic pollution in the oceans——减少海洋里的塑料污染。选项把 oceans 偷换成 local areas（本地地区），范围被偷改了；并且 reduce pollution 这件事在录音里也不是政府计划的内容，而是"包装厂家被施压"去做的，主体也不对。属于范围偷改+张冠李戴的双重错。
借用原文：reducing the enormous amount of plastic pollution in the oceans

stem: What do we learn about the Dreamery, a business in Manhattan?

options.text: It studies dreams.
It rents a place for nap-takers.
It is a hotel for business people.
It is a nap research institute.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the Dreamery, a business in Manhattan?
【翻译】关于位于曼哈顿的Dreamery这家企业,我们了解到什么?
A) 它研究梦境。
B) 它为午睡者出租场地。
C) 它是一家为商务人士服务的酒店。
D) 它是一家午睡研究机构。
【答案】B （细节题）It rents a place for nap-takers.
【定位】At the Dreamery, a business in Manhattan, naps are for sale. A 45-minute session in a darkened enclosure with peace and quiet costs $25. To be clear, this institution is no hotel. This is a nap joint.
在曼哈顿的一家叫 Dreamery 的店里,午睡是被拿来出售的。在一个黑暗、安静的小隔间里睡 45 分钟,要 25 美元。说清楚一点,这家机构不是酒店,这是一家专门的午睡店。
【信号】正面定义 + 否定式澄清。答案句的信号有两层:一是 naps are for sale 直接给出 Dreamery做什么生意——卖午睡;二是 To be clear, this institution is no hotel. This is a nap joint.用'no… this is…'的否定式定义把考生最容易误以为的身份(酒店)否掉、把真身(专门做午睡的店)亮出来,这是典型的篇章信号:说话人主动澄清的句子常常就是答案句。
【替换】naps are for sale ↔rents a place for nap-takers
naps are for sale ≈ rents a place for nap-takers
A 45-minute session in a darkened enclosure with peace and quiet costs $25. ↔ rents a place for nap-takers
a darkened enclosure ≈ a place;costs $25 ≈ rents

【排除】A)
未提及
It studies dreams. 利用机构名 Dreamery 含 dream 一词来制造'研究梦'的字面联想,但录音从未说这家店研究 dreams,只说它出售 naps are for sale;店名带 dream 不等于业务是研究 dream,这是把字面误当成业务定义。
C)
与原文相反
It is a hotel for business people. 里的 hotel 在录音 this institution is no hotel 里原词出现,但出现的位置正是被讲话人否掉的位置——讲话人明确说'这不是酒店'。考生若只听到hotel 三个字就选,会正好掉进讲话人提前设的反话陷阱里。
借用原文：this institution is no hotel
D)
过度推断
It is a nap research institute. 把这家店从'a business / a nap joint'拔高为'研究机构'。录音明明说 At the Dreamery, a business in Manhattan,定位是 business(生意),又自称 nap joint(店);从未说它是 research institute,这是把性质从'商业'拔高到'学术研究',越界推断。
借用原文：At the Dreamery, a business in Manhattan

stem: Why does the speaker ask us to look at the world around us at 2:30 in the afternoon?

options.text: To find out creative people's work performance.
To see how many people can go without napping.
To understand the obvious importance of napping.
To feel how difficult it is to get his idea across.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the speaker ask us to look at the world around us at 2:30 in the afternoon?
【翻译】为什么说话者要我们在下午2点30分观察周围的世界?
A) 为了了解有创造力的人的工作表现。
B) 为了看看有多少人可以不午睡。
C) 为了理解午睡的明显重要性。
D) 为了感受让别人理解他的想法有多困难。
【答案】C （目的题）To understand the obvious importance of napping.
【定位】Is a nap worth $25? The answer is obviously yes. Here, at this point in the argument, it's traditional for me to bring up all the studies that show the benefits of napping. But do you really need experts to tell you that? Just look at the world around you at 2:30 in the afternoon.
午睡值不值 25 美元?答案显然是值的。讲到这一步,我按惯例本该搬出一堆研究来证明午睡的好处。但你真的需要专家来告诉你这件事吗?只要看看下午两点半你身边的世界就行了。
【信号】立场句 + 反问 + 让你看现象。信号有三层:一是立场句 The answer is obviously yes. 先抛出讲话人的论点——午睡显然值得;二是反问 But do you really need experts to tell you that?,讲话人用反问替代了'引研究'的常规论证;三是承接动作 Just look at the world around you at 2:30 in the afternoon.——既然不需要专家,那就用'你身边下午两点半的景象'来代替专家的研究,直接让听众自己看到午睡显然重要。三层连起来:让你看下午两点半的世界,目的就是让你自己印证讲话人那句'午睡显然重要'。

【替换】The answer is obviously yes. ↔the obvious importance of napping
obviously yes ≈ obvious importance
Just look at the world around you at 2:30 in the afternoon. ↔ To understand the obvious importance of napping
look at ≈ understand
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
To find out creative people's work performance. 借了录音第三段里 I don't understand how people have creative careers without napping. 中的 creative 一词制造熟悉感,但讲话人让人看下午两点半的世界,目的不是去研究'有创造力的人的工作表现',他根本没让你去观察任何特定人群。这是跨段盗词,把第三段的词嫁接到第二段的目的上。
借用原文：I don't understand how people have creative careers without napping.
B)
与原文相反
To see how many people can go without napping. 在方向上正好与讲话人立场相反。讲话人是在论证'午睡显然重要',让你看世界是为了证明大家都需要午睡;选项却说目的是'看有多少人不靠午睡也行',这把目的反向了。
借用原文：The answer is obviously yes.
D)
偷换概念
To feel how difficult it is to get his idea across. 把讲话人的目的偷换成'体会到自己讲清楚观点有多难'。录音里讲话人并不是在抱怨自己难以传达观点,他相反非常自信地说'你不需要专家'——他对自己的观点能不能被听懂没有任何困扰,选项是对讲话人姿态的歪曲。
借用原文：But do you really need experts to tell you that?

source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the quantity and quality of the speaker's work?

options.text: They decline due to pointless meetings.
They depend on his ability to concentrate.
They enable him to enjoy a creative career.
They are affected by the overuse of social media.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the quantity and quality of the speaker's work?
【翻译】关于说话者工作的数量和质量,我们了解到什么?
A) 它们因无意义的会议而下降。
B) 它们取决于他的专注能力。
C) 它们使他能够享受创造性的职业生涯。
D) 它们受到社交媒体过度使用的影响。
【答案】B （细节题）They depend on his ability to concentrate.
【定位】I've been working from home for more than 10 years now. And the quality and quantity of work I can do emerges directly from my ability to concentrate.
我在家工作已经超过 10 年了。我能完成的工作的质量和数量,直接取决于我集中注意力的能力。

【信号】因果衔接词 emerges directly from。答案信号是 emerges directly from 这一因果衔接短语——它把'工作的质和量'与'集中力'明确绑成因果关系。这种'A emerges/comes/results from B'结构是听力细节题最直接的答案信号,因为它已经替你把'答案靠什么'说清楚了,只需把 B 抓住即可。
【替换】the quality and quantity of work I can do ↔They
the quality and quantity of work ≈ They
emerges directly from my ability to concentrate ↔depend on his ability to concentrate
emerges directly from ≈ depend on
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
They decline due to pointless meetings. 借了录音里 attend pointless meetings until 7 p.m. 中的 pointless meetings 制造熟悉感,但 pointless meetings 在录音里是讲话人用来描述'不午睡就要被迫做的烂事'之一,并不是导致讲话人产出 decline 的原因。讲话人压根没说自己产出在下降,只是把不午睡的人生活描述为低效。
借用原文：attend pointless meetings until 7 p.m.
C)
与原文相反
They enable him to enjoy a creative career. 盗了录音 I don't understand how people have creative careers without napping. 中的 creative career 来诱选。但因果方向相反:录音是说'人怎么能在没午睡的情况下还做创造性工作'——讲话人是用 creative career 来反衬'没午睡就难做创造性工作',而不是说工作的质和量'使他能享受'创造性职业。选项把'我的工作量质 → 取决于集中力'偷换成'我的工作量质 → 让我能享受创造性职业',因果颠倒。
借用原文：I don't understand how people have creative careers without napping.
D)
原词陷阱
They are affected by the overuse of social media. 借了录音里 daydream and drift around social media 中的 social media 制造熟悉感。但录音里 drift around social media 是讲话人描述'不午睡会陷入'的散漫状态之一,并非他在说自己的工作量质被社交媒体过度使用所影响。同样是用原词嫁接到错位的因果上。
借用原文：daydream and drift around social media

stem: What does the speaker say he finds odd?

options.text: Some bosses associate napping with laziness.
Many office workers nap during work hours.
Some bosses can concentrate without napping.
Many of his friends daydream in the office.

explanation:
【题目】What does the speaker say he finds odd?
【翻译】说话者说他觉得什么很奇怪?
A) 一些老板把午睡与懒惰联系在一起。
B) 许多办公室职员在工作时间午睡。
C) 一些老板可以不午睡就能集中注意力。
D) 他的许多朋友在办公室里做白日梦。
【答案】A （细节题）Some bosses associate napping with laziness.

【定位】The friends I have who still work in offices inform me their bosses insist that they take the second option, and that napping is associated with laziness. I genuinely find it odd.
我那些还在办公室上班的朋友告诉我,他们的老板坚持要他们走第二条路(发呆、刷社交媒体、开无意义的会),而且认为午睡跟懒惰挂钩。我真的觉得这件事很奇怪。
【信号】态度词 odd 直接锁前一句。答案信号是 I genuinely find it odd. 中的 odd——题干 What does the speaker say he finds odd? 在录音里几乎是原词复现,it 又指代前面紧挨的那个现象。听力里'我觉得 odd / strange / surprising'这种句式,it 指的就是前一句讲过的事——这是态度题的最直接信号。
【替换】their bosses insist that they take the second option, and that napping is associated with laziness ↔ Some bosses associate napping with laziness.
their bosses + napping is associated with laziness ≈ Some bosses associate napping with laziness
I genuinely find it odd. ↔Some bosses associate napping with laziness.
it = 前一句现象 ≈ A 项内容
【排除】B)
未提及
Many office workers nap during work hours. 借了录音里 The friends I have who still work in offices 中的 offices 制造场景熟悉感,但录音从未说很多上班族在上班时间午睡,反而说老板逼他们走第二条路(发呆、刷社交媒体、开无意义的会)。这是凭空造一个录音没有的现象。
C)
原词陷阱
Some bosses can concentrate without napping. 盗了第三段 my ability to concentrate里的 concentrate 一词制造熟悉感,但讲话人本人的立场恰恰是'不午睡很难保持集中力',而且讲话人觉得 odd 的对象是'老板对午睡的偏见',不是老板的集中力。选项把讲话人不解的对象偷换成了与原话无关的、且方向相反的命题。
借用原文：my ability to concentrate
D)
张冠李戴
Many of his friends daydream in the office. 盗了第三段 daydream and drift around social media 里的 daydream 与第四段 The friends I have who still work in offices 里的friends,把两个原词拼到一起造一个录音没说的现象。录音里讲话人觉得 odd 的是老板把午睡当懒惰,而不是朋友在办公室发呆;且 daydream 是讲话人假设'不午睡就会陷入'的状态,不是他对朋友行为的描述。
借用原文：daydream and drift around social media

stem: Well, creating fabric from cotton, which is the most __(27)__ clothing material, is actually a process that involves a lot of water, 2,700 liters per shirt to be __(28)__ .

options.text: abstracts
abundant
awareness

sew

explanation:
27. which is the most __(27)__ clothing material
【答案】B) abundant
形容词
【词性槽】the most + 空 + 名词，形容词最高级作定语
【依据】棉花是"最常见/产量最大"的衣料，abundant 最贴

stem: What are big houses promoted to be in the United States?

options.text: A luxury for the homeless.
A reward for industriousness.
An abundant source of comforts.
An absolute necessity for happiness.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】Q46 问的是 What are big houses promoted to be，要的是文中明写的一个事实陈述，不需推理。
【拆句】Q46 是一个被动语态疑问句，主干为"big houses are promoted to be 什么"，promoted to be 后面接的内容就是答案要补的成分，结构平铺，无陷阱。
【定位】Big houses are advertised as a reward for hard work and diligence, turning housing from a basic necessity into a luxury.
大房子被宣传成对努力工作和勤勉的一种回报，把住房从基本必需品变成了奢侈品。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
原文宣传是面向勤奋者的回报，A luxury for the homeless 把奢侈品安到 homeless 头上，而原文 homelessness 只是危机背景，并非大房子的宣传对象。
B)
✓ 正确
a reward for hard work and diligence ↔A reward for industriousness
预判的"对勤奋的回报"在 A reward for industriousness 中 reward 与 industriousness双双对应，锁定该项。
C)
答非所问
An abundant source of comforts 取自第三段及背景里 amenities/abound 的语义，但 Q46 问的是大房子被"宣传成什么"，定位句给的是 reward，不是"舒适之源"。
D)
与原文相反
原文恰恰说大房子使住房 from a basic necessity into a luxury（从必需变奢侈），An absolute necessity for happiness 反把它说成"幸福的绝对必需品"，与原文相反。

stem: What is one of the consequences of living big?

options.text: Many Americans' quality of life has become lower.
People from diverse backgrounds no longer socialize.
People no longer have access to public swimming pools.
Many Americans' private life has been negatively affected.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What is one of the consequences 用 one of 限定，答案是原文列举的多项后果中的一项，属可直接定位的细节。
【拆句】Q47 主干为"What is one of the consequences"，of living big 是后置定语修饰consequences，one of 提示原文有多项后果，结构简单。
【定位】Second, once-public spaces, where people from diverse backgrounds used to come together, have increasingly become privatized, leading to a reduction in the number of public facilities available to all, and a reduced quality of life for many.
第二，曾经的公共空间——不同背景的人过去常在此相聚——日益被私有化，导致面向所有人的公共设施数量减少，许多人的生活质量随之下降。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
a reduced quality of life for many ↔Many Americans' quality of life has become lower
预判的"生活质量下降"与 quality of life has become lower 字面同义，直接锁定。
B)
过度推断
原文只说公共空间被私有化、不同背景的人"过去"常相聚（used to），并未说人们 no longer socialize（彻底不再社交），属过度引申。
C)
以偏概全
游泳池只是说明私有化的一个例子，原文说 public municipal pools were often closed（常被关闭），no longer have access to public swimming pools 把"常被关"绝对成"再也用不上"，且以个例顶替本题要的总后果。
D)
偷换概念
原文受影响的是 quality of life（生活质量），private life has been negatively affected 偷换成 private life（私人生活），概念不同。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

【拆句】Q48 主干"What questions arise"，from living big 为原因状语，整句问"住大房子引发哪类问题"，无复杂从句。
【定位】The trend for bigger housing thus poses ethical questions.
因此，住房越来越大的趋势引出了伦理（道德）层面的问题。

✓ 正确

答非所问
labor cost 取自第四段反问里 using the low-wage labor of others，但那只是伦理问题的内容举例，问题的"性质"是伦理性，labor cost 答非所问。
C)
张冠李戴

D)
无中生有
housing development（住房开发/发展）在第四段问题里并无对应表述，原文谈的是伦理而非开发问题，属凭空捏造。

stem: What kind of social system does the author think is unacceptable?

options.text: One in which the wealthy exploit the low-wage laborers building their houses.
One in which the rich purchase amenities at an increasingly unjustifiable price.
One in which the upper classes deprive the lower classes of affordable housing.
One in which the affluent enjoy a more comfortable life at the expense of the poor.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What kind of social system does the author think is unacceptable 答案在原文有 a system in which... 的直接描述，是可定位的细节，而非需推断的整体态度。
【拆句】Q49 主干"What kind of social system is unacceptable"，中间插入 does the author think 表明这是作者的判断，从句嵌套但语义清晰：找作者认为不可接受的那种制度。
【定位】Are we willing to accept a system in which an increase in amenities purchased by the affluent means a reduction in amenities for the poor?
我们是否愿意接受这样一种制度：富人购买的便利设施增加，就意味着穷人可享的便利设施减少？
【选项】A)
以偏概全
原文第一个反问确提到 using the low-wage labor of others，但 the low-wage laborers building their houses 把"他人的低薪劳动"窄化为"盖房工人"，且第二个反问（富人便利↔穷人便利）才是更完整的对应，A 项以偏概全。
B)
无中生有
原文说富人购买便利使穷人便利减少，从未谈 an increasingly unjustifiable price（越来越不合理的价格），价格维度是捏造的。
C)
偷换概念
deprive the lower classes of affordable housing（剥夺下层的平价住房）取自首段背景 Affordable housing is inadequate，但作者第四段否定的制度是"便利的增减对立"，不是剥夺平价住房，概念被偷换。
D)
✓ 正确
an increase in amenities purchased by the affluent means a reduction in amenities for the poor ↔the affluent enjoy a more comfortable life at the expense of the poor
预判的"富人享乐、穷人受损"恰是 enjoy a more comfortable life at the expense of the poor 的含义，锁定该项。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author advocate for people to live well?

options.text: Finding ways to turn private spaces into public ones.
Building more houses affordable to those less affluent.
More public spaces created for everyone to enjoy.
All amenities made accessible to the rich and the poor alike.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What does the author advocate 答案是末段作者直接给出的建议，有明写对应句，属细节定位题。
【拆句】Q50 主干"What does the author advocate"，for people to live well 是目的状语（为了让人们住得好），整句问"作者为此提倡什么"，结构清楚。
【定位】A better goal than building bigger houses for some is to create more publicly accessible spaces and amenities for all.
比起为少数人盖更大的房子，更好的目标是为所有人创造更多可公共使用的空间与设施。
【选项】A)
无中生有
作者主张是"创造更多公共空间"，并未说要把私人空间 turn private spaces into public ones（改造成公共空间），这一具体做法原文没有。
B)
与原文相反
Building more houses affordable 回到了"盖房子"，而作者主张的恰恰是别再盖大房子、转向公共空间，且 affordable housing 是首段背景非作者的提倡，方向与主张相悖。
C)
✓ 正确
create more publicly accessible spaces and amenities for all ↔ More public spaces created for everyone to enjoy
预判的"为人人创造公共空间"与 More public spaces created for everyone to enjoy字面同义，锁定该项。
D)
偷换概念
原文是"为所有人创造公共空间与设施"，All amenities made accessible to the rich and the poor alike 用 All amenities 把范围绝对化为"所有便利设施都对贫富开放"，超出作者所说的"公共空间"范围。

stem: What does the author think of most entrepreneurs?

options.text: They are more willing to risk their own lives.
They are more ambitious than ordinary people.
They achieve greater nonconventional success.
They have more positive qualities than most of us.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author think of most entrepreneurs? 直接问对一个明确对象的看法，答案能在原文某句找到对应陈述，不需跨段综合，属细节题而非推断。
【拆句】题干 What does the author think of most entrepreneurs? 是 think of 引导的特殊疑问句，think of sb 意为"对某人的看法"，结构平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【定位】Most of us in the entrepreneurial community are blessed—or cursed—with higher-than-average ambition.
我们创业圈里的大多数人，都被赋予——或者说被困于——高于常人的野心。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文说野心者 willing to take more risks 指愿冒事业风险，选项却说 risk their own lives（拿命冒险），把"风险"偷换成"生命危险"。
B)
✓ 正确
higher-than-average ambition ↔more ambitious than ordinary people
选项 They are more ambitious than ordinary people 与预判"野心高于普通人"完全吻合，是定位句的同义替换。
C)
无中生有
原文谈的是 conventional "success"（传统成功），选项却说 nonconventional success（非传统成功），文中从无此说法。
D)
以偏概全
原文只说野心 this is a positive quality 是"一种"积极特质，选项却说创业者 more positive qualities than most of us"比我们多"，既夸大数量又把比较对象搞错（原文most of us 本就包含创业者）。

stem: What does the author imply by saying "this isn't always the case" (Line 1, Para. 3)?

options.text: Ambitious people may not have a greater chance of success.
Ambitious people may not have more positive qualities.
Entrepreneurs' ambition does as much good as harm.
Entrepreneurs are more naturally driven to success.

explanation:
【答案】A （词义句意题）
【判型】题干 What does the author imply by saying "this isn't always the case" 用 imply by saying 问一个具体句子的含义，要求理解 this 指代什么、否定的是什么，属词义句意题。
【拆句】题干主干 What does the author imply，by saying "..." 是方式状语；关键在引文里的this 是指代词，须回原文找它替代的上文内容；isn't always 是部分否定，意为"并非总是"，不是全盘否定。
【定位】Actually, this isn't always the case.
实际上，情况并非总是如此。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
you are more likely to succeed ↔may not have a greater chance of success
选项 Ambitious people may not have a greater chance of success 正是"this（野心者更易成功）＋部分否定"的还原，与预判一致。
B)
偷换概念
this 指代的是"更易成功"，并非"积极特质"；选项 may not have more positive qualities 把否定矛头指向上一段的 positive quality，找错了 this 的指代。
C)
与原文相反
原文只说极端野心 may end up doing more harm than good（弊"大于"利），选项却说 does as much good as harm（利害"相当"），把"大于"篡改成"相等"。
D)
与原文相反
选项 more naturally driven to success 几乎照搬上文 more naturally driven to set goals，可这恰是本句要否定的观点，方向正好相反。

【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author say is of extreme importance 用 say 直问作者明说的内容，答案是原文一句强调重要性的话，属细节题。
【拆句】题干 What does the author say is of extreme importance for one to become a successful entrepreneur?，主干是 What...is of extreme importance；of+抽象名词等于形容词，of extreme importance＝extremely important；for one to become... 是不定式目的状语，指明"为了成为成功创业者"。
【定位】This is problematic because it hinders your ability to adapt to new circumstances, which is vital if you want to be a successful entrepreneur.
这是有问题的，因为它会损害你适应新环境的能力，而这种能力对于想成为成功创业者的人至关重要。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文说过度野心导致 focus too determinedly on one particular vision 反而有害，需straying from your original vision；选项 Holding on to one's original vision（死守原愿景）正是文章要批评的做法。
B)
✓ 正确
adapt to new circumstances ↔adapt to new situations
选项 Being able to adapt to new situations 与预判"适应新环境的能力"几乎逐词对应，确为答案。
C)
与原文相反
选项 Focusing determinedly on one particular goal 直接抄自 focus too determinedly on one particular vision，而原文说这是过度野心的"副作用"，绝非"极其重要"之事。
D)
与原文相反
原文说有时须 change direction"改变方向"，选项却说 Avoiding radical change in one's career direction"避免大改方向"，与文意相左。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: How do the most ambitious entrepreneurs regard failure in their endeavor?

options.text: It will awaken them to reality.
It is a lesson they have to learn.
It means the end of their career.
It will result in a slow recovery.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 How do the most ambitious entrepreneurs regard failure 问一个明确群体对失败的态度，原文有明文表述，属细节题。
【拆句】题干 How do the most ambitious entrepreneurs regard failure in their endeavor?，regard sth 意为"看待某事"，in their endeavor（在其奋斗中）是范围状语；结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】Unfortunately, for the most ambitious entrepreneurs, a failure is seen as disastrous, and impossible to recover from.
不幸的是，对那些野心最大的创业者来说，一次失败被视为灾难性的、且无法翻身的。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
awaken them to reality 对应的是第六段 failure is viewed as something closer to reality，那讲的是"野心有限者"，而非题干问的"野心最大者"。
B)
张冠李戴
a lesson they have to learn 对应第六段 every failure you survive is a learning experience，同样是说"野心有限者"，张冠李戴。
C)
✓ 正确
disastrous, and impossible to recover from ↔means the end of their career
选项 It means the end of their career 把"灾难、无法恢复"提炼成"事业到头"，与预判一致，确为答案。
D)
与原文相反
原文说 impossible to recover from"无法恢复"，选项却说 result in a slow recovery"导致缓慢恢复"，恢复从"不可能"被偷改成"慢"。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author advise us to do concerning ambition?

options.text: Distinguish between conventional success and our life goal.
Follow the example of the most ambitious entrepreneurs.
Avoid taking unnecessary risks when starting a business.
Prioritize health and happiness over material success.

explanation:
【答案】D （推断题）
【判型】题干 What does the author advise us to do concerning ambition? 问作者的建议，原文未必有一句直说"我建议你……"，需综合全文对野心利弊的论述提炼，属推断题。
【拆句】题干 What does the author advise us to do concerning ambition?，advise sb to do意为"建议某人做某事"，concerning ambition（关于野心）是话题状语；结构平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文要区分的是 conventional "success" 与 health and happiness，选项 Distinguish between conventional success and our life goal 把后一项换成了文中没有的"人生目标"，区分对象被改错。
B)
与原文相反
全文都在指出 the most ambitious entrepreneurs 看待失败的方式有害，选项 Follow the example of the most ambitious entrepreneurs 却劝人效仿他们，与作者立场正相反。
C)
以偏概全
Avoid taking unnecessary risks 只关乎 take more risks 这一点，并非全文劝诫的落脚；作者最终落点是健康幸福，而非"少冒险"，以偏概全且无中生有。
D)
✓ 正确
such success means nothing for their health and happiness—and if you don't have health and happiness, what else could possibly matter? ↔Prioritize health and happiness over material success
选项 Prioritize health and happiness over material success 与主线"健康幸福重于成功"吻合，且统摄全文对过度野心的批评，是建议题应有的全局答案。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页

stem: What do we learn from the police report?

options.text: A man was bitten by a snake.
A man was taken to a hospital.
A man kept a 4-foot snake as a pet.
A man fell off his toilet seat.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the police report?
【翻译】我们从警方报告中了解到什么?
A) 一名男子被蛇咬伤。
B) 一名男子被送往医院。
C) 一名男子养了一条4英尺长的蛇作为宠物。
D) 一名男子从马桶座上摔了下来。
【答案】A （细节题）A man was bitten by a snake.
【定位】Police have reported a man being bitten by a 4-foot snake when he lifted his toilet seat on Sunday morning.
警方报告称，周日早晨一名男子在掀开马桶盖时被一条 4 英尺长的蛇咬伤。
【信号】新闻导语句即答案。答案句就是 Police have reported a man being bitten by a 4-foot snake when he lifted his toilet seat on Sunday morning. 这一句——新闻报道的第一句（导语）就是 Police have reported…，是"警方报告"信号的直接落点。新闻题里只要题干问"警方/官方/这则报道说什么"，几乎都落在导语句。
【替换】a man being bitten by a 4-foot snake ↔A man was bitten by a snake.
非谓语转过去时·同义直接对应

【排除】B)
与原文相反
录音第二段明确说 the man did not have to go to the hospital——这位男子**没有**去医院，只是在现场处理了手臂。选项 A man was taken to a hospital. 盗用了原文的hospital 一词却把否定砍掉，反成肯定，是典型"听到 hospital 就想选"的陷阱。
借用原文：the man did not have to go to the hospital
C)
原词陷阱
选项 A man kept a 4-foot snake as a pet. 把录音第 1 段里的 a 4-foot snake 原词搬过来，看似耳熟。但录音第 3 段明确说 the snake didn't belong to the man，蛇并不是男子的，更谈不上 kept…as a pet。这是"听到原词就想选"的原词陷阱。
借用原文：a 4-foot snake
D)
原词陷阱
选项 A man fell off his toilet seat. 借用了录音 he lifted his toilet seat 中的 toilet seat这块"熟面孔"，但把动作偷换成了 fell off（从马桶上摔下来）。录音说的是"他掀开马桶盖"，根本没说他摔倒。这又是一处原词陷阱叠加偷换概念。
借用原文：he lifted his toilet seat
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the report say was still unclear?

options.text: Where the snake had been taken.
Whether the snake was infected.
How the snake was captured.
Who owned the snake.

explanation:
【题目】What does the report say was still unclear?
【翻译】报告称什么仍不清楚?
A) 蛇被带到了哪里。
B) 蛇是否被感染。
C) 蛇是如何被捕获的。
D) 蛇的主人是谁。
【答案】D （细节题）Who owned the snake.
【定位】It was unclear who the owner was. The snake may be taken to a local zoo for care if the owner does not come forward.
蛇的主人是谁尚不清楚。如果主人不出面认领，这条蛇可能会被送到当地一家动物园照料。
【信号】unclear + who 直接锁定。答案信号是 It was unclear who the owner was. 中的 unclear一词——它与题干 still unclear 直接对应；unclear 后面跟的 who the owner was 就是"未明的内容"，几乎是把答案塞到题干同款词的旁边。
【替换】It was unclear who the owner was. ↔Who owned the snake.
名词转动词·who 从句同义重写

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音 The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers and taken to an animal hospital afterward. 已经明确告诉我们蛇被送去了 animal hospital；之后还补了一句若无主认领"可能送到当地动物园"，去向并非"unclear"。选项 Where the snake had been taken. 借用 taken 这一原词制造"哪里去了仍不清楚"的错觉，实际录音对去向已交代。
借用原文：taken to an animal hospital afterward
B)
原词陷阱
录音 It was being treated for an outer skin infection. 明确说蛇正在因外皮感染接受治疗，感染状况已确认而非未明。选项 Whether the snake was infected. 把 infection 一词盗作诱饵，骗"听到 infection 就想选"的考生。
借用原文：It was being treated for an outer skin infection.
C)
原词陷阱
录音 The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers 明确说蛇是被当地的"动物管理员"捕获的，捕获方式（由谁、怎么抓）已交代。选项 How the snake was captured. 直接挪用 captured 一词，把已说清的事伪装成 unclear，是经典原词陷阱。
借用原文：The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What has Andrea Belcher been doing since last April?

options.text: Taking her trash out in fancy dresses.
Amusing herself by going to ball parties.
Sharing her photos with famous movie stars.
Posting her daughter's photos on social media.

explanation:
【题目】What has Andrea Belcher been doing since last April?
【翻译】自去年四月以来，Andrea Belcher 一直在做什么?
A) 穿着华丽的礼服去倒垃圾。
B) 通过参加舞会派对来自娱自乐。
C) 与著名电影明星分享她的照片。
D) 在社交媒体上发布她女儿的照片。
【答案】A （细节题）Taking her trash out in fancy dresses.
【定位】Every week since last April, Andrea Belcher has been doing something slightly unusual and amusing when she takes out her trash.
自去年四月起，安德烈娅·贝尔彻每周倒垃圾的时候都会做一件稍微有点不寻常又搞笑的事。
【信号】开篇点题句 + 时间状语锁定。新闻开篇 Every week since last April 与题干 since last April 完全对应，时间状语就是答案信号；后半句 when she takes out her trash 直接揭示行为载体——倒垃圾，这是承载答案的那句话。
【替换】doing something slightly unusual and amusing when she takes out her trash ↔ Taking her trash out in fancy dresses
概括 + 后文具体细化
get dressed up to take out the trash ↔in fancy dresses
get dressed up = 穿正装 = fancy dresses

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音第2段提到 a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown，ball gown（晚礼服）只是她穿的衣服样式，并不是说"她去参加舞会"。选项 B把 ball 偷换成 ball parties，把"穿礼服倒垃圾"硬扭成"去舞会自娱"，是典型的原词陷阱。
借用原文：a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown
C)
张冠李戴
录音第2段明确 a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown——分享照片的人是那位明星，分享的内容是明星自己的照片。选项 C 把动作主语换成了 Andrea，把"她和明星分享照片"安到她头上，是张冠李戴。
借用原文：a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown
D)
张冠李戴
录音第3段说 Her daughter filmed it，是女儿帮她拍视频；第4段说 sharing her exploits on social media，分享的是"她自己的事迹"。选项 D 却说"发布她女儿的照片"，把"女儿帮拍"偷换成"发布女儿的照片"，主客颠倒。
借用原文：Her daughter filmed it
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why has Andrea Belcher kept up her videos?

options.text: To make herself popular.
To amuse people.
To please her daughter.
To record her achievements.

explanation:
【题目】Why has Andrea Belcher kept up her videos?
【翻译】为什么 Andrea Belcher 一直坚持制作她的视频?
A) 为了让自己受欢迎。
B) 为了逗乐人们。
C) 为了取悦她的女儿。
D) 为了记录她的成就。
【答案】B （细节题）To amuse people.
【定位】Explaining why she has kept up the videos, Andrea explained how nice it was to have a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile.
在解释为什么坚持拍这些视频时，安德烈娅说，能有一点点乐趣和疯狂，让人们露出笑容，这感觉真好。
【信号】结尾解释句直接对应题干。录音第5段开头 Explaining why she has kept up the videos与题干 Why has Andrea Belcher kept up her videos? 是几乎逐字对应的解释信号；其后的 a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile 就是她给出的真实原因，是承载答案的那句话。
【替换】a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile ↔To amuse people
made people smile = amuse people
fun and craziness ↔amuse
fun ≈ amuse 的同根义

【排除】A)
未提及
录音里完全没有出现 popular/famous 类的动机描述；她坚持的原因被明确说成 to have a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile，与"让自己出名"无关。选项 A是"花絮新闻最常见的诱选动机"——预读时已警惕。
C)
原词陷阱
录音第3段有 Her daughter filmed it and the whole family laughed，daughter 真的被念到，但只是说女儿帮她拍、全家笑——这不是她坚持的目的。选项 C 把 daughter 偷过来，硬安成"为了讨女儿欢心"，是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：Her daughter filmed it and the whole family laughed
D)
未提及
录音里既没有 record（记录）也没有 achievements（成就）类的表达；she had done 20 weeks 只是叙述事实，并非"为了记录成就"。选项 D 是凭"长期坚持"脑补出来的，与解释信号后给出的真实动机不符。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What can people do at Frank's restaurant?

options.text: Eat as much as they want for $10.
Have a chance of winning a $100 prize.
Have a meal even if they have no money.
Get a free meal after answering some questions.

explanation:
【题目】What can people do at Frank's restaurant?
【翻译】人们在Frank餐厅可以做什么?
A) 花10美元想吃多少就吃多少。
B) 有机会赢得100美元的奖金。
C) 即使没有钱也能吃一顿饭。
D) 回答一些问题后获得免费餐食。
【答案】C （细节题）Have a meal even if they have no money.
【定位】No money but still hungry? No problem! Welcome to Frank's restaurant where customers are paying for meals and leaving receipts on a board. Anyone who is hungry and wants something to eat can take one, no questions asked and hand it to the staff for some food.
没钱但还是饿着？没关系！欢迎来到 Frank's 餐厅——这里的顾客先付饭钱，再把小票留在一块板上。任何饿了想吃东西的人都可以取下一张小票，无需任何询问，把它交给店员就能换到一份食物。
【信号】导语句直接点题。开头连用两个设问 No money but still hungry? No problem!，紧接着用 Welcome to… 引出餐厅做法，这是新闻典型的导语式信号——把整则新闻的核心事实押在第一段第一句。听到设问+欢迎句出现，就要在心里把笔停在这一句。
【替换】No money but still hungry? No problem! ↔even if they have no money
设问反问 = 让步条件
Anyone who is hungry and wants something to eat can take one, no questions asked and hand it to the staff for some food
↔Have a meal
hand it to the staff for some food = Have a meal

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音第三段确实提到每份饭 each costing about $10，但说的是每张小票背后对应的餐费，并非顾客只要付 $10 就能 Eat as much as they want；选项盗用 $10 这个原词，把它扭成自助式的随便吃，是典型的听到数字就想选式陷阱。
借用原文：each costing about $10
B)
录音第二段说 a donor came in with $100 for each member of its staff，$100 是某位捐赠者发给员工的人均款项，根本不是 a $100 prize 抽奖奖金；选项盗用 $100 这个原词，再嫁接 prize 制造抽奖联想。
借用原文：a donor came in with $100 for each member of its staff
D)
录音里 no questions asked 明确说取餐时不需要回答任何问题，而 Get a free meal after answering some questions 偏偏要求顾客 answering some questions 才能得到免费餐，与原文方向相反；选项盗用 questions 这个原词，却反转了它的语义。
借用原文：no questions asked
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the owner of the restaurant say about the idea for the board of free meals?

options.text: It was brought up by two staffers.
It helped to popularize her restaurant.
It originated from a donation to her staff.
It was suggested by some of her customers.

explanation:
【题目】What does the owner of the restaurant say about the idea for the board of free meals?
【翻译】餐厅老板对免费餐食公告板这个想法是怎么说的?
A) 这是由两名员工提出的。
B) 这帮助推广了她的餐厅。
C) 这源于一笔给她员工的捐款。
D) 这是由她的一些顾客建议的。
【答案】C （细节题）It originated from a donation to her staff.
【定位】The idea for the board of free meals started after a donor came in with $100 for each member of its staff. After two staffers returned to their share, there was $700 leftover according to Tarah Morris, the owner of the restaurant, so they decided to do something more by creating the board.
餐厅老板 Tarah Morris 说，这块免费餐板的点子始于一位捐赠者走进店里、给每位员工100 美元；其中两名员工把自己那份退了回去，于是剩下了 700 美元，他们便决定用这笔钱做点更有意义的事，就这样有了这块板。
【信号】according to + owner 的转述信号。录音里 according to Tarah Morris, the owner of the restaurant 是典型的新闻转述信号，把整段缘起绑定到店主之口，正好对应题干 the owner…say about。听到 according to + 人物身份，就要在心里给整段打上本人原话的标签。

【替换】The idea for the board of free meals started after a donor came in with $100 for each member of its staff
↔originated from a donation
started after = originated from
$100 for each member of its staff ↔to her staff
for each member of its staff = to her staff
【排除】A)
录音里 After two staffers returned to their share 说的是两名员工把分到的 $100 退了回来，他们的动作是 returned，而不是 brought up the idea；选项盗用 two staffers 这个原词，把退款人偷换为想法的提出者，是张冠李戴。
借用原文：After two staffers returned to their share
B)
未提及
店主谈的是 idea 怎么开始的，整段录音从未提及这块板让餐厅本身变得更出名或更受欢迎，popularize her restaurant 在原文中找不到对应信息，是用主题词撑起的无中生有项。
D)
录音里把 idea 的发起归到店主与员工的商量（they decided to do something more by creating the board），并未出现顾客建议的桥段；suggested by some of her customers 把提议人替换成 customers，与原文角色不符，是典型的张冠李戴。
借用原文：they decided to do something more by creating the board

stem: What has happened at Frank's restaurant since the board of free meals was created?

options.text: Fifty customers have offered donations.
More people have been giving than taking.
Many people have come to eat at the restaurant.
Most staffers have received messages of kindness.

explanation:
【题目】What has happened at Frank's restaurant since the board of free meals was created?
【翻译】自从免费餐食公告板创建以来,Frank餐厅发生了什么?
A) 五十位顾客提供了捐款。
B) 付出的人比索取的人更多。
C) 许多人来这家餐厅吃饭。
D) 大多数员工都收到了善意的留言。
【答案】B （细节题）More people have been giving than taking.
【定位】The drive has been going on for two weeks and Morris said just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal. There have been no reports of anyone taking advantage of the situation. In fact, there are a lot more people giving tickets than receiving.
这场公益行动已经持续了两周，Morris 说接近 50 名顾客取走了免费餐；尚未出现任何人趁机占便宜的情况；事实上，捐出小票的人远多于来取走小票的人。

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【信号】In fact 强调真正结论。录音用 In fact, there are a lot more people giving tickets than receiving，In fact 是新闻里典型的强调真正结论的信号词，把前文铺垫与轻描淡写一笔翻起来，落到本则新闻的核心收束。听到 In fact 就要在心里抢一拍：这后面是答案落点。
【替换】there are a lot more people giving tickets than receiving ↔ More people have been giving than taking
more…than 结构原样保留
giving tickets ↔giving
省略宾语而义不变
【排除】A)
录音里 just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal，50 这个数字指的是取走免费餐的顾客接近 50 人，而不是 Fifty customers have offered donations 提供捐款的人；选项盗用 50 这个原词数字，把动作从 picked up 偷换为 offered donations，是经典的数字原词陷阱。
借用原文：just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal
C)
Many people have come to eat at the restaurant 只说很多人来吃饭，是泛化的常识陈述；录音真正强调的是 giving 与 taking 的对比，而不是来店人数。选项盗用 people、eat、restaurant 这类高频主题词，制造听起来都对的错觉。
借用原文：just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal
D)
录音里 The board has messages of kindness like, "If you want more kindness in the world, put it here." 说的是这块板上写满了暖心留言，并不是 Most staffers have received messages of kindness 大多数员工收到了暖心留言；选项盗用 messages of kindness 这一原词短语，把接受方从板偷换成员工，是张冠李戴。
借用原文：The board has messages of kindness
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第10页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the man?

options.text: He is a psychologist.
He is a famous writer.
He is a host for a TV program.
He is a primary school teacher.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the man?
【翻译】关于这位男士我们了解到什么?
A) 他是一位心理学家。
B) 他是一位著名作家。
C) 他是一档电视节目的主持人。
D) 他是一位小学教师。
【答案】A （细节题）He is a psychologist.
【定位】Welcome to our program, Friends and Relationships. Our guest today is psychologist Steve Pinker from McGill University.
欢迎收看我们的节目《朋友与关系》。今天的嘉宾是来自麦吉尔大学的心理学家史蒂夫·平克。
【信号】开场介绍嘉宾的固定句。信号词是 Our guest today is psychologist——「今天的嘉宾是…」是访谈节目报身份的标志句，紧跟其后的名词就是嘉宾职业。
【替换】psychologist Steve Pinker ↔He is a psychologist.
同词直给——但听清职业
【排除】B)
未提及录音通篇没有提到男士是作家，He is a famous writer. 属于无中生有。
C)
原词陷阱
录音里 Welcome to our program 中的 program 确实是「节目」原词，He is a host for a TV program. 故意用 program 引诱，但说「欢迎收看节目」的是女主持人 Jane，男士是「嘉宾」(guest)，不是主持人。
借用原文：Welcome to our program, Friends and Relationships.
D)
未提及
录音从头到尾未提及小学/教师/teach 等任何线索，He is a primary school teacher. 属于完全无中生有。
