stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

options.text: Why social media accounts vanish without a trace.
Why parents raise their children in different ways.
Why people fail to respond to emails promptly.
Why friends break off contact all of a sudden.

explanation:
【题目】What are the speakers mainly talking about?

【翻译】说话者主要在谈论什么?
A) 为什么社交媒体账号会消失得无影无踪。
B) 为什么父母以不同方式抚养孩子。
C) 为什么人们无法及时回复电子邮件。
D) 为什么朋友会突然断绝联系。
【答案】D （主旨题）Why friends break off contact all of a sudden.
【定位】Our question today is why friends suddenly disappear. They may block us on their social media accounts and stop responding to our emails. They simply vanish without a trace.
我们今天的问题是：朋友为什么会突然消失。他们可能会在社交媒体上把我们拉黑、不再回我们的邮件，就这么毫无踪迹地消失了。
【信号】Our question today is… 是节目抛题信号。信号词是 Our question today is why friends suddenly disappear——访谈节目用 Our question today is…/Today we will talk about… 这种句式直接点出本期话题，后面的从句就是主旨。
【替换】why friends suddenly disappear ↔Why friends break off contact all of a sudden.
同义改写——disappear ↔ break off contact，suddenly ↔ all of a sudden
block us on their social media accounts and stop responding to our emails ↔ friends break off contact
详述↔概括
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Why social media accounts vanish without a trace. 抠走了录音里的 social media accounts 和 vanish without a trace 两个原词，听到就想选；但录音说的是「朋友」会通过拉黑社交账号等方式消失，主体是「朋友」，不是「账号本身」——选项把「朋友消失」的一种具体表现错读成了主题，属以偏概全。
借用原文：They may block us on their social media accounts
B)
录音确实在 The answer may lie in childhood, the way the person related to their mom and dad. 谈到了童年与父母关系，但那是嘉宾对「为什么朋友会突然消失」的解释；选项 Why parents raise their children in different ways. 把这个解释方向错抬成了主题，主题是「消失」不是「育儿方式」。
借用原文：The answer may lie in childhood
C)
原词陷阱
Why people fail to respond to emails promptly. 抠走了录音原词 stop responding to our emails，但「不回邮件」只是「朋友消失」的一种具体形态而已，把它当主题同样是以偏概全，且和 A 犯一样的错。
借用原文：stop responding to our emails
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第14页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: How do children with an anxious attachment style react to a breakdown in their relationship with parents?

options.text: They simply shut themselves down.
They avoid showing their emotions.
They scream to get their parents back.
They attempt to ignore the whole situation.

explanation:
【题目】How do children with an anxious attachment style react to a breakdown in their relationship with parents?
【翻译】具有焦虑型依恋风格的儿童如何应对与父母关系的破裂?
A) 他们只是把自己封闭起来。
B) 他们避免表露自己的情绪。
C) 他们通过尖叫来让父母回到身边。
D) 他们试图忽视整个情况。
【答案】C （细节题）They scream to get their parents back.
【定位】When there is a relationship breakdown with their parents, children with an anxious attachment style scream and cry to get their parents to come back. But other children simply shut down and try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation.
当他们和父母的关系破裂时，焦虑型依附的孩子会尖叫、哭闹，把父母叫回来；而另一些孩子则会直接封闭自己，试着通过忽视这种情境来处理自己的情绪。
【信号】对照结构 anxious …. But other children …。信号词是 But other children——嘉宾用But 把两类孩子的反应并排对照。这种对照句是出题铁矿，正确反应几乎都在 But 两侧之一。题干问的是 anxious 那一类，对应 But 前半部分。
【替换】scream and cry to get their parents to come back ↔They scream to get their parents back.
选项几乎是原句裁剪
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
They simply shut themselves down. 抠走了录音原词 simply shut down，听到 simply shut down 就想选；但录音明确说这是 But other children(另一类，即回避型)的反应，不是焦虑型的反应。
借用原文：But other children simply shut down
B)
They avoid showing their emotions. 描述的是「回避情绪」，更接近回避型(But other children…try to deal with their emotions by ignoring)；焦虑型 scream and cry 反而是大力外露情绪，与本选项相反。
借用原文：try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation
D)
原词陷阱
They attempt to ignore the whole situation. 抠走的是录音原词 ignoring the situation，听到就想选；但这同样是 But other children 那一类(回避型)的反应，不是焦虑型的反应。
借用原文：try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第15页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about insecurely attached people?

options.text: They may regard any difference as the end of a relationship.
They are on better terms with friends and romantic partners.
They try to express their feelings and thoughts effectively.
They attach more value to their relationships with others.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about insecurely attached people?
【翻译】这位男士关于不安全依恋型的人说了什么?
A) 他们可能把任何分歧都视为一段关系的终结。
B) 他们与朋友和恋爱伴侣的关系更好。
C) 他们试图有效地表达自己的感受和想法。
D) 他们更加重视与他人的关系。
【答案】A （细节题）They may regard any difference as the end of a relationship.
【定位】However, an insecurely attached person won't. They might either attack you, get defensive, or just disappear from your life. To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals the end of the relationship.
然而，不安全依附的人就不会这样。他们要么攻击你、要么变得防御、要么干脆从你生活里消失。在他们看来，再小的分歧，都意味着这段关系的终结。
【信号】However + To them 双重信号锁定结论。信号词一：However, an insecurely attached person won't——However 是转折信号，前面说安全型怎么处理，转折后才是题干所问的不安全型。信号词二：To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals the end of the relationship.——To them 是对前面群体下定论的总结句，是嘉宾真正要传达给观众的「金句」，几乎必出题。
【替换】To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals the end of the relationship. ↔ They may regard any difference as the end of a relationship.
同义改写——signals ↔ regard…as，no matter how small ↔ any

【排除】B)
They are on better terms with friends and romantic partners. 是正面描述「和朋友/恋人相处更好」，但录音里嘉宾对不安全型的描述是 They might either attack you, get defensive, or just disappear from your life.，是关系处理失败的方向，选项与录音方向完全相反。
借用原文：They might either attack you, get defensive, or just disappear from your life.
C)
原词陷阱
They try to express their feelings and thoughts effectively. 抠走的是录音原词 express their own feelings and thoughts effectively，听到 express…effectively 就想选；但这句话是嘉宾对 securely attached(安全型)人的描述，不是问的不安全型。
借用原文：They're able to hear what the other person is saying and express their own feelings and thoughts effectively.
D)
They attach more value to their relationships with others. 说「他们更看重关系」，录音通篇没有这种说法。相反，录音说他们把小分歧当作关系终结的信号，是「轻易抛弃关系」的方向，不是「更看重关系」。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What makes the man choose to buy jeans made in Japan?

options.text: Their price.
Their color.
Their quality.
Their design.

explanation:
【题目】What makes the man choose to buy jeans made in Japan?
【翻译】是什么让这位男士选择购买日本制造的牛仔裤?
A) 它们的价格。
B) 它们的颜色。
C) 它们的质量。
D) 它们的设计。
【答案】C （细节题）Their quality.
【定位】Also, the fabric they use is of a higher quality and the dyes are natural. They have a denser weave, and are more durable than any other jeans in the world.
而且他们用的面料质量更高，染料是天然的。这种牛仔裤织得更密，比世界上任何其他牛仔裤都更耐用。
【信号】比较级 higher / denser / more durable 集中爆发。the fabric they use is of a higher quality 与 more durable than any other jeans in the world 连用三处比较级——比较级在听力里几乎等同于『考点信号灯』，它在为日本牛仔裤的某项属性给出对比性证据。

【替换】the fabric they use is of a higher quality ↔Their quality.
原文 higher quality 直接对应选项 quality
more durable than any other jeans in the world ↔Their quality.
durable 是 quality 的下位表现
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
原文 They should be around $500. 提到了具体价格，让粗心的考生听到数字就奔『price』；但价格出现在男士交代规格那段，根本不是他选择日本货的『理由』，男士选日本货的理由集中在第 9 段的质量描述，Their price. 是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：They should be around $500.
B)
未提及
全文没有出现任何关于 color 的描述，Their color. 属于无中生有；它和 quality/design 一样是『物品属性词』，被列在这里只为凑成四项并列结构干扰考生。
D)
原词陷阱
原文末段 they're very fashionable too 与 But they are very special 容易让人联想到『款式好』而选 Their design.；但 fashionable/special 在原文里是男士补充说明价格值不值时的次要修饰，不是他选『日本货』的核心理由——核心理由是第 9 段集中讲的质量。
借用原文：they're very fashionable too
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why is the woman puzzled by the man's request?

options.text: Jeans are a typical American garment.
America makes the best-known brands of jeans.
America has the best weaving tools in the world.
Jeans are available in a greater variety in America.

explanation:
【题目】Why is the woman puzzled by the man's request?
【翻译】为什么这位女士对男士的要求感到困惑?
A) 牛仔裤是典型的美国服装。
B) 美国生产最知名品牌的牛仔裤。
C) 美国拥有世界上最好的编织工具。
D) 牛仔裤在美国有更多样化的选择。
【答案】A （细节题）Jeans are a typical American garment.
【定位】Really? I had no idea Japan made jeans. I would have thought America made the best jeans because it's a typical American garment.
真的吗？我都不知道日本还做牛仔裤。我原本以为美国生产最好的牛仔裤，因为牛仔裤是典型的美国服饰。
【信号】心理动词过去式 had no idea / would have thought。I had no idea Japan made jeans 与 I would have thought America made the best jeans 紧跟 because it's a typical American garment——『原本以为…因为它是典型美国服饰』这一句直接交代了女士困惑的根源。
【替换】it's a typical American garment ↔Jeans are a typical American garment.
代词 it 还原为 jeans 后字面等同

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
原文 I would have thought America made the best jeans 与 more durable than any other jeans in the world 都出现了 best 类用语，容易误导考生选含 best-known 的America makes the best-known brands of jeans.；但女士原话说的是 best jeans（最好的牛仔裤），不是 best-known brands（最知名的品牌），后者是偷换概念。
借用原文：I would have thought America made the best jeans
C)
张冠李戴
原文 Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools 说的是『日本』有传统织布工具，America has the best weaving tools in the world. 把这条属性硬安到 America 头上，是典型张冠李戴；同时女士困惑的依据也不是『美国有最好的织布工具』，而是『牛仔裤是美国典型服饰』。
借用原文：Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools
D)
未提及
原文从未做过『美国牛仔裤种类比日本多』的比较，Jeans are available in a greater variety in America. 凭空造出 greater variety 这一比较，属未提及。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第19页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about the dyes of Japanese jeans?

options.text: They are artificial.
They are natural.
They are unique.
They are special.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about the dyes of Japanese jeans?
【翻译】关于日本牛仔裤的染料,男士说了什么?
A) 它们是人工的。
B) 它们是天然的。
C) 它们是独特的。
D) 它们是特殊的。
【答案】B （细节题）They are natural.
【定位】Also, the fabric they use is of a higher quality and the dyes are natural.
而且他们用的面料质量更高，染料是天然的。
【信号】dyes are natural 是关键词后直接表语。the dyes are natural——题干关键词 dyes 在原文里只出现一次，紧跟 are + 形容词 natural，完全是『关键词原句锁定 + 表语取答』的标准结构。
【替换】the dyes are natural ↔They are natural.
原词复现下的指代还原

【排除】A)
与原文相反
They are artificial. 是 the dyes are natural 的直接反义，原文明确说染料是天然的，artificial 与之极性相反，属于反向干扰。
借用原文：the dyes are natural
C)
答非所问
原文整段 9 强调日本牛仔裤独特优良（traditional weaving tools / superior / denser weave），容易让人选 They are unique.；但题干特定问 dyes，原文给的形容词是natural，unique 是把『整段对日本牛仔裤的整体评价』错位安到 dyes 头上。
借用原文：But the end result is surely superior.
D)
答非所问
原文 But they are very special. 中的 special 形容的是『日本牛仔裤这件物品』，不是dyes；They are special. 把整体的 special 嫁接到了局部 dyes 上，与 C 同类错法。
借用原文：But they are very special.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第20页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about Japanese jeans at the end of the conversation?

options.text: They are for casual wearing.
They are popular with boys.
They are much too pricey.
They are worth the price.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about Japanese jeans at the end of the conversation?
【翻译】在对话结束时,男士对日本牛仔裤说了什么?
A) 它们适合休闲穿着。
B) 它们受男孩们欢迎。
C) 它们太贵了。
D) 它们物有所值。
【答案】D （态度观点题）They are worth the price.
【定位】They are a little pricey, yes. But they are very special. Bear in mind, they will last me several years and they're very fashionable too. I think they're totally worth it.
是的，它们是有点贵。但它们很特别。要知道，它们能穿好几年，款式也很时髦。我觉得它们完全值这个价。
【信号】让步 but + 下结论 I think…totally worth it。They are a little pricey, yes. But they are very special. 是让步转折，I think they're totally worth it. 是男士在对话末段亲口下的结论——But 之后才是真意，I think + totally 是态度题答案句的金信号。
【替换】I think they're totally worth it. ↔They are worth the price.
totally worth it 与 worth the price 同义
they will last me several years ↔They are worth the price.
耐用是『值这个价』的下位证据

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
原文 Do you typically spend that much on a pair of casual trousers? 里 casual 出现在女士的反问中，并非男士对 Japanese jeans 的表态；They are for casual wearing. 直接搬走 casual 一词制造熟悉感，但题干特定问『男士说』，casual 不是男士的观点。
借用原文：Do you typically spend that much on a pair of casual trousers?
B)
未提及
原文从未提到日本牛仔裤『在男生中流行』，They are popular with boys. 完全是从『jeans 这种衣物大众印象=年轻男孩穿的』的常识跳过来的，与录音内容无关。
C)
与原文相反
原文 They are a little pricey, yes. 确实承认贵，They are much too pricey. 把这句话强化为『贵得过分』；但男士紧跟一个 But 把态度翻到 totally worth it，C 只取了让步前半、丢了真意。much too pricey 的『过分嫌贵』也与男士的 a little pricey + 值得相矛盾。
借用原文：They are a little pricey, yes.

stem: How does the speaker feel every time he walks out of a superhero movie?

options.text: He desires more in life.
He wants to see it again.
He feels as inspired as other audience members.
He longs to become a superstar himself.

explanation:
【题目】How does the speaker feel every time he walks out of a superhero movie?
【翻译】说话者每次走出超级英雄电影院时感觉如何？
A) 他渴望生活中有更多东西。
B) 他想再看一遍。
C) 他感到和其他观众一样受到鼓舞。
D) 他渴望自己成为超级明星。
【答案】A （细节题）He desires more in life.
【定位】Every time I walk out of a superhero movie, I feel the same way. I experience a sense of longing, realizing that there should be more in life.
每次我走出超级英雄电影的影厅，感受都一样。我体验到一种渴望，意识到生活里应该有更多东西。
【信号】题干与原文几乎同句开篇。Every time I walk out of a superhero movie, I feel the same way. 这句与题干 every time he walks out of a superhero movie 几乎逐词对应，紧跟其后的 I experience a sense of longing, realizing that there should be more in life. 就是对感受的具体说明——一句话点题、下一句给答案，是篇章题最常见的开门见山结构。
【替换】a sense of longing ↔desires
longing 与 desire 同义
there should be more in life ↔more in life
原话直接搬

【排除】B)
未提及
He wants to see it again. 原文从头到尾没说“想再看一遍”，only 说每次走出影院都有同样的感受——这是把“every time（每次都）”误读成了“want to see again（想再看）”。
C)
原词陷阱
He feels as inspired as other audience members. 盗用了原文 being inspired 这个词，但原文是说“hero stories 让人 inspired”是普遍道理，且根本没说“和其他观众一样被启发” ——加了“as … as other audience members”这层比较，是凭空添料。
借用原文：being inspired
D)
He longs to become a superstar himself. 用了 longs 这个 long 的近义动词来引诱，但原文只说“渴望生活里有更多东西”，从未说“渴望自己也成为超级巨星”——这是把抽象的“渴望”过度具体化成“想当超级巨星”。
借用原文：I experience a sense of longing

stem: What does the passage say about the plot of all superhero movies?

options.text: It is rather unrealistic.
It is extremely artistic.
It is somewhat complicated.
It is relatively predictable.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about the plot of all superhero movies?
【翻译】文章关于所有超级英雄电影的情节是怎么说的？
A) 相当不现实。
B) 极具艺术性。
C) 有些复杂。
D) 相对可预测。
【答案】D （细节题）It is relatively predictable.
【定位】The plot of each superhero film has become relatively predictable: the world is in peril, the world needs a hero, the hero is in peril, the hero resolves the peril, the hero saves the world.
每部超级英雄电影的剧情已变得相对可预测：世界陷入危机，世界需要英雄，英雄陷入危机，英雄化解危机，英雄拯救世界。
【信号】题干关键词 plot 原词复现 + 冒号定义式说明。The plot of each superhero film has become relatively predictable 里 plot 与题干 the plot of all superhero movies 是同一指代，冒号后面用“世界陷入危机→英雄出场→英雄解危→拯救世界”五段式具体例证predictable——既给定义又给例证，是答案句的典型信号。
【替换】relatively predictable ↔relatively predictable
原词原义直接复现

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
It is rather unrealistic. 盗用了原文 numerous punches that land unrealistically well 里的 unrealistically，但原文说的是“拳头打得不真实”，是描写动作镜头，不是说整个 plot（剧情）不现实——把局部修饰偷换成整体判断。
借用原文：numerous punches that land unrealistically well
B)
张冠李戴
It is extremely artistic. 里 artistic 一词在原文出现的位置是第 3 段 They say the films lack any form of artistry.——是精英说“缺乏 artistry”，恰好与“extremely artistic”相反；且谈论对象是 films 整体而非 plot。
借用原文：They say the films lack any form of artistry.
C)
It is somewhat complicated. 与原文判断方向相反——第 3 段 These movies are criticized as being too simple. 明说被批评为 too simple（太简单），与 complicated（复杂）完全对立。
借用原文：These movies are criticized as being too simple.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第24页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do the elites of American society think of superhero movies?

options.text: They are biased against women.
They are basically misleading.
They are full of shootings.
They are too simple.

explanation:
【题目】What do the elites of American society think of superhero movies?
【翻译】美国社会的精英阶层对超级英雄电影有什么看法？
A) 它们对女性存有偏见。
B) 它们基本上具有误导性。
C) 它们充满枪战场面。
D) 它们过于简单。
【答案】D （细节题）They are too simple.
【定位】The elites of our society have rejected superhero films. They say the films lack any form of artistry. These movies are criticized as being too simple.
我们社会的精英已经拒绝了超级英雄电影。他们说这些电影毫无艺术性可言。这些电影被批评为太过简单。
【信号】题干主语 elites 原词出现 + 三连否定评价。The elites of our society have rejected superhero films. 中的 elites 与题干 the elites of American society 一致，紧跟 They say与 are criticized 两个评价领句词，连出三句负面评价（rejected / lack any form of artistry / too simple），其中最后一句 too simple 就是核心答案信号。
【替换】These movies are criticized as being too simple. ↔They are too simple.
被动转主动 + too simple 原词复现

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
They are biased against women. 盗用了原文 women desire to play an irreplaceable role 里的 women 一词，但第 4 段是作者引用作家观点说“女性想参与伟大冒险”，跟精英的看法毫无关系；且原文从未说电影“对女性有偏见”。
借用原文：women desire to play an irreplaceable role in a great adventure
B)
过度推断
They are basically misleading. 用 misleading 替换了原文里的批评，但原文精英的批评只有“lack artistry”和“too simple”，没有任何“误导观众”的意思——属于自行升级原文负评的过度推断。
C)
未提及
They are full of shootings. 里的 shootings（枪战）一词在原文里根本没出现，唯一接近的是 numerous punches（拳头），但 punches 是打斗、不是枪战，且这是讲套路不是精英观点。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say about storytelling?

options.text: It can highlight leadership.
It can help connect people.
It is a means to inspire creative thinking.
It is an intuitive way to solidify friendship.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about storytelling?
【翻译】文章关于讲故事说了什么？
A) 它能突出领导力。
B) 它能帮助连接人们。
C) 它是激发创造性思维的手段。
D) 它是巩固友谊的直观方式。
【答案】B （细节题）It can help connect people.
【定位】Storytelling forges connections among people.
讲故事会在人与人之间建立起紧密的联系。
【信号】首段并列直陈句。这是录音开头一气连说的核心结论之一：Telling stories is one of the most powerful means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire. 之后紧跟Storytelling forges connections among people.，用 forges 这个动作动词直接给storytelling 下功能判断，是典型的『答案落在直陈结论句』的信号。
【替换】forges connections among people ↔help connect people
动词同义＋名转动
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音首句出现 means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire，A 项把 leaders 与leadership 嫁接成 highlight leadership，听到 leaders 就想选 A 是典型原词陷阱；但原文是说『讲故事是领导者影响他人的手段』，并未说讲故事能突显领导力。
借用原文：means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire
C)
原词陷阱
录音里出现 influence, teach and inspire，inspire 的宾语并不是 creative thinking；C 项把 inspire 抓出来后强行接上 creative thinking，构成『词对了搭配错了』的原词陷阱。
借用原文：influence, teach and inspire
D)
偷换概念
原文第二段确实有 help solidify relationships，D 项把 solidify 留住、把 relationships 偷换成 friendship，缩小了范围。讲故事建立的是各种关系（包括职场关系），不专指友谊。
借用原文：help solidify relationships
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第27页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What can good stories do to listeners according to the passage?

options.text: Allow them to recite data points.
Make them more open to learning.
Enable them to remember the main idea.
Stimulate them to engage in discussions.

explanation:
【题目】What can good stories do to listeners according to the passage?
【翻译】根据文章，好的故事能对听众产生什么作用？
A) 让他们背诵数据要点。
B) 使他们更愿意学习。
C) 使他们能够记住主要观点。
D) 激励他们参与讨论。
【答案】B （细节题）Make them more open to learning.
【定位】They allow the listener to enter the story, making them more open to learning.
好故事让听者走进故事里，从而使他们更愿意去学习新东西。
【信号】主语 They + listener 直接出现。第三段开头 Good stories do more than create a sense of connection. 起句后，紧跟一句 They allow the listener to enter the story, making them more open to learning。主语 They 回指 Good stories、对象 listener 直接出现，是题干两要素正合的句子，几乎一定是答案句。
【替换】making them more open to learning ↔more open to learning
几乎原句搬运
【排除】A)
与原文相反
录音里讲 more engaging than the recital of data points，意思是故事比『罗列数据』更吸引人——『让听众背数据』恰恰是讲故事要避免的反例。A 项把这个反向参照偷换成『允许他们背数据』，方向反了。
借用原文：more engaging than the recital of data points
C)
偷换概念
录音说 Good stories can contain multiple meanings, so they're surprisingly economical in conveying complex ideas in graspable ways.，意思是故事能以可理解的方式传达复杂观点，但没说『让听者记住 main idea』。C 项把 graspable ways 与conveying ideas 模糊归并成『记住主旨』，属于概念偷换。
借用原文：conveying complex ideas in graspable ways
D)
原词陷阱
录音里既出现 more engaging than the recital of data points or a discussion of abstract ideas，D 项就把 engage 和 discussion 拼凑成 engage in discussions，但原文是把『抽象观点的讨论』当成对照面，并不是说故事让听者参与讨论。
借用原文：a discussion of abstract ideas
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第28页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What can leaders do with a simple personal story?

options.text: Inspire listeners' imagination.
Convey fundamental values.
Enrich their own experience.
Explain insightful ideas.

explanation:
【题目】What can leaders do with a simple personal story?
【翻译】领导者可以用一个简单的个人故事做什么？
A) 激发听众的想象力。
B) 传达基本价值观。
C) 丰富他们自己的经验。
D) 解释富有洞察力的想法。
【答案】B （细节题）Convey fundamental values.
【定位】with a simple personal story, they can convey fundamental values.
凭借一个简单的个人故事，领导者就能传递出根本性的价值观。
【信号】题干双锚点同句出现。第四段中 with a simple personal story, they can convey fundamental values 一句同时出现 simple personal story（与题干 a simple personal story 完全对应）与代词 they（回指上文的 leaders），是题干两个关键词联合命中的句子，必然就是答案承载句。
【替换】convey fundamental values ↔Convey fundamental values
原句搬运
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音末句出现 they are more likely to inspire others to want to know more，A 项把inspire 抓出来后接上 listeners' imagination，但原文是说激发别人『想了解更多』而非激发『想象力』；inspire 的宾语被偷换了。
借用原文：inspire others to want to know more
C)
张冠李戴
录音里 They can offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge，their own experience 指的是 leaders 自己的经验，而且动作是『提供洞察』而非『丰富经验』；C 项把『让别人看见自己的经验』偷换成『丰富他们的经验』，主体与动作都偏了。
借用原文：offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge
D)
原词陷阱
录音里出现 offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge，D 项 Explain insightful ideas. 用 insightful 这个同根词钓人，但原文动作是『提供对自身经验演变的洞见』，不是『解释富有洞见的观点』；同根词＋搭配错位是典型陷阱。
借用原文：offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第29页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say statistics prove?

options.text: Immigrants outnumber U.S.-born Americans.
Immigrants have been contributing to the U.S.
Another wave of immigrants is hitting the U.S.
The number of immigrants to the U.S. is declining.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say statistics prove?
【翻译】文章说统计数据证明了什么?
A) 移民人数超过在美国出生的美国人。
B) 移民一直在为美国做贡献。
C) 另一波移民潮正在冲击美国。
D) 移民美国的人数正在下降。

【答案】B （细节题）Immigrants have been contributing to the U.S.
【定位】The U.S. was founded by successive waves of immigrants, and immigrants are still contributing to America today—statistics prove it.
美国是由一波又一波的移民建立的，而移民们今天仍在为美国做出贡献——统计数据证明了这一点。
【信号】开头点题 + 题干关键词 statistics 原词出现。这句话出现在 P1，正是篇章的开篇点题句；题干里的关键词 statistics prove 在原文里以 statistics prove it 原词出现，it 指代的就是前半句 immigrants are still contributing to America today——这是典型的「代词回指找答案」信号。
【替换】immigrants are still contributing to America today ↔ Immigrants have been contributing to the U.S.
are still contributing today 与 have been contributing 的时态同义改写
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 Immigrants outnumber U.S.-born Americans. 把录音里反复出现的 immigrants 和后文 U.S.-born individuals 拼到一起，编造出「移民人数超过本土美国人」的关系，但原文从未比较两群体的人数。
借用原文：From 1996 to 2016, the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.-born individuals.
C)
原词陷阱
选项 Another wave of immigrants is hitting the U.S. 盗用了原文 successive waves of immigrants 里的 wave 一词，但原文说的是「美国由一波波移民建立」，不是「现在又来一波」，时间和事件都被改了。
借用原文：The U.S. was founded by successive waves of immigrants
D)
与原文相反
选项 The number of immigrants to the U.S. is declining. 说移民数量在下降，但原文immigrants are still contributing to America today 强调的是移民在持续贡献，且后文还说从 1996 到 2016 移民创业速度是本土的两倍，整体方向是积极的，不存在数量下降。
借用原文：immigrants are still contributing to America today
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第31页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about immigrants in the U.S., compared with native-born Americans?

options.text: More of them expect their children to succeed in business.
They have fewer chances to be hired by U.S. companies.
They have founded most Fortune 500 companies.
More of them are successful business people.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about immigrants in the U.S., compared with native-born Americans?

【翻译】与在美国出生的美国人相比,我们对美国移民了解到什么?
A) 他们当中更多人期望自己的孩子在商业上取得成功。
B) 他们被美国公司雇用的机会更少。
C) 他们创立了大多数财富500强公司。
D) 他们当中更多人是成功的商业人士。
【答案】D （细节题）More of them are successful business people.
【定位】From 1996 to 2016, the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.- born individuals. Immigrants aren't just becoming entrepreneurs more frequently. They're often succeeding. Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one.
从 1996 年到 2016 年，移民创业的速度是美国本土出生者的两倍。移民不仅创业更频繁，而且经常获得成功。超过 40% 的财富 500 强公司，其创始人要么是移民，要么是移民的子女。
【信号】比较结构 double that of + 递进 aren't just…They're often succeeding。double that of U.S.-born individuals 是与题干 compared with native-born Americans 直接对应的比较信号；紧接着的 Immigrants aren't just becoming entrepreneurs more frequently. They're often succeeding. 是 not just…but also 类递进结构，递进后面的succeeding 是这道题的真正落点。
【替换】Immigrants aren't just becoming entrepreneurs more frequently. They're often succeeding. ↔ More of them are successful business people.
「entrepreneurs + succeeding」概括为「successful business people」
Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one ↔More of them are successful business people.
用 Fortune 500 创始人占比作为「成功生意人多」的具象证据
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 More of them expect their children to succeed in business. 盗用了原文 the child of one 里的 child，编出「期望子女在事业上成功」这一根本没说的意思。原文只是说Fortune 500 创始人有的是移民、有的是移民子女，并未提及移民对子女的期望。
借用原文：Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one.
B)
与原文相反
选项 They have fewer chances to be hired by U.S. companies. 说移民被美国公司雇佣的机会更少，但原文整段说的是移民自己创业、自己当 founder，根本不是「被雇佣」的角度，更没说机会更少。
借用原文：the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.- born individuals
C)
原词陷阱
选项 They have founded most Fortune 500 companies. 盗用了录音里非常醒目的Fortune 500，但原文是 Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one，是「超过 40%」且「创始人之一是移民或移民子女」，绝不是 most（大多数）。这是典型的范围/程度被偷改。
借用原文：Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one.

stem: What does the passage say about immigrants in the U.S., in terms of financial strength?

options.text: They have higher installment loan debt than native-born Americans.
Nineteen percent of them borrow money from friends and family.
Their level of debt is lower than that of native-born Americans.
Thirty-four percent of them use credit for their daily purchases.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about immigrants in the U.S., in terms of financial strength?
【翻译】就财务实力而言,文章对美国移民说了什么?
A) 他们的分期贷款债务高于在美国出生的美国人。
B) 他们当中有百分之十九的人从朋友和家人那里借钱。
C) 他们的债务水平低于在美国出生的美国人。
D) 他们当中有百分之三十四的人使用信贷进行日常购物。
【答案】C （细节题）Their level of debt is lower than that of native-born Americans.
【定位】Another key measure of financial strength is debt level. Immigrants do better in this area too. Immigrants use credit less often for purchasing cars, homes or starting businesses. This results in significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans.
另一项衡量经济实力的关键指标是债务水平。移民在这方面表现也更好。移民较少使用信贷购买汽车、住房或创业。这使得他们的债务水平显著低于美国本土出生者。

【信号】比较结构 lower…than + 因果信号 This results in。significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans 是与题干 compared with native-born Americans 完全对应的比较句；前面的 This results in 是因果信号，把「少用信贷」的原因和「债务更低」的结果连起来，使这句成为本段的核心结论句。
【替换】This results in significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans. ↔ Their level of debt is lower than that of native-born Americans.
几乎是原文的「近义同结构改写」
【排除】A)
与原文相反
选项 They have higher installment loan debt than native-born Americans. 盗用了原文installment loan debt，但原文明确说移民的债务「显著更低」，这里却说「更高」，方向完全反掉。
借用原文：This results in significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans.
B)
张冠李戴
选项 Nineteen percent of them borrow money from friends and family. 盗用了原文just 19% of the general population 里的 19% 和后文 they borrow money from friends and family 中的借钱方式，但 19% 在原文里指的是 general population（一般人口）里「没有信用卡或分期贷款债务」的比例，根本不是「19% 的移民找亲友借钱」。两个原词被强行拼到一起，是典型的张冠李戴。
借用原文：just 19% of the general population
D)
原词陷阱
选项 Thirty-four percent of them use credit for their daily purchases. 盗用了原文 34% of Americans born in Latin America 的 34%，但原文是说 34% 的拉美裔美国人「没有」信用卡或分期贷款债务，选项却说「34% 的人用信用卡做日常消费」，对象不对、行为也反过来了，还加上了 daily purchases 这个原文没有的限定。
借用原文：34% of Americans born in Latin America report no credit card or installment loan debt.

stem: What do immigrants do to achieve their goals in the U.S.?

options.text: Keep their traditional values and old habits.
Find employment in competitive businesses.
Borrow money from financial institutions.
Collaborate with native-born Americans.

explanation:
【题目】What do immigrants do to achieve their goals in the U.S.?
【翻译】移民在美国做什么来实现他们的目标?
A) 保持他们的传统价值观和旧习惯。
B) 在竞争激烈的行业中找到工作。
C) 从金融机构借钱。
D) 与在美国出生的美国人合作。
【答案】A （细节题）Keep their traditional values and old habits.

【定位】Why are immigrants doing so well? The values and habits they bring from their own homelands help explain some of the success.
为什么移民们做得这么好？他们从故乡带来的价值观与习惯，可以解释他们部分的成功。
【信号】设问句 Why + 解释句中的 values and habits。Why are immigrants doing so well? 是篇章独白里典型的设问句，紧接着的 The values and habits they bring from their own homelands help explain some of the success. 是直接回答这个设问的解释句，整段功能就是「解释移民达成目标的原因」。这是篇章独白里最强的「答案信号」之一。
【替换】The values and habits they bring from their own homelands ↔ Keep their traditional values and old habits.
「从故乡带来的价值观和习惯」=「保留传统价值观和旧习惯」
individuals must save more in order to achieve their goals ↔ Keep their traditional values and old habits.
in order to achieve their goals 与题干呼应，save more 是 old habits 的具体表现
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
选项 Find employment in competitive businesses. 盗用了原文反复出现的 businesses，但原文说的是移民自己 started businesses（自己创业），而非 find employment（找工作被雇佣），且原文从未提及行业「竞争激烈」。
借用原文：the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.- born individuals
C)
与原文相反
选项 Borrow money from financial institutions. 盗用了原文 they borrow money from friends and family rather than a bank 里的 borrow money，但原文明确说移民是「找亲友借，而不是找银行」，financial institutions（金融机构）正好就是 bank 那一边，选项把方向反掉了。rather than 是这道题的关键否定信号。
借用原文：they borrow money from friends and family rather than a bank
D)
未提及
选项 Collaborate with native-born Americans. 提出「与本土美国人合作」，但全文只出现「移民 vs 本土美国人」的对比，从未提及二者合作。属于无中生有。

【选项】A)
过度推断
原文只说超市利润薄、处境难，从未说它"正走向破产"；on the way to bankruptcy把"利润薄"夸大成"濒临破产"，程度严重超出原文。
B)
✓ 正确
thinnest-margined businesses ↔losing customers and profits
under attack from e-commerce giants ↔losing customers
预判落在"生意难做、客流利润受损"，四个选项里只有 They have been losing customers and profits. 同时覆盖了原文的"利润薄"和"受电商攻击"，与预判最契合。
C)
偷换概念
原文说超市"受电商攻击"，并没说它们"被迫去采用电商策略"；forced to use e-commerce strategies 把"被攻击"偷换成"被迫效仿"，是原文未提的内容。
D)
偷换概念
原文是超市"被指责加剧气候变化"（超市是被指责方），而 have difficulty adapting to climate change 说成"超市难以适应气候变化"，把"被指责制造问题"换成了"自己适应不了"。

stem: What does the passage say about the idea of a self-service grocery?

options.text: It was put forward by King Kullen.
It originated in the United States.
It has been under constant debate.
It proves revolutionary even today.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the passage say about the idea of a self-service grocery? 问的是原文就这个想法"说了什么"，是对原文具体陈述的核对，属细节题。
【拆句】What does the passage say about the idea of a self-service grocery? 主干是"原文关于这个想法说了什么"，of the idea of a self-service grocery 是层层嵌套的 of 介词短语作后置定语，只是在限定"哪个想法"，剥掉修饰后主干很清楚，无理解陷阱。
【定位】The revolutionary idea of a self-service grocery, where people could hunt and gather food from aisles rather than asking a clerk to fetch items from behind a counter, first came about in America.
让人们能在货架间自行寻找采集食物、而不必请店员从柜台后取货的自助式杂货这一革命性想法，最早出现在美国。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
原文说金库伦是公认的"第一家超市"，并未说这个"想法"是金库伦"提出"的；put forward by King Kullen 把"第一家店"错安成"想法的提出者"。
B)
✓ 正确
first came about in America ↔It originated in the United States.
预判核心是"起源地是美国"，四项里只有 It originated in the United States. 准确对应定位句的起源信息，故锁定。
C)
偷换概念
原文 some debate about which was the very first 争论的是"哪家是第一家店"，而非"这个想法本身"；under constant debate 把争论对象由"谁是第一家"偷换成"这个想法"。
D)
与原文相反
原文只说该想法当年是 revolutionary，并称超市 may not feel cutting-edge now（如今未必前沿），并无"至今仍具革命性"之说；proves revolutionary even today 是原文没有的论断。

stem: What did supermarkets do by adopting the Fordist factory approach?

options.text: They modernized traditional groceries in many ways.
They introduced cutting-edge layout of their stores.
They improved the quality of the food they sold.
They revolutionized the distribution of goods.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What did supermarkets do by adopting the Fordist factory approach? 问超市靠这一做法"做成了什么"，是对原文一个具体结果的核对，属细节题。
【拆句】What did supermarkets do by adopting the Fordist factory approach? 主干是"超市做了什么"，by adopting... 是 by + 动名词的方式状语，表示"通过采用福特式工厂做法这一手段"，by 在此不是"被"而是"通过"，基础薄弱者易误读，点明即可。
【定位】The supermarket imitated the Fordist factory, with its emphasis on efficiency and standardization, and reimagined it as a place to buy food. Supermarkets may not feel cutting-edge now, but they were a revolution in distribution at the time.
超市模仿了讲求效率与标准化的福特式工厂，并把它重新设想成一个买食物的地方。超市如今也许感觉不再前沿，但它们在当时是分销领域的一场革命。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文只说超市模仿福特工厂、成为分销革命，没说它"在许多方面把传统杂货店现代化"；modernized traditional groceries in many ways 是原文未提的笼统说法。
B)
与原文相反
原文紧接着说超市 may not feel cutting-edge now（如今未必前沿），且布局九十年几乎没变，并非"引入了前沿布局"；cutting-edge layout 与原文意思相反。
C)
无中生有
原文谈的是分销方式的革命，全程未涉及"食品质量"的提升；improved the quality of the food 在原文找不到任何依据。
D)
✓ 正确
a revolution in distribution ↔They revolutionized the distribution of goods.
预判核心是"在分销上掀起革命"，四项里只有 They revolutionized the distribution of goods. 与定位句 a revolution in distribution 直接等值，故锁定。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What is the typical supermarket layout intended to do?

options.text: Arouse customers' appetite to buy flowers, fruit and vegetables.
Provide customers easy access to items they want to buy.
Induce customers to make more unplanned purchases.
Enable customers to have a more enjoyable shopping experience.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What is the typical supermarket layout intended to do? 问布局的具体意图，是对原文一处目的陈述的核对，属细节题。
【拆句】What is the typical supermarket layout intended to do? 主干是"布局意在做什么"，be intended to do 是"被设计用来做……"的固定结构，是被动语态，主语 layout 是被设计的对象，看懂这个被动是解题前提，结构上无其他陷阱。
【定位】Meanwhile, they keep the milk, eggs, and other daily basics all the way back so you'll travel through as much of the store as possible, and be tempted along the way.
与此同时，超市把牛奶、鸡蛋等日用必需品全放在最里面，好让你穿过尽可能多的店面，一路上被诱惑。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
原文说前端摆鲜花果蔬只是 a breath of freshness to arouse our appetite（唤起食欲）的一个手段，最终目的是让人走遍全店；appetite to buy flowers, fruit and vegetables 把局部手段当成了整体布局的意图。
B)
与原文相反
原文布局恰恰把必需品放到最里、逼顾客绕远，并非"方便顾客买想买的东西"；easy access to items they want to buy 与原文意图相反。
C)
✓ 正确
travel through as much of the store as possible, and be tempted along the way ↔ Induce customers to make more unplanned purchases.
预判核心是"让顾客多走多买计划外的东西"，四项里只有 Induce customers to make more unplanned purchases. 抓住了布局的真实意图，故锁定。
D)
无中生有
原文讲的是诱导顾客多买，从未说布局是为"让购物更愉快"；more enjoyable shopping experience 是原文没有的说法。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页

stem: What have people long feared about supermarkets?

options.text: They use tricky strategies to promote their business.
They are going to replace the local groceries entirely.
They apply corporate black magic to the goods on display.
They take advantage of the weaknesses of women shoppers.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What have people long feared about supermarkets? 问人们长期害怕的具体内容，是对原文一处陈述的核对，属细节题。
【拆句】What have people long feared about supermarkets? 主干是"人们长期害怕超市什么"，have long feared 是现在完成时夹一个副词 long，强调"长久以来一直害怕"，about supermarkets 是 fear 的对象，结构清楚无陷阱。
【定位】We have long feared that this "revolution in distribution" uses corporate black magic on our appetite.
长期以来我们一直害怕，这场"分销革命"在用企业的黑魔法操纵我们的食欲。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
uses corporate black magic on our appetite ↔ They use tricky strategies to promote their business.
预判核心是"用隐秘手段操纵食欲"，四项里只有 They use tricky strategies to promote their business. 把"黑魔法"这一比喻还原为"狡猾手段"，与定位句契合，故锁定。
B)
无中生有
原文讲的是人们怕超市操纵食欲，全程未提"取代本地杂货店"；replace the local groceries entirely 是原文没有的内容。
C)
偷换概念
原文是黑魔法用在 our appetite（我们的食欲）上，而 black magic to the goods on display 把作用对象偷换成"陈列的商品"，对象张冠李戴。
D)
以偏概全
关于女性的内容出自被引用的《隐形说客》一书、只是个例证，并非人们"长期"害怕的核心；weaknesses of women shoppers 拿书中一个局部例子当成了普遍的担忧。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页

stem: Why did America's traditional school year have a three-month summer vacation?

options.text: Students needed to help with farm work.
Students needed time to learn necessary farming skills.
The agricultural society then attached less importance to academics.
America lagged behind other countries in making a scientific school calendar.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】Why did America's traditional school year have a three-month summer vacation? 问一个写在文中的具体事实原因，答案应能在原文直接找到。
【拆句】Q51 是一个 Why 引导的特殊疑问句，主干就是 school year have a three-month summer vacation，没有从句也没有否定，结构平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【定位】The traditional school year, with three months of vacation every summer, was first implemented when America was an agricultural society and the summer months were needed for farm work.
传统学年带有每年夏季三个月假期，它最初设立于美国还是农业社会、夏季几个月需要用于农活的时候。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
the summer months were needed for farm work ↔Students needed to help with farm work
预判的"夏天要干农活"与 Students needed to help with farm work 完全吻合，故锁定此项。
B)
无中生有
原文只说夏季需要去做农活，从未提学生需要时间去"学习"农业技能，learn necessary farming skills 文中没有依据。
C)
无中生有
原文只说当时是农业社会、夏天要务农，并未说农业社会 attached less importance to academics，这是文中没有的因果。
D)
张冠李戴
America lagged behind other countries 出自第二段 With the U.S. lagging behind other countries in academics，那是"如今"现状，并非当初设三个月暑假的原因，张冠李戴。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页

stem: What benefit will year-round schooling bring students in addition to improving their learning?

options.text: It will help them get back to where their lessons started.
It will enable them to absorb what they have learned.
It will familiarize them with the school environment.
It will strengthen their relationship with teachers.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What benefit will year-round schooling bring students in addition to improving their learning? 问一项写在文中的具体好处，属可直接核对的事实。
【拆句】Q52 主干是 What benefit will year-round schooling bring students，后接介词短语in addition to improving their learning 作限定，提醒答案要排除学业类好处，是理解关键。
【定位】But year-round schooling isn't just about academics. Teachers and students experience a closer relationship in year-round schools than they do in traditional schools and, in the absence of any long-term break, students do not feel detached from the school environment.
但全年制不仅仅关乎学业。在全年制学校里，师生关系比在传统学校里更亲近，而且由于没有任何长期假期，学生不会感到与校园环境疏离。
【选项】A)
答非所问
get back to where their lessons started 套用第二段 get back to where they were，那讲的是暑期遗忘后补回进度，属学业范畴，被题干限定排除，且原文是消除这一损耗而非"帮学生回到起点"。
B)
答非所问
absorb what they have learned 仍是讲学习吸收，属 improving their learning 范畴，被题干"除学业外"排除。
C)
偷换概念
原文说的是学生 do not feel detached from the school environment（不疏离），并非 familiarize them with the school environment（使其熟悉环境），把"不疏远"偷换成"变熟悉"。
D)
✓ 正确
Teachers and students experience a closer relationship ↔ strengthen their relationship with teachers
预判的"师生关系更近"正对应 strengthen their relationship with teachers，且它落在"学业之外"的范围内，故选此项。

stem: What do some childhood development experts believe about the long summer vacation?

options.text: It meets students' need to study on their own.
It enables students to learn about the outside world.
It satisfies students' desire to stay longer at home.
It contributes to students' healthy growth.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What do some childhood development experts believe about the long summer vacation? 问的是专家在文中直接表述的观点，可逐字核对，不需要读者推断。
【拆句】Q53 主干 What do some childhood development experts believe，后接 about the long summer vacation 点明评论对象；注意主语是 experts 而非作者，是"这话谁说的"的关键。
【定位】Some childhood development experts believe that time off from school is vital to healthy development as kids are not designed to spend so much of their time inside classrooms and the summer break provides a perfect opportunity to get outside.
一些儿童发展专家认为，离开学校的休息时间对健康成长至关重要，因为孩子天生不适合把这么多时间花在教室里，而暑假正好提供了走到户外的绝佳机会。
【选项】A)
无中生有
专家强调的是休息和户外，从未说放假满足学生 study on their own（自学）的需要，原文无此意。
B)
过度推断
原文只说暑假给孩子 a perfect opportunity to get outside（到户外的机会），并不等于 learn about the outside world（了解外部世界），后者把"到户外"拔高成"认识世界"。
C)
张冠李戴
专家观点里没有"满足学生 stay longer at home"的说法；待在家看电视是后文作者反驳时提到的现实，并非专家所赞同的需求。
D)
✓ 正确
time off from school is vital to healthy development ↔ It contributes to students' healthy growth
预判的"放假利于健康成长"正对应 It contributes to students' healthy growth，故选此项。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What is the argument against the experts' idea of a long summer vacation?

options.text: It does little good to most students.
It benefits few students playing outside.
It leads students to neglect their studies.
It makes students addicted to computer games.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What is the argument against the experts' idea of a long summer vacation? 问一个写在文中的具体反驳理由，可直接核对。
【拆句】Q54 主干 What is the argument against the experts' idea，介词 against 决定方向是"反对专家"；读懂 against 才不会把专家自己的话误当反驳，是理解关键。
【定位】The problem with this argument is that most children aren't playing outside or even spending time with other kids. While some children visit summer camps, most stay at home, watching TV or playing games on electronic devices, which hardly benefits them.
这个论点的问题在于，大多数孩子并没有在户外玩耍，甚至没有和别的孩子相处。虽然有些孩子去参加夏令营，但多数人待在家里看电视或玩电子设备上的游戏，这对他们几乎没有好处。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
most stay at home, watching TV or playing games on electronic devices, which hardly benefits them
↔It does little good to most students
预判的"对多数孩子没好处"正对应 It does little good to most students，故选此项。
B)
以偏概全
原文 hardly benefits them 说的是待在家的"多数"孩子没好处，benefits few students playing outside 却把对象缩成"在外面玩的少数"，偷改了范围。
C)
无中生有
作者反驳讲的是放假对孩子无益，并未说放假让学生 neglect their studies（荒废学业），文中无此意。
D)
以偏概全
原文把看电视和玩电子设备游戏并列为现象之一，并未断言放假使学生 addicted to computer games（沉迷电脑游戏），把众多居家活动之一夸成"上瘾"。

stem: What does the author think of the traditional school year in the U.S. today?

options.text: Well-grounded.
Culture-bound.
Outdated.
Welcomed.

explanation:
【答案】C （态度题）
【判型】What does the author think of the traditional school year in the U.S. today? 问的是作者对旧学制的整体评价，需通览全文立场而非某句。
【拆句】Q55 主干 What does the author think of the traditional school year，关键是 today ——问的是"在今天看来"旧学制如何，提示要结合文章"时代已变"的论调判断，是解题关键。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
Well-grounded（有充分根据的）是褒义，意味旧学制合理；而作者全篇主张它该改，态度恰好相反。
B)
无中生有
文章把旧学制归因于"农业经济"这一时代背景，并未从"文化"角度评价，Culture-bound（受文化局限）在原文找不到落点。
C)
✓ 正确
The U.S. has changed from a farming economy to a knowledge- and innovation-based economy, so it makes sense for the school year to change as well
↔Outdated
预判的"旧学制已不合时宜、该改"与 Outdated 一词对应，故选此项。
D)
与原文相反
Welcomed（受欢迎的）是褒义，暗示作者赞许旧学制；而作者主张它该改、显然不持欢迎态度，方向相反。

stem: Why are many employees opposed to team-building exercises?

options.text: They consider such exercises annoying.
They deem these exercises counter-productive.
They see such exercises as harmful to harmony.
They find these exercises too demanding.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】Why are many employees opposed to team-building exercises? 用 Why 提问，问的是原文已写明的具体理由，不需要跨段推理。
【拆句】题干 Why are many employees opposed to team-building exercises? 是一般疑问句，主干为员工反对团建练习，be opposed to 是固定搭配表示反对、抵触，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Unfortunately many employees resent compulsory bonding and often regard these exercises as a nuisance.
遗憾的是，许多员工反感被强制团建，并常把这些练习视为一种麻烦。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
regard these exercises as a nuisance ↔consider such exercises annoying
resent ↔annoying
预判员工嫌团建烦人，They consider such exercises annoying 正是定位句 regard these exercises as a nuisance 的同义改写，故锁定该项。
B)
无中生有
counter-productive 指适得其反、降低生产力，原文只说员工嫌烦，从未说团建会起反作用，属凭空添加。
C)
与原文相反
harmful to harmony 称团建有害于和谐，但原文 increase organisational and team harmony 说团建本意是增进和谐，选项把目的反说成危害。
D)
答非所问
too demanding 指要求过高、太费力，这是 on top of their busy jobs 一带而过的另一层意思，并非第 46 题问的反对的主要原因。

stem: What did Dr. Matous and his team do to find out whether team-building activities would improve productivity?

options.text: They relocated team leaders and their offices.
They rearranged the staff and office spaces.
They redesigned the staff's work schedules.
They reintroduced some cohesive activities.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What did Dr. Matous and his team do 问的是研究团队具体做了什么，答案是原文明写的动作清单，属事实查找。
【拆句】题干主干是 What did Dr. Matous and his team do，后接不定式目的状语 to find out whether...，其中 whether 引导宾语从句表示是否提升效率；理清主干问做法、状语说目的，即无障碍。
【定位】Teams are formed, combined and restructured. Staff are relocated and office spaces redesigned. All this is done with the aim of improving workplace efficiency, collaboration and cohesion.
团队被组建、合并、重组。员工被调岗，办公空间被重新设计。所有这些都是为了提升工作效率、协作与凝聚力。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
relocated team leaders 只说调动了团队领导，而原文 Staff are relocated 指全体员工，选项把范围悄悄缩小到领导一类人。
B)
✓ 正确
Staff are relocated ↔rearranged the staff
office spaces redesigned ↔office spaces
预判为调动员工与办公空间，They rearranged the staff and office spaces 把两个动作合并改写，与定位句一一对应，故锁定该项。
C)
偷换概念
redesigned the staff's work schedules 说重新设计的是工作日程，但原文redesigned 的对象是 office spaces 办公空间，选项偷换了被改造的对象。
D)
无中生有
reintroduced some cohesive activities 说重新引入凝聚性活动，原文从未提及重新引入活动这一动作，纯属添加。

stem: What did the study by Matous' team find about some team-building exercises?

options.text: They were intended to share personal attitudes and relationships.
They implicitly added to the vulnerability of team members.
They invariably strengthened connections among colleagues.
They were regarded as an intrusion into employees' private lives.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What did the study by Matous' team find about some team-building exercises? 问的是研究已写明的发现，可直接定位明文结论，属细节查找。
【拆句】题干 What did the study by Matous' team find about some team-building exercises?主干为研究发现了什么，about 引出对象范围；注意 some 限定的是部分团建练习而非全部，是本题理解关键。
【定位】The study found that team-building exercises which focused on the sharing of and intervening into personal attitudes and relationships between team members were considered too heavy-handed and intrusive, although the researchers say some degree of openness and vulnerability is often necessary to make deep, effective connections with colleagues.
研究发现，那些聚焦于分享并干预团队成员个人态度与关系的团建练习，被认为过于强硬且具有侵入性，尽管研究者表示，某种程度的开放与脆弱往往是与同事建立深层有效联系所必需的。
【选项】A)
答非所问
intended to share personal attitudes and relationships 说团建意在分享个人态度关系，但 focused on the sharing of... 是研究者对这类团建特征的客观描述，且本题问的是研究的发现而非团建的意图。
B)
与原文相反
added to the vulnerability 称团建增加了成员的脆弱，但原文 some degree of...vulnerability is often necessary 说一定程度的脆弱是建立联系所必需的，并非团建恶意制造脆弱。
C)
过度推断
invariably strengthened connections 说团建无一例外地增进了联系，但原文只说脆弱开放是建立联系所必需的前提，且整段强调这类团建被嫌侵入，并未说它总能增进联系。
D)
✓ 正确
intrusive ↔an intrusion into employees' private lives
interest in their lives beyond their direct work performance ↔into employees' private lives
预判某团建被嫌强硬侵入，They were regarded as an intrusion into employees' private lives 把 intrusive 与 P6 对私生活的窥探合并改写，完全对应。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: How can the self-disclosure approach succeed in increasing interpersonal closeness?

options.text: By allowing participants freedom to express themselves.
By applying it to employees who volunteer to participate.
By arranging in proper order the questions participants face.
By guiding employees through a series of steps in team building.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】How can the self-disclosure approach succeed in increasing interpersonal closeness?问的是原文明写的成功前提，可直接定位，属细节题。
【拆句】题干 How can the self-disclosure approach succeed in increasing interpersonal closeness? 主干问该方法如何才能成功，succeed in doing 是固定搭配表示成功做到某事；结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】The method is well-tested and has been shown to increase interpersonal closeness. However, to be successful it must be voluntary.
该方法经过充分检验，已被证明能增进人际亲密。然而，要想成功，它必须是自愿的。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
freedom to express themselves 说让参与者自由表达，但原文规定的成功条件是voluntary 自愿参加，而非表达自由，选项偷换了条件的内容。
B)
✓ 正确
it must be voluntary ↔employees who volunteer to participate
预判成功须自愿，By applying it to employees who volunteer to participate 把voluntary 落实为只对自愿参与者使用，与定位句完全对应。
C)
答非所问
arranging in proper order the questions 说按顺序排好问题，这是 guided through a series of questions 描述的方法本身，而非题干所问的成功前提。
D)
偷换概念
guiding employees through a series of steps in team building 把自我表露法说成团建中的引导步骤，原文的 a series of questions 是问题不是团建步骤，且仍未触及自愿这一成功条件。

stem: What does Matous think of the various psychological methods borrowed from other fields for strengthening relationships?

options.text: They must be used in combination for an entire collective.
They prioritise some psychological aspects over others.
They place too much stress on individual relationships.
They have to be applied cautiously to be effective.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does Matous think of the various psychological methods... 虽问看法，但Matous 的观点在原文引语中已明说，可直接定位，按细节题处理。
【拆句】题干 What does Matous think of the various psychological methods borrowed from other fields for strengthening relationships? 主干为 Matous 怎么看这些方法，think of表示对某事的评价，borrowed... 是后置定语修饰 methods；抓住主干即可。
【定位】"With caution, many relational methods to improve teams and organisations can be borrowed from other fields. The question is how to apply them effectively to strengthen an entire collective, which is more than just the sum of individual relationships," said Dr. Matous.
Matous 博士说："谨慎地说，许多用于改善团队与组织的关系方法可以从其他领域借鉴。问题在于如何有效地运用它们来强化一个整体，而这个整体不只是个体关系的简单相加。"
【选项】A)
过度推断
used in combination for an entire collective 说必须组合使用，但原文 how to apply them effectively to strengthen an entire collective 说的是如何有效运用以强化整体，并未要求把方法组合起来。
B)
张冠李戴
prioritise some psychological aspects over others 说这些方法偏重某些心理层面，这呼应的是 numerous schools of thought that propose differing psychological methods，是对各派别的描述，并非 Matous 对借用方法的看法。
C)
与原文相反
place too much stress on individual relationships 说过分强调个体关系，但原文more than just the sum of individual relationships 恰恰说整体不只是个体关系之和，提醒不要只看个体，选项把意思说反了。
D)
✓ 正确
With caution ↔applied cautiously
how to apply them effectively ↔to be effective
预判须谨慎且讲求有效，They have to be applied cautiously to be effective 同时覆盖 With caution 与 apply them effectively，故锁定该项。

【拆句】Q51 是一个标准疑问句，主干为 Why did the citizens vote to raise their own taxes，其中 to raise their own taxes 是不定式作 vote 的目的，整句结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】The purpose of such action is to fund an enormous multibillion-dollar, 10-year program of housing and social services for the homeless.

housing and social services for the homeless ↔combat the county's homelessness

加税资助的是 housing and social services，the development of local infrastructure 把"住房与社会服务"偷换成"地方基础设施建设"，二者并非一回事。

They are the victims of fast economic development.

【拆句】Q52 主干为 What do people tend to believe about the homeless，tend to believe是"倾向于相信"的固定搭配，about the homeless 限定讨论对象，结构简单无陷阱。
【定位】For as long as there are homeless people, there is a tendency to blame the victims themselves for their condition—to see their failure to thrive as an issue of character, of moral weakness, of laziness.
只要有无家可归者存在，就有一种倾向，把他们的处境归咎于受害者自身——把他们的潦倒看作品格、道德缺陷或懒惰的问题。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文说无家可归者"多数并非"精神病或瘾君子，是作者驳斥偏见，seldom meet the descriptions 把"少数符合"歪曲成"很少符合"，且这是作者观点而非"人们倾向相信"的内容。

victims of fast economic development 把原文 the economy forgot them（被经济遗忘）偷换成"快速经济发展的受害者"，且这是作者给出的真实成因，并非题干所问的"人们倾向相信"的偏见。
C)
✓ 正确
blame the victims themselves for their condition ↔responsible for their own condition
the victims themselves ↔their own
预判"责任在他们自己"与 They are responsible for their own condition 直接对应，故锁定。
D)
以偏概全
原文只说"相当一部分人"符合吸毒等描述，account for the majority of drug addicts反过来说无家可归者"占瘾君子的大多数"，既夸大又颠倒了主从关系。

【拆句】Q53 主干为 What is one of the causes，for more and more people in Los Angeles to become homeless 是介词 for 引导的长定语，修饰 causes，说明"什么的成因"；拆开后即"越来越多洛杉矶人沦为无家可归者"的成因，理清这层修饰即无障碍。

【选项】A)

预判"房市苛刻让人难有住处"与 They find it increasingly difficult to afford a place to live 吻合，故锁定。
B)
无中生有
原文只提个别人 fled an abusive marriage（逃离虐待婚姻），是个体经历，从未说"全郡离婚率持续上升"，divorce rate … on a steady rise 属臆造统计趋势。
C)
无中生有
原文说有人 lost a job（失业），并未说他们被迫去做低薪工作，compelled to take low-paying jobs 与文意不符且属臆造。
D)
偷换概念
原文 unforgiving 形容的是 housing market（房市无情），society fails to forgive them for their mistakes 把"房市"偷换成"社会"、把"无情"曲解为"不原谅错误"，张冠李戴式偷换。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the new Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority report?

options.text: Supplying enough job opportunities for the homeless remains a challenge.
Everyone is pulling in the same direction to solve the homelessness problem.
The increase in new housing falls short of the demand of the growing homeless population.
Los Angeles' homeless condition is deteriorating faster than many people predict.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn from the new … report 问一份具名报告的内容，答案就是报告所陈述的事实，回原文读该报告对应句即可。
【拆句】Q54 主干为 What do we learn from the report，new Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority 是一长串前置定语修饰 report，看着唬人，实为"洛杉矶无家可归者服务局的新报告"，拆掉定语主干极简，无陷阱。
【定位】That reality was driven home this month by a new Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority report showing that the county's homeless population is growing faster than the supply of new housing.
本月一份新的洛杉矶无家可归者服务局报告印证了这一现实：本郡无家可归人口的增长速度快于新住房的供给速度。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
报告比较的是"人口"与"住房"，Supplying enough job opportunities 把"住房供给"偷换成"就业机会供给"，报告未涉及就业。
B)
答非所问
Everyone is pulling in the same direction 取自报告前一句 even if everyone is pulling in the same direction，那是作者的假设语气，并非报告内容，题干问的是"报告说了什么"。
C)
✓ 正确
the county's homeless population is growing faster than the supply of new housing ↔ The increase in new housing falls short of the demand of the growing homeless population
the supply of new housing ↔The increase in new housing
预判"住房供给跟不上需求"与 The increase in new housing falls short of the demand 完全对应，故锁定。
D)
无中生有
报告只说人口增长快于住房供给，从未提"恶化速度快于许多人的预测"，faster than many people predict 凭空加入"预测"这一参照，属臆造。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: How do most Los Angeles residents now feel about homelessness?

options.text: They are increasingly ashamed about its scale.
They find it no more scaring than it appears.
They are less and less indifferent to it.
They no longer find it shocking.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】How do most Los Angeles residents now feel 看似问态度，但原文末段把居民的感受逐词列了出来，答案能逐字对应，按细节题回原文核对即可，无需揣摩作者立场。
【拆句】Q55 主干为 How do residents feel about homelessness，now 是关键时间状语，强调"如今"而非过去，提醒答案要选"当下"的感受；句子结构简单，唯一要抓的是这个时间限定。
【定位】But most Los Angeles residents are no longer either shocked or shamed. Increasingly, we are uncomfortable, annoyed, disgusted, scared or unaware.
但多数洛杉矶居民已不再震惊，也不再羞愧。我们越来越多地感到不适、恼火、厌恶、害怕或浑然不觉。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文说居民 no longer … shamed（不再羞愧），increasingly ashamed 说"越来越羞愧"，与原文正相反。
B)
与原文相反
原文把 scared（害怕）列为居民如今增多的情绪之一，no more scaring than it appears 却说"不比看上去更可怕"，与原文相反。
C)
与原文相反
原文说居民越来越 unaware（漠然），同情 being replaced by resignation（被无奈取代），less and less indifferent 说"越来越不漠然"，与原文趋势相反。
D)
✓ 正确
most Los Angeles residents are no longer either shocked or shamed ↔ They no longer find it shocking
预判"不再震惊"与 They no longer find it shocking 逐词吻合，故锁定。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页

stem: What may be the reason that friends are similar to each other according to the recent research?

options.text: Their brains work in harmony.
They are generally the same age.
Their interests are quite similar.
They have the same ethnic background.

explanation:
【题目】What may be the reason that friends are similar to each other according to the recent research?
【翻译】根据最近的研究,朋友之间相似的原因可能是什么?
A) 他们的大脑协调运作。
B) 他们通常年龄相同。
C) 他们的兴趣非常相似。
D) 他们有相同的族裔背景。
【答案】A （细节题）Their brains work in harmony.
【定位】It may be because your brains operate in harmony with each other.
这可能是因为你们的大脑彼此协同运作。
【信号】因果信号 because。录音开头先抛问句“有没有发现你和朋友很像“，紧接 It may be because your brains operate in harmony with each other —— because 就是把答案点亮的因果信号词，because 后面那句正是“相似的原因“，直接命中题干所问。
【替换】your brains operate in harmony with each other ↔Their brains work in harmony.
operate 换说成 work

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音确实念到 friends are more likely to be the same age，They are generally the same age. 正盗用了这个 same age。但这句前面有 We know that，是“早已知道的旧结论“，并非题干所问的“近期研究发现的相似原因“——原因落在大脑那句，不在同龄这句。
借用原文：friends are more likely to be the same age, gender and ethnic background
C)
未提及
Their interests are quite similar. 听起来很合常识，但录音通篇没提“兴趣（interests）“相似，只说了年龄、性别、族裔背景与大脑。它靠的是考生“朋友兴趣相投“的生活常识，而非录音内容，属未提及。
D)
原词陷阱
They have the same ethnic background. 盗用了录音的 ethnic background。和 B 一样，这句出自 We know that friends are more likely to be the same age, gender and ethnic background，是“已知的旧情况“，不是近期研究新发现的相似原因，答非所问。
借用原文：the same age, gender and ethnic background
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the news report say about the relationship between friends?

options.text: It can be touching.
It is hard to predict.
It can work both ways.
It resembles family ties.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say about the relationship between friends?
【翻译】新闻报道关于朋友之间的关系说了什么?
A) 它可能令人感动。
B) 它难以预测。
C) 它可以双向作用。
D) 它类似于家庭纽带。
【答案】C （细节题）It can work both ways.
【定位】The relationship probably goes two ways. We are drawn to people who think like us; we then influence their thoughts over time, which may push their brain activity into more closely resembling our own.
这种关系很可能是双向的。我们被与自己想法相近的人吸引；随后我们又会逐渐影响他们的想法，这可能促使他们的大脑活动变得更接近我们自己的。
【信号】定性句 goes two ways。录音第二段结尾用 The relationship probably goes two ways直接给“关系“下定性，后面 We are drawn to people…; we then influence their thoughts 一来一回正是对“双向“的解释。这句“主语就是题干 relationship + 紧跟一个性质判断“的结构，就是答案句信号。
【替换】The relationship probably goes two ways ↔It can work both ways.
two ways 换成 both ways
We are drawn to people who think like us; we then influence their thoughts ↔ It can work both ways.
一来一回印证双向

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
It can be touching. 盗用了录音的 touching，可那个 touching 出现在 Some people might find a romantic scene touching——是在举例说明“不同人对同一画面反应不同“，说的是“浪漫场景“感人，根本不是在评价“朋友关系“。张冠李戴，答非所问。
借用原文：Some people might find a romantic scene touching, for instance
B)
与原文相反
It is hard to predict. 借了录音的 predict。但录音说的是 it could be used to predict whether two people were already friends or not——意思是“大脑相似度高到能用来预测两人是不是朋友“，是说“能预测“，根本没说“关系难预测“。选项把“能预测“反着说成了“难预测“，与原文相反。
借用原文：it could be used to predict whether two people were already friends or not
D)
未提及
It resembles family ties. 听着像那么回事，但录音全程没把朋友关系比作“家庭纽带（family ties）“，只说了关系“双向“。它纯靠考生自行联想，录音无任何对应，属未提及。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did both Alan Robinson and Walter MacDonald attempt to do on DNA matching websites?

options.text: Search for their half-brothers.
Identify their biological fathers.
Find out more about their ancestry.
See whether they are actually related.

explanation:
【题目】What did both Alan Robinson and Walter MacDonald attempt to do on DNA matching websites?
【翻译】Alan Robinson 和 Walter MacDonald 在 DNA 匹配网站上都试图做什么?
A) 寻找他们同父异母的兄弟。
B) 确认他们的生父身份。
C) 了解更多关于他们祖先的信息。
D) 查看他们是否真的有血缘关系。
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.

【答案】C （细节题）Find out more about their ancestry.
【定位】So recently, they made separate attempts on DNA matching websites to discover more about their ancestry.
所以最近，他们俩各自在DNA配对网站上做了尝试，想多了解一些自己的家世血统。
【信号】题干原词attempt复现+目的句。题干问 attempt to do，录音里恰好出现 made separate attempts on DNA matching websites，attempt 和 DNA matching websites 原词对上，紧跟其后的 to discover more about their ancestry 用 to do 带出目的——这个‘题干关键词复现 + to do 目的句’就是答案信号。
【替换】to discover more about their ancestry ↔Find out more about their ancestry.
discover换成find out，ancestry原样
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说去 Search for their half-brothers.(寻找同父异母的兄弟)。录音确实出现 they are actually brothers‘他们其实是兄弟’，A 盗用了 brothers 这个词，但录音里这是新闻最后揭晓的真相，不是他俩上网时‘想去找的目标’——而且他们是同母兄弟、不是 half-brothers，张冠李戴。
借用原文：they are actually brothers
B)
原词陷阱
B 说去 Identify their biological fathers.(确认亲生父亲)。录音有 Walter never knew his father，B 盗用了 father 一词，但这只是介绍背景，两人上网的目的写得很清楚是discover more about their ancestry(查家世)，不是专门去认父亲。
借用原文：Walter never knew his father
D)
原词陷阱
D 说去 See whether they are actually related.(看看俩人是否真有亲属关系)。录音里 they are actually brothers 用了 actually 一词，D 盗用了 actually 并改写成 related，可他们上网时压根不知道彼此有血缘、不是‘去验证是否有关系’，验出是兄弟是意外结果，不是上网动机。
借用原文：they are actually brothers
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the news report say about Alan Robinson and Walter MacDonald?

options.text: They were both given up for adoption.
They were born to the same mother.
They flew 737 airplanes as pilots.
They were both 60 years of age.

explanation:
【题目】What did the news report say about Alan Robinson and Walter MacDonald?
【翻译】新闻报道关于 Alan Robinson 和 Walter MacDonald 说了什么?
A) 他们都被送去领养了。
B) 他们是同一个母亲所生。
C) 他们作为飞行员驾驶 737 飞机。
D) 他们都是 60 岁。
【答案】B （细节题）They were born to the same mother.

【定位】The pair were born to the same mother 15 months apart.
这两个人是同一个母亲所生，出生时间相差15个月。
【信号】结尾收束句给出血缘真相。新闻把最关键的血缘结论放在末句 The pair were born to the same mother 15 months apart——新闻报道常把核心事实或结局压在结尾，这个‘篇末收束’位置就是答案信号，born to the same mother 与选项 B 直接对应。
【替换】born to the same mother ↔They were born to the same mother.
原句几乎照搬主语换成They
【排除】A)
与原文相反
A 说两人 They were both given up for adoption.(都被送养)。录音里确有 Alan was given away for adoption，A 盗用了 adoption，但录音只说 Alan 一个人被送养，A 却说成 both(两个人都)，把范围从一人扩大到两人，与原文不符。
借用原文：Alan was given away for adoption
C)
张冠李戴
C 说两人 They flew 737 airplanes as pilots.(都当飞行员开737)。录音念到了 flew 737 airplanes when he was a pilot，C 盗用了 737 和 pilot 这两个醒目词，但 he 指的只是Alan 一人，C 说成 They(两人都飞)，把一人之事安到两人头上。
借用原文：flew 737 airplanes when he was a pilot
D)
偷换概念
D 说两人 They were both 60 years of age.(都60岁)。录音开头有 best friends for 60 years，D 盗用了数字 60，但这60是‘做了60年好朋友’，是友谊的年数，不是两人的年龄；偷换了60所修饰的对象。
借用原文：best friends for 60 years
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why did one of the male tourists feel sad?

options.text: One of his friends was caught littering.
Other tourists refused to join in the cleanup.
The beautiful beach was spoiled with lots of trash.
The kilometer-long beach was practically deserted.

explanation:
【题目】Why did one of the male tourists feel sad?
【翻译】为什么其中一位男性游客感到难过?
A) 他的一位朋友因乱扔垃圾被抓到。
B) 其他游客拒绝参加清理活动。
C) 美丽的海滩被大量垃圾破坏了。
D) 这片长达一公里的海滩几乎荒无一人。
【答案】C （细节题）The beautiful beach was spoiled with lots of trash.
【定位】He felt so sad to see such a gorgeous place littered with so much trash.
他看到如此美丽的地方却被这么多垃圾弄得脏乱不堪，感到非常难过。
【信号】feel sad 与题干同词直接命中。答案句直接出现题干里的 He felt so sad，紧跟其后的 to see such a gorgeous place littered with so much trash 就是难过的原因；听到与题干情绪词同样的‘sad’，那一句就是答案句。
【替换】such a gorgeous place littered with so much trash ↔ The beautiful beach was spoiled with lots of trash
同义改写：美景被垃圾糟蹋
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 项借用录音里的 his friends 一词，但原文只说他和朋友一起去捡垃圾，从没说‘朋友被抓乱扔垃圾’，是把出现过的原词拼成一个录音根本没说的情节。
借用原文：he and his friends decided to grab a few trash bags
B)
未提及
录音说的是‘nobody was doing anything’（没人去管这些垃圾），并非‘其他游客拒绝加入清理’；‘refused to join in’这一情节录音从未出现，属凭空捏造。
D)
与原文相反
D 项盗用录音里的 kilometer-long beach，却说海滩‘practically deserted（几乎空无一人）’；而录音强调的是海滩满是垃圾、不够美，与‘空无一人’语义不符，方向反了。
借用原文：Yesterday two male and three female tourists were spotted walking the kilometer-long beach
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Who put the good deed video on the internet?

options.text: A passerby.
A local woman.
The beach authorities.
One of the five tourists.

explanation:
【题目】Who put the good deed video on the internet?
【翻译】谁把这段善举视频上传到了网上?
A) 一位路人。
B) 一位当地妇女。
C) 海滩管理部门。
D) 五位游客中的一位。
【答案】A （细节题）A passerby.
【定位】A man passing by decided to video their good deed and put it on the internet.
一名路过的男子决定把他们的善举拍下来并发布到网上。
【信号】动作 put it on the internet 与题干同动作。答案句出现与题干同样的动作 put it on the internet，前面的主语 A man passing by 就是施动者；听到题干里的关键动作时，紧抓它的主语即可锁定答案。
【替换】A man passing by ↔A passerby
短语压缩成单词
【排除】B)
张冠李戴
B 项盗用录音里的 One local woman，但这位本地女子做的是‘评论说自己很尴尬’，并非上传视频；把别人做的事安到她头上，属人物错位。
借用原文：One local woman commented on being embarrassed that tourists were cleaning up their beach
C)
未提及
录音通篇没出现‘beach authorities（海滩管理方）’这个角色，上传视频的也不是任何官方机构，属凭空捏造的身份。
D)
张冠李戴
D 项盗用录音里的‘游客’，游客确实是事件主角、在捡垃圾，但发视频到网上的是路过男子而非游客中的某人；把上传动作错记到游客身上。
借用原文：they were most likely traveling together
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why did one local woman say she was embarrassed?

options.text: The tourists' good deed was not noticed by the locals.
Some natives were selling poor-quality food to tourists.
The number of tourists to the beach is on a steady decline.
It was tourists not natives who were cleaning up the beach.

explanation:
【题目】Why did one local woman say she was embarrassed?
【翻译】为什么一位当地妇女说她感到尴尬?
A) 游客的善举没有被当地人注意到。
B) 一些本地人向游客出售劣质食品。
C) 前往海滩的游客数量持续下降。
D) 清理海滩的是游客而不是本地人。

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【答案】D （细节题）It was tourists not natives who were cleaning up the beach.
【定位】One local woman commented on being embarrassed that tourists were cleaning up their beach.
一名本地女子评论说，她为游客在清理他们本地的海滩这件事感到尴尬。
【信号】embarrassed that 直接引出原因。答案句出现题干同词 embarrassed，紧跟的 that tourists were cleaning up their beach 由 that 直接引出尴尬的原因；听到 embarrassed后那句 that 从句就是答案句。
【替换】that tourists were cleaning up their beach ↔ It was tourists not natives who were cleaning up the beach
补出隐含对照：游客而非本地人
【排除】A)
与原文相反
A 项说‘游客善举没被本地人注意到’，但录音里本地女子明明注意到了才会尴尬，路人还拍了视频，恰恰说明被注意到了；‘not noticed’与录音事实相反。
借用原文：One local woman commented on being embarrassed
B)
偷换概念
B 项盗用录音里的 food and drinks，但原文是说本地人‘带来食物饮料后留下垃圾’，绝非‘卖劣质食物给游客’；把‘带来食物乱丢垃圾’偷换成‘卖劣质食物’。
借用原文：it was actually the natives who brought food and drinks then left trash all along the island
C)
未提及
录音通篇没提‘游客数量在持续下降’这一信息，本题谈的是清理海滩与尴尬，与游客增减无关，属凭空捏造的全新话题。

stem: Why can't the man go for a run Saturday morning?

options.text: He has to play football with workmates.
He has got some books to read.
He is going to visit a friend.
He is physically unfit for it.

explanation:
【题目】Why can't the man go for a run Saturday morning?

【翻译】为什么男士周六早上不能去跑步?
A) 他必须和同事踢足球。
B) 他有一些书要读。
C) 他要去拜访一位朋友。
D) 他的身体状况不适合跑步。
【答案】D （细节题）He is physically unfit for it.
【定位】I'd love to, but I hurt my ankle last weekend playing football with work colleagues.
我很想去，但我上周末和同事踢足球时弄伤了脚踝。
【信号】转折 but 后才是真理由。男士先说 I'd love to（很想去）是客套，紧跟的 but 才转出真正原因——I hurt my ankle，所以答案句落在 but 之后。
【替换】I hurt my ankle ↔He is physically unfit for it.
具体伤情概括成"身体不适合"
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 He has to play football with workmates. 把原文里的 playing football with work colleagues 原词搬来，但原文是说"踢球时受了伤"、不是"周六要去踢球"，听到 football就选会落进陷阱。
借用原文：playing football with work colleagues
B)
张冠李戴
选项 He has got some books to read. 说的是他后面提到的读书 I've been catching up on some reading，那是第11题的内容，与"为何不能去跑步"无关，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：I've been catching up on some reading
C)
未提及
选项 He is going to visit a friend. 在对话里根本没出现，男士不能去跑步的理由是脚伤，不是去看朋友，纯属编造。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why is the woman's whole family going to the zoo next Saturday?

options.text: To teach kids about animal protection.
To learn how popular zoos could be.
To see some rare animals in cages.
To give her little nephew a treat.

explanation:
【题目】Why is the woman's whole family going to the zoo next Saturday?
【翻译】为什么女士全家下周六要去动物园?
A) 教孩子们动物保护知识。
B) 了解动物园能有多受欢迎。
C) 看一些关在笼子里的稀有动物。
D) 给她的小侄子一个惊喜。
【答案】D （细节题）To give her little nephew a treat.
【定位】My little nephew turns six, and he loves the zoo, so the whole family is going.
我的小侄子要满六岁了，他很喜欢动物园，所以全家一起去。

【信号】因果 so 引出去的原因。so the whole family is going 里的 so 把前因"小侄子过六岁生日、又喜欢动物园"和后果"全家去"连起来，so 之前就是"为什么去"的答案。
【替换】My little nephew turns six, and he loves the zoo ↔To give her little nephew a treat.
为侄子庆生=给侄子一份开心
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 To teach kids about animal protection. 借了女士后面说的 they are fun and educational for children 里的 educational，但原文只说动物园对孩子有趣又有教育意义，从没说全家去是为了"教孩子动物保护"，是把原词拔高到原文没说的目的。
借用原文：they are fun and educational for children
B)
原词陷阱
选项 To learn how popular zoos could be. 套用了 They are nowhere near as popular as they used to be 里的 popular，但那只是女士顺口评论动物园不如从前受欢迎，绝不是全家去的目的。
借用原文：They are nowhere near as popular as they used to be
C)
原词陷阱
选项 To see some rare animals in cages. 借了 the poor animals stuck in cages 里的cages，但原文是女士同情笼中动物，没说去看"珍稀"动物，rare 更是凭空添加。
借用原文：the poor animals stuck in cages

stem: What do we learn about Dan from the man's description?

options.text: He enjoys excellent health.
He is keen on extreme sports.
He coaches tennis players every week.
He spends most of his time in the gym.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about Dan from the man's description?
【翻译】从男士的描述中我们了解到Dan的什么情况?
A) 他身体非常健康。
B) 他热衷于极限运动。
C) 他每周指导网球运动员。
D) 他大部分时间都在健身房度过。
【答案】A （细节题）He enjoys excellent health.
【定位】Dan is extremely fit and healthy. He goes to the gym most days, plus tennis two or three times a week.
Dan 非常健壮、健康。他几乎每天去健身房，外加每周打两三次网球。
【信号】直接给出对 Dan 的总评。男士 Dan is extremely fit and healthy 是对 Dan 的直接定性评价，后面 gym、tennis 都是佐证，这句总评就是答案句。
【替换】Dan is extremely fit and healthy ↔He enjoys excellent health.
extremely fit and healthy = excellent health

【排除】B)
未提及
选项 He is keen on extreme sports. 把 Dan 的运动夸大为"极限运动"，原文只说他常去健身房、打网球，从没提 extreme sports，属无中生有。
C)
偷换概念
选项 He coaches tennis players every week. 搬来原文的 tennis 和 a week，但原文是Dan 自己"打"网球 plus tennis two or three times a week，不是"教"网球选手，把"打"偷换成"教"。
借用原文：plus tennis two or three times a week
D)
原词陷阱
选项 He spends most of his time in the gym. 借了 He goes to the gym most days 里的 gym 和 most，但原文是"多数日子去健身房"，选项偷偷改成"把大部分时间花在健身房"，频率被夸大成时长。
借用原文：He goes to the gym most days

stem: What has the man been doing since last weekend?

options.text: Tending to his swollen ankle.
Concentrating on reading.
Writing three book reports.
Planning Christmas celebrations.

explanation:
【题目】What has the man been doing since last weekend?
【翻译】男士从上周末以来一直在做什么?
A) 照料他肿胀的脚踝。
B) 专心阅读。
C) 写三篇读书报告。
D) 计划圣诞节庆祝活动。
【答案】B （细节题）Concentrating on reading.
【定位】I've been catching up on some reading. I was given three books over Christmas, and I'm only now getting around to reading them.
我一直在补读一些书。圣诞节别人送了我三本书，我现在才腾出空来读它们。
【信号】I've been doing 直接应答。女士问他脚伤期间在干嘛，男士直接以 I've been catching up on some reading 应答，被问者的这句应答就是答案句，与题干时态对应。
【替换】I've been catching up on some reading ↔Concentrating on reading.
catching up on reading = concentrating on reading

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 Tending to his swollen ankle. 借了女士问句里的 that swollen ankle，但脚踝肿只是他读书的背景，他并没说"一直在护理脚踝"，把背景说成正在做的活动。
借用原文：that swollen ankle
C)
原词陷阱
选项 Writing three book reports. 搬来原文的 I was given three books 里的 three 和books，但原文是别人送他三本书"读"，不是他"写三份读书报告"，把"读书"偷换成"写报告"。
借用原文：I was given three books over Christmas
D)
原词陷阱
选项 Planning Christmas celebrations. 借了 over Christmas 里的 Christmas，但原文Christmas 只是"圣诞期间收到书"的时间状语，他并没在"筹备圣诞庆祝"，纯属对原词的曲解。
借用原文：over Christmas

stem: What do we learn about the man's book published recently?

options.text: It is being debated by hundreds of retirees.
It is attracting many people's attention.
It partly records his own experience.
It argues for postponing retirement.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the man's book published recently?
【翻译】关于这位男士最近出版的书，我们了解到什么？
A) 数百名退休人员正在对它进行讨论。
B) 它正在吸引许多人的关注。
C) 它部分记录了他自己的经历。
D) 它主张推迟退休。
【答案】B （细节题）It is attracting many people's attention.
【定位】John, your book is getting a lot of attention, partly because you write that most people can retire by 40.
约翰，你的书正受到很多关注，部分原因是你在书里写道大多数人能在 40 岁退休。

【信号】主持人开场对书的正面定性句。主持人介绍书时直接给出定性：your book is getting a lot of attention。这种"主持人开场对作品的概括"就是介绍类细节题的答案信号——它把书的核心特点一句点明。
【替换】getting a lot of attention ↔attracting many people's attention
"获得关注"换说成"吸引关注"
【排除】C)
偷换概念
录音里作者说 I interviewed hundreds of people who retired by 40，是"采访了几百人"，并没说书"记录他自己的经历"；C 把"研究别人"偷换成"写他自己"，答非所问。
借用原文：I interviewed hundreds of people who retired by 40
D)
与原文相反
录音说书主张 most people can retire by 40，是"提前到 40 岁退休"，而 D 说书主张"推迟退休"(postponing retirement)，正好反了。这是把"提前"听成"推迟"的反向陷阱。
借用原文：most people can retire by 40
A)
原词陷阱
录音里 hundreds 来自 I interviewed hundreds of people，指作者"采访了几百人"，A 却说书"正被几百名退休者讨论"(debated by hundreds of retirees)，把"被采访的人"偷换成"在讨论书的人"，是听到 hundreds 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：I interviewed hundreds of people who retired by 40
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第15页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do the articles the woman read recommend?

options.text: One should foresee a financial crisis.
One should trust financial planners, figures.
One should have one million dollars to retire.
One should start saving as early as possible.

explanation:
【题目】What do the articles the woman read recommend?
【翻译】这位女士读到的文章建议什么？
A) 人们应该预见到金融危机。
B) 人们应该相信理财规划师的数据。
C) 人们应该有一百万美元才能退休。
D) 人们应该尽早开始储蓄。
【答案】C （细节题）One should have one million dollars to retire.
【定位】I've read articles recommending one million dollars as a good figure for retirement.
我读过一些文章，推荐一百万美元作为退休的合适数额。
【信号】女士转述文章的 recommend 句。女士说 I've read articles recommending one million dollars，动词 recommend 与题干 recommend 完全对应，这句"女士转述文章推荐什么"就是答案信号——题目问的正是这个来源。
【替换】one million dollars as a good figure for retirement ↔have one million dollars to retire
"一百万作合适数额"="应有一百万才退休"

【排除】B)
张冠李戴
financial planners 确实在录音出现 most financial planners do give numbers，但那是嘉宾说"规划师爱给数字、我觉得没用"，文章并没"推荐相信规划师"。B 把原词搬来、又把内容安错了人(文章 vs 规划师)。
借用原文：most financial planners do give numbers, I don't think that's useful
D)
答非所问
"尽早储蓄"听着像理财常识，但录音里文章推荐的是"一百万这个数额"，并没说"尽早储蓄"；至于储蓄、投资是嘉宾在后面(P14)讲的做法，不是"女士读的文章"推荐的。D 答非所问。
借用原文：investing half your monthly income
A)
未提及
选项 A 的 financial crisis 借了话题里"financial"的语感，但文章推荐的是具体金额，从没让人"预见金融危机"；录音通篇也没出现"危机"的意思。A 是听到 financial 就联想出来的干扰。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about retirement?

options.text: It doesn't need to be permanent.
It shouldn't be considered risky.
It helps to reduce travel expenses.
It is the way to quit a job one hates.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about retirement?
【翻译】这位男士对退休有何看法？
A) 它不必是永久性的。
B) 它不应该被认为有风险。
C) 它有助于减少旅行开支。
D) 它是辞去自己讨厌的工作的方式。
【答案】A （细节题）It doesn't need to be permanent.
【定位】Retirement doesn't have to be permanent, and if people need to, they can go back to work.
退休不一定是永久的，如果有需要，人们可以重新回去工作。
【信号】男士对退休下的直接定性句。男士直接断言 Retirement doesn't have to be permanent，这是他对"退休"本身的一句正面定义，又用 they can go back to work 加以说明，是"他怎么说退休"的直接答案信号。
【替换】Retirement doesn't have to be permanent ↔It doesn't need to be permanent
doesn't have to=doesn't need to
they can go back to work ↔doesn't need to be permanent
"能回去工作"佐证"不必永久"

【排除】B)
与原文相反
risky 来自女士 That sounds risky to me 和男士 I counsel people to take risks——男士是"劝人去冒险"，承认有风险；B 却说退休"不该被视为有风险"，意思反了，是听到 risk 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：I counsel people to take risks
D)
原词陷阱
a job they hate 确实出现在 spend their lives working on jobs they hate，但那是男士解释"很多人因恐惧而困在烂工作里"的背景，不是给退休下定义；D 把这句背景说成"退休就是辞掉烂工作的途径"，答非所问。
借用原文：spend their lives working on jobs they hate
C)
未提及
C 说退休"有助减少差旅开支"(reduce travel expenses)，录音里 transport 出现在 cutting housing, food, and transport expenses，那是"怎样攒钱"的省钱办法，与"退休本身是什么"无关，更没说退休能省路费。C 属嫁接他处原词的无中生有。
借用原文：cutting housing, food, and transport expenses
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: How does the man say his proposal about retirement can be carried out?

options.text: By keeping close contact with one's employers.
By retiring when one reaches sixty years old.
By investing half of one's monthly income.
By following the counsel of financial planners.

explanation:
【题目】How does the man say his proposal about retirement can be carried out?
【翻译】这位男士说他关于退休的提议可以如何实施？
A) 通过与雇主保持密切联系。
B) 通过在年满六十岁时退休。
C) 通过投资月收入的一半。
D) 通过遵循理财规划师的建议。
【答案】C （细节题）By investing half of one's monthly income.
【定位】Simple, by cutting housing, food, and transport expenses, and investing half your monthly income.
很简单，靠削减住房、饮食和交通开支，并拿出月收入的一半去投资。
【信号】男士回答"怎么做到"的 by 操作句。面对女士"怎么可能 40 岁退休"的追问，男士直接答 by cutting housing, food, and transport expenses, and investing half your monthly income，这句"by + 一串具体动作"就是 How 类题的答案信号。
【替换】investing half your monthly income ↔investing half of one's monthly income
几乎原句对应的"投月收入一半"

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
employers 出现在 you will be attracted to employers，那是男士讲"保持技能就能被雇主青睐、好重返职场"，回应的是"能否回去工作"，不是"怎么攒钱提前退休"；A 把它说成"靠和雇主保持密切联系来实现退休"，答非所问。
借用原文：if you keep current with your skills, you will be attracted to employers
B)
与原文相反
sixty 来自女士的反问 most people can't retire at 60，意在质疑"连 60 都退不了，怎么40 退"；B 却说"靠 60 岁退休来实现"，方向反了——男士主张的是 40 岁提前退，不是等到 60。
借用原文：how can anyone save enough to retire by 40 when most people can't retire at 60
D)
与原文相反
financial planners 和 counsel 都在录音里——但男士对规划师是 I don't think that's useful，并不让人"听规划师的"；counsel 是他"劝人冒险"(I counsel people to take risks)，不是"听规划师劝告"。D 把原词拼到一起，方向与男士立场相反。
借用原文：While most financial planners do give numbers, I don't think that's useful
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What was the finding of the new research from America about consumers' food choices?

options.text: They tended to be easily anticipated by those belonging to their own race.
They tended to be arbitrarily judged by individuals of opposing groups.
They were readily shared among members of the same social or racial group.
They were influenced by the presence of someone from an outsider group.

explanation:
【题目】What was the finding of the new research from America about consumers' food choices?
【翻译】来自美国的新研究关于消费者食物选择的发现是什么?
A) 它们往往容易被属于同一种族的人预测。
B) 它们往往被对立群体的个体任意评判。
C) 它们在同一社会或种族群体的成员之间容易共享。
D) 它们受到来自外部群体的某人在场的影响。
【答案】D （细节题）They were influenced by the presence of someone from an outsider group.
【定位】This research found college students were more likely to choose healthy food in the presence of an observer of a different race, as opposed to an observer from their own race.
这项研究发现，与本族观察者在场相比，大学生在不同种族的观察者在场时更可能选择健康食物。
【信号】结论标志词 found。录音 This research found 直接亮出研究结论，found 后面跟的就是研究发现，这是篇章交代核心结论的标志，听到 found/showed 这类词就知道答案句来了。
【替换】in the presence of an observer of a different race ↔ influenced by the presence of someone from an outsider group
下位换上位
were more likely to choose healthy food ↔were influenced
详述换概括

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 用了录音后文 participants anticipated more negative judgment 里的 anticipated 一词，但把它扭成易被同族人预料，与研究发现毫无关系，是听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：participants anticipated more negative judgment
B)
偷换概念
B 说食物选择被对立群体的个人任意评判，借了录音 they felt less judged by members of their own group 的 judge 概念，但研究发现的是选择被在场者影响，不是选择本身被评判，偷换了概念。
借用原文：they felt less judged by members of their own group
C)
与原文相反
C 说食物选择在同族群体内易被共享，但录音 they felt less judged by members of their own group 讲的是同族在场时人感觉评判更少、影响更小，根本没说共享选择，且方向与研究重点（外群体才带来改变）相反。
借用原文：they felt less judged by members of their own group
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第20页

stem: When did 31 percent of students in the experiment select the healthier option?

options.text: When they tried to make a positive impression on the researchers.
When an unknown student from another university was present.
When an experimenter from the research team took notice.
When they were offered both candy and fruit as a snack.

explanation:
【题目】When did 31 percent of students in the experiment select the healthier option?
【翻译】实验中百分之三十一的学生在什么时候选择了更健康的选项?
A) 当他们试图给研究人员留下积极印象时。
B) 当一名来自另一所大学的陌生学生在场时。
C) 当研究团队的一名实验人员注意到时。
D) 当他们被提供糖果和水果作为零食时。
【答案】B （细节题）When an unknown student from another university was present.
【定位】However, this number was 31 percent when in the presence of an unknown student from another university.
然而，当一名来自另一所大学的陌生学生在场时，这个数字是 31%。
【信号】数字与 when 条件绑定。录音 this number was 31 percent when in the presence of an unknown student from another university 把 31 percent 与 when 引导的在场条件直接绑在一起，听到目标数字就顺势抓它后面的 when 从句，即答案条件。
【替换】an unknown student from another university ↔an unknown student from another university
条件原句对应
in the presence of ↔was present
名词短语换动词

【排除】A)
未提及
A 说学生想给研究者留好印象，录音只说他们 use healthy food choices to make a positive impression，但针对的是外群体在场者，不是 researchers，录音从未提对研究者留好印象这个条件，属无中生有。
C)
原词陷阱
C 借了录音多次出现的 research/experimenter 概念，编出研究团队的实验员注意到时，但31 percent 绑定的是外校学生在场，与实验员留意无关，是听到 research 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Other experiments showed similar results
D)
张冠李戴
D 说同时提供糖果和水果作零食时，candy 和 fruit 确是录音 participants were offered the choice between candy and fruit as a snack 的原词，但这是整个实验的设置，对应12% 与 31% 两种情境，不专属 31%，把背景条件错安成 31% 的专属触发，张冠李戴。
借用原文：participants were offered the choice between candy and fruit as a snack
