source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: How could a healthy diet be promoted according to the findings of the new research?

options.text: By advertising its social benefits.
By teaching consumers diet strategies.
By supporting struggling consumers.
By maintaining its positive image.

explanation:
【题目】How could a healthy diet be promoted according to the findings of the new research?
【翻译】根据新研究的发现,如何促进健康饮食?
A) 通过宣传其社会益处。
B) 通过向消费者传授饮食策略。
C) 通过支持处境艰难的消费者。
D) 通过维持其正面形象。
【答案】A （细节题）By advertising its social benefits.
【定位】This research finds that one way to promote a healthy diet could be to advertise the social benefits of healthy choices.
这项研究发现，推动健康饮食的一种方式可能是宣传健康选择的社会益处。
【信号】建议句 one way to…could be to。录音 one way to promote a healthy diet could be to advertise the social benefits 用 one way to…could be to 这一建议句式给出对策，这是篇章结尾提对策的信号，听到就锁定后面的方法。
【替换】advertise the social benefits of healthy choices ↔advertising its social benefits
动词变动名词

【排除】B)
未提及
B 说教消费者饮食策略，录音虽提到 many attempts to help consumers make healthier choices，但从未说具体方法是教饮食策略，这个手段是凭空添加的，属未提及。
C)
原词陷阱
C 说支持苦苦挣扎的消费者，借了录音 consumers often struggle to maintain a healthy diet 的 struggle 一词，但那只是描述现状，不是研究给出的对策，是听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：consumers often struggle to maintain a healthy diet
D)
张冠李戴
D 说维持其正面形象，借了录音 make a positive impression 里的 positive 概念，但那讲的是个人用健康选择给自己留好印象，不是推动健康饮食的对策，张冠李戴。
借用原文：they strategically use healthy food choices to make a positive impression
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the recent study led by Patricia Pendry aim to examine?

options.text: The academic and learning issues struggling students encounter.
The risk students face due to a history of mental health problems.
The effect of interacting with therapy dogs on students under pressure.
The work universities are doing to help students succeed academically

explanation:
【题目】What does the recent study led by Patricia Pendry aim to examine?
【翻译】Patricia Pendry领导的最新研究旨在考察什么?
A) 处境困难的学生遇到的学业和学习问题。
B) 学生因心理健康问题史而面临的风险。
C) 与治疗犬互动对压力下学生的影响。
D) 大学为帮助学生在学业上取得成功所做的工作。
【答案】C （主旨题）The effect of interacting with therapy dogs on students under pressure.
【定位】This study shows that traditional stress management approaches aren't as effective for this population compared with programs that focus on providing opportunities to interact with therapy dogs.
这项研究表明，对这一人群而言，传统的压力管理方法不如那些专注于提供与治疗犬互动机会的项目有效。
【信号】总结句 This study shows。This study shows that 是篇章里的"结论/点题"信号——一旦听到"这项研究表明……"，后面紧跟的就是研究的核心发现/目的，这正是主旨题的答案落点。
【替换】programs that focus on providing opportunities to interact with therapy dogs ↔ The effect of interacting with therapy dogs on students under pressure
动作短语→名词化概括
For college students under pressure ↔students under pressure
几乎原词对应的对象

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项盗用了录音里的 academic and learning issues 原词，但那只是描述"哪类学生处于风险"的背景信息，不是研究要考察的内容。听到原词就选会中招。
借用原文：academic and learning issues
B)
原词陷阱
选项搬用了录音的 a history of mental health issues，但那同样是在说明"哪些学生有风险"的铺垫，不是研究目的。把背景当主旨就错了。
借用原文：a history of mental health issues
D)
原词陷阱
选项几乎照搬录音 Universities are doing a lot of great work trying to help students succeed academically，但那是 Pendry 在铺垫"大学在做很多帮扶工作"的大背景，不是"这项研究"本身要考察的内容；研究聚焦的是治疗犬，不是泛泛的大学帮扶工作。
借用原文：Universities are doing a lot of great work trying to help students succeed academically
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第24页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the new study measure in the participants?

options.text: Their communicative skills.
Their executive functioning.
Their academic networking.
Their leadership capacities.

explanation:
【题目】What did the new study measure in the participants?
【翻译】这项新研究测量了参与者的什么?
A) 他们的沟通技能。
B) 他们的执行功能。
C) 他们的学术人际网络。
D) 他们的领导能力。
【答案】B （细节题）Their executive functioning.
【定位】The researchers measured executive functioning in the students involved in the study.
研究人员测量了参与研究的学生的执行功能。
【信号】原词 measured 直接领出宾语。录音用 The researchers measured executive functioning，measured 这个动词与题干 measure 完全对应，紧跟其后的宾语就是答案，是最直接的细节定位信号。
【替换】measured executive functioning ↔Their executive functioning
原词直接对应

【排除】A)
未提及
communicative skills（沟通能力）录音从头到尾没提，是凭"听起来像学生该有的能力"硬编的干扰项，没有原文支撑。
C)
原词陷阱
academic networking 把录音里多次出现的 academic（学业的）这个原词抓来拼了个新词，但录音讲的是 academic stress/success，从没说测"学业人脉"，是借原词 academic制造的假象。
借用原文：academic stress management programs
D)
未提及
leadership capacities（领导力）录音里完全没出现，是又一个"听上去像能力词"的硬凑干扰，无原文依据。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does Patricia Pendry think traditional stress management programs may do?

options.text: Rid students of their anxiety.
Add to some students' stress.
Contribute little to typical students' success.
Help students with mental issues pull through.

explanation:
【题目】What does Patricia Pendry think traditional stress management programs may do?
【翻译】Patricia Pendry认为传统压力管理项目可能会做什么?
A) 消除学生的焦虑。
B) 增加一些学生的压力。
C) 对普通学生的成功贡献甚微。
D) 帮助有心理问题的学生渡过难关。
【答案】B （态度观点题）Add to some students' stress.
【定位】But they're less helpful for struggling students. Pendry believes those students may experience the programs as another lecture and feel even more stressed.
但对学习困难的学生而言，这些项目帮助不大。Pendry 认为这些学生可能会把这些项目当成又一堂讲座，从而感到压力更大。
【信号】转折 But 后才是真实态度。But they're less helpful for struggling students 里的 But 是关键信号——前半句先肯定"传统项目对普通学生有帮助"，But 一转才说出 Pendry 真正的判断：对困难学生反而"更有压力"。态度题的答案几乎都在转折后。
【替换】feel even more stressed ↔Add to some students\' stress
感受描述→施动概括
for struggling students ↔some students
下位→上位概括

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项里的 anxiety 盗用了录音 manage stress or anxiety 的原词，且 Rid\.\.\.of（彻底消除）把"帮助管理焦虑"夸大成"消除焦虑"，原文从没说传统项目能"根除"焦虑，程度被拔高了。
借用原文：manage stress or anxiety
C)
与原文相反
录音明说传统项目 help typical students succeed——对普通学生是有帮助的；选项却说"对普通学生的成功几乎没贡献"，把"有帮助"反成了"没帮助"，正话反说，且对象（typical students）正是录音说有用的那群人。
借用原文：these workshops help typical students succeed
D)
与原文相反
录音说传统项目对"有困难的学生" less helpful for struggling students——是帮不上忙；选项却说能"帮有心理问题的学生渡过难关"，把"帮不上"说成"帮得上"，方向反了，对象也被偷换成"有心理问题的学生"。
借用原文：But they're less helpful for struggling students
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第26页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do entrepreneurs have to do when taking risks according to the passage?

options.text: Work hard and plan carefully.
Attempt to succeed at any cost.
Aim high and expect great results.
Remain optimistic even in difficulty.

explanation:
【题目】What do entrepreneurs have to do when taking risks according to the passage?
【翻译】根据文章，企业家在承担风险时必须做什么？
A) 努力工作并仔细计划。
B) 不惜任何代价争取成功。
C) 目标远大并期待卓越成果。
D) 即使在困难中也保持乐观。
【答案】A （细节题）Work hard and plan carefully.
【定位】On the contrary, taking risks in entrepreneurship involves careful planning and hard work.
恰恰相反，创业中的冒险需要的是周密的规划和辛勤的努力。
【信号】转折 On the contrary 后是真意。录音先说冒险“不是盲目去做、坐等大成果”，紧接着用On the contrary 转折，转折之后那句 involves careful planning and hard work 才是正面答案；听到 On the contrary 就该锁定后半句。
【替换】careful planning and hard work ↔Work hard and plan carefully
名词短语换成动词短语
【排除】C)
原词陷阱
Aim high and expect great results 几乎照搬了录音被否定那半句的 expecting great results，但录音是说“冒险”不等于“盲目坐等大成果”，这是被批评的做法，不是创业者“该做”的；听到 expect great results 就选，正好踩进陷阱。
借用原文：expecting great results
B)
未提及
Attempt to succeed at any cost“不惜一切代价求成功”，录音通篇没说要“不计代价”，反而强调冒险要靠规划和努力、还提醒“并非所有风险都是好风险”，这种太满的说法是命题人添加的。
D)
答非所问
Remain optimistic even in difficulty 式的“乐观”确实在录音里出现过，an optimistic risk-taker 也提到 optimistic，adapting in difficult times 也讲困境中应变，但那是讲“失败时的心态”，不是回答“冒险时必须做什么”这道题，把别处的内容搬来作答即错位。
借用原文：an optimistic risk-taker
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第28页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say is key to business growth?

options.text: Regarding failure as something inevitable.
Trying out innovative marketing strategies.
Venturing into sectors never explored before.
Being willing to experiment with novel ideas.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say is key to business growth?
【翻译】文章认为什么是业务增长的关键？
A) 将失败视为不可避免的事情。
B) 尝试创新的营销策略。
C) 冒险进入从未探索过的领域。
D) 愿意尝试新颖的想法。
【答案】D （细节题）Being willing to experiment with novel ideas.
【定位】The willingness to experiment with new ideas is key to business growth.
愿意去尝试新点子，是企业成长的关键。
【信号】原文 key 与题干同词对应。录音 is key to business growth 和题干 key to business growth 用词几乎一模一样，这句话主语 The willingness to experiment with new ideas就是答案；标志词 key 一响，定位即成。
【替换】The willingness to experiment with new ideas ↔Being willing to experiment with novel ideas
近义改写 new=novel
【排除】B)
未提及
Trying out innovative marketing strategies 听起来很像“创新”，录音确有“new ideas”的意思，但根本没提“marketing strategies（营销策略）”；它用“创新”诱你，却塞了原文没有的“营销”。
C)
过度推断
Venturing into sectors never explored before“进入从未有人涉足的领域”比录音的“尝试新点子”程度重得多，录音只说 experiment with new ideas，并没说要闯入“全新行业”，这是把原意拔高了。
借用原文：experiment with new ideas
A)
原词陷阱
Regarding failure as something inevitable 里 failure 是录音高频词，look at failure as an opportunity to learn 也讲了对失败的看法，但录音说的是“把失败当学习机会”，不是“把失败当不可避免”，更不是回答“增长关键”；它用熟悉的 failure 制造错觉。
借用原文：look at failure as an opportunity to learn
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第29页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What are we advised to do when we fail?

options.text: Expect future success so as to move forward.
Learn from our failure and forge ahead.
Distinguish between good and bad risks.
Examine our strategies and find out weaknesses.

explanation:
【题目】What are we advised to do when we fail?

【翻译】当我们失败时，建议我们做什么？
A) 期待未来成功以便继续前进。
B) 从失败中学习并勇往直前。
C) 区分好的风险和坏的风险。
D) 检查我们的策略并找出弱点。
【答案】B （细节题）Learn from our failure and forge ahead.
【定位】But just remember that not all risks are good ones, and when you fail, learn from it and move forward.
但要记住，并非所有风险都是好风险；当你失败时，要从中吸取教训，然后继续前进。
【信号】条件句 when you fail 直接应题。题干问 when we fail，录音正好有 when you fail, learn from it and move forward 这句条件句，措辞与题干对应；听到 when you fail 后面紧跟的 learn from it and move forward 就是答案。
【替换】learn from it and move forward ↔Learn from our failure and forge ahead
代词还原＋近义短语
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Expect future success so as to move forward 借用了录音的 move forward，但把前提偷换成“指望未来成功”——录音让你“前进”的前提是“从失败中学”，不是“指望成功”；听到move forward 就选，正中陷阱。
借用原文：move forward
C)
答非所问
Distinguish between good and bad risks 用了录音 not all risks are good ones 的意思，录音确实提醒“并非所有风险都好”，但那是另一层提醒，不是“失败时”被建议做的事，答非所问。
借用原文：not all risks are good ones
D)
未提及
Examine our strategies and find out weaknesses“检查策略、找出弱点”录音没有对应说法，录音只讲“失败教你如何战略性思考”think and plan strategically，并没有让你去“查弱点”，是凭 strategically 一词联想出来的。
借用原文：think and plan strategically
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第30页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does it mean to risk-taking businesses when most people tend to avoid risk?

options.text: Fresher offers.
Safer operation.
More challenges.
Less competition.

explanation:
【题目】What does it mean to risk-taking businesses when most people tend to avoid risk?
【翻译】当大多数人倾向于规避风险时，对承担风险的企业意味着什么？
A) 更新鲜的机会。
B) 更安全的运营。
C) 更多挑战。
D) 更少竞争。
【答案】D （细节题）Less competition.

【定位】Simply put, when most individuals stay away from risk, it means less competition for risk-takers.
简单地说，当大多数人远离风险时，对冒险者而言就意味着更少的竞争。
【信号】Simply put 总结句给结论。录音用 Simply put（简而言之）领出一句总结，it means less competition for risk-takers 直接给出结论，与题干“what does it mean”正好对接；听到Simply put 这类收束词就知道结论要来了。
【替换】less competition for risk-takers ↔Less competition
几乎原词截取
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Fresher offers 借了录音 fresh offers 这个原词，但那句讲的是冒险者“用新点子、新供给、大胆发明在立标准”，是描述冒险者的做法，不是回答“别人避险意味着什么”，张冠李戴。
借用原文：fresh offers
C)
与原文相反
More challenges“更多挑战”与录音结论方向相反：录音说别人避险对冒险者是“更少竞争”这种好事，而 challenge 是偏负面的负担，录音的 adapting in difficult times 谈的是冒险者善应变，并没说“更多挑战”。
借用原文：adapting in difficult times
B)
未提及
Safer operation 像是从录音 stay safe 联想来的，但 as long as you want to stay safe 是说“你若一味求稳就永远不会知道结果”，是对“守成者”的提醒，并不是说冒险企业能“更安全地运营”，原文没有这层意思。
借用原文：stay safe
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第30页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Several recent studies have found that even low-intensity exercise, done for a short amount of time, can have a meaningful __(26)__ on health.

options.text: adjust
alter
approximately
controversial
coordinates
impact
limitations
moderate
participated
patterns
populated
risk
seemingly
type
upper

explanation:
26. can have a meaningful __(26)__ on health
【答案】F) impact
名词

stem: What is a reason for the author to be in the habit of saying "busy" when asked how he is doing?

options.text: He just follows successful people's example.
He is actually proud to be fully occupied.
He thinks everyone should be devoted to work.
He believes busyness ensures accomplishments.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What is a reason for the author to be in the habit 问一个具体可在原文找到的原因，答案直接落在某句话里。
【拆句】主干是 What is a reason，后接 for 引导的逻辑主语 for the author to be in the habit of saying "busy"，再用 when 状语 when asked how he is doing 限定情境。结构清晰，无陷阱，只需读成“作者在被问近况时爱说忙，原因是什么”。
【定位】Sometimes it's because I actually am busy, but other times it's because that's what I think I'm supposed to say. That's what important people say. That's what people who get promoted say.
有时是因为我确实忙，但另一些时候是因为那是我以为自己应该说的话。重要人物就这么说，得到晋升的人就这么说。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
That's what important people say. That's what people who get promoted say ↔ follows successful people's example
预判“效仿成功者的做法”与 He just follows successful people's example 完全吻合，故锁定此项。
B)
张冠李戴
原文末尾反问 why are we so proud to talk about how busy we are 是带反思的反问，并非作者承认自己“为忙而自豪”，选项把反问当作者的真实态度，属张冠李戴。
C)
无中生有
原文从未说作者认为“人人都应投身工作”；相反作者反思忙碌文化，everyone should be devoted to work 在文中无任何依据，属无中生有。
D)
与原文相反
原文明说 working long hours doesn't drive better results，即忙碌并不保证成就；busyness ensures accomplishments 与原文意思正好相反。

stem: Why do we tend to think that busy people are of high status?

options.text: Our status can be attributed to our social mobility.
We hold the belief that hard work leads to success.
Our own opportunity for success never comes easily.
We find few people of high status have time for leisure.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 Why do we tend to think that busy people are of high status 问的是原文研究已经给出的解释，属可定位的明确事实。
【拆句】Why do we tend to think that busy people are of high status 中 think 后接 that 宾语从句 busy people are of high status。tend to 是“倾向于”，不是绝对，读时不必纠结，整句即“我们为什么倾向认为忙人地位高”。
【定位】In other words, the more we believe that one has the opportunity for success based on hard work, the more we tend to think that people who skip leisure and work all the time are of higher standing.
换句话说，我们越是相信一个人靠努力工作就有成功的机会，就越倾向于认为那些放弃休闲、一直工作的人地位更高。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文说我们对社会流动的信念影响了地位判断，并非“地位可归因于社会流动”；status can be attributed to our social mobility 把“信念影响判断”偷换成“地位源于流动”，颠倒了关系。
B)
✓ 正确
the more we believe that one has the opportunity for success based on hard work ↔ We hold the belief that hard work leads to success
预判的“努力工作通向成功的信念”与 hold the belief that hard work leads to success逐字对应，故锁定此项。
C)
无中生有
原文谈的是“相信有机会成功”，从未说“我们自己的成功机会来之不易”；opportunity for success never comes easily 在文中无依据，属无中生有。
D)
答非所问
题问“为何觉得忙人地位高”，few people of high status have time for leisure 是描述高地位者的现象，没回答原因，且原文也未这么说，属答非所问兼无中生有。

stem: What do we learn about the culture of busyness from a recent study?

【判型】题干 What do we learn about the culture of busyness from a recent study 问一项研究的具体结论，答案在原文摆着。
【拆句】What do we learn about the culture of busyness from a recent study：主干 What do we learn，about 短语限定话题，from 短语点明信息来源。三段修饰平铺，无陷阱。
【定位】This culture of busyness is making it hard for employees to find work-life balance. According to a recent study, one in five highly engaged employees is at risk of burnout(精疲力竭).
这种忙碌文化正使员工难以找到工作与生活的平衡。根据近期一项研究，每五名高投入员工中就有一名面临精疲力竭的风险。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
meetings, emails and stress 出自上一段对“显得忙的人”的描写 knee-deep in meetings, emails, and stress，并非“近期研究”的结论；题问研究发现什么，此项把别处内容搬来，属张冠李戴。
B)
偷换概念
原文 one in five（约20%）指的是“面临精疲力竭风险”的人，compels some 20% of employees to appear always busy 把这20%偷换成“被迫显得忙”，数据所指对象被改。
C)
无中生有
原文未提忙碌文化“扭曲了员工对满意生活的认知”；distorts…belief of what a satisfying life is 在文中找不到对应句，属无中生有。
D)
✓ 正确
one in five highly engaged employees is at risk of burnout ↔ It does much harm to many busy employees' well-being
预判“危害员工身心”与 does much harm to many busy employees' well-being 吻合，故锁定此项。

stem: What do such utterances as "I have limited access to email" sound like according to the author?

options.text: One is too busy to check all emails in time.
One is opposed to the prevailing work culture.
One is forced by circumstances to stop working.
One is simply enjoying their time off work.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do such utterances as … sound like according to the author 问作者认为这类话听起来像什么，答案是原文作者的明确评价。
【拆句】What do such utterances as "I have limited access to email" sound like according to the author：such…as 举例结构，sound like 是“听起来像”。注意 sound like 后省略了表语，正是要补的答案；according to the author 提示以作者原话为准。
【定位】Phrases like "I have limited access to email" and "I'll respond as soon as I get back" sound like you're being held against your will from working as opposed to making the most of your time off.
“我邮件查看受限”“我一回来就回复”这类话听起来像是你被违背意愿地拦着不让工作，而不是在充分利用你的休假时光。
【选项】A)
答非所问
题问这类话“听起来像”什么（即给人的印象），too busy to check all emails in time描述的是字面情境而非作者说的负面印象；作者的重点是“像被迫”，此项答非所问。
B)
过度推断
作者只说这类话“听起来像被迫”、设错了基调，并未说它表示“反对主流工作文化”；opposed to the prevailing work culture 是读者强行拔高，属过度推断。
C)
✓ 正确
you're being held against your will from working ↔ One is forced by circumstances to stop working
预判“被迫无法工作”与 forced by circumstances to stop working 吻合，故锁定此项。
D)
与原文相反
原文用 as opposed to 把“被迫不能工作”与“充分享受休假”对立，明说这类话听起来“不是”在享受休假；simply enjoying their time off work 恰是被否定的那一面，正好相反。

To encourage both employers and employees to answer emails promptly.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 Why did the author and his colleagues launch the Out of Office Email Generator 问一个具体动作的目的，答案藏在原文相应段落。
【拆句】Why did the author and his colleagues launch the Out of Office Email Generator：主干 Why did the author and his colleagues launch，宾语是专有工具名。一般疑问语序无陷阱，落脚在“为何推出这个工具”。
【定位】That's why we recently launched the Out of Office Email Generator, a free tool you can use before your next long weekend or trip. You can share loud and proud that you won't be checking email until you're back. Managers need to think twice about emailing their teams on the weekend and talking about how busy they are. Leaders should take time off themselves and encourage employees to do the same.
这就是我们最近推出“Out of Office Email Generator”这款免费工具的原因，你可以在下个长周末或出行前使用它。你可以大方而自豪地宣告，回来之前不会查邮件。管理者需要三思，别在周末给团队发邮件、别炫耀自己多忙。领导者应自己带头休假，并鼓励员工同样如此。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
“少花时间查邮件”只是手段、且只覆盖员工一方，原文目的是让双方“真正休假”；spend less time checking emails 把整体目的缩成局部手段，属以偏概全。
B)
✓ 正确
You can share loud and proud that you won't be checking email until you're back ↔ To ensure employees as well as employers truly have time off
Leaders should take time off themselves and encourage employees to do the same ↔ employers as well as employees
预判“让员工和雇主都真正休假”与 employees as well as employers truly have time off 完整对应、双方都覆盖，故锁定此项。
C)
以偏概全
“别谈论团队多忙”只是原文对管理者诸多建议之一 talking about how busy they are，不是推出工具的总目的；stop managers from talking about how busy… 拿一个分支当全部，属以偏概全。
D)
与原文相反
原文呼吁休假时“不查/不发邮件”，answer emails promptly（及时回邮件）与原文意图正好相反。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What did the author's team conclude about the gender difference in airfares from their further investigation?

options.text: It is largely attributed to women booking earlier than men.
It is largely explained by women's choosing cheaper flights.
It is mainly accounted for by male employees' readiness to pay more.
It is due to the fact that women care more about their company's money.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What did the author's team conclude 问作者团队得出了什么结论，是对文中已陈述事实的提取，不需推断。
【拆句】主干是 What did the author's team conclude about the gender difference in airfares，特殊疑问句，conclude 后接 about 引出结论的对象；句末 from their further investigation 是状语，交代结论的来源，是关键定位信号，结构平铺、无陷阱。
【定位】Further investigation allowed us to conclude that this gap is largely explained by the fact that women tended to book earlier than men, 1.8 days on average.
进一步调查使我们得出结论：这一差距很大程度上可由女性比男性订得更早这一事实来解释，平均早 1.8 天。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
this gap is largely explained by the fact that women tended to book earlier than men ↔ It is largely attributed to women booking earlier than men
选项 largely attributed to women booking earlier than men 与预判“价差主要因女性订得更早”完全吻合，是定位句的同义替换。
B)
无中生有
原文将价差归因于订得早，从未说女性“选了更便宜的航班”；women's choosing cheaper flights 是文中没有的新说法。
C)
偷换概念
原文成因是订得早晚，并非男性“更愿意多付钱”；male employees' readiness to pay more 把订得晚导致票价高，曲解成男性主动愿意付高价。
D)
张冠李戴
“女性更在乎公司的钱”是第 4 段负向回报机制的延伸，不是本题进一步调查的结论；women care more about their company's money 张冠李戴到本题。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What did the researchers want to determine by testing a variety of possible explanations?

options.text: What made male frequent travelers book air tickets late.
What caused women to plan ahead in booking business trips.
What motivated women to book cheaper flights.
What accounted for the gender gap in airfares.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 What did the researchers want to determine 问研究者想弄清什么，答案是文中明写的目的，属事实提取。
【拆句】主干 What did the researchers want to determine，后接介词短语 by testing a variety of possible explanations 作方式状语，by 表手段；理清“通过检验多种解释”是手段、“想弄清什么”才是问点，避免把手段当答案。
【定位】We wanted to determine what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips so we tested a variety of possible explanations, such as women choosing to plan ahead or male frequent travelers being inclined to book late.
我们想弄清是什么造成了订商务差旅中的这些性别差异，于是检验了多种可能的解释，比如女性选择提前规划，或男性常旅客倾向于晚订。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
What made male frequent travelers book air tickets late 取自文中举例的待检解释male frequent travelers being inclined to book late，是被检验的假设之一，不是研究总目的。
B)
以偏概全
What caused women to plan ahead in booking business trips 同样取自待检举例women choosing to plan ahead，是子假设而非研究要弄清的总问题。
C)
无中生有
What motivated women to book cheaper flights 中“女性订更便宜的航班”文中从未出现，价差源于订得早而非选便宜航班。
D)
✓ 正确
what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips ↔ What accounted for the gender gap in airfares
What accounted for the gender gap in airfares 正是预判“弄清性别价差成因”的同义表达，锁定该项。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What happened when the negative reciprocity variable was taken into account?

options.text: Both men and women were found to engage in negative behaviors.
Neither men nor women viewed booking late as a bad behavior.
The gender difference in airfare expenses no longer existed.
The gender gap tended to narrow to a significant degree.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What happened when the negative reciprocity variable was taken into account问“当变量被纳入后发生了什么”，结果文中明写，属细节。
【拆句】主干 What happened when ...，when 引导时间状语从句，从句用被动 was taken into account；读懂“当负向回报这一变量被引入分析时”这个条件，结果句即答案。
【定位】It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.
它只是意味着，当我们把负向回报这一变量代入后，性别差距就消失了。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文称男性比女性更常有此类行为 men tend to exhibit more of these negative behaviors than women，并非“男女都有”；Both men and women were found to engage in negative behaviors 与原文相悖，且非“代入变量后”的结果。
B)
偷换概念
原文只说晚订不必然是异常行为 booking relatively late is a sign of abnormal behavior 的免责说明，并非“男女都不视晚订为坏行为”，更不是代入变量后的结果。
C)
✓ 正确
the gender gap disappears ↔The gender difference in airfare expenses no longer existed
The gender difference in airfare expenses no longer existed 与预判“性别差距消失”完全对应，锁定该项。
D)
偷换概念
原文是差距“消失” the gender gap disappears，The gender gap tended to narrow to a significant degree 说成“显著缩小”，程度被改弱，与原文不符。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What did prior research on negative reciprocity among workers find?

options.text: It can do more harm to the workplace than to employees.
It contributes to the male-female divide in the workplace.
It proves to be counterproductive in a number of ways.
It can result in increasing labor-management conflicts.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 What did prior research ... find 问先前研究发现了什么，是文中已陈述的内容，属事实提取。
【拆句】主干 What did prior research on negative reciprocity among workers find，find 是问点动词；among workers 限定研究对象，prior 限定时间，定位时认准“先前的、关于工人的”那项研究。
【定位】Prior research on negative reciprocity among workers found that it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale(士气) and culture.
先前关于工人负向回报的研究发现，它会导致员工积极性、业绩、职场士气与文化的下降。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文未比较“对职场”与“对员工”谁伤害更大；do more harm to the workplace than to employees 凭空造出一个原文没有的比较。
B)
张冠李戴
“造成职场男女分化”是后文 P6 对本研究结果的引申，不是先前研究的发现；contributes to the male-female divide in the workplace 张冠李戴。
C)
✓ 正确
it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale(士气) and culture
↔It proves to be counterproductive in a number of ways
counterproductive in a number of ways 正是预判“多方面负面下降”的抽象概括，锁定该项。
D)
无中生有
原文后果是积极性、业绩、士气、文化下降，无“劳资冲突加剧”；increasing labor-management conflicts 是文中没有的新后果。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author emphasize about their analysis in the last paragraph?

options.text: It can help companies increase their savings significantly.
It can duly contribute to companies' business performance.
It can translate women's booking practice into men's behavior.
It can enhance large multinational companies' competitiveness.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does the author emphasize about their analysis in the last paragraph 锁定最后一段、问其强调点，答案在段内明写，属细节。
【拆句】主干 What does the author emphasize about their analysis，emphasize 后 about引出强调对象 their analysis；末尾 in the last paragraph 限定到最后一段，定位即在该段内。
【定位】Our analysis suggests early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year for a large multinational company with 20,000 regular travelers.
我们的分析表明，女性的早订每年可为一家拥有两万名常旅客的大型跨国公司带来一百万美元的节省。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year ↔ It can help companies increase their savings significantly
help companies increase their savings significantly 正是预判“早订为公司省大钱”的概括，锁定该项。
B)
张冠李戴
“提升业绩”是第 5 段先前研究提到的 business performance，不是末段分析所强调的内容；contribute to companies' business performance 张冠李戴到本段。
C)
偷换概念
原文 translate into 的宾语是 savings（节省），不是“把女性的做法变成男性的行为”；translate women's booking practice into men's behavior 借同一动词曲解原意。
D)
过度推断
原文只谈为公司省钱，未涉及“提升竞争力”；enhance large multinational companies' competitiveness 是过度引申出的新结论。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: Why did the police officer stop the SUV car?

options.text: He noticed the driver was too young to drive.
He found there was no one sitting at the wheel.
He thought something must be wrong with the driver.
He saw the driver changing lanes much too frequently.

explanation:
【题目】Why did the police officer stop the SUV car?
【翻译】警察为什么拦停那辆SUV?
A) 他注意到驾驶员太年轻,不能开车。
B) 他发现驾驶座上没有人。
C) 他认为驾驶员一定出了什么问题。
D) 他看到驾驶员变换车道过于频繁。
【答案】C （细节题）He thought something must be wrong with the driver.
【定位】A police officer in the U.S. stopped a large SUV car that was going very slowly and drifting across lanes on a highway. He expected to find a driver who was either very drunk or having a medical emergency.
美国一名警察拦下了一辆在高速公路上行驶得非常缓慢、还在车道间飘忽乱晃的大型 SUV。他原以为会发现一个要么烂醉、要么突发疾病的司机。
【信号】开篇即点题、紧跟一句"原以为"的推断。新闻把核心事件放在第一句：车 going very slowly and drifting across lanes（开得很慢、车道间乱飘）。紧接着 He expected to find a driver who was either very drunk or having a medical emergency 这句"警察原以为"，直接道出他判断"司机一定出了问题"——这正是拦车的真实理由。
【替换】a driver who was either very drunk or having a medical emergency ↔ something must be wrong with the driver
具体病况概括成"司机有问题"

wheel.

driver.

frequently.
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音后面确实揭晓司机是 a five-year-old boy（五岁男孩），A 项 He noticed the driver was too young to drive.（发现司机太小不能开车）就盗用了这个"年龄小"的事实。但那是警察拦车"之后"才发现的真相，并非拦车的原因——拦车时他根本看不清开车的是谁。听到"小孩"就选 A，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：a five-year-old boy sat on the edge of the driver's seat
B)
与原文相反
B 项 He found there was no one sitting at the wheel.（发现没人坐在方向盘后）听起来很像那个离奇画面，但录音说的是男孩 sat on the edge of the driver's seat——其实有人坐在驾驶位，只是个小孩。而且"座位上情况"是拦车后才看清的，拦车当下警察只看到车乱晃。B 既与原文不符、又答非所问。
借用原文：a five-year-old boy sat on the edge of the driver's seat
D)
偷换概念
D 项 He saw the driver changing lanes much too frequently.（看到司机频繁变道）盗用了原文 drifting across lanes 里的 lanes。但 drifting across lanes 是"车失控地在车道间飘移乱晃"（因为开车的是够不着踏板的小孩），不是司机主动、频繁地变换车道。D把"失控飘移"偷换成"频繁变道"，看似沾边实则两回事。
借用原文：drifting across lanes on a highway
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the boy tell the police officers he was planning to do?

options.text: Buy a sports car.
Drive across town.
Leave California.
Visit his sister.

explanation:
【题目】What did the boy tell the police officers he was planning to do?
【翻译】男孩告诉警察他打算做什么?
A) 买一辆跑车。
B) 开车穿过城镇。
C) 离开California。
D) 看望他的姐姐。
【答案】A （细节题）Buy a sports car.
【定位】The boy later told confused officers that he was planning to travel to California and buy a Lamborghini sports car.
男孩后来告诉一脸困惑的警察，他打算开去加利福尼亚，买一辆兰博基尼跑车。
【信号】planning to 直接引出打算做的事。信号词 he was planning to travel to California and buy a Lamborghini sports car 里的 planning to 正是"表打算"的标志，其后跟着的两个动作（去加州、买跑车）就是男孩的计划，是题目要的答案落点。
【替换】buy a Lamborghini sports car ↔Buy a sports car.
去掉品牌名后即同一动作

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 项 Drive across town.（开车穿过城镇）盗用了原文 drove three kilometers across town 里的 across town。但"开车穿城"是男孩已经做过的事（他已经开了三公里穿过城镇上高速），不是他"打算"做的事。题目问的是 planning to 之后的计划，B 把"已发生"偷换成"打算做"，答非所问。
借用原文：He then drove three kilometers across town before getting on the highway.
C)
与原文相反
C 项 Leave California.（离开加州）盗用了地名 California，但录音说的是 travel to California（去往加州），方向恰好相反——是去、不是离开。地名一念到极易被耳朵抓住，但方向词（to / leave）被悄悄反转，最易让人误选。
借用原文：he was planning to travel to California
D)
原词陷阱
D 项 Visit his sister.（看望他姐姐）盗用了原文出现的 sister。但 sister 在录音里只是"趁姐姐午睡时拿了车钥匙"的背景人物（while his teenage sister was napping），男孩的计划是去加州买跑车，从没说过要去看望姐姐。这是把一个出现过的人名硬塞进"计划"里。
借用原文：while his teenage sister was napping
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the report say we have not yet understood about mobile phones?

options.text: How they change the way we shop.
How they alter human skeletons.
How they cause increased headaches.
How they affect our communication.

explanation:
【题目】What does the report say we have not yet understood about mobile phones?
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.

【翻译】报告称我们尚未了解手机的哪个方面？
A) 手机如何改变我们的购物方式。
B) 手机如何改变人类骨骼。
C) 手机如何导致头痛增加。
D) 手机如何影响我们的沟通。
【答案】B （细节题）How they alter human skeletons.
【定位】What we have not yet understood is the way the tiny machines in front of us are changing our skeletons, possibly altering not just the way we behave but even the very shape of our bodies.
我们还没有理解的，是眼前这些小小的机器正在改变我们的骨骼这件事——它们或许不仅改变我们的行为方式，甚至会改变我们身体的形状。
【信号】题干原话 we have not yet understood 直接复现。录音里 What we have not yet understood is the way the tiny machines in front of us are changing our skeletons 把题干的核心短语 "we have not yet understood" 原样念出，这种 "题干关键词在原文出现"就是答案句的定位信号，紧跟其后的 changing our skeletons 即所求。
【替换】changing our skeletons ↔How they alter human skeletons.
changing 同义替换为 alter
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音开头 how we read, work, communicate, and shop 确实念到 shop 购物，但紧接着说 But we already know this——购物属于 "我们已经知道" 的部分，而题目问的是 "还没理解" 的，正好相反，选它就掉进了原词陷阱。
借用原文：how we read, work, communicate, and shop
C)
未提及
选项 How they cause increased headaches. 说手机导致头痛增多，但整段录音从未提到headaches 头痛，是凭 "手机看多了会头疼" 的生活常识硬加的，属无中生有。
D)
原词陷阱
录音里 how we read, work, communicate, and shop 念到 communicate 沟通，How they affect our communication. 借此设套；但沟通和购物一样属于 But we already know this 已知的部分，不是题问的 "还没理解" 的，故错。
借用原文：how we read, work, communicate, and shop
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What happens to the skin when rubbed or pressed constantly?

options.text: It loosens.
It brightens.
It hardens.
It softens.

explanation:
【题目】What happens to the skin when rubbed or pressed constantly?
【翻译】当皮肤持续受到摩擦或按压时会发生什么？
A) 它变松弛。
B) 它变亮。
C) 它变硬。
D) 它变软。
【答案】C （细节题）It hardens.

【定位】This process can be compared to the way the skin hardens in response to constant rubbing or pressure.
这个过程可以类比皮肤在持续摩擦或受压之下变硬的方式。
【信号】题干关键词 skin、rubbing、pressure 同句聚齐。录音 the skin hardens in response to constant rubbing or pressure 把题干的 skin、rubbed / pressed（原文作 rubbing / pressure）几个词凑在同一句，关键词集中出现即答案句信号，紧跟的动词 hardens 就是结果。
【替换】the skin hardens ↔It hardens.

stem: What does the report say the village is going to do for the cat Wilbur?

Ask a local pet shop to adopt him.
Name an orange tree after him.
Hold a birthday party for him.

explanation:
【题目】What does the report say the village is going to do for the cat Wilbur?
【翻译】报道中说村子将为猫Wilbur做什么?
A) 为它创建网页。
B) 请当地宠物店收养它。
C) 用它的名字命名一棵橙树。
D) 为它举办生日派对。
【答案】D （细节题）Hold a birthday party for him.
【定位】A village is going to throw a birthday party for an orange cat named Wilbur, who has become famous for making a regular appearance at local shops.
一座村庄即将为一只名叫 Wilbur 的橘猫举办生日派对，这只猫因为经常出现在当地店铺而声名鹊起。
【信号】开篇 going to 句式即新闻核心事件。新闻第一句 A village is going to throw a birthday party for an orange cat named Wilbur 用 going to 直接给出整条新闻的核心事件，符合短篇新闻「开门见山报导何事」的体例，是本题的答案句无疑。
【替换】is going to throw a birthday party ↔Hold a birthday party for him.
throw=hold 的同义词替换
for an orange cat named Wilbur ↔for him
具体名词到人称代词的概括

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 Create Internet pages for him. 借用了第二段 Wilbur has his own Internet pages这一原词，但原文说的是 Wilbur 已经拥有自己的网页（既成事实），而非村庄「将要为他创建」网页，且这件事不是「村庄为他做的事」，属于答非所问加时态错位的双重陷阱。
借用原文：Wilbur has his own Internet pages
B)
未提及
选项 Ask a local pet shop to adopt him. 抓住了录音里反复出现的 local shops 这一概念，但录音从未提及 pet shop 或 adopt——Wilbur 是已经有人照看的明星猫，「让宠物店领养他」是凭借 cat/shops 自行联想的过度推断。
C)
原词陷阱
选项 Name an orange tree after him. 同时盗用了 an orange cat 中的 orange 和named Wilbur 中的 name，制造「以橘猫之名命名橘树」的错觉，但原文里 orange 修饰的是 cat、name 是给猫命名，与「橘树」毫无关系。

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the report about the cat?

A) 它是一只大胆好斗的宠物。
B) 它定期光顾村里的商店。

D) 它喜欢坐在理发师的椅子上。

他的大部分时间都泡在村里的店铺和商家里，他会自顾自地走进任何一家店，到处都是。
【信号】频次副词 most of his time 与范围词 any/anywhere 强调常态。He spends most of his time in shops and businesses around the village 里的 most of his time 与紧接着的He'll just take himself into any shop, anywhere 中的 any/anywhere，都是高强度的频次与范围信号，明确告诉考生「经常去店铺」是这只猫的常态行为——这正是 B 项 regular visits 的答案信号。
【替换】spends most of his time in shops and businesses around the village ↔ pays regular visits to village shops.
频次副词 most of his time 与 regular 等值
shops and businesses around the village ↔village shops
村庄里的店铺这一对象一致
making a regular appearance at local shops ↔pays regular visits to village shops.
regular appearance 与 regular visits 直接对应

【排除】A)
与原文相反
选项 He is a bold and aggressive pet. 盗用了录音里 Wilbur is both bold and friendly中的 bold，但把后半句的 friendly 偷偷换成了 aggressive。bold 在 friendly 与aggressive 两种语境下意思走向完全相反，原文明确说他是 bold and friendly（大胆又友好），与 aggressive 截然相反。
借用原文：Wilbur is both bold and friendly
C)
原词陷阱
选项 He once bit a doctor's receptionist. 借用了录音里 the doctor's receptionist came back and he was sitting on her chair 中 receptionist 这一原词，但原文说的是「前台回来时发现他坐在自己椅子上」，根本没有「咬人」这一情节。bite 是凭「猫与人接触」自行加戏的虚构事件。
借用原文：the doctor's receptionist came back and he was sitting on her chair
D)
张冠李戴
选项 He likes to sit on the hairdresser's chair. 把「坐在椅子上」这一情节（原文里发生在 the doctor's receptionist came back and he was sitting on her chair 即医生前台的椅子上）安到了理发店的椅子上。原文只在 Among his favorite haunts are a local hairdresser 里提及理发店是他常去的地方之一，但并未说他喜欢坐理发店椅子。

stem: What are the speakers talking about in this conversation?

options.text: Who to order the food.
Whether to have sandwiches.
When to go for their meal.
Where to have their lunch.

explanation:
【题目】What are the speakers talking about in this conversation?
【翻译】说话者在这段对话中谈论什么?
A) 由谁来订餐。
B) 是否吃三明治。
C) 何时去用餐。
D) 在哪里吃午餐。
【答案】D （主旨题）Where to have their lunch.
【定位】M: So, where do you want to go for lunch?
男：那你想去哪儿吃午饭？
【信号】开门见山的话题问句。where do you want to go for lunch? 是对话的第一句，用 So 起头直接抛话题，正是听力主旨题最常用的开头点题信号。后续整段所有讨论（三明治店、汉堡店、意大利餐厅）都是围绕这句话在选地方吃午饭。
【替换】where do you want to go for lunch? ↔Where to have their lunch.
where to go 与 where to have 同义

【排除】A)
未提及
全篇对话围绕选餐厅展开，从头到尾没有任何一句提到由谁来点食物，纯属 Who to order the food. 制造的无中生有。
B)
录音里 What about the Sandwich Place on Camden Street? 与 I don't feel like sandwiches today. 确实念到了 sandwiches，Whether to have sandwiches. 就盗用了这个原词，让「听到原词就想选」的考生中招。但实际上三明治只是男方第一个提议的备选之一，被否决后整段对话又讨论了汉堡、意大利餐厅，三明治远不足以代表主旨。
借用原文：I don't feel like sandwiches today.
C)
录音里 I need to get back by 2:30 for a conference call. 出现了具体时间，但那是女方解释自己时间紧、不要选服务慢的店的附带理由，整段对话从未围绕「几点去吃」展开讨论，When to go for their meal. 把次要约束当主线。
借用原文：I need to get back by 2:30 for a conference call.

stem: Why does the woman say Jeremy should throw his soup in the bin?

options.text: She doesn't deem homemade soup tasty.
She doesn't think his wife cooks well.
She feels Jeremy would rather dine out.
She has found the soup smells terrible.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the woman say Jeremy should throw his soup in the bin?
【翻译】女士为什么说Jeremy应该把他的汤扔进垃圾桶?
A) 她认为自制汤不好吃。
B) 她认为他妻子厨艺不好。
C) 她觉得Jeremy宁愿在外面吃饭。
D) 她发现这汤闻起来很难闻。
【答案】B （推断题）She doesn't think his wife cooks well.
【定位】W: Poor Jeremy. His wife is a terrible cook. He should throw that soup in the bin and join us.
女：可怜的 Jeremy。他妻子是个糟糕的厨师。他真该把那碗汤扔了，跟我们一起去。
【信号】终判式因果链。His wife is a terrible cook. He should throw that soup in the bin 是一个语义上的因果链：先下评判 His wife is a terrible cook，再据此建议 He should throw…。前一句就是建议的真正原因，是答案句中最关键的承载句。
【替换】His wife is a terrible cook. ↔She doesn't think his wife cooks well.
贬义形容词转含蓄否定

【排除】A)
偷换概念
录音里女方的批评对象是 His wife（人 - 妻子的厨艺），不是汤本身。She doesn't deem homemade soup tasty. 把矛头从「妻子厨艺差」偷换成「她觉得家常汤本身不好吃」，是范围偏移。她没有否定家常汤这个品类，只是否定他妻子做的这一碗。
借用原文：His wife is a terrible cook.
C)
录音 He should throw that soup in the bin and join us. 出现了 join us，She feels Jeremy would rather dine out. 就据此过度推断成「她觉得 Jeremy 更愿意出去吃」。但女方建议他出来吃是她的提议，不是 Jeremy 自己的偏好；原文里 Jeremy 自己说的是 He has brought his own lunch today, so he will stay in.，恰恰是要留下不出去。C 把女方的建议错认成 Jeremy 的意愿，过度推断且方向反了。
借用原文：He should throw that soup in the bin and join us.
D)
原词陷阱
录音里女方说的是 His wife is a terrible cook.——评价做菜人的水平，从未提到汤闻起来怎么样。She has found the soup smells terrible. 盗用了 terrible 这个原词，但把它从修饰 cook 偷换为修饰 smells，是经典的「原词换搭配」陷阱。
借用原文：His wife is a terrible cook.

stem: Who is the man talking to in the conversation?

options.text: A landlady.
A waitress.
A receptionist.
A saleswoman.

explanation:
【题目】Who is the man talking to in the conversation?
【翻译】对话中男士在和谁说话?
A) 女房东。
B) 女服务员。
C) 接待员。
D) 女销售员。
【答案】C （细节题）A receptionist.
【定位】Hi, there. How are you today? Do you have a reservation with us already?
你好，今天感觉如何？您已经在我们这里预订了吗？
【信号】开场专属话术。Do you have a reservation with us already? 是酒店前台接待客人时最典型的开场询问——问『是否有预订』。这种『询问预订』的话术是接待员的专属标记，是定身份的信号句。
【替换】Do you have a reservation with us already? ↔A receptionist.
话术 → 身份的同义替换
I can get you all checked in and show you to your rooms. ↔A receptionist.
结尾办理入住二次确认

【排除】A)
未提及
A landlady. 是出租房屋的房东，话术应是 rent/deposit/lease，不会用 reservation 这类酒店术语；录音里也没有出现任何与租房相关的词。
B)
原词陷阱
A waitress. 是餐厅服务员。录音 has all kinds of food and cool little shops 确实提到了food，但讲的是夜市，不是接待方提供餐饮服务，属于典型原词陷阱——听到 food 就误以为对方是 waitress。
借用原文：has all kinds of food and cool little shops selling souvenirs and local jewelry and clothing made by hand
D)
原词陷阱
A saleswoman. 是售货员。录音 cool little shops selling souvenirs and local jewelry and clothing made by hand 确实提到了『卖纪念品和手工衣物的小店』，但卖东西的是夜市的小店，不是这位接待者，属于典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：cool little shops selling souvenirs and local jewelry and clothing made by hand

stem: What do we learn about the man's father-in-law from the conversation?

options.text: He was involved in a terrible car accident last April.
He has much difficulty getting up and down stairs.
He is expected to undergo a knee operation.
He prefers to stay next door to the children.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the man's father-in-law from the conversation?
【翻译】从对话中我们了解到男士的岳父有什么情况?
A) 他去年四月遭遇了一场严重的车祸。
B) 他上下楼梯非常困难。
C) 他预计要接受膝关节手术。
D) 他更愿意住在孩子们隔壁。
【答案】B （细节题）He has much difficulty getting up and down stairs.
【定位】My father-in-law has had terrible problems getting up and down stairs since his knee operation last April.
我岳父自从去年四月做了膝关节手术以来，上下楼梯一直有很大困难。
【信号】现在完成时 + since 圈定当前状态。has had terrible problems getting up and down stairs since his knee operation last April 中 has had 是现在完成时，配合 since…，明确这是『从手术之后一直延续到现在的状况』。手术（knee operation）是过去事件、上下楼梯困难（getting up and down stairs）才是当前状态——也就是题目要问的『现在我们了解到他怎么样』。
【替换】has had terrible problems getting up and down stairs ↔ He has much difficulty getting up and down stairs.
terrible problems = much difficulty

April.

stairs.

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
He was involved in a terrible car accident last April. 盗用了录音里的 terrible 与 last April 这两个高辨识度词，制造『我好像听见 terrible 和 last April』的错觉，但录音里 last April 修饰的是 knee operation（膝关节手术），不是 car accident（车祸）；车祸录音里根本没提。
借用原文：has had terrible problems getting up and down stairs since his knee operation last April
C)
与原文相反
He is expected to undergo a knee operation. 用 is expected to undergo（将要做）描述膝关节手术，但录音里 since his knee operation last April 说的是『自从去年四月做了手术之后』——手术已经做完。时态从过去/完成偷换成将来，与原文相反。
借用原文：since his knee operation last April
D)
张冠李戴
He prefers to stay next door to the children. 借用了录音 right next to each other on the ground floor 里 next to 的安排关系，但录音说的是『前台把两间房安排在彼此隔壁』，并不是岳父 prefers（更愿意）住孩子隔壁，主语与动机都被替换。
借用原文：right next to each other on the ground floor, since you mentioned in your message that they have trouble with stairs

stem: Why does the man say they will explore all the options available?

options.text: To please his parents-in-law.
To find the best trip for his kids.
To satisfy his curiosity.
To compare prices.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the man say they will explore all the options available?
【翻译】男士为什么说他们会探索所有可行的选择?
A) 为了取悦他的岳父母。
B) 为了给他的孩子们找到最好的旅行。
C) 为了满足他的好奇心。
D) 为了比较价格。
【答案】D （细节题）To compare prices.
【定位】We were thinking of renting a car, but we will explore all the options available for sure. So, yes, that would be very helpful in comparing prices.
我们本来打算租辆车，但我们一定会把所有可选方案都看一遍。所以，是的，这对比价会很有帮助。
【信号】So + that would be very helpful in...。So, yes, that would be very helpful in comparing prices. 中 So 是结果连词，紧跟前一句『会把所有方案都看一遍』，that would be very helpful in 直接说明这样做的好处/目的——comparing prices（比价）。这就是男方自报动机的关键句。
【替换】that would be very helpful in comparing prices ↔To compare prices.
be helpful in V-ing → To do

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
To please his parents-in-law. 利用了录音 another double room for your parents-in-law 里 parents-in-law 这个原词，让人误以为『探索所有方案是为了照顾岳父母』，但录音里只说他们『住一楼』，从未把『探索方案』的动机归到讨好岳父母上。
借用原文：another double room for your parents-in-law
B)
原词陷阱
To find the best trip for his kids. 利用了录音 The kids will love it 里出现的 kids 与 trip两个原词，制造『是为了给孩子找最佳旅程』的错觉。但 The kids will love it 是女方推荐boat trip 时说的，男方说『探索所有方案』的动机不是这件事。
借用原文：The kids will love it and there are so many islands nearby to explore
C)
未提及
To satisfy his curiosity. 录音里完全没有出现 curiosity 或与好奇心相关的表达；选项是凭空加的目的，属于未提及型干扰。

stem: What does the woman suggest the man and his family do close to the end of the conversation?

options.text: Visit a local art gallery.
Go on a boat trip.
Take some photos of the islands.
Try her hand-made clothing.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman suggest the man and his family do close to the end of the conversation?
【翻译】在对话接近尾声时,女士建议男士和他的家人做什么?
A) 参观当地的美术馆。
B) 进行一次乘船游览。
C) 拍摄一些岛屿的照片。
D) 试穿她手工制作的衣服。
【答案】B （细节题）Go on a boat trip.
【定位】I would recommend getting out on a boat trip. The kids will love it and there are so many islands nearby to explore.
我会推荐你们去坐船出游一趟。孩子们会很喜欢，附近还有很多岛屿可以探索。
【信号】I would recommend... 建议句。I would recommend getting out on a boat trip. 中 I would recommend 是最显性的建议信号词，紧跟的动作 getting out on a boat trip 就是被建议的事。
【替换】getting out on a boat trip ↔Go on a boat trip.
getting out on = Go on

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
未提及
Visit a local art gallery. 录音里完全没有提到 art gallery（艺术画廊）；女方推荐的是boat trip 和 night market，画廊纯属选项添加的迷惑活动。
C)
原词陷阱
Take some photos of the islands. 利用了录音 there are so many islands nearby to explore 里出现的 islands 一词，让人以为『建议去拍岛屿照片』。但原文里 islands 是boat trip 时『可以探索』的对象，女方从未建议『拍照』；take photos 这个动作录音里没有出现。
借用原文：there are so many islands nearby to explore
D)
张冠李戴
Try her hand-made clothing. 利用了录音 clothing made by hand 这个原词组，但录音里 clothing made by hand 是『夜市小店在卖』的东西，不是『她』（前台接待员）自己手工做的，也不是被建议的核心动作；同时 try（试穿/尝试）这个动作录音里也没有。
借用原文：clothing made by hand

stem: What does the passage say about artificial intelligence agents?

options.text: They are more intelligent than many of us.
They have already become our new friends.
They have begun to affect our social behavior.
They play increasingly more important roles.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about artificial intelligence agents?
【翻译】文章关于人工智能代理说了什么?
A) 它们比我们许多人更聪明。
B) 它们已经成为我们的新朋友。
C) 它们已经开始影响我们的社会行为。
D) 它们发挥着越来越重要的作用。
【答案】D （细节题）They play increasingly more important roles.
【定位】Artificial intelligence agents play ever more influential roles in our lives.
人工智能代理在我们的生活中扮演着越来越具有影响力的角色。
【信号】篇章首句即点题句。答案句正是录音的第一句 Artificial intelligence agents play ever more influential roles in our lives.：篇章独白的开头第一句几乎一定是点题句，直接给出对象 + 总体评价，这是篇章听力定位最强的信号——比任何转折词都更稳。
【替换】play ever more influential roles ↔play increasingly more important roles
ever more 与 increasingly 同义改写

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
They are more intelligent than many of us. 利用了录音里 Artificial intelligence agents中 intelligence 这个词，把 "人工智能" 偷换成 "它们比我们许多人更聪明"。录音从未把 AI与人做智力比较，主体考生一听到 intelligence 就反射性挑 intelligent 是典型的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Artificial intelligence agents
B)
与原文相反
They have already become our new friends. 利用了录音里 suggesting new friends（替我们推荐新朋友），把 "推荐朋友" 偷换成 "它们自己已经成为我们的新朋友"。这是already + 完成时把功能性服务夸大为既成事实，方向已经反了。
借用原文：suggesting new friends
C)
偷换概念
They have begun to affect our social behavior. 利用了录音里 play ever more influential roles in our lives（在生活中起越来越重要的作用），把宽泛的 "生活" 偷换成专指的 social behavior（社交行为）。录音从未提及 social behavior 这一具体范畴，属于把宽口径收窄到一个录音没说过的窄范畴。
借用原文：play ever more influential roles in our lives
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the new study want to find out about using an artificial intelligence agent?

options.text: Whether it might have any effect on the way we negotiate.
Whether it might actually outperform human negotiators.
Whether it can facilitate business transactions.
Whether it can speed up legal procedures.

explanation:
【题目】What does the new study want to find out about using an artificial intelligence agent?
【翻译】这项新研究想要了解关于使用人工智能代理的什么问题?
A) 它是否可能对我们谈判的方式产生影响。
B) 它是否可能实际上超越人类谈判者。
C) 它能否促进商业交易。
D) 它能否加快法律程序。
【答案】A （细节题）Whether it might have any effect on the way we negotiate.
【定位】So, it's important to know whether using an artificial intelligence agent might affect how we negotiate.
因此，弄清楚使用人工智能代理是否会影响我们谈判的方式，是很重要的。
【信号】So 引出结论 + know whether 引出研究问题。答案句以 So, it's important to know whether using an artificial intelligence agent might affect how we negotiate. 出现：So 是结论信号，it's important to know whether… 是研究问题的固定起手式——这是篇章里 "研究想搞清什么" 最强的语言信号，几乎不会与别的句子搞混。

【替换】might affect how we negotiate ↔might have any effect on the way we negotiate
动词 affect 与名词 effect 同根改写
it's important to know whether ↔Whether it might have any effect on the way we negotiate.
Whether 从句被独立保留
【排除】B)
过度推断
Whether it might actually outperform human negotiators. 把研究问题从 "是否影响我们的谈判方式" 强行升级为 "是否真的胜过人类谈判者"。录音里只问 affect，没有任何outperform / beat / better than 的提法，是典型把 "有影响" 推到 "胜过" 的两步跳跃。
C)
原词陷阱
Whether it can facilitate business transactions. 直接搬用了录音里 commercial transactions（商业交易）这个场景词。录音只是把 commercial transactions 列为 AI 代理可能介入的应用场景之一，并没有把它定为研究问题；选项把 "场景" 偷换成 "研究问题"，是典型听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：commercial transactions
D)
原词陷阱
Whether it can speed up legal procedures. 同样借用了录音里 legal disputes（法律纠纷）这个场景词，再把名词改成 legal procedures（法律程序）。录音没有提加快速度（speed up）这一研究目标，是 "原词靠近 + 概念替换" 的双重陷阱。
借用原文：legal disputes
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did participants tend to do when assigned an AI agent to negotiate on their behalf?

options.text: Choose to be tough.
Sympathize with their opponent.
Use deceptive strategies.
Appear to be pleasant.

explanation:
【题目】What did participants tend to do when assigned an AI agent to negotiate on their behalf?
【翻译】当被分配一个人工智能代理代表他们进行谈判时,参与者倾向于做什么?
A) 选择表现强硬。
B) 同情他们的对手。
C) 使用欺骗性策略。
D) 表现得令人愉快。
【答案】C （细节题）Use deceptive strategies.
【定位】Participants were more willing to employ deceptive strategies when assigned an agent to negotiate on their behalf.
当被安排一个代理替自己谈判时，参与者更愿意采用欺骗性策略。
【信号】段末 were more willing to 是结论信号。答案句出现在录音末尾 Participants were more willing to employ deceptive strategies when assigned an agent to negotiate on their behalf.：段末 + were more willing to 是研究类篇章给出实验结论最稳的双重信号——前面 tough / sympathy / anger / dissatisfaction 都是为它做铺垫的策略列举，真正的结论压到最后一句。

【替换】were more willing to employ deceptive strategies ↔Use deceptive strategies.
employ 与 Use 同义替换
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Choose to be tough. 直接借用录音 participants could choose to be tough by making an opening demand far greater than what they'd be willing to accept 中 "choose to be tough" 几个原词。但这一句只是研究方法里 "参与者可以做出哪些选择" 的举例之一，不是研究结论里 "被安排代理时实际倾向做" 的事。听到 tough 就选是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：participants could choose to be tough
B)
原词陷阱
Sympathize with their opponent. 借用了录音 choose to express sympathy with their opponent to appear pleasant 里 sympathy with their opponent。这句同样是研究方法的举例选项之一，是受试者 "可以选" 的策略，不是结论性倾向；选项把 sympathy 改成sympathize 听起来更顺耳，但只是原词陷阱。
借用原文：express sympathy with their opponent
D)
原词陷阱
Appear to be pleasant. 借用了录音 to appear pleasant 的几个字。但 to appear pleasant 在录音里只是说明 "表达同情" 这种策略的目的（让自己看起来友好），仍属于研究方法的举例铺垫，并不是结论。把目的状语当作结论行为是典型 "听到 pleasant 就选" 的原词陷阱。
借用原文：to appear pleasant
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the benefits the participants gained from the healthy cooking course?

options.text: They were perceived differently by some academics.
They still existed six months after the course ended.
They varied greatly among the course participants.
They were only measurable within seven weeks.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the benefits the participants gained from the healthy cooking course?
【翻译】关于参与者从健康烹饪课程中获得的益处，我们了解到什么？
A) 它们被一些学者以不同方式看待。
B) 它们在课程结束六个月后仍然存在。
C) 它们在课程参与者之间差异很大。
D) 它们只能在七周内测量。
【答案】B （细节题）They still existed six months after the course ended.
【定位】These benefits remained six months after the completion of the course.
这些益处在课程结束六个月之后依然存在。
【信号】段落收束句 + 时间锚点 six months。These benefits remained six months after the completion of the course. 是第二段最后一句，承担收束作用：前两句 Course participants saw significant improvements in general health. 与 They also reported improved mental health and subjective vitality immediately after the program. 先讲了课程结束后“立即”的好处，最后一句一个 remained + six months 把时间窗拉长——这正是预读时圈出的时间锚点。
【替换】These benefits remained six months after the completion of the course. ↔ They still existed six months after the course ended.
remained = still existed；completion of the course = course ended

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项里 perceived differently by some academics 听起来像在说“被某些学者看法不一”，它盗用了第一段里 Academics measured the program's effect on cooking confidence and self-perceived mental health. 出现过的 Academics 与 self-perceived，但录音从未说 academics 之间对这些好处有不同看法，是把原文里出现过的词重新拼装成一个新意思。
借用原文：Academics measured the program's effect on cooking confidence and self-perceived mental health.
C)
与原文相反
选项 They varied greatly among the course participants. 说好处在参与者之间差异巨大，但第四段 Also, the mental health benefits were equal among participants who were overweight or obese and those in a healthy weight range. 反而说好处在不同体重人群之间是相等的，方向恰好与本选项相反。
借用原文：the mental health benefits were equal among participants who were overweight or obese and those in a healthy weight range
D)
原词陷阱
选项 They were only measurable within seven weeks. 表面有 seven weeks 这个录音里念到的数字（a seven-week healthy cooking course），听起来像是“原话”。但 seven-week 在录音中只是课程的时长，不是好处的可测时间窗；而且加了 only 限定，与第二段的 six months 直接矛盾。
借用原文：a seven-week healthy cooking course
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2023-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do the new research findings suggest about mental health benefits?

options.text: They can be easily seen among participants in a healthy weight range.
They should be attributed to participants' change in diet behaviors.
They are linked to cooking confidence and cooking satisfaction.
They actually result from eating more fruits and vegetables.

explanation:
【题目】What do the new research findings suggest about mental health benefits?
【翻译】关于心理健康益处，新的研究发现表明了什么？
A) 它们可以在体重处于健康范围的参与者中轻易观察到。
B) 它们应归因于参与者饮食行为的改变。
C) 它们与烹饪信心和烹饪满意度相关。
D) 它们实际上源于摄入更多水果和蔬菜。
【答案】C （细节题）They are linked to cooking confidence and cooking satisfaction.
【定位】This suggests a link between cooking confidence and satisfaction around cooking, and mental health benefits.
这一点表明，烹饪信心与对烹饪的满足感和心理健康益处之间存在关联。

【信号】转折 However 之后的 This suggests 结论句。第四段首句 However, the study showed participants' mental health improved even if their reported diet did not change after completing the program. 用 however 翻盘——把第三段“也许是因为多吃果蔬”的猜测推翻；段尾 This suggests a link between cooking confidence and satisfaction around cooking, and mental health benefits. 用 This suggests 直接给出研究真正归因。这两个信号（however + This suggests）是听力定位结论句的金标准。
【替换】This suggests a link between cooking confidence and satisfaction around cooking, and mental health benefits.
↔They are linked to cooking confidence and cooking satisfaction.
a link between A and B = A are linked to B
satisfaction around cooking ↔cooking satisfaction

【题目】What plays a role in determining who benefits most from learning to cook?
【翻译】什么因素在决定谁从学习烹饪中获益最多方面发挥作用？
A) 性别。
B) 信心。

谁从学做饭中获益最多？性别在其中起了作用。
【信号】段首设问 + 直接应答。Who benefits most from learning to cook? 是段首设问，几乎是把题干 What plays a role in determining who benefits most from learning to cook?原样念了一遍——这种设问句之后的第一句 Gender plays a part. 就是答案句。设问+应答是篇章独白里最强的答案信号。

stem: What does research show about our personal space?

options.text: It keeps others away.
It causes discomfort.
It remains visible.
It varies in size.

explanation:
【题目】What does research show about our personal space?
【翻译】研究表明我们的个人空间有什么特点?
A) 它使他人保持距离。
B) 它会引起不适。
C) 它保持可见。
D) 它的大小会变化。
【答案】D （细节题）It varies in size.
【定位】Research shows, however, that we actually have bubbles of different sizes.
然而，研究表明，我们实际上拥有不同大小的（个人空间）气泡。

【信号】Research shows + however 转折。答案句一头连了两个强信号：Research shows 是题干 What does research show 的原句对应，however 是转折信号，转折之后才是真意——前半『以为是同一个气泡』被推翻，后半『其实大小不同』才是结论。
【替换】bubbles of different sizes ↔It varies in size.
bubbles of different sizes = varies in size
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 It keeps others away. 借用了原文 others can't enter 里的 others 来制造『听到others 就想选』的诱惑；但原文说的是『别人进不来（指气泡的功能描述）』，并不是『研究发现』那条结论。研究发现的真意在转折 however 之后，不在转折之前。
借用原文：others can't enter
B)
原词陷阱
选项 It causes discomfort. 抓住了原文 without causing discomfort 里的 discomfort 来制造原词陷阱；但原文是说『别人进入气泡会带来不适』，描述的是『进入气泡的后果』，不是研究本身的结论。这条信息在 23 题才用得上，放到 22 题就是张冠李戴。
借用原文：without causing discomfort
C)
与原文相反
选项 It remains visible. 说气泡『一直可见』，而原文 an invisible bubble of space 明确说 invisible（看不见）。选项盗用了气泡这个话题，却把极性反过来了，是典型的极性反转陷阱。
借用原文：an invisible bubble of space

explanation:
【题目】What happens if a mere acquaintance enters our intimate space?
【翻译】如果一个泛泛之交进入我们的亲密空间会发生什么?
A) 它使我们感到不舒服。
B) 它使这个熟人变成陌生人。
C) 它使这个熟人与我们更亲近。
D) 它导致我们周围的气泡消失。
【答案】A （细节题）It makes us feel uncomfortable.
【定位】A mere acquaintance entering our intimate space makes us uncomfortable.
一个仅仅是熟人的人进入我们的亲密空间，会让我们感到不舒服。
【信号】题干定位词原句重现。录音里 A mere acquaintance entering our intimate space 几乎是题干 a mere acquaintance enters our intimate space 的原句搬运，定位词全中；其后紧跟的 makes us uncomfortable 就是直白结果，是典型的『触发条件 + 紧跟结果』结构。
【替换】makes us uncomfortable ↔It makes us feel uncomfortable.
几乎逐词对应

【排除】B)
过度推断
选项 It renders the acquaintance a stranger. 借用录音里反复出现的 acquaintance 和strangers 来制造『听到原词就选』的诱惑；但原文从未说『熟人会变成陌生人』，只是分别为不同人群分配了不同空间。从『让人不适』推到『熟人变陌生人』属于过度推断。
借用原文：Friends and acquaintances can comfortably occupy this zone

与原文相反
选项 It brings the acquaintance closer to us. 说『把熟人拉近』，但原文 makes us uncomfortable 明确说会让我们不适，属于结果方向反了。同时它盗用了 acquaintance 这个原词来骗你选。

D)
未提及
选项 It causes the bubble around us to vanish. 借用整组核心词 bubble 来吸引点击，但录音从未说过『熟人进入亲密空间会让气泡消失』，只是说会让我们不舒服。bubble vanish 这一结果属于原文未提及。

stem: When are the sizes of our bubbles fixed?

options.text: When we begin to feel fear.

explanation:
【题目】When are the sizes of our bubbles fixed?
【翻译】我们的气泡大小在什么时候固定下来?
A) 当我们开始感到恐惧时。
B) 当我们形成空间意识时。
C) 当我们3岁或4岁时。
D) 当我们进入青少年时期时。
【答案】D （细节题）When we enter our teens.
【定位】The sizes of our bubbles are fixed by our teens.
我们（个人空间）气泡的大小在我们进入青少年时期时就被定型了。
【信号】题干原句重现 + 关键介词 by。录音 The sizes of our bubbles are fixed by our teens 几乎逐词复述题干 the sizes of our bubbles fixed，再加上时间介词 by our teens，定位与时间一并锁定。这是题干原句重现 + 时间限定词紧跟的双信号。
【替换】by our teens ↔When we enter our teens.
介词短语 ↔ 时间状语从句
are fixed ↔fixed
动作原词重现

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 When we begin to feel fear. 盗用了录音 the brain region involved in fear 里的fear 来吸引点击，但原文从未把 fear 当作一个时间节点，只是顺带提到大脑里负责恐惧的区域参与构建气泡。这是把『脑区话题』偷换成『时间节点』。
借用原文：These bubbles are constructed and monitored by the brain region involved in fear.
B)
答非所问
选项 When we develop a sense of space. 盗用了录音 we begin to develop our individual sense of personal space 里的 develop 和 sense of space，但这一句对应的动作是 develop（开始发展），不是题干问的 fixed（被定型）。同一段里两个动作各配一个时间，选项把动作和时间故意错配。
借用原文：we begin to develop our individual sense of personal space around age 3 or 4
C)
张冠李戴
选项 When we are 3 or 4 years old. 直接盗用了录音里的数字 around age 3 or 4，但这个年龄绑的是『开始发展空间感』(develop)，不是『定型』(fixed)。题干问的是 fixed 的时间，故 3 or 4 岁是错配。
借用原文：around age 3 or 4

stem: How can competitive rivalry benefit entrepreneurs according to the passage?

options.text: By enabling them to outcompete other entrepreneurs.
By enabling them to make their venture a success.
By helping them to reach long-term goals.
By helping them to stay goal-oriented.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】How can competitive rivalry benefit entrepreneurs 问的是"靠什么具体方式带来好处"，答案是文中某句客观陈述，属细节题。
【拆句】主干是 How can competitive rivalry benefit entrepreneurs，competitive rivalry（竞争性的对手关系）作主语，benefit 在这里是动词"使……受益"，entrepreneurs（创业者）是宾语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Having a rival can keep you committed to achieving your goals and enhance your overall performance.
有一个竞争对手能让你持续专注于实现自己的目标，并提升你的整体表现。
【选项】A)
答非所问
By enabling them to outcompete other entrepreneurs"使其胜过其他创业者"是"拥有对手"的前提情境，文章首段说的好处是专注目标、提升表现，不是"胜过别人"本身。
B)
过度推断
By enabling them to make their venture a success"使其事业成功"是夸大结果；原文只说 enhance your overall performance"提升表现"，并未说能"让事业成功"。
C)
无中生有
By helping them to reach long-term goals 多出 long-term"长期"这一限定；原文achieving your goals 只说"目标"，并未区分长期短期。
D)
✓ 正确
keep you committed to achieving your goals ↔helping them to stay goal-oriented
四项中只有 helping them to stay goal-oriented 准确对应定位句"保持专注目标"这一好处，与预判一致。

stem: What is one of the traps entrepreneurs may often fall into when competing with rivals?

options.text: They may adopt strategies that are bound to ruin their venture.
They may resort to unethical means to outperform their rivals.
They may be too eager to succeed while ignoring the huge labor cost.
They may be intently focused on winning at the current market level.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What is one of the traps 问的是文中列出的某一个具体陷阱，答案直接来自原文陈述，属细节题。
【拆句】What is one of the traps entrepreneurs may often fall into when competing with rivals：主干问 What is one of the traps，后接 entrepreneurs…fall into 是省略了关系词的定语从句修饰 traps，when competing 是时间状语。fall into a trap 是固定搭配"落入陷阱"。
【定位】They found that when people compete against their rivals, they are more willing to behave unethically to win.
他们发现，当人们与对手竞争时，更愿意为了取胜而采取不道德的行为。
【选项】A)
过度推断
strategies that are bound to ruin their venture 用 bound to"必定"把后果说死；原文 may stain your reputation 只是"可能"损害声誉，并非必然毁掉事业。
B)
✓ 正确
behave unethically to win ↔resort to unethical means to outperform their rivals
resort to unethical means to outperform their rivals 与定位句"为赢而行不道德之事"完全对应，与预判一致。
C)
无中生有
ignoring the huge labor cost 里的 labor cost"劳动成本"文中从未提及；第2段讲的是忽视"如何取胜"的方式，不是忽视成本。
D)
偷换概念
winning at the current market level 把第3段 next level 的"层级"挪来，原文从未说陷阱是"只盯当前市场层级"，属拼接错位。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页

stem: What are entrepreneurs advised to do to avoid traps that often accompany rivalry?

options.text: Deliberate on what really matters.
Prioritize reaping immediate benefits.
Estimate the long-term consequences.
Reflect on what successes are achievable.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What are entrepreneurs advised to do 问作者建议的具体做法，答案是原文对策句的转述，属细节题。
【拆句】What are entrepreneurs advised to do to avoid traps that often accompany rivalry：被动结构 are advised to do（被建议做某事），to avoid… 是目的状语，that often accompany rivalry 是定语从句修饰 traps，accompany 意为"伴随"。
【定位】One way to avoid this trap is to stop and reflect on what's important.
避免这个陷阱的一个办法是停下来，反思什么才是重要的。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
reflect on what's important ↔Deliberate on what really matters
Deliberate on what really matters 精确对应对策句，与预判一致。
B)
与原文相反
Prioritize reaping immediate benefits"优先攫取眼前利益"恰与原文相悖：原文 the loss of your integrity will have long-term consequences 是提醒别只图短期，B 却让人优先短期。
C)
偷换概念
Estimate the long-term consequences"评估长期后果"取自原文 long-term consequences，但那是说明丧失诚信的代价，并非作者建议的做法（作者建议是"反思什么重要"）。
D)
偷换概念
Reflect on what successes are achievable 借用了原文 reflect on，却把宾语改成"哪些成功可实现"；原文反思的对象是 what's important"什么重要"，而非"成功是否可达"。

stem: How can entrepreneurs avoid making impulsive and insensible decisions?

options.text: By engaging themselves in critical reasoning.
By developing a habit of keeping their integrity.
By criticizing themselves for previous poor performances.
By refraining from being too excited about their successes.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】How can entrepreneurs avoid making impulsive and insensible decisions 问避免冲动决策的具体办法，答案直取原文方法句，属细节题。
【拆句】How can entrepreneurs avoid making impulsive and insensible decisions：avoid 后接动名词 making（avoid doing 固定用法），impulsive"冲动的"、insensible"不明智的"两个形容词并列修饰 decisions。结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】But it's possible to avoid such costly mistakes by making a habit of engaging in critical thinking, such as considering opposing viewpoints and conducting cost-benefit analyses, especially for those decisions that are complex and can determine the future of your venture.
但可以通过养成进行批判性思考的习惯来避免这类代价高昂的错误，比如考虑相反的观点、做成本收益分析，尤其是对那些复杂且能决定事业未来的决策。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
engaging in critical thinking ↔engaging themselves in critical reasoning
engaging themselves in critical reasoning 精确对应对策句的方法，与预判一致。
B)
张冠李戴
keeping their integrity"保持诚信"是第2段针对"不道德行为"的对策，与本段"冲动决策"无关，属跨段错位。
C)
偷换概念
criticizing themselves for previous poor performances"为以往糟糕表现自责"文中没有依据；原文说的是 critical thinking 批判性思考，不是"自我批评"。
D)
偷换概念
refraining from being too excited about their successes"别为成功太兴奋"对错了对象；原文 eagerness to win 指"求胜的急切"导致冲动，办法是批判性思考，而非"压抑对成功的兴奋"。

stem: How can entrepreneurs overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry?

options.text: By paying close attention to their current performance.
By taking steps that stand to endanger their rivals' success.
By monitoring how their decision-making impacts their mentality.
By keeping their emotions in check to avoid making poor decisions.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】How can entrepreneurs overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry 问克服风险效应的具体方法，答案直取原文，属细节题。
【拆句】How can entrepreneurs overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry：主干 How can entrepreneurs overcome the effects，risk-inducing（诱发风险的）作定语修饰effects，of rivalry 是后置定语说明这种效应的来源。无陷阱。
【定位】One way you can overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry that stand to endanger your venture's success is to remain attentive to your emotional state and actively monitor how such feelings are affecting your decision-making.
你能克服这种危及事业成功的、由竞争诱发风险的效应的一个办法，是持续关注自己的情绪状态，并主动监控这些情绪如何影响你的决策。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
paying close attention to their current performance 把对象换成 current performance"当前表现"；原文要关注的是 emotional state"情绪状态"，对象被换。
B)
与原文相反
taking steps that stand to endanger their rivals' success"采取危及对手成功的举措"与原文相悖：原文 endanger your venture's success 担心的是危及"自己"的事业，办法是管情绪，不是去害对手。
C)
与原文相反
monitoring how their decision-making impacts their mentality 说"监控决策如何影响心态"，方向反了；原文是 how such feelings are affecting your decision-making"情绪如何影响决策"，主语宾语对调。
D)
✓ 正确
remain attentive to your emotional state ↔keeping their emotions in check
how such feelings are affecting your decision-making ↔to avoid making poor decisions
keeping their emotions in check to avoid making poor decisions 整体对应对策句的两层意思，与预判一致。

stem: What does a "multitasker" originally refer to?

options.text: An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once.
A skilled worker executing more than one task at the same time.
A sophisticated technology doing several tasks effectively at once.
An efficient person able to perform multiple tasks at the same time.

explanation:
【答案】A （词义句意题）
【判型】题干 What does a "multitasker" originally refer to 直接问一个词「原本指什么」，考的是文中对该词来源含义的界定。
【拆句】句子主干是 What does a "multitasker" originally refer to，结构平铺，refer to 意为「指代、指的是」，originally 作状语修饰 refer to，意为「最初指的是」。无陷阱。
【定位】The concept does indeed come from the realms of technology, where it is used to refer to an operating system that can execute multiple tasks at the same time.
这个概念确实来自科技领域，在那里它被用来指一种能够同时执行多项任务的操作系统。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
an operating system that can execute multiple tasks at the same time ↔ An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once
预判要的「能同时多任务的操作系统」与 An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once 完全吻合，主体、能力、同时性三点都对上。
B)
偷换概念
A skilled worker（熟练工人）把主体说成人，而原词最初指的是操作系统，主体张冠李戴。
C)
偷换概念
A sophisticated technology（一种复杂技术）只取了原文「来自科技领域」的背景，却没说成「操作系统」，主体被放大成笼统的「技术」，与原文具体所指不符。
D)
答非所问
An efficient person（高效的人）把主体说成人，对应的是首句对 multitasker 的「现今」描述，而非题干要的「最初」所指，时间与主体都错。

stem: Why can't people really be multitaskers according to neuroscientists?

options.text: They are not sufficiently exposed to multitasking situations.
They are not comparable to mechanical operating systems.
Their brains do not allow them to multitask.
Their attention span cannot be expanded.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】题干 Why can't people really be multitaskers according to neuroscientists 问的是某方观点下的具体理由，答案能在原文直接找到对应句。
【拆句】Why can't people really be multitaskers according to neuroscientists：主干是 why ... can't people be multitaskers（人为什么不能成为多任务者），really 加强语气，according to neuroscientists 是状语，限定「按神经科学家的看法」。really 易让人误读为「真的能吗」，其实它服务于全句的否定，意为「人确实当不了」。
【定位】So much so that, according to experts in neuroscience(神经系统科学), our brains do not handle multitasking situations well.
以至于，按照神经科学专家的说法，我们的大脑并不能很好地处理多任务情境。
【选项】A)
无中生有
not sufficiently exposed to multitasking situations（接触多任务情境不够）文中从未提及，原文讲的是大脑机能，不是接触多少。
B)
答非所问
not comparable to mechanical operating systems（无法与机械操作系统相比）只是首段把人和电脑作类比的延伸，并非神经科学家给出的不能多任务的理由。
C)
✓ 正确
our brains do not handle multitasking situations well ↔ Their brains do not allow them to multitask
预判的「大脑处理不好」与 Their brains do not allow them to multitask 一致，把原因归于大脑这一生理层面，正合定位句。
D)
无中生有
attention span cannot be expanded（注意力广度无法扩展）文中并无此说，原文只说两项任务争夺注意力时效率下降，没谈注意力能否扩展。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页

stem: What do we learn from the conclusion of a recent study on multitasking?

options.text: People make greater achievements by maintaining whatever they are doing is multitasking.
People's performance benefits from the perception of what they are doing as multitasking.
People's active mental processes exert a positive effect on their multitasking.
People can improve their capabilities by handling multitasking situations.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 What do we learn from the conclusion of a recent study 问一项具体研究的结论，原文有对应明示句，属可直接定位的细节。
【拆句】What do we learn from the conclusion of a recent study on multitasking：主干 what do we learn（我们了解到什么），from the conclusion of a recent study 是状语，on multitasking 修饰 study，指「一项关于多任务的近期研究的结论」。结构平铺，无陷阱。
【定位】A recent study concluded that regardless of whether people are actually handling several tasks or not, the mere fact that they perceive this activity as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance.
一项近期研究得出结论：无论人们是否真的在处理多项任务，仅仅是他们把这一活动感知为多任务这个事实，就对他们的表现有正面影响。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
maintaining whatever they are doing is multitasking 用 maintaining（坚持主张/坚持做）替换原文的 perceive（感知），「坚称是多任务」不等于「感知为多任务」，把主观认知偷换成口头主张。
B)
✓ 正确
they perceive this activity as multitasking ↔ the perception of what they are doing as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance ↔performance benefits from
预判的「感知为多任务即提升表现」与 People's performance benefits from the perception of what they are doing as multitasking 完全对应，落点都在「感知」这一主观因素。
C)
张冠李戴

stem: How does the business world view multitasking?

options.text: It is a rare skill often found in fluid organisations.
It is an adaptable capability required of all workers.
It is an essential quality many employees lack.
It is a desirable ability that can be developed.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 How does the business world view multitasking 问商业界如何看待多任务，原文有专段陈述该立场，属可定位细节。
【拆句】How does the business world view multitasking：view 在此是动词「看待」，主干为the business world view multitasking（商业界如何看待多任务）。需注意 view 此处不是名词「景观」而是动词，属熟词的常见用法。
【定位】From this different perspective, you can not only be multitasking but this ability can also be taught: something that is easier in fluid organisations, which favour flexibility in their working practices.
从这一不同视角看，你不仅可以做到多任务，而且这种能力还可以被传授：这在灵活的组织里更容易做到，这类组织在工作方式上崇尚灵活性。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
a rare skill（罕见技能）与原文 many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking 矛盾——能被许多公司寻得且可传授，说明并不罕见。
B)
以偏概全
required of all workers（对所有员工的要求）把范围夸大成「全体员工」，原文只说many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking，是企业青睐某些人，而非要求所有人都具备。
C)
无中生有
many employees lack（许多员工缺乏）文中并无此说，原文谈的是公司想要、能力可教，没有说员工普遍缺乏这种能力。
D)
✓ 正确
many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking ↔a desirable ability
this ability can also be taught ↔that can be developed
预判的「可培养的实用能力」与 a desirable ability that can be developed 两点全中：desirable 对应被公司追求，can be developed 对应可教。

stem: What does the author imply we should do if we have to focus on some task and do it well?

options.text: Work in a flexible way.
Learn from mistakes.
Avoid multitasking.
Increase efficiency

explanation:
【答案】C （推断题）
【判型】题干 What does the author imply we should do 用 imply 问作者「暗示」我们该怎么做，答案需基于原文推理而非直接摘录。
【拆句】What does the author imply we should do if we have to focus on some task and do it well：主干 what does the author imply we should do（作者暗示我们该做什么），if引导条件状语从句 if we have to focus on some task and do it well（如果我们必须专注某项任务并把它做好）。从句是答案成立的前提，须连同主句一起理解。
【定位】But having to pay attention to several things at once means that the powers of concentration are reduced and that can lead to more mistakes.
但不得不同时关注好几件事，意味着专注力会下降，而这会导致更多错误。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
Work in a flexible way（以灵活方式工作）取自第四段商业视角的 favour flexibility in their working practices，与末段「要专注做好该怎么办」无关。
B)
无中生有
Learn from mistakes（从错误中学习）只是借了末段 mistakes 一词，原文说的是多任务会「导致」更多错误，从未建议「从错误中学习」。
C)
✓ 正确
having to pay attention to several things at once means that the powers of concentration are reduced
↔Avoid multitasking
预判的「别同时做多件事」与 Avoid multitasking 一致——既然多任务降低专注、引发错误，那要做好就该避免它。
D)
答非所问
Increase efficiency（提高效率）对应原文 Being quicker and more efficient，但那是多任务的「好处」一面，并非「要专注做好」的对策；况且追求效率与多任务相伴，恰是降低专注的根源。

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn from the passage about Red Rum the racehorse 问对赛马的整体了解，落点仍是文中可直接找到的客观陈述，而非要求读者跨段推断或归纳全文主旨。
【拆句】What do we learn from the passage about Red Rum the racehorse 主干是 What do we learn，介词短语 from the passage 表来源，about Red Rum the racehorse 表对象，其中 the racehorse 是 Red Rum 的同位语，仅起身份补充，无陷阱。
【定位】In the history of horse racing, few horses have captured the affection of the British public like Red Rum. Today, three decades after his retirement, he is still one of the best-known and most beloved racehorses of all time.
在赛马史上，很少有马像 Red Rum 那样赢得英国公众的喜爱。今天，距它退役已有三十年，它仍是有史以来最知名、最受爱戴的赛马之一。
【选项】A)
无中生有
He captured public affection long before he won national titles 凭空添加“夺冠之前就赢得公众喜爱”的时间先后关系，原文 P1 只说他广受喜爱，未提“夺冠之前”。
B)
✓ 正确
few horses have captured the affection of the British public like Red Rum ↔ He won enormous fame and love from British people
the affection of the British public ↔love from British people
预判说“他从英国公众那里获得巨大名声与喜爱”，He won enormous fame and love from British people 是这句话的同义复述，无需推断即可锁定。
C)
偷换概念
原文 three decades after his retirement, he is still one of the best-known and most beloved racehorses of all time 只说退役三十年后他仍然知名；He became a myth three decades after his retirement 把 still well-known 偷换成 became a myth（成为一个神话/传说），属于程度与性质的偷换。
D)
以偏概全
He owed his great success to several well-known horse trainers 说“他把成功归因于多位知名教练”；但原文 The agent who made the purchase was the now-legendary horse trainer Donald "Ginger" McCain 全文只突出一位教练 Ginger，没有 several。

【定位】For Ginger and Red Rum, though, it was just an obstacle to greatness that had to be overcome.

✓ 正确
it was just an obstacle to greatness that had to be overcome ↔ It was simply a hindrance they had to get over to excel
had to be overcome ↔they had to get over
It was simply a hindrance they had to get over to excel 几乎是 it was just an obstacle to greatness that had to be overcome 的逐词同义改写，预判与选项几乎重合。
B)
无中生有
It was surely a disadvantage though not considered fatal 加了一个 not considered fatal 的让步，原文从未拿“致命/非致命”来评价此病；选项偷偷在原句外塞入新评价。

【拆句】What does the author say Red Rum did with his power, speed and jumping ability 句中 the author say 是插入性主语从句框架，真正的问题核心是 Red Rum did what with his power, speed and jumping ability，介词 with 引出工具。基础薄弱的考生容易被does the author say 带偏去找作者观点，实质仍是问赛马本身的行为。
【定位】Red Rum's true talent came out in steeplechases. His power, speed and jumping ability carried him to his first Grand National title in 1973. The very next year, Red Rum returned to take his second title. He was the first horse to take successive firsts since Reynoldstown in 1935-1936.
Red Rum 真正的才华在障碍赛中绽放。他的力量、速度与跳跃能力把他带向 1973 年第一座全国大赛冠军。次年他再度归来，拿下第二冠，成为自 1935-1936 年 Reynoldstown 之后第一匹蝉联的马。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
He won his first Grand National title at 12 把首冠年龄定为 12 岁；但 his first Grand National title in 1973 是首冠时间，而 He was 12 years old 是 1977 年第三冠时的年龄，选项把第三冠的年龄安到首冠头上。
B)
张冠李戴
He took two firsts successively in 1935-1936 把 1935-1936 连冠归到 Red Rum 名下，但原文 He was the first horse to take successive firsts since Reynoldstown in 1935-1936 明确 1935-1936 的连冠属于另一匹马 Reynoldstown。
C)
张冠李戴
He surprised sporting fans worldwide in 1973 把“worldwide 惊讶”与 1973 挂钩，但原文 He surprised sporting fans around the world 明确发生在 1977 年第三冠那次，与 in 1973 无关。
D)
✓ 正确
his first Grand National title in 1973 ↔three Grand National wins in the 1970s
the first horse to take successive firsts ↔three Grand National wins in the 1970s
taking his third Grand National win ↔three Grand National wins in the 1970s
把 1973、1974、1977 三场冠军合并，正好对应 three Grand National wins in the 1970s，全部时间都落在 1970 年代。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页

stem: What did people generally think of Red Rum when he returned to the racecourse in 1977?

options.text: He had already passed the peak of his racing life.
He would have no rival in Grand National steeplechases.
He had lost his charm with the leagues of Grand National fans.
He could be expected to repeat his glory in the prime of his career.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What did people generally think of Red Rum when he returned to the racecourse in 1977 问的是原文中直接表述过的公众看法，不需要跨段推断。
【拆句】What did people generally think of Red Rum when he returned to the racecourse in 1977 主干 What did people think of X，时间状语从句 when he returned to the racecourse in 1977 用一般过去时锁定 1977 那次复出。考生注意 think of 在此是“对……有何看法”，不是“想到”。
【定位】When he returned in 1977 to try again, he was largely regarded as past his prime. He was 12 years old and not expected to place highly.
1977 年他再度归来尝试时，普遍被认为已过巅峰；他已 12 岁，不被看好会拿到好名次。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
was largely regarded as past his prime ↔He had already passed the peak of his racing life
原文 past his prime 与选项 passed the peak of his racing life 是同义改写，且 was largely regarded as 完整对应题干 people generally think。
B)
与原文相反
He would have no rival in Grand National steeplechases 说他在大赛中无敌手；原文 he was largely regarded as past his prime 表达的是相反的预期——大家觉得他过气了。
C)
与原文相反
He had lost his charm with the leagues of Grand National fans 说他对大赛粉丝失去了魅力；但原文 Red Rum's spirit and grace had already begun to charm the leagues of Grand National fans 与 P5 处都未出现魅力消失的描述，反而 his public life and fame by no means decreased 进一步否定这一说法。
D)
与原文相反
He could be expected to repeat his glory in the prime of his career 说“大家期待他在巅峰期再现辉煌”；但原文 not expected to place highly 明说他不被看好，且 past his prime 已说明他不在巅峰。
