source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the woman always talking about to her elder daughter?

options.text: The importance of cutting down family expenses.
The need to learn important lessons from her elders.
The delight in seeing their savings grow.
The necessity of saving into a pension.

explanation:
【题目】What is the woman always talking about to her elder daughter?
【翻译】这位女士总是和她的大女儿谈论什么?
A) 削减家庭开支的重要性。
B) 需要向长辈学习重要的经验教训。
C) 看到他们的储蓄增长的喜悦。
D) 向养老金储蓄的必要性。
【答案】D （细节题）The necessity of saving into a pension.

【定位】W: I am always talking to my elder daughter about the importance of saving into a pension.
女：我总是跟我大女儿讲存钱进养老金的重要性。
【信号】always + importance 强调。女士说 I am always talking to my elder daughter about the importance of saving into a pension，always 与 importance 双重强调，且对象elder daughter 与题干完全一致，这句即答案落点。
【替换】the importance of saving into a pension ↔The necessity of saving into a pension
importance 换成 necessity
【排除】A)
未提及
The importance of cutting down family expenses.（削减家庭开支的重要性）虽与省钱沾边，但录音里女士对女儿谈的是"存养老金"，从未谈"削减家庭开支"，属无中生有。
B)
原词陷阱
The need to learn important lessons from her elders. 盗用了男士末句的 it's such an important lesson to learn 与选项 11 里 elder daughter 的 elder，但 from her elders（向长辈学）方向反了，女士是"对女儿讲"不是"向长辈学"。
借用原文：it's such an important lesson to learn
C)
张冠李戴
The delight in seeing their savings grow. 里 see savings grow 来自女士前面讲存钱罐的so they can see their savings grow，那是对小孩子说的，不是对大女儿谈的内容，被错接到本题。
借用原文：so they can see their savings grow
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the man?

options.text: He is a successful businessman.
He reviews books on political affairs.
He has published a new bestseller.
He has worked in several banks.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the man?
【翻译】关于这位男士我们了解到什么?
A) 他是一位成功的商人。
B) 他评论政治事务方面的书籍。
C) 他出版了一本新的畅销书。
D) 他曾在几家银行工作过。
【答案】C （细节题）He has published a new bestseller.
【定位】Our guest today is John Banks, the author of the best selling new book, Rewarding Success.
今天的嘉宾是约翰·班克斯，畅销新书《奖励成功》的作者。

【信号】主持人开场介绍嘉宾。信号是访谈开场的身份介绍句 Our guest today is John Banks, the author of the best selling new book——主持人介绍嘉宾时点出的身份，正是人物题答案最常藏身处。
【替换】the author of the best selling new book ↔He has published a new bestseller.
"畅销书作者"="出版了畅销书"
【排除】A)
未提及
录音说他是作者、教授、政治顾问，从没说他是商人；He is a successful businessman. 属凭"成功"二字（书名 Rewarding Success）联想出来的误判，文中无据。
B)
张冠李戴
He reviews books on political affairs. 盗用了开场 Books in Review（节目名"书评"）和author of the book 里的 book 字样，骗"听到 book/review 就选"。但评书的是主持人，他是被采访的作者，身份张冠李戴。
借用原文：Welcome to Books in Review
D)
原词陷阱
He has worked in several banks. 借的是嘉宾姓 John Banks 里的 Banks（人名）和后文谈经济、税收的氛围，骗人误以为他在银行工作过。实际他干的是 worked as a political consultant，与银行无关。
借用原文：John Banks
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第15页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say is the most controversial?

options.text: The man's ideas about education.
The man's academic background.
The man's attempts at drawing public attention.
The man's proposals to solve economic problems.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say is the most controversial?
【翻译】女士说最具争议的是什么?
A) 这位男士关于教育的观点。
B) 这位男士的学术背景。
C) 这位男士吸引公众关注的尝试。
D) 这位男士解决经济问题的提案。
【答案】A （细节题）The man's ideas about education.
【定位】You discuss three of those problems in the book, improving public education, reducing our nation's healthcare burden, and increasing personal savings. But your ideas about education are the most controversial.
你在书里谈了其中三个问题：改善公共教育、减轻国家医疗负担、增加个人储蓄。但你关于教育的主张最具争议。
【信号】转折 But + 最高级 the most controversial。信号是女方话里的转折加最高级 But your ideas about education are the most controversial.——But 之后才是她真正想强调的落点，the most controversial 直接点名争议所在。

【替换】your ideas about education are the most controversial ↔The man's ideas about education.
近乎原句，只换 your→The man's
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
The man's academic background. 盗用了前文 let's talk about your background 里的background。但谈背景是 But 之前的铺垫闲聊，女方明确说"最有争议"的是教育主张，不是背景。
借用原文：let's talk about your background
C)
偷换概念
The man's attempts at drawing public attention. 借了前文 why it's getting so much attention 里的 attention。原文 attention 指的是"书为何受关注"，并非说他"刻意博关注"，是把客观受关注偷换成主观博眼球。
借用原文：why it's getting so much attention
D)
偷换概念
The man's proposals to solve economic problems. 沾了全书谈经济问题的大背景。但女方点名最具争议的是 education（教育）这一具体领域，不是笼统的"经济提案"，范围对不上。
借用原文：problems in our country
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say is his real goal?

options.text: To reduce students' financial burden.
To motivate all students to be successful.
To give students incentive to excel in economics.
To provide remedies for students' poor performance.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say is his real goal?
【翻译】男士说他的真正目标是什么?
A) 减轻学生的经济负担。
B) 激励所有学生取得成功。
C) 给予学生在经济学方面出类拔萃的动力。
D) 为学生的不良表现提供补救措施。
【答案】B （细节题）To motivate all students to be successful.
【定位】A lot of people think I'm trying to punish students who aren't doing well, when actually my goal is to give all students more incentive to succeed.
很多人以为我想惩罚成绩不好的学生，其实我的目标是给所有学生更多动力去取得成功。
【信号】actually + my goal is 的澄清句。信号是他亲口纠正误解的句子 when actually my goal is to give all students more incentive to succeed——actually 推翻前面"人们以为"的误解，my goal is 直接交代真实目的，正是 real goal 题的答案落点。
【替换】to give all students more incentive to succeed ↔To motivate all students to be successful.
give incentive=motivate，succeed=be successful

【排除】A)
未提及
To reduce students' financial burden. 谈减轻经济负担，但他在第 6 段说的目的是"给学生动力"，与减负无关；减负是另一个层面的话题，文中没把它当作他的目标。
C)
原词陷阱
To give students incentive to excel in economics. 几乎照搬原话 give … incentive，却把 all students to succeed 偷偷缩成 excel in economics（在经济学上拔尖）。他要激励的是所有学生取得成功，不限于经济这一科。
借用原文：to give all students more incentive to succeed
D)
与原文相反
To provide remedies for students' poor performance. 借了女方后文 poor performance in school 的原词，听着像"针对差生补救"。但他的目的恰恰不是只盯差生——这正是他要澄清反对的"惩罚差生"那层误解的变体。
借用原文：poor performance in school isn't a child's fault
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What will be one option for funding the proposed rewards according to the man?

options.text: Improving school budgeting.
Increasing tuition fees.
Seeking donations.
Raising taxes.

explanation:
【题目】What will be one option for funding the proposed rewards according to the man?
【翻译】根据男士所说,为拟议的奖励提供资金的一个选择是什么?
A) 改善学校预算。
B) 提高学费。
C) 寻求捐赠。
D) 提高税收。
【答案】D （细节题）Raising taxes.
【定位】Well, by increasing taxes or moving money from other areas of the budget into education.
嗯，靠加税，或者把预算中其他领域的钱挪到教育上来。
【信号】对被问者"钱怎么出"的直接应答。信号是被问方对女方提问 How will we fund the rewards in the meantime? 的直接应答 by increasing taxes or moving money from other areas——对话题里问题落在哪、答案就在被问者那句应答里。
【替换】by increasing taxes ↔Raising taxes.
increase taxes=raise taxes

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Improving school budgeting. 盗用了原话 moving money from other areas of the budget 里的 budget。但他说的是"把预算里别处的钱挪进教育"，不是"改善学校的预算编制"，做法被偷换。
借用原文：moving money from other areas of the budget into education
B)
未提及
Increasing tuition fees. 与正确项 Raising taxes. 共用 increase/raise 结构、都谈"加钱"，极易混。但他全程没提涨学费，只说加税和挪预算，tuition 是凭"学校、学生"话题脑补的。
C)
未提及
Seeking donations. 即募集捐款，录音里他只给了加税和挪预算两条路，从没提过募捐，属凭"筹钱"话题硬补的选项。

stem: Why is the speaker launching a campaign?

options.text: To show his sympathy towards people always being busy.
To prevent people from complaining about being "busy".
To call on busy people to take care of themselves.
To help busy people to sort out their priorities.

explanation:
【题目】Why is the speaker launching a campaign?
【翻译】说话者为什么发起一项运动？
A) 表达他对总是忙碌的人们的同情。
B) 阻止人们抱怨自己很"忙"。
C) 呼吁忙碌的人们照顾好自己。
D) 帮助忙碌的人们理清他们的优先事项。
【答案】B （目的题）To prevent people from complaining about being "busy".
【定位】So I'm launching a campaign to stop people complaining about being "busy."
所以我要发起一场运动，让大家别再抱怨『忙』了。
【信号】to 引出意图，紧跟在 campaign 后。答案句里 campaign 后面紧跟一个 to stop people complaining，这个不定式直接交代了发起运动的目的——听到 launching a campaign to… 时，to 后面那一截就是答案落点，这是目的题最典型的信号。
【替换】to stop people complaining about being "busy." ↔ To prevent people from complaining about being "busy".
stop = prevent，近义替换

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 项 To show his sympathy towards people always being busy. 利用了原文 you being busy doesn't make me sympathetic at all 里的 sympathetic 一词，但原话是『一点也不让我同情』，说话人恰恰是不同情，A 把否定听成了肯定、方向反了。
借用原文：you being busy doesn't make me sympathetic at all
C)
未提及
C 项 To call on busy people to take care of themselves. 说发起运动是为了呼吁忙人照顾好自己，但全文从未提到 take care of themselves，说话人发起运动是为了让人别再抱怨忙，而非关心忙人的健康，属凭常识臆造。
D)
原词陷阱
D 项 To help busy people to sort out their priorities. 借了原文 it's just about priorities里的 priorities 一词，但那句是在第四段解释『没人真的太忙、只是优先级问题』，并不是发起运动的目的；D 把后文一个无关概念词搬来充当发起动机，张冠李戴。
借用原文：nobody is too busy—it's just about priorities
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第20页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the speaker advise us to do next time someone asks how we are?

options.text: Avoid saying we are busy.
Reflect on their true purpose.
Describe our schedule in detail.
Respond as most busy people do.

explanation:
【题目】What does the speaker advise us to do next time someone asks how we are?
【翻译】当下次有人问我们怎么样时，说话者建议我们做什么？
A) 避免说我们很忙。
B) 反思他们的真实目的。
C) 详细描述我们的日程安排。
D) 像大多数忙碌的人那样回应。
【答案】A （细节题）Avoid saying we are busy.
【定位】So the next time someone asks you how you are, maybe respond differently.
所以下次有人问你『最近怎么样』，也许可以换个方式回答。
【信号】next time + maybe，建议信号。答案句以 So the next time someone asks you how you are 起头、接 maybe respond differently，next time 与建议词 maybe 连用，正是说话人给建议的标志句——听到 maybe / you should / next time 一类软建议词，后面那句就是建议内容。
【替换】respond differently ↔Avoid saying we are busy.
differently 的具体所指 = 别再说忙

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 项 Reflect on their true purpose. 借了原文反复出现的 purpose（their real purpose）一词，但说话人在第四段讲 real purpose 是在解释『忙是借口』，并没有建议我们『去反思真正目的』；B 把别处的概念词搬来当本题建议，答非所问。
借用原文：they're not actually accomplishing their real purpose
C)
原词陷阱
C 项 Describe our schedule in detail. 用了原文出现过的 schedule（YOUR spot on their schedule），但说话人从没建议我们详细描述自己的日程，反而是在反对把『忙』挂嘴边；C 借 schedule 一词编了个原文没给的建议。
借用原文：it's a reflection of YOUR spot on their schedule
D)
与原文相反
D 项 Respond as most busy people do. 说『像多数忙人那样回答』，但原文恰恰让你respond differently（换个方式、不要照旧），D 取了与建议完全相反的方向，正话反说。
借用原文：maybe respond differently
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why do many people make the "I'm busy" response according to the speaker?

options.text: To show their achievements resulted from great efforts.
To prove they stand out as accomplished professionals.
To cover up their failure to achieve some purpose.
To tell others a complete lie about their inability.

explanation:
【题目】Why do many people make the "I'm busy" response according to the speaker?
【翻译】根据说话者的说法，为什么许多人会做出"我很忙"的回应？
A) 展示他们通过巨大努力取得的成就。
B) 证明他们作为有成就的专业人士脱颖而出。
C) 掩盖他们未能实现某个目标的事实。
D) 向他人彻底撒谎说自己没有能力。
【答案】C （细节题）To cover up their failure to achieve some purpose.
【定位】In my experience, the "I'm busy" response is really covering up the fact that they're not actually accomplishing their real purpose.
以我的经验，『我很忙』这种回答其实是在掩盖一个事实——他们并没有真正完成自己真正的目标。
【信号】really + covering up，点出真实原因。答案句里 is really covering up the fact 的 really（其实/真正）是揭示真相的强调信号，covering up（掩盖）直接说出动机——听到 really / actually / the truth is 这类点真相的词，后面就是说话人要你听到的真实原因。
【替换】covering up the fact that they're not actually accomplishing their real purpose ↔ To cover up their failure to achieve some purpose.
没做成 = failure，概念升级

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 项 To show their achievements resulted from great efforts. 用了与原文accomplished 同根的 achievements，但原文 "being busy" doesn't…mean…accomplished 明说忙并不等于有成就，说话人是在否定『忙=有成就』，A 却说人们这么答是为了炫耀成就，方向反了。
借用原文："being busy" doesn't stand out, nor does it mean productive, creative, accomplished, or professional
B)
原词陷阱
B 项 To prove they stand out as accomplished professionals. 同时搬了原文 stand out、accomplished、professional 三个原词，迷惑性很强，但原文那句是说『忙并不让人显得突出、也不代表专业』，是否定；B 反过来说人们答忙是为了证明自己是杰出专业人士，与原意相反、也不是题目问的真实动机。
借用原文："being busy" doesn't stand out, nor does it mean productive, creative, accomplished, or professional
D)
原词陷阱
D 项 To tell others a complete lie about their inability. 借了原文 the lie they tell themselves 的 lie，但原文说的是『他们对自己撒的谎』、且没有 complete（彻底）这种程度，D 改成『对别人说彻底的谎、关于自己的无能』，对象（自己→别人）和程度（a lie→a complete lie）都被篡改、过度夸大。
借用原文："being busy" is the lie they tell themselves about why they can't achieve it

stem: What may sound strange to say about extreme sports?

options.text: They will help one reduce fear
They should become so popular.
They will be less challenging after a time.
They should cover so many different types.

explanation:
【题目】What may sound strange to say about extreme sports?
【翻译】关于极限运动，说什么可能听起来很奇怪?
A) 它们会帮助人减少恐惧
B) 它们应该变得如此流行。
C) 一段时间后它们的挑战性会降低。
D) 它们应该涵盖如此多不同的类型。
【答案】A （细节题）They will help one reduce fear
【定位】It may sound strange to say that their main function is to reduce fear.
要说极限运动的主要作用是减少恐惧，这听起来也许有点奇怪。
【信号】题干原话 sound strange 在原文回响。原文 It may sound strange to say that their main function is to reduce fear 把题干里的 may sound strange to say 几乎原样念出，这种"题干措辞在原文重现"是最强定位信号，紧跟其后的 to reduce fear 即答案内容。
【替换】their main function is to reduce fear ↔They will help one reduce fear
main function = will help，reduce fear 原义保留

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
第1段确实念到 Why are these sports becoming so popular?，They should become so popular 把 popular 原词搬来；但"流行"是全文引子，并非那句"听起来奇怪"的说法，属听到原词就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Why are these sports becoming so popular?
C)
未提及
They will be less challenging after a time 听起来"奇怪"但录音从未说极限运动会"变得不那么有挑战"；它蹭了第2段 after a time 这个时间词，却把内容编造成"难度下降"，属未提及。
借用原文：after a time, your fear response to other things in life will be dramatically reduced
D)
张冠李戴
第1段列举 snowboarding, skateboarding, mountain biking, and many more，They should cover so many different types 借此说"涵盖很多类型"；但这是开篇举例，不是题干所指那句"听起来奇怪"的话，张冠李戴。
借用原文：snowboarding, skateboarding, mountain biking, and many more

stem: Why should one be highly focused when doing extreme sports?

options.text: To break one's ultimate limits.
To stop being extremely afraid.
To avoid dangerous mistakes.
To enjoy the sports to the full.

explanation:
【题目】Why should one be highly focused when doing extreme sports?
【翻译】为什么在做极限运动时应该高度专注?
A) 为了突破个人的极限
B) 为了停止极度恐惧
C) 为了避免危险的错误
D) 为了充分享受这些运动
【答案】C （细节题）To avoid dangerous mistakes.
【定位】You'll be pushed to your limits, and if you aren't focused you'll make dangerous mistakes.
你会被逼到极限，如果不专注，就会犯危险的错误。
【信号】if 引出的因果条件句。if you aren't focused you'll make dangerous mistakes 是个 if 条件句："不专注→犯危险错误"，反过来即"专注是为了避免危险错误"。if…you'll… 的因果结构就是原因题的答案信号。
【替换】if you aren't focused you'll make dangerous mistakes ↔To avoid dangerous mistakes
肯否转换：不专注就犯错 = 专注为避免犯错

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
原文 You'll be pushed to your limits 念到 limits，To break one's ultimate limits 抢用limits 制造"听到就选"；但原文是"你会被逼到极限"，并非"专注是为了突破极限"，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：You'll be pushed to your limits
B)
张冠李戴
To stop being extremely afraid 对应的是第2段"减少恐惧"的内容，与第3段"为什么要专注"无关；把别段的好处安到本题，张冠李戴。
借用原文：their main function is to reduce fear
D)
未提及
To enjoy the sports to the full 听着合理，但录音从没说"专注是为了把运动玩到尽兴"；它无原文出处，是凭常识编出来的，属未提及。

stem: How can extreme sports benefit us more than standard exercise routines and sports?

options.text: By allowing our motivation to be at an all-time high.
By stopping us hurting the same muscles repeatedly.
By burning as many as 300 calories per hour.
By enabling us to get an all-over workout.

explanation:
【题目】How can extreme sports benefit us more than standard exercise routines and sports?
【翻译】极限运动如何比标准锻炼常规和运动更有益?
A) 通过让我们的动力达到空前的高度
B) 通过阻止我们反复伤害相同的肌肉
C) 通过每小时燃烧多达300卡路里
D) 通过使我们能够得到全身锻炼
【答案】D （细节题）By enabling us to get an all-over workout.
【定位】With extreme sports, you'll be working entirely different muscles, and that means you get an all-over workout.
做极限运动时，你会动用到完全不同的肌肉，这意味着你能得到全身锻炼。
【信号】对比 + that means 引出结论。前句 standard exercise routines and sports only work the same muscles repeatedly 与本句"动用完全不同肌肉"形成对比，that means you get an all-over workout 用 that means 把结论点出——"对比 + that means 的结论"就是答案信号。
【替换】that means you get an all-over workout ↔By enabling us to get an all-over workout
that means = By enabling us to，all-over workout 原义保留

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
By allowing our motivation to be at an all-time high 盗用第5段 your self-confidence will be at an all-time high 的 all-time high；但原文说的是"自信"达到最高、且与"比常规运动好在哪"无关，且把 self-confidence 偷换成 motivation，原词陷阱兼偷换概念。
借用原文：your self-confidence will be at an all-time high
B)
与原文相反
原文说常规运动 only work the same muscles repeatedly（反复练同一块肌肉，是它的不足）；By stopping us hurting the same muscles repeatedly 盗用 same muscles repeatedly，却把它说成极限运动的益处方式，与原文指向相反。
借用原文：only work the same muscles repeatedly
C)
原词陷阱
原文 Basketball burns around 300 in the same time，300 是篮球的消耗；极限运动（滑板）是 can burn as many as 500 calories per hour。By burning as many as 300 calories per hour 故意配错数字，是典型数字陷阱。
借用原文：Basketball burns around 300 in the same time

stem: What does the passage say about conflict in organizations?

options.text: It is natural.
It is instrumental.
It is personal.
It is vital.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about conflict in organizations?
【翻译】文章关于组织中的冲突说了什么?
A) 这是自然的。
B) 这是有益的。
C) 这是针对个人的。
D) 这是至关重要的。
【答案】A （细节题）It is natural.
【定位】Conflict is natural. We all bring different life and work experiences to the table.
冲突是自然的。我们每个人都把各自不同的生活和工作经历带到一起来。
【信号】is + 形容词的直接定性。答案信号是一句最直白的判断句 Conflict is natural.——主语正是题问的 conflict，紧跟 is + 形容词给它定性，这种'X is + 形容词'的下定义句就是定性题的落点。
【替换】Conflict is natural. ↔It is natural.
代词替换+原词保留
【排除】B)
未提及
It is instrumental.（起工具/促进作用的）原文从未用来形容冲突，是凭空安上的形容词，与定性句 Conflict is natural. 不符。
C)
原词陷阱
原文后文确实提到 We all have different personality preferences and tendencies.，It is personal. 盗用了 personality 这个原词，让人觉得'听到了'。但那句是在解释冲突为何自然，并非给冲突定性为'个人的'，属答非所问。
借用原文：We all have different personality preferences and tendencies.
D)
原词陷阱
It is vital. 盗用的是第 3 段 Productive conflict is a vital part of teams and organizations 里的 vital，但那是形容'有益的冲突 productive conflict'，而本题问的是冲突本身的性质，原文这里给的定性是 natural，不是 vital。
借用原文：Productive conflict is a vital part of teams and organizations

stem: Why do some people want to avoid conflict at all costs?

options.text: To guard against being perceived negatively.
To prevent themselves from being isolated.
To conceal personality preferences.
To maintain workplace harmony.

explanation:
【题目】Why do some people want to avoid conflict at all costs?
【翻译】为什么有些人想不惜一切代价避免冲突?
A) 防止被负面看待。
B) 防止自己被孤立。
C) 隐藏个性偏好。
D) 维护工作场所和谐。
【答案】D （细节题）To maintain workplace harmony.
【定位】But too often we get caught in this place where conflict is perceived to be negative— something we want to avoid so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace.
但我们常常陷入这样一种境地：冲突被视为负面的东西——一种我们想要回避的东西，以便能维持工作场所的和谐。
【信号】so that 引出目的。答案信号是表目的的连接词 so that：something we want to avoid so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace，so that 之后正是'回避冲突'的目的，这就是 Why 题要的落点。
【替换】so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace ↔To maintain workplace harmony.
语序压缩+同词复现
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
To guard against being perceived negatively. 盗用了原文 conflict is perceived to be negative 里的 perceived/negative，听起来很耳熟。但原文那句是说'冲突被视为负面'，是回避的背景，不是人们回避冲突所追求的目的，属答非所问。
借用原文：conflict is perceived to be negative
B)
未提及
To prevent themselves from being isolated.（防止自己被孤立）原文从未提到'被孤立'，是凭空添加的目的，与 so that 后的'维持和谐'无关。
C)
原词陷阱
To conceal personality preferences. 盗用第 1 段 We all have different personality preferences and tendencies. 里的 personality preferences，但那是讲冲突为何自然，跟'回避冲突的目的'毫不相干，且原文没有'隐藏 conceal'之意。
借用原文：We all have different personality preferences and tendencies.

stem: Why is productive conflict important for teams and organizations?

options.text: It helps to enhance team spirit.
It stimulates innovative ideas.
It helps to resolve problems.
It facilitates policy-making.

explanation:
【题目】Why is productive conflict important for teams and organizations?
【翻译】为什么建设性冲突对团队和组织很重要?
A) 它有助于增强团队精神。
B) 它激发创新想法。
C) 它有助于解决问题。
D) 它促进政策制定。
【答案】B （细节题）It stimulates innovative ideas.
【定位】Without conflict, we're often stuck in this artificial harmony where people don't express potentially innovative ideas for fear that they may start conflict with others.
没有冲突，我们往往困在这种虚假的和谐里，人们由于害怕会与他人引发冲突，而不去表达那些可能很有创新性的想法。
【信号】Without...反面论证。答案信号是 Without conflict 引出的反面假设：没有冲突，人们就不敢说出 potentially innovative ideas。反过来即说明'有益的冲突'的价值就在于能让创新想法被表达出来，这是从反面点出作用的落点。
【替换】people don't express potentially innovative ideas ↔It stimulates innovative ideas.
否定反推+同词保留
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
It helps to enhance team spirit. 借了原文反复出现的 team(s)，让人一听 team 就想选。但原文说冲突带来的是 innovation 与 trust，从未说它增强'团队精神 team spirit'，属答非所问。
借用原文：greater trust on teams
C)
原词陷阱
It helps to resolve problems. 利用第 1 段 how to approach policies, programs or problems 里的 problems 一词，但那是说大家对如何处理问题有分歧（冲突的来源），并非说冲突能'解决问题'，是偷换概念。
借用原文：how to approach policies, programs or problems
D)
原词陷阱
It facilitates policy-making. 把第 1 段 approach policies, programs or problems 中的policies 改头换面成 policy-making，但原文从未说冲突有助于'制定政策'，是无中生有的作用。
借用原文：how to approach policies, programs or problems

source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does productive conflict need as a basis?

options.text: An innovative mind.
Corporate culture.
Mutual trust.
A healthy mentality.

explanation:
【题目】What does productive conflict need as a basis?
【翻译】建设性冲突需要什么作为基础?
A) 创新思维。
B) 企业文化。
C) 相互信任。
D) 健康的心态。
【答案】C （细节题）Mutual trust.
【定位】But if you're in a place where you have a basis of trust, conflict can be extremely productive.
但如果你处在一个有信任基础的环境里，冲突可以变得极富成效。
【信号】a basis of 直接点前提。答案信号就是题干同款词 basis：if you're in a place where you have a basis of trust，a basis of 后面紧跟的 trust 正是冲突变得有益所需的基础，与设问的 as a basis 直接对上。
【替换】a basis of trust ↔Mutual trust.
核心词同+补足限定
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
An innovative mind. 盗用原文多次出现的 innovative/innovation，但创新在原文里是冲突带来的'结果'（lead to increased innovation），不是它需要的'基础'，前提与结果被颠倒。
借用原文：It can lead to increased innovation
B)
未提及
Corporate culture.（企业文化）原文从未提及，是借'谈职场就该有企业文化'的常识硬塞的，与 basis of trust 无关。
D)
原词陷阱
A healthy mentality. 盗用原文 good leaders and healthy teams 里的 healthy，但那是形容'健康的团队'，而非冲突所需的'健康心态 mentality'，原文也没说前提是某种心态，是张冠李戴。
借用原文：good leaders and healthy teams

Interestingly, they found that men were far more likely to speak in the abstract than were women.

explanation:

形容词
【词性槽】and 前后并列，名词 purpose 之前需要一个与 broader 平行的形容词
【依据】ultimate purpose 是英语固定搭配，意为「最终目的」
the ultimate purpose of action「行动的最终目的」与 the broader picture「更宏观的画面」语义共振，都指向抽象 speech 关注「全局/根本」。与 abstract speech that focuses on the broader picture and __(26)__ purpose of action 的语境严丝合缝。
【竞争词】D) difficult difficult purpose 搭配生硬、语义跑偏
difficult 表「困难的」，「困难的行动目的」既不是固定搭配，也与「抽象 speech 关注大局」的语义无关。留给真正讲「难以…」的空位（30 题）。

stem: To arrive at this __(28)__ , the researchers examined the linguistic(语言的) patterns of men and women in over 600,000 blog posts written on websites.

options.text: approximately
attaining
conclusion
difficult
emerges
fixed
ignored
legally
manipulated
recommended
refraining
signals
significantly
source
ultimate

explanation:
28. To arrive at this __(28)__, the researchers examined the linguistic patterns
【答案】C) conclusion
名词
【词性槽】指示代词 this 之后需要名词
【依据】arrive at a conclusion 是固定搭配，意为「得出结论」
上一段 they found that men were far more likely to speak in the abstract than were women 已经摆出了研究结论；本段开头 To arrive at this __(28)__, the researchers examined…「为得出这一结论，研究者们考察了…」，回指上段的研究发现，conclusion是英语阅读里 arrive at 最高频的宾语之一。
【竞争词】N) source
搭配错位且语义反向：arrive at this source 不通，且 source 强调「源头」与此处「结论」反向
arrive at a source 不是英语习惯搭配；语义上 source 指「根源/来源」，应该是「为查明这一现象的根源」才用 source——而那正是 32 题要做的事。把 source 留给 32 题，conclusion 留给 28 题，分工干净。

stem: To do this, the researchers computed abstractness ratings for __(29)__ 40,000 commonly used words in the English language.

options.text: approximately
attaining

difficult

legally
manipulated

source

explanation:
29. the researchers computed abstractness ratings for __(29)__ 40,000 commonly used words
【答案】A) approximately
副词
【词性槽】空后紧跟数词，需要修饰数词的副词
【依据】approximately 是英语里专门修饰数词表「大约」的标配副词
approximately + 数字 是英语里几乎固定的表达「大约 40,000 个常用词」，对应中文「研究者对大约 4 万个常用英语单词计算了抽象度评分」，与 computed abstractness ratings for __(29)__ 40,000 commonly used words 完全贴合。

动词
【词性槽】主语 the researchers 之后需要谓语动词（过去式）
【依据】manipulate 在心理学实验语境里的固定义：操控/调控自变量
实验研究中 manipulate 是术语：研究者「人为操控/调控」某一变量看其因果效应。原文in a follow-up study conducted with a sample of 300 students, the researchers __(33)__ power dynamics in an interpersonal setting to see if this would influence communicative abstraction——研究者「操控了人际情境中的权力动态」，正是典型的实验设计描述。
【竞争词】G) ignored 逻辑反向：研究的就是 power dynamics，怎么会去「忽视」它
ignored「忽视」与本句目的「to see if this would influence…」（看它是否影响…）正相反——研究者是要观察权力变量的作用，不可能去忽视它。

stem: What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower?

options.text: Keep it under control.
Apply it continuously.
Learn from entrepreneurs.
Aim at success determinedly.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower? 用what...need to do 句式直接问具体做法，不含 infer/imply/mainly about，是标准的细节题问法。
【拆句】What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower? 主干是 what does the author say (that) we need to do，后面的 to strengthen our willpower 是目的状语；翻译时把目的状语提到前面："为了强化意志力，作者说我们需要做什么"。无陷阱。
【定位】Willpower is just like a muscle; to keep it strong you need to constantly exercise it.
意志力就像一块肌肉；要让它保持强壮，你需要不断地锻炼它。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文说意志力本身就是 the ability to control yourself，是控制者，不是被控对象；Keep it under control. 把主客关系倒置。
B)
✓ 正确
constantly exercise it ↔Apply it continuously.
预判"持续锻炼"与 Apply it continuously. 字面同义，是 constantly exercise it 的标准同义替换，无需推断。
C)
无中生有
why some entrepreneurs have greater success than others 只是引出话题的例子，文中并未要求读者"向企业家学习"以强化意志力。
D)
张冠李戴
strong determination that allows you to do something difficult 说的是意志力"能让人坚定追求成功"，是它的功能；选项把功能当成强化方法，张冠李戴。

stem: How are almost half of our daily actions performed according to the passage?

options.text: Out of habit.
With determination.
Like muscle building.
By self-discipline.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】How are almost half of our daily actions performed according to the passage? 用how 询问客观执行方式，并加 according to the passage 强调贴文回答，是细节题。
【拆句】How are almost half of our daily actions performed according to the passage? 这是how 引导的被动语态疑问句，主语是 almost half of our daily actions，谓语 are performed；according to the passage 是状语。考生若不熟悉被动，需理解为"我们日常行为中近一半是如何被完成的"。
【定位】Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis.
我们日常行为中近一半属于习惯而不是决定，因此一旦正确习惯到位，你就会每天自动去做那些事。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
are part of our habits and not decisions ↔Out of habit.
预判"出于习惯"与 Out of habit. 字面一致，是 are part of our habits 的标准同义替换。
B)
与原文相反
are part of our habits and not decisions 已明说"不是决定"；With determination.与 decision 同属"有意识决断"的语义场，正好被否定。
C)
张冠李戴
muscle building 来自 Willpower is just like a muscle 的比喻，与 Q47 的执行方式无关，被借来制造干扰。
D)
张冠李戴
self-discipline 与 Self-control 同义，但 P5 谈的是自控的功能，不是"日常行为如何被执行"，被借来诱导。

stem: What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically?

options.text: Practising it on a day-to-day basis.
Associating it with improving health.
Possessing a reasonable amount of talent.
Foreseeing the desired outcome it will yield.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically? 是 what + 具体行为，问"什么会帮助"，求客观条件，属细节题。
【拆句】What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically? 主干What will help people (to) stick to doing something；stick to 后接动名词 doing；constructive 与 automatically 分别修饰"事"和"做"。基础薄弱者要注意 stick to 不是"棍子"，而是固定搭配"坚持"。
【定位】Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit will help you stick to that habit permanently.
把一个有价值的结果与某个习惯绑定，会帮助你长期坚持那个习惯。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis 中 day-to-day是养成习惯后"自动每日去做"的结果；选项把结果当方法，因果倒置。
B)
以偏概全
if you have a health issue 只是说明"有价值结果"的一个例子；选项把例子当成普适条件，以偏概全。
C)
与原文相反
Even with an incredible amount of talent, without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits, it can be difficult to achieve success. 明确说光有天赋不够；选项却把"有一定天赋"当成坚持习惯的条件，与原文相反。
D)
✓ 正确
Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit ↔ Foreseeing the desired outcome it will yield.
预判"预见到有价值回报"的语义被 Foreseeing the desired outcome it will yield. 精确承担，是 P4 段尾结论句的同义替换。

stem: How does the art of self-control help us succeed?

options.text: By allowing us to remain clear-headed permanently.
By enabling us to alter our behaviors constantly.
By enabling us to take positive actions
By allowing us to avoid taking risks.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】How does the art of self-control help us succeed? 用 how 询问机制，要求贴文给出self-control 起作用的方式，属细节题。
【拆句】How does the art of self-control help us succeed? 主干 How does X help us (to) succeed；help 后省略 to，接动词原形 succeed。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Self-control enables you to avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success and adopt those that do.
自控让你能够避开那些无助于成功的行为，并采纳那些有助于成功的行为。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文未提"保持头脑清醒"，更未说 permanently；选项凭空生造"永远清醒"。
B)
与原文相反
原文说自控让人"避开无益行为、采纳有益行为"，是有方向的取舍；alter our behaviors constantly 暗示"不断改来改去"，与作者"养成稳定好习惯"的立场相反。
C)
✓ 正确
adopt those that do ↔By enabling us to take positive actions
Self-control enables you to ↔By enabling us to
预判同时含"避开"与"采纳"两面，选项 By enabling us to take positive actions 抓住其中"采纳正向行为"的一面，是定位句的合法概括（避开 negative = 接近 positive，二者同向）。
D)
偷换概念
原文是 avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success，避的是"无益行为"，不是 risks；"风险"是文中从未出现的概念。

stem: Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control?

options.text: Most of us are not in the habit of exercising self-control.
We may not get immediate rewards from self-control.
Self-control tends to be associated with pains.
Self-control only brings about small benefits.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control? 用 why 问"难以保持自控"的客观原因，答案要能在文中找到，按细节题处理。
【拆句】Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control? 这是 why 引导的疑问句 + 形式主语句型：it 形式主语，真主语是 to maintain self-control；can 表示"有可能、可能会"的可能性，不要误译成"能够"。
【定位】Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control, it can be easy to get off track.
因为自控带来的是延迟的满足感，所以人很容易脱离正轨。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文反复强调正确习惯一旦养成就会 automatically perform；选项却说"我们大多数人没有自控的习惯"，与作者立场相反，且并非作者给出的难维持原因。
B)
✓ 正确
there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control ↔ We may not get immediate rewards from self-control.
预判"回报被推迟"被 We may not get immediate rewards from self-control. 精确承担，是 because 句的正反同义改写。
C)
无中生有
原文谈的是 delayed satisfaction，是"满足感被推迟"，并非 pains"痛苦"；作者从未把自控与痛苦绑定。
D)
偷换概念
原文说 if you work on sticking to those small positive habits...it becomes easier to...achieve that delayed reward，重点是"小习惯"带来"延迟的大回报"；small benefits 把延迟错读成"好处本身小"。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage mainly discuss regarding scientific research?

options.text: Its foundation.
Its rewards.
Its prospect.
Its funding.

explanation:
【答案】D （主旨题）
【判型】What does the passage mainly discuss regarding scientific research? 中的 mainly discuss 直接锁定主旨题。
【拆句】题干主句是 What does the passage mainly discuss，regarding scientific research 是介词短语作状语，限定讨论的对象范围，句式平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【选项】A)
无中生有：选项核心词在全文找不到主线对应
Its foundation 中的 foundation（基础／根基）在 P1~P4 中找不到对应；原文一次都未把科研的‘基础’作为讨论对象。
B)
以偏概全：拿某段／某句的局部当全文主旨
we reap the rewards from this science 中确实出现 rewards，但只是一句话铺垫，P2~P4 都未围绕 ‘rewards’ 展开；Its rewards 把局部一句话上升为全文主旨。
C)
无中生有＋时态错位
Its prospect 中的 prospect（前景／未来展望）在 P1~P4 中无对应——作者讨论的是‘现状’与‘应对方式’，未对科研的未来作出预测。
D)
✓ 正确
most scientific research is funded by government grants, companies doing research and development, and non-profit foundations ↔Its funding
Funding for science has changed with the times ↔Its funding
Its funding 中的 Its 回指 scientific research，funding 则覆盖了 P1~P4 反复讨论的资助来源、资助偏差、资助审慎度——是唯一覆盖四段共同主线的选项。

stem: What do we learn from the passage about researchers like birdwatchers and rock collectors?

options.text: They have little access to government funding.
They can do research with limited resources.
They can do amateur work in their own fields.
They have no means for large-scale research.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn from the passage about researchers like birdwatchers and rock collectors? 询问对某一特定群体的事实陈述，是典型细节题。
【拆句】主干是 What do we learn from the passage about researchers，like birdwatchers and rock collectors 是举例修饰 researchers，结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】Most of us can't afford to do nuclear research as a private hobby, but birdwatchers, rock collectors, and others can do real research on a limited budget.
我们大多数人无法把核研究当成私人爱好，但观鸟人、岩石收藏者等人可以用有限的预算做真正的研究。
【选项】A)
无中生有：原文未提即排除
They have little access to government funding 在 P2 中找不到对应陈述——原文只说他们自掏腰包，并未对‘是否能拿到政府资助’作判断。
B)
✓ 正确
on a limited budget ↔with limited resources
can do real research ↔can do research
B 项 They can do research with limited resources 把定位句 can do real research on a limited budget 中的能力与资源条件一一对应替换，与预判完全吻合。
C)
偷换概念：把原文措辞替换为相近但意义偏移的表达
原文 can do real research 强调的是‘真正的研究’，而 amateur work in their own fields 把‘真正研究’偷换成‘业余工作’，且 in their own fields 也是原文未提的限定。
D)
张冠李戴＋绝对化
They have no means for large-scale research 把 Most of us can't afford to do nuclear research as a private hobby 中‘多数人’的处境强行套到 ‘birdwatchers, rock collectors’ 头上，并把陈述绝对化为 no means。

stem: What would scientific studies look like in a perfect world according to the author?

options.text: They would be totally unbiased.
They would be independently funded.
They would be responsibly conducted.
They would be strictly supervised

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What would scientific studies look like in a perfect world according to the author?用 would look like 询问作者对一个特定情境下的事实描述。
【拆句】主句是 What would scientific studies look like，in a perfect world 与 according to the author 都是状语修饰，按情境＋来源给约束，句式无陷阱。
【定位】In a perfect world, money wouldn't matter—all scientific studies would be completely objective.
在一个完美的世界里，钱不会成为问题——所有的科学研究都会是完全客观的。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
completely objective ↔totally unbiased
A 项 They would be totally unbiased 用 unbiased 反向定义 objective，用 totally 替换 completely，与预判 ‘完全客观’ 一一对应。
B)
偷换概念：把比较项当成主张
原文 Drug research sponsored by the pharmaceutical(制药的) industry is more likely to end up favoring the drug under consideration than studies sponsored by government grants or charitable organizations 仅把独立资助的研究当作偏差较小的对照，并未说‘完美世界里所有研究都应独立资助’。
C)
无中生有：选项关键词在原文无对应
They would be responsibly conducted 中的 responsibly 在 P3 中没有对应词或近义概念，属凭语感想当然。
D)
无中生有＋话题外推
They would be strictly supervised 引入‘严格监管’这一原文未涉及的维度。原文只谈‘客观’，未谈‘监管’。

stem: What does the author say about companies and special interest groups?

options.text: They try hard to pull down the safeguards for research.
They make extra efforts to research their own products.
They provide valuable resources for scientific research.
They reap the most benefits from scientific research.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say about companies and special interest groups? 询问作者对某一明确主体的具体陈述，是细节题。
【拆句】主句是 What does the author say about companies and special interest groups?，about 引导的介词短语锁定主体对象，句式简短无陷阱。
【定位】These groups provide invaluable funding for scientific research.
这些团体为科学研究提供了极其宝贵的资金。
【选项】A)
与原文相反：把肯定语句逆转
原文 science has many safeguards in place to catch instances of bias that affect research outcomes 明确指出科学有 safeguards，作者也未指控这些团体‘试图打掉’safeguards；A 项 They try hard to pull down the safeguards for research 直接与原文事实对立。
B)
过度推断：把现象升级为意图
原文只说企业资助的研究‘更可能偏向其产品’（more likely to end up favoring the drug under consideration），并未说企业‘额外努力地’去研究自家产品；B 项 They make extra efforts to research their own products 是从结果反推动机，越界。
C)
✓ 正确
provide invaluable funding for scientific research ↔ provide valuable resources for scientific research
C 项 They provide valuable resources for scientific research 与定位句结构、谓语、宾语短语高度对齐，是定位句最纯粹的同义改写。
D)
无中生有＋绝对化
They reap the most benefits from scientific research 中‘获益最多’这一比较级在 P4中找不到任何对应陈述——原文谈他们是‘出资方’，未谈‘获益方排序’。

stem: What does the author think of research funded by industry or special interest groups?

options.text: Its recommendations should be examined for feasibility.
Its misleading results should be corrected in time.
Its validity should be checked with additional care.
Its hidden biases should be identified independently.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）

【定位】Meanwhile, it pays to examine studies funded by industry or special interest groups with extra care.
同时，对工业界或特殊利益团体资助的研究多加小心地审视，是值得的。
【选项】A)
无中生有＋话题偏移

张冠李戴：把全局机制改成对单一对象的建议

C)
✓ 正确
examine…with extra care ↔Its validity should be checked with additional care
Are the results consistent with other independently funded studies? ↔Its validity
C 项 Its validity should be checked with additional care 把作者 ‘要带着额外的小心去审查这类研究’ 用被动语态、上位名词重写，与预判一一对应。

偷换概念＋强加限定
原文 A little examination can go a long way towards identifying bias associated with the funding source 只说‘审视可帮助识别偏差’，并未要求‘独立地（independently）识别 hidden biases’；D 项强加 hidden 与 independently 两层原文没说的限制。

stem: What does the author think of the book Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History?

options.text: It is read by people for entirely different reasons.
It is meant for those interested in fashion history.
It makes enjoyable as well as informative reading.
It converts fashion into something for deliberation.

explanation:
【答案】C （主旨题）
【判型】What does the author think of the book 问的是作者对整本书的看法，不针对任何细节段，属于全文评价层面的主旨态度问题。
【拆句】主干 What does the author think of the book：think of 在此是「认为……怎么样」的固定搭配，of 后接评价对象；书名作 of 的宾语。无陷阱。
【选项】A)
过度推断
It is read by people for entirely different reasons 把 I happen to be interested in both, and ended up enjoying the book for completely different reasons 中「我个人因不同理由喜欢」错误推广到所有读者群体。
B)
与原文相反
It is meant for those interested in fashion history 与 you don't have to be interested in fashion, or even in history, to enjoy 直接矛盾——原文是「不必对这两者感兴趣也能享受」，选项却限定「专为感兴趣者而写」。
C)
✓ 正确
enjoy Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History ↔enjoyable
intellectual profoundness ↔informative
enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing ↔enjoyable
It makes enjoyable as well as informative reading 用 enjoyable as well as informative 两个形容词分别对应「P1/P4 阅读体验」和「P5 思想深度」两条主线，是唯一同时覆盖两面的选项。
D)
过度推断
It converts fashion into something for deliberation 把 You will probably never think of fashion as a trifle again 过度解读为「把时尚转化为可供深思的事物」，把作者对一句话的预测拔成全书定位。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: How can people best understand a particular fashion in an era, according to Ford?

options.text: By examining the restraints imposed on it.
By looking at what the nobility were wearing.
By glancing at its fabrics, colors and ornaments.
By doing a survey of the upper and middle classes

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】How can people best understand a particular fashion in an era, according to Ford?用 how 问具体方法，且明确归属 according to Ford，是定位 Ford 观点句的细节题。
【拆句】主干 How can people understand…，best 修饰 understand 表程度；in an era 限定fashion 所处时代；句末 according to Ford 标注观点归属。无陷阱。
【定位】Ford's thesis is that the best way to understand what particular fashions meant in any given era is to look at the restrictions placed on them.
Ford 的核心论点是：要理解某一时代里特定时尚的含义，最好的方式就是看强加在这些时尚之上的种种限制。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
look at the restrictions placed on them ↔examining the restraints imposed on it
四个选项中只有 By examining the restraints imposed on it 完整还原「观察—限制」这一对核心语义，与预判完全等值。
B)
拿例证替换方法
By looking at what the nobility were wearing 只截取 the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments 这处例证，没回到 Ford 真正提出的方法——「看限制」。
C)
偷换概念
By glancing at its fabrics, colors and ornaments 取自 certain fabrics, colors and ornaments，是 1200s 立法所限制的具体内容，被偷换成了「理解时尚的方法」。
D)
无中生有
By doing a survey of the upper and middle classes 中 doing a survey 文中并无任何对应，Ford 谈的是「看限制」而非做问卷或调查。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What was the aim of the first laws passed regarding fashion in the 1200s?

options.text: To facilitate the rise of the middle class.
To loosen restrictions on dress codes.
To help initiate some novel fashions
To preserve the status of the nobles.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What was the aim of the first laws 问的是某一具体历史事件的目的，需要回原文找对应「目的/原因」表述。
【拆句】主干 What was the aim of the first laws…？aim of 后接修饰首批法律的两个定语 passed regarding fashion 和 in the 1200s。无陷阱。
【定位】the first laws passed in the 1200s to ensure that only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments reflected the rise of the middle class, who were now able to imitate some of these fashions. The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it.
1200 年代通过的最早一批法律，规定只有贵族才能穿戴某些面料、颜色与饰品；这些法律折射出中产阶级的崛起，因为他们已能模仿其中一些时尚。上层阶级的地位受到威胁，时尚成为维持这一地位的工具。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
To facilitate the rise of the middle class 把「中产阶级崛起」当成目的，但原文是中产阶级崛起在前、立法在后，立法是为了反制这种崛起、保护贵族。
B)
与原文相反
To loosen restrictions on dress codes 与原文「立法是限制」的方向完全相反，原文是 only the nobility were allowed to wear，明显是加紧而非放松。
C)
无中生有
To help initiate some novel fashions 称立法是为了开启新潮流，文中只字未提；原文谈的是用法律压制模仿，而非鼓励创新。
D)
✓ 正确
The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it ↔ To preserve the status of the nobles
only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments ↔ To preserve the status of the nobles
预判「维护贵族地位」直接对应 To preserve the status of the nobles，preserve、status、nobles 三个关键词全部命中，是直白的同义重述。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author think of Ford's writing?

options.text: It uses comparison and contrast in describing fashions of different eras.
It makes heavy reading but is not lacking in humor or appeal.
It is filled with interesting episodes to spare readers intolerable boredom.
It is characteristic of academics in presenting arguments.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does the author think of Ford's writing? 评价对象是局部的 writing，不是全书，属于一段内的评价细节题。
【拆句】主干 What does the author think of Ford's writing？think of 仍是固定搭配「对…怎么看」。无陷阱。
【定位】His writing is more than a little dense—dense with research, clauses, and precise adjectives and nouns. But there's also humor and enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing.
他的写作可以说相当密实——密集的研究、从句以及精准的形容词与名词。但其中也不乏幽默与足够多的有趣片段，使得整本书读来仍具吸引力。
【选项】A)
无中生有
It uses comparison and contrast in describing fashions of different eras 谈 Ford用了 comparison and contrast，P4 通篇没有这层评价。
B)
✓ 正确
His writing is more than a little dense ↔makes heavy reading
there's also humor and enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing ↔ not lacking in humor or appeal
It makes heavy reading but is not lacking in humor or appeal 用 but 连接，分别对接原文 dense 与 But there's also humor and …appealing 两个分句，与预判完全一致。
C)
过度推断
It is filled with interesting episodes to spare readers intolerable boredom 把原文「也有」夸成「充满」，把「使写作吸引人」放大为「拯救读者免于难以忍受的无聊」，与 dense 评价并列存在的事实矛盾。
D)
以偏概全
It is characteristic of academics in presenting arguments 与 sound almost like reading a court opinion, only maybe wordier 有关，但题目问的是 P4 段的写作评价；且选项遗漏了「幽默与吸引力」这一面。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say is the greatest strength of Ford's book?

options.text: Plentiful information.
Meaningful choices.
Evolved thinking.
Intellectual depth

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say is the greatest strength of Ford's book? 问「最大优点是什么」，文中必有显式表述，属细节定位题。
【拆句】主干 What does the author say is the greatest strength…？嵌套宾语从句 the author say + 主语 [the greatest strength of Ford's book] + 系动词 is，问的是表语的内容。无陷阱。
【定位】But the greatest strength of this book (on fashion!) is its intellectual profoundness.
但这本（讲时尚的！）书最大的优点，是它在思想上的深刻。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
Plentiful information 把 dense with research 误当作本段「最大优点」，跨段错位，且 Ford 的写作密度在原文是写作风格而非最大优点。
B)
以偏概全
Meaningful choices 取自 the simplest choices are charged with meaning，那是支撑思想深度的细节，不是最大优点本身。
C)
与原文相反
Evolved thinking 直接对应 We believe our thinking today is evolved; Ford shows us it's not，作者明确指出今天的思维其实并未进化——把它当作 Ford 书的最大优点，与原文结论完全相反。
D)
✓ 正确
intellectual profoundness ↔Intellectual depth
Intellectual depth 与预判「思想上的深刻」语义一一对应，无任何缩放或偷换。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the author say about the ability to be persuasive in the first paragraph?

options.text: People may either be born with it or be able to cultivate it.
It proves crucial in making others follow one's course of action.
It refers to the natural and instinctive power of influencing one's coworkers.
People may view it as both a means to convince others and an art of communication.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say about the ability to be persuasive in the first paragraph?是典型的 What does the author say + 段落限定，问的是作者在指定段落对某事的具体说法，无 infer/imply 字样。
【拆句】题干 What does the author say about the ability to be persuasive in the first paragraph? 主干为 What does the author say about X，X 是 the ability to be persuasive；in the first paragraph 是地点状语修饰 say。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally. For the rest of us, persuasion skills can be learned and developed over time.
对我们中的一些人来说，说服是与生俱来的天赋，影响他人的能力是天生的；对我们其余的人来说，说服技巧是可以随时间学习并培养的。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality ↔born with it
persuasion skills can be learned and developed over time ↔be able to cultivate it
预判要求“天生或后天习得”两端都覆盖，仅 People may either be born with it or be able to cultivate it 用 either...or 句式完整对应两端。
B)
答非所问
It proves crucial in making others follow one's course of action 把首段对“能力来源”的说明换成了“能力的重要性”，回答的不是 What does the author say 这个角度的问题。
C)
以偏概全
It refers to the natural and instinctive power of influencing one's coworkers 只截取了“天生本能”那一半（some of us），漏掉了“后天习得”那一半（the rest of us），且把场景窄化到 coworkers。
D)
无中生有
People may view it as both a means to convince others and an art of communication 中的 art of communication 在首段并未提及，原文只说 the art of persuasion，把 persuasion 偷换成 communication。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace?

options.text: They enable employees to be convinced of their long-term gains.
They enable employees to trust their leaders unconditionally.
They help motivate coworkers to strive for a common goal.
They help an organization to broaden its vision effectively.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace? 问的是被广泛重视的具体原因，是文中可直接读出的事实，不要求跨段综合推断。
【拆句】题干 Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace? 是 Why + be + 过去分词 valued 构成的被动疑问句，主语是 persuasion skills；in the workplace 是地点状语。被动语态把动作发出方（雇主）省略了，考生需要意识到“被谁所重视”的隐含主语在原文是 employers。
【定位】Effective use of persuasion skills will not only help get your coworkers excited about your ideas, it'll also help you motivate them to achieve a common goal.
有效运用说服技巧不仅有助于让你的同事对你的想法感到兴奋，也有助于你激励他们为实现共同目标而努力。
【选项】A)
无中生有
They enable employees to be convinced of their long-term gains 中的 long-term gains 在原文找不到对应，原文 long-term mission 谈的是组织的长期使命，并非员工的长远收益。
B)
过度推断
They enable employees to trust their leaders unconditionally 中 unconditionally是绝对化表述，原文只谈“激励”，从未要求“无条件信任”，属于过度推断。
C)
✓ 正确
help you motivate them to achieve a common goal ↔ help motivate coworkers to strive for a common goal
预判“激励同事为共同目标”两要素，They help motivate coworkers to strive for a common goal 在句法结构上几乎是原文的平移，是最贴近预判的选项。
D)
偷换概念
They help an organization to broaden its vision effectively 把原文的“让员工committed to vision”（员工对愿景的认同）偷换成“拓展组织的愿景”（broaden its vision），动作和受体都被换掉。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页

stem: What should people do to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace?

options.text: Acquire effective communication skills.
Avoid getting involved in conflicts with others.
Understand the reason for pursuing their goals.
Commit themselves fully to their ideas and plans.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What should people do to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace? 提问“为达成X 该做什么”，答案是原文中显性陈述的前置条件，无需推断。
【拆句】题干 What should people do to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace? 主干是What should people do，to learn... at the workplace 是不定式做目的状语。考生易把to learn 误读为定语修饰 do，正确理解应是“为了学会...，人们该做什么”。
【定位】Good communication is the first step in effective persuasion, but logic and reasoning are just as important.
良好的沟通是有效说服的第一步，但逻辑和推理同样重要。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
Good communication is the first step in effective persuasion ↔ Acquire effective communication skills
预判要求“先做好沟通”，Acquire effective communication skills 用 acquire 动作动词直译 first step 隐含的“获取动作”，匹配度最高。
B)
偷换概念
Avoid getting involved in conflicts with others 把原文 how to handle conflicts（处理冲突）偷换成 avoid... conflicts（回避冲突），原文从未让人避开冲突。
C)
张冠李戴
Understand the reason for pursuing their goals 把原文中的“帮别人理解为什么要追求该目标”张冠到“自己理解”，主语错位。
D)
答非所问
Commit themselves fully to their ideas and plans 描述的是听众被说服后的状态（fully committed），是“说服成功”的结果，而题干问的是说服者该做的前置条件。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers?

options.text: When they are convinced you work in their interests while sacrificing your own
When they become aware of the potential strength of the judgements you make
When they become aware of the meaningful relationships you keep with them.
When they are convinced they will make achievements together with you.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers? 问的是某客观条件下的可能性，文中第四段直陈条件句，可直接定位。
【拆句】题干 When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers? 主干是When are you more likely to succeed，to succeed in doing 是固定搭配。考生易把more likely 误读作纯感情色彩词，应理解为“在何种条件下，更可能”，相当于在问触发条件。
【定位】Your coworkers are more likely to agree with you when they succeed alongside you.
当你的同事与你一起取得成功时，他们更可能同意你的看法。
【选项】A)
过度推断
while sacrificing your own 是原文从未提及的“牺牲自我利益”，原文只说“为对方利益着想”，未要求牺牲自己。
B)
偷换概念
the potential strength of the judgements you make 把原文 they trust your judgement and strength 中的并列两件事偷换成“判断的潜在力量”，concept 被悄悄合并改写。
C)
答非所问
meaningful relationships you keep with them 是说服力的前提条件（说服者需要做的事），不是同事被说服的触发条件——题干问的是后者。
D)
✓ 正确
when they succeed alongside you ↔ When they are convinced they will make achievements together with you
预判“双方共同成功才更易被说服”，they will make achievements together with you是定位句 they succeed alongside you 的同义改写，方向一致。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: Why are organizations and leaders advised to adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes?

options.text: To convince employees of the value of collaboration
To allow for the preferences of most people of today
To improve on traditional organizational structures
To adapt to employees' ever-changing working styles

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】Why are organizations and leaders advised to adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes? 问的是该建议的事实依据，文中末段直陈，无须推断。
【拆句】题干 Why are organizations and leaders advised to adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes? 是 Why + 被动 are advised to do 的疑问句，to bring about... 是不定式做目的状语。该结构隐含的动作发出方是“作者”，被建议方是organizations and leaders；考生需识别这是在问作者给出此建议的依据。
【定位】A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures; no one likes to be told what to do or to be pushed around. Therefore, organizations and leaders should adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes.
绝大多数人更喜欢协作与团队合作，而非传统组织结构；没人喜欢被指使或被任意摆布。因此，组织和领导者应当采用有力的说服技巧来带来必要的变革。
【选项】A)
答非所问
To convince employees of the value of collaboration 把“顺应大多数人偏好”换成了“说服员工相信协作的价值”——原文是员工自己已经偏好协作，无需再被说服其价值。
B)
✓ 正确
A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures
↔To allow for the preferences of most people of today
题干问“为什么被建议这么做”，To allow for the preferences of most people of today 用 To do 不定式直接给出目的-原因，是最贴合预判的答案。
C)
无中生有
To improve on traditional organizational structures 把“改善传统组织结构”列为目的，但原文 traditional organizational structures 出现的语境是“人们更偏好协作而非传统组织结构”，并未把“改善”它作为说服技巧的目的。
D)
无中生有
To adapt to employees' ever-changing working styles 中的 ever-changing working styles（不断变化的工作方式）原文未提，原文谈的是“偏好”而非“工作方式的变化”。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2024-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about Sherry Christian?

options.text: She is making a special effort to be recognized.
She has been living in Fayetteville for 25 years.
She has been driving a school bus ever since 2009.
She is the longest-serving bus driver in Fayetteville.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about Sherry Christian?
【翻译】关于Sherry Christian我们了解到什么?
A) 她正在特别努力以获得认可。
B) 她已在Fayetteville生活了25年。
C) 她自2009年以来一直驾驶校车。
D) 她是Fayetteville服务时间最长的公交车司机。
【答案】D （细节题）She is the longest-serving bus driver in Fayetteville.
【定位】As part of the event, the city is celebrating its longest-serving driver on the force.
作为活动的一部分，该市正在表彰其在职时间最长的司机。
【信号】最高级 longest-serving 强调。答案句的信号是最高级 longest-serving driver on the force——『在职最久的司机』。最高级是新闻强调『独一份身份』的标志，一旦听到 the longest / the most，往往就是出题点，要立刻锁定。
【替换】the city is celebrating its longest-serving driver on the force ↔ She is the longest-serving bus driver in Fayetteville.
同身份的换说法

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
录音里 The City of Fayetteville is making a special effort to recognize its bus drivers的主语是『城市』在努力表彰司机；选项 A 把它偷换成 She is making a special effort to be recognized.——变成『她自己在努力争取被认可』。努力的人从城市换成了她本人，主语张冠李戴。
借用原文：The City of Fayetteville is making a special effort to recognize its bus drivers
B)
原词陷阱
录音第 2 段说 Christian has been a driver for 25 years.——她当『司机』25 年；选项 B把这个 25 年的数字盗来，安到 living in Fayetteville for 25 years『在 Fayetteville 住了25 年』上。录音说的是开车 25 年、不是住了 25 年，听到 25 years 就选正中陷阱。
借用原文：Christian has been a driver for 25 years.
C)
原词陷阱
录音第 3 段 Transit Driver Appreciation Day has been celebrated across the country as far back as 2009. 里的 2009，说的是『这个表彰日全国早在 2009 年就有了』，与她本人无关；选项 C 把 2009 盗来，说成 driving a school bus ever since 2009『她从 2009年起开校车』。年份对象被偷换，听到 2009 就选即中招。
借用原文：Transit Driver Appreciation Day has been celebrated across the country as far back as 2009.
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did city officials of Fayetteville want bus drivers to be aware of?

options.text: The importance of their service to the city.
The number of riders they serve in the city.
The new proclamation issued early this week.
The significance of the event to take place March 18.

explanation:
【题目】What did city officials of Fayetteville want bus drivers to be aware of?
【翻译】Fayetteville市政府官员希望公交车司机意识到什么?
A) 他们为这座城市提供的服务的重要性。
B) 他们在这座城市服务的乘客数量。
C) 本周早些时候发布的新公告。
D) 将于3月18日举行的活动的重要意义。
【答案】A （细节题）The importance of their service to the city.
【定位】Officials said they want bus drivers to know how important they are to Fayetteville, serving almost 1.6 million riders a year.
官员们说，他们想让公交司机知道，他们对 Fayetteville 有多么重要，每年服务近 160 万名乘客。
【信号】官方表态 said they want…to know。答案句的信号是官方直接表态 Officials said they want bus drivers to know how important they are——『官员说想让司机知道他们有多重要』。said…want…to know 直接抛出他们要传达的内容，是答案句的明确路标。
【替换】how important they are to Fayetteville ↔The importance of their service to the city.
形容词改名词

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音句尾 serving almost 1.6 million riders a year 确实念到了乘客数量，但它只是补充说明司机为何重要的背景；选项 B 把这个数字盗来当成官方想让司机知道的内容 The number of riders they serve in the city.。官方强调的是『重要性』，不是『乘客数量』这个数字本身，听到 riders 就选即中招。
借用原文：serving almost 1.6 million riders a year
C)
答非所问
录音第 3 段 this week, the City of Fayetteville issued a proclamation 提到本周发了公告，选项 C 把它说成 The new proclamation issued early this week.。公告是事件背景，题目问的是『官方想让司机知道什么』，公告本身不是答案，属答非所问。
借用原文：this week, the City of Fayetteville issued a proclamation for the day
D)
原词陷阱
录音 for the day to take place March 18th 念到了活动日期 3 月 18 日，选项 D 把它说成The significance of the event to take place March 18.。日期只是活动安排的细节，官方想让司机知道的是『他们的重要性』而非『这个活动的意义』，听到 March 18 就选即被日期带偏。
借用原文：for the day to take place March 18th
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the news report say the Wilton School Board has done?

options.text: Budgeted $56.7 million for the coming school year.
Requested to raise teachers' salaries by 3 percent.
Proposed a spending increase by 5.99 percent.
Kept raising funds for at least 8 budget cycles.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say the Wilton School Board has done?
【翻译】新闻报道称 Wilton 学区委员会做了什么?
A) 为即将到来的学年预算了 5670 万美元。
B) 要求将教师工资提高 3%。
C) 提议将开支增加 5.99%。
D) 在至少 8 个预算周期内持续筹集资金。
【答案】C （细节题）Proposed a spending increase by 5.99 percent.
【定位】The Wilton School Board has proposed a 5.99% spending increase.
威尔顿学区校董会提出了一项 5.99% 的支出增长。
【信号】开篇首句直陈主体动作。新闻把核心事实放在开篇，第一句 The Wilton School Board has proposed a 5.99% spending increase. 直接交代了校董会做的事，主体+动作+数字俱全，正是答案句。
【替换】has proposed a 5.99% spending increase ↔Proposed a spending increase by 5.99 percent.
原句几乎平移到选项
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Budgeted $56.7 million for the coming school year. 借用了录音真实念到的数字 56.7 million，可录音说的是 up from the $56.7 million budgeted for the current school year——这是『本学年』已编的旧预算、是被比较的基数，并非为『下一学年』新编的，听到 56.7 million 就选会掉坑。
借用原文：up from the $56.7 million budgeted for the current school year
B)
原词陷阱
Requested to raise teachers' salaries by 3 percent. 看似与教师薪资相关，但录音只说薪资占比 64% of the total request 与金额升至 59 million，从未说按 3% 加薪；3 percent与录音里的 2.99% 近似，是用近似数字加上『加薪』这个貌似合理的动作拼出来的干扰。
借用原文：2.99% for the 2021-2022 school year
D)
原词陷阱
Kept raising funds for at least 8 budget cycles. 抓住了录音里的 at least eight budget cycles，但录音原意是『这是至少八个预算周期以来最大的一次涨幅』，eight budget cycles 是个时间比较范围，并非校董会『持续筹款八个周期』这个动作，属于把时间状语硬读成动作。
借用原文：the largest jump in at least eight budget cycles
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What will a decline in the total enrollment lead to?

options.text: Decrease in salaries for school administrators.
Reduction in federal and state funding.
Firing of less qualified faculty members.
Closing down of some less competitive schools.

explanation:
【题目】What will a decline in the total enrollment lead to?
【翻译】总入学人数下降会导致什么?
A) 学校管理人员工资减少。
B) 联邦和州资助减少。
C) 解雇资质较低的教职员工。
D) 关闭一些竞争力较弱的学校。
【答案】B （细节题）Reduction in federal and state funding.
【定位】This represents 47 fewer students than the current year. Fewer students mean less federal and state funding.
这意味着比本学年少了 47 名学生。学生减少意味着联邦和州的拨款减少。
【信号】因果词 mean 点出后果。录音用 Fewer students mean less federal and state funding中的 mean 直接把『学生减少』和『拨款减少』连起来，mean 后面那一截就是题目要的后果，是标准的因果信号句。
【替换】less federal and state funding ↔Reduction in federal and state funding.
less 换成名词 Reduction
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Decrease in salaries for school administrators. 里 salaries 一词录音确实出现过（教师薪资升至 59 million），但录音只说薪资是上涨的、且针对的是教师而非行政人员，更没说招生下降会让薪资下降，是把听过的 salaries 拿来嫁接的无中生有后果。
借用原文：teacher salaries. These account for 64% of the total request at $59 million
C)
未提及
Firing of less qualified faculty members. 听上去『钱少了就裁人』很合逻辑，但录音对学生减少给出的唯一后果是拨款减少，从未提到裁教师，这是用常识脑补、原文未提。
D)
未提及
Closing down of some less competitive schools. 同样是凭常识想象的后果，录音谈的是同一个学区内部的预算与拨款，根本没提到关停任何学校，属未提及。

1 A rare thundersnow event has taken place in Scotland. And alarmed locals contacted police, thinking they had heard bombs going off. The phenomenon happens when thunder and lightning mix with a heavy snowstorm—sometimes causing loud claps that can be confused with explosions.
苏格兰发生了一次罕见的雷雪事件。惊慌失措的当地居民联系了警方,以为他们听到了炸弹爆炸的声音。这种现象发生在雷电与暴雪混合时,有时会产生巨大的爆裂声,容易被误认为是爆炸。

stem: What do we learn about thundersnows from the report?

options.text: They often take place in the Scottish highlands.
They usually happen in the middle of the night.
Their damage can be as serious as that of bombs.
Their loud claps can be confused with explosions.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about thundersnows from the report?
【翻译】我们从报道中了解到关于雷暴雪的什么信息?
A) 它们经常发生在苏格兰高地。
B) 它们通常发生在午夜时分。
C) 它们造成的破坏可能与炸弹一样严重。
D) 它们的巨大响声可能会与爆炸声混淆。
【答案】D （细节题）Their loud claps can be confused with explosions.
【定位】The phenomenon happens when thunder and lightning mix with a heavy snowstorm— sometimes causing loud claps that can be confused with explosions.
这一现象发生在雷电与强暴风雪交织之时——有时会造成响亮的轰鸣声，让人误以为是爆炸。
【信号】定义句"The phenomenon happens when…"。信号是这句对现象下定义的结构 The phenomenon happens when（这一现象发生在……之时），新闻在介绍一个陌生概念后，紧跟的这种"定义/解释句"就是该现象特征的承载句，听到"The phenomenon…"就锁定它后面的内容。
【替换】loud claps that can be confused with explosions ↔ Their loud claps can be confused with explosions.
原句换主语几乎平移

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音开头只说这次事件发生在苏格兰这一具体地点，并没说雷雪"往往发生在苏格兰高地"。A 借"Scotland/highlands"这个地名营造熟悉感，把"这一次在苏格兰"偷换成"通常在高地"，是个频率/范围被夸大的陷阱。
借用原文：A rare thundersnow event has taken place in Scotland.
B)
原词陷阱
录音里 woken up in the middle of the night 说的是"某个人这一次在半夜被吵醒"，并非"雷雪通常发生在半夜"。B 把这个时间状语原词搬过来，又加上"usually"夸成惯例，听到"middle of the night"就选 B 正中陷阱。
借用原文：Another person was woken up in the middle of the night
C)
偷换概念
录音说的是雷雪的"巨响"可被误当爆炸（声音层面），并没说它的"破坏力"和炸弹一样大。C 借用"bombs"这个原词，把"声音像炸弹"偷换成"破坏力像炸弹"，听到 bombs 就选会掉进去。
借用原文：loud claps that can be confused with explosions
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the police do when they received the local residents' phone calls?

options.text: They sent out a message to calm them down.
They promised to stop the construction work.
They told them the military exercise was over.
They set off to inspect the site of the plane crash.

explanation:
【题目】What did the police do when they received the local residents' phone calls?
【翻译】警方在接到当地居民的电话后做了什么?
A) 他们发出了一条消息让居民冷静下来。
B) 他们承诺停止施工作业。
C) 他们告诉居民军事演习已经结束。
D) 他们出发前往检查飞机坠毁现场。
【答案】A （细节题）They sent out a message to calm them down.
【定位】The police were flooded with many calls from the public. And they sent out a message asking people to remain calm.
警方接到了公众打来的大量电话。随后他们发出一条消息，请大家保持冷静。
【信号】主语 the police 紧跟的动作句。信号是以警方为主语、紧接"接到大量电话"之后的那个动作 they sent out a message asking people to remain calm。题目问"接到电话后做了什么"，录音里"接到电话"这句的下一句就是答案落点，顺着叙事次序就能接住。
【替换】sent out a message asking people to remain calm ↔They sent out a message to calm them down.
"请人保持冷静"="使其平静"

【排除】B)
未提及
录音只提到有人"以为是施工开工"，从没说警方"承诺停止施工"。B 借"construction"这个画面把不存在的承诺安到警方头上，属凭空捏造的动作。
借用原文：what he thought was early construction work starting
C)
原词陷阱
录音是警方"向大家保证这只是雷电、不是军事演习"，并非"告诉大家军演结束了"。C 偷来"military exercise"原词，把"不是军演"改成"军演已结束"——录音根本没有军演，何来结束，听到 military exercise 就选 C 正中陷阱。
借用原文：it was just thunder and lightning rather than some military exercise
D)
原词陷阱
录音里"plane crash"只是某人形容声音"像飞机失事"的比喻，根本没有真飞机失事，警方更没"前往勘查失事现场"。D 把这个比喻里的原词搬来，编出一个不存在的警方动作，听到plane crash 就选会掉坑。
借用原文：described it as a loud boom, similar to a plane crash
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What were people advised to do when traveling outside?

options.text: Keep warm.
Take caution.
Avoid driving.
Use rail service.

explanation:
【题目】What were people advised to do when traveling outside?
【翻译】人们被建议在外出时做什么?
A) 保持温暖。
B) 小心谨慎。
C) 避免驾车。
D) 使用铁路服务。
【答案】B （细节题）Take caution.
【定位】The weather was the coldest it had been for the season, so people were warned to be careful when traveling outside.
天气是本季最冷的，因此人们被提醒外出时要小心。
【信号】提醒信号"were warned to be careful"。信号是 people were warned to be careful when traveling outside 里的"were warned"（被提醒）这一提醒标志词，它后面紧跟的be careful 就是"被建议做什么"的直接答案，听到 warned/advised 就锁后面的动作。
【替换】people were warned to be careful ↔Take caution
"be careful"="take caution"

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
过度推断
录音虽说"本季最冷"，但提醒的内容是"小心"，并没说让大家"保暖"。A 借"最冷天气"的语境顺势推出"keep warm"，是录音没明说的过度延伸，听到 coldest 就联想到保暖会被带偏。
借用原文：The weather was the coldest it had been for the season
C)
原词陷阱
录音说"结冰湿滑路面会给司机带来困难"，是提醒司机小心，并没说"别开车"。C借"drivers"原词把"开车要当心"偷换成"避免开车"，比录音说得更绝对，听到 drivers 就选C 会掉坑。
借用原文：dangerous conditions such as icy roads or wet ground could cause difficulty for drivers
D)
与原文相反
录音说"铁路服务也宣布列车可能因大雪受扰"，是说火车也受影响、不可靠，绝非建议大家"改坐火车"。D 偷来"rail service"原词，把"火车受影响"反着说成"用火车出行"，听到 rail service 就选 D 正中反向陷阱。
借用原文：The rail service also announced potential disruptions to trains due to the deep snow.

stem: What does the woman say she was actually wondering about?

options.text: Why the man is so anxious to buy a new phone.
How the man could possibly afford a new phone.
How the man got into the habit of being wasteful.
Why the man is so fond of using his credit card.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say she was actually wondering about?
【翻译】女士说她实际上想知道的是什么?
A) 为什么男士如此急于购买新手机。
B) 男士怎么可能负担得起新手机。
C) 男士是如何养成浪费习惯的。
D) 为什么男士如此喜欢使用信用卡。
【答案】B （细节题）How the man could possibly afford a new phone.
【定位】No, actually, I was wondering how you could possibly afford a new phone.
不，其实我是在想，你到底怎么买得起一部新手机。
【信号】actually 纠偏后的真意。女方先用 No 否定男方的猜测，再用 actually 引出自己真正在想的事——"actually"后面才是她的本意，这正是答案信号：纠正/转折之后的内容才是落点。
【替换】how you could possibly afford a new phone ↔How the man could possibly afford a new phone.
几乎原句搬运，仅换人称

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音确有男方 I'm going to the city centre to buy a new phone today. 这种"今天就去买"的急切感，A 借此造"为何这么急"的诱惑；但女方明说在想的是"怎么买得起"，不是"为何急"。
借用原文：I'm going to the city centre to buy a new phone today.
C)
原词陷阱
女方确实说了 getting another phone so soon is wasteful，C 盗这个 wasteful 来骗；但这是她在 But now that you mention it 之后补的评价，题干问的是她"actually was wondering"的那件事，那件事是"如何负担"，不是"如何变浪费"。
借用原文：getting another phone so soon is wasteful
D)
张冠李戴
录音后文男方说 I just got a credit card，D 借"信用卡"造"为何爱用卡"的问题；但这是男方的话、且在女方发问之后，女方"在想"的内容里根本没有它。
借用原文：I just got a credit card
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why is the man a little embarrassed by the phone he's using now?

options.text: It is not in fashion any more.
It goes out of order frequently.
It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.
It lacks functions office work requires.

explanation:
【题目】Why is the man a little embarrassed by the phone he's using now?
【翻译】为什么男士对他现在使用的手机感到有点尴尬?
A) 它已经不再流行了。
B) 它经常出现故障。
C) 它不如他同事的手机高级。
D) 它缺少办公工作所需的功能。
【答案】C （细节题）It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.
【定位】Maybe you're right, but the thing is, everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone, and I'm a little embarrassed by mine.
也许你说得对，但问题是，办公室里每个人都有一部又好又贵的手机，我对自己这部有点难为情。
【信号】the thing is 引出真正缘由。男方用 but the thing is 转入正题，紧接着给出难为情的原因——"大家都有又好又贵的手机"。"the thing is"是"我接下来说的才是要点"的提示，正是答案信号。
【替换】everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone ↔It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.
正话反说＋同义改写
I'm a little embarrassed by mine ↔It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.
难为情对应的正是"比不上"

【排除】A)
未提及
男方只说自己手机比不上同事、并非"不再时髦"。in fashion 这层意思录音从未出现，是凭"旧手机"常识硬加的。
B)
未提及
男方难为情是因为手机不够气派，不是因为它老出故障。"goes out of order"录音里完全没有对应。
D)
原词陷阱
录音确有 everyone at the office 出现"office"，D 用 functions office work requires把"office"接到"工作功能缺失"上；但男方难为情是"不如别人气派"，从没说手机缺工作所需功能。
借用原文：everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about the credit card he just got?

options.text: It enables him to buy a new phone at a more favorable price.
It is a special offer to recent college graduates working in offices.
It is available to office workers who have a good enough credit score.
It allows him to borrow money without paying interest for six months.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about the credit card he just got?
【翻译】关于男士刚办的信用卡,他说了什么?
A) 它使他能够以更优惠的价格购买新手机。
B) 这是为刚毕业在办公室工作的大学生提供的特别优惠。
C) 信用评分足够好的办公室职员可以办理。
D) 它允许他借款六个月不用支付利息。
【答案】D （细节题）It allows him to borrow money without paying interest for six months.
【定位】Maybe you're right, but the credit card has a very good special offer, where I don't pay any interest for six months.
也许你说得对，但这张信用卡有个很不错的特别优惠，六个月内我不用付任何利息。
【信号】数字/期限信息点。男方介绍卡时给出 I don't pay any interest for six months——"不付利息"加"六个月"是一处明确的数字/条件信息，正是该题的答案信号，听到数字就该锁定。
【替换】I don't pay any interest for six months ↔ It allows him to borrow money without paying interest for six months.
同义改写＋补出隐含的"借钱"

【排除】A)
未提及
卡的好处是"免息"而非"以更优价格买手机"。a more favorable price 录音里没有对应，免息不等于降价。
B)
张冠李戴
录音里女方说 you are a recent graduate，B 借此编出"专给应届办公族的特别优惠"；但这是女方议论男方身份的话，与卡的优惠对象无关，男方介绍卡时根本没提面向谁。
借用原文：you are a recent graduate
C)
原词陷阱
录音反复出现 credit card 的 credit，C 借此造 a good enough credit score 的门槛；但男方说的是"免息"，从没提任何信用分要求，credit score 是凭 credit 一词联想出来的。
借用原文：the credit card has a very good special offer
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about one of the woman's colleagues?

options.text: She borrowed money to pay her debt.
She developed a habit of overspending.
She enjoys buying a lot of fancy things.
She regrets ignoring the woman's advice.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about one of the woman's colleagues?
【翻译】关于女士的一位同事,我们了解到什么?
A) 她借钱来偿还债务。
B) 她养成了过度消费的习惯。
C) 她喜欢购买很多高级物品。
D) 她后悔没有听从女士的建议。
【答案】B （细节题）She developed a habit of overspending.
【定位】One of my colleagues bought a lot of things on credit during her first year of work, and it became a bad habit, and she accumulated a lot of debt.
我的一个同事在工作第一年用信用卡买了一大堆东西，后来变成了一个坏习惯，她还欠下了一大笔债。
【信号】举例＋"became a bad habit"落点。女方用 One of my colleagues 引出例子，关键落在it became a bad habit——"变成一个坏习惯"是这句话的结论，正是答案信号：举例句里那个"演变成…"的结果才是要点。
【替换】bought a lot of things on credit ... it became a bad habit ↔ She developed a habit of overspending.
"乱买成习惯"概括为 overspending habit

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音确有 she accumulated a lot of debt 出现 debt，A 借此编出"借钱去还债"；但原文只说她"欠了债"，从没说她"再借钱来还"，多绕了一步。
借用原文：she accumulated a lot of debt
C)
原词陷阱
录音说她 bought a lot of things on credit，C 改成"enjoys buying a lot of fancy things"；"fancy（华而不实/高档）"与"enjoys（乐在其中）"录音都没有，原文重点是"成了坏习惯"而非"她爱买好东西"。
借用原文：bought a lot of things on credit
D)
张冠李戴
后文男方说 I'm sure she regrets it，D 借此说"她后悔没听劝"；但这是男方的推测、且"没听 the woman 的劝"录音根本没有，属把男方的话安到同事头上。
借用原文：I'm sure she regrets it

source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the tiny home movement mainly advocate?

options.text: Blog writing and natural resources saving.
Joint efforts to improve the local community.
Audience participation in The Morning Show.
Home ownership and environmental protection.

explanation:
【题目】What does the tiny home movement mainly advocate?
【翻译】小型住宅运动主要倡导什么？
A) 博客写作和节约自然资源。
B) 共同努力改善当地社区。
C) 观众参与《早间节目》。
D) 拥有住房和环境保护。
【答案】D （主旨题）Home ownership and environmental protection.
【定位】Well, it's mainly about increasing home ownership and protecting the environment.
嗯，它主要就是关于提高住房拥有率和保护环境。
【信号】被问者应答 + mainly 点题。前一段主持人直接发问"can you tell our audience what it's about"，紧接着这段是被问者 Bob 的正面应答，且自带点题词 it's mainly about——对话题里"提问后被问者的第一句正面回答"加上 mainly 这种总括词，正是答案句的双重信号。

【替换】increasing home ownership ↔Home ownership
动名词短语压缩成名词
protecting the environment ↔environmental protection
动词短语名词化
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音开头确实说嘉宾是 a popular blog writer，后文也提到省 fewer resources，本项Blog writing and natural resources saving 把这两个零散原词拼到一起冒充主旨，但"写博客"只是嘉宾身份、不是这个运动主张的内容，答非所问。
借用原文：a popular blog writer
B)
未提及
Joint efforts to improve the local community 说"合力改善本地社区"，但录音通篇只讲购房与环保，从未提到"社区"或"共同努力"，属凭空添加。
C)
原词陷阱
录音里 The Morning Show 只是这档节目的名字，本项 Audience participation in The Morning Show 借这个耳熟的专有名词，硬说运动主张是"观众参与节目"，与运动内容毫不相干。
借用原文：The Morning Show
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say about houses as small as 20 square meters?

options.text: Not a realistic size for families.
Not welcomed by most Americans.
Only fit for families of four or less.
Only suitable for renting to the poor.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about houses as small as 20 square meters?
【翻译】这位女士对面积小至20平方米的住宅有何看法？
A) 对家庭来说不是现实的面积。
B) 不受大多数美国人欢迎。
C) 只适合四口或四口以下的家庭。
D) 只适合出租给穷人。
【答案】A （细节题）Not a realistic size for families.
【定位】But I've seen your blog, and you write about houses that are as small as 20 square meters. That's not a realistic size for families.
但是我看过你的博客，你写的是小到只有 20 平方米的房子。对家庭来说那可不是一个现实的尺寸。
【信号】转折 But + 直接否定评价。这句以 But 转折开头，女方先承认目标好、随即话锋一转给出否定评价 That's not a realistic size for families——转折后那句才是她的真实立场，正是答案句信号。题干问"the woman 说了什么"，定位到女方说话的这一段即可。
【替换】That's not a realistic size for families ↔Not a realistic size for families
去掉主系结构后近乎原意

【排除】B)
未提及
Not welcomed by most Americans 说"不受多数美国人欢迎"，但女方只说尺寸"不现实"，从没提"美国人"或"受不受欢迎"，是凭空替换成另一种否定理由。
C)
张冠李戴
录音后面男方才提到 many families of four are happy living（四口之家也住得开），本项Only fit for families of four or less 盗用"four"这个数字，还用 Only 把范围限死成"仅四口以下"。这既张冠李戴（那是男方后说的、且态度相反），又把话说绝了。
借用原文：many families of four are happy living in houses that are under 30 square meters
D)
未提及
Only suitable for renting to the poor 说"只适合租给穷人"，录音里女方对小房子只评价了"尺寸不现实"，从未谈到"出租"或"穷人"，纯属添加。

stem: What does the man think about the dream of owning a 150-square-meter house?

options.text: It should be changed.
It isn't easy to realize.
It will come true sooner or later.
It doesn't appeal to average families.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man think about the dream of owning a 150-square-meter house?
【翻译】这位男士对拥有150平方米住宅的梦想有何看法？
A) 应该改变。
B) 不容易实现。
C) 迟早会实现。
D) 不吸引普通家庭。
【答案】A （态度观点题）It should be changed.
【定位】Yes, but I think that dream needs to change, considering the cost of housing.
是的，但我认为考虑到住房成本，那个梦想需要改变。
【信号】but + I think + needs to change 表态。前一段女方说大房子"是人们梦想拥有的"，男方先 Yes 让步、随即用 but I think that dream needs to change 转折表态。but + I think是态度信号，needs to change（需要改变）直接亮明他的立场，正是答案句。
【替换】that dream needs to change ↔It should be changed
主动 needs to 改成被动 should be

【排除】B)
偷换概念
录音男方提到 considering the cost of housing（考虑住房成本），本项 It isn't easy to realize 借"成本高"联想成"梦想不易实现"，但男方的原话是"梦想该改"，不是"难实现"，偷换了概念。
借用原文：considering the cost of housing
C)
与原文相反
It will come true sooner or later 说"迟早会实现"，方向与男方"该改变"完全相反。男方否定的是这个大房梦本身，绝不会说它迟早成真。
借用原文：that dream needs to change
D)
未提及
It doesn't appeal to average families 说"对普通家庭没吸引力"，但男方对这个 150 平米梦想只说了"该改"，从没说"对谁没吸引力"，是另造一个评价。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about tiny homes?

options.text: They help to lower housing prices.
They help to save up for larger houses.
They are a good choice for many people.
They are vital to reducing waste worldwide.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about tiny homes?
【翻译】这位男士对小型住宅有何看法？
A) 它们有助于降低住房价格。
B) 它们有助于为更大的住宅攒钱。
C) 它们对许多人来说是一个好选择。
D) 它们对于减少全球浪费至关重要。
【答案】C （态度观点题）They are a good choice for many people.
【定位】So, tiny homes might not be for everyone, but they're a good option for many.
所以呢，微型住宅可能不适合所有人，但对很多人来说是个好选择。
【信号】So 收束 + but 后的总评。这句以 So 收束前面关于省钱的讨论，男方先让步"未必适合所有人"、再用 but 给出总评 they're a good option for many。So 后的总结句加 but 后的真态度，是这道总评题的双重信号。
【替换】they're a good option for many ↔They are a good choice for many people
option=choice、many=many people

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】A)
偷换概念
录音谈到小房子便宜、能省钱 a tiny home costs just \$50,000，本项 They help to lower housing prices 借"价格"话题，偷换成"帮助拉低房价"。男方说的是"个人买得起、省钱"，不是"压低市场房价"，概念被偷换。
借用原文：Many people who can only afford to rent a large home are able to buy a tiny home
B)
与原文相反
录音说省下的钱让人能"买下小房子"，本项 They help to save up for larger houses 把方向拧反成"攒钱去买更大的房子"。这与男方"买小房子、改掉大房梦"的主张正相反。
借用原文：are able to buy a tiny home
D)
过度推断
录音只在结尾说小房子"用更少土地与资源" they use less land and fewer resources，本项 They are vital to reducing waste worldwide 用 vital（至关重要）、worldwide（全世界）夸大成"对全球减废至关重要"，程度和范围都远超原话。
借用原文：they use less land and fewer resources to build them

stem: What do children seem to have a natural desire to do?

options.text: Play outdoors and enjoy themselves.
Beat challenges and take risks.
Take care of their well-being.
Grow up strong and healthy.

explanation:
【题目】What do children seem to have a natural desire to do?
【翻译】孩子们似乎天生渴望做什么?
A) 在户外玩耍并享受乐趣。
B) 战胜挑战并承担风险。
C) 照顾自己的健康。
D) 健康强壮地成长。
【答案】B （细节题）Beat challenges and take risks.
【定位】To begin with, children seem to have a natural desire to overcome challenges and take risks.
首先，孩子们似乎天生就有克服挑战、承担风险的渴望。
【信号】序数词 To begin with 领出第一个要点。To begin with 是篇章列举的第一个序数词，它后面紧跟的就是本段第一个论点句，也是题干里 natural desire 原话的落点，听到序数词起头就要立刻锁定其后这句。
【替换】overcome challenges and take risks ↔Beat challenges and take risks
overcome 同义替换为 Beat

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
原文开头确有 run, jump, stretch and play，又多处讲 pleasure，选项 Play outdoors and enjoy themselves. 拼出 play 与 enjoy 听着耳熟，但这些不是孩子天生渴望要做的那件事，与题干 natural desire 错位。
借用原文：run, jump, stretch and play
C)
张冠李戴
原文有 improve emotional well-being，选项 Take care of their well-being. 借了 well-being 这个原词，但提升幸福感是运动带来的好处，不是孩子天生的渴望，把别处的内容安到本题上。
借用原文：improve emotional well-being
D)
未提及
Grow up strong and healthy. 是人人认同的常识，听着最顺，但原文说孩子天生渴望的是克服挑战、承担风险，并未说他们天生渴望健康成长，凭印象选它就中了陷阱。

stem: According to the American Psychological Association, what does regular physical activity do to children?

options.text: Enable them to develop their motor skills.
Help them to conceal their frustration.
Reduce their stress and depression.
Prevent them from feeling lonely.

explanation:
【题目】According to the American Psychological Association, what does regular physical activity do to children?
【翻译】根据美国心理学会的说法,经常进行体育活动对孩子们有什么作用?
A) 使他们能够发展运动技能。
B) 帮助他们掩饰挫败感。
C) 减轻他们的压力和抑郁。
D) 防止他们感到孤独。
【答案】C （细节题）Reduce their stress and depression.
【定位】Thirdly, according to the American Psychological Association, regular physical activity (and especially outdoor activity) reduces children's stress and depression, and improves their ability to focus and learn.
第三，根据美国心理学会的说法，规律的身体活动（尤其是户外活动）能减轻孩子的压力和抑郁，并提升他们专注和学习的能力。
【信号】出处词 according to 与题干同源对接。原文 according to the American Psychological Association 与题干出处一字不差，听到这个机构名就知道答案句到了，其后 reduces children's stress and depression 即为落点。
【替换】reduces children's stress and depression ↔Reduce their stress and depression
近乎同表述、仅人称代词改写

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
原文 develop their motor skills 确有这个搭配，选项 Enable them to develop their motor skills. 原词照搬，听着最像，但这是第一段讲运动总体好处时说的，不属于美国心理学会出处句，被题干的出处限定排除。
借用原文：develop their motor skills
B)
偷换概念
原文出现 persist through frustration 与 positive outlet for frustration，选项 Help them to conceal their frustration. 借 frustration 一词，却把原文的疏导挫折偷换成隐藏挫折，方向相反。
借用原文：positive outlet for frustration
D)
未提及
Prevent them from feeling lonely. 听起来合理，但原文讲的是减压、抗抑郁、助专注，从未提到防止孤独，属于无中生有。
