stem: What does the passage say about cultivating the habit of physical activity?

options.text: It begins early.
It proves demanding.
It calls for lifelong efforts.
It lies in nature experiences.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about cultivating the habit of physical activity?
【翻译】文章关于培养体育活动习惯说了什么?
A) 它从早期开始。
B) 它证明很费力。
C) 它需要终身努力。
D) 它在于自然体验。
【答案】A （细节题）It begins early.
【定位】Finally, we know that physical activity is important for our physical and mental health, and cultivating the habit of physical activity starts early.
最后，我们知道身体活动对我们的身心健康很重要，而养成身体活动的习惯要从早开始。
【信号】序数词 Finally 领出末点、starts early 是定性词。Finally 标出最后一个要点，紧接着cultivating the habit of physical activity starts early 直接对养成习惯下定性，starts early 就是答案的核心信息。
【替换】cultivating the habit of physical activity starts early ↔It begins early
starts 同义替换为 begins、习惯被代词 It 概括

【排除】B)
未提及
It proves demanding. 说养成习惯很费劲，但原文只说它 starts early，并未评价它吃力，属于无中生有。
C)
原词陷阱
原文确有 a healthy coping skill throughout life 和 a lifelong love of physical activity，选项 It calls for lifelong efforts. 借 lifelong 这个原词，但原文是说会终身热爱、终身受用，绝不是说养成习惯需要终身努力，把听到的 lifelong 安错了对象，也与本题定性句starts early 矛盾。
借用原文：a lifelong love of physical activity
D)
原词陷阱
原文结尾确有 gardening or nature experiences，选项 It lies in nature experiences. 搬了 nature experiences 这个原词，但那是在举可替代的活动选项，不是在说养成习惯这件事的特点，答非所问。
借用原文：gardening or nature experiences
1 A new study finds that job seekers are even willing to explore jobs with lower salaries when companies are more diverse. It finds that sharing information about diversity makes job postings more attractive to job seekers, even when pay is lower.
一项新研究发现，当公司更具多样性时，求职者甚至愿意探索薪资较低的工作。研究发现，分享关于多样性的信息使得招聘信息对求职者更具吸引力，即使薪酬较低。
2 To conduct the study, the team partnered with an online job listings platform which emails postings relevant to individuals and their job search criteria. For the course of the 11-week study, the platform emailed job listings to some 180,000 users placed in one of two conditions. In the baseline condition, participants saw emails in the normal format, with no information on diversity; in the diversity condition, participants saw a diversity score for each listing: information about the race, gender, education, and language skills of a company's workforce compared to others in the same sector and location. Information was then gathered on whether the email was opened, and which job listings were clicked on by each user.
为了进行这项研究，研究团队与一个在线招聘信息平台合作，该平台会向个人发送与其求职标准相关的职位信息邮件。在为期11周的研究过程中，该平台向约18万名用户发送招聘信息邮件，这些用户被分为两种情况之一。在基线情况下，参与者看到的是正常格式的邮件,没有关于多样性的信息;在多样性情况下,参与者看到每个招聘信息的多样性评分:关于公司员工的种族、性别、教育程度和语言技能与同一行业和地区其他公司相比的信息。然后收集关于邮件是否被打开以及每个用户点击了哪些招聘信息的数据。
3 Participants in the diversity condition tended to click on job listings from companies with slightly higher diversity scores than those in the baseline condition: that is, participants seemed to be paying attention to information about diversity, and using this when deciding whether to click on the listing.

stem: When are job seekers willing to explore jobs with lower salaries, according to a new study?

options.text: When companies share their information online.
When their job search criteria are met fully.
When companies embrace greater diversity
When they find job postings visually attractive.

explanation:
【题目】When are job seekers willing to explore jobs with lower salaries, according to a new study?
【翻译】根据一项新研究,求职者在什么情况下愿意考虑薪资较低的工作?
A) 当公司在网上分享其信息时。
B) 当他们的求职标准得到充分满足时。
C) 当公司拥抱更大的多样性时。
D) 当他们发现招聘信息在视觉上有吸引力时。
【答案】C （细节题）When companies embrace greater diversity
【定位】A new study finds that job seekers are even willing to explore jobs with lower salaries when companies are more diverse.
一项新研究发现，当企业更具多样性时，求职者甚至愿意去考虑薪资更低的工作。
【信号】when 条件状语点出触发条件。这句用 when companies are more diverse 这个条件状语，直接把『愿接受低薪』的触发条件说出来，正是题干 When 所问。开篇第一句即点题，是篇章独白的典型落点。
【替换】when companies are more diverse ↔When companies embrace greater diversity
形容词转动词的同义改写

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音后文确有 sharing information about diversity 和提到在线平台，A 项 share their information online 盗用了 information、online 这些原词，但它说的是公司在网上分享信息，并非求职者接受低薪的触发条件，听到原词就选会落入陷阱。
借用原文：sharing information about diversity
B)
原词陷阱
录音提到平台按 their job search criteria 推送邮件，B 项 When their job search criteria are met fully 借用了 job search criteria 这个原词，但录音从没说『求职标准被完全满足』才接受低薪，这是用原词拼出的无中生有条件。
借用原文：their job search criteria
D)
偷换概念
录音说多样性让 job postings more attractive，D 项 When they find job postings visually attractive. 盗用了 job postings、attractive，却加了 visually（视觉上）这层录音没有的意思，把『内容上更有吸引力』偷换成『看起来好看』。
借用原文：more attractive to job seekers

stem: What did participants see in the baseline condition of the study?

options.text: Emails in the normal format.
Major companies in one location.
All companies in the same sector.
Various aspects of a company's workforce.

explanation:
【题目】What did participants see in the baseline condition of the study?
【翻译】在研究的基线条件下,参与者看到了什么?
A) 正常格式的电子邮件。
B) 一个地点的主要公司。
C) 同一行业的所有公司。
D) 公司员工队伍的各个方面。
【答案】A （细节题）Emails in the normal format.
【定位】In the baseline condition, participants saw emails in the normal format, with no information on diversity; in the diversity condition, participants saw a diversity score for each listing.
在基线组，参与者看到的是普通格式的邮件，不含任何多样性信息；在多样性组，参与者则看到每条招聘的多样性评分。
【信号】限定词 baseline condition 直接领出答案。录音用 In the baseline condition, participants saw emails in the normal format 直接点名基线组及其所见，与题干限定词完全对上，是顺听即可锁定的答案句；分号后是另一组，须切开别混。
【替换】participants saw emails in the normal format ↔Emails in the normal format.
近乎原句的概括

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音末尾提到 others in the same sector and location，B 项 Major companies in one location. 盗用了 location 这个原词，但录音从未说基线组看到『同一地点的大公司』，是借词造出的无中生有内容。
借用原文：others in the same sector and location
C)
原词陷阱
录音里 others in the same sector and location 出现过 same sector，C 项 All companies in the same sector. 直接搬来这个短语，但它说的是比较的参照系，不是基线组所见，听到 same sector 就选会中招。
借用原文：compared to others in the same sector and location
D)
张冠李戴
Various aspects of a company's workforce. 描述的是多样性组看到的 information about the race, gender, education, and language skills of a company's workforce，录音明确说基线组 with no information on diversity，D 把另一组的内容安到基线组头上。
借用原文：information about the race, gender, education, and language skills of a company's workforce

stem: What does the passage say participants seem to be paying attention to?

options.text: Job security.
Potential pay raises.
Minimum base salary.
Information about diversity.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say participants seem to be paying attention to?
【翻译】文章说参与者似乎在关注什么?
A) 工作保障。
B) 潜在的加薪。
C) 最低基本工资。
D) 关于多样性的信息。
【答案】D （细节题）Information about diversity.
【定位】Participants seemed to be paying attention to information about diversity, and using this when deciding whether to click on the listing.
参与者似乎在关注多样性方面的信息，并在决定是否点击招聘时用上了这些信息。
【信号】that is 收束句点明关注对象。这句由 that is 引出对前文的小结，并直接用 paying attention to information about diversity 说出参与者关注的对象，与题干表态短语完全对应，是篇章的结论落点。
【替换】paying attention to information about diversity ↔Information about diversity.
提取宾语成名词短语

【排除】A)
未提及
A 项 Job security. 在录音里从未出现，整篇只谈多样性信息与薪资，没有任何关于工作稳定性的内容，属凭印象添加的未提及项。
B)
过度推断
录音多次提到 lower salaries，B 项 Potential pay raises. 借薪资话题推出『可能的加薪』，但录音只说参与者愿接受低薪、并未说他们关注加薪，是顺着薪资词过度推断。
借用原文：listings with lower salaries
C)
原词陷阱
C 项 Minimum base salary. 借用了录音反复出现的薪资话题，但录音从未提『最低底薪』这一概念，更没说参与者关注它，是用薪资原词拼出的偷换项。
借用原文：listings with lower salaries
1 A new study from Oregon State University found that dogs tend to match their behavior with the children in their family. The findings are important because there is a growing body of evidence that dogs can help children in many ways. These include helping with social development, increasing physical activity, managing anxiety or serving as a source of attachment in the face of changing family structures.
俄勒冈州立大学的一项新研究发现，狗往往会使自己的行为与家庭中的儿童相匹配。这些发现很重要，因为越来越多的证据表明狗可以在许多方面帮助儿童。这些方面包括帮助社交发展、增加身体活动、管理焦虑或在家庭结构变化时充当依恋来源。
2 Yet, very little research has focused on how dogs perceive and socially engage with children. "The great news is that this study suggests dogs are paying a lot of attention to the kids that they live with," said Monique Udell, the lead author of the study. "One interesting thing we have observed is that dogs are matching children's behavior, but less frequently than what we have seen between dogs and adults. This suggests that while dogs may view children as social companions, there are also some differences that we need to understand better."
然而，很少有研究关注狗如何感知儿童并与儿童进行社交互动。该研究的主要作者Monique Udell说："好消息是，这项研究表明狗非常关注与它们一起生活的孩子。我们观察到的一个有趣现象是，狗会匹配儿童的行为，但频率低于我们在狗和成人之间观察到的情况。这表明虽然狗可能将儿童视为社交伙伴，但也存在一些我们需要更好理解的差异。"
3 While research has found dogs can have a lot of positive impacts on a child's life, there are also risks associated with the dog-child relationship. For example, other studies have found dogs are more likely to bite children versus adults. "We still have a lot to learn about the dog-child relationship," Udell said. "But research does show that kids are very capable of training dogs."
虽然研究发现狗可以对儿童的生活产生许多积极影响，但狗与儿童的关系也存在风险。例如，其他研究发现狗咬儿童的可能性高于咬成人。Udell说："关于狗与儿童的关系，我们还有很多需要了解的。但研究确实表明，孩子们非常有能力训练狗。"

stem: What does the passage say about the findings of a new study from Oregon State University?

options.text: Positive.
Original.
Important.
Surprising.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say about the findings of a new study from Oregon State University?
【翻译】文章对俄勒冈州立大学一项新研究的发现有何评价?
A) 积极的
B) 原创的
C) 重要的
D) 令人惊讶的
【答案】C （细节题）Important.
【定位】The findings are important because there is a growing body of evidence that dogs can help children in many ways.
这些发现很重要，因为越来越多的证据表明狗能在许多方面帮助孩子。
【信号】对 findings 的直接定性。录音紧跟着研究结果给出定性 The findings are important，主语正是题干问的 findings，是一句直接的"X 是怎样的"判断句，这种直接定性句就是评价类细节题的答案落点。
【替换】The findings are important ↔Important.
原词直接对应
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音第三段确实出现 positive impacts，但那是形容狗对孩子生活的影响，不是形容这项研究的 findings，把 Positive. 安到 findings 上属答非所问。
借用原文：dogs can have a lot of positive impacts on a child's life
B)
未提及
Original. 表示"首创、原创的"，录音通篇没有对 findings 作此评价，属于无中生有。
D)
未提及
Surprising. 是"出人意料的"，录音只说 findings 重要，没有任何"惊讶/意外"的措辞，属无中生有。

stem: What does a growing body of evidence show according to the passage?

options.text: Dogs match their behavior with kids as much as with adults.
Kids and adults alike find in dogs a source of attachment.
Kids' attitude to dogs is influenced by adults.
Dogs can help kids in many ways.

explanation:
【题目】What does a growing body of evidence show according to the passage?
【翻译】根据文章,越来越多的证据表明了什么?
A) 狗对儿童的行为表现与对成年人的一样多
B) 儿童和成年人都在狗身上找到了依恋的来源
C) 儿童对狗的态度受到成年人的影响
D) 狗可以在许多方面帮助儿童

【答案】D （细节题）Dogs can help kids in many ways.
【定位】there is a growing body of evidence that dogs can help children in many ways.
越来越多的证据表明狗能在许多方面帮助孩子。
【信号】evidence that 引出结论。录音 a growing body of evidence that dogs can help children in many ways 中的 that 直接引出证据的内容，这种"evidence that + 句子"结构里 that 后面就是答案落点。
【替换】dogs can help children in many ways ↔Dogs can help kids in many ways.
children 与 kids 同义替换
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Dogs match their behavior with kids as much as with adults. 借用了录音里match...behavior 的说法，但本题问的是 evidence 表明什么（帮孩子），而且原文后文恰恰说狗匹配孩子行为"少于"成人，并非 as much as，与原文相反。
借用原文：dogs are matching children's behavior, but less frequently than what we have seen between dogs and adults
B)
原词陷阱
Kids and adults alike find in dogs a source of attachment. 套用了录音里 source of attachment 一词，但原文是说狗"作为依恋来源"帮助孩子，并没有说"孩子和成人都把狗当依恋来源"，多加了 adults，属偷换概念。
借用原文：serving as a source of attachment in the face of changing family structures
C)
未提及
Kids' attitude to dogs is influenced by adults. 谈的是"成人影响孩子对狗的态度"，录音通篇没有这层意思，属无中生有。

stem: What did Monique Udell say their study suggests?

options.text: Dogs pay much attention to the kids they live with.
Dogs view both adults and kids as social companions.
Kids differ from adults in their behavior towards dogs.
Kids need to be aware of the risks in playing with dogs.

explanation:
【题目】What did Monique Udell say their study suggests?
【翻译】Monique Udell说他们的研究表明了什么?
A) 狗对与它们一起生活的儿童十分关注
B) 狗将成年人和儿童都视为社交伙伴
C) 儿童对狗的行为不同于成年人
D) 儿童需要意识到与狗玩耍的风险
【答案】A （细节题）Dogs pay much attention to the kids they live with.
【定位】This suggests that while dogs may view children as social companions, there are also some differences that we need to understand better.
这表明，尽管狗可能把孩子视为社交伙伴，但也存在一些我们需要进一步了解的差异。

stem: What does the author want to emphasise in the first paragraph?

options.text: The year 2020 was a big turning point in human history.
Economic growth benefits people little in the long run.
It is unwise to weaken the human connection to nature.
It is harmful to mankind to use human-made materials.

explanation:
【答案】C （主旨题）
【判型】What does the author want to emphasise in the first paragraph? 问的是首段作者想强调什么，是段落主旨而非局部细节。
【拆句】What does the author want to emphasise in the first paragraph? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，want to emphasise 是一个简单的动词短语，无从句无否定，结构清爽，无陷阱。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
The year 2020 was a big turning point in human history. 把段落里一个支撑论据（2020 年的 tipping point）当作主旨，且"in human history"是过度推断——原文只说人造物质量超过生命这一比较点。
B)
偷换概念
Economic growth benefits people little in the long run. 把原文"对经济或许有利"扭曲成"经济增长对人没好处"，攻击点从"与自然的连接"偷换到了"经济增长本身"，并把短期权衡偷换为 in the long run。
C)
✓ 正确
The weakening of the human connection to nature might be good for economic growth but is bad for people. ↔It is unwise to weaken the human connection to nature.
Continuing to grow concrete forests rather than real ones is shortsighted. ↔ It is unwise to weaken the human connection to nature.
预判要的是"削弱与自然的连接是不明智的"，It is unwise to weaken the human connection to nature. 正好是这一判断的同义表达，且覆盖整段而不偏向某个论据。
D)
过度推断
It is harmful to mankind to use human-made materials. 把"人造物总质量超过生命"这一比较事实，推断成"使用人造物本身就有害"，原文从未否定使用人造物，只是反对以此取代真实自然。

C)
无中生有
It is especially appealing to the taste of teenagers. 全句"对青少年口味格外有吸引力"在 P2 中没有任何对应；原文只是提到青少年将能参加自然史考试，并未谈流行文化对青少年的吸引力。
D)
与原文相反
It is still impacted by the hit songs of the 1950s. 说流行文化仍受 50 年代流行歌曲影响，但原文用 50 年代和 50 年后的数据对比，恰恰说明这种影响在减弱、自然主题在流失，方向相反。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页

stem: What does the author propose people do?

options.text: Take measures to ensure sustainable food development.
Reconnect with nature through the right to grow.
Stand by the parliament in fighting social diseases.
Cover public spaces with fruit trees and vegetable plants.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does the author propose people do? 问作者具体提议人们做什么，定位到对应主张句即可作答，属于细节题。
【拆句】What does the author propose people do? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，propose 后接"people do"是"propose sb do sth"句型省略了 that 与情态的简略问法，相当于问"作者建议人们做什么"，无陷阱。
【定位】Part of remedying this social disease would be for parliament to pass a "right to grow" law, allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces into vegetable and fruit gardens. The idea is for people to get back in touch with the soil—while producing food sustainably.
矫正这一社会病的一部分举措，是让议会通过一项"种植权"法案，允许任何人把利用不足的公共空间改造成菜园和果园。其理念在于让人们重新接触土壤——同时可持续地生产粮食。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
Take measures to ensure sustainable food development. 把原文末尾"while producing food sustainably"这一附带的从属信息抬升成了核心主张，掩盖了"重新接触土壤、与自然重连"这一真正的主诉。
B)
✓ 正确
Part of remedying this social disease would be for parliament to pass a "right to grow" law ↔ Reconnect with nature through the right to grow.
The idea is for people to get back in touch with the soil ↔ Reconnect with nature through the right to grow.
预判要的两层信息——"通过种植权"和"重新接触自然"——B 项用 through 和reconnect with nature 一并覆盖，所以是答案。
C)
偷换概念
Stand by the parliament in fighting social diseases. 把"议会通过法案"偷换成"人们站在议会一边"，方向完全反过来——原文是作者建议议会行动，不是建议民众站队议会。
D)
过度推断
Cover public spaces with fruit trees and vegetable plants. 把原文"allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces"的"利用不足的公共空间"扩展到"所有公共空间"，并把"允许"扭曲为"全面覆盖"，方式与范围都被放大。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the passage about vegetable planting?

options.text: It all started in 1649 in Southern England.
It is protected by US government regulations.
It has long been used to increase food supply and improve urban landscape.
It has been popularised worldwide with the increasing influence of social media.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn from the passage about vegetable planting? 问从文章中获取的事实信息，属于细节题。
【拆句】What do we learn from the passage about vegetable planting? 主干 What do we learn，from the passage 与 about vegetable planting 都是介词短语作状语，前者点出来源、后者点出话题对象，结构清晰。
【定位】In April 1649, locals responded to high prices and food shortages by cultivating vegetables on common land in Southern England. The practice of throwing seed bombs to turn vacant plots of land green took off in 1970s New York, and has been revived by green-thumbed social media influencers who defy local US regulations in a war on ugly spots in cities.
1649 年 4 月，英国南部居民为应对高物价与粮食短缺，在公共土地上种植蔬菜。把种子炸弹扔到空地以使其变绿的做法在 1970 年代的纽约兴起，并被有园艺天分的社交媒体网红重新带火，他们无视当地美国法规，向城市里的丑陋角落"开战"。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
It all started in 1649 in Southern England. 把段内一个时间点放大为"全部起源"，原文只说 1649 年发生过一次，并未说蔬菜种植起源于此。
B)
与原文相反
It is protected by US government regulations. 与原文 defy local US regulations 直接相反：原文说网红"无视"美国当地法规，选项说"受其保护"。
C)
✓ 正确
locals responded to high prices and food shortages by cultivating vegetables on common land in Southern England ↔It has long been used to increase food supply and improve urban landscape.
throwing seed bombs to turn vacant plots of land green ↔ It has long been used to increase food supply and improve urban landscape.
Vegetable planting has a respectable tradition. ↔ It has long been used to increase food supply and improve urban landscape.
预判要的"补食物 + 美化城市"两条线，C 项用 food supply 与 urban landscape 并列，正好两条都覆盖，所以是答案。
D)
过度推断
It has been popularised worldwide with the increasing influence of social media.把原文里"1970 年代纽约 + 美国网红重新带火"扩张为"全球普及"，并把"重振"延伸为"日益增长的影响力"，超出原文范围。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What can publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens do apart from their practical functions?

options.text: Raise people's environmental awareness.
Add to the great variety of plant species.
Act as the first defence against natural disasters.
Enhance people's community spirit.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What can publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens do apart from their practical functions? 问的是除实用功能之外这些菜园还能做什么，是对应原文并列项的细节题。
【拆句】What can publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens do apart from their practical functions? 主干 What can ... gardens do，apart from their practical functions 作状语限定范围，相当于把"实用功能"这一已知项排除出去；其中 publicly accessible 是副词修饰形容词，整体修饰 gardens。
【定位】They can make unlovely spaces lovely, and marry use and beauty as well as help promote a sense of community.
它们能化丑为美，把实用与美感融合在一起，并有助于增强一种社区感。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
Raise people's environmental awareness. 把"连接食物与产地、对抗物种丧失"偷换成"提升环保意识"，前者是行为层面的连接和效用，后者是心理认知层面的意识。
B)
无中生有
Add to the great variety of plant species. 说菜园会增加植物物种多样性，原文从未谈"增加植物物种多样性"这一功能。
C)
偷换概念
Act as the first defence against natural disasters. 把 first defence against species loss and climate change 偷换成"对抗自然灾害"——物种丧失和气候变化不等于"自然灾害"，并且选项主语 act as 暗示把整个菜园当成防线，与原文 Plants are 也对不上。
D)
✓ 正确
help promote a sense of community ↔Enhance people's community spirit.
预判要的"增强社区感"在原文里有直接对应的 "help promote a sense of community"，D 项把 promote 替换为 enhance、sense of community 替换为community spirit，是高保真同义替换，可锁定。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第1篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say about the engineering profession in the United States?

options.text: It has seen a change in attitude towards women engineers since 1979.
It witnessed a significant increase in women engineers in the 1970s.
It has experienced the gradual weakening of male dominance.
It boasted the largest number of engineering majors in 2000.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What does the passage say about the engineering profession in the United States 没有 infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨标志，问 "the passage say"，是对原文已陈述事实的核对，属四级最高频的细节题。
【拆句】题干主干是 What does the passage say about ...，是 say about 后接宾语的特殊疑问句，结构平铺直叙、无陷阱，只要知道 say about="就……说了什么"即可。
【定位】In 1970, the percentage of women majoring in engineering was less than 1%. In 1979, that number was 9%. Many hoped women would continue to enter the field at the same rate. But that's not what happened.
1970 年，主修工程的女性占比不到 1%；1979 年这一数字升至 9%。许多人本希望女性能以同样速度持续进入这一行业，但事实并非如此。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文只给比例数据，没有提任何"对待女工程师态度的变化"，a change in attitude towards women engineers since 1979 属于凭空添加新概念。
B)
✓ 正确
In 1970, the percentage of women majoring in engineering was less than 1%. In 1979, that number was 9% ↔It witnessed a significant increase in women engineers in the 1970s
In 1970 和 In 1979 ↔in the 1970s
预判要的是"70 年代女工程师比例大幅上升"，B 项 significant increase in women engineers in the 1970s 几乎逐词对应，无需犹豫即可锁定。
C)
与原文相反
Today, only 21% of engineering majors are women, a number largely unchanged since 2000 明确说自 2000 年起男性主导未弱化，与 gradual weakening of male dominance 直接相反。
D)
偷换概念
原文 2000 年只是"21% 未变"的起算点，并未说 2000 年工程专业人数达到最大，boasted the largest number of engineering majors in 2000 属于把时间词原样搬，结论却换了内容。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does one survey taker say was her greatest challenge?

options.text: Not to feel superior to less qualified male engineers.
Not to take seriously all the messages she was getting.
Not to think highly of her qualifications when promoted or given a pay raise.
Not to lose self-confidence though constantly discouraged or unfairly treated.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does one survey taker say was her greatest challenge 是对原文一句引语的客观还原，属细节题。
【拆句】What does one survey taker say was her greatest challenge 是个嵌套问句，say 后面接的是 "(that) her greatest challenge was ____"，疑问词 What 提到了句首，回原文找"挑战是 ____" 这层语义即可。
【定位】The greatest challenge for me was continuing to believe in myself, when all the messages I was getting were that I would never be taken seriously or promoted or given raises at the same rate as men, who were clearly less qualified and not as smart as I was.
我最大的挑战是在收到"我永远不会像男性那样被认真对待、被晋升或被加薪——而那些男性明显不如我合格、不如我聪明"这类信息时，仍然继续相信自己。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文受访者只是说"那些男性明显不如我合格"，是事实陈述；Not to feel superior to less qualified male engineers 把它扭曲成"不要觉得自己高人一等"，方向截然不同。
B)
答非所问
原文 all the messages I was getting 是"挑战的背景"，不是"挑战本身"；B 项却把"不要把这些信息当真"说成挑战，错把背景当主体。
C)
与原文相反
原文说"她被晋升/加薪的待遇不如男性"，C 项却说"在被晋升/加薪时不要看高自己的资历"，既颠倒了情境（她没有被同等晋升），也错读了态度。
D)
✓ 正确
continuing to believe in myself ↔Not to lose self-confidence
all the messages I was getting were that I would never be taken seriously or promoted or given raises at the same rate as men ↔though constantly discouraged or unfairly treated
预判要"在打压中坚持自信"，D 项 Not to lose self-confidence though constantly discouraged or unfairly treated 两个要素全有，是定位句的精准同义替换。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: How do women engineers frequently feel according to the two civil engineers?

options.text: Disqualified on many levels.
Excluded from the group.
Overworked by their organizations.
Looked down upon by male colleagues.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】How do women engineers frequently feel according to the two civil engineers 问的是"她们感觉如何"，依据 according to 直接锁定原文两位 civil engineer 的话，是细节归纳题。
【拆句】How do women engineers frequently feel according to the two civil engineers 主干是 How do women engineers feel，frequently 是状语，according to ... 是介词短语作状语，限定信息来源，没有从句也无否定，是直白的特殊疑问句。
【定位】A civil engineer said, "We are 'women engineers.' People don't refer to a man as a 'man engineer'—he's an engineer. We are constantly reminded that we don't truly belong." Another civil engineer stated, "On many levels, you're never quite one of the groups."
一位土木工程师说："我们被叫作'女工程师'。人们不会把男人叫'男工程师'——他就是工程师。我们时刻被提醒：我们并不真正属于这里。"另一位土木工程师说："在很多层面上，你从来不算这个圈子的一员。"
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文 On many levels, you're never quite one of the groups 中的 on many levels 修饰"在多个层面上"不属于群体，A 项 Disqualified on many levels 把它说成"在多个层面上不合格"，是把"不属于群体"换成"不合格"。
B)
✓ 正确
We are constantly reminded that we don't truly belong ↔Excluded from the group
you're never quite one of the groups ↔Excluded from the group
预判要"不属于/被排除的情绪"，B 项 Excluded from the group 直接对应两位受访者的核心情感，是最稳的同义替换。
C)
张冠李戴
P6 全段谈的是"不属于群体"的归属感问题，根本未涉及工作量；Overworked by their organizations 是从 work twice as hard 借来的概念，硬塞进了 53 题。
D)
过度推断
原文两位土木工程师讲的是"被整个圈子提醒不属于"，并未具体说"是男同事看低自己"；Looked down upon by male colleagues 把抽象的群体压缩成"男同事"这一具体施动者。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What probably makes young women engineers more accepted nowadays?

options.text: Their success in gaining an equal footing.
Their ability to balance work and family.
The change in their responsibilities.
The increase in their number.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What probably makes young women engineers more accepted nowadays 看似含probably 像推断，实质问"原文里给出的原因是什么"，原文已经直说理由，仍是细节题。
【拆句】What probably makes young women engineers more accepted nowadays 是 What makes sb. + 形容词 的使役结构，What 作主语，makes 是谓语，young women engineers 是宾语，more accepted nowadays 是宾语补足语，意为"是什么让年轻女工程师如今更被接受"。
【定位】Young women engineers are more accepted mostly because there are just more of them.
年轻女工程师之所以如今更被接受，主要是因为她们的人数变多了。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
原文 Young women engineers are on an equal footing until they have children 只说"育前与男性平起平坐"，是过去就存在的状态，不是"如今更被接受"的新原因；A 项Their success in gaining an equal footing 把它包装成新成就，归错原因。
B)
与原文相反
原文 then they struggle to balance work and family 明明说"在生育后她们挣扎于平衡工作与家庭"，B 项却说"她们有能力平衡工作与家庭"，方向完全相反。
C)
无中生有
原文 compete with men who don't have the same household responsibilities 提到"家庭责任不对等"，但从未说女工程师的责任发生了变化；C 项 The change in their responsibilities 是凭空增添一个变化。
D)
✓ 正确
there are just more of them ↔The increase in their number
预判要"人数变多"，D 项 The increase in their number 是这层意思的最贴近名词化表达，无可争议。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What can we conclude about many female engineers from the statement of a mechanical engineer?

options.text: They take great pride in their chosen career.
They have reaped the benefits of being flexible.
They enjoy doing engineering to the best degree.
They have proved capable of doing almost anything.

explanation:
【答案】A （推断题）
【判型】What can we conclude about many female engineers from the statement of a mechanical engineer 中的 conclude+from 是典型推断题信号，需要从一位受访者的具体话语得出"许多女工程师"层面的结论。
【拆句】What can we conclude about many female engineers from the statement of a mechanical engineer 主干为 What can we conclude，about many female engineers是 conclude 的对象，from the statement of a mechanical engineer 是信息来源；问的是"从这位机械工程师的话里能得出关于许多女工程师的什么结论"。
【定位】Many women engineers hailed the benefits of their chosen career. A program manager in manufacturing stated that engineering is the best degree. A mechanical engineer said, "It will give you the flexibility to do almost anything. It is also satisfying to see the effects of what you have done."
许多女工程师都盛赞自己所选职业的好处。一位制造业项目经理说工程是最好的学位。一位机械工程师说："它会给你几乎可以做任何事的灵活度，看到自己所做工作的成果也令人满足。"
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
Many women engineers hailed the benefits of their chosen career ↔ They take great pride in their chosen career
It is also satisfying to see the effects of what you have done ↔ take great pride in their chosen career
预判要"对职业感到自豪"，A 项 take great pride in their chosen career 在态度极性和概括层级上都对得最准，是最贴预判的一项。
B)
偷换概念
原文 give you the flexibility to do almost anything 是说"这份职业能给你灵活度"，强调的是职业本身的属性；B 项 reaped the benefits of being flexible 把它说成"她们因"自己"灵活而获益"，把工具属性挪到了人本身。
C)
无中生有
原文 engineering is the best degree 是"工程是最好的学位"，整体作主系表；C 项enjoy doing engineering to the best degree 把 the best degree 拆成 to the best degree（=最大程度地）作状语，意思变成"以最高程度享受做工程"，是字面拼凑出的伪意思。
D)
过度推断
原文 give you the flexibility to do almost anything 是工程这个职业"能让你"做几乎任何事，是潜在可能；D 项 proved capable of doing almost anything 说她们"已经证明自己能做几乎任何事"，把可能性升级为既定事实。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第1套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: Why are families across the U.S. looking to this winter with fear?

options.text: They will see a 27% higher price to buy natural gas.
They will have insufficient heating oil to keep warm.
They will have a costly bill to pay to heat their homes.
They will experience the coldest winter in four decades.

explanation:
【题目】Why are families across the U.S. looking to this winter with fear?
【翻译】为什么全美各地的家庭对今冬感到恐惧?
A) 他们购买天然气的价格将上涨27%。
B) 他们将没有足够的取暖用油来保暖。
C) 他们将支付高昂的账单来为家里供暖。
D) 他们将经历四十年来最冷的冬天。
【答案】C （细节题）They will have a costly bill to pay to heat their homes.
【定位】U.S. families are looking to the winter with fear as energy costs soar. The Energy Department projects heating bills will jump 28% this winter for those who rely on natural gas.
随着能源成本飙升，美国家庭对这个冬天满怀恐惧。能源部预计，对那些依赖天然气的家庭来说，今冬取暖账单将上涨 28%。
【信号】as 引出发愁的直接原因。原文 looking to the winter with fear as energy costs soar 中的 as 直接把‘发愁’与‘能源成本飙升’扣在一起，as 后面就是答案信号——发愁的原因是费用涨，后文 heating bills will jump 28% 进一步坐实是‘取暖账单暴涨’。
【替换】heating bills will jump 28% ↔a costly bill to pay to heat their homes
‘账单涨28%’概括为‘贵账单’
energy costs soar ↔costly
soar 对应 costly

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
原文确实念了 27%，但 Heating oil is projected to be 27% higher 说的是‘取暖用油’涨27%；选项 a 27% higher price to buy natural gas 把 27% 安到了天然气头上（天然气其实是涨 28%），数字盗用且对错对象。
借用原文：Heating oil is projected to be 27% higher
B)
过度推断
原文有 supplies have been reduced（供应减少）和大量 heating oil 字样，选项insufficient heating oil to keep warm 借这些词造出‘油不够保暖’的说法，但原文讲的是‘费用贵’，从未说会‘缺油到取不了暖’。
借用原文：supplies have been reduced
D)
原词陷阱
原文 four decades 出现在 consumer prices growing 6.6%. That's the fastest pace in four decades，说的是‘物价涨速四十年最快’；选项 the coldest winter in four decades却把 four decades 挪去形容‘四十年最冷的冬天’，原文根本没谈天气冷暖。
借用原文：That's the fastest pace in four decades
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the federal government do last month?

options.text: Provided additional funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program.
Assured U.S. citizens of an increase in energy supplies by the end of this year.
Predicted a 10% jump in heating bills for most U.S. households this winter.
Decided on this year's energy assistance package of $8 billion in total.

explanation:
【题目】What did the federal government do last month?
【翻译】联邦政府上个月做了什么?
A) 为低收入家庭能源援助计划提供了额外资金。
B) 向美国公民保证今年年底前能源供应将增加。
C) 预测今冬大多数美国家庭的取暖费用将上涨10%。
D) 决定今年总额为80亿美元的能源援助方案。
【答案】A （细节题）
Provided additional funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program.
【定位】Last month, the federal government added $1 billion in funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program, bringing the total to $4.8 billion.
上个月，联邦政府向‘低收入家庭能源援助项目’追加了 10 亿美元资金，使总额达到 48 亿美元。
【信号】Last month 与题干同词定位。原文 Last month, the federal government added \$1 billion in funding 开头的 Last month 与题干 last month 完全对上，紧跟的动词 added就是答案信号——政府上月‘追加了拨款’。

【替换】added \$1 billion in funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program ↔ Provided additional funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program
added funding=provided additional funding
【排除】B)
与原文相反
原文出现过 supplies have been reduced（供应减少），选项 Assured U.S. citizens of an increase in energy supplies 反过来说政府‘保证能源供应会增加’，方向相反，原文也无任何‘保证’动作。
借用原文：supplies have been reduced
C)
原词陷阱
原文 10% 出自 electricity 10% higher（电费涨 10%），且作预测的是能源部不是政府这一动作主体；选项 Predicted a 10% jump in heating bills 把电费的 10% 改成‘取暖账单’、又把‘预测’这一动作安给了政府上月的作为，数字与主体双错。
借用原文：electricity 10% higher
D)
原词陷阱
原文 a reduction from last year's energy assistance package of over \$8 billion 明说80 亿是‘去年’援助方案、且今年比它‘减少’了；选项 Decided on this year's energy assistance package of \$8 billion in total 把去年的 80 亿说成‘今年合计敲定 80 亿’，年份与金额张冠李戴。
借用原文：last year's energy assistance package of over \$8 billion
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the main finding of a new study about many Americans?

options.text: They care less about their diet now than before.
They may lack adequate knowledge of healthy food.
They may hold too optimistic a view about their diet.
They pay insufficient attention to their choice of food.

explanation:
【题目】What is the main finding of a new study about many Americans?
【翻译】一项关于许多美国人的新研究的主要发现是什么?
A) 他们现在对饮食的关注程度不如以前。
B) 他们可能缺乏关于健康食品的充分知识。
C) 他们可能对自己的饮食持过于乐观的看法。
D) 他们对食物选择的关注不足。
【答案】C （主旨题）They may hold too optimistic a view about their diet.
【定位】Many Americans think they make healthy food choices, but they may be viewing their diet too optimistically. That's the main finding of a new study by researchers at the U.S. Department of Agriculture in Stoneville, Mississippi.
很多美国人以为自己在做健康的食物选择，但他们对自己饮食的看法可能太乐观了。这正是美国农业部研究人员一项新研究的主要发现。
【信号】转折but+点题句That's the main finding。答案藏在转折之后：but they may be viewing their diet too optimistically 才是真意，紧接着一句 That's the main finding of a new study 直接盖章这就是"主要发现"，双重信号（but转折 + 点题句）锁定它是答案句。
【替换】viewing their diet too optimistically ↔hold too optimistic a view about their diet
副词转形容词的同义改写
【排除】A)
未提及
care less about their diet now than before 说"现在比从前更不在乎饮食"，录音通篇没有"今昔对比"，更没说他们"不在乎"——恰恰相反，他们"以为"自己吃得健康。属凭空捏造的对比。
B)
偷换概念
lack adequate knowledge of healthy food 把问题归为"缺乏健康饮食知识"，但录音说的是他们"看得太乐观"（认知偏差），不是"不懂"。盗用了 healthy food 这一原词，却把病因悄悄换掉。
借用原文：Many Americans think they make healthy food choices
D)
原词陷阱
pay insufficient attention to their choice of food 说他们"对选食不够上心"，但录音里他们其实很在意、还自认 make healthy food choices，问题是"高估"而非"不上心"。盗用choices 一词来制造"听到 food choices 就想选"的诱惑。
借用原文：make healthy food choices
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Who tended to rate their diet more accurately in the survey?

options.text: Those who finished 24-hour food questionnaires.
Those who fully understood the rating scale.
Those who cared about food quality.
Those who rated their diet as poor.

explanation:
【题目】Who tended to rate their diet more accurately in the survey?
【翻译】在调查中,谁倾向于更准确地评价自己的饮食?
A) 那些完成了24小时食物问卷的人。
B) 那些完全理解评分量表的人。
C) 那些关心食品质量的人。
D) 那些将自己的饮食评为较差的人。
【答案】D （细节题）Those who rated their diet as poor.
【定位】Those who rated their diet as poor tended to be far more accurate. Their rating matched that of the researchers more than nine times out of ten.
那些把自己饮食评为"差"的人，往往要准确得多。他们的评分有十之九以上与研究人员的评定相符。
【信号】题干词more accurate原句复现做信号。题干问 more accurately，录音里 tended to be far more accurate 几乎原样出现，这处与题干高度重合的句子就是答案句；紧跟的 more than nine times out of ten 用数字坐实其"更准"。
【替换】Those who rated their diet as poor ↔Those who rated their diet as poor
主语整句几乎原词搬运
tended to be far more accurate ↔4D
谓语印证人群身份
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Those who finished 24-hour food questionnaires. 搬来录音 completed 24-hour food questionnaires，但那只是"所有参与者都做的一个环节"，录音从没说"填了这问卷的人评得更准"。专骗听到 24-hour 这个醒目数字就选的人。
借用原文：Folks also completed 24-hour food questionnaires
B)
未提及
Those who fully understood the rating scale. 说"完全看懂评分表的人"，录音只让参与者用 excellent, very good, good, fair or poor 评级，从没区分"谁更懂评分表"，更没说这类人更准。属凭空添加。
C)
偷换概念
Those who cared about food quality. 盗用录音 rate the quality of their diet 里的quality 一词，编出"在乎食物质量的人"，但录音问的是评级准不准，与"在不在乎质量"无关，是借原词造的假分类。
借用原文：rate the quality of their diet
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第6页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the report say dozens of Indians did last week?

options.text: They experienced a heartbreaking moment.
They gathered together to rescue an elephant.
They heard a noise from the bottom of a well.
They found an elephant wandering around a well.

explanation:
【题目】What does the report say dozens of Indians did last week?
【翻译】报道称上周有数十名印度人做了什么?
A) 他们经历了一个令人心碎的时刻。
B) 他们聚集在一起营救一头大象。
C) 他们听到井底传来噪音。
D) 他们发现一头大象在井边徘徊。
【答案】B （细节题）They gathered together to rescue an elephant.
【定位】It was a heartwarming moment that dozens of Indian rescuers rallied together to use a crane in order to save an elephant trapped at the bottom of a 20-foot well.
那是一个暖心的时刻：数十名印度营救人员齐心协力，动用一台起重机去解救一头被困在20 英尺深井底部的大象。
【信号】题干原话定位开头句。题干里的 dozens of Indians 直接对应录音首句 dozens of Indian rescuers rallied together，新闻第一题答案多在开头，听到这群人"齐心协力去救大象"就锁定此句。
【替换】dozens of Indian rescuers rallied together ↔They gathered together
rallied=gathered 同义替换
to save an elephant ↔to rescue an elephant
save=rescue 同义替换

【排除】A)
与原文相反
录音首句明明是 a heartwarming moment（暖心时刻），选项却写成 a heartbreaking moment（令人心碎的时刻），盗用了高度相似的 heart- 开头词把情绪极性反了过来，听到 heart 就选会中招。
借用原文：It was a heartwarming moment
C)
张冠李戴
"听到井里有声音"确实在录音里 The army officers heard a noise coming from the well，但那是"军官"听到的，不是这群营救人员做的，选项把军官的动作安到了 dozens of Indians 头上。
借用原文：The army officers heard a noise coming from the well
D)
偷换概念
录音说的是大象自己 wandered out of the jungle and fell into the well，是大象游荡，不是这群印度人"发现一头在井边游荡的大象"，选项盗用 wander 和 well 拼出一个原文没说的动作。
借用原文：The elephant wandered out of the jungle and fell into the well
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why did the army officers call the local forest department?

options.text: To borrow their crane.
To ask them for help.
To report the strange noise.
To get food for the elephant.

explanation:
【题目】Why did the army officers call the local forest department?
【翻译】军官们为什么给当地林业部门打电话?
A) 借用他们的起重机。
B) 向他们寻求帮助。
C) 报告奇怪的噪音。
D) 为大象获取食物。
【答案】B （目的题）To ask them for help.
【定位】The officers then threw in some food for the creature and called the local forest department for help.
随后军官们往井里扔了些食物给这头大象，并打电话向当地林业部门求助。
【信号】for help 点出目的。答案信号是表目的的 called the local forest department for help 里的 for help——"call ... for help"直接说明打电话就是"为了求助"，这是目的题的落点。
【替换】called the local forest department for help ↔To ask them for help
for help=ask for help 同义

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
crane（起重机）确实在录音里出现过 use a crane，但那是后来营救时用的工具，录音从没说打电话是"为了借起重机"，选项盗用 crane 这个原词制造"听到了就想选"的诱惑。
借用原文：to use a crane
C)
答非所问
"井里传来奇怪声音"在录音里是军官自己 heard a noise coming from the well，他们打电话是去求助、不是"去报告这个声音"，选项把"听到声音"硬说成打电话的目的。
借用原文：The army officers heard a noise coming from the well
D)
原词陷阱
"给大象弄吃的"沾着录音里 threw in some food for the creature，但扔食物是军官自己做的另一件事，不是打电话的目的，选项盗用 food 这个原词来误导。
借用原文：threw in some food for the creature
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the news report say happened finally?

options.text: The elephant was able to return to the jungle.
The army officers were examined for injuries.
The army officers were rewarded for their rescue efforts.
The elephant was given medical treatment for many days.

explanation:
【题目】What does the news report say happened finally?
【翻译】新闻报道称最终发生了什么?
A) 大象能够返回丛林。
B) 军官们接受了伤情检查。
C) 军官们因救援努力获得了奖励。
D) 大象接受了多日的医疗治疗。
【答案】A （细节题）The elephant was able to return to the jungle.
【定位】The elephant was kept under close supervision for a few days before it was successfully released back into the wild.
这头大象被严密看护了几天，之后才被成功放归野外。
【信号】尾句 released 收束结局。答案信号是录音最后一句的 successfully released back into the wild——"成功放归野外"是整件事的收尾结局，新闻末题答案就在此。
【替换】released back into the wild ↔return to the jungle
the wild=the jungle 同义

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】B)
张冠李戴
"检查伤情"在录音里有 for evaluation of any injuries，但被检查的是大象，不是"军官"，选项把检查对象从大象偷换成 army officers，听到 injuries 就选会错。
借用原文：taken to an examining room for evaluation of any injuries
C)
未提及
录音通篇没有说军官因营救"受到奖励"，reward 是凭空添加的情节，属于原文根本没提到的内容。
D)
偷换概念
录音说的是 kept under close supervision for a few days（看护了几天），选项却写成given medical treatment for many days，把"几天看护"夸成"很多天的治疗"，且最终结局是"放归"而非"治疗"，盗用 days 偷改了时长与重点。
借用原文：kept under close supervision for a few days
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why has the man stopped paying online for the last three months?

options.text: He found it had caused him much inconvenience.
It led him to spend more money than necessary.
It was much less secure than paying with cash.
He wanted to be less dependent on his phone.

explanation:
【题目】Why has the man stopped paying online for the last three months?
【翻译】为什么这位男士在过去三个月里停止了网上支付?
A) 他发现这给他造成了很多不便。
B) 这导致他花费了超出必要的钱。
C) 这比用现金支付安全性差得多。
D) 他想减少对手机的依赖。
【答案】B （细节题）It led him to spend more money than necessary.
【定位】No, they are safe. But paying online is too convenient and I spent too much money on things I didn't need.
不，线上付款是安全的。但线上付款太方便了，我在不需要的东西上花了太多钱。
【信号】转折 But 之后才是真因。男方先用 No, they are safe. 否掉"不安全"的猜测，再用 But 引出真正理由 I spent too much money on things I didn't need——转折后那半句才是答案句。

【替换】I spent too much money on things I didn't need ↔ It led him to spend more money than necessary.
"不需要的东西上多花钱"="花了多于必要的钱"
【排除】A)
与原文相反
录音说线上付款 too convenient（太方便了），选项却说 caused him much inconvenience（带来很多不便）——A 盗了 convenient 这个原词却反着说，方向正相反。
借用原文：paying online is too convenient
C)
与原文相反
选项 much less secure（不太安全）盗用了"安全"这一话题，但录音明确说 they are safe ——他恰恰否认了安全顾虑，C 取的是被否定的方向。
借用原文：No, they are safe
D)
未提及
less dependent on his phone（少依赖手机）听着合理，但录音通篇只说花钱失控，没有一句提到"想摆脱对手机的依赖"，属凭常识硬补。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What problem does the woman say she may also have?

options.text: Living beyond her means.
Lack of budgeting strategies.
Fashion addiction.
Impulse purchasing.

explanation:
【题目】What problem does the woman say she may also have?
【翻译】这位女士说她可能也有什么问题?
A) 入不敷出。
B) 缺乏预算策略。
C) 时尚成瘾。
D) 冲动购物。
【答案】D （细节题）Impulse purchasing.
【定位】Oh, impulse purchases can be an issue for me, too. I've definitely bought clothes and shoes I didn't need because they were on sale.
哦，冲动购物对我来说也是个问题。我确实买过自己并不需要的衣服和鞋子，就因为它们在打折。
【信号】for me, too 的自我承认。女方用 can be an issue for me, too（对我来说也是个问题）直接认账，too 是"我也有"的信号，紧接着的 impulse purchases 就是她自陈的毛病。
【替换】impulse purchases can be an issue for me, too ↔Impulse purchasing.
purchases=purchasing，几乎原义对应

【排除】A)
过度推断
Living beyond her means（花超过收入）听着像"花太多"，但女方只承认冲动购物，没说自己入不敷出，是程度上的过度引申。
B)
未提及
Lack of budgeting strategies（缺预算策略）原文无对应；女方反而说自己有 review my spending every night 的办法，谈不上缺策略。
C)
原词陷阱
录音里她提到 bought clothes and shoes，选项 Fashion addiction（迷恋时尚成瘾）借这两个词把"偶尔冲动买"夸成"成瘾"，听到 clothes/shoes 就选会中招。
借用原文：bought clothes and shoes I didn't need
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say he could do at the canteen?

options.text: Eat healthier food with less money.
Order food like burgers and chips.
Avoid getting addicted to junk food
Pay either in cash or with his phone.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say he could do at the canteen?
【翻译】这位男士说他在食堂可以做什么?
A) 用更少的钱吃更健康的食物。
B) 点汉堡和薯条之类的食物。
C) 避免对垃圾食品上瘾。
D) 用现金或手机支付。
【答案】A （细节题）Eat healthier food with less money.
【定位】I'd use my phone to order food, like burgers and other junk, instead of going to the canteen, where I could get a healthier meal for half the price.
我会用手机点外卖，比如汉堡之类的垃圾食品，而不是去食堂——在食堂我能用一半的价钱吃到更健康的一餐。
【信号】canteen 后的 where 从句给好处。答案就在 going to the canteen, where I could get a healthier meal for half the price——canteen 后面的 where 从句直接说出在食堂能得到什么，是答案句的落点。
【替换】a healthier meal for half the price ↔Eat healthier food with less money.
half the price=less money，meal=food

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
Order food like burgers and chips 直接盗用录音的 burgers，但那是他用手机点的外卖、是 instead of（而不是）去食堂的反面行为，根本不是"在食堂能做的"。
借用原文：order food, like burgers and other junk
C)
过度推断
录音有 other junk（垃圾食品），选项 Avoid getting addicted to junk food 借 junk 编出"避免吃上瘾"，但原文只说食堂更健康便宜，没提"上瘾"或"避免上瘾"。
借用原文：burgers and other junk
D)
原词陷阱
Pay either in cash or with his phone 把前文的"现金/手机付款"搬来，但题问的是"在食堂能做什么"，付款方式与此无关，是套用别处原词的干扰。
借用原文：use my phone to order food
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is now just a habit for the man?

options.text: Making a shopping list.
Sticking to his budget.
Withdrawing cash only once a month.
Thinking twice before buying something.

explanation:
【题目】What is now just a habit for the man?
【翻译】现在对这位男士来说什么只是一种习惯?
A) 列购物清单。
B) 坚持他的预算。
C) 每月只取一次现金。
D) 买东西前三思而后行。
【答案】B （细节题）Sticking to his budget.
【定位】After that I refused to spend more than what I had budgeted, and by now it's just a habit.
在那之后我就拒绝花超过我预算的钱，到现在这已经成了一种习惯。
【信号】by now it's just a habit 收尾点题。by now it's just a habit 是收束信号，紧贴它前面的refused to spend more than what I had budgeted 就是"成了习惯"的那件事——答案在习惯标志词紧邻的前半句。
【替换】refused to spend more than what I had budgeted ↔Sticking to his budget.
"不超预算花钱"="守住预算"

【排除】A)
未提及
Making a shopping list 是常见省钱招，但录音通篇没提"列清单"，是凭常识补的干扰。
C)
与原文相反
Withdrawing cash only once a month 借用前文取现的场景，但录音说他 go to the bank once a week（每周一次）而非 once a month，频次被偷改，且这不是收尾点出的"习惯"。
借用原文：I go to the bank once a week
D)
答非所问
Thinking twice before buying something 与"控制冲动"沾边，但男方收尾点出的习惯明确是"不超预算"，没有说"买前三思"成了习惯，方向虽近却非他的原话。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第14页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why is the woman opposed to their son joining a sport like soccer?

options.text: He does not enjoy any ball games.
He has to prepare for the future.
He has breathing problems.
He is not up to anything challenging.

explanation:
【题目】Why is the woman opposed to their son joining a sport like soccer?
【翻译】为什么这位女士反对他们的儿子参加像足球这样的运动?
A) 他不喜欢任何球类运动。
B) 他必须为未来做准备。
C) 他有呼吸问题。
D) 他无法胜任任何有挑战性的事情。
【答案】C （细节题）He has breathing problems.
【定位】W: Um, I don't think he should be doing something so challenging with all his breathing issues.
女：嗯，我觉得他不该去做这么有挑战性的运动，他还有那一身呼吸方面的毛病呢。
【信号】反对句后跟出理由。女方先表态 I don't think he should be doing something so challenging（反对做高强度运动），紧接着用 with 引出真正的缘由 with all his breathing issues——"反对+because式补充"就是答案信号，落点在 with 之后的原因。
【替换】breathing issues ↔breathing problems
issues=problems 同义换词

【排除】A)
未提及
He does not enjoy any ball games. 说他"不喜欢任何球类"，可女方通篇都在给儿子挑球类（羽毛球、排球），根本没说他不喜欢球，属凭空捏造。
B)
原词陷阱
He has to prepare for the future. 里的"为将来做准备"确实在录音里出现过，但那是男方even if it might prepare him for the future 说的、且是他要否定的东西，不是女方反对足球的理由——典型的"听到原词就想选"。
借用原文：even if it might prepare him for the future
D)
偷换概念
He is not up to anything challenging.（应付不了有挑战的事）借用了原文 something so challenging 里的 challenging，听着很顺，但女方反对的根子是"呼吸问题"，"高强度"只是结果、不是原因——把原因偷换成了表象。
借用原文：something so challenging
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man suggest their son try in order to understand team spirit?

options.text: Soccer.
Badminton.
Volleyball.
Basketball.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man suggest their son try in order to understand team spirit?
【翻译】这位男士建议他们的儿子尝试什么来理解团队精神?
A) 足球。
B) 羽毛球。
C) 排球。
D) 篮球。
【答案】D （细节题）Basketball.
【定位】M: He could try basketball since many of the courts are indoors now and it's a sport that could help him understand team spirit while cooperating with others.
男：他可以试试篮球，现在很多球场都在室内了，而且这是一项能帮他在与人协作中理解团队精神的运动。
【信号】建议词+目的吻合。男方用建议句 He could try basketball，并紧接着点出目的 could help him understand team spirit，与题干"in order to understand team spirit"严丝合缝——"建议句 + 目的状语命中题干限定"就是答案信号。
【替换】He could try basketball ↔Basketball.
运动名原词对应
understand team spirit ↔Basketball.
目的对上题干限定

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
Soccer. 确实被念到，但那是男方开头 like soccer 提的、并非"为理解团队精神"而提，不满足题干限定，听到 soccer 就选会落坑。
借用原文：like soccer
B)
张冠李戴
Badminton. 是女方 like badminton 建议的室内运动，既不是男方提的、也与团队精神无关，张冠李戴又跑题。
借用原文：like badminton
C)
原词陷阱
Volleyball. 是女方在第4段 what about volleyball 才提的，且理由是社交和奖学金，不是男方、也不是为团队精神，纯属原词诱选。
借用原文：what about volleyball
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第17页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is one of the woman's considerations in choosing a sport for her son?

options.text: The possibilities of joining the school sports team.
The opportunities of winning some championships.
The chances of getting an athletic scholarship later on.
The odds of becoming a professional sportsman someday.

explanation:
【题目】What is one of the woman's considerations in choosing a sport for her son?
【翻译】这位女士为儿子选择运动时的考虑因素之一是什么?
A) 加入学校运动队的可能性。
B) 赢得一些冠军的机会。
C) 日后获得体育奖学金的机会。
D) 有朝一日成为职业运动员的可能性。
【答案】C （细节题）The chances of getting an athletic scholarship later on.
【定位】W: It's not as popular as some sports, which means he has better odds of possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future.
女：它不像有些运动那么热门，这意味着他将来更有机会拿到体育奖学金。
【信号】which means引出考量。女方在介绍排球时用 which means he has better odds of possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future 道出她看重的好处——"which means + 具体好处"就是她考量的落点，正是答案信号。
【替换】getting an athletic scholarship in the future ↔getting an athletic scholarship later on
in the future=later on
better odds of possibly getting ↔The chances of getting
odds=chances 同义

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
The possibilities of joining the school sports team. 对应的"加入校队"是男方在第3段join the school basketball team 提的，且针对篮球，不是女方选排球的考量，说话人和项目都错。
借用原文：join the school basketball team
B)
张冠李戴
The opportunities of winning some championships. 里的"赢冠军"出自男方第3段winning a game or even a championship，是他讲团队运动好处时说的，与女方无关。
借用原文：winning a game or even a championship
D)
过度推断
The odds of becoming a professional sportsman someday. 盗用了女方原句里的odds，又把"拿奖学金"夸大成"当职业运动员"，原文根本没说要走职业道路，是顺着 odds往前多推了一步。
借用原文：better odds of possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第18页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say about beach volleyball?

options.text: It differs entirely from indoor volleyball.
It appeals to both schoolgirls and schoolboys.
It is less popular than indoor sports in the country.
It is completely different from other outdoor games.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say about beach volleyball?
【翻译】这位男士关于沙滩排球说了什么?
A) 它与室内排球完全不同。
B) 它对女学生和男学生都有吸引力。
C) 它在这个国家不如室内运动受欢迎。
D) 它与其他户外运动完全不同。
【答案】A （细节题）It differs entirely from indoor volleyball.
【定位】M: As I've said many times before, beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different.
男：我之前说过很多次了，沙滩排球和室内排球是完全不一样的。
【信号】强调句直接表态。男方用 As I've said many times before（我说过很多遍了）加重语气，再直给观点 beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different——这种"强调铺垫+直接表态"就是答案句，落点清清楚楚。
【替换】beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different ↔ It differs entirely from indoor volleyball.
completely different=differs entirely

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】B)
张冠李戴
It appeals to both schoolgirls and schoolboys. 对应的"男女都参与"是女方第4段 he could socialize with both girls and boys 说普通排球时讲的，既不是男方、也不是评沙滩排球。
借用原文：he could socialize with both girls and boys
C)
张冠李戴
It is less popular than indoor sports in the country. 化用了女方 not as popular as some sports，但那是女方评普通排球、且对比对象是"some sports"而非"室内运动"，说话人和内容都对不上。
借用原文：not as popular as some sports
D)
偷换概念
It is completely different from other outdoor games. 几乎照搬男方的 completely different 句式，唯独把比较对象从"indoor volleyball（室内排球）"偷换成"other outdoor games（其他户外运动）"——男方比的是室内外排球，不是和别的户外项目比。
借用原文：beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第19页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the passage about the lift-off of spacecraft?

options.text: It usually requires years of preparations.
It does a lot of harm to the environment.
It often burns over three hundred tonnes of refined fuel.
It proves to be the most complicated stage of space missions.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the passage about the lift-off of spacecraft?
【翻译】从文章中我们了解到关于航天器升空的什么信息？
A) 它通常需要数年的准备。
B) 它对环境造成很大危害。
C) 它通常燃烧超过三百吨精炼燃料。
D) 它被证明是太空任务中最复杂的阶段。
【答案】B （细节题）It does a lot of harm to the environment.
【定位】Lift-off is usually the most environmentally harmful stage of any space mission, with vast quantities of fuel burnt up in a matter of minutes.
发射升空通常是任何太空任务中对环境危害最大的阶段，几分钟内就有大量燃料被烧掉。
【信号】篇章首句即点题。这是第一段的开篇第一句，篇章独白常把核心论断放在段首；句中 the most environmentally harmful stage"对环境危害最大的阶段"是一个带最高级的明确论断，正是答案句信号。
【替换】the most environmentally harmful stage ↔does a lot of harm to the environment
最高级换成动词短语

【排除】A)
It usually requires years of preparations. 说发射"通常需要数年准备"，原文通篇没提准备时长，是凭"航天听起来很复杂"的常识臆造出来的。
C)
It often burns over three hundred tonnes of refined fuel. 看似与原文 112 tonnes of refined fuel 对得上，但原文说的 112 吨是"精炼燃料"，336 吨是排放的 CO₂；选项把over three hundred tonnes 安到了 refined fuel 头上，张冠李戴地偷换了数字。听到three hundred 就选，正中陷阱。
借用原文：Falcon 9 gets through 112 tonnes of refined fuel, emitting about 336 tonnes of CO₂
D)
It proves to be the most complicated stage of space missions. 盗用了原文的最高级框架 the most environmentally harmful stage，但把 harmful（有害）偷换成complicated（复杂）。原文讲的是"危害最大"不是"最复杂"，听到 the most…stage 就选，会被这个偷换骗到。
借用原文：the most environmentally harmful stage of any space mission
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What happens traditionally to boosters, fuel tanks and other components in spaceflight?

options.text: They are burnt up in outer space.
They are guided back to Earth.
They are reused up to 100 times.
They are treated as expendable.

explanation:
【题目】What happens traditionally to boosters, fuel tanks and other components in spaceflight?
【翻译】在太空飞行中，助推器、燃料箱和其他部件传统上会怎样处理？
A) 它们在外太空被烧毁。
B) 它们被引导返回地球。
C) 它们被重复使用多达100次。
D) 它们被视为一次性消耗品。
【答案】D （细节题）They are treated as expendable.
【定位】Traditionally, boosters, fuel tanks and other components are treated as expendable.
传统上，助推器、燃料箱和其他部件都被当作用完即弃的消耗品。
【信号】限定词traditionally领出答案。句子以 Traditionally 开头，与题干里的 traditionally 完全对应；这种"题干限定词在原文里原样出现"的句子就是答案句。注意紧随其后的 But guiding them back to Earth 是转折后的新做法，问"传统"时不能抓那一句。
【替换】treated as expendable ↔They are treated as expendable.
近乎原句照搬

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
They are burnt up in outer space. 说部件"在外太空被烧毁"。原文第一段确有 fuel burnt up"燃料被烧掉"，但那是讲燃料、不是部件，更没说在外太空烧；这项盗用了 burnt up 的印象来骗人。
借用原文：vast quantities of fuel burnt up in a matter of minutes
B)
They are guided back to Earth. 对应原文 But guiding them back to Earth，但这是 But转折之后讲的"新可能"，是与"传统"相对的现在做法；题干问的是 traditionally，选 B 等于把转折后的新情况当成了传统做法。
借用原文：But guiding them back to Earth in a controlled manner
C)
原词陷阱
They are reused up to 100 times. 直接搬了原文 can be reused up to 100 times，原词、数字都对，极具迷惑性；但那同样是 But 转折之后的新做法，不是 traditionally 的传统处理。听到 100 times 就选，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：most components from the Falcon 9 can be reused up to 100 times
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say we already have regarding spaceflight?

options.text: New technologies for bringing back space vehicles for recycling.
The technology for meeting the needs of commercial space travel.
Many of the technologies to limit the impact of space travel on Earth.
The technology for effectively protecting ozone from being destroyed.

explanation:
【题目】What does the passage say we already have regarding spaceflight?
【翻译】文章说我们在太空飞行方面已经拥有什么？
A) 将太空飞行器带回以供回收利用的新技术。
B) 满足商业太空旅行需求的技术。
C) 限制太空旅行对地球影响的许多技术。
D) 有效保护臭氧层免遭破坏的技术。
【答案】C （细节题）Many of the technologies to limit the impact of space travel on Earth.
【定位】But we already have many of the technologies needed to start limiting its impact on our planet.
但我们已经拥有许多项所需的技术，可以开始限制太空旅行对地球的影响。
【信号】尾段转折收束句。这是全文最后一段的收尾句，以 But we already have 起头：前一句说"真正环保的太空旅行还很遥远"，But 一转给出积极结论，转折之后才是文章真正落点，正是答案句。
【替换】many of the technologies needed to start limiting its impact on our planet ↔ Many of the technologies to limit the impact of space travel on Earth.
保留核心仅压缩表述

【排除】A)
New technologies for bringing back space vehicles for recycling. 借用了第三段"回收复用"的印象（guiding them back to Earth、reused），但原文尾句说的是"已经拥有的many of the technologies"，不是 new technologies；且"带回回收"只是文中一个细节，拿它冒充全文结论，以偏概全。
借用原文：guiding them back to Earth in a controlled manner
B)
原词陷阱
The technology for meeting the needs of commercial space travel. 盗用了原文commercial spaceflight"商业航天"这个词，但原文提它是说"商业航天兴起让问题更紧迫"，并非说"我们已有满足商业航天需求的技术"；这项把原词搬过来却换了说法，答非所问。
借用原文：These issues are growing more pressing with the emergence of commercial spaceflight.
D)
过度推断
The technology for effectively protecting ozone from being destroyed. 盗用了原文emit particles that destroy ozone 里的 ozone"臭氧"，但原文只是说火箭排放粒子"会破坏臭氧"，根本没说我们"已有有效保护臭氧的技术"；这项把一个细节问题夸大成现成的单项技术，无中生有。
借用原文：rocket engines emit particles that destroy ozone
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第23页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does research show about reading to a loyal and nonjudgmental companion?

options.text: It can help unskilled readers feel more secure.
It can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud.
It can strengthen children's confidence in others.
It can boost children's interest in communication.

explanation:
【题目】What does research show about reading to a loyal and nonjudgmental companion?
【翻译】研究表明,向一个忠诚且不评判的伙伴阅读会产生什么效果?
A) 它可以帮助阅读能力不足的读者感到更安心。
B) 它可以鼓励不愿意阅读的读者大声朗读。
C) 它可以增强儿童对他人的信心。
D) 它可以提高儿童对交流的兴趣。
【答案】B （细节题）It can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud.
【定位】Research shows that reading to a loyal and nonjudgmental companion, such as a dog or cat, can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud, which will in turn boost their self-confidence.
研究表明，读给一个忠诚且不加评判的伙伴（比如一只狗或猫）听，能鼓励那些不情愿读书的孩子大声朗读，这反过来又会增强他们的自信。
【信号】题干原词复现处即答案句。录音里 Research shows that reading to a loyal and nonjudgmental companion 与题干用词几乎一字不差，题干问的对象在录音里原样出现，这句就是答案句；紧跟其后的 can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud 正是"研究表明的结果"。
【替换】can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud ↔ It can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud.
近乎原句搬运

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 项 help unskilled readers feel more secure 里的 secure 来自录音后一句 help children feel secure，但那句讲的是"有个伙伴倾诉感受"带来的安全感，不是"读给宠物听"的研究结果；而且录音说的是 reluctant readers（不情愿的读者），A 偷换成 unskilled readers（不熟练的读者）。
借用原文：can also help children feel secure and develop communication skills
C)
偷换概念
C 项 strengthen children's confidence in others 借用了录音的 confidence，但录音说的是 boost their self-confidence（自信，对自己的信心），C 偷偷改成"对他人的信心（confidence in others）"，方向反了。
借用原文：which will in turn boost their self-confidence
D)
原词陷阱
D 项 boost children's interest in communication 的 communication 来自录音末句develop communication skills，但那是"有人倾诉感受"的好处，不是"读给宠物听"的研究结果；而且录音说的是"发展沟通技能"，不是"提升沟通兴趣"。

stem: How can parents make pets a fantastic subject for their children's research and learning?

options.text: By motivating children to find out about their favourite pets.
By taking children to the library to borrow books on animals.
By allowing children to surf the internet about pets by themselves.
By showing children how to acquire knowledge about healthy pets.

explanation:
【题目】How can parents make pets a fantastic subject for their children's research and learning?
【翻译】家长如何使宠物成为孩子研究和学习的绝佳对象?
A) 通过激励孩子去了解他们喜爱的宠物。
B) 通过带孩子去图书馆借阅有关动物的书籍。
C) 通过允许孩子自己上网查询有关宠物的信息。
D) 通过向孩子展示如何获取有关健康宠物的知识。
【答案】A （细节题）By motivating children to find out about their favourite pets.
【定位】Parents can encourage their child to research their favourite pets at the library or during a supervised internet search.
父母可以鼓励孩子在图书馆或在有人监督的网络搜索中，去研究他们最喜欢的宠物。
【信号】题干research落点处即答案句。题干问"research and learning"，录音第 3 段开头点题Pets also provide a fantastic subject for research and learning，紧接着 Parents can encourage their child to research their favourite pets 就是父母做法的答案句，subject for research 与题干完全对应。

【替换】encourage their child to research their favourite pets ↔ motivating children to find out about their favourite pets
同义词替换encourage=motivate、research=find out
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 项 taking children to the library to borrow books on animals 盗用了录音的 library，但录音说的是 research their favourite pets at the library（在图书馆研究宠物），是"去图书馆查"，并非"带孩子去借书（borrow books）"，borrow books on animals 是录音没说的。
借用原文：to research their favourite pets at the library
C)
与原文相反
C 项 allowing children to surf the internet about pets by themselves 借用了录音的internet，但录音原文是 a supervised internet search（有人监督的网络搜索），C 把它改成"让孩子自己（by themselves）上网"，恰恰与"有人监督"相反。
借用原文：during a supervised internet search
D)
偷换概念
D 项 showing children how to acquire knowledge about healthy pets 把录音里 their favourite pets（最喜欢的宠物）偷换成 healthy pets（健康的宠物）；healthy 这个词出自录音别处 keeping their pet happy and healthy，被挪到这里制造干扰，且"研究主题"是 favourite pets 而非 healthy pets。
借用原文：to research their favourite pets

stem: How can children still benefit even when their family doesn't have a pet?

options.text: By learning that raising pets can do much good.
By watching how healthy pets are brought up.
By hearing about their peers' passion for pets.
By visiting friends who have household pets.

explanation:
【题目】How can children still benefit even when their family doesn't have a pet?
【翻译】即使家里没有宠物,孩子如何仍能从中受益?
A) 通过了解饲养宠物可以带来很多好处。
B) 通过观察健康的宠物是如何被养育的。
C) 通过听说同龄人对宠物的热情。
D) 通过拜访有家养宠物的朋友。
【答案】D （细节题）By visiting friends who have household pets.
【定位】And of course, if a child doesn't have a pet in their own household, they can still benefit from all of the above when visiting a friend who does.
当然，如果一个孩子自己家里没有宠物，他们在拜访一位养宠物的朋友时，仍然能从上述所有方面获益。
【信号】if加still的让步收尾句。录音末段用 if a child doesn't have a pet in their own household, they can still benefit 这个"假设没有宠物 + still 仍能受益"的让步结构收尾，正好对应题干的 even when…doesn't have a pet，是典型的答案信号句。

【替换】when visiting a friend who does ↔By visiting friends who have household pets
代动词does=have a pet展开
【排除】A)
答非所问
A 项 learning that raising pets can do much good 把录音的 benefit 含义改头换面，说成"懂得养宠物有好处"，但题干问的是"没养宠物时怎样仍能受益"，答案是"去拜访朋友"这个动作，A 只是泛泛重复"养宠物有益"的大主旨，答非所问。
借用原文：a child can benefit greatly from involvement in bringing up a happy and healthy pet
B)
原词陷阱
B 项 watching how healthy pets are brought up 借了录音多处出现的 healthy pet / bringing up，但录音从没说"观看（watching）宠物怎么养大"，这个动作是凭原词拼造出来的，并非没宠物时的受益途径。
借用原文：bringing up a happy and healthy pet
C)
未提及
C 项 hearing about their peers' passion for pets 里的 passion 来自录音第 3 段 their passion for learning flourishes，但那讲的是"孩子对学习的热情"，录音通篇没说"听同龄人（peers）讲他们对宠物的热情"，这个途径属于无中生有。
借用原文：as their passion for learning flourishes

stem: What would the new bill in the Ohio legislature require public colleges and universities to do?

options.text: Send would-be students a packet of information.
Update regularly all information on their websites.
Inform prospective students of their yearly enrollment.
Answer questions raised by applicants and their parents.

explanation:
【题目】What would the new bill in the Ohio legislature require public colleges and universities to do?
【翻译】俄亥俄州立法机构的新法案将要求公立学院和大学做什么?
A) 向准学生发送一份信息资料包。
B) 定期更新其网站上的所有信息。
C) 告知未来学生其年度招生人数。
D) 回答申请者及其家长提出的问题。
【答案】A （细节题）Send would-be students a packet of information.
【定位】A new bill in the Ohio legislature would require state public colleges and universities to send prospective students a packet of information.
俄亥俄州议会的一项新法案将要求州立公立高校向准学生寄送一个信息包。
【信号】信号是首句直陈"require…to send"。答案句是第一段开门见山的一句 A new bill in the Ohio legislature would require state public colleges and universities to send prospective students a packet of information，require…to send 直接给出 "要求做的动作"，篇章独白常在首句点题，这句即落点。
【替换】send prospective students a packet of information ↔ Send would-be students a packet of information.
prospective=would-be，几乎同义改写

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
Update regularly all information on their websites. 借了原文末段确有的 provide similar information on their websites 里 websites、information 的影子，但法案要求的是 "寄信息包"，不是 "定期更新网站"，听到 website 就选会中招。
借用原文：provide similar information on their websites
C)
未提及
Inform prospective students of their yearly enrollment. 借用了 prospective students这个原词，但信息包里列的是 costs of college, grants and scholarships 等，根本没有"年度招生人数（yearly enrollment）"，属凭空添加的内容。
D)
未提及
Answer questions raised by applicants and their parents. 听起来合理，但录音从头到尾说的是学校 "主动寄信息包"，没有 "回答申请者和家长提问" 这一动作，是想当然的添加。

stem: What can the state only do according to Adam Mathews?

options.text: Oversee private institutions directly.
Follow other states' example.
Supervise all schools consistently.
Regulate public institutions by law.

explanation:
【题目】What can the state only do according to Adam Mathews?
【翻译】根据Adam Mathews的说法,州政府只能做什么?
A) 直接监管私立院校。
B) 效仿其他州的做法。
C) 一致地监督所有学校。
D) 依法监管公立院校。
【答案】D （细节题）Regulate public institutions by law.
【定位】He notes that the state can only regulate public institutions in this way, but he hopes private institutions in Ohio follow the lead of the state and post similar information.
他指出，州只能以这种方式监管公立院校，但他希望俄亥俄的私立院校效仿州的做法、也发布类似信息。
【信号】信号是带only的限定句+but转折。答案句 the state can only regulate public institutions in this way 自带 only 限定，正面回答 "只能做什么"；其后 but he hopes private institutions…follow 用 but 把私立摘出去，反衬出 "只能管公立"，这种 only + but 的结构就是答案信号。
【替换】the state can only regulate public institutions in this way ↔Regulate public institutions by law.
"by a new bill"概括为"by law"

【排除】A)
与原文相反
Oversee private institutions directly. 抓的是 but 后面 private institutions in Ohio 这个词，但原文是 "只能管公立、私立只是希望它效仿"，把 "管公立" 偷换成 "直接管私立"，方向正好反。
借用原文：but he hopes private institutions in Ohio follow the lead
B)
张冠李戴
Follow other states' example. 里 follow…lead 听着像原文 follow the lead of the state，但原文是 "私立效仿本州"，不是 "本州效仿别的州"，且主语张冠李戴。
借用原文：private institutions in Ohio follow the lead of the state
C)
偷换概念
Supervise all schools consistently. 用 all schools 把范围扩到所有学校，但答案句明确can only regulate public institutions，only 把范围卡死在公立，all 与 only 直接矛盾。
借用原文：the state can only regulate public institutions

stem: What do we learn about Ohio's schools from the passage?

options.text: They are resourceful.
They are competitive.
They provide the best opportunity to realize one's dream.
They appeal most to students from other states in the U.S.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about Ohio's schools from the passage?
【翻译】从文章中我们对俄亥俄州的学校了解到什么?
A) 它们富有资源。
B) 它们竞争激烈。
C) 它们提供实现梦想的最佳机会。
D) 它们对来自美国其他州的学生最具吸引力。
【答案】B （细节题）They are competitive.
【定位】Ohio's schools are already competitive. The state attracts more undergraduate students than it sends to colleges out of state.
俄亥俄的学校已经很有竞争力了。该州吸引来的本科生比它送往外州读大学的还要多。
【信号】信号是直陈定性句"are already competitive"。答案句 Ohio's schools are already competitive 是直接给学校下定义的一句，主系表把 competitive 这个定性词摆在明处；后一句 attracts more undergraduate students than it sends 用数据印证它，这种 "先下结论再举证" 的结构里，结论句即落点。
【替换】Ohio's schools are already competitive ↔They are competitive.
competitive原词对应，仅换主语为They

【排除】A)
未提及
They are resourceful. 的 resourceful（资源丰富）听着像也是夸学校的好词，但录音夸学校用的是 competitive，并没说 resourceful，是凭空换了个褒义词。
C)
原词陷阱
They provide the best opportunity to realize one's dream. 整句几乎照搬第二段 give them the best opportunity to match their skills and their dreams，但原文那是议员说"把信息摆给学生能给他们最好的机会"，主语是 "提供信息"，不是说学校本身就是 "实现梦想的最佳机会"，且本题问的是 "了解到学校什么"。
借用原文：give them the best opportunity to match their skills and their dreams
D)
偷换概念
They appeal most to students from other states in the U.S. 借了第三段 attracts more undergraduate students than it sends to colleges out of state，但原文说的是 "吸引来的本科生比送出去的多"，并非 "对外州学生最有吸引力"，appeal most 是夸大且改了意思。
借用原文：attracts more undergraduate students than it sends to colleges out of state

stem: What is the problem with schools providing information on their websites?

options.text: Some students waste much time surfing the net.
Students may need to visit too many websites.
Students have to search for the information.
Some students may lack adequate access.

explanation:
【题目】What is the problem with schools providing information on their websites?
【翻译】学校在其网站上提供信息存在什么问题?
A) 一些学生在网上浏览浪费大量时间。
B) 学生可能需要访问过多网站。
C) 学生必须搜索相关信息。
D) 一些学生可能缺乏足够的访问途径。
【答案】C （细节题）Students have to search for the information.
【定位】Many colleges and universities currently provide similar information on their websites. This includes tuition, fees, graduation rates and more. But students need to search for the information.
许多高校目前已在网站上提供类似信息，包括学费、各项收费、毕业率等等。但学生得自己去搜索这些信息。
【信号】信号是But转折后的短板句。前面 Many colleges and universities currently provide similar information on their websites 在夸网站信息已经很全，But students need to search for the information 用 But 一转点出 "得自己找" 的短板——But 后面这句才是 "问题" 所在，正是答案句。
【替换】students need to search for the information ↔Students have to search for the information.
need to=have to，近乎原句

【排除】A)
未提及
Some students waste much time surfing the net. 借了 "网络" 的话题氛围，但原文只说学生 "得自己搜"，没说 "浪费很多时间上网"，waste much time 是凭空添加的。
B)
原词陷阱
Students may need to visit too many websites. 抓住原文 on their websites 的websites 一词，把 "得自己搜信息" 夸张成 "得访问太多网站"，原文从没说网站 too many。
借用原文：provide similar information on their websites
D)
未提及
Some students may lack adequate access. 说学生 "缺少足够渠道"，但原文的问题是 "信息在网上、得自己去搜"，并不是 "上不了网/没渠道"，access 这层意思原文没有。

【答案】L) revealed
动词
【词性槽】主语 New research 后缺谓语，需要单数动词
【依据】research revealed that... 是科研报道高频搭配
句子是典型的"新研究揭示……"句式，New research from biologists at the University of Maryland __(26)__ that sight deprivation also changes the way brain cells __(27)__ with one another，research revealed/showed that 是四级和考研阅读里科普类语料最常见的引出研究结论的搭配。
【竞争词】H) prescribes 义为"开处方/规定"，与"研究揭示"不沾边
prescribe 多用于医生开药或权威机构"规定"，与 research 做主语完全不搭，且其内容 that 从句是研究结论，不是规定。
K) reinforces 义为"加强"，需要被加强的对象，与本句"首次揭示"不符
reinforce 是"加强、强化已有事物"，常见结构 reinforces the idea/finding/argument that...；本句是直接给出"新研究"的发现，并非在加强某个先前结论，更适合放在第 28 空。
O) speculate 原形动词，主谓不一致；且语气是"推测"不是"揭示"
speculate 是原形，主语 New research 为三单需要 -s 形式，形态先不符；语义上"推测"也弱于"揭示"，与前句已知事实并列叙述的语气不匹配。

stem: What has the author come to realise since entering university?

options.text: He needs a crash course on financial terms.
He is very much lacking in financial literacy.
It requires consistent education to be financially independent.
It is unrealistic to give all Australian youth a financial education.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What has the author come to realise直接问一个具体认知结果，不含infer/imply/mainly about等推断或主旨信号词。
【拆句】What has the author come to realise since entering university?主干是What ... has come to realise，What作realise的宾语；since entering university是时间状语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】As a university student, I've come to realise just how little I know about money.
作为一名大学生，我已经意识到自己对金钱了解得有多么少。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
He needs a crash course on financial terms说作者需要一门速成课，而原文Diving headfirst into the crash course of starting university里的crash course指的是大学开学这件事本身像速成课，不是金融术语速成课。
B)
✓ 正确
just how little I know about money ↔lacking in financial literacy
预判说我钱的知识少，He is very much lacking in financial literacy里的lacking in financial literacy正是这层意思的标准表达。
C)
答非所问
It requires consistent education to be financially independent谈的是要做到financially independent的条件，而题干问的是作者意识到什么，P1里realise的宾语并不是这个条件论。
D)
与原文相反
It is unrealistic to give all Australian youth a financial education说给澳洲青年金融教育不现实，而原文Australia's youth are being done a great disservice by not receiving any consistent financial education恰恰是在痛心他们没有得到金融教育，作者立场是该给而不是不现实。

stem: How did the author feel in today's money world?

Ignorant of financial literature.

explanation:

【判型】How did the author feel直接问感受，是关于感受这个事实的细节题，不含推断信号词。
【拆句】How did the author feel in today's money world?主干How did the author feel，in today's money world是地点/情境状语；结构简单，无陷阱。
【定位】I felt that I was sailing the financial seas with no skills and no life jacket!
我感觉自己正在金融的海洋上航行，却既没有技能也没有救生衣！
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
sailing the financial seas with no skills and no life jacket ↔Badly equipped to survive

B)
偷换概念
Ignorant of financial literature里financial literature是金融文献，而原文谈的是financial literacy/skills，文献和素养是两回事，选项偷换了对象。
C)
程度副词偷换
Barely capable of moving ahead说勉强能前进，原文no skills and no life jacket描绘的是完全无装备的处境，是不能前进而不是勉强能。

答非所问
Overwhelmed by the resources online说被网络资源压垮，而原文hundreds of great resources out there并没有说作者被压垮，反而是肯定资源很多，作者的负面感受来自缺装备不是资源多。

stem: What did the author realise after talking to his friends?

options.text: They were as keen as he was on financial matters.
The schooling system was to blame for his trouble.
High schoolers knew nothing about the modern financial world.
Financial courses were as unpopular as compulsory English classes.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What did the author realise after talking to his friends问的是一个具体认知结果，没有infer/imply等信号词。
【拆句】What did the author realise after talking to his friends?主干What did the author realise，after talking to his friends是时间状语；结构平直，无陷阱。
【定位】However, after talking to my friends who felt the same, I quickly realised that it wasn't my ignorance but the lack of financial education in our schooling system that is leaving high schoolers seriously behind in the modern world of money.
然而，和有同感的朋友们聊过之后，我很快意识到，让高中生在现代金钱世界里严重落后的，不是我的无知，而是我们学校系统里金融教育的缺失。
【选项】A)
过度推断
They were as keen as he was on financial matters说朋友们也对金融问题热心，而原文my friends who felt the same只说朋友们有同感（同样觉得吃力），并没说他们热心研究金融。
B)
✓ 正确
not...but the lack of financial education in our schooling system ↔ The schooling system was to blame for his trouble
预判说学校系统背锅，The schooling system was to blame for his trouble里was to blame正是这层归因意思。
C)
以偏概全
High schoolers knew nothing about the modern financial world说高中生对金融世界一无所知，而原文leaving high schoolers seriously behind说的是严重落后不是一无所知，knew nothing是把落后扩大成零知识。
D)
无中生有
Financial courses were as unpopular as compulsory English classes说金融课和必修英语一样不受欢迎，原文English may not be the most popular subject只是承认英语不算最受欢迎，从未说金融课不受欢迎或两者并列，且这点出现在48题区间之外，纯属无中生有。

stem: What is the author's idea of a financial education course?

options.text: It should foresee students' needs after graduation.
It should provide students with some basic knowledge.
It should be taught the same way as English is taught.
It should be integrated into high school education.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What is the author's idea of a financial education course?问的是作者明确提出的具体主张，原文应有should句直接对应，不需推断。
【拆句】What is the author's idea of a financial education course?主干What is the author's idea，of短语限定idea的对象，结构平直无陷阱。
【定位】It shouldn't be just a one-day event but a course integrated throughout the whole of high school that would allow students to gradually expand their financial literacy, and would prevent the need for a 'catch up' phase once we're out on our own after graduation.
它不该只是一个一日活动，而该是一门贯穿整个高中阶段的课程，让学生逐步拓展自己的金融素养，从而避免我们毕业独立生活后还得补课。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
It should foresee students' needs after graduation说该课该预见学生毕业后的需求，而原文prevent the need for a 'catch up' phase once we're out on our own after graduation说的是避免毕业后补课，不是预见学生需求，foresee needs偷换了prevent the need这层因果。
B)
以偏概全
It should provide students with some basic knowledge说该课只该提供基础知识，而原文gradually expand their financial literacy说的是逐步拓展金融素养，且years to gradually accumulate bits and pieces of knowledge强调长期积累，some basic把整个长期拓展过程缩成基础知识，是范围偷小。
C)
过度推断
It should be taught the same way as English is taught说该课该用和英语一样的教法，而原文Let's compare a theoretical financial education subject to the standard compulsory English class只是拿英语做类比强调持续性，并没有说要在教法上完全一样，taught the same way是把类比推过头。
D)
✓ 正确
a course integrated throughout the whole of high school ↔ It should be integrated into high school education
预判说该课应融入高中始终，It should be integrated into high school education里integrated into high school education正是这层意思的同义表达。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第5页

stem: What would financial literacy do to young people?

options.text: Allow them to enter adulthood with financial security.
Enable them to look after themselves without worrying about money.
Render them confident and secure in terms of money management.
Help them become familiar with the world of money.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What would financial literacy do to young people问的是金融素养对年轻人的具体作用，原文应有直接对应句。
【拆句】What would financial literacy do to young people?主干What would financial literacy do，to young people是间接宾语；结构平直无陷阱。
【定位】Giving young people the opportunity to become familiar with the world of money would provide them with a great advantage to enter adulthood with confidence and security so that they are able to manage their own money and look after themselves.
让年轻人有机会熟悉金钱世界，会让他们带着自信和安全感步入成年，并因此能够自己管理钱财、照顾好自己。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
Allow them to enter adulthood with financial security只保留了security丢掉了confidence，且把confidence and security压缩为financial security一项，原文是双重收益而不是只有金融安全。
B)
过度推断
Enable them to look after themselves without worrying about money里without worrying about money是说不必为钱发愁，而原文able to manage their own money只说能管理钱，不等于不必为钱发愁，without worrying是从能管理钱推过头。
C)
✓ 正确
enter adulthood with confidence and security so that they are able to manage their own money ↔Render them confident and secure in terms of money management
预判说在金钱管理上自信且有安全感，Render them confident and secure in terms of money management里confident and secure in terms of money management正是这层意思最完整的同义替换。
D)
答非所问
Help them become familiar with the world of money说帮他们熟悉金钱世界，而原文Giving young people the opportunity to become familiar with the world of money里熟悉金钱世界是金融素养这件事的前提条件而不是它带来的后果，题干问的是financial literacy带来什么，不是它是什么。

stem: What do people believe chocolates can do?

options.text: Cheer them up instantly.
Create happy calories.
Conceal emotional distress.
Relieve them of heart trouble.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What do people believe chocolates can do? 问的是巧克力能干什么这一具体功能，没有infer/imply/mainly 等信号词。
【拆句】题干主干 What do people believe chocolates can do? 是一个嵌套宾语从句的特殊疑问句：What 是 do 的宾语，people 是主语，believe 后跟省略 that 的宾语从句 chocolates can do (what)。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】We all have faith in chocolates to delight us in an instant!
我们都相信巧克力能在一瞬间让我们开心起来！
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
delight us in an instant ↔Cheer them up instantly
「瞬间让人开心」的预判与 Cheer them up instantly 在语义上完全重合，无差量，直接锁定。
B)
偷换概念识别
Create happy calories 把原文 channelling happy calories inside us 中「输送/导入愉快卡路里」当成「创造卡路里」，把比喻动作偷换成 create。
C)
与原文相反识别
原文是 They comfort us in times of trouble——「安抚」情绪，而 Conceal emotional distress 说「隐藏」情绪，安抚≠隐藏，意思相反。
D)
过度推断识别
原文 calming down a racing heart 是比喻「让狂跳的心平静下来」，而 Relieve them of heart trouble 把 racing heart 强行解为「心脏疾病」并把 calming down 换成relieve…of，属于过度推断。

stem: What was scientists' recent assertion about chocolates?

options.text: They could become a rare treat in the near future.
They could calm people down a bit in times of crisis.
They could prevent people from getting heartbroken.
They could become unavailable in less than 30 years.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What was scientists' recent assertion about chocolates? 问的是科学家断言的具体内容，原文中可定位一句即可作答。
【拆句】题干 What was scientists' recent assertion about chocolates? 是 What…be 句型，主语scientists' recent assertion 由所有格 + 形容词 + 名词构成，about chocolates 是后置介词短语修饰 assertion。结构简单，无陷阱。
【定位】Recently, chocolate lovers were heartbroken as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050!
最近，巧克力爱好者们伤心欲绝，因为科学家声称巧克力到 2050 年可能灭绝！
【选项】A)
过度推断识别
They could become a rare treat in the near future 说巧克力会变成「稀有美食」，但原文是 extinct（灭绝/绝种），不是 rare（稀少），属于程度上的过度推断与偷换。
B)
答非所问识别
They could calm people down a bit in times of crisis 描述的是巧克力的安抚功能，是首段的内容；题干问的是「科学家最近的断言」，不在第一段范围内。
C)
与原文相反识别
They could prevent people from getting heartbroken 利用 chocolate lovers were heartbroken 中的 heartbroken 反向拼凑，把「伤心」错改为「防止伤心」，与原文方向完全相反。
D)
✓ 正确
they can become extinct by 2050 ↔They could become unavailable in less than 30 years
「2050 年前灭绝」的预判与 They could become unavailable in less than 30 years完全重合，时间值与「灭绝/不可得」均对得上。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2024-12/第2套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What would happen if the cacao farms were shifted to cooler mountainous areas?

options.text: The natural habitat of wildlife there would be ruined.
The cacao farmers would have a tough time to adapt.
The rainforests would be shrinking dramatically.
The quality of cocoa beans would suffer greatly.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What would happen if the cacao farms were shifted to cooler mountainous areas?是 if 条件下的客观结果，可直接到原文条件句中找到表述。
【拆句】题干 What would happen if the cacao farms were shifted to cooler mountainous areas? 是 What + 虚拟条件句：主句 what would happen 用 would，从句 were shifted是被动语态，整体表达「假设农场被迁走，会发生什么」。要注意 were shifted 是被动结构，主体是农场而非农民。
【定位】These farms will then have to be shifted to cooler mountainous areas, which are the natural habitat of wildlife.
这些农场届时将不得不被迁到更凉爽的山区，而那里正是野生动物的自然栖息地。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
cooler mountainous areas, which are the natural habitat of wildlife ↔ The natural habitat of wildlife there would be ruined
whether to grow chocolate or save wildlife ↔would be ruined
「侵占并破坏野生动物栖息地」的预判与 The natural habitat of wildlife there would be ruined 完全重合。
B)
无中生有识别
The cacao farmers would have a tough time to adapt 谈的是「农民适应困难」，原文从未提及农民的适应问题，纯属编造。
C)
答非所问识别
The rainforests would be shrinking dramatically 谈的是雨林萎缩，但题干问的是「农场迁到凉爽山区之后」，迁出地（雨林）的变化并不是题干问的「会发生什么」的核心后果，且原文未说雨林会因此显著萎缩。
D)
无中生有识别
The quality of cocoa beans would suffer greatly 说可可豆质量会大幅下降，原文从未谈及「质量」问题，只提到产量（yields）下降；属于无中生有。

无中生有识别
They try to seek help from gene-editing scientists 说农场主动求助科学家，原文第五、六段是科学家自己在研究、不是农场求助，属无中生有。

时态偷换识别
