stem: What did some customers think when they saw the first cat routinely appear in the store?

options.text: It might be a nuisance to the loyal shoppers.
It might have been abandoned by its owner.
It might be 12 months old.
It might have got lost.

explanation:
【题目】What did some customers think when they saw the first cat routinely appear in the store?

【翻译】当一些顾客看到第一只猫经常出现在商店时，他们是怎么想的？
A) 它可能会给忠实顾客带来麻烦。
B) 它可能被主人遗弃了。
C) 它可能有12个月大。
D) 它可能迷路了。
【答案】D （细节题）It might have got lost.
【定位】Local newspapers reported that puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost.
当地报纸报道说，困惑的顾客在脸书群组里发帖，想弄清楚这只猫是不是走丢了。
【信号】顾客行为句直接道出"以为它丢了"。描述顾客当时反应的句子就是答案句：puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost——困惑的顾客发帖打听"猫是不是走丢了"。其中 if the cat was lost 直接点出顾客脑中的念头。听到 puzzled（困惑的）和 lost 就该锁定。
【替换】to try to find out if the cat was lost ↔It might have got lost.
"想弄清是否走丢"="它可能走丢了"
【排除】A)
答非所问
nuisance to the loyal shoppers 借了 loyal/shoppers 的影子，但录音里顾客看到第一只猫时是 puzzled（困惑），去打听它是否走丢，并没有觉得它"惹人嫌"。猫多到要贴告示是后文的事，且也没说它惹忠实顾客嫌，时间和内容都对不上。
借用原文：puzzled customers
B)
偷换概念
abandoned by its owner 与正解贴得最近，都是"它出事了"，但录音里顾客打听的是 if the cat was lost（是否走丢），是"丢"不是"主人不要了"。况且下文 its owner assured the concerned customers it was very much loved 说主人很爱它，根本没被遗弃。错在偷换了"走丢"与"被弃"这两个相近却不同的概念。
借用原文：if the cat was lost
C)
原词陷阱
It might be 12 months old. 抓住录音真念过的 12 个月，但录音 The unusual situation started about 12 months ago 说的是"这桩怪事大约始于 12 个月前"，12 个月是"猫开始来店多久"，根本不是"猫 12 个月大"。听到 12 months 就选 C，是典型的数字原词陷阱。
借用原文：The unusual situation started about 12 months ago
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What are customers asked not to do?

options.text: Feed the cats.
Remove any store signs.
Sit in the shop aisles.
Bring in pets with them.

explanation:
【题目】What are customers asked not to do?
【翻译】顾客被要求不要做什么？
A) 喂猫。
B) 移除任何商店标识。
C) 坐在商店过道里。
D) 随身带宠物进来。

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【答案】A （细节题）Feed the cats.
【定位】They visit the store so much that staff have been forced to put up signs, asking their customers not to feed them.
这些猫太常来店里，以至于店员不得不张贴告示，要求顾客不要喂它们。
【信号】请求句 asking…not to 直接给出禁止内容。答案句末尾的请求结构就是定位信号：asking their customers not to feed them（要求顾客不要喂它们）。听到 not to + 动词，紧跟的 feed 就是被禁止的那件事。这是"听要求句、抓 not to 后面的动作"的标准落点。
【替换】not to feed them ↔Feed the cats.
"不要喂它们"对应被禁动作"喂猫"
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
Remove any store signs. 抓住录音真念过的 signs，可录音 staff have been forced to put up signs 说的是店员"贴"告示，从没要求顾客"撤"告示。听到 signs 就选 B，正中原词陷阱，且把"贴"反成了"撤"。
借用原文：staff have been forced to put up signs
C)
张冠李戴
Sit in the shop aisles. 借了录音原词 aisles，可录音 several cats settling down in the shop aisles 说的是猫在过道里安顿，不是顾客坐过道，更没人要求顾客别坐。听到 aisles就选 C，是原词陷阱加张冠李戴。
借用原文：several cats settling down in the shop aisles
D)
未提及
Bring in pets with them. 蹭了录音里的 pet 一词，但录音里店员唯一对顾客提的要求是not to feed them（别喂猫），从没说过"别带宠物进店"。带宠物进店是凭常识联想出来的，原文并未提及。
借用原文：asking their customers not to feed them
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What has the woman been thinking of doing next semester?

options.text: Sharing her room with friends.
Cutting down her living expenses.
Living off campus.
Moving to the city center.

explanation:
【题目】What has the woman been thinking of doing next semester?
【翻译】这位女士一直在考虑下学期做什么?
A) 与朋友合住一个房间。
B) 削减她的生活开支。
C) 住在校外。
D) 搬到市中心。
【答案】C （细节题）Living off campus.
【定位】W: I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester.
女：我一直在考虑下学期搬到校外去住。
【信号】开场首句直陈打算。信号是女方对话开场第一句的直接陈述 I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester.，与题干 thinking of doing 完全对应——这就是承载答案的那句。
【替换】moving off campus ↔Living off campus
moving=living 同指搬离校园住
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
Sharing her room with friends. 借了后文女方说的 Three of my friends from the dormitory would share the place with me，但那是『四人合租整套房子』，不是『与朋友合住一个房间』，且非她最初的打算，是把后文细节错安到本题。
借用原文：Three of my friends from the dormitory would share the place with me
B)
原词陷阱
Cutting down her living expenses. 盗用了原文反复出现的 the expense 一词，但女方的打算是搬出校外，省钱只是搬出后讨论的一个方面，不是她『在考虑做的事』本身，听到expense 就选会落坑。
借用原文：And then there's the expense, too.
D)
与原文相反
Moving to the city center. 与原文正相反：女方说的是 if we move far enough from the city center（搬到离市中心足够远的地方），选项却说搬向市中心，极性反了。
借用原文：if we move far enough from the city center
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第11页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man suggest the woman take into consideration?

options.text: The facilities available.
Various costs involved.
Changes in living conditions.
The distance to her home.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man suggest the woman take into consideration?

【翻译】这位男士建议这位女士考虑什么?
A) 可用的设施。
B) 涉及的各种费用。
C) 生活条件的变化。
D) 到她家的距离。
【答案】B （细节题）Various costs involved.
【定位】M: Are you sure about that? Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas. Have you factored those in?
男：你确定吗？大城市的房租很高，还有电费和燃气费。这些你都算进去了吗？
【信号】连列费用项+反问提醒。信号是男方一口气列出 Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas 并反问 Have you factored those in?——他反复强调、要女方算进去的正是各项费用，这就是答案句。
【替换】Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas ↔ Various costs involved
罗列各项费用=概括为各种费用
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
The facilities available. 看似贴居住话题，但原文男方提醒的是费用，厨房、卧室等设施是后文女方自己列搬出去的好处 We'd have a kitchen，并非男方让她『考虑』的事，张冠李戴。
借用原文：We'd have a kitchen, so we could cook ourselves.
C)
偷换概念
Changes in living conditions. 借用了贯穿全程的 living 一词，但男方让考虑的是『费用』这一具体方面，不是笼统的『生活条件变化』，把具体范畴偷换成宽泛说法。
借用原文：if we move far enough from the city center, the rent is low enough
D)
原词陷阱
The distance to her home. 盗用了男方开头 so far from home 里的 home 一词，但那是男方表达担忧的话，并非他要女方『纳入考虑』的方面，且真正反复提醒的是费用，听到home 就选会落坑。
借用原文：living all by yourself in an apartment so far from home
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the woman say she did during high school?

options.text: Went through much trouble.
Commuted to save money.
Studied on the bus.
Lived on campus.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say she did during high school?
【翻译】这位女士说她在高中期间做了什么?
A) 经历了很多麻烦。
B) 通勤以省钱。
C) 在公交车上学习。
D) 住在校园里。
【答案】C （细节题）Studied on the bus.

【定位】W: It's about an hour to campus, but there's no reason I can't study on the bus. After all, I did that during high school and my commute was even longer then.
女：到学校大约一小时，但我没理由不能在公交车上学习啊。毕竟我高中时就是这么做的，那时候我通勤路上的时间还更长呢。
【信号】时间词 during high school 处的回指。信号是题干时间词在原文的复现 I did that during high school，而 that 回指紧挨着的 study on the bus——这句就是答案句。
【替换】I did that during high school ↔Studied on the bus
that 回指 study on the bus
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
Went through much trouble. 借了男方的话 go through all that trouble，但那是男方对『搬出去折腾』的评价，不是女方说她高中做过的事，把男方的话安到女方头上。
借用原文：go through all that trouble
B)
原词陷阱
Commuted to save money. 把原文出现的 commute（my commute was even longer）和前文省钱话题拼在一起，但女方说高中时做的是在车上学习，并非『为省钱而通勤』，且省钱是合租话题、不是高中经历。
借用原文：my commute was even longer then
D)
与原文相反
Lived on campus. 借用了贯穿全程的 campus、live 等词，但女方高中时是通勤（commute 路上更长），恰恰说明她当时没住校，选项与原意相反。
借用原文：my commute was even longer then
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第12页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does the man say he'll do at the end of the conversation?

options.text: Discuss the matter with the woman's mother.
Make a decision within a few days.
Try his best to persuade his wife.
Weigh the benefits against the disadvantages.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say he'll do at the end of the conversation?
【翻译】这位男士说他在对话结束时会做什么?
A) 与这位女士的母亲讨论这件事。
B) 在几天内做出决定。
C) 尽力说服他的妻子。
D) 权衡利弊。
【答案】A （细节题）Discuss the matter with the woman's mother.
【定位】M: I'm not convinced that the benefits are greater than the disadvantages, but I'll discuss this with your mother.
男：我还不太相信好处大过坏处，不过我会和你妈妈商量一下这件事。
【信号】转折 but 后的 I'll 表态。信号是结尾男方转折词 but 之后的 I'll discuss this with your mother——but 之后才是他真正要做的事，这就是答案句。

【替换】I'll discuss this with your mother ↔Discuss the matter with the woman's mother
this=the matter、your mother=woman's mother
【排除】B)
未提及
Make a decision within a few days. 里 within a few days 录音从头到尾没出现，是凭『商量后该尽快决定』的常识脑补出来的时限，原文未提。
C)
偷换概念
Try his best to persuade his wife. 把男方要找 mother（即他妻子）这层关系拿来，却说成『努力说服妻子』，可原文是 discuss this with your mother——是平等商量，不是单方说服，把『商量』偷换成『说服』。
借用原文：I'll discuss this with your mother
D)
原词陷阱
Weigh the benefits against the disadvantages. 盗用了同句 the benefits are greater than the disadvantages 的原词，但那是男方表达『还没被说服』的态度（but 之前），不是他说接下来要做的事；他要做的是商量，听到 benefits/disadvantages 就选会落坑。
借用原文：I'm not convinced that the benefits are greater than the disadvantages
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第13页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the woman doing?

options.text: Interviewing the man.
Looking for Lawrence.
Choosing a present for her nephew.
Helping the man with his shopping.

explanation:
【题目】What is the woman doing?
【翻译】这位女士在做什么?
A) 正在面试这位男士。
B) 正在寻找Lawrence。
C) 正在为她的侄子挑选礼物。
D) 正在帮这位男士购物。
【答案】C （细节题）Choosing a present for her nephew.
【定位】W: Good morning. I'm looking for a present for my nephew, Lawrence.
女：早上好。我在给我侄子劳伦斯找一份礼物。

【信号】开场自报来意。女士一开口就用 I'm looking for a present for my nephew 交代了来店目的，这种"开场自述要做什么"的句子就是 What doing 题的答案句。
【替换】looking for a present for my nephew ↔Choosing a present for her nephew
looking for=Choosing 同义改写
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
全程是女士向店员咨询、店员介绍商品，没有任何采访行为；Interviewing the man. 把"咨询"误当"采访"，且弄反了谁主导对话。
B)
原词陷阱
录音确实念到了 Lawrence，但 Lawrence 是要送礼的侄子，女士并不是在"找劳伦斯本人"；Looking for Lawrence. 偷了这个人名来骗"听到就选"。
借用原文：I'm looking for a present for my nephew, Lawrence
D)
与原文相反
是店员（男士）在帮女士选礼物，不是女士帮男士购物；Helping the man with his shopping. 把帮忙的方向反了过来。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第15页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: How does the man describe Bobo Man, the action figure?

options.text: Quite educational.
Incredibly popular.
Driven by batteries.
Obviously childish.

explanation:
【题目】How does the man describe Bobo Man, the action figure?
【翻译】这位男士如何描述Bobo Man这个动作人偶?
A) 相当有教育意义。
B) 非常受欢迎。
C) 由电池驱动。
D) 明显很幼稚。
【答案】B （细节题）Incredibly popular.
【定位】M: For that age group, our biggest seller this year has been this action figure. It's called Bobo Man, and it's incredibly popular.
男：对这个年龄段，我们今年卖得最好的就是这个人偶。它叫 Bobo Man，非常受欢迎。
【信号】店员正面推介的形容。男士介绍这件玩具时直接说 it's incredibly popular，这句正面评价就是"他如何描述它"的答案句。
【替换】it's incredibly popular ↔Incredibly popular.
原句直取，几乎零改写

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
educational 确实在录音出现，但那是女士后来问 something educational、指向拼图，并非男士对 Bobo Man 的描述；Quite educational. 把后文别处的词搬来安到 Bobo Man 头上。
借用原文：Perhaps something educational
C)
与原文相反
batteries 在录音里出现，但男士明确说 It has no batteries——它"没有"电池；Driven by batteries. 取了原词却反了意思。
借用原文：It has no batteries
D)
未提及
录音从未把 Bobo Man 说成幼稚；男士只说它受欢迎、是动画主角。Obviously childish.属于凭印象编的负面评价，原文无据。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第16页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What kind of game does the woman think would be good for Lawrence?

options.text: One he loves for helping exercise his mind.
One he can play together with his sister.
One he finds interesting and challenging.
One he can play either alone or in a group.

explanation:
【题目】What kind of game does the woman think would be good for Lawrence?
【翻译】这位女士认为什么样的游戏适合Lawrence?
A) 一个他喜欢的有助于锻炼思维的游戏。
B) 一个他可以和妹妹一起玩的游戏。
C) 一个他觉得有趣且有挑战性的游戏。
D) 一个他可以单独玩或集体玩的游戏。
【答案】B （细节题）One he can play together with his sister.
【定位】W: I like this sort of idea. Lawrence has a sister who is slightly older, so maybe a game that they can play together would be good.
女：我喜欢这个主意。劳伦斯有个稍大一点的姐姐，所以也许一款他们能一起玩的游戏会不错。
【信号】女士本人 so...would be good 的结论。女士先说有姐姐，再用 so maybe a game that they can play together would be good 给出她看重的条件——"两人一起玩"，这正是think...good 的答案句。
【替换】a game that they can play together ↔One he can play together with his sister
they=他和姐姐，指代还原

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
exercising the mind 出现在录音，但那是男士介绍拼图时说 great for exercising the mind，不是女士看重的理由；题干问的是女士的想法，故 One he loves for helping exercise his mind. 张冠李戴。
借用原文：great for exercising the mind
C)
未提及
女士没有说看重"有趣又有挑战"；challenging 一词录音根本没出现。One he finds interesting and challenging. 是凭印象编的卖点。
D)
张冠李戴
play either alone or in groups 确在录音，但那是男士介绍拼图的卖点 can be played either alone or in groups，不是女士对劳伦斯看重的点；女士看重的是"和姐姐一起"。One he can play either alone or in a group. 把店员的话当成女士的判断。
借用原文：can be played either alone or in groups

source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn from the conversation about the game Battleships?

options.text: It has been enjoyed by kids for decades.
It always reminds people of times of war.
It has been played both indoors and outdoors.
It distinguishes itself as one of the oldest games.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the conversation about the game Battleships?
【翻译】从对话中我们了解到关于Battleships这个游戏的什么信息?
A) 几十年来一直深受孩子们喜爱。
B) 总是让人想起战争时期。
C) 既可以在室内玩也可以在室外玩。
D) 作为最古老的游戏之一而与众不同。
【答案】A （细节题）It has been enjoyed by kids for decades.
【定位】M: Of course you did. Everyone did. And kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young. Some games just never get old.
男：你当然玩过。人人都玩过。而且如今的孩子玩它玩得和当年的你我一样开心。有些游戏就是永不过时。
【信号】多年仍受孩子喜爱的信息点。男士说 kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young，加上前文 It has been around since the 1930s，合起来支持"几十年来一直被孩子喜爱"。
【替换】It has been around since the 1930s ↔It has been enjoyed by kids for decades
since the 1930s=for decades
kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young ↔ It has been enjoyed by kids for decades
孩子持续喜爱=enjoyed by kids

Directions: In this section, you will hear three passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【排除】B)
过度推断
录音只说这游戏经典、不过时，从没说它"让人想起战争"。It always reminds people of times of war. 是看 Battleships（战舰）这名字凭空联想，原文无据，且 always 太绝对。
C)
原词陷阱
女士提到 we had to stay indoors（下雨只能待室内玩），录音只说室内，从没说室外也玩；It has been played both indoors and outdoors. 偷了 indoors 一词，却擅自加上outdoors。
借用原文：we had to stay indoors
D)
过度推断
男士只说它是 a total classic、自 1930 年代就有，并没说它"是最古老的游戏之一"；It distinguishes itself as one of the oldest games. 把"经典"拔高成"最古老之一"，程度过头。
借用原文：It's a total classic

stem: What do we learn from the passage about the paradox of choice?

options.text: A display of a variety of products increases consumers' interest.
Too many choices decrease one's desire to buy.
Fewer choices lead to lower customer satisfaction.
Customers given more choices are more likely to get confused.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn from the passage about the paradox of choice?
【翻译】从文章中我们对选择悖论了解到什么?
A) 多种产品的陈列会增加消费者的兴趣。
B) 过多的选择会降低购买欲望。
C) 较少的选择会导致较低的顾客满意度。
D) 给予顾客更多选择更有可能使其感到困惑。
【答案】B （细节题）Too many choices decrease one's desire to buy.
【定位】But here's the paradox of choice: if a person is presented with too many choices, they are actually less likely to buy.
但这就是“选择悖论”：如果一个人面对太多选择，他实际上反而更不可能购买。
【信号】转折 But 加冒号点题，后半才是真意。前一句 We assume that if we offer our customers more choices, then they'll be more likely to buy 是“我们以为”的错误假设，紧跟 But here's the paradox of choice 用转折加冒号正式抛出概念，转折后的内容才是答案句。
【替换】too many choices ↔Too many choices
原词同形保留
less likely to buy ↔decrease one's desire to buy
“更不可能买”=“降低购买欲”，同义改写

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 说陈列多样“增加兴趣”，借的是后文 created more interest里的 interest，但本题问的是paradox of choice 的核心结论，原文用 But 推翻的正是“选项多就更想买”这种正向假设，A 站在被推翻的一边。
借用原文：created more interest
C)
与原文相反
C 说“更少选择导致更低满意度”，盗用了原文 customer satisfaction 一词，但原文 the bigger display of jams leads to lower customer satisfaction than the smaller display说的是“更多”选择才满意度更低，C 把多少接反了，属与原文相反。
借用原文：lower customer satisfaction
D)
未提及
D 说顾客“get confused”（困惑），听上去像“选择多”的合理后果，但原文从头到尾只说更不可能买、满意度更低，从未提到“困惑”，属凭常识脑补的未提及项。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第20页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did the psychologists want to find out in their 2012 study about jams?

options.text: What kind of display results in more sales.
What kind of display creates more interest.
What kind of display attracts a greater crowd of customers.
What kind of display leads to greater customer satisfaction.

explanation:
【题目】What did the psychologists want to find out in their 2012 study about jams?
【翻译】心理学家在2012年关于果酱的研究中想要弄清楚什么?
A) 什么样的陈列方式会带来更多销售额。
B) 什么样的陈列方式会产生更多兴趣。
C) 什么样的陈列方式会吸引更多顾客。
D) 什么样的陈列方式会带来更高的顾客满意度。
【答案】A （目的题）What kind of display results in more sales.
【定位】Guess which display table led to more sales?
猜猜哪张陈列桌带来了更多销量？
【信号】设问句直接点出研究要回答的问题。原文以反问 Guess which display table led to more sales?把整段研究的核心问题挑明——研究就是要看“哪种展示带来更多销量”，这个设问句即研究目的的答案句。
【替换】which display table led to more sales ↔What kind of display results in more sales.
“哪张桌带来更多销量”=“哪种陈列带来更多销量”

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 说研究想找“哪种展示引起更多兴趣”，借了原文 created more interest里的 interest，但“更多兴趣”是研究顺带得出的结果，研究真正要找的是销量；B 把结果当成了研究目的。
借用原文：created more interest
C)
未提及
C 说研究想找哪种展示“吸引更大客流”，crowd of customers 原文压根没出现，是凭“大展台显眼”的常识脑补出来的，属未提及。
D)
原词陷阱
D 说研究想找哪种展示带来“更高满意度”，借了原文 customer satisfaction 一词，但满意度同样是研究附带得出的结论，不是 2012 研究设问要找的目标；与 B 同病，混淆结果与目的。
借用原文：lower customer satisfaction
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第21页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What is the finding of an extensive study published in 2015?

options.text: There are situations where customers buy nothing.
There are tricks to increase customer satisfaction.
There are ways to predict customer preferences.
There are rules that motivate customers to buy.

explanation:
【题目】What is the finding of an extensive study published in 2015?
【翻译】2015年发表的一项广泛研究有什么发现?
A) 存在顾客什么都不买的情况。
B) 存在提高顾客满意度的技巧。
C) 存在预测顾客偏好的方法。
D) 存在激励顾客购买的规律。
【答案】D （细节题）There are rules that motivate customers to buy.
【定位】They found four rules that motivate consumers to buy: when people want to make a quick and easy choice, when the product is complex, when it's difficult to compare alternatives, and when consumers don't have clear preferences.
他们发现了促使消费者购买的四条规则：当人们想做一个又快又省事的选择时、当产品很复杂时、当难以比较各个备选项时、以及当消费者没有明确偏好时。
【信号】found 加冒号列举，结论句标志。原文 They found four rules that motivate consumers to buy以 found 引出、冒号后接四条列举，是这项 2015 研究的总结论句，正是“finding”所在。
【替换】four rules that motivate consumers to buy ↔There are rules that motivate customers to buy.
“motivate consumers to buy”=“motivate customers to buy”，近乎同形

【排除】A)
未提及
A 说研究发现“存在顾客什么都不买的情形”，听似贴合“选择多就不买”的主题，但 2015 研究的发现明确是“four rules”，原文没说“buy nothing”，属把前文主题硬套到本题、未提及。
B)
张冠李戴
B 说研究发现“提升满意度的技巧”，借了前文 customer satisfaction 一词，但满意度是前一项果酱研究的内容，2015 研究找的是“促买规则”不是“提升满意度的技巧”，张冠李戴且偷换概念。
借用原文：lower customer satisfaction
C)
偷换概念
C 说研究发现“预测顾客偏好的方法”，盗用了原文 consumers don't have clear preferences里的 preferences，但原文说的是“消费者没有明确偏好”是促买的条件之一，绝非“能预测偏好”，属偷换概念。
借用原文：consumers don't have clear preferences
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第22页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do many Americans think of volunteering?

options.text: Stressful.
Burdensome.
Worthwhile.
Energy-boosting.

explanation:
【题目】What do many Americans think of volunteering?
【翻译】许多美国人如何看待志愿服务?
A) 有压力的。
B) 繁重的。
C) 值得的。
D) 提升精力的。
【答案】C （态度观点题）Worthwhile.
【定位】According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteered, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile.
据一项调查，只有 26% 的美国人做过志愿服务，尽管有报道称许多美国人认为志愿服务是值得做的。
【信号】题干同词 many Americans 在 despite 让步从句里现身。答案句里 many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile 与题干 many Americans 完全对上，且 despite（尽管）这个让步信号后面跟的正是‘大家的看法’，听到 despite + many Americans 就该锁定这句。
【替换】view volunteering as worthwhile ↔Worthwhile.
原句形容词被直接抽出做选项
【排除】A)
未提及
很多人想当然觉得志愿‘让人有压力’，但录音对态度只给了 worthwhile 一个正面评价，从没说 stressful，属于用常识代替文本的硬伤。
B)
与原文相反
录音明确是 worthwhile（值得、正面），Burdensome（负担重的）是负面，方向相反；预读时已把它和 worthwhile 分到对立两组，听出正面语气即可排除。
D)
答非所问
录音后文确实讲志愿能 boost happiness、提升健康，本项把这些好处浓缩成‘提神’来诱选，但题干问的是 many Americans think of it 的评价，答案句只给了 worthwhile，本项答非所问。
借用原文：boost happiness
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第24页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: How could companies ensure both employees and employers benefit from volunteering?

options.text: By linking it with employees' salary.
By taking it as the New Year resolution.
By improving work schedules.
By making it part of the job.

explanation:
【题目】How could companies ensure both employees and employers benefit from volunteering?
【翻译】公司如何确保员工和雇主都能从志愿服务中受益?
A) 将其与员工的薪水挂钩。
B) 将其作为新年决心。
C) 改善工作日程安排。
D) 使其成为工作的一部分。
【答案】D （细节题）By making it part of the job.
【定位】Most people cite time and conflicting work schedules as major barriers, but employees and employers would actually benefit if companies made employee volunteering part of the job.
大多数人把时间和工作排期冲突列为主要障碍，但如果公司把员工志愿服务变成工作的一部分，员工和雇主其实都会受益。
【信号】转折 but 之后才是真正答案，且 benefit 与题干呼应。but employees and employers would actually benefit if companies made employee volunteering part of the job里，转折词 but 后面才是作者的真意，且 benefit、employees and employers 与题干both…benefit 直接对上，听到 but 紧跟 benefit 就锁定这句。
【替换】made employee volunteering part of the job ↔By making it part of the job.
过去式陈述改写成 By doing，it 指代志愿
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 By linking it with employees' salary. 借 employees 这个录音高频词显得耳熟，但录音从未说把志愿与‘薪水’挂钩，salary 是凭常识脑补的合理做法。
借用原文：employees and employers would actually benefit
B)
原词陷阱
录音确有 company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution，本项By taking it as the New Year resolution. 抠走 resolution 一词，但那只是把项目比作‘新年愿望’的修辞，不是‘如何让双方受益’的办法，答非所问。
借用原文：company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution
C)
原词陷阱
录音 Most people cite time and conflicting work schedules as major barriers 把 work schedules 说成‘障碍’，本项 By improving work schedules. 把它翻成‘改善作息’当对策，正是 but 转折前的干扰内容，与录音给的真正办法不符。
借用原文：conflicting work schedules as major barriers
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第25页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did 75% of employees say about volunteering in a survey?

options.text: It was very important to their well-being.
It had taken little of their spare time.
It was an outlet for their personal fulfillment.
It helped improve their working environment.

explanation:
【题目】What did 75% of employees say about volunteering in a survey?
【翻译】在一项调查中,75%的员工对志愿服务有何评价?
A) 它对他们的幸福感非常重要。
B) 它几乎没有占用他们的业余时间。
C) 它是他们实现个人价值的途径。
D) 它有助于改善他们的工作环境。
【答案】A （细节题）It was very important to their well-being.
【定位】In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being.
在一项调查中，89% 的员工认为赞助志愿活动的公司营造了更好的工作环境，75% 的员工则表示志愿服务对他们的幸福感至关重要。
【信号】数字 75% 直接领出答案，须与相邻 89% 切开。录音连说两个数字，75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being 才是题干要的 75%；听到 75% said 就锁定它后半句，切勿被前面 89% 那句串台。
【替换】critical to their well-being ↔It was very important to their well-being.
critical 同义替换为 very important
【排除】B)
未提及
本项 It had taken little of their spare time. 说志愿‘几乎没占业余时间’，录音 75% 的人说的是它‘至关重要’，方向不符；录音只在前文把 time 说成‘障碍’，从没说它‘占用很少’。
C)
张冠李戴
录音确有 the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment，本项 It was an outlet for their personal fulfillment. 几乎照搬这句，但那是作者自己的论述，不是 75%员工‘在调查中说’的内容，张冠李戴。
借用原文：the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment
D)
张冠李戴
It helped improve their working environment. 取自 89% of employees perceived companies…as creating a better working environment，是相邻的 89% 那句的内容；题干问 75%，本项把另一个数字的说法搬过来，是典型数字串台。
借用原文：89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第26页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the UK's retail sector food waste?

options.text: It amounts to 2,000 tons daily.
It mostly comes from supermarkets.
It is estimated at 11% of the UK's total food supply.
It has a lot to do with independent luxury food suppliers.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the UK's retail sector food waste?
【翻译】关于英国零售业食品浪费,我们了解到什么?
A) 它每天达到2000吨。
B) 它主要来自超市。
C) 它估计占英国食品供应总量的11%。
D) 它与独立的奢侈食品供应商有很大关系。
【答案】B （细节题）It mostly comes from supermarkets.

【定位】The vast majority of the UK's 200,000 tonnes of retail sector's annual food waste comes from supermarkets.
英国零售业每年 20 万吨的食物浪费，绝大部分来自超市。
【信号】首句正面定性 the vast majority。这是段落开篇的总起句，用 The vast majority（绝大部分）直接给 "来源" 下定性结论——细节题的答案常落在这种正面交代主体的句子上，而不是后面的补充。
【替换】The vast majority of the UK's 200,000 tonnes of retail sector's annual food waste comes from supermarkets ↔It mostly comes from supermarkets.
the vast majority = mostly
【排除】A)
未提及
录音只说全年总量是 200,000 tonnes（20 万吨/年），选项 It amounts to 2,000 tons daily. 把数字改成 "2,000 吨/天"，数额和 "每日" 的口径都是录音没说的，属于拿一个貌似听过的数字来骗。
借用原文：200,000 tonnes
C)
原词陷阱
录音说的是 It's estimated at less than one per cent of the UK's food waste total ——"不到 1%，且是占食物浪费总量"。选项 It is estimated at 11% of the UK's total food supply. 盗用了 "estimated" 这个原词，却把 "less than one per cent" 改成"11%"、把 "food waste total" 改成 "food supply"，数字与口径全反了。
借用原文：It's estimated at less than one per cent of the UK's food waste total
D)
张冠李戴
录音说浪费主要来自超市，只是 it's a problem that impacts independent luxury food suppliers too——高端供应商只是 "也受影响" 的次要对象。选项 It has a lot to do with independent luxury food suppliers. 盗用 "independent luxury food suppliers" 这串原词，把次要对象说成主因，张冠李戴。
借用原文：it's a problem that impacts independent luxury food suppliers too
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第27页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What does Sophie André's business do in London?

options.text: It rents bicycles to deliver food.
It sells sought-after coffee beans.
It delivers luxury hand-made food.
It recycles waste food from the city.

explanation:
【题目】What does Sophie André's business do in London?
【翻译】Sophie André的企业在伦敦做什么?
A) 它出租自行车来配送食品。
B) 它销售抢手的咖啡豆。
C) 它配送奢侈的手工制作食品。
D) 它回收利用来自城市的废弃食品。
【答案】C （细节题）It delivers luxury hand-made food.

【定位】In 2016 she moved to London and began by setting up a business delivering luxury hand-made food across the city.
2016 年她搬到伦敦，先创办了一家在全城配送高端手工食品的公司。
【信号】creating/setting up 引出业务定义。began by setting up a business delivering luxury hand-made food 用 "setting up a business doing…" 的句式直接给这家公司的主营下定义——这种 "创办一家做……的公司" 句就是业务题的答案句。
【替换】setting up a business delivering luxury hand-made food across the city ↔ It delivers luxury hand-made food.
几近原词的定性概括
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音里 "自行车" 出现在 I started delivering products by bicycle——自行车只是配送 "工具"。选项 It rents bicycles to deliver food. 盗用 "bicycle" 原词，却把 "用自行车送货" 偷换成 "出租自行车"，业务定位完全错了。
借用原文：I started delivering products by bicycle
B)
原词陷阱
"coffee beans" 出现在第一段 sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away，说的是 "被浪费的高端食材举例"，根本不是这家公司在卖的东西。选项 It sells sought-after coffee beans. 盗用这串原词，安到公司业务上，答非所问。
借用原文：sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away every day
D)
与原文相反
录音明确说这家公司 the idea is not simply to redistribute waste food, but to provide a high-quality product——明确否定了 "只是重新分配废弃食物"。选项 It recycles waste food from the city. 盗用 "waste" 原词，恰好把录音否定掉的那层意思当成业务，与原文相反。
借用原文：the idea is not simply to redistribute waste food, but to provide a high-quality product
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第28页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第2套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: In what way does Sophie André's business differ from many food waste projects?

options.text: It pays special attention to the size and shape of its products.
It tries to escape the constraints of the current food system.
It cooperates closely with local producers.
It aims to provide high-quality products.

explanation:
【题目】In what way does Sophie André's business differ from many food waste projects?
【翻译】Sophie André的企业在哪些方面不同于许多食品废弃物项目?
A) 它特别关注其产品的大小和形状。
B) 它试图摆脱当前食品系统的限制。
C) 它与当地生产商密切合作。
D) 它旨在提供高质量的产品。
【答案】D （细节题）It aims to provide high-quality products.

【定位】Unlike many food waste projects that have sprung up in recent years, the idea is not simply to redistribute waste food, but to provide a high-quality product.

C)
原词陷阱

stem: Why will suppliers always have a certain amount of surplus?

options.text: To ensure a regular supply.
To maintain a unique menu.
To make up for the waste products.
To meet customers' urgent demand.

explanation:
【题目】Why will suppliers always have a certain amount of surplus?
【翻译】为什么供应商总会有一定数量的剩余?
A) 为了确保有规律的供应。
B) 为了保持独特的菜单。
C) 为了弥补废弃产品。
D) 为了满足顾客的紧急需求。
【答案】A （细节题）To ensure a regular supply.

【定位】Perhaps unlike other waste food, the supply is regular. Suppliers will always have a certain amount of surplus. So the menus remain regular too.
也许与其他剩余食物不同，这里的供应是稳定的。供应商总会有一定量的剩余。所以菜单也保持稳定。
【信号】the supply is regular 的因果链。这题的因果不在 "surplus" 那句本身，而在它前面的 the supply is regular——正因要保证 "稳定供应"，所以供应商总会留出一定剩余；"surplus"那句与 "so the menus remain regular" 共同把 "regular（稳定）" 这条逻辑钉死。
【替换】the supply is regular ↔To ensure a regular supply.
regular supply 几乎原词对应
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
录音说的是 So the menus remain regular too——菜单 "保持稳定（regular）"。选项 To maintain a unique menu. 盗用 "menu" 原词，却把 "regular（稳定）" 偷换成 "unique（独特）"，把听过的词配上录音没说的形容词。
借用原文：So the menus remain regular too
C)
原词陷阱
"waste products" 出现在 Elysia uses waste products to create…meals——是说公司 "用剩余食材做餐"，并非 "供应商留剩余是为弥补废弃"。选项 To make up for the waste products. 盗用 "waste products" 这个主题原词，编出一个录音没有的因果，答非所问。
借用原文：Elysia uses waste products to create "simple, natural, straightforward" meals and snacks
D)
未提及
录音通篇没说 "满足顾客的紧急需求"，只讲了供应稳定、菜单稳定。选项 To meet customers' urgent demand. 里的 "urgent demand" 是录音完全没出现的内容，属凭空捏造。

visually 是副词，也套得进 He was __(33)__ productive，看似强调"视觉效果"。识破口：visually 多搭 stunning/appealing 等视觉感受形容词，不修饰 productive；33 题问的是"多产程度"。

stem: What does science suggest the right dress may do?

options.text: Add to our advantage in work and life.
Enable us to look a lot more attractive.
Help us to enjoy a fuller personal life.
Provide extra energy for what we do.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】题干 What does science suggest the right dress may do? 直接问 science 提出 dress 会做什么，属于针对原文某句客观事实的复述。
【拆句】主干 What does science suggest the right dress may do? 是宾语从句嵌套：science 后跟省略 that 的宾语从句 the right dress may do What；理解上把 What 还原到从句末尾，即可看清问的是 dress 的功能/作用。
【定位】Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives.
科学现在表明，穿对衣服可以在我们的职业与生活中给予我们额外的优势。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
the extra edge ↔Add to our advantage
in our professional and personal lives ↔in work and life
选项 Add to our advantage in work and life. 恰好覆盖「在职业与生活中增加优势」，与预判完全吻合。
B)
偷换概念
原文谈的是 the extra edge（优势），选项 Enable us to look a lot more attractive.把它换成了外貌吸引力，方向不同。
C)
以偏概全
原文同时强调 professional and personal lives 两方面，选项 Help us to enjoy a fuller personal life. 只保留 personal life，丢掉了职业一面。
D)
偷换概念
原文是 the extra edge（优势），选项 Provide extra energy for what we do. 把edge 换成 energy（精力），属于熟词僻义误读。

stem: Why does science say the clothes one wears may affect their interaction with others?

options.text: Clothes usually represent one's social and economic status.
Clothes largely determine one's likability by people around.
Different types of clothing markedly reflect different personalities.
Different types of clothing convey different messages symbolically.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】题干 Why does science say the clothes one wears may affect their interaction with others? 问的是原因，原文应有 because/due to 等显式因果标志。
【拆句】主干为 Why does science say … ；say 后是省略 that 的宾语从句 the clothes one wears may affect their interaction with others，其中 one wears 是修饰 clothes 的省略关系代词的定语从句，理解为「人们穿的衣服」。
【定位】Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing.
科学表明，我们所穿的衣服会影响我们的行为、情绪甚至我们与他人互动的方式，这是因为我们赋予不同类型衣物的象征意义。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文从未提及 social and economic status，Clothes usually represent one's social and economic status. 是凭印象添加。
B)
偷换概念
原文谈的是衣服带来的象征意义影响互动，选项 Clothes largely determine one's likability by people around. 把它替换为「决定一个人受不受人喜欢」，并加重为largely determine。
C)
偷换概念
原文说衣服传递象征意义，选项 Different types of clothing markedly reflect different personalities. 把它换成「反映性格」，personalities 是原文没有的概念。
D)
✓ 正确
the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing ↔ Different types of clothing convey different messages symbolically.
assign ↔convey
选项 Different types of clothing convey different messages symbolically. 把原文因果端逐一对应，是同义复述。

原文 the way they make us feel 谈的是 feel（感受），选项 By exerting an effect on our power of judgment. 换成了 power of judgment（判断力），概念发生偏移。
B)
✓ 正确
the way they make us feel ↔how we feel about ourselves
because of ↔By impacting
选项 By impacting how we feel about ourselves. 把原文 the way they make us feel用 how we feel about ourselves 改写，完全贴合预判。
C)
答非所问
选项 By affecting what we take as the basis for assessment. 描述的是「影响我们用什么作为评判依据」，等于反过来在说「clothes 改变了我们的评判标准」，可原文只说clothes 让我们对自己有感受，再据此评价自己，并未谈「评判标准本身」。
D)
张冠李戴
symbolic messages 是第 2 段谈衣服影响互动的原因，选项 By influencing our interpretation of symbolic messages. 把它挪到了第 3 段评价自我的机制上，张冠李戴。

stem: Why does the author say tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'?

options.text: They are necessary for formal business dealings.
They may help people concentrate on their business.
They are vital to keeping a dominant position in business transactions.
They may enable people to have the right mentality for doing business.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】Why does the author say tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'? 问作者为何这么说，正是细节原因题的典型表述。
【拆句】主干 Why does the author say + 宾语从句 tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'；be associated with 是固定搭配「与……相关」，being 引导的动名词短语作介词宾语，整体读作「为什么作者说西装外套与『为成功而着装』相关」。
【定位】There's a reason tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'. It seems that wearing formal office wear puts us in the right frame of mind to conduct business.
西装外套之所以被认为与「为成功而着装」相关，是有原因的。看起来，穿正式办公着装会让我们进入做生意的正确心理状态。
【选项】A)
过度推断
原文只说西装让人进入做生意心态，并未声称它是 necessary（必要条件），They are necessary for formal business dealings. 把「有帮助」拔高为「必备」。
B)
偷换概念
原文是 the right frame of mind（正确的心理状态），选项 They may help people concentrate on their business. 把它换成 concentrate（集中注意力），属于偷换。
C)
过度推断
原文 Wearing power clothing makes us feel more confident and even increases hormones needed for displaying dominance. 是讲附加效果，选项 They are vital to keeping a dominant position in business transactions. 把它拔高为「对保持优势地位至关重要」，既偏离了 Q49 问的「为何被称为 dressed for success」，又把程度上拉到 vital。
D)
✓ 正确
puts us in the right frame of mind ↔enable people to have the right mentality
to conduct business ↔for doing business
选项 They may enable people to have the right mentality for doing business. 把原文「让我们处于做生意的正确心态」逐一对应，是同义复述。

stem: What are people advised to do when they want to socialize?

options.text: Focus on clothing.
Wear a good suit.
Dress casually.
Look unusual.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What are people advised to do when they want to socialize? 询问具体建议行为，是典型的细节复述。
【拆句】主干 What are people advised to do；when 引导时间状语从句 they want to socialize，整体读作「当人们想社交时，建议穿什么」。被动语态 are advised 隐含「文章作者建议」。
【定位】On the other hand, a casual dress helps us become more friendly and creative. These findings support the idea of wearing business casuals on a Friday; since colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week.
另一方面，休闲着装能让我们变得更友好、更有创造力。这些发现支持周五穿商务休闲装的做法，因为同事们最有可能在一周的最后一个工作日抽时间社交。
【选项】A)
答非所问
原文从未建议把注意力集中在「衣服」本身，Focus on clothing. 与「社交场合该穿什么」毫无对应。
B)
与原文相反
原文明说 wearing formal wear isn't a great idea when we want to socialize，选项Wear a good suit. 恰好建议穿西装，与原文方向相反。
C)
✓ 正确
a casual dress ↔Dress casually
wearing formal wear isn't a great idea when we want to socialize ↔Dress casually
选项 Dress casually. 把 a casual dress 的建议浓缩为祈使句，完整对应原文。
D)
无中生有
原文从未提到「穿得与众不同」，Look unusual. 是凭空生造的建议。

stem: What does the author think of classical music and opera in today's world?

options.text: They still make their presence felt.
They have given way to electronic music.
They will not fade away from the public eye.
They are no longer relevant to teenagers' lives.

explanation:
【答案】A （态度题）
【判型】题干 What does the author think of classical music and opera in today's world? 用think of 直接问作者看法，对象又是全文核心话题，是典型的整体态度题。
【拆句】题干主干是 What does the author think of …，think of sth = 对某事物的看法；in today's world 是时间地点状语，限定评价的时间范围。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
both opera and classical music are now still quite alive ↔They still make their presence felt
四个选项里只有 They still make their presence felt 与预判「仍有存在感」的肯定立场吻合，其余三项要么表否定立场、要么改换主语。
B)
与原文相反
P1 只列举 pop music, jazz, and electronic music 作为崛起的对手，没说古典乐和歌剧已 give way to（让位给）电子乐。
C)
无中生有
原文 started to fade away from the public eye 是已发生的事实，选项 They will not fade away from the public eye 把它改成对将来的否定预言，是无中生有的预言。
D)
以偏概全
you will not typically see today's teenagers lending their ears to Bach anytime soon 只是承认青少年不常听，但作者用 Granted（诚然）让步后立刻 but 反转，重点不在青少年身上。

stem: What do we learn about much of the popular music currently produced?

options.text: It can be difficult for many classical music fans to appreciate.
It can be seen as an indicator of refinement on classical music.
It caters to society's taste in music in a more subtle way than classical music.
It contains elements similar to those in some masterpieces of classical music.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about much of the popular music currently produced? 是对某具体对象的客观信息提问，不带 infer/imply，按细节题处理。
【拆句】much of the popular music currently produced 是名词短语：much of 限定范围（大部分），currently produced 是过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 popular music = 当下被制作出来的流行音乐。后置分词定语是四级长难句高频结构，识别它能避免把 produced 误读成谓语。
【定位】The most major indicator of classical music's importance in society today is the fact that much of the popular music that is currently being produced uses similar beats, harmonies, and melodies(旋律) as those that were used in some of classical music's best works.
古典乐在当今社会重要性的最显著标志是：当下被制作出来的大部分流行乐使用了与古典乐一些最佳作品相似的节拍、和声与旋律。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
原文说的是「不学乐理的人难以察觉这一现象」，没说流行乐让古典乐迷难以欣赏。
B)
过度推断
原文只说流行乐「使用相似要素」，并未称其是古典乐的 refinement（精炼/提升）。
C)
张冠李戴
原文是「交响乐对社会音乐品味的影响是 subtle 的」，主语是交响乐的影响、不是流行乐。
D)
✓ 正确
uses similar beats, harmonies, and melodies(旋律) as those that were used in some of classical music's best works ↔It contains elements similar to those in some masterpieces of classical music
选项 D 把 similar 与 some of classical music's best works 都原样保留，仅把并列名词上位为 elements，是定位句的标准同义替换。

stem: Why does the author mention the invention of the rock opera?

options.text: To illustrate how to tell a story using music.
To present the simplest definition of opera.
To show the relevance of opera and classical music.
To justify the necessity of using orchestras in opera.

explanation:
【答案】C （例证目的题）
【判型】题干 Why does the author mention the invention of the rock opera? 直接问举例的目的，是例证目的题的最典型句式。
【拆句】题干主干 Why does the author mention X？X = the invention of the rock opera，of短语作 the invention 的后置定语。结构简单，无陷阱。
【定位】A better example for the relevance of opera and classical music can be seen in the invention of the rock opera.
歌剧与古典乐仍具相关性的一个更佳例证，可以从摇滚歌剧的发明中看出。
【选项】A)
答非所问
Opera, in its simplest definition, is telling a story using music as its form 只是为了说明摇滚歌剧的合理性而插入的歌剧定义，不是举摇滚歌剧的目的。
B)
以偏概全
段中确实给了歌剧的最简定义，但那是为论证服务的工具，不是举摇滚歌剧的目的。
C)
✓ 正确
A better example for the relevance of opera and classical music can be seen in the invention of the rock opera ↔To show the relevance of opera and classical music
原文已把例子的服务对象 the relevance of opera and classical music 写在前置位置，选项 C 用不定式 to show 把这个目的复述出来，是逐字命中。
D)
过度推断
原文只说 sometimes actual orchestras are used for major parts of the opera itself ——是 sometimes（有时），不是 necessity（必要性）。

stem: Why are classical music pieces still used as background music in modern movies?

options.text: There are few types of music for movie producers to choose from.
They are considered to be the most expressive type of music.
They are well received by movie fans from all over the world.
They are essential for movies to become the world's greatest hits.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】题干 Why are classical music pieces still used as background music in modern movies? 是对一个具体事实问原因，答案在原文有直接对应，按细节题处理。
【拆句】题干主干 Why are classical music pieces still used as background music ...？被动语态are used，still 表「仍然」，in modern movies 是地点状语。识别 are used 是被动而非主动是关键，能避免把题理解成「古典乐使用了什么」。
【定位】Fans of classical music can also tell you that there are few types of music that are more expressive. So, it should come as no surprise to anyone that classical music pieces are still used as background music in modern movies.
古典乐迷也会告诉你，没有多少类型的音乐比它更具表现力。所以，古典乐至今仍被用作现代电影的背景音乐就一点也不意外了。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文从未说「电影制作方可选的音乐类型很少」，only 谈古典乐自身的表现力强。
B)
✓ 正确
there are few types of music that are more expressive ↔ They are considered to be the most expressive type of music
题干问 why，定位句的 So 前那句被替换为最高级表达，正好回答原因；这是唯一与原因句对应的选项。
C)
因果颠倒
原文 These are often very well received amongst mainstream music fans 是讲电影配乐的结果——观众接受——并未说这是它被选作配乐的原因。
D)
张冠李戴
Some of the world's greatest hits have been parts of rock operas 谈的是摇滚歌剧的成就，与电影配乐被使用的原因无关。

stem: What do we learn about our modern music?

options.text: It could not have come into being without classical music and opera as its foundation.
It cannot outcompete classical music and opera in its impact on our current society.
It will not enjoy as much popularity as classical music and opera among music fans.
It might not be able to rival classical music and opera in importance for centuries to come.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about our modern music? 是对 modern music 的客观信息提问，按细节题处理；但因对象是全文性概念，定位句多落在尾段总结。
【拆句】题干主干 What do we learn about our modern music？our modern music 是介词宾语，about 引出谈论对象。结构简单，无陷阱。
【定位】Classical music and opera are the very foundation of what our modern music is based upon.
古典乐与歌剧正是我们现代音乐所赖以建立的根基。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
Classical music and opera are the very foundation of what our modern music is based upon ↔ It could not have come into being without classical music and opera as its foundation
选项 A 用「否定 + without」的常见同义改写技法，把肯定陈述变成必要条件，逻辑完全等价，是定位句标准的同义替换。
B)
无中生有
原文从未拿现代音乐和古典乐/歌剧比对社会影响力的高下，仅强调古典乐和歌剧仍重要。
C)
偷换概念
原文谈的是「根基」与「重要性」，不是受欢迎程度（popularity）的比较。
D)
过度推断
原文 we can expect them to continue to remain important for centuries to come只是肯定古典乐和歌剧的持久重要，没有否定现代音乐重要性。

副词

【依据】‘尤其明显’才与下文的研究举例语气一致

27. despite missing half of this critical __(27)__

名词

28. the __(28)__ half of their brain strengthened

形容词

29. This __(29)__ that the brain is able to compensate

动词
【词性槽】This __ that… 主语+谓语+宾语从句缺谓语
【依据】‘上文现象→表明这一推论’，indicates 最中性贴切
This __(29)__ that the brain is able to compensate for loss of certain brain structure是用上文‘连接更强’的事实推出‘大脑能代偿’这一结论，indicates that…（表明/说明……）是英语里把现象引向结论的最标准说法。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 N) —— underlines 与 indicates 都能接 that 从句、词性时态全过关。This __(29)__ that the brain is able to compensate for loss of certain brain structure里，主体考生一看 underlines that 也通就容易选错；防坑要看上文是‘新发现’还是‘旧结论’，本句是新发现支撑推论，用 indicates 才对。

自从开始研究幽灵交通堵塞以来,Horn了解到鱼群、鸟群和蝙蝠群使用类似的间距策略,以避免在密集群体中游泳或飞行时相互碰撞。特别是,对东南亚洞穴中黄昏时涌出的数百万只蝙蝠的研究表明,每只蝙蝠都使用一种双边控制形式来减少在密集群体中与其他蝙蝠碰撞的可能性,Horn说。
M) Unlike bats, birds and fish, however, humans have difficulty judging distances behind them. To address that weakness, Horn is now working with the car company Toyota to enable a form of bilateral control via modifications to existing adaptive cruise control systems, which use forward-facing sensors to judge the distance to the vehicle ahead. The bilateral control approach would include adding rear-facing sensors to determine the distance to the vehicle following a car.
然而,与蝙蝠、鸟类和鱼类不同,人类很难判断身后的距离。为了解决这一弱点,Horn现在正与汽车公司Toyota合作,通过改进现有的自适应巡航控制系统来实现一种双边控制形式,该系统使用前向传感器来判断与前方车辆的距离。双边控制方法将包括添加后向传感器来确定与跟随车辆的距离。

但在这些系统成为标准配置之前,人类司机可以通过不那么紧地跟随前车来帮助减少幽灵交通堵塞。正如Horn所说,"紧跟前车绝对没有任何好处。"

stem: What do we learn about American society from the first paragraph?

options.text: It sees lots of personal income wasted on beauty products.
It considers one's physical appearance very important.
It places a high value on the physical fitness of stars.
It expects every individual to look their very best.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about American society from the first paragraph? 是 what...learn型客观信息问答，且范围锁定首段，属于典型细节题。
【拆句】Q46 主干是 What do we learn about American society，from the first paragraph 是状语限定信息来源；句子平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【定位】Our society places a high value on physical beauty.
我们的社会高度看重外貌。
【选项】A)
无中生有
It sees lots of personal income wasted on beauty products. 把 over $722 each year on their appearance 的客观花费篡改为 "被浪费"，原文从未做此评价。
B)
✓ 正确
places a high value on physical beauty ↔ considers one's physical appearance very important
预判 "美国社会把外貌看得很重要" 与 considers one's physical appearance very important 字面贴合，无需推断。
C)
偷换概念
places a high value on the physical fitness of stars 把 "看重外貌" 的主体悄悄换成"明星的 physical fitness"；原文 One in ten Americans has tried to look like a star只说有人想模仿明星，未谈明星本身的体魄。
D)
过度推断
It expects every individual to look their very best. 把 Our society places a high value on physical beauty 升级为 "要求每一个人都做到最好"，强度与范围都被拔高。

stem: What happens when people strive to look better?

options.text: They have to get prepared for resentment and bitter court battles.
They are better able to gain attention, love, and personal connection.
They may neglect to cultivate the inner qualities that matter more.
They feel much of their precious time, energy and resources is wasted.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What happens when people strive to look better? 询问某动作引发的客观后果，是典型的因果型细节题。
【拆句】Q47 主干 What happens 后接 when 引导的时间状语从句，提示发生条件；结构简单无陷阱。
【定位】Many of us spend far too much time, energy, and money trying to polish an image of what we think will bring attention, love, and connection. In the process, we may fail to attend to ourselves in a way that would move us toward deeper intimacy, fulfillment, and meaning.
我们当中许多人花了过多的时间、精力和金钱去打磨一个我们以为会带来关注、爱与连结的形象。在这个过程中，我们可能会忽略对自己的关照，错过本可带来更深亲密、满足与意义的方式。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
They have to get prepared for resentment and bitter court battles. 把第 4 段说明影星案例的 resentment and bitter court battles 强行移植到 Q47 的情境中，但原文从未把这描述为追求外表的 "必然准备"。
B)
与原文相反
They are better able to gain attention, love, and personal connection. 把原文what we think will bring attention, love, and connection 中 "我们以为会带来" 的主观期待包装成客观事实，方向恰好与作者批评意图相反。
C)
✓ 正确
fail to attend to ourselves in a way that would move us toward deeper intimacy, fulfillment, and meaning
↔neglect to cultivate the inner qualities that matter more
预判 "疏于关照内在更要紧的部分" 几乎逐字对应 neglect to cultivate the inner qualities that matter more。
D)
偷换概念
They feel much of their precious time, energy and resources is wasted. 把作者对time, energy, and money 的客观描述换成 "他们自己觉得被浪费"，主体变成 they feel；原文未提及当事人有此自觉。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第3页

stem: What does the author say about outer beauty?

options.text: It may be inherited or cultivated.
It may lead to bad as well as good habits.
It may create connection or isolation.
It may do as much harm as good.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What does the author say about outer beauty? 询问作者就某概念的明确陈述，归入细节题。
【拆句】Q48 主干 What does the author say，about outer beauty 是介词短语状语；无难句结构。
【定位】Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing.
外在美既可能是祝福，也同样可能是诅咒。
【选项】A)
无中生有
It may be inherited or cultivated. 谈外貌的来源（遗传/后天培养），原文从未讨论外貌的获得方式。
B)
偷换概念
It may lead to bad as well as good habits. 把 Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing. 改成 "导致好坏习惯"，对象层面从 "对人生整体的祸福" 缩到 "习惯"。原文确实提到 develop a habit，但说的是 "只关注外表的习惯"，并非 "好习惯/坏习惯" 的对照。
C)
与原文相反
It may create connection or isolation. 称外貌可能创造 connection；但 P5 P6 都说 connection 来自 inner qualities / meeting of inner worlds，外貌不直接创造 connection。
D)
✓ 正确
as much of a curse as a blessing ↔do as much harm as good
预判 "坏处与好处一样多" 直接命中 do as much harm as good，无需推断。

stem: What brings about spiritual connection?

options.text: Meeting of minds.
Attraction at first sight.
Physical chemistry.
Frequent interaction.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What brings about spiritual connection? 询问导致某结果的原因，对应原文中一处明确的因→果叙述。
【拆句】Q49 主干 What brings about spiritual connection，brings about=cause/lead to，是一个三个单词的简单疑问句。
【定位】While our initial attraction may be based, in part, on physical chemistry, it is the meeting of our inner worlds that creates the lasting intimacy and spiritual connection for which we long.
虽然最初的吸引可能在一定程度上源于身体的化学反应，但真正创造我们所渴求的长久亲密与精神连结的，是内在世界的相遇。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
the meeting of our inner worlds ↔Meeting of minds.
预判 "内在世界相遇" 几乎逐字对应 Meeting of minds.。
B)
与原文相反
Attraction at first sight. 对应 our initial attraction，但原文明确说这只是 "in part" 的初始吸引，并非 spiritual connection 的来源。
C)
与原文相反
Physical chemistry. 直接抓取 physical chemistry 这一原词，但原文用 While 让步结构说明它只贡献 initial attraction，不是 spiritual connection 的来源。
D)
无中生有
Frequent interaction. 谈交往频率，原文从未提及 spiritual connection 来自频繁互动。

stem: What happens when we take the path toward cultivating inner beauty?

options.text: We may find a route toward other people's souls.
We may be appreciated more by people around us.
We will meet people who value us for who we are.
We will be discouraged from revealing our true selves.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What happens when we take the path toward cultivating inner beauty? 仍是 what happens when 的因果型问法，问的是文章对此动作所述的结果。
【拆句】Q50 主干 What happens，when 从句中 take the path toward cultivating inner beauty用了介词短语作 path 的修饰，toward 后接动名词 cultivating，提示这是个比喻：把培养内在美比作走一条路。
【定位】Eventually we'll find those compatible souls who appreciate us as we are.
最终我们会遇到那些欣赏真实的我们的契合灵魂。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
We may find a route toward other people's souls. 让 "我们走向别人的灵魂"；原文P7 描述的是别人走向真实的我们，方向与重点都不一致。
B)
以偏概全
We may be appreciated more by people around us. 把 "被那些契合的人欣赏" 扩大为 "被周围所有人更多地欣赏"；原文紧前一句明说 Not everyone will see us and appreciate us，恰好否定 "被周围人普遍更欣赏"。
C)
✓ 正确
Eventually we'll find those compatible souls who appreciate us as we are. ↔ We will meet people who value us for who we are.
预判 "最终遇到欣赏真实自我的人" 与 We will meet people who value us for who we are. 几乎逐字对应。
D)
与原文相反
We will be discouraged from revealing our true selves. 称我们会被打消展露真我的念头；但原文 if they don't, it is their loss, not ours 是鼓励继续展露自我，与选项方向相反。

stem: What can we expect of plant-based meats?

options.text: An increasing interest in their analyses.
An enormous effort in their promotion.
A huge boost in their consumption.
A noticeable surge in their varieties.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What can we expect of plant-based meats? 没有出现 infer/imply/suggest，问的是一个文中已表述的预期结果，属于事实细节题。
【拆句】What can we expect of plant-based meats? 结构是 expect sth of sb/sth（对……抱有什么期待/预期），of 后接被期待的对象。考生熟悉的 expect sth from sb 在此处换成 of，含义相近，不必紧张。
【定位】Analysts don't expect the meat-free movement to slow anytime soon; a 2021 report predicts the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030—a 957 percent surge.
分析师们不预期植物肉浪潮短期内会放缓；一份 2021 年的报告预测，到 2030 年该市场将猛增至 740 亿美元——增幅高达 957%。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
An increasing interest in their analyses 把原文里「分析师们的预期」偷换成「对它们分析的兴趣增长」，文章并未说人们对植物肉的分析研究兴趣上升。
B)
无中生有
An enormous effort in their promotion 谈的是「推广上的巨大努力」，原文只说市场规模会增长，没提企业或政府投入推广，属无中生有。
C)
✓ 正确
the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030—a 957 percent surge ↔ A huge boost in their consumption
预判要的是「消费规模大增」，A huge boost in their consumption 正是这个语义，锁定 C。
D)
偷换概念
A noticeable surge in their varieties 把 surge 的对象从原文的「市场规模」换成「种类」，原文仅提到 Newer varieties imitate the look, flavor, and texture of meat，说新品种已出现，但没说种类会激增。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2025-06/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products?

options.text: They are mostly non-vegetarians.
They are mostly animal-rights advocates.
Most of them refrain from eating meat for health reasons.
Most of them eat meatless meat to protect the environment.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products? 是 learn about + 名词结构，问关于该人群在原文中已写明的属性。
【拆句】What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products? 主干 What do we learn about consumers，buying ... 是后置的现在分词短语作 consumers 的定语，相当于 who buy ...，结构无陷阱。
【定位】More than nine out of ten consumers who buy Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products also eat meat.
在购买 Beyond Burger 和 Impossible Foods 产品的消费者中，有超过十分之九的人同时也吃肉。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
More than nine out of ten consumers who buy Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products also eat meat ↔They are mostly non-vegetarians
预判说的「多数也吃肉」正对应「多数非素食者」，A 命中。
B)
以偏概全
They are mostly animal-rights advocates 把动物权利说成消费者的主要身份，但原文animal rights, health, or environmental reasons 是并列的三类动机之一，没有说大多数是动物权利倡导者。
C)
以偏概全
Most of them refrain from eating meat for health reasons 同样把并列三动机里的「健康」拎出来说大多数，且 refrain from eating meat（克制吃肉）与原文 reduce their meat consumption 程度被夸大。
D)
以偏概全
Most of them eat meatless meat to protect the environment 同样犯「三选一拎为主因」的错误，无原文比例支撑。

stem: What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark?

options.text: They more often appeal to meat-eaters.
They very much resemble animal meat.
Some have become its signature dishes.
Most of them are sold as true fake meat.

explanation:
【答案】B （推断题）
【判型】What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark? 中 conclude from ... remark 表示要从她的话里推出关于产品的判断。
【拆句】What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark? 主干 What can we conclude about X from Y，about 引出推断对象（产品），from 引出推断依据（她的话）；这是固定结构。
【定位】Maybe the best sign that Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat is that I couldn't stand to take another bite.
或许 Impossible Foods 成功破解「逼真假肉」密码的最有力信号，就是连我（这个素食者）都没法再吃一口。
【选项】A)
答非所问
题目要求从她的话推断 Impossible Foods 的「产品本身」特性，They more often appeal to meat-eaters 说的是「产品更受肉食者欢迎」，那是 Q52 答案，不是 Q53的推断方向。
B)
✓ 正确
Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat ↔ They very much resemble animal meat
预判要的是「产品逼真像真肉」，They very much resemble animal meat 直接对应，锁 B。
C)
无中生有
Some have become its signature dishes 说这些菜成了「招牌菜」，原文只说她试吃了 a dish from Impossible Foods，并未说哪些是招牌。
D)
偷换概念
Most of them are sold as true fake meat 把 realistic fake meat（逼真的假肉）改成sold as true fake meat（作为「真假肉」出售），不仅商业化（销售行为）是原文没有的，true 修饰 fake meat 的逻辑也与「产品像真肉」相违。

stem: Why can the habit of eating a plant-based diet lead to better health?

options.text: It frees people from any known link to cancer.
It provides all the nutrients for staying healthy.
It helps maintain normal blood pressure and blood sugar.
It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】Why can the habit of eating a plant-based diet lead to better health? 用 Why 提问，原文有明确因果链时仍属细节题。
【拆句】Why can the habit of eating a plant-based diet lead to better health? 中主语是 the habit of doing sth（做某事的习惯）这个抽象名词短语，谓语 lead to 表示导致，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】Not only has red meat been linked to cancer, but studies show that people who ditch meat have lower blood pressure, lower average blood sugar, and lower cholesterol levels.
不仅红肉被发现与癌症相关，研究还显示放弃吃肉的人血压更低、平均血糖更低、胆固醇水平也更低。
【选项】A)
过度推断
It frees people from any known link to cancer 中 frees ... from any known link 表示「完全免除任何已知关联」，但原文只说红肉与癌症「被发现相关」（red meat been linked to cancer），并未说弃肉就能彻底斩断所有癌症关联。
B)
过度推断
It provides all the nutrients for staying healthy 说植物饮食提供「所有保持健康所需的营养」，P4 只列了维生素、矿物质、蛋白质、纤维四项，没说「全部」。
C)
以偏概全
It helps maintain normal blood pressure and blood sugar 只提血压和血糖，漏了胆固醇和癌症，且 maintain normal 意为「维持正常」，比 lower 表达的「降低」程度还弱。
D)
✓ 正确
Not only has red meat been linked to cancer, but studies show that people who ditch meat have lower blood pressure, lower average blood sugar, and lower cholesterol levels. ↔It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption
预判要「综合性下降」，D 的 various health risks 正好覆盖了四种风险，是唯一概括项。

stem: What does the author recommend we eat at the end of the passage?

options.text: Naturally produced foods.
Processed protein substitutes.
Red meats like traditional beef.
New generations of alternate meat.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the author recommend we eat at the end of the passage? 位置写死、动作写死，只问被推荐的事物，不涉及推断。
【拆句】What does the author recommend we eat at the end of the passage? 中 recommend (that) we eat 省略 that，we eat 是宾语从句；at the end of the passage 是位置状语，结构无陷阱。
【定位】These new generations of alternate meat get all the attention, but don't forget about whole grains and vegetables. Beans are an especially excellent protein substitute. They're nutritious, inexpensive, and far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes on the market today.
这些新一代的肉类替代品备受关注，但不要忘了全谷物和蔬菜。豆类是格外出色的蛋白替代品。它们营养丰富、价格便宜，可持续性远胜于今天市面上任何加工过的植物肉替代品。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
whole grains and vegetables ↔Naturally produced foods
far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes ↔ Naturally produced foods
预判要「天然食物」，Naturally produced foods 同时覆盖三类推荐对象的共同属性，是唯一合适项。
B)
与原文相反
Processed protein substitutes 说的正是作者要反对的加工蛋白替代品，far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes 明确把这类产品当对照面。
C)
与原文相反
Red meats like traditional beef 是全文反复劝退的对象（red meat been linked to cancer），作者绝不会在结尾推荐它。
D)
与原文相反
New generations of alternate meat 与 These new generations of alternate meat原词复现，但原文用 but 转折表示「它们抢了风头但作者另有所荐」，并非推荐对象。

stem: Where was the black cat found?

options.text: Outside the office of a charity foundation.
Inside the car of David King's neighbour.
Under the engine cover of a man's car.
At the gate of a grade school in Kent.

explanation:
【题目】Where was the black cat found?
【翻译】这只黑猫是在哪里被发现的?
A) 在一家慈善基金会的办公室外面。
B) 在David King邻居的车内。
C) 在一名男子汽车的引擎盖下面。
D) 在Kent一所小学的大门口。
【答案】C （细节题）Under the engine cover of a man's car.
【定位】The black cat was found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car when he decided to do an oil check after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent.
这只黑猫是在大卫·金送孙子上学后、决定检查机油时，被发现蜷缩在他汽车的引擎盖下面的。
【信号】found ＋ 地点介词短语。答案句的信号是动词 found 紧跟一个表地点的介词短语 found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car——题干问 Where… found，原文恰好出现 found ＋『在哪儿』，这就是承载答案的那一句。
【替换】under the engine cover of David King's car ↔Under the engine cover of a man's car.
人名换成泛称 a man
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项把后文出现的 UK charity Cats Protection 里的 charity 一词搬来，编成『慈善机构门口』这个地点。可录音里 charity 只用来说明谁救的猫，从没说猫是在慈善机构门口被发现的，属听到 charity 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection
B)
张冠李戴
选项把末段的 Mr King's neighbour（邻居）搬来，说猫是在『邻居的车里』被发现。但邻居在录音里是猫的主人、出现在结局处，发现猫的车是金先生自己的车，把发现地点安到邻居车上是张冠李戴。
借用原文：reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbour
D)
原词陷阱
选项抓住原文的 school in Kent，把『学校门口』说成发现地点。可录音里 school 是金先生送孙子去的地方、是事情发生前的背景，猫是他送完孙子、回来做机油检查时才在引擎盖下被发现的，发现地不是学校门口。
借用原文：after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第2页
source_file: cet4/2025-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about the cat at the end of the news report?

options.text: It got reunited with its owner.
It was injured during the rescue.
It became a pet of Mr King's grandson.
It was placed in the care of a UK charity.

explanation:
【题目】What do we learn about the cat at the end of the news report?
【翻译】关于这只猫,新闻报道最后我们了解到什么?
A) 它与主人团聚了。
B) 它在救援过程中受伤了。
C) 它成为了King先生孙子的宠物。
D) 它被交由一家英国慈善机构照料。
【答案】A （细节题）It got reunited with its owner.
【定位】Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection, the four-year-old cat was later reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbour.
在英国慈善机构『猫咪保护』救援之后，这只四岁的猫最终与它的主人——金先生的邻居——团聚了。
【信号】末段＋later标结局。本句是录音最末一段、且含时间词 later，正对应题干的 at the end；新闻的结果通常落在最后一句，later reunited 直接交代了猫的最终下场，是答案句。
【替换】reunited with its owner ↔It got reunited with its owner.
近乎原句的同义重述
【排除】B)
未提及
选项说猫『在救援中受伤』，但录音从头到尾只字未提受伤，末段只说被救后团聚。它利用第3段 terrified（受惊）、stuck（卡住）等词让人联想到猫很惨，进而脑补成『受伤』，实属过度推断、原文未提。
C)
张冠李戴
选项把第1段的 grandson（孙子）搬来，说猫成了金先生孙子的宠物。可孙子只在『送孙子上学』的背景里出现，录音末段明说猫团聚的对象是主人即邻居，不是被孙子养，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent
D)
原词陷阱
选项说猫『被交由英国一家慈善机构照管』，盗用了末段 UK charity Cats Protection 这个真出现的机构。但录音里 charity 是负责『救援』的一方，救完之后猫是团聚而非留在机构照管，把过程中的救援者说成最终归宿，差在结局。
借用原文：Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2025-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month?

options.text: The 100th anniversary celebration of Methodist University.
The first important political event in the next five years.
The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games.
The reunion of this year's Olympic gold medalists.

explanation:
【题目】What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month?
【翻译】不到一个月后，Fayetteville 将见证什么?
A) Methodist University 的百年校庆庆典。
B) 未来五年中的第一个重要政治活动。
C) 特殊奥林匹克春季运动会的开幕式。
D) 今年奥运会金牌得主的重聚。
【答案】C （细节题）The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games.
【定位】In less than a month, the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville.
不到一个月后，特殊奥林匹克运动会春季赛事将重返费耶特维尔。
【信号】题干时间词原样出现。录音开头 In less than a month 与题干 in less than a month 用词完全一致，这种"题干时间状语在原文原样响起"就是最强的定位信号，听到它，紧跟其后的主语就是答案所在。
【替换】the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return ↔ The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games.
重返即开赛

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音确实念到了 Methodist University（卫理公会大学），A 就把这个原词捡来编出 The 100th anniversary celebration of Methodist University."百年校庆"，但原文只说赛事在该校举办，从没提任何校庆或"100th"，是典型听到地名就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：The event will take place at Methodist University.
B)
原词陷阱
录音说赛事是 coming back for the first time in five years（五年来首次回归），B 把"five years" 这个原词改头换面成 The first important political event in the next five years.，既把"赛事"偷换成"政治大事"，又把"过去五年"扭成"未来五年"，是盗用数字+偷换概念的双重陷阱。
借用原文：The Games are coming back for the first time in five years.
D)
偷换概念
选项 The reunion of this year's Olympic gold medalists. 借了原文反复出现的"Olympics" 来误导：原文是 Special Olympics（特殊奥林匹克/残障人士运动会），D 偷偷掐掉 "Special" 变成普通"Olympic gold medalists 金牌选手聚会"，原文从未提金牌选手聚会，属偷换概念。
借用原文：the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2025-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did Benjamin Kowalczyk say is rewarding to see?

options.text: Volunteers visit the Games' website to sign up.
Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
Organizers devote their time and energy to the Games.
Children play in a fun tent and enjoy themselves fully.

explanation:
【题目】What did Benjamin Kowalczyk say is rewarding to see?
【翻译】Benjamin Kowalczyk 说看到什么令人欣慰?
A) 志愿者访问运动会网站报名参加。
B) 有特殊需要的运动员在运动会上取得胜利。
C) 组织者为运动会投入他们的时间和精力。
D) 孩子们在趣味帐篷里玩耍并尽情享受。
【答案】B （细节题）Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
【定位】Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
Kowalczyk 说，看到有特殊需求的运动员在赛事中取得胜利，是很有意义、很值得的。
【信号】题干rewarding原话再现。录音 Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see 把题干里的人名和评价词 "rewarding" 原样念出，这是"人物+评价词"双重信号，听到它就知道接下来 "to see" 后面那件事正是答案承载句。
【替换】athletes with special needs triumph in the Games ↔ Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
评价词后内容直接对应

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
录音第三段确有 visit the Games' website to sign up，A 把这句原词整段搬来，但那是给"想当志愿者的人"的报名指引，不是 Kowalczyk "觉得值得一看"的事，盗用原词却答非所问。
借用原文：Organizers encourage them to visit the Games' website to sign up.
C)
张冠李戴
选项 Organizers devote their time and energy to the Games. 看似贴合主题，但原文Kowalczyk 评"值得"的是运动员取胜，并没说"组织者投入时间精力"这件事值得看；原文只说想帮忙的人可去志愿，把评价对象悄悄换成了组织者，属张冠李戴+未提及。
借用原文：it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games
D)
原词陷阱
录音第二段确实念了 There will also be a fun tent for children.，D 把 "fun tent/children" 这组原词捡来，但那只是顺带交代赛事设施，Kowalczyk 的 "rewarding"评价根本没落在孩子玩耍上，是听到原词就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：There will also be a fun tent for children.
1 A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy its chocolate rabbits after it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer.
一家德国超市在与一家瑞士巧克力制造商的法庭诉讼中败诉后,被勒令销毁其巧克力兔子产品。
2 The Swiss firm had argued its gold-wrapped chocolate rabbit deserved copyright protection from a similar product sold by the budget supermarket.
这家瑞士公司辩称,其金色包装的巧克力兔子应当受到版权保护,以防止这家廉价超市销售的类似产品侵权。
3 Switzerland's highest court agreed and overturned a ruling last year by the country's commercial court that had sided with the supermarket. It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed, but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted. It could be melted for use in other products.
瑞士最高法院表示同意,推翻了去年该国商事法院支持超市的裁决。法院下令销毁所有仿冒兔子产品,但建议巧克力无需浪费,可以融化用于其他产品。
4 It said even though there are some differences between the two products, there was still the possibility of confusion for consumers. The Swiss manufacturer's rabbit has a red bow and bell, while the German supermarket's has a green bow and bell. The colour of the wrapper is similar, as are the illustrations of the features.
法院称,尽管两种产品之间存在一些差异,但仍有可能使消费者产生混淆。瑞士制造商的兔子有红色蝴蝶结和铃铛,而德国超市的兔子有绿色蝴蝶结和铃铛。包装纸的颜色相似,特征的图案也相似。

stem: What has the German supermarket been ordered to do?

options.text: Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits.
Change the wrapping of its commodities.
Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss.
Defend itself in the country's commercial court.

explanation:
【题目】What has the German supermarket been ordered to do?
【翻译】这家德国超市被要求做什么?
A) 销毁其仿制的巧克力兔子。
B) 更改其商品的包装。
C) 赔偿瑞士制造商的损失。
D) 在该国商事法院为自己辩护。
【答案】A （细节题）Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits.
【定位】A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy its chocolate rabbits after it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer.
一家德国超市在与一家瑞士巧克力制造商的官司中败诉后，被勒令销毁其巧克力兔子。
【信号】命令信号 ordered to。答案句的信号是 has been ordered to destroy，ordered to 正是题干 been ordered to 的呼应，这种表命令、判决的短语就是答案落点，听到立刻锁定其后的动作。
【替换】destroy its chocolate rabbits ↔Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits.
近乎同表述加补词
【排除】B)
原词陷阱
选项 Change the wrapping of its commodities. 借用了原文后文反复提到的 wrapper（包装），但原文从没要求超市改包装，命令是销毁，属听到 wrapping 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：The colour of the wrapper is similar
C)
原词陷阱
选项 Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss. 拼用了原文的 Swiss manufacturer和 lost（败诉），但原文判的是销毁，从未提赔偿损失，是把熟词重组出的假动作。
借用原文：it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer
D)
原词陷阱
选项 Defend itself in the country's commercial court. 借了原文的 commercial court，但那是去年商业法院的旧判决场景，本题命令是销毁兔子，并非要超市去出庭辩护。
借用原文：overturned a ruling last year by the country's commercial court
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第7页
source_file: cet4/2025-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: What did Switzerland's highest court suggest about the chocolate in question?

options.text: It could be rewrapped and sold by the budget supermarket.
It could be reshaped into animals other than rabbits.
It could be resold cheaper to avoid waste.
It could be reused in other products.

explanation:
【题目】What did Switzerland's highest court suggest about the chocolate in question?
【翻译】瑞士最高法院对有关巧克力提出了什么建议?
A) 它可以被重新包装并由廉价超市出售。
B) 它可以被重新塑造成兔子以外的动物。
C) 它可以以更低价格转售以避免浪费。
D) 它可以在其他产品中重新使用。
【答案】D （细节题）It could be reused in other products.
【定位】It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed, but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted. It could be melted for use in other products.
法院下令销毁所有仿制兔子，但建议巧克力不必浪费，可以熔化后用于其他产品。
【信号】转折 but 后是真意。答案句信号是转折词 but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted，but 前讲销毁、but 后才是对巧克力的建议，转折之后才是落点，这正呼应题干的 suggest。
【替换】melted for use in other products ↔It could be reused in other products.
熔化再用即重复使用
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 rewrapped and sold by the budget supermarket 搬来原文的 budget supermarket，但原文建议是熔化再用，从没说重新包装由该超市出售，是熟词拼出的假处置。
借用原文：a similar product sold by the budget supermarket
B)
原词陷阱
选项 reshaped into animals other than rabbits 借了原文 rabbits 一词臆造出改造成别的动物，原文只说熔化用于其他产品，并未提改塑成动物。
借用原文：all the imitation rabbits be destroyed
C)
原词陷阱
选项 resold cheaper to avoid waste 借了原文 needn't be wasted 中的 waste 概念，但原文是熔化再用以避免浪费，不是降价转售，处置动作被偷换。
借用原文：the chocolate needn't be wasted
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第8页
source_file: cet4/2025-12/第1套/PDF/听力真题.pdf

stem: Why did Switzerland's highest court overturn the commercial court's ruling?

options.text: To be fair to the German supermarkets.
To protect chocolate retailers' interests.
To boost the growth of the chocolate industry.
To prevent consumers' possible confusion.

explanation:
【题目】Why did Switzerland's highest court overturn the commercial court's ruling?

Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions. Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
【翻译】瑞士最高法院为什么推翻商事法院的裁决?
A) 为了对德国超市公平。
B) 为了保护巧克力零售商的利益。
C) 为了促进巧克力行业的增长。
D) 为了防止消费者可能产生的混淆。
【答案】D （细节题）To prevent consumers' possible confusion.
【定位】It said even though there are some differences between the two products, there was still the possibility of confusion for consumers.
法院表示，尽管两种产品之间存在一些差异，但仍有可能让消费者产生混淆。
【信号】让步转折露真因。答案句信号是让步结构 even though there are some differences...there was still the possibility of confusion，even though 让一步、but/still 后才是真正理由——担心消费者混淆，这就是推翻判决的原因。
【替换】the possibility of confusion for consumers ↔To prevent consumers' possible confusion.
存在混淆即为防混淆
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
选项 To be fair to the German supermarkets. 借了原文反复出现的 German supermarket，但原文推翻原判恰恰对超市不利，目的是防混淆而非对超市公平，方向相反。
借用原文：A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy
B)
偷换概念
选项 To protect chocolate retailers' interests. 把原文的 consumers（消费者）偷换成retailers（零售商），原文明说担心的是消费者混淆，保护对象被换了一方。
借用原文：the possibility of confusion for consumers
C)
未提及
选项 To boost the growth of the chocolate industry. 借了反复出现的 chocolate，但原文从未提推动巧克力行业发展这一目的，是凭熟词臆造的目的。
answer_source: 听力解析.pdf 第9页

stem: What does the man request the woman to do?

options.text: Return the handbook to him.
Make a vegetable dish.
Pass a book to him.
Meet his sister's boyfriend.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man request the woman to do?
【翻译】男士要求女士做什么?
A) 把手册还给他。
B) 做一道蔬菜菜肴。
C) 把一本书递给他。
D) 见见他姐姐的男朋友。
【答案】C （细节题）Pass a book to him.
【定位】Can you please hand me that book over there?
你能把那边那本书递给我吗？

【信号】请求句 Can you please...。答案句的信号是请求口吻 Can you please hand me that book over there?，Can you please 一出，后面跟的动作 hand me that book 就是男的请女的做的事，这正是"做什么"题要锁定的落点。
【替换】hand me that book ↔Pass a book to him.
hand 与 pass 同义换词
【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 的 Return the handbook to him. 用 handbook 蹭录音里的 hand me that book 的发音（hand...book），听着像，但录音说的是 hand（递）+ book（书），不是 handbook（手册），更没有 return（还）的意思。
借用原文：hand me that book
B)
答非所问
B 的 Make a vegetable dish. 用了录音 making a winter bean salad 里的做素菜原词，但做菜是男的自己"I need to make"，不是请女的做，答非所问。
借用原文：I need to make a lot of vegetable dishes
D)
原词陷阱
D 的 Meet his sister's boyfriend. 取自录音 My sister's boyfriend is coming over for dinner 的原词，但那只是交代背景（男友要来吃饭），并非男的请女的去见他。
借用原文：My sister's boyfriend is coming over for dinner

stem: What does the woman say about eating vegetables only?

options.text: It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet.
It would reduce one's protein intake.
It would do harm to one's muscles.
It doesn't sound practical for her.

explanation:
【题目】What does the woman say about eating vegetables only?
【翻译】关于只吃蔬菜,女士是怎么说的?
A) 这似乎不是均衡的饮食。
B) 这会减少一个人的蛋白质摄入。
C) 这会对一个人的肌肉造成伤害。
D) 这对她来说听起来不实际。
【答案】A （态度观点题）It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet.
【定位】He only eats vegetables, no meat? That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet.
他只吃菜、不吃肉？那听起来不像是很均衡的饮食啊。
【信号】评价句 That doesn't sound like...。答案信号是女的抛出的总评价 That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet，doesn't sound like 是直接表态，这是她对"只吃素"的核心判断，后面 protein、muscles 都是她为这个判断补的理由。
【替换】That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet ↔It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet.
sound like 换 seem to be

【排除】B)
原词陷阱
B 的 It would reduce one's protein intake. 蹭了录音 How can he get enough protein?的 protein 原词，但女的只是反问"怎么获取足够蛋白质"来支撑她的判断，并没下"会减少蛋白质摄入"的结论。
借用原文：How can he get enough protein?
C)
原词陷阱
C 的 It would do harm to one's muscles. 借用录音 strengthen his muscles 的 muscles原词，但女的是问"他怎么练肌肉"，并没说"会伤肌肉"，属于无中生有地拔高。
借用原文：strengthen his muscles
D)
偷换概念
D 的 It doesn't sound practical for her. 套用了录音 sound 的口吻，但女的评价的是"这饮食不均衡"，从没说"对她本人不实际"，把评判对象悄悄换成了"对她"。
借用原文：That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet

stem: Why does the boyfriend of the man's sister choose to be a vegetarian?

options.text: To improve his health.
To protect animal rights.
To follow a trendy lifestyle.
To stick to his religious belief.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the boyfriend of the man's sister choose to be a vegetarian?
【翻译】男士的姐姐的男朋友为什么选择成为素食主义者?
A) 为了改善他的健康。
B) 为了保护动物权利。
C) 为了追随时尚的生活方式。
D) 为了坚持他的宗教信仰。
【答案】B （细节题）To protect animal rights.
【定位】He's an animal activist. He's always been very sensitive and sympathizes with animals.
他是个动物保护活动者。他一向很敏感，对动物充满同情。
【信号】亮明身份句 He's an animal activist。答案信号是男的直接亮出男友的身份与立场 He's an animal activist，紧接 sympathizes with animals。原因题里这种"He's a + 身份/立场"的句子，往往就是动机所在——他吃素是因为他是动物保护者。
【替换】He's an animal activist ↔To protect animal rights.
身份具体说法换成概括目的

【排除】A)
原词陷阱
A 的 To improve his health. 蹭了录音 health condition 的 health 原词，但那是女的列举可能原因时随口提的选项之一，录音随后明确否掉、给出的真实原因是动物保护，不是健康。
借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?
C)
原词陷阱
C 的 To follow a trendy lifestyle. 借用录音 lifestyle 原词，但这同样只是女的列举的待选项之一，男的回答里根本没提"赶潮流"，是答非所问。
借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?
D)
原词陷阱
D 的 To stick to his religious belief. 用了录音 religion 原词，且"宗教吃素"最符合日常常识，最易被默认选中；但录音明说原因是动物保护，宗教只是女的列举的可能性之一，并非答案。
借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?

stem: On what point does the man agree with the woman at the end of the conversation?

options.text: The torture and distress dolphins suffer in parks.
The necessity of having zoos and eating meat.
The gloomy environments animals are kept in.
The urgency of joining an animal rights group.

explanation:
【题目】On what point does the man agree with the woman at the end of the conversation?
【翻译】在对话结束时,男士在哪一点上同意女士的观点?
A) 海豚在公园里遭受的折磨和痛苦。
B) 拥有动物园和吃肉的必要性。
C) 动物被饲养的阴暗环境。
D) 加入动物权利组织的紧迫性。
【答案】B （细节题）The necessity of having zoos and eating meat.
【定位】W: Not all zoos and animal parks have the most favorable conditions, but without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals and their environments. Besides, I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game. M: Honestly, I agree.
女：并不是所有动物园和动物公园条件都最理想，但要是没有它们，就没法了解动物和它们的生存环境了。再说，我可舍不得放弃看棒球赛时来一根热狗。男：说实话，我同意。
【信号】赞同信号 Honestly, I agree。答案信号是男的结尾的明确赞同 Honestly, I agree，它指向的是女的紧挨着说的两点——动物园有存在的必要 without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals 和不愿放弃吃热狗（肉）I could ever give up a good hot dog。赞同句认同的就是这两点合起来的立场。

【替换】without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals ↔ The necessity of having zoos and eating meat.
没了就不行 = 有必要
I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog ↔eating meat
舍不得放弃热狗 = 要吃肉
【排除】A)
张冠李戴
A 的 The torture and distress dolphins suffer in parks. 几乎照搬录音 the torture of dolphins in sea parks 与 causes them great distress 的原词，但那是男友（动物活动家）的立场，不是男女二人结尾达成的共识，张冠李戴。
借用原文：the torture of dolphins in sea parks
C)
原词陷阱
C 的 The gloomy environments animals are kept in. 蹭录音 That's a little gloomy 的gloomy 原词，但 gloomy 是女的形容男友说法"有点令人沮丧"，并非两人一致认同"动物处境阴郁"，答非所问。
借用原文：That's a little gloomy
D)
原词陷阱
D 的 The urgency of joining an animal rights group. 借用录音 his local animal rights group 的 animal rights group 原词，但录音只是说男友是该组织发言人，根本没提"加入组织的紧迫性"，属凭空编造。
借用原文：He's the spokesperson for his local animal rights group

stem: What part of the TV program does the man say was interesting?

options.text: The part about getting over jetlag.
The part about air travel in the past.
The part about not eating on board the plane.
The part about avoiding sleeping on the plane.

explanation:
【题目】What part of the TV program does the man say was interesting?
【翻译】男士说电视节目的哪部分内容很有趣?
A) 关于克服时差反应的部分。
B) 关于过去航空旅行的部分。
C) 关于不在飞机上进食的部分。
D) 关于避免在飞机上睡觉的部分。
【答案】A （细节题）The part about getting over jetlag.
【定位】The part about overcoming jetlag was interesting.
关于克服时差的那一部分很有趣。
【信号】被问者男士的直接应答 + 评价词 interesting。本题问的是男士，男士开口的 The part about overcoming jetlag was interesting. 就是被问者的直接应答，句中 interesting 与题干 interesting 完全对应，是把这句锁成答案句的信号。
【替换】overcoming jetlag ↔getting over jetlag
同义短语替换 overcome=get over

【排除】B)
未提及
The part about air travel in the past 里 air travel 是整段对话的大话题词，听着耳熟，但男士说有趣的是克服时差那部分，"过去的航空旅行"录音并未作为有趣的一部分提到，属拿大话题词凑出的诱选。
C)
原词陷阱
not eating on board the plane 盗用了录音 not eating for the entire journey 这个原词内容，但那是男士转述"专家推荐"的建议、且他说的是"surprised（吃惊）"，并非回答"哪部分有趣"。听到 not eating 就选即落陷阱。
借用原文：the expert recommended not eating for the entire journey
D)
原词陷阱
avoiding sleeping on the plane 盗用录音 avoiding sleeping on the plane 的原词，但这与 C 一样属男士转述的专家建议、令他吃惊的内容，并不是他点名"有趣"的那部分（有趣的是克服时差整块），属原词陷阱。
借用原文：avoiding sleeping on the plane

stem: What does the man say he will do next time he flies a long distance?

options.text: Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone.
Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger.
Concentrate on reading articles recommended by experts.
Try following the advice given by the expert on the show.

explanation:
【题目】What does the man say he will do next time he flies a long distance?
【翻译】男士说他下次长途飞行时会做什么?
A) 小睡一会儿以适应新时区。
B) 像平常一样进餐以避免饥饿。
C) 专注阅读专家推荐的文章。
D) 尝试遵循节目中专家给出的建议。
【答案】D （细节题）Try following the advice given by the expert on the show.
【定位】the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations, so I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance.
节目里的那位专家确实引用了支持她建议的研究，所以我想下次长途飞行时我会试试看。
【信号】表打算的信号 I'll give it a try + 时间短语 next time。I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance 里的 I'll give it a try 是典型"打算"信号，又带 next time I fly a long distance 与题干时间完全吻合，是锁定答案句的双重信号。
【替换】give it a try ↔Try following the advice
give it a try=try following，照建议试一试
the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations ↔ the advice given by the expert on the show
her recommendations=the advice，同为专家建议

【排除】A)
张冠李戴
Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone 盗用了女士那句 taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone 的原词，但那是女士转述"过去文章"的主张，且专家恰恰建议"不要睡"，并非男士下次要做的事，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone
B)
张冠李戴
Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger 对应女士读到的旧观点 it was important not to miss meals，而男士打算照的是"专家建议"，专家主张是 not eating ——男士要做的恰与 B 相反，属张冠李戴兼与原文相反。
借用原文：it was important not to miss meals
C)
偷换概念
Concentrate on reading articles recommended by experts 把录音里的 expert 与 W 提到的 an article on the subject 拼在一起，造出"读专家推荐的文章"，但男士说的是 give it a try（照建议试做），并非去读文章，属偷换概念。
借用原文：I read an article on the subject in the past

stem: Why does the woman think she is lucky?

options.text: She does not have any problem flying.
She can spend a lot of time vacationing.
She does not have to worry about jetlag.
She has been well treated when traveling.

explanation:
【题目】Why does the woman think she is lucky?
【翻译】女士为什么认为自己很幸运?
A) 她乘飞机没有任何问题。
B) 她可以花大量时间度假。
C) 她不必担心时差反应。
D) 她在旅行时得到了很好的待遇。
【答案】C （细节题）She does not have to worry about jetlag.
【定位】she did say that jetlag often becomes more of a problem after 40, so I guess I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well.
她确实说过时差在 40 岁以后往往会变成更大的问题，所以我想我算幸运，因为我还能很好地适应不同的时区。
【信号】标志词 I'm lucky + that 引出理由。I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well 里 I'm lucky 直接对应题干 lucky，紧跟的 that 从句给出理由——这个"幸运 + that 理由"结构就是答案句信号。
【替换】I can still adjust to different time zones well ↔She does not have to worry about jetlag
能适应时区=不必担心时差，肯否定转换

【排除】A)
与原文相反
She does not have any problem flying 与原文相反：女士紧接着说 My problem is I'm afraid to fly，明说自己有怕飞的问题，所以"飞行无问题"是反着说的，且她的幸运也不是指这点。
借用原文：My problem is I'm afraid to fly
B)
未提及
She can spend a lot of time vacationing 里 vacation 蹭了后文男士提到的 our family vacations，但那是男士讲自家度假方式，女士的幸运与"能度很多假"毫无关系，属未提及。
借用原文：our family vacations were always by car or train
D)
未提及
She has been well treated when traveling"旅行中受优待"在整段录音里没有任何对应内容，与女士的幸运（能适应时区）也不搭，属凭空捏造。
