stem: What are Foulkes' findings about kids' dreams?

options.text: They feature strange animals.
They are unsurprising to adults.
They grow and evolve with age.
They reflect kids' waking life.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What are Foulkes' findings about kids' dreams? 直接问研究结论是什么，是细节题。
【拆句】Q54 结构是 "What are Foulkes' findings about kids' dreams?"，about kids' dreams限定 findings 的范围，没有从句也没有否定，无陷阱。
【定位】Foulkes' findings are unsurprising. Basically, little kids have little dreams. But exactly what kids see while dreaming depends on their age. As children develop and grow, their dreams do too.
Foulkes 的发现并不令人意外。本质上，小孩做的也是小梦。但孩子在梦中究竟看到什么，取决于他们的年龄。随着孩子的发育成长，他们的梦也在发育成长。
【选项】A)
以偏概全
They heavily feature animals and other familiar sights 只说幼儿梦多含动物等"熟悉景象"，They feature strange animals 把动物拔成 "strange animals" 且当成所有孩子梦的特征。
B)
答非所问
题问 findings 的内容；They are unsurprising to adults. 拿原文 "unsurprising" 的评价词当做内容，Foulkes' findings are unsurprising 的 unsurprising 是对 "findings 本身" 的评价，而非 findings 的实质内容。
C)
✓ 正确
As children develop and grow, their dreams do too ↔They grow and evolve with age.
预判 "梦随孩子发育而发育" 与 They grow and evolve with age. 完全对应，选 C。
D)
偷换概念
原文 Children's dream life…seems to be similar to their waking imagination and narration 的相似对象是 "清醒时的想象与叙事"，They reflect kids' waking life. 把 "想象/叙事" 偷换成 "waking life"（清醒生活本身）。

stem: What can we assume about babies who appear upset upon waking?

They have trouble recollecting the images of their dreams.
They have been affected by something other than dreaming.

explanation:

【定位】So, if your baby seems to be in a stressful state while sleeping or is upset upon waking, there may be other factors at play.
因此，如果你的婴儿睡觉时显得紧张、或一醒来就不安，那很可能是别的因素在起作用。
【选项】A)
无中生有

与原文相反
原文 babies do not have nightmares 明确说婴儿不做噩梦；They have been disturbed by a nightmare. 反着说婴儿被噩梦惊扰。

答非所问
题问 "哭醒原因"，They have trouble recollecting the images of their dreams. 把焦点换成 "回忆梦境困难"，且 25% of the kids in Foulkes' studies had no recollection of dreaming 说的是 5-9 岁孩子，而非 "babies"。
D)
✓ 正确

explanation:
26. on either April 22 or the day the spring equinox( 春分) occurs throughout the __(26)__ of the world.
【答案】M) rest
名词
【词性槽】the ___ of the world：定冠词 + 空 + of，典型名词位
【依据】the rest of the world：固定搭配，指"世界其余地方"
本句对比的是"美国（the United States）"和"世界其他地方"两部分——Earth Day is celebrated on April 22 in the United States and on either April 22 or the day the spring equinox(春分) occurs throughout the __(26)__ of the world. "the rest of the world"（世界其余地方）正是这种二分对照的固定表达，语义和搭配双双吻合。
【竞争词】A) concerns concerns of the world 语义错位
concerns 意为"关切事项"，"the concerns of the world"指"世界的关切问题"，与本句"在世界其余地方庆祝"的地理范围语义完全不搭。
B) expansion expansion 指"扩张"，与对比语境不合
the expansion of the world 意为"世界的扩张"，原文要表达的是"美国 vs 世界其他地方"的地域对比，扩张没有对照含义，不通。
D) geography geography 偏"地理学/地形"，不指"其余地区"
the geography of the world 通常指"世界的地理（地形地貌）"，强调地理特征，无法承担"美国以外的其他地方"这层"其余"含义。
E) importance importance 是抽象"重要性"，与地点状语冲突
the importance of the world 意为"世界的重要性"，但本句是 throughout 引导的地点范围状语，需要的是"地方"概念，importance 完全跑题。
I) partners partners 复数指"合作伙伴们"，与 the…of the world 不搭
the partners of the world 不是一个自然搭配，且 throughout "遍及"后接的是地理范围、不是人群。
J) potential potential 指"潜力"，不能承载"地方"语义
the potential of the world 意为"世界的潜力"，与 throughout 表达"在……各地"的地点范围意义不一致。
L) rescues rescues 指"救援"，与本句话题彻底无关
the rescues of the world"世界的救援"在本句完全无依据，地球日叙述中并未涉及救援行动。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 J) —— potential 沾边但抓不准因果。educating participants in the __(29)__ of environmental protection 极易因为"the potential of"也是地道搭配而误选 J；防坑要诀：往下读一句，看下文落点是"推动立法"——要让人去推动立法，必须先认识到事情的"重要性"（importance）而不是"潜力"，因果链才接得上。

D I S T R A C T O R S · 干扰词复盘
这 5 个词始终没被任何空选用
词库 15 词里有 5 个是命题人埋的干扰词——它们词性看着也对、词义也沾点边，却不该填进任何一个空。下面逐个剖析它们最像哪个空的答案、为什么是陷阱。
B) expansion 最像 26 题答案：与 the…of 框架形式贴合
expansion 是名词，在 throughout the __(26)__ of the world 里乍看 the expansion of the world 也符合"the+名词+of"框架，但语义上"世界的扩张"与 throughout 引导的地点范围彻底冲突——识破方法：固定搭配 the rest of the world 在英语里地位远高，且对照"the United States vs 其余地方"的二分逻辑只能选 rest。
C) forth 最像 31 题答案：同为副词、且 bring forth 是真实短语
31 题 Earth Day now brings __(31)__ citizens and activists from around the world 里 brings 后接副词，bring forth 也是真存在的动副短语，容易被选成 C；但 bring forth 后接的是"想法/结果/产物"，本空后接"人"，搭配按宾语类型一卡，立刻倒向 together。
F) imposed 最像 27/30 两道动词空：同为过去式动词
imposed 与 inspired/strengthened 都是 -ed 结尾的过去式动词，27 题 __(27)__ Wisconsin Senator Gaylord Nelson to create 和 30 题 the event __(30)__ support 都可能误选 F；识破方法——impose的典型结构是 impose sth on sb，不能直接跟 sb to do；且语义偏"强加（中性/负面）"，与本段"环保正面推动"的叙述色彩冲突。
J) potential 最像 29 题答案：与 environmental protection 沾边
educating participants in the __(29)__ of environmental protection 里 the potential of environmental protection"环保的潜力"看似讲得通，但下文 strengthened support for legislation这条因果链要求的起点是"让人意识到重要性"才会去支持立法，importance 比 potential 更紧贴；识破方法——把候选代回去，看与下文因果是否衔接。
L) rescues 最像 33 题答案：复数名词形式与 organizations 形式相称
33 题 rallies more than 20,000 __(33)__ and organizations in 190 countries 中 rescues 也是复数名词，形式上能塞进去，但语义类别错——organizations 是"参与主体"，并列项也必须是"主体"，rescues"救援行动"是事件，类别不符；识破方法——并列同类律。

We can rail against "ageism" all we like. It gets us nowhere. And it's easy to forget that
Bottom line? Yes, it really can be difficult getting a new job after age 45, let alone cha

stem: What do we learn about New York's Eleven Madison Park?

options.text: It is the first vegan restaurant to receive the highest Michelin rating.
It is the first restaurant in the city to remove meat from its menu.
It was famed throughout the U.S. for its fancy regional dishes.
It was established as a three-star Michelin restaurant in 2011.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about New York's Eleven Madison Park? 问的是关于某对象的客观信息，没有 infer/imply 等推断信号，属典型细节题。
【拆句】What do we learn about New York's Eleven Madison Park? 是一句结构平铺直叙的特殊疑问句，learn about 后跟宾语，无陷阱。
【定位】New York's Eleven Madison Park has become the first vegan(素食主义的) restaurant to be awarded three Michelin stars.
纽约的 Eleven Madison Park 成为首家获颁米其林三星的素食餐厅。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
the first vegan(素食主义的) restaurant to be awarded three Michelin stars ↔ the first vegan restaurant to receive the highest Michelin rating
It is the first vegan restaurant to receive the highest Michelin rating. 完整覆盖了预判的三要素，首家、素食、最高评级，且无任何额外信息，与定位句一一对应。
B)
偷换概念
原文说的是首家获三星的素食餐厅，the first restaurant in the city to remove meat from its menu 把首家偷换到了全市首家撤肉上，原文并无此说。
C)
无中生有
原文 famed for its fancy animal-based dishes 说的是过去以荤菜闻名，famed throughout the U.S. for its fancy regional dishes 一改 animal-based 为 regional（地方菜），二加范围 throughout the U.S.（全美），都无原文支持。
D)
偷换概念
原文 received its first three-star Michelin rating in 2011 说的是 2011 年首次获三星，established as a three-star Michelin restaurant in 2011 把获评偷换成建立，与原文 its nearly 25-year history 也矛盾。

stem: Why did Daniel Humm decide to remove meat from the menu of his restaurant?

options.text: To encourage more customers to be vegan.
To contribute to a sustainable food system.
To show the appeal of a plant-based menu.
To strive for the three-star Michelin rating.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】Why did Daniel Humm decide to remove meat from the menu of his restaurant? 用Why 直接问原因，对应原文必有显性的原因表述。
【拆句】Why did Daniel Humm decide to remove meat from the menu of his restaurant? 主干为 Why did X decide to do Y，decide to 后接动作，无修饰陷阱。
【定位】However, last year, the restaurant's co-owner and famous chef, Daniel Humm, made the bold decision to remove meat from the menu, citing our unsustainable food system.
然而，去年餐厅的联合所有者兼名厨 Daniel Humm 做出了大胆决定，将肉从菜单中撤下，理由是我们的食物体系不可持续。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
To encourage more customers to be vegan. 把动机应对不可持续体系偷换成鼓励顾客吃素，原文 Humm 的关注点是体系层面而非顾客饮食选择。
B)
✓ 正确
citing our unsustainable food system ↔To contribute to a sustainable food system.
四个选项中只有 To contribute to a sustainable food system. 含 sustainable 这个原文核心词根，且其表达的目的与 citing 的事实方向自洽。
C)
答非所问
If we can show the possibilities of eating plant-based food in this setting, it can open a lot of doors 是 Humm 对该决定后续效果的展望，而非他做决定的原因，时间和因果关系都被改写。
D)
与原文相反
三星米其林是撤肉之后才获得的结果，To strive for the three-star Michelin rating. 把它说成做决定的目的，因果关系与原文相反。

stem: What did Daniel Humm think of his move to a meat-free menu?

options.text: It was a worthwhile effort even though he was unsure of its success.
It would set a model for many more restaurants to follow.
It was a mad gamble few chefs in the fine dining world would risk taking.
It would prove a right step to take in today's catering business.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What did Daniel Humm think of his move to a meat-free menu? 问的是 Humm 自己怎么看，原文必有他直接表态的引语。
【拆句】What did Daniel Humm think of his move to a meat-free menu? think of 是固定搭配，意为对...的看法，主干清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】At the time, Humm acknowledged the move was risky, admitting that "it wasn't clear if guests would come", but called the gamble "a risk worth taking."
当时 Humm 承认此举有风险，承认不清楚客人是否还会来，但他把这场赌博称作一次值得冒的险。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
it wasn't clear if guests would come ↔he was unsure of its success
a risk worth taking ↔a worthwhile effort
It was a worthwhile effort even though he was unsure of its success. 用 even though 把值得与不确定连起来，恰好对应原文 but 引出的双面态度。
B)
答非所问
It would set a model for many more restaurants to follow. 是 Humm 在 it can open a lot of doors 中说的对外效用，而非他对自己这一举动的内心评价。
C)
过度推断
a mad gamble few chefs in the fine dining world would risk taking 用 mad、few chefs would risk 把原文的 risky 与 a risk worth taking 夸大成几乎没人敢冒的疯狂赌博，原文 Humm 并未做此横向比较。
D)
偷换概念
It would prove a right step to take in today's catering business. 把 Humm 对自己这一步的个人评价换成对整个餐饮业的判断，且 a right step 也比 a risk worth taking多了行业普遍正确的隐含。

stem: What does Michelin's 2022 New York guide say about Eleven Madison Park's decision?

options.text: It elevates the restaurant's cooking to an art form.
It proves the validity of ratings awarded by Michelin.
It shows a daring foresight regarding future fine dining.
It is an effort to transform the restaurant into a luxury one.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What does Michelin's 2022 New York guide say about Eleven Madison Park's decision? 问指南说了什么，对应原文必有指南的引语或转述。
【拆句】What does Michelin's 2022 New York guide say about Eleven Madison Park's decision? say about 后接讨论对象，结构线性、无陷阱。
【定位】Now, this impressive new accomplishment validates Eleven Madison Park's decision to take meat off the menu and embrace plant-based foods, with Michelin's 2022 New York guide branding it 'a bold vision of luxury dining'.
如今，这一令人瞩目的新成就印证了 Eleven Madison Park 撤肉、拥抱植物饮食的决定；米其林 2022 纽约指南将其誉为奢华餐饮的大胆愿景。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
It elevates the restaurant's cooking to an art form. 取自 Their cooking is elevated to an art form，而那是米其林对三星厨师的总体描述，不是 2022 纽约指南对 Eleven Madison Park 这个决定的表态。
B)
与原文相反
It proves the validity of ratings awarded by Michelin. 把指南怎么说决定颠倒为决定证明了米其林评级的有效性，原文 validates 的对象是 decision，而不是评级。
C)
✓ 正确
a bold vision of luxury dining ↔a daring foresight regarding future fine dining
It shows a daring foresight regarding future fine dining. 同时给出大胆远见与高端、未来餐饮两个要素，且整体语气与原文引号短语一致。
D)
无中生有
It is an effort to transform the restaurant into a luxury one. 把指南的评价改成餐厅的主观努力（an effort to），且新增把餐厅变成奢华餐厅这一目的，原文从未提及。

stem: What does the awarding of three Michelin stars to Eleven Madison Park indicate?

options.text: An optimistic vision of vegan foods becoming mainstream.
A greater responsibility for the culinary world to undertake.
A strong incentive for more restaurants to offer healthier foods to their customers.
An explicit recognition of the rising importance of restaurants serving vegan foods.

explanation:
【答案】D （推断题）
【判型】What does the awarding of three Michelin stars to Eleven Madison Park indicate? 中的 indicate 是推断题专属信号词。
【拆句】What does the awarding of three Michelin stars to Eleven Madison Park indicate? 主干为 What does X indicate，X 是动名词短语 the awarding of...，结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】"Their cooking is elevated to an art form and some of their dishes are destined to become classics," reads Michelin's website, in a clear nod to plant-based foods' growing significance in the culinary(烹饪的) world.
米其林官网写道：他们的烹饪被提升为一种艺术形式，他们的部分菜肴注定将成为经典；这是对植物饮食在烹饪界日益增长的重要性的明确认可。
【选项】A)
过度推断
An optimistic vision of vegan foods becoming mainstream. 把地位上升（rising importance）推到成为主流（becoming mainstream），且加上乐观愿景，跨度超过原文一步可达的范围。
B)
答非所问
A greater responsibility for the culinary world to undertake. 取自 luxury companies have a real role to play and a responsibility 这种 Humm 的呼吁，而非授星事件本身所表明的含义。
C)
偷换概念
A strong incentive for more restaurants to offer healthier foods to their customers. 一把素食或植物偷换成更健康的食物（healthier foods），二把地位上升变成激励更多餐厅，原文从未谈健康层面，也未谈对其他餐厅的激励效应。
D)
✓ 正确
in a clear nod to plant-based foods' growing significance in the culinary(烹饪的) world ↔ An explicit recognition of the rising importance of restaurants serving vegan foods.
An explicit recognition of the rising importance of restaurants serving vegan foods. 仅把植物饮食地位上升在表达载体上落到提供素食的餐厅，恰是从授星事件能合理外推的一步，无超过原文的判断。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第1篇解析.pdf 第6页

stem: What does the passage say is of importance regarding genetic tests?

options.text: Knowing their accuracy.
Evaluating their applicability.
Utilizing the information they provide.
Weighing the consequences they have.

explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
【判型】What does the passage say is of importance regarding genetic tests 直接问文章"说了什么"，没有 infer/imply 这种推断信号词，是查找型细节题。
【拆句】What does the passage say is of importance regarding genetic tests 主干是 "What does the passage say"，宾语从句省略了 that，完整化即 "the passage say (that) ... is of importance"，regarding genetic tests 是介词短语作话题限定，相当于 about。无陷阱。
【定位】Whether you are taking a DNA test to build your extended DNA family tree, or want precise information on inborn health conditions, it is important to understand how accurate genetic tests are, and what information we can rely upon.
无论你是为了构建延伸的 DNA 家谱树而做基因测试，还是想获得关于先天健康状况的精确信息，搞清楚基因检测到底有多准、我们可以依赖哪些信息，都是很重要的。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
it is important to understand how accurate genetic tests are ↔Knowing their accuracy
预判说"知道它准不准"，Knowing their accuracy 一字不差地说"知道它的准确度"，直接锁定 A。
B)
无中生有
Evaluating their applicability 中的 applicability（适用性/可用性）在 P1 里完全没提，作者只强调准确度。
C)
偷换概念
what information we can rely upon 说的是"哪些信息可以依赖"——是判断可不可信，而不是 Utilizing the information they provide 说的"利用它给出的信息"。
D)
无中生有
Weighing the consequences they have 里的 consequences（后果）在原文里没有任何对应——作者通篇只在谈准确度，没谈"后果"。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第2页

stem: What kind of genetic tests tend to be comparatively reliable?

options.text: Those complex enough to reveal the genetics behind a trait.
Those looking for traits responsible for certain diseases.
Those focusing on the specific questions being asked.
Those looking for traits determined by a single gene.

explanation:
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What kind of genetic tests tend to be comparatively reliable 是查询事实性比较，找到原文那句 "X 更可靠" 即可对答案。
【拆句】What kind of genetic tests tend to be comparatively reliable 中 "tend to be" 是"倾向于、往往是"的弱化系动词结构，相当于 are usually；comparatively 修饰 reliable，是"相对来说"，并非"绝对可靠"。
【定位】For example, tests for traits that depend on a single gene provide much more reliable results, because you can see whether a disease-causing trait is present.
举个例子，对于那些只依赖单个基因的性状，相关检测能给出准确得多的结果，因为你可以直接看到致病性状到底存不存在。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
Those complex enough to reveal the genetics behind a trait 说"复杂到能揭示性状背后基因"，原文却是"取决于单基因的简单情况更可靠"，方向相反。
B)
偷换概念
Those looking for traits responsible for certain diseases 抓住的是 a disease-causing trait——但原文里 "致病性状" 只是"为什么单基因检测可靠"的解释，不是"哪一类检测可靠"。
C)
偷换概念
Those focusing on the specific questions being asked 把 the specific question you ask 直接搬来，但原文那一句讲的是"准确度取决于问题"，不是"针对特定问题的检测更可靠"。
D)
✓ 正确
tests for traits that depend on a single gene ↔ Those looking for traits determined by a single gene
全篇只有 single gene 这一处出现"单基因"，且就配着 more reliable，预判和 D 完全对齐，锁定 D。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第3页
source_file: cet4/2025-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What do we learn about genetic health tests from the passage?

options.text: They are unable to identify certain hereditary diseases by themselves.
They are generally unable to separate genetic and non-genetic factors.
They cannot independently identify the majority of potential diseases.
They cannot tell apart the impact of lifestyle and that of the environment.

explanation:
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about genetic health tests from the passage 问的是文章"告诉我们什么"，属于事实查询，不是推断。
【拆句】What do we learn about genetic health tests from the passage 句式为 "learn about X from Y"——从 Y 中了解到关于 X 的什么；about 后是话题，from 后是来源。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】While certain rare diseases can be easily identified, most potential health conditions cannot be identified by genetic testing alone.
虽然某些罕见疾病能轻松识别出来，但大多数潜在的健康问题靠基因检测一项是查不出来的。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
They are unable to identify certain hereditary diseases by themselves 用 certain（某些）替换原文的 most（多数）——原文恰恰说 certain rare diseases can be easily identified，让步从句中的 certain rare 反而是"能识别的"，A 把它颠倒了。
B)
无中生有
They are generally unable to separate genetic and non-genetic factors 凭空加了"区分基因与非基因因素"这件事——原文只说健康状况受非基因因素影响，从未要求基因检测"区分"两者。
C)
✓ 正确
most potential health conditions cannot be identified by genetic testing alone ↔ They cannot independently identify the majority of potential diseases
predict 关键的"多数""靠它单独"两个限定词，C 选项用 the majority of 和independently 一一对应，且主语"基因健康检测"一致，无任何过度信息。
D)
偷换概念
They cannot tell apart the impact of lifestyle and that of the environment 把lifestyle 和 environment 单挑出来谈区分，但原文这两词只是 non-genetic factors, such as lifestyle, the environment, and many others 的举例，且 also 之后从未谈"区分两者影响"。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第4页
source_file: cet4/2025-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What makes genetic tests for multi-factorial traits tricky to interpret?

options.text: The challenge in determining the role of each individual gene.
The difficulty of foretelling how the various genes will interact.
The difficulty of telling genetic factors from environmental ones.
The enormous work to identify the hundreds of genes involved.

explanation:
【答案】B （细节题）
【判型】What makes genetic tests for multi-factorial traits tricky to interpret 是 What makes X Y 的句式，问的是事实层面的原因，原文里有现成原因句。
【拆句】What makes genetic tests for multi-factorial traits tricky to interpret 结构是 "make +宾语 + 形容词"——"使...变得难以解读"。What 作主语，问的是导致这件难事的原因；to interpret 是后置不定式作形容词补足语。
【定位】A test can look at many genes at once, but it's difficult to predict how they will play together.
一次基因检测可以同时查看许多基因，但很难预测这些基因放在一起会怎么"协作"。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
The challenge in determining the role of each individual gene 把"每个单基因的作用"塞进答案，但 each contributing a little to the outcome 只是顺带一提"每个贡献一点"，原文并没有说"难以确定每个基因的作用"。
B)
✓ 正确
it's difficult to predict how they will play together ↔ The difficulty of foretelling how the various genes will interact
整篇文章只有 P6 这一句用了 difficult to predict 的结构，预判"基因互动难以预测"严丝合缝地对应 B 选项的"预测基因如何相互作用的难度"，直接锁定。
C)
无中生有
The difficulty of telling genetic factors from environmental ones 编出"区分基因因素与环境因素"这件事——原文只说"还要把非基因因素也考虑进去"，从未要求"区分两者"。
D)
无中生有
The enormous work to identify the hundreds of genes involved 把焦点放到"识别这几百个基因的庞大工作量"——原文 hundreds of genes 只是说数量大，没说"识别它们工作量巨大"，也根本没说"工作量"才是"难解读"的原因。
answer_source: 阅读理解（四选一）第2篇解析.pdf 第5页
source_file: cet4/2025-12/第3套/PDF/阅读理解（四选一）第2篇真题.pdf

stem: What does the passage say about DNA tests to predict personality or talents?

options.text: They are solid scientific bases for application.
They are helpful in finding a romantic match.
They do not look promising at the moment.
They do not make any sense at present.

explanation:
【答案】D （态度题）
【判型】What does the passage say about DNA tests to predict personality or talents——配合选项里 do not look promising、do not make any sense 这种全是态度评价的格局，本质是问作者对这件事的态度。
【拆句】What does the passage say about DNA tests to predict personality or talents 中"DNA tests to predict ..." 的不定式 to predict 作 DNA tests 的后置定语，等于 "DNA tests that predict ..."——"用来预测人格或才能的 DNA 测试"。
【定位】Tests that offer to find your perfect romantic match and those claiming to predict personality or talents based on your DNA are pure nonsense. At the moment, the scientific bases for these applications are non-existent or incredibly weak.
那些声称能帮你找到完美恋爱对象的检测、以及那些号称能根据 DNA 预测性格或才能的检测，都是纯粹的胡说八道。眼下，这些应用的科学依据要么压根不存在，要么薄弱得离谱。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
They are solid scientific bases for application 说"是坚实的科学依据"，原文恰好说the scientific bases for these applications are non-existent or incredibly weak ——科学依据要么不存在要么极弱，方向完全相反。
B)
与原文相反
They are helpful in finding a romantic match 抓了原文里的另一个例子 find your perfect romantic match——但原文是把它当作"也是胡说"的反面例子，B 却说它"有帮助"，立场反了。
C)
偷换概念
They do not look promising at the moment 译过来是"目前看起来不太有前景"——但原文是 pure nonsense（纯属胡扯），属于强烈否定，C 把它弱化成"前景不佳"这种中性偏负的客气说法。
D)
✓ 正确
are pure nonsense ↔They do not make any sense at present
At the moment ↔at present
预判"作者强烈否定"对应 do not make any sense；at present 又把 at the moment这个时间限定带上了——D 一字不漏地把作者的核心态度搬过来了。
